verses.textZh: 在以法莲山地的拉玛．琐非，有一个以法莲人名叫以利加拿，是耶罗罕的儿子、以利户的孙子、托户的曾孙、苏弗的玄孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在以法莲山地的拉玛．琐非，有一个以法莲人名叫以利加拿，是耶罗罕的儿子、以利户的孙子、托户的曾孙、苏弗的玄孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲山地的拉玛‧琐非有一个以法莲人，名叫以利加拿，是苏弗的玄孙，托户的曾孙，以利户的孙子，耶罗罕的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: There was a certain man from Ramathaim, a Zuphite from the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Elkanah son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.
verses.textEnEsv: There was a certain man of Ramathaim-zophim of the hill country of Ephraim whose name was Elkanah the son of Jeroham, son of Elihu, son of Tohu, son of Zuph, an Ephrathite.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim Zophim, of the mountains of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.
verses.textEnNlt: There was a man named Elkanah who lived in Ramah in the region of Zuph in the hill country of Ephraim. He was the son of Jeroham, son of Elihu, son of Tohu, son of Zuph, of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was a man from Ramathaim-zophim from the hill country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.
verses.textEn: There was a certain man from Ramathaim, a Zuphite from the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Elkanah son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.

verses.textZh: 他有两个妻子，一个名叫哈拿，另一个名叫毘尼拿。毘尼拿有孩子，哈拿却没有孩子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他有两个妻子，一个名叫哈拿，另一个名叫毘尼拿。毘尼拿有孩子，哈拿却没有孩子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他有两个妻：一名哈拿，一名毗尼拿。毗尼拿有儿女，哈拿没有儿女。
verses.textEnNiv: He had two wives; one was called Hannah and the other Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah had none.
verses.textEnEsv: He had two wives. The name of the one was Hannah, and the name of the other, Peninnah. And Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he had two wives: the name of one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.
verses.textEnNlt: Elkanah had two wives, Hannah and Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah did not.
verses.textEnNasb: And he had two wives: the name of one was Hannah and the name of the other Peninnah; and Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.
verses.textEn: He had two wives; one was called Hannah and the other Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah had none.

verses.textZh: 这人每年都从他的本城上示罗去敬拜，献祭给万军之耶和华。在示罗有以利的两个儿子，何弗尼和非尼哈，作耶和华的祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这人每年都从他的本城上示罗去敬拜，献祭给万军之耶和华。在示罗有以利的两个儿子，何弗尼和非尼哈，作耶和华的祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 这人每年从本城上到示罗，敬拜祭祀万军之耶和华；在那里有以利的两个儿子何弗尼、非尼哈当耶和华的祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: Year after year this man went up from his town to worship and sacrifice to the Lord Almighty at Shiloh, where Hophni and Phinehas, the two sons of Eli, were priests of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Now this man used to go up year by year from his city to worship and to sacrifice to the Lord of hosts at Shiloh, where the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were priests of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: This man went up from his city yearly to worship and sacrifice to the Lord of hosts in Shiloh. Also the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of the Lord, were there.
verses.textEnNlt: Each year Elkanah would travel to Shiloh to worship and sacrifice to the Lord of Heaven’s Armies at the Tabernacle. The priests of the Lord at that time were the two sons of Eli—Hophni and Phinehas.
verses.textEnNasb: Now this man would go up from his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice to the Lord of armies in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were priests to the Lord there.
verses.textEn: Year after year this man went up from his town to worship and sacrifice to the Lord Almighty at Shiloh, where Hophni and Phinehas, the two sons of Eli, were priests of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 以利加拿在献祭的那天，就把祭肉分给妻子毘尼拿和她所有的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利加拿在献祭的那天，就把祭肉分给妻子毘尼拿和她所有的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利加拿每逢献祭的日子，将祭肉分给他的妻毗尼拿和毗尼拿所生的儿女；
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever the day came for Elkanah to sacrifice, he would give portions of the meat to his wife Peninnah and to all her sons and daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: On the day when Elkanah sacrificed, he would give portions to Peninnah his wife and to all her sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: And whenever the time came for Elkanah to make an offering, he would give portions to Peninnah his wife and to all her sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: On the days Elkanah presented his sacrifice, he would give portions of the meat to Peninnah and each of her children.
verses.textEnNasb: When the day came that Elkanah sacrificed, he would give portions to his wife Peninnah and to all her sons and daughters;
verses.textEn: Whenever the day came for Elkanah to sacrifice, he would give portions of the meat to his wife Peninnah and to all her sons and daughters.

verses.textZh: 但他只分给哈拿一分；他虽然爱哈拿 ，耶和华却使哈拿不能怀孕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他只分给哈拿一分；他虽然爱哈拿 ，耶和华却使哈拿不能怀孕。
verses.textZhCuv: 给哈拿的却是双分，因为他爱哈拿。无奈耶和华不使哈拿生育。
verses.textEnNiv: But to Hannah he gave a double portion because he loved her, and the Lord had closed her womb.
verses.textEnEsv: But to Hannah he gave a double portion, because he loved her, though the Lord had closed her womb.
verses.textEnNkjv: But to Hannah he would give a double portion, for he loved Hannah, although the Lord had closed her womb.
verses.textEnNlt: And though he loved Hannah, he would give her only one choice portion because the Lord had given her no children.
verses.textEnNasb: but to Hannah he would give a double portion, because he loved Hannah, but the Lord had closed her womb.
verses.textEn: But to Hannah he gave a double portion because he loved her, and the Lord had closed her womb.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华使哈拿不能怀孕，她的对头就尽力刺激她，使她苦恼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华使哈拿不能怀孕，她的对头就尽力刺激她，使她苦恼。
verses.textZhCuv: 毗尼拿见耶和华不使哈拿生育，就作她的对头，大大激动她，要使她生气。
verses.textEnNiv: Because the Lord had closed Hannah’s womb, her rival kept provoking her in order to irritate her.
verses.textEnEsv: And her rival used to provoke her grievously to irritate her, because the Lord had closed her womb.
verses.textEnNkjv: And her rival also provoked her severely, to make her miserable, because the Lord had closed her womb.
verses.textEnNlt: So Peninnah would taunt Hannah and make fun of her because the Lord had kept her from having children.
verses.textEnNasb: Her rival, moreover, would provoke her bitterly to irritate her, because the Lord had closed her womb.
verses.textEn: Because the Lord had closed Hannah’s womb, her rival kept provoking her in order to irritate her.

verses.textZh: 年年都是这样；每逢她上耶和华殿的时候，毘尼拿总是刺激哈拿，使她哭泣，吃不下饭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 年年都是这样；每逢她上耶和华殿的时候，毘尼拿总是刺激哈拿，使她哭泣，吃不下饭。
verses.textZhCuv: 每年上到耶和华殿的时候，以利加拿都以双分给哈拿；毗尼拿仍是激动她，以致她哭泣不吃饭。
verses.textEnNiv: This went on year after year. Whenever Hannah went up to the house of the Lord , her rival provoked her till she wept and would not eat.
verses.textEnEsv: So it went on year by year. As often as she went up to the house of the Lord , she used to provoke her. Therefore Hannah wept and would not eat.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, year by year, when she went up to the house of the Lord, that she provoked her; therefore she wept and did not eat.
verses.textEnNlt: Year after year it was the same—Peninnah would taunt Hannah as they went to the Tabernacle. Each time, Hannah would be reduced to tears and would not even eat.
verses.textEnNasb: And it happened year after year, as often as she went up to the house of the Lord, that she would provoke her; so she wept and would not eat.
verses.textEn: This went on year after year. Whenever Hannah went up to the house of the Lord , her rival provoked her till she wept and would not eat.

verses.textZh: 她的丈夫以利加拿对她说："哈拿，你为甚么哭泣？为甚么不吃饭，为甚么心里难过呢？你有我不是比有十个儿子更好吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她的丈夫以利加拿对她说："哈拿，你为甚么哭泣？为甚么不吃饭，为甚么心里难过呢？你有我不是比有十个儿子更好吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 她丈夫以利加拿对她说：「哈拿啊，你为何哭泣，不吃饭，心里愁闷呢？有我不比十个儿子还好吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Her husband Elkanah would say to her, "Hannah, why are you weeping? Why don’t you eat? Why are you downhearted? Don’t I mean more to you than ten sons?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Elkanah, her husband, said to her, "Hannah, why do you weep? And why do you not eat? And why is your heart sad? Am I not more to you than ten sons?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Elkanah her husband said to her, "Hannah, why do you weep? Why do you not eat? And why is your heart grieved? Am I not better to you than ten sons?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Why are you crying, Hannah?" Elkanah would ask. "Why aren’t you eating? Why be downhearted just because you have no children? You have me—isn’t that better than having ten sons?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Elkanah her husband would say to her, "Hannah, why do you weep, and why do you not eat, and why is your heart sad? Am I not better to you than ten sons?"
verses.textEn: Her husband Elkanah would say to her, "Hannah, why are you weeping? Why don’t you eat? Why are you downhearted? Don’t I mean more to you than ten sons?"

verses.textZh: 哈拿在示罗吃喝完了，就起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈拿在示罗吃喝完了，就起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在示罗吃喝完了，哈拿就站起来。祭司以利在耶和华殿的门框旁边，坐在自己的位上。
verses.textEnNiv: Once when they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh, Hannah stood up. Now Eli the priest was sitting on his chair by the doorpost of the Lord ’s house.
verses.textEnEsv: After they had eaten and drunk in Shiloh, Hannah rose. Now Eli the priest was sitting on the seat beside the doorpost of the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So Hannah arose after they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh. Now Eli the priest was sitting on the seat by the doorpost of the tabernacle of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Once after a sacrificial meal at Shiloh, Hannah got up and went to pray. Eli the priest was sitting at his customary place beside the entrance of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Hannah got up after eating and drinking in Shiloh. Now Eli the priest was sitting on the seat by the doorpost of the temple of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Once when they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh, Hannah stood up. Now Eli the priest was sitting on his chair by the doorpost of the Lord ’s house.

verses.textZh: 她心里愁苦，就向耶和华祷告，流泪痛哭，
verses.textZhCnvs: 她心里愁苦，就向耶和华祷告，流泪痛哭，
verses.textZhCuv: 哈拿心里愁苦，就痛痛哭泣，祈祷耶和华，
verses.textEnNiv: In her deep anguish Hannah prayed to the Lord , weeping bitterly.
verses.textEnEsv: She was deeply distressed and prayed to the Lord and wept bitterly.
verses.textEnNkjv: And she was in bitterness of soul, and prayed to the Lord and wept in anguish.
verses.textEnNlt: Hannah was in deep anguish, crying bitterly as she prayed to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: She, greatly distressed, prayed to the Lord and wept bitterly.
verses.textEn: In her deep anguish Hannah prayed to the Lord , weeping bitterly.

verses.textZh: 并且许愿，说："万军之耶和华啊，你若是看顾使女的困苦，记念我，不忘记你的使女，赐给使女一个儿子，我就必把他一生献给耶和华，不剃他的头。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且许愿，说："万军之耶和华啊，你若是看顾使女的困苦，记念我，不忘记你的使女，赐给使女一个儿子，我就必把他一生献给耶和华，不剃他的头。"
verses.textZhCuv: 许愿说：「万军之耶和华啊，你若垂顾婢女的苦情，眷念不忘婢女，赐我一个儿子，我必使他终身归与耶和华，不用剃头刀剃他的头。」
verses.textEnNiv: And she made a vow, saying, " Lord Almighty, if you will only look on your servant’s misery and remember me, and not forget your servant but give her a son, then I will give him to the Lord for all the days of his life, and no razor will ever be used on his head."
verses.textEnEsv: And she vowed a vow and said, "O Lord of hosts, if you will indeed look on the affliction of your servant and remember me and not forget your servant, but will give to your servant a son, then I will give him to the Lord all the days of his life, and no razor shall touch his head."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she made a vow and said, "O Lord of hosts, if You will indeed look on the affliction of Your maidservant and remember me, and not forget Your maidservant, but will give Your maidservant a male child, then I will give him to the Lord all the days of his life, and no razor shall come upon his head."
verses.textEnNlt: And she made this vow: "O Lord of Heaven’s Armies, if you will look upon my sorrow and answer my prayer and give me a son, then I will give him back to you. He will be yours for his entire lifetime, and as a sign that he has been dedicated to the Lord , his hair will never be cut. "
verses.textEnNasb: And she made a vow and said, "Lord of armies, if You will indeed look on the affliction of Your bond-servant and remember me, and not forget Your bond-servant, but will give Your bond-servant a son, then I will give him to the Lord all the days of his life, and a razor shall never come on his head."
verses.textEn: And she made a vow, saying, " Lord Almighty, if you will only look on your servant’s misery and remember me, and not forget your servant but give her a son, then I will give him to the Lord for all the days of his life, and no razor will ever be used on his head."

verses.textZh: 哈拿向耶和华祷告了很久，以利一直在注视她的嘴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈拿向耶和华祷告了很久，以利一直在注视她的嘴。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈拿在耶和华面前不住地祈祷，以利定睛看她的嘴。（
verses.textEnNiv: As she kept on praying to the Lord , Eli observed her mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: As she continued praying before the Lord , Eli observed her mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, as she continued praying before the Lord, that Eli watched her mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: As she was praying to the Lord , Eli watched her.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about, as she continued praying before the Lord, that Eli was watching her mouth.
verses.textEn: As she kept on praying to the Lord , Eli observed her mouth.

verses.textZh: 原来哈拿是在心中诉说，只见她的嘴唇在动，却听不见她的声音，因此以利以为她是个喝醉了的女人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来哈拿是在心中诉说，只见她的嘴唇在动，却听不见她的声音，因此以利以为她是个喝醉了的女人。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来哈拿心中默祷，只动嘴唇，不出声音，因此以利以为她喝醉了。）
verses.textEnNiv: Hannah was praying in her heart, and her lips were moving but her voice was not heard. Eli thought she was drunk
verses.textEnEsv: Hannah was speaking in her heart; only her lips moved, and her voice was not heard. Therefore Eli took her to be a drunken woman.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Hannah spoke in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard. Therefore Eli thought she was drunk.
verses.textEnNlt: Seeing her lips moving but hearing no sound, he thought she had been drinking.
verses.textEnNasb: As for Hannah, she was speaking in her heart, only her lips were quivering, but her voice was not heard. So Eli thought that she was drunk.
verses.textEn: Hannah was praying in her heart, and her lips were moving but her voice was not heard. Eli thought she was drunk

verses.textZh: 以利就对她说："你要醉到几时呢？快快醒过来吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利就对她说："你要醉到几时呢？快快醒过来吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利对她说：「你要醉到几时呢？你不应该喝酒。」
verses.textEnNiv: and said to her, "How long are you going to stay drunk? Put away your wine."
verses.textEnEsv: And Eli said to her, "How long will you go on being drunk? Put your wine away from you."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Eli said to her, "How long will you be drunk? Put your wine away from you!"
verses.textEnNlt: "Must you come here drunk?" he demanded. "Throw away your wine!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Eli said to her, "How long will you behave like a drunk? Get rid of your wine!"
verses.textEn: and said to her, "How long are you going to stay drunk? Put away your wine."

verses.textZh: 哈拿回答："我主啊，不是的。我是个心灵愁苦的妇人，淡酒烈酒都没有喝，只不过在耶和华面前倾吐我的心意。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈拿回答："我主啊，不是的。我是个心灵愁苦的妇人，淡酒烈酒都没有喝，只不过在耶和华面前倾吐我的心意。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈拿回答说：「主啊，不是这样。我是心里愁苦的妇人，清酒浓酒都没有喝，但在耶和华面前倾心吐意。
verses.textEnNiv: "Not so, my lord," Hannah replied, "I am a woman who is deeply troubled. I have not been drinking wine or beer; I was pouring out my soul to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: But Hannah answered, "No, my lord, I am a woman troubled in spirit. I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but I have been pouring out my soul before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: But Hannah answered and said, "No, my lord, I am a woman of sorrowful spirit. I have drunk neither wine nor intoxicating drink, but have poured out my soul before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Oh no, sir!" she replied. "I haven’t been drinking wine or anything stronger. But I am very discouraged, and I was pouring out my heart to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: But Hannah answered and said, "No, my lord, I am a woman despairing in spirit; I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but I have poured out my soul before the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Not so, my lord," Hannah replied, "I am a woman who is deeply troubled. I have not been drinking wine or beer; I was pouring out my soul to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 不要把你的使女看作不检点的女子，我因为极度愁苦和激动，才一直倾诉到现在。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要把你的使女看作不检点的女子，我因为极度愁苦和激动，才一直倾诉到现在。"
verses.textZhCuv: 不要将婢女看作不正经的女子。我因被人激动，愁苦太多，所以祈求到如今。」
verses.textEnNiv: Do not take your servant for a wicked woman; I have been praying here out of my great anguish and grief."
verses.textEnEsv: Do not regard your servant as a worthless woman, for all along I have been speaking out of my great anxiety and vexation."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Do not consider your maidservant a wicked woman, for out of the abundance of my complaint and grief I have spoken until now."
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t think I am a wicked woman! For I have been praying out of great anguish and sorrow."
verses.textEnNasb: Do not consider your bond-servant a useless woman, for I have spoken until now out of my great concern and provocation."
verses.textEn: Do not take your servant for a wicked woman; I have been praying here out of my great anguish and grief."

verses.textZh: 以利回答："平平安安回去吧！愿以色列的神把你向他所求的赐给你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利回答："平平安安回去吧！愿以色列的神把你向他所求的赐给你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利说：「你可以平平安安地回去。愿以色列的神允准你向他所求的！」
verses.textEnNiv: Eli answered, "Go in peace, and may the God of Israel grant you what you have asked of him."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Eli answered, "Go in peace, and the God of Israel grant your petition that you have made to him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Eli answered and said, "Go in peace, and the God of Israel grant your petition which you have asked of Him."
verses.textEnNlt: "In that case," Eli said, "go in peace! May the God of Israel grant the request you have asked of him."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Eli answered and said, "Go in peace; and may the God of Israel grant your request that you have asked of Him."
verses.textEn: Eli answered, "Go in peace, and may the God of Israel grant you what you have asked of him."

verses.textZh: 哈拿说："愿你的婢女在你眼前蒙恩！"于是这妇人回去，并且吃饭，脸上再没有愁容。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈拿说："愿你的婢女在你眼前蒙恩！"于是这妇人回去，并且吃饭，脸上再没有愁容。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈拿说：「愿婢女在你眼前蒙恩。」于是妇人走去吃饭，面上再不带愁容了。
verses.textEnNiv: She said, "May your servant find favor in your eyes." Then she went her way and ate something, and her face was no longer downcast.
verses.textEnEsv: And she said, "Let your servant find favor in your eyes." Then the woman went her way and ate, and her face was no longer sad.
verses.textEnNkjv: And she said, "Let your maidservant find favor in your sight." So the woman went her way and ate, and her face was no longer sad.
verses.textEnNlt: "Oh, thank you, sir!" she exclaimed. Then she went back and began to eat again, and she was no longer sad.
verses.textEnNasb: She said, "Let your bond-servant find favor in your sight." So the woman went on her way and ate, and her face was no longer sad.
verses.textEn: She said, "May your servant find favor in your eyes." Then she went her way and ate something, and her face was no longer downcast.

verses.textZh: 第二天，他们清早起来，在耶和华面前敬拜，然后回到他们的家乡拉玛，回到自己的家里去。以利加拿和妻子哈拿同房；耶和华顾念哈拿，
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，他们清早起来，在耶和华面前敬拜，然后回到他们的家乡拉玛，回到自己的家里去。以利加拿和妻子哈拿同房；耶和华顾念哈拿，
verses.textZhCuv: 次日清早，他们起来，在耶和华面前敬拜，就回拉玛。到了家里，以利加拿和妻哈拿同房，耶和华顾念哈拿，
verses.textEnNiv: Early the next morning they arose and worshiped before the Lord and then went back to their home at Ramah. Elkanah made love to his wife Hannah, and the Lord remembered her.
verses.textEnEsv: They rose early in the morning and worshiped before the Lord ; then they went back to their house at Ramah. And Elkanah knew Hannah his wife, and the Lord remembered her.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they rose early in the morning and worshiped before the Lord, and returned and came to their house at Ramah. And Elkanah knew Hannah his wife, and the Lord remembered her.
verses.textEnNlt: The entire family got up early the next morning and went to worship the Lord once more. Then they returned home to Ramah. When Elkanah slept with Hannah, the Lord remembered her plea,
verses.textEnNasb: Then they got up early in the morning and worshiped before the Lord, and returned again to their house in Ramah. And Elkanah had relations with Hannah his wife, and the Lord remembered her.
verses.textEn: Early the next morning they arose and worshiped before the Lord and then went back to their home at Ramah. Elkanah made love to his wife Hannah, and the Lord remembered her.

verses.textZh: 她就怀孕；时候到了，就生了一个儿子，哈拿给他起名叫撒母耳，因为她说："他是我从耶和华那里求来的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她就怀孕；时候到了，就生了一个儿子，哈拿给他起名叫撒母耳，因为她说："他是我从耶和华那里求来的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 哈拿就怀孕。日期满足，生了一个儿子，给他起名叫撒母耳，说：「这是我从耶和华那里求来的。」
verses.textEnNiv: So in the course of time Hannah became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She named him Samuel, saying, "Because I asked the Lord for him."
verses.textEnEsv: And in due time Hannah conceived and bore a son, and she called his name Samuel, for she said, "I have asked for him from the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: So it came to pass in the process of time that Hannah conceived and bore a son, and called his name Samuel, saying, "Because I have asked for him from the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: and in due time she gave birth to a son. She named him Samuel, for she said, "I asked the Lord for him."
verses.textEnNasb: It came about in due time, after Hannah had conceived, that she gave birth to a son; and she named him Samuel, saying, "Because I have asked for him of the Lord."
verses.textEn: So in the course of time Hannah became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She named him Samuel, saying, "Because I asked the Lord for him."

verses.textZh: 以利加拿和他全家都上示罗去，向耶和华献年祭和还所许的愿；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利加拿和他全家都上示罗去，向耶和华献年祭和还所许的愿；
verses.textZhCuv: 以利加拿和他全家都上示罗去，要向耶和华献年祭，并还所许的愿。
verses.textEnNiv: When her husband Elkanah went up with all his family to offer the annual sacrifice to the Lord and to fulfill his vow,
verses.textEnEsv: The man Elkanah and all his house went up to offer to the Lord the yearly sacrifice and to pay his vow.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the man Elkanah and all his house went up to offer to the Lord the yearly sacrifice and his vow.
verses.textEnNlt: The next year Elkanah and his family went on their annual trip to offer a sacrifice to the Lord and to keep his vow.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the man Elkanah went up with all his household to offer to the Lord the yearly sacrifice and to pay his vow.
verses.textEn: When her husband Elkanah went up with all his family to offer the annual sacrifice to the Lord and to fulfill his vow,

verses.textZh: 哈拿却没有上去，因为她对丈夫说："等孩子断了奶，我才带他去朝见耶和华。他要永远住在那里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈拿却没有上去，因为她对丈夫说："等孩子断了奶，我才带他去朝见耶和华。他要永远住在那里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 哈拿却没有上去，对丈夫说：「等孩子断了奶，我便带他上去朝见耶和华，使他永远住在那里。」
verses.textEnNiv: Hannah did not go. She said to her husband, "After the boy is weaned, I will take him and present him before the Lord , and he will live there always."
verses.textEnEsv: But Hannah did not go up, for she said to her husband, "As soon as the child is weaned, I will bring him, so that he may appear in the presence of the Lord and dwell there forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Hannah did not go up, for she said to her husband, "Not until the child is weaned; then I will take him, that he may appear before the Lord and remain there forever."
verses.textEnNlt: But Hannah did not go. She told her husband, "Wait until the boy is weaned. Then I will take him to the Tabernacle and leave him there with the Lord permanently. "
verses.textEnNasb: But Hannah did not go up, for she said to her husband, "I will not go until the child is weaned; then I will bring him, so that he may appear before the Lord and stay there for life."
verses.textEn: Hannah did not go. She said to her husband, "After the boy is weaned, I will take him and present him before the Lord , and he will live there always."

verses.textZh: 她丈夫以利加拿对她说："你看怎样好，就怎样作吧。你可以留在这里，等到你给孩子断了奶，但愿耶和华实现他的话。"于是哈拿留在家里乳养孩子，直到给他断了奶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她丈夫以利加拿对她说："你看怎样好，就怎样作吧。你可以留在这里，等到你给孩子断了奶，但愿耶和华实现他的话。"于是哈拿留在家里乳养孩子，直到给他断了奶。
verses.textZhCuv: 她丈夫以利加拿说：「就随你的意行吧！可以等儿子断了奶。但愿耶和华应验他的话。」于是妇人在家里乳养儿子，直到断了奶；
verses.textEnNiv: "Do what seems best to you," her husband Elkanah told her. "Stay here until you have weaned him; only may the Lord make good his word." So the woman stayed at home and nursed her son until she had weaned him.
verses.textEnEsv: Elkanah her husband said to her, "Do what seems best to you; wait until you have weaned him; only, may the Lord establish his word." So the woman remained and nursed her son until she weaned him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Elkanah her husband said to her, "Do what seems best to you; wait until you have weaned him. Only let the Lord establish His word." Then the woman stayed and nursed her son until she had weaned him.
verses.textEnNlt: "Whatever you think is best," Elkanah agreed. "Stay here for now, and may the Lord help you keep your promise. " So she stayed home and nursed the boy until he was weaned.
verses.textEnNasb: Elkanah her husband said to her, "Do what seems best to you. Stay until you have weaned him; only may the Lord confirm His word." So the woman stayed and nursed her son until she weaned him.
verses.textEn: "Do what seems best to you," her husband Elkanah told her. "Stay here until you have weaned him; only may the Lord make good his word." So the woman stayed at home and nursed her son until she had weaned him.

verses.textZh: 她给孩子断了奶之后，就带他一同上去，又带了一头三岁的公牛 、十公斤面和一皮袋酒。她把孩子带到示罗耶和华的殿那里；那时孩子还很小。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她给孩子断了奶之后，就带他一同上去，又带了一头三岁的公牛 、十公斤面和一皮袋酒。她把孩子带到示罗耶和华的殿那里；那时孩子还很小。
verses.textZhCuv: 既断了奶，就把孩子带上示罗，到了耶和华的殿；又带了三只公牛，一伊法细面，一皮袋酒。（那时，孩子还小。）
verses.textEnNiv: After he was weaned, she took the boy with her, young as he was, along with a three-year-old bull, an ephah of flour and a skin of wine, and brought him to the house of the Lord at Shiloh.
verses.textEnEsv: And when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, along with a three-year-old bull, an ephah of flour, and a skin of wine, and she brought him to the house of the Lord at Shiloh. And the child was young.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bulls, one ephah of flour, and a skin of wine, and brought him to the house of the Lord in Shiloh. And the child was young.
verses.textEnNlt: When the child was weaned, Hannah took him to the Tabernacle in Shiloh. They brought along a three-year-old bull for the sacrifice and a basket of flour and some wine.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with a three-year-old bull, one ephah of flour, and a jug of wine, and brought him to the house of the Lord in Shiloh, although the child was young.
verses.textEn: After he was weaned, she took the boy with her, young as he was, along with a three-year-old bull, an ephah of flour and a skin of wine, and brought him to the house of the Lord at Shiloh.

verses.textZh: 他们宰了公牛以后，就带孩子到以利那里，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们宰了公牛以后，就带孩子到以利那里，
verses.textZhCuv: 宰了一只公牛，就领孩子到以利面前。
verses.textEnNiv: When the bull had been sacrificed, they brought the boy to Eli,
verses.textEnEsv: Then they slaughtered the bull, and they brought the child to Eli.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they slaughtered a bull, and brought the child to Eli.
verses.textEnNlt: After sacrificing the bull, they brought the boy to Eli.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they slaughtered the bull, and brought the boy to Eli.
verses.textEn: When the bull had been sacrificed, they brought the boy to Eli,

verses.textZh: 妇人说："我主啊，我敢指着我主的性命起誓，我就是从前在这里站在你旁边，向耶和华祷告的那个妇人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 妇人说："我主啊，我敢指着我主的性命起誓，我就是从前在这里站在你旁边，向耶和华祷告的那个妇人。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人说：「主啊，我敢在你面前起誓，从前在你这里站着祈求耶和华的那妇人，就是我。
verses.textEnNiv: and she said to him, "Pardon me, my lord. As surely as you live, I am the woman who stood here beside you praying to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And she said, "Oh, my lord! As you live, my lord, I am the woman who was standing here in your presence, praying to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And she said, "O my lord! As your soul lives, my lord, I am the woman who stood by you here, praying to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Sir, do you remember me?" Hannah asked. "I am the very woman who stood here several years ago praying to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And she said, "Pardon me, my lord! As your soul lives, my lord, I am the woman who stood here beside you, praying to the Lord.
verses.textEn: and she said to him, "Pardon me, my lord. As surely as you live, I am the woman who stood here beside you praying to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 那时我祈求为要得这孩子，耶和华已经把我向他所求的赐给我了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时我祈求为要得这孩子，耶和华已经把我向他所求的赐给我了，
verses.textZhCuv: 我祈求为要得这孩子；耶和华已将我所求的赐给我了。
verses.textEnNiv: I prayed for this child, and the Lord has granted me what I asked of him.
verses.textEnEsv: For this child I prayed, and the Lord has granted me my petition that I made to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this child I prayed, and the Lord has granted me my petition which I asked of Him.
verses.textEnNlt: I asked the Lord to give me this boy, and he has granted my request.
verses.textEnNasb: For this boy I prayed, and the Lord has granted me my request which I asked of Him.
verses.textEn: I prayed for this child, and the Lord has granted me what I asked of him.

verses.textZh: 所以我现在把他献给耶和华，他的一生是属于耶和华的。"于是他就在那里敬拜耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我现在把他献给耶和华，他的一生是属于耶和华的。"于是他就在那里敬拜耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我将这孩子归与耶和华，使他终身归与耶和华。」 于是在那里敬拜耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: So now I give him to the Lord . For his whole life he will be given over to the Lord ." And he worshiped the Lord there.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I have lent him to the Lord . As long as he lives, he is lent to the Lord ." And he worshiped the Lord there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I also have lent him to the Lord; as long as he lives he shall be lent to the Lord." So they worshiped the Lord there.
verses.textEnNlt: Now I am giving him to the Lord , and he will belong to the Lord his whole life." And they worshiped the Lord there.
verses.textEnNasb: So I have also dedicated him to the Lord; as long as he lives he is dedicated to the Lord." And he worshiped the Lord there.
verses.textEn: So now I give him to the Lord . For his whole life he will be given over to the Lord ." And he worshiped the Lord there.

verses.textZh: 哈拿祷告说： "我的心因耶和华喜乐， 我的角因耶和华高举， 我的口向仇敌大大夸耀， 因为我以你的救恩为乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈拿祷告说： "我的心因耶和华喜乐， 我的角因耶和华高举， 我的口向仇敌大大夸耀， 因为我以你的救恩为乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈拿祷告说： 我的心因耶和华快乐； 我的角因耶和华高举。 我的口向仇敌张开； 我因耶和华的救恩欢欣。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Hannah prayed and said: "My heart rejoices in the Lord ; in the Lord my horn is lifted high. My mouth boasts over my enemies, for I delight in your deliverance.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hannah prayed and said, "My heart exults in the Lord ; my horn is exalted in the Lord . My mouth derides my enemies, because I rejoice in your salvation.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Hannah prayed and said: "My heart rejoices in the Lord; My horn is exalted in the Lord. I smile at my enemies, Because I rejoice in Your salvation.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Hannah prayed: "My heart rejoices in the Lord ! The Lord has made me strong. Now I have an answer for my enemies; I rejoice because you rescued me.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Hannah prayed and said, "My heart rejoices in the Lord; My horn is exalted in the Lord, My mouth speaks boldly against my enemies, Because I rejoice in Your salvation.
verses.textEn: Then Hannah prayed and said: "My heart rejoices in the Lord ; in the Lord my horn is lifted high. My mouth boasts over my enemies, for I delight in your deliverance.

verses.textZh: 没有人像耶和华那么圣洁， 因为除你以外没有别的神， 也没有盘石像我们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有人像耶和华那么圣洁， 因为除你以外没有别的神， 也没有盘石像我们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 只有耶和华为圣； 除他以外没有可比的， 也没有磐石像我们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: "There is no one holy like the Lord ; there is no one besides you; there is no Rock like our God.
verses.textEnEsv: "There is none holy like the Lord : for there is none besides you; there is no rock like our God.
verses.textEnNkjv: "No one is holy like the Lord, For thereis none besides You, Nor isthere any rock like our God.
verses.textEnNlt: No one is holy like the Lord ! There is no one besides you; there is no Rock like our God.
verses.textEnNasb: "There is no one holy like the Lord, Indeed, there is no one besides You, Nor is there any rock like our God.
verses.textEn: "There is no one holy like the Lord ; there is no one besides you; there is no Rock like our God.

verses.textZh: 你们不要多说骄傲的话， 也不要口出狂妄之言， 因为耶和华是全知的神， 人的一切行为他都鉴察。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不要多说骄傲的话， 也不要口出狂妄之言， 因为耶和华是全知的神， 人的一切行为他都鉴察。
verses.textZhCuv: 人不要夸口说骄傲的话， 也不要出狂妄的言语； 因耶和华是大有智识的神， 人的行为被他衡量。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not keep talking so proudly or let your mouth speak such arrogance, for the Lord is a God who knows, and by him deeds are weighed.
verses.textEnEsv: Talk no more so very proudly, let not arrogance come from your mouth; for the Lord is a God of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Talk no more so very proudly; Let no arrogance come from your mouth, For the Lordis the God of knowledge; And by Him actions are weighed.
verses.textEnNlt: "Stop acting so proud and haughty! Don’t speak with such arrogance! For the Lord is a God who knows what you have done; he will judge your actions.
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not go on boasting so very proudly, Do not let arrogance come out of your mouth; For the Lord is a God of knowledge, And with Him actions are weighed.
verses.textEn: "Do not keep talking so proudly or let your mouth speak such arrogance, for the Lord is a God who knows, and by him deeds are weighed.

verses.textZh: 勇士的弓都被折断， 跌倒的人却以力量束腰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 勇士的弓都被折断， 跌倒的人却以力量束腰。
verses.textZhCuv: 勇士的弓都已折断； 跌倒的人以力量束腰。
verses.textEnNiv: "The bows of the warriors are broken, but those who stumbled are armed with strength.
verses.textEnEsv: The bows of the mighty are broken, but the feeble bind on strength.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The bows of the mighty men are broken, And those who stumbled are girded with strength.
verses.textEnNlt: The bow of the mighty is now broken, and those who stumbled are now strong.
verses.textEnNasb: "The bows of the mighty are broken to pieces, But those who have stumbled strap on strength.
verses.textEn: "The bows of the warriors are broken, but those who stumbled are armed with strength.

verses.textZh: 饱足的，要劳碌觅食， 饥饿的，不再饥饿； 不能生育的，生了七个儿女， 有过许多儿女的，反倒衰微。
verses.textZhCnvs: 饱足的，要劳碌觅食， 饥饿的，不再饥饿； 不能生育的，生了七个儿女， 有过许多儿女的，反倒衰微。
verses.textZhCuv: 素来饱足的，反作用人求食； 饥饿的，再不饥饿。 不生育的，生了七个儿子； 多有儿女的，反倒衰微。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who were full hire themselves out for food, but those who were hungry are hungry no more. She who was barren has borne seven children, but she who has had many sons pines away.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who were full have hired themselves out for bread, but those who were hungry have ceased to hunger. The barren has borne seven, but she who has many children is forlorn.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thosewhowere full have hired themselves out for bread, And the hungry have ceased tohunger. Even the barren has borne seven, And she who has many children has become feeble.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who were well fed are now starving, and those who were starving are now full. The childless woman now has seven children, and the woman with many children wastes away.
verses.textEnNasb: "Those who were full hire themselves out for bread, But those who were hungry cease to be hungry. Even the infertile woman gives birth to seven, But she who has many children languishes.
verses.textEn: Those who were full hire themselves out for food, but those who were hungry are hungry no more. She who was barren has borne seven children, but she who has had many sons pines away.

verses.textZh: 耶和华使人死，也使人活； 使人下阴间，也使人从阴间上来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华使人死，也使人活； 使人下阴间，也使人从阴间上来。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华使人死，也使人活， 使人下阴间，也使人往上升。
verses.textEnNiv: "The Lord brings death and makes alive; he brings down to the grave and raises up.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord kills and brings to life; he brings down to Sheol and raises up.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord kills and makes alive; He brings down to the grave and brings up.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gives both death and life; he brings some down to the grave but raises others up.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord puts to death and makes alive; He brings down to Sheol and brings up.
verses.textEn: "The Lord brings death and makes alive; he brings down to the grave and raises up.

verses.textZh: 耶和华使人贫穷，也使人富足； 使人降卑，也使人升高。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华使人贫穷，也使人富足； 使人降卑，也使人升高。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使人贫穷，也使人富足， 使人卑微，也使人高贵。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord sends poverty and wealth; he humbles and he exalts.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord makes poor and makes rich; he brings low and he exalts.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord makes poor and makes rich; He brings low and lifts up.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord makes some poor and others rich; he brings some down and lifts others up.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord makes poor and rich; He humbles, He also exalts.
verses.textEn: The Lord sends poverty and wealth; he humbles and he exalts.

verses.textZh: 他从灰尘中抬举贫寒的人， 从粪堆中提拔穷乏的人， 使他们与显贵同坐， 承受尊贵的座位。 大地的柱子属于耶和华， 他把全地安放在柱子上面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从灰尘中抬举贫寒的人， 从粪堆中提拔穷乏的人， 使他们与显贵同坐， 承受尊贵的座位。 大地的柱子属于耶和华， 他把全地安放在柱子上面。
verses.textZhCuv: 他从灰尘里抬举贫寒人， 从粪堆中提拔穷乏人， 使他们与王子同坐， 得着荣耀的座位。 地的柱子属于耶和华； 他将世界立在其上。
verses.textEnNiv: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap; he seats them with princes and has them inherit a throne of honor. "For the foundations of the earth are the Lord ’s; on them he has set the world.
verses.textEnEsv: He raises up the poor from the dust; he lifts the needy from the ash heap to make them sit with princes and inherit a seat of honor. For the pillars of the earth are the Lord ’s, and on them he has set the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: He raises the poor from the dust And lifts the beggar from the ash heap, To set them among princes And make them inherit the throne of glory. "For the pillars of the earth are the Lord’s, And He has set the world upon them.
verses.textEnNlt: He lifts the poor from the dust and the needy from the garbage dump. He sets them among princes, placing them in seats of honor. For all the earth is the Lord ’s, and he has set the world in order.
verses.textEnNasb: "He raises the poor from the dust, He lifts the needy from the garbage heap To seat them with nobles, And He gives them a seat of honor as an inheritance; For the pillars of the earth are the Lord’s, And He set the world on them.
verses.textEn: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap; he seats them with princes and has them inherit a throne of honor. "For the foundations of the earth are the Lord ’s; on them he has set the world.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必保护虔诚人的脚步， 却使恶人在黑暗中灭亡， 因为人得胜不是靠着力量。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必保护虔诚人的脚步， 却使恶人在黑暗中灭亡， 因为人得胜不是靠着力量。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必保护圣民的脚步， 使恶人在黑暗中寂然不动； 人都不能靠力量得胜。
verses.textEnNiv: He will guard the feet of his faithful servants, but the wicked will be silenced in the place of darkness. "It is not by strength that one prevails;
verses.textEnEsv: "He will guard the feet of his faithful ones, but the wicked shall be cut off in darkness, for not by might shall a man prevail.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will guard the feet of His saints, But the wicked shall be silent in darkness. "For by strength no man shall prevail.
verses.textEnNlt: "He will protect his faithful ones, but the wicked will disappear in darkness. No one will succeed by strength alone.
verses.textEnNasb: "He watches over the feet of His godly ones, But the wicked ones are silenced in darkness; For not by might shall a person prevail.
verses.textEn: He will guard the feet of his faithful servants, but the wicked will be silenced in the place of darkness. "It is not by strength that one prevails;

verses.textZh: 至高者在天上打雷， 耶和华必打碎与他作对的人。 耶和华要审判地的四极， 却要赐力量给他所立的王， 高举他膏立之人的角。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 至高者在天上打雷， 耶和华必打碎与他作对的人。 耶和华要审判地的四极， 却要赐力量给他所立的王， 高举他膏立之人的角。"
verses.textZhCuv: 与耶和华争竞的，必被打碎； 耶和华必从天上以雷攻击他， 必审判地极的人， 将力量赐与所立的王， 高举受膏者的角。
verses.textEnNiv: those who oppose the Lord will be broken. The Most High will thunder from heaven; the Lord will judge the ends of the earth. "He will give strength to his king and exalt the horn of his anointed."
verses.textEnEsv: The adversaries of the Lord shall be broken to pieces; against them he will thunder in heaven. The Lord will judge the ends of the earth; he will give strength to his king and exalt the horn of his anointed."
verses.textEnNkjv: The adversaries of the Lord shall be broken in pieces; From heaven He will thunder against them. The Lord will judge the ends of the earth. "He will give strength to His king, And exalt the horn of His anointed."
verses.textEnNlt: Those who fight against the Lord will be shattered. He thunders against them from heaven; the Lord judges throughout the earth. He gives power to his king; he increases the strength of his anointed one."
verses.textEnNasb: "Those who contend with the Lord will be terrified; Against them He will thunder in the heavens, The Lord will judge the ends of the earth; And He will give strength to His king, And will exalt the horn of His anointed."
verses.textEn: those who oppose the Lord will be broken. The Most High will thunder from heaven; the Lord will judge the ends of the earth. "He will give strength to his king and exalt the horn of his anointed."

verses.textZh: 后来，以利加拿回拉玛自己的家去。那孩子却留在以利祭司面前事奉耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，以利加拿回拉玛自己的家去。那孩子却留在以利祭司面前事奉耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利加拿往拉玛回家去了。那孩子在祭司以利面前事奉耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Elkanah went home to Ramah, but the boy ministered before the Lord under Eli the priest.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Elkanah went home to Ramah. And the boy was ministering to the Lord in the presence of Eli the priest.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Elkanah went to his house at Ramah. But the child ministered to the Lord before Eli the priest.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elkanah returned home to Ramah without Samuel. And the boy served the Lord by assisting Eli the priest.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Elkanah went to his home at Ramah. But the boy continued to attend to the service of the Lord before Eli the priest.
verses.textEn: Then Elkanah went home to Ramah, but the boy ministered before the Lord under Eli the priest.

verses.textZh: 以利的两个儿子是无赖，不尊重耶和华，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利的两个儿子是无赖，不尊重耶和华，
verses.textZhCuv: 以利的两个儿子是恶人，不认识耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Eli’s sons were scoundrels; they had no regard for the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Now the sons of Eli were worthless men. They did not know the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the sons of Eli were corrupt; they did not know the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Now the sons of Eli were scoundrels who had no respect for the Lord
verses.textEnNasb: Now the sons of Eli were useless men; they did not know the Lord.
verses.textEn: Eli’s sons were scoundrels; they had no regard for the Lord .

verses.textZh: 也不理会当时祭司待人民的规矩。凡是有人献祭，在煮肉的时候，祭司的仆人就来，手里拿着三齿的叉，
verses.textZhCnvs: 也不理会当时祭司待人民的规矩。凡是有人献祭，在煮肉的时候，祭司的仆人就来，手里拿着三齿的叉，
verses.textZhCuv: 这二祭司待百姓是这样的规矩：凡有人献祭，正煮肉的时候，祭司的仆人就来，手拿三齿的叉子，
verses.textEnNiv: Now it was the practice of the priests that, whenever any of the people offered a sacrifice, the priest’s servant would come with a three-pronged fork in his hand while the meat was being boiled
verses.textEnEsv: The custom of the priests with the people was that when any man offered sacrifice, the priest’s servant would come, while the meat was boiling, with a three-pronged fork in his hand,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the priests’ custom with the people wasthat when any man offered a sacrifice, the priest’s servant would come with a three-pronged fleshhook in his hand while the meat was boiling.
verses.textEnNlt: or for their duties as priests. Whenever anyone offered a sacrifice, Eli’s sons would send over a servant with a three-pronged fork. While the meat of the sacrificed animal was still boiling,
verses.textEnNasb: And this was the custom of the priests with the people: when anyone was offering a sacrifice, the priest’s servant would come while the meat was cooking, with a three-pronged fork in his hand.
verses.textEn: Now it was the practice of the priests that, whenever any of the people offered a sacrifice, the priest’s servant would come with a three-pronged fork in his hand while the meat was being boiled

verses.textZh: 把叉子插入煎盘里，或鼎里，或釜里，或锅里，叉子插上来的，祭司都拿去。所有到示罗来的以色列人，祭司都是这样待他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把叉子插入煎盘里，或鼎里，或釜里，或锅里，叉子插上来的，祭司都拿去。所有到示罗来的以色列人，祭司都是这样待他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 将叉子往罐里，或鼎里，或釜里，或锅里一插，插上来的肉，祭司都取了去。凡上到示罗的以色列人，他们都是这样看待。
verses.textEnNiv: and would plunge the fork into the pan or kettle or caldron or pot. Whatever the fork brought up the priest would take for himself. This is how they treated all the Israelites who came to Shiloh.
verses.textEnEsv: and he would thrust it into the pan or kettle or cauldron or pot. All that the fork brought up the priest would take for himself. This is what they did at Shiloh to all the Israelites who came there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he would thrust it into the pan, or kettle, or caldron, or pot; and the priest would take for himself all that the fleshhook brought up. So they did in Shiloh to all the Israelites who came there.
verses.textEnNlt: the servant would stick the fork into the pot and demand that whatever it brought up be given to Eli’s sons. All the Israelites who came to worship at Shiloh were treated this way.
verses.textEnNasb: And he would thrust it into the pan, or kettle, or caldron, or pot; everything that the fork brought up, the priest would take for himself. They did so in Shiloh to all the Israelites who came there.
verses.textEn: and would plunge the fork into the pan or kettle or caldron or pot. Whatever the fork brought up the priest would take for himself. This is how they treated all the Israelites who came to Shiloh.

verses.textZh: 还有，在焚烧脂油以前，祭司的仆人就来，对献祭的人说："把祭肉交给祭司烧烤吧，因为他不会向你要煮过的肉，单要生的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有，在焚烧脂油以前，祭司的仆人就来，对献祭的人说："把祭肉交给祭司烧烤吧，因为他不会向你要煮过的肉，单要生的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又在未烧脂油以前，祭司的仆人就来对献祭的人说：「将肉给祭司，叫他烤吧。他不要煮过的，要生的。」
verses.textEnNiv: But even before the fat was burned, the priest’s servant would come and say to the person who was sacrificing, "Give the priest some meat to roast; he won’t accept boiled meat from you, but only raw."
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, before the fat was burned, the priest’s servant would come and say to the man who was sacrificing, "Give meat for the priest to roast, for he will not accept boiled meat from you but only raw."
verses.textEnNkjv: Also, before they burned the fat, the priest’s servant would come and say to the man who sacrificed, "Give meat for roasting to the priest, for he will not take boiled meat from you, but raw."
verses.textEnNlt: Sometimes the servant would come even before the animal’s fat had been burned on the altar. He would demand raw meat before it had been boiled so that it could be used for roasting.
verses.textEnNasb: Also, before they burned the fat, the priest’s servant would come and say to the man who was sacrificing, "Give the priest meat for roasting, as he will not take cooked meat from you, only raw."
verses.textEn: But even before the fat was burned, the priest’s servant would come and say to the person who was sacrificing, "Give the priest some meat to roast; he won’t accept boiled meat from you, but only raw."

verses.textZh: 如果那人对仆人说："必须先把脂油焚烧了，然后你才可以随意去拿。"他就说："不可以，你现在就要给我，否则我就抢去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果那人对仆人说："必须先把脂油焚烧了，然后你才可以随意去拿。"他就说："不可以，你现在就要给我，否则我就抢去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 献祭的人若说：「必须先烧脂油，然后你可以随意取肉。」仆人就说：「你立时给我，不然我便抢去。」
verses.textEnNiv: If the person said to him, "Let the fat be burned first, and then take whatever you want," the servant would answer, "No, hand it over now; if you don’t, I’ll take it by force."
verses.textEnEsv: And if the man said to him, "Let them burn the fat first, and then take as much as you wish," he would say, "No, you must give it now, and if not, I will take it by force."
verses.textEnNkjv: And if the man said to him, "They should really burn the fat first; then you may take asmuch as your heart desires," he would then answer him, "No, but you must give it now; and if not, I will take it by force."
verses.textEnNlt: The man offering the sacrifice might reply, "Take as much as you want, but the fat must be burned first." Then the servant would demand, "No, give it to me now, or I’ll take it by force."
verses.textEnNasb: And if the man said to him, "They must burn the fat first, then take as much as you desire," then he would say, "No, but you must give it to me now; and if not, I am taking it by force!"
verses.textEn: If the person said to him, "Let the fat be burned first, and then take whatever you want," the servant would answer, "No, hand it over now; if you don’t, I’ll take it by force."

verses.textZh: 这样，那两个青年人在耶和华面前所犯的罪很大，因为他们藐视献给耶和华的祭物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，那两个青年人在耶和华面前所犯的罪很大，因为他们藐视献给耶和华的祭物。
verses.textZhCuv: 如此，这二少年人的罪在耶和华面前甚重了，因为他们藐视耶和华的祭物 。
verses.textEnNiv: This sin of the young men was very great in the Lord ’s sight, for they were treating the Lord ’s offering with contempt.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus the sin of the young men was very great in the sight of the Lord , for the men treated the offering of the Lord with contempt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the sin of the young men was very great before the Lord, for men abhorred the offering of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So the sin of these young men was very serious in the Lord ’s sight, for they treated the Lord ’s offerings with contempt.
verses.textEnNasb: And so the sin of the young men was very great before the Lord, for the men treated the offering of the Lord disrespectfully.
verses.textEn: This sin of the young men was very great in the Lord ’s sight, for they were treating the Lord ’s offering with contempt.

verses.textZh: 那时，撒母耳还是个孩童，束着细麻布的以弗得，在耶和华面前事奉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，撒母耳还是个孩童，束着细麻布的以弗得，在耶和华面前事奉。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，撒母耳还是孩子，穿着细麻布的以弗得，侍立在耶和华面前。
verses.textEnNiv: But Samuel was ministering before the Lord —a boy wearing a linen ephod.
verses.textEnEsv: Samuel was ministering before the Lord , a boy clothed with a linen ephod.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Samuel ministered before the Lord, evenas a child, wearing a linen ephod.
verses.textEnNlt: But Samuel, though he was only a boy, served the Lord . He wore a linen garment like that of a priest.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Samuel was ministering before the Lord, as a boy wearing a linen ephod.
verses.textEn: But Samuel was ministering before the Lord —a boy wearing a linen ephod.

verses.textZh: 撒母耳的母亲每年为他做一件小外袍，她和丈夫一同上来献年祭的时候，就带来给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳的母亲每年为他做一件小外袍，她和丈夫一同上来献年祭的时候，就带来给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他母亲每年为他做一件小外袍，同着丈夫上来献年祭的时候带来给他。
verses.textEnNiv: Each year his mother made him a little robe and took it to him when she went up with her husband to offer the annual sacrifice.
verses.textEnEsv: And his mother used to make for him a little robe and take it to him each year when she went up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover his mother used to make him a little robe, and bring it to him year by year when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.
verses.textEnNlt: Each year his mother made a small coat for him and brought it to him when she came with her husband for the sacrifice.
verses.textEnNasb: And his mother would make for him a little robe and bring it up to him from year to year when she would come up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.
verses.textEn: Each year his mother made him a little robe and took it to him when she went up with her husband to offer the annual sacrifice.

verses.textZh: 以利给以利加拿和他的妻子祝福，说："愿耶和华从这妇人身上还给你后裔，代替你献给耶和华的孩子。"他们就回自己的地方去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利给以利加拿和他的妻子祝福，说："愿耶和华从这妇人身上还给你后裔，代替你献给耶和华的孩子。"他们就回自己的地方去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利为以利加拿和他的妻祝福，说：「愿耶和华由这妇人再赐你后裔，代替你从耶和华求来的孩子。」他们就回本乡去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife, saying, "May the Lord give you children by this woman to take the place of the one she prayed for and gave to the Lord ." Then they would go home.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife, and say, "May the Lord give you children by this woman for the petition she asked of the Lord ." So then they would return to their home.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife, and say, "The Lord give you descendants from this woman for the loan that was given to the Lord." Then they would go to their own home.
verses.textEnNlt: Before they returned home, Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife and say, "May the Lord give you other children to take the place of this one she gave to the Lord . "
verses.textEnNasb: Then Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife, and say, "May the Lord give you children from this woman in place of the one she requested of the Lord." And they went to their own home.
verses.textEn: Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife, saying, "May the Lord give you children by this woman to take the place of the one she prayed for and gave to the Lord ." Then they would go home.

verses.textZh: 耶和华眷顾哈拿，她再怀孕，先后生了三个儿子和两个女儿。那孩子撒母耳在耶和华面前，渐渐长大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华眷顾哈拿，她再怀孕，先后生了三个儿子和两个女儿。那孩子撒母耳在耶和华面前，渐渐长大。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华眷顾哈拿，她就怀孕生了三个儿子，两个女儿。那孩子撒母耳在耶和华面前渐渐长大。
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord was gracious to Hannah; she gave birth to three sons and two daughters. Meanwhile, the boy Samuel grew up in the presence of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Indeed the Lord visited Hannah, and she conceived and bore three sons and two daughters. And the boy Samuel grew in the presence of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord visited Hannah, so that she conceived and bore three sons and two daughters. Meanwhile the child Samuel grew before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord blessed Hannah, and she conceived and gave birth to three sons and two daughters. Meanwhile, Samuel grew up in the presence of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord indeed visited Hannah, and she conceived and gave birth to three sons and two daughters. And the boy Samuel grew up before the Lord.
verses.textEn: And the Lord was gracious to Hannah; she gave birth to three sons and two daughters. Meanwhile, the boy Samuel grew up in the presence of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 以利已经非常老了，听见自己的儿子对待以色列人的一切事，又听见他们与在会幕门口侍应的妇女同寝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利已经非常老了，听见自己的儿子对待以色列人的一切事，又听见他们与在会幕门口侍应的妇女同寝。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利年甚老迈，听见他两个儿子待以色列众人的事，又听见他们与会幕门前伺候的妇人苟合，
verses.textEnNiv: Now Eli, who was very old, heard about everything his sons were doing to all Israel and how they slept with the women who served at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Eli was very old, and he kept hearing all that his sons were doing to all Israel, and how they lay with the women who were serving at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Eli was very old; and he heard everything his sons did to all Israel, and how they lay with the women who assembled at the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: Now Eli was very old, but he was aware of what his sons were doing to the people of Israel. He knew, for instance, that his sons were seducing the young women who assisted at the entrance of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Eli was very old; and he heard about everything that his sons were doing to all Israel, and that they slept with the women who served at the doorway of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: Now Eli, who was very old, heard about everything his sons were doing to all Israel and how they slept with the women who served at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 以利就对他们说："你们为甚么作这些事？我亲自从众民那里听见了你们的恶行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利就对他们说："你们为甚么作这些事？我亲自从众民那里听见了你们的恶行。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就对他们说：「你们为何行这样的事呢？我从这众百姓听见你们的恶行。
verses.textEnNiv: So he said to them, "Why do you do such things? I hear from all the people about these wicked deeds of yours.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Why do you do such things? For I hear of your evil dealings from all these people.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said to them, "Why do you do such things? For I hear of your evil dealings from all the people.
verses.textEnNlt: Eli said to them, "I have been hearing reports from all the people about the wicked things you are doing. Why do you keep sinning?
verses.textEnNasb: So he said to them, "Why are you doing such things as these, the evil things that I hear from all these people?
verses.textEn: So he said to them, "Why do you do such things? I hear from all the people about these wicked deeds of yours.

verses.textZh: 我儿啊，不要这样，因为我听见的消息很不好，你们使耶和华的子民违背律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿啊，不要这样，因为我听见的消息很不好，你们使耶和华的子民违背律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿啊，不可这样！我听见你们的风声不好，你们使耶和华的百姓犯了罪。
verses.textEnNiv: No, my sons; the report I hear spreading among the Lord ’s people is not good.
verses.textEnEsv: No, my sons; it is no good report that I hear the people of the Lord spreading abroad.
verses.textEnNkjv: No, my sons! For itis not a good report that I hear. You make the Lord’s people transgress.
verses.textEnNlt: You must stop, my sons! The reports I hear among the Lord ’s people are not good.
verses.textEnNasb: No, my sons; for the report is not good which I hear the Lord’s people circulating.
verses.textEn: No, my sons; the report I hear spreading among the Lord ’s people is not good.

verses.textZh: 如果有人得罪人，有官长 惩罚他；如果有人得罪耶和华，有谁为他求情呢？"他们却不听父亲的话，因为耶和华有意要杀他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人得罪人，有官长 惩罚他；如果有人得罪耶和华，有谁为他求情呢？"他们却不听父亲的话，因为耶和华有意要杀他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若得罪人，有士师审判他；人若得罪耶和华，谁能为他祈求呢？」然而他们还是不听父亲的话，因为耶和华想要杀他们。
verses.textEnNiv: If one person sins against another, God may mediate for the offender; but if anyone sins against the Lord , who will intercede for them?" His sons, however, did not listen to their father’s rebuke, for it was the Lord ’s will to put them to death.
verses.textEnEsv: If someone sins against a man, God will mediate for him, but if someone sins against the Lord , who can intercede for him?" But they would not listen to the voice of their father, for it was the will of the Lord to put them to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: If one man sins against another, God will judge him. But if a man sins against the Lord, who will intercede for him?" Nevertheless they did not heed the voice of their father, because the Lord desired to kill them.
verses.textEnNlt: If someone sins against another person, God can mediate for the guilty party. But if someone sins against the Lord , who can intercede?" But Eli’s sons wouldn’t listen to their father, for the Lord was already planning to put them to death.
verses.textEnNasb: If one person sins against another, God will mediate for him; but if a person sins against the Lord, who can intercede for him?" But they would not listen to the voice of their father, for the Lord desired to put them to death.
verses.textEn: If one person sins against another, God may mediate for the offender; but if anyone sins against the Lord , who will intercede for them?" His sons, however, did not listen to their father’s rebuke, for it was the Lord ’s will to put them to death.

verses.textZh: 那孩子撒母耳的身量，耶和华和众人对他的喜爱，都不断增长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那孩子撒母耳的身量，耶和华和众人对他的喜爱，都不断增长。
verses.textZhCuv: 孩子撒母耳渐渐长大，耶和华与人越发喜爱他。
verses.textEnNiv: And the boy Samuel continued to grow in stature and in favor with the Lord and with people.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the boy Samuel continued to grow both in stature and in favor with the Lord and also with man.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the child Samuel grew in stature, and in favor both with the Lord and men.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the boy Samuel grew taller and grew in favor with the Lord and with the people.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the boy Samuel was continuing to grow and to be in favor both with the Lord and with people.
verses.textEn: And the boy Samuel continued to grow in stature and in favor with the Lord and with people.

verses.textZh: 有一位神人来见以利，对他说："耶和华这样说：‘你父家在埃及法老家为奴的时候，我不是向他们显现吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一位神人来见以利，对他说："耶和华这样说：‘你父家在埃及法老家为奴的时候，我不是向他们显现吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 有神人来见以利，对他说：「耶和华如此说：『你祖父在埃及法老家作奴仆的时候，我不是向他们显现吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Now a man of God came to Eli and said to him, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Did I not clearly reveal myself to your ancestor’s family when they were in Egypt under Pharaoh?
verses.textEnEsv: And there came a man of God to Eli and said to him, "Thus says the Lord , ‘Did I indeed reveal myself to the house of your father when they were in Egypt subject to the house of Pharaoh?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then a man of God came to Eli and said to him, "Thus says the Lord: ‘Did I not clearly reveal Myself to the house of your father when they were in Egypt in Pharaoh’s house?
verses.textEnNlt: One day a man of God came to Eli and gave him this message from the Lord : "I revealed myself to your ancestors when they were Pharaoh’s slaves in Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Then a man of God came to Eli and said to him, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Did I not indeed reveal Myself to the house of your father when they were in Egypt in bondage to Pharaoh’s house?
verses.textEn: Now a man of God came to Eli and said to him, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Did I not clearly reveal myself to your ancestor’s family when they were in Egypt under Pharaoh?

verses.textZh: 我不是从以色列众支派中，选出他们作我的祭司，上我的坛烧香，在我面前穿以弗得吗？我不是把以色列人所献的火祭，都赐给了你的父家吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我不是从以色列众支派中，选出他们作我的祭司，上我的坛烧香，在我面前穿以弗得吗？我不是把以色列人所献的火祭，都赐给了你的父家吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 在以色列众支派中，我不是拣选人作我的祭司，使他烧香，在我坛上献祭，在我面前穿以弗得，又将以色列人所献的火祭都赐给你父家吗？
verses.textEnNiv: I chose your ancestor out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to go up to my altar, to burn incense, and to wear an ephod in my presence. I also gave your ancestor’s family all the food offerings presented by the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: Did I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to go up to my altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before me? I gave to the house of your father all my offerings by fire from the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Did I not choose him out of all the tribes of Israel tobe My priest, to offer upon My altar, to burn incense, and to wear an ephod before Me? And did I not give to the house of your father all the offerings of the children of Israel made by fire?
verses.textEnNlt: I chose your ancestor Aaron from among all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to offer sacrifices on my altar, to burn incense, and to wear the priestly vest as he served me. And I assigned the sacrificial offerings to you priests.
verses.textEnNasb: Did I not choose them from all the tribes of Israel to be My priests, to go up to My altar, to burn incense, to carry an ephod before Me? And did I not give to the house of your father all the fire offerings of the sons of Israel?
verses.textEn: I chose your ancestor out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to go up to my altar, to burn incense, and to wear an ephod in my presence. I also gave your ancestor’s family all the food offerings presented by the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 你们为甚么轻视 我所吩咐要为我居所献上的祭牲和礼物呢？ 你为甚么尊重你的儿子过于尊重我，用我子民以色列所献一切最好的礼物自肥呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们为甚么轻视 我所吩咐要为我居所献上的祭牲和礼物呢？ 你为甚么尊重你的儿子过于尊重我，用我子民以色列所献一切最好的礼物自肥呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 我所吩咐献在我居所的祭物，你们为何践踏？尊重你的儿子过于尊重我，将我民以色列所献美好的祭物肥己呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: Why do you scorn my sacrifice and offering that I prescribed for my dwelling? Why do you honor your sons more than me by fattening yourselves on the choice parts of every offering made by my people Israel?’
verses.textEnEsv: Why then do you scorn my sacrifices and my offerings that I commanded for my dwelling, and honor your sons above me by fattening yourselves on the choicest parts of every offering of my people Israel?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do you kick at My sacrifice and My offering which I have commanded inMy dwelling place, and honor your sons more than Me, to make yourselves fat with the best of all the offerings of Israel My people?’
verses.textEnNlt: So why do you scorn my sacrifices and offerings? Why do you give your sons more honor than you give me—for you and they have become fat from the best offerings of my people Israel!
verses.textEnNasb: Why are you showing contempt for My sacrifice and My offering which I have commanded for My dwelling, and why are you honoring your sons above Me, by making yourselves fat with the choicest of every offering of My people Israel?’
verses.textEn: Why do you scorn my sacrifice and offering that I prescribed for my dwelling? Why do you honor your sons more than me by fattening yourselves on the choice parts of every offering made by my people Israel?’

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华以色列的神说：‘我曾说：你的家和你的父家，必永远行在我面前。’现在耶和华却说：‘我决不容你们这样行了，因为尊重我的，我必尊重他；藐视我的，必受到轻视。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华以色列的神说：‘我曾说：你的家和你的父家，必永远行在我面前。’现在耶和华却说：‘我决不容你们这样行了，因为尊重我的，我必尊重他；藐视我的，必受到轻视。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，耶和华－以色列的神说：『我曾说，你和你父家必永远行在我面前；现在我却说，决不容你们这样行。因为尊重我的，我必重看他；藐视我的，他必被轻视。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore the Lord , the God of Israel, declares: ‘I promised that members of your family would minister before me forever.’ But now the Lord declares: ‘Far be it from me! Those who honor me I will honor, but those who despise me will be disdained.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the Lord , the God of Israel, declares: ‘I promised that your house and the house of your father should go in and out before me forever,’ but now the Lord declares: ‘Far be it from me, for those who honor me I will honor, and those who despise me shall be lightly esteemed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the Lord God of Israel says: ‘I said indeed that your house and the house of your father would walk before Me forever.’ But now the Lord says: ‘Far be it from Me; for those who honor Me I will honor, and those who despise Me shall be lightly esteemed.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, the Lord , the God of Israel, says: I promised that your branch of the tribe of Levi would always be my priests. But I will honor those who honor me, and I will despise those who think lightly of me.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the Lord God of Israel declares, ‘I did indeed say that your house and the house of your father was to walk before Me forever’; but now the Lord declares, ‘Far be it from Me—for those who honor Me I will honor, and those who despise Me will be insignificant.
verses.textEn: "Therefore the Lord , the God of Israel, declares: ‘I promised that members of your family would minister before me forever.’ But now the Lord declares: ‘Far be it from me! Those who honor me I will honor, but those who despise me will be disdained.

verses.textZh: 日子快到了，我要砍下你和你父亲的膀臂，使你家中再没有有权势的长者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 日子快到了，我要砍下你和你父亲的膀臂，使你家中再没有有权势的长者。
verses.textZhCuv: 日子必到，我要折断你的膀臂和你父家的膀臂，使你家中没有一个老年人。
verses.textEnNiv: The time is coming when I will cut short your strength and the strength of your priestly house, so that no one in it will reach old age,
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the days are coming when I will cut off your strength and the strength of your father’s house, so that there will not be an old man in your house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, the days are coming that I will cut off your arm and the arm of your father’s house, so that there will not be an old man in your house.
verses.textEnNlt: The time is coming when I will put an end to your family, so it will no longer serve as my priests. All the members of your family will die before their time. None will reach old age.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, the days are coming when I will eliminate your strength and the strength of your father’s house, so that there will not be an old man in your house.
verses.textEn: The time is coming when I will cut short your strength and the strength of your priestly house, so that no one in it will reach old age,

verses.textZh: 我赐给以色列人的一切福分，你必像一个对头，以嫉妒的眼光来看；而在你的家中，必永远再没有有权势的长者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我赐给以色列人的一切福分，你必像一个对头，以嫉妒的眼光来看；而在你的家中，必永远再没有有权势的长者。
verses.textZhCuv: 在神使以色列人享福的时候，你必看见我居所的败落。在你家中必永远没有一个老年人。
verses.textEnNiv: and you will see distress in my dwelling. Although good will be done to Israel, no one in your family line will ever reach old age.
verses.textEnEsv: Then in distress you will look with envious eye on all the prosperity that shall be bestowed on Israel, and there shall not be an old man in your house forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you will see an enemy inMy dwelling place, despite all the good which God does for Israel. And there shall not be an old man in your house forever.
verses.textEnNlt: You will watch with envy as I pour out prosperity on the people of Israel. But no members of your family will ever live out their days.
verses.textEnNasb: And you will look at the distress of My dwelling, in spite of all the good that I do for Israel; and there will never be an old man in your house.
verses.textEn: and you will see distress in my dwelling. Although good will be done to Israel, no one in your family line will ever reach old age.

verses.textZh: 我必不从我的祭坛那里灭绝你家的人，免得你的眼睛昏花，心灵忧伤，但所有你家中增添的人都必像世人一样死去 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必不从我的祭坛那里灭绝你家的人，免得你的眼睛昏花，心灵忧伤，但所有你家中增添的人都必像世人一样死去 。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必不从我坛前灭尽你家中的人；那未灭的必使你眼目干瘪、心中忧伤。你家中所生的人都必死在中年。
verses.textEnNiv: Every one of you that I do not cut off from serving at my altar I will spare only to destroy your sight and sap your strength, and all your descendants will die in the prime of life.
verses.textEnEsv: The only one of you whom I shall not cut off from my altar shall be spared to weep his eyes out to grieve his heart, and all the descendants of your house shall die by the sword of men.
verses.textEnNkjv: But any of your men whom I do not cut off from My altar shall consume your eyes and grieve your heart. And all the descendants of your house shall die in the flower of their age.
verses.textEnNlt: The few not cut off from serving at my altar will survive, but only so their eyes can go blind and their hearts break, and their children will die a violent death.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet I will not cut off every man of yours from My altar, so that your eyes will fail from weeping and your soul grieve, and all the increase of your house will die in the prime of life.
verses.textEn: Every one of you that I do not cut off from serving at my altar I will spare only to destroy your sight and sap your strength, and all your descendants will die in the prime of life.

verses.textZh: 你的两个儿子何弗尼和非尼哈所要遭遇的事，是给你的一个证据：他们二人必同日而死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的两个儿子何弗尼和非尼哈所要遭遇的事，是给你的一个证据：他们二人必同日而死。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的两个儿子何弗尼、非尼哈所遭遇的事可作你的证据：他们二人必一日同死。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘And what happens to your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, will be a sign to you—they will both die on the same day.
verses.textEnEsv: And this that shall come upon your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, shall be the sign to you: both of them shall die on the same day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now this shallbe a sign to you that will come upon your two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas: in one day they shall die, both of them.
verses.textEnNlt: And to prove that what I have said will come true, I will cause your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, to die on the same day!
verses.textEnNasb: And this will be the sign to you which will come in regard to your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas: on the same day both of them will die.
verses.textEn: " ‘And what happens to your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, will be a sign to you—they will both die on the same day.

verses.textZh: 我要为自己兴起一位忠心的祭司，他必依照我的心意行事；我要为他建立一个稳固的家，他一生必行在我的受膏者面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要为自己兴起一位忠心的祭司，他必依照我的心意行事；我要为他建立一个稳固的家，他一生必行在我的受膏者面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要为自己立一个忠心的祭司；他必照我的心意而行。我要为他建立坚固的家；他必永远行在我的受膏者面前。
verses.textEnNiv: I will raise up for myself a faithful priest, who will do according to what is in my heart and mind. I will firmly establish his priestly house, and they will minister before my anointed one always.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will raise up for myself a faithful priest, who shall do according to what is in my heart and in my mind. And I will build him a sure house, and he shall go in and out before my anointed forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I will raise up for Myself a faithful priest who shall do according to what is in My heart and in My mind. I will build him a sure house, and he shall walk before My anointed forever.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then I will raise up a faithful priest who will serve me and do what I desire. I will establish his family, and they will be priests to my anointed kings forever.
verses.textEnNasb: But I will raise up for Myself a faithful priest who will do according to what is in My heart and My soul; and I will build him an enduring house, and he will walk before My anointed always.
verses.textEn: I will raise up for myself a faithful priest, who will do according to what is in my heart and mind. I will firmly establish his priestly house, and they will minister before my anointed one always.

verses.textZh: 你家中剩下的人，都要来向他下拜；求一个银币，一块饼，也要说：求你容我参与祭司的职务，使我可以有点饼吃。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你家中剩下的人，都要来向他下拜；求一个银币，一块饼，也要说：求你容我参与祭司的职务，使我可以有点饼吃。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你家所剩下的人都必来叩拜他，求块银子，求个饼，说：求你赐我祭司的职分，好叫我得点饼吃。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Then everyone left in your family line will come and bow down before him for a piece of silver and a loaf of bread and plead, "Appoint me to some priestly office so I can have food to eat." ’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And everyone who is left in your house shall come to implore him for a piece of silver or a loaf of bread and shall say, "Please put me in one of the priests’ places, that I may eat a morsel of bread."’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall come to pass that everyone who is left in your house will come and bow down to him for a piece of silver and a morsel of bread, and say, "Please, put me in one of the priestly positions, that I may eat a piece of bread." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then all of your surviving family will bow before him, begging for money and food. ‘Please,’ they will say, ‘give us jobs among the priests so we will have enough to eat.’"
verses.textEnNasb: And everyone who is left in your house will come to bow down to him for a silver coin or a loaf of bread and say, "Please assign me to one of the priest’s offices so that I may eat a piece of bread." ’ "
verses.textEn: Then everyone left in your family line will come and bow down before him for a piece of silver and a loaf of bread and plead, "Appoint me to some priestly office so I can have food to eat." ’ "

verses.textZh: 那孩子撒母耳在以利面前事奉耶和华，在那些日子，耶和华的言语稀少，异象也不常有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那孩子撒母耳在以利面前事奉耶和华，在那些日子，耶和华的言语稀少，异象也不常有。
verses.textZhCuv: 童子撒母耳在以利面前事奉耶和华。当那些日子，耶和华的言语稀少，不常有默示。
verses.textEnNiv: The boy Samuel ministered before the Lord under Eli. In those days the word of the Lord was rare; there were not many visions.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the boy Samuel was ministering to the Lord in the presence of Eli. And the word of the Lord was rare in those days; there was no frequent vision.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the boy Samuel ministered to the Lord before Eli. And the word of the Lord was rare in those days; therewas no widespread revelation.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the boy Samuel served the Lord by assisting Eli. Now in those days messages from the Lord were very rare, and visions were quite uncommon.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the boy Samuel was attending to the service of the Lord before Eli. And word from the Lord was rare in those days; visions were infrequent.
verses.textEn: The boy Samuel ministered before the Lord under Eli. In those days the word of the Lord was rare; there were not many visions.

verses.textZh: 有一天，以利躺卧在自己的地方，他的眼睛早已昏花，不能看得清楚了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一天，以利躺卧在自己的地方，他的眼睛早已昏花，不能看得清楚了。
verses.textZhCuv: 一日，以利睡卧在自己的地方；他眼目昏花，看不分明。
verses.textEnNiv: One night Eli, whose eyes were becoming so weak that he could barely see, was lying down in his usual place.
verses.textEnEsv: At that time Eli, whose eyesight had begun to grow dim so that he could not see, was lying down in his own place.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass at that time, while Eli was lying down in his place, and when his eyes had begun to grow so dim that he could not see,
verses.textEnNlt: One night Eli, who was almost blind by now, had gone to bed.
verses.textEnNasb: But it happened at that time as Eli was lying down in his place (now his eyesight had begun to be poor and he could not see well),
verses.textEn: One night Eli, whose eyes were becoming so weak that he could barely see, was lying down in his usual place.

verses.textZh: 神的灯还没有熄灭，撒母耳躺卧在耶和华的殿中，就是安放神约柜的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的灯还没有熄灭，撒母耳躺卧在耶和华的殿中，就是安放神约柜的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 神的灯在神耶和华殿内约柜那里，还没有熄灭，撒母耳已经睡了。
verses.textEnNiv: The lamp of God had not yet gone out, and Samuel was lying down in the house of the Lord , where the ark of God was.
verses.textEnEsv: The lamp of God had not yet gone out, and Samuel was lying down in the temple of the Lord , where the ark of God was.
verses.textEnNkjv: and before the lamp of God went out in the tabernacle of the Lord where the ark of God was, and while Samuel was lying down,
verses.textEnNlt: The lamp of God had not yet gone out, and Samuel was sleeping in the Tabernacle near the Ark of God.
verses.textEnNasb: and the lamp of God had not yet gone out, and Samuel was lying down in the temple of the Lord where the ark of God was,
verses.textEn: The lamp of God had not yet gone out, and Samuel was lying down in the house of the Lord , where the ark of God was.

verses.textZh: 耶和华呼唤撒母耳，他说："我在这里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华呼唤撒母耳，他说："我在这里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华呼唤撒母耳。撒母耳说：「我在这里！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord called Samuel. Samuel answered, "Here I am."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord called Samuel, and he said, "Here I am!"
verses.textEnNkjv: that the Lord called Samuel. And he answered, "Here I am!"
verses.textEnNlt: Suddenly the Lord called out, "Samuel!" "Yes?" Samuel replied. "What is it?"
verses.textEnNasb: that the Lord called Samuel; and he said, "Here I am."
verses.textEn: Then the Lord called Samuel. Samuel answered, "Here I am."

verses.textZh: 他就跑到以利那里，说："你呼唤我，我在这里。"以利说："我没有呼唤你，回去睡吧。"他就回去睡了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就跑到以利那里，说："你呼唤我，我在这里。"以利说："我没有呼唤你，回去睡吧。"他就回去睡了。
verses.textZhCuv: 就跑到以利那里，说：「你呼唤我？我在这里。」以利回答说：「我没有呼唤你，你去睡吧。」他就去睡了。
verses.textEnNiv: And he ran to Eli and said, "Here I am; you called me." But Eli said, "I did not call; go back and lie down." So he went and lay down.
verses.textEnEsv: and ran to Eli and said, "Here I am, for you called me." But he said, "I did not call; lie down again." So he went and lay down.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he ran to Eli and said, "Here I am, for you called me." And he said, "I did not call; lie down again." And he went and lay down.
verses.textEnNlt: He got up and ran to Eli. "Here I am. Did you call me?" "I didn’t call you," Eli replied. "Go back to bed." So he did.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he ran to Eli and said, "Here I am, for you called me." But he said, "I did not call, go back and lie down." So he went and lay down.
verses.textEn: And he ran to Eli and said, "Here I am; you called me." But Eli said, "I did not call; go back and lie down." So he went and lay down.

verses.textZh: 耶和华再次呼唤撒母耳，他就起来走到以利那里，说："你呼唤我，我在这里。"以利说："我儿，我没有呼唤你，回去睡吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华再次呼唤撒母耳，他就起来走到以利那里，说："你呼唤我，我在这里。"以利说："我儿，我没有呼唤你，回去睡吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华又呼唤撒母耳。撒母耳起来，到以利那里，说：「你呼唤我？我在这里。」以利回答说：「我的儿，我没有呼唤你，你去睡吧。」
verses.textEnNiv: Again the Lord called, "Samuel!" And Samuel got up and went to Eli and said, "Here I am; you called me." "My son," Eli said, "I did not call; go back and lie down."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord called again, "Samuel!" and Samuel arose and went to Eli and said, "Here I am, for you called me." But he said, "I did not call, my son; lie down again."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord called yet again, "Samuel!" So Samuel arose and went to Eli, and said, "Here I am, for you called me." He answered, "I did not call, my son; lie down again."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord called out again, "Samuel!" Again Samuel got up and went to Eli. "Here I am. Did you call me?" "I didn’t call you, my son," Eli said. "Go back to bed."
