verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord called yet again, "Samuel!" So Samuel got up and went to Eli and said, "Here I am, for you called me." But he said, "I did not call, my son, go back and lie down."
verses.textEn: Again the Lord called, "Samuel!" And Samuel got up and went to Eli and said, "Here I am; you called me." "My son," Eli said, "I did not call; go back and lie down."

verses.textZh: 那时撒母耳还没有认识耶和华，因为耶和华的话还没有向他启示。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时撒母耳还没有认识耶和华，因为耶和华的话还没有向他启示。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时撒母耳还未认识耶和华，也未得耶和华的默示。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Samuel did not yet know the Lord : The word of the Lord had not yet been revealed to him.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Samuel did not yet know the Lord , and the word of the Lord had not yet been revealed to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: (Now Samuel did not yet know the Lord, nor was the word of the Lord yet revealed to him.)
verses.textEnNlt: Samuel did not yet know the Lord because he had never had a message from the Lord before.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Samuel did not yet know the Lord, nor had the word of the Lord yet been revealed to him.
verses.textEn: Now Samuel did not yet know the Lord : The word of the Lord had not yet been revealed to him.

verses.textZh: 耶和华第三次呼唤撒母耳，他又起来，走到以利那里，说："你呼唤我，我在这里。"以利就明白是耶和华呼唤这孩子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华第三次呼唤撒母耳，他又起来，走到以利那里，说："你呼唤我，我在这里。"以利就明白是耶和华呼唤这孩子。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华第三次呼唤撒母耳。撒母耳起来，到以利那里，说：「你又呼唤我？我在这里。」以利才明白是耶和华呼唤童子。
verses.textEnNiv: A third time the Lord called, "Samuel!" And Samuel got up and went to Eli and said, "Here I am; you called me." Then Eli realized that the Lord was calling the boy.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord called Samuel again the third time. And he arose and went to Eli and said, "Here I am, for you called me." Then Eli perceived that the Lord was calling the boy.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord called Samuel again the third time. So he arose and went to Eli, and said, "Here I am, for you did call me." Then Eli perceived that the Lord had called the boy.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord called a third time, and once more Samuel got up and went to Eli. "Here I am. Did you call me?" Then Eli realized it was the Lord who was calling the boy.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord called Samuel again for the third time. And he got up and went to Eli and said, "Here I am, for you called me." Then Eli realized that the Lord was calling the boy.
verses.textEn: A third time the Lord called, "Samuel!" And Samuel got up and went to Eli and said, "Here I am; you called me." Then Eli realized that the Lord was calling the boy.

verses.textZh: 因此以利对撒母耳说："去睡吧！如果他呼唤你，你就说：‘耶和华啊！请说，仆人敬听。’"于是撒母耳回去，仍然睡在自己的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此以利对撒母耳说："去睡吧！如果他呼唤你，你就说：‘耶和华啊！请说，仆人敬听。’"于是撒母耳回去，仍然睡在自己的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此以利对撒母耳说：「你仍去睡吧；若再呼唤你，你就说：『耶和华啊，请说，仆人敬听！』」撒母耳就去，仍睡在原处。
verses.textEnNiv: So Eli told Samuel, "Go and lie down, and if he calls you, say, ‘Speak, Lord , for your servant is listening.’ " So Samuel went and lay down in his place.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore Eli said to Samuel, "Go, lie down, and if he calls you, you shall say, ‘Speak, Lord , for your servant hears.’" So Samuel went and lay down in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore Eli said to Samuel, "Go, lie down; and it shall be, if He calls you, that you must say, ‘Speak, Lord, for Your servant hears.’ " So Samuel went and lay down in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: So he said to Samuel, "Go and lie down again, and if someone calls again, say, ‘Speak, Lord , your servant is listening.’" So Samuel went back to bed.
verses.textEnNasb: And Eli said to Samuel, "Go lie down, and it shall be if He calls you, that you shall say, ‘Speak, Lord, for Your servant is listening.’ " So Samuel went and lay down in his place.
verses.textEn: So Eli told Samuel, "Go and lie down, and if he calls you, say, ‘Speak, Lord , for your servant is listening.’ " So Samuel went and lay down in his place.

verses.textZh: 耶和华又来站着，像前几次一样呼唤："撒母耳，撒母耳！"他回答："请说！仆人敬听。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华又来站着，像前几次一样呼唤："撒母耳，撒母耳！"他回答："请说！仆人敬听。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华又来站着，像前三次呼唤说：「撒母耳啊！撒母耳啊！」撒母耳回答说：「请说，仆人敬听！」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord came and stood there, calling as at the other times, "Samuel! Samuel!" Then Samuel said, "Speak, for your servant is listening."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord came and stood, calling as at other times, "Samuel! Samuel!" And Samuel said, "Speak, for your servant hears."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord came and stood and called as at other times, "Samuel! Samuel!" And Samuel answered, "Speak, for Your servant hears."
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord came and called as before, "Samuel! Samuel!" And Samuel replied, "Speak, your servant is listening."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord came and stood, and called as at the other times: "Samuel! Samuel!" And Samuel said, "Speak, for Your servant is listening."
verses.textEn: The Lord came and stood there, calling as at the other times, "Samuel! Samuel!" Then Samuel said, "Speak, for your servant is listening."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对撒母耳说："看哪！我要在以色列中行一件事，听见的人，都必耳鸣；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对撒母耳说："看哪！我要在以色列中行一件事，听见的人，都必耳鸣；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对撒母耳说：「我在以色列中必行一件事，叫听见的人都必耳鸣。
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord said to Samuel: "See, I am about to do something in Israel that will make the ears of everyone who hears about it tingle.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Samuel, "Behold, I am about to do a thing in Israel at which the two ears of everyone who hears it will tingle.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Samuel: "Behold, I will do something in Israel at which both ears of everyone who hears it will tingle.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Samuel, "I am about to do a shocking thing in Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Samuel, "Behold, I am going to do a thing in Israel, and both ears of everyone who hears about it will ring.
verses.textEn: And the Lord said to Samuel: "See, I am about to do something in Israel that will make the ears of everyone who hears about it tingle.

verses.textZh: 在那日，我必在以利身上彻底实现我论到他的家所说的一切话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那日，我必在以利身上彻底实现我论到他的家所说的一切话。
verses.textZhCuv: 我指着以利家所说的话，到了时候，我必始终应验在以利身上。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time I will carry out against Eli everything I spoke against his family—from beginning to end.
verses.textEnEsv: On that day I will fulfill against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, from beginning to end.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day I will perform against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, from beginning to end.
verses.textEnNlt: I am going to carry out all my threats against Eli and his family, from beginning to end.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day I will carry out against Eli everything that I have spoken in regard to his house, from beginning to end.
verses.textEn: At that time I will carry out against Eli everything I spoke against his family—from beginning to end.

verses.textZh: 我曾告诉他：‘我必按着他所知道的罪孽永远处罚他的家。这罪就是他的儿子自招咒诅，他也不责备他们。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我曾告诉他：‘我必按着他所知道的罪孽永远处罚他的家。这罪就是他的儿子自招咒诅，他也不责备他们。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我曾告诉他必永远降罚与他的家，因他知道儿子作孽，自招咒诅，却不禁止他们。
verses.textEnNiv: For I told him that I would judge his family forever because of the sin he knew about; his sons blasphemed God, and he failed to restrain them.
verses.textEnEsv: And I declare to him that I am about to punish his house forever, for the iniquity that he knew, because his sons were blaspheming God, and he did not restrain them.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I have told him that I will judge his house forever for the iniquity which he knows, because his sons made themselves vile, and he did not restrain them.
verses.textEnNlt: I have warned him that judgment is coming upon his family forever, because his sons are blaspheming God and he hasn’t disciplined them.
verses.textEnNasb: For I have told him that I am going to judge his house forever for the wrongdoing that he knew, because his sons were bringing a curse on themselves and he did not rebuke them.
verses.textEn: For I told him that I would judge his family forever because of the sin he knew about; his sons blasphemed God, and he failed to restrain them.

verses.textZh: 所以我向以利家起了誓：‘以利家的罪孽永远不能用祭物或供物来买赎。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我向以利家起了誓：‘以利家的罪孽永远不能用祭物或供物来买赎。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我向以利家起誓说：『以利家的罪孽，虽献祭奉礼物，永不能得赎去。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I swore to the house of Eli, ‘The guilt of Eli’s house will never be atoned for by sacrifice or offering.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I swear to the house of Eli that the iniquity of Eli’s house shall not be atoned for by sacrifice or offering forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: And therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli that the iniquity of Eli’s house shall not be atoned for by sacrifice or offering forever."
verses.textEnNlt: So I have vowed that the sins of Eli and his sons will never be forgiven by sacrifices or offerings."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli that the wrongdoing of Eli’s house shall never be atoned for by sacrifice or offering."
verses.textEn: Therefore I swore to the house of Eli, ‘The guilt of Eli’s house will never be atoned for by sacrifice or offering.’ "

verses.textZh: 撒母耳睡到天亮，他就开了耶和华殿的门。但撒母耳不敢把异象告诉以利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳睡到天亮，他就开了耶和华殿的门。但撒母耳不敢把异象告诉以利。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳睡到天亮，就开了耶和华的殿门，不敢将默示告诉以利。
verses.textEnNiv: Samuel lay down until morning and then opened the doors of the house of the Lord . He was afraid to tell Eli the vision,
verses.textEnEsv: Samuel lay until morning; then he opened the doors of the house of the Lord . And Samuel was afraid to tell the vision to Eli.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Samuel lay down until morning, and opened the doors of the house of the Lord. And Samuel was afraid to tell Eli the vision.
verses.textEnNlt: Samuel stayed in bed until morning, then got up and opened the doors of the Tabernacle as usual. He was afraid to tell Eli what the Lord had said to him.
verses.textEnNasb: So Samuel lay down until morning. Then he opened the doors of the house of the Lord. But Samuel was afraid to tell the vision to Eli.
verses.textEn: Samuel lay down until morning and then opened the doors of the house of the Lord . He was afraid to tell Eli the vision,

verses.textZh: 以利呼唤撒母耳，说："我儿撒母耳！"他回答："我在这里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利呼唤撒母耳，说："我儿撒母耳！"他回答："我在这里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利呼唤撒母耳说：「我儿撒母耳啊！」撒母耳回答说：「我在这里！」
verses.textEnNiv: but Eli called him and said, "Samuel, my son." Samuel answered, "Here I am."
verses.textEnEsv: But Eli called Samuel and said, "Samuel, my son." And he said, "Here I am."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Eli called Samuel and said, "Samuel, my son!" He answered, "Here I am."
verses.textEnNlt: But Eli called out to him, "Samuel, my son." "Here I am," Samuel replied.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Eli called Samuel and said, "Samuel, my son." And he said, "Here I am."
verses.textEn: but Eli called him and said, "Samuel, my son." Samuel answered, "Here I am."

verses.textZh: 以利说："耶和华对你说了甚么话呢？你不要向我隐瞒，他对你所说的一切话，如果你向我隐瞒一句，愿神对付你，并且加倍对付你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利说："耶和华对你说了甚么话呢？你不要向我隐瞒，他对你所说的一切话，如果你向我隐瞒一句，愿神对付你，并且加倍对付你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利说：「耶和华对你说什么，你不要向我隐瞒；你若将神对你所说的隐瞒一句，愿他重重地降罚与你。」
verses.textEnNiv: "What was it he said to you?" Eli asked. "Do not hide it from me. May God deal with you, be it ever so severely, if you hide from me anything he told you."
verses.textEnEsv: And Eli said, "What was it that he told you? Do not hide it from me. May God do so to you and more also if you hide anything from me of all that he told you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "What is the word that theLord spoke to you? Please do not hide it from me. God do so to you, and more also, if you hide anything from me of all the things that He said to you."
verses.textEnNlt: "What did the Lord say to you? Tell me everything. And may God strike you and even kill you if you hide anything from me!"
verses.textEnNasb: He said, "What is the word that He spoke to you? Please do not hide it from me. May God do the same to you, and more so, if you hide a single word from me of all the words that He spoke to you!"
verses.textEn: "What was it he said to you?" Eli asked. "Do not hide it from me. May God deal with you, be it ever so severely, if you hide from me anything he told you."

verses.textZh: 于是撒母耳把一切话都告诉了以利，一句也没有隐瞒。以利说："他是耶和华，他看怎么好，就怎么行吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是撒母耳把一切话都告诉了以利，一句也没有隐瞒。以利说："他是耶和华，他看怎么好，就怎么行吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳就把一切话都告诉了以利，并没有隐瞒。以利说：「这是出于耶和华，愿他凭自己的意旨而行。」
verses.textEnNiv: So Samuel told him everything, hiding nothing from him. Then Eli said, "He is the Lord ; let him do what is good in his eyes."
verses.textEnEsv: So Samuel told him everything and hid nothing from him. And he said, "It is the Lord . Let him do what seems good to him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Samuel told him everything, and hid nothing from him. And he said, "It is the Lord. Let Him do what seems good to Him."
verses.textEnNlt: So Samuel told Eli everything; he didn’t hold anything back. "It is the Lord ’s will," Eli replied. "Let him do what he thinks best."
verses.textEnNasb: So Samuel told him everything and hid nothing from him. And he said, "He is the Lord; let Him do what seems good to Him."
verses.textEn: So Samuel told him everything, hiding nothing from him. Then Eli said, "He is the Lord ; let him do what is good in his eyes."

verses.textZh: 撒母耳渐渐长大，耶和华与他同在，使他所说的一切话，没有一句落空。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳渐渐长大，耶和华与他同在，使他所说的一切话，没有一句落空。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳长大了，耶和华与他同在，使他所说的话一句都不落空。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord was with Samuel as he grew up, and he let none of Samuel’s words fall to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: And Samuel grew, and the Lord was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Samuel grew, and the Lord was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: As Samuel grew up, the Lord was with him, and everything Samuel said proved to be reliable.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Samuel grew, and the Lord was with him, and He let none of his words fail.
verses.textEn: The Lord was with Samuel as he grew up, and he let none of Samuel’s words fall to the ground.

verses.textZh: 从但到别是巴，以色列人都知道撒母耳被耶和华确立为先知。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从但到别是巴，以色列人都知道撒母耳被耶和华确立为先知。
verses.textZhCuv: 从但到别是巴所有的以色列人都知道耶和华立撒母耳为先知。
verses.textEnNiv: And all Israel from Dan to Beersheba recognized that Samuel was attested as a prophet of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And all Israel from Dan to Beersheba knew that Samuel was established as a prophet of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And all Israel from Dan to Beersheba knew that Samuel hadbeen established as a prophet of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: And all Israel, from Dan in the north to Beersheba in the south, knew that Samuel was confirmed as a prophet of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And all Israel from Dan even to Beersheba knew that Samuel was confirmed as a prophet of the Lord.
verses.textEn: And all Israel from Dan to Beersheba recognized that Samuel was attested as a prophet of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华又在示罗显现，因为耶和华在示罗借着他的话向撒母耳启示自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华又在示罗显现，因为耶和华在示罗借着他的话向撒母耳启示自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华又在示罗显现；因为耶和华将自己的话默示撒母耳，撒母耳就把这话传遍以色列地。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord continued to appear at Shiloh, and there he revealed himself to Samuel through his word.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord appeared again at Shiloh, for the Lord revealed himself to Samuel at Shiloh by the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord appeared again in Shiloh. For the Lord revealed Himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord continued to appear at Shiloh and gave messages to Samuel there at the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord appeared again at Shiloh, because the Lord revealed Himself to Samuel at Shiloh by the word of the Lord.
verses.textEn: The Lord continued to appear at Shiloh, and there he revealed himself to Samuel through his word.

verses.textZh: 撒母耳的话传遍了以色列。那时，以色列人出去迎战非利士人，他们靠近以便以谢安营，非利士人却在亚弗安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳的话传遍了以色列。那时，以色列人出去迎战非利士人，他们靠近以便以谢安营，非利士人却在亚弗安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人出去与非利士人打仗，安营在以便以谢；非利士人安营在亚弗。
verses.textEnNiv: And Samuel’s word came to all Israel. Now the Israelites went out to fight against the Philistines. The Israelites camped at Ebenezer, and the Philistines at Aphek.
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out to battle against the Philistines. They encamped at Ebenezer, and the Philistines encamped at Aphek.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out to battle against the Philistines, and encamped beside Ebenezer; and the Philistines encamped in Aphek.
verses.textEnNlt: And Samuel’s words went out to all the people of Israel. At that time Israel was at war with the Philistines. The Israelite army was camped near Ebenezer, and the Philistines were at Aphek.
verses.textEnNasb: So the word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out to meet the Philistines in battle, and they camped beside Ebenezer, while the Philistines camped in Aphek.
verses.textEn: And Samuel’s word came to all Israel. Now the Israelites went out to fight against the Philistines. The Israelites camped at Ebenezer, and the Philistines at Aphek.

verses.textZh: 非利士人列阵，要与以色列人交战。战事展开后，以色列人败在非利士人面前，非利士人在战场上杀了约四千人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人列阵，要与以色列人交战。战事展开后，以色列人败在非利士人面前，非利士人在战场上杀了约四千人。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人向以色列人摆阵。两军交战的时候，以色列人败在非利士人面前；非利士人在战场上杀了他们的军兵约有四千人。
verses.textEnNiv: The Philistines deployed their forces to meet Israel, and as the battle spread, Israel was defeated by the Philistines, who killed about four thousand of them on the battlefield.
verses.textEnEsv: The Philistines drew up in line against Israel, and when the battle spread, Israel was defeated before the Philistines, who killed about four thousand men on the field of battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Philistines put themselves in battle array against Israel. And when they joined battle, Israel was defeated by the Philistines, who killed about four thousand men of the army in the field.
verses.textEnNlt: The Philistines attacked and defeated the army of Israel, killing 4,000 men.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Philistines drew up in battle formation to meet Israel. When the battle spread, Israel was defeated by the Philistines, who killed about four thousand men on the battlefield.
verses.textEn: The Philistines deployed their forces to meet Israel, and as the battle spread, Israel was defeated by the Philistines, who killed about four thousand of them on the battlefield.

verses.textZh: 军队回到营里，以色列的长老说："今天耶和华为甚么在非利士人面前击败我们呢？我们要把耶和华的约柜从示罗抬到我们这里来。约柜一到我们中间，就会拯救我们脱离仇敌的手。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 军队回到营里，以色列的长老说："今天耶和华为甚么在非利士人面前击败我们呢？我们要把耶和华的约柜从示罗抬到我们这里来。约柜一到我们中间，就会拯救我们脱离仇敌的手。"
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓回到营里，以色列的长老说：「耶和华今日为何使我们败在非利士人面前呢？我们不如将耶和华的约柜从示罗抬到我们这里来，好在我们中间救我们脱离敌人的手。」
verses.textEnNiv: When the soldiers returned to camp, the elders of Israel asked, "Why did the Lord bring defeat on us today before the Philistines? Let us bring the ark of the Lord ’s covenant from Shiloh, so that he may go with us and save us from the hand of our enemies."
verses.textEnEsv: And when the people came to the camp, the elders of Israel said, "Why has the Lord defeated us today before the Philistines? Let us bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord here from Shiloh, that it may come among us and save us from the power of our enemies."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the people had come into the camp, the elders of Israel said, "Why has the Lord defeated us today before the Philistines? Let us bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord from Shiloh to us, that when it comes among us it may save us from the hand of our enemies."
verses.textEnNlt: After the battle was over, the troops retreated to their camp, and the elders of Israel asked, "Why did the Lord allow us to be defeated by the Philistines?" Then they said, "Let’s bring the Ark of the Covenant of the Lord from Shiloh. If we carry it into battle with us, it will save us from our enemies."
verses.textEnNasb: When the people came into the camp, the elders of Israel said, "Why has the Lord defeated us today before the Philistines? Let’s take the ark of the covenant of the Lord from Shiloh, so that He may come among us and save us from the power of our enemies."
verses.textEn: When the soldiers returned to camp, the elders of Israel asked, "Why did the Lord bring defeat on us today before the Philistines? Let us bring the ark of the Lord ’s covenant from Shiloh, so that he may go with us and save us from the hand of our enemies."

verses.textZh: 于是他们派人到示罗去，从那里把坐在二基路伯中间万军之耶和华的约柜抬来；以利的两个儿子，何弗尼和非尼哈，也与神的约柜一同来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们派人到示罗去，从那里把坐在二基路伯中间万军之耶和华的约柜抬来；以利的两个儿子，何弗尼和非尼哈，也与神的约柜一同来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是百姓打发人到示罗，从那里将坐在二基路伯上万军之耶和华的约柜抬来。以利的两个儿子何弗尼、非尼哈与神的约柜同来。
verses.textEnNiv: So the people sent men to Shiloh, and they brought back the ark of the covenant of the Lord Almighty, who is enthroned between the cherubim. And Eli’s two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.
verses.textEnEsv: So the people sent to Shiloh and brought from there the ark of the covenant of the Lord of hosts, who is enthroned on the cherubim. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the people sent to Shiloh, that they might bring from there the ark of the covenant of the Lord of hosts, who dwells between the cherubim. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.
verses.textEnNlt: So they sent men to Shiloh to bring the Ark of the Covenant of the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, who is enthroned between the cherubim. Hophni and Phinehas, the sons of Eli, were also there with the Ark of the Covenant of God.
verses.textEnNasb: So the people sent men to Shiloh, and from there they carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord of armies who is enthroned above the cherubim; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.
verses.textEn: So the people sent men to Shiloh, and they brought back the ark of the covenant of the Lord Almighty, who is enthroned between the cherubim. And Eli’s two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的约柜来到营中的时候，以色列众人就大声欢呼，大地也回声响应。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的约柜来到营中的时候，以色列众人就大声欢呼，大地也回声响应。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的约柜到了营中，以色列众人就大声欢呼，地便震动。
verses.textEnNiv: When the ark of the Lord ’s covenant came into the camp, all Israel raised such a great shout that the ground shook.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as the ark of the covenant of the Lord came into the camp, all Israel gave a mighty shout, so that the earth resounded.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the ark of the covenant of the Lord came into the camp, all Israel shouted so loudly that the earth shook.
verses.textEnNlt: When all the Israelites saw the Ark of the Covenant of the Lord coming into the camp, their shout of joy was so loud it made the ground shake!
verses.textEnNasb: And as the ark of the covenant of the Lord was coming into the camp, all Israel shouted with a great shout, so that the earth resounded.
verses.textEn: When the ark of the Lord ’s covenant came into the camp, all Israel raised such a great shout that the ground shook.

verses.textZh: 非利士人听见了欢呼的声音，就问："在希伯来人的营中为甚么有这样大声的欢呼呢？"后来才知道耶和华的约柜来到了营中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人听见了欢呼的声音，就问："在希伯来人的营中为甚么有这样大声的欢呼呢？"后来才知道耶和华的约柜来到了营中。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人听见欢呼的声音，就说：「在希伯来人营里大声欢呼，是什么缘故呢？」随后就知道耶和华的约柜到了营中。
verses.textEnNiv: Hearing the uproar, the Philistines asked, "What’s all this shouting in the Hebrew camp?" When they learned that the ark of the Lord had come into the camp,
verses.textEnEsv: And when the Philistines heard the noise of the shouting, they said, "What does this great shouting in the camp of the Hebrews mean?" And when they learned that the ark of the Lord had come to the camp,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, "What does the sound of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews mean?" Then they understood that the ark of the Lord had come into the camp.
verses.textEnNlt: "What’s going on?" the Philistines asked. "What’s all the shouting about in the Hebrew camp?" When they were told it was because the Ark of the Lord had arrived,
verses.textEnNasb: And when the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, "What does the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews mean?" Then they understood that the ark of the Lord had come into the camp.
verses.textEn: Hearing the uproar, the Philistines asked, "What’s all this shouting in the Hebrew camp?" When they learned that the ark of the Lord had come into the camp,

verses.textZh: 非利士人就害怕起来，他们说："有神来到他们的营中了。"又说："我们有祸了！因为从来没有这样的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人就害怕起来，他们说："有神来到他们的营中了。"又说："我们有祸了！因为从来没有这样的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人就惧怕起来，说：「有神到了他们营中」；又说：「我们有祸了！向来不曾有这样的事。
verses.textEnNiv: the Philistines were afraid. "A god has come into the camp," they said. "Oh no! Nothing like this has happened before.
verses.textEnEsv: the Philistines were afraid, for they said, "A god has come into the camp." And they said, "Woe to us! For nothing like this has happened before.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Philistines were afraid, for they said, "God has come into the camp!" And they said, "Woe to us! For such a thing has never happened before.
verses.textEnNlt: they panicked. "The gods have come into their camp!" they cried. "This is a disaster! We have never had to face anything like this before!
verses.textEnNasb: So the Philistines were afraid, for they said, "God has come into the camp!" And they said, "Woe to us! For nothing like this has happened before.
verses.textEn: the Philistines were afraid. "A god has come into the camp," they said. "Oh no! Nothing like this has happened before.

verses.textZh: 我们有祸了！从前在旷野用各样灾祸击打埃及人的，就是这些神。谁能救我们脱离这些大能之神的手呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们有祸了！从前在旷野用各样灾祸击打埃及人的，就是这些神。谁能救我们脱离这些大能之神的手呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我们有祸了！谁能救我们脱离这些大能之神的手呢？从前在旷野用各样灾殃击打埃及人的，就是这些神。
verses.textEnNiv: We’re doomed! Who will deliver us from the hand of these mighty gods? They are the gods who struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness.
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to us! Who can deliver us from the power of these mighty gods? These are the gods who struck the Egyptians with every sort of plague in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to us! Who will deliver us from the hand of these mighty gods? These are the gods who struck the Egyptians with all the plagues in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: Help! Who can save us from these mighty gods of Israel? They are the same gods who destroyed the Egyptians with plagues when Israel was in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to us! Who will save us from the hand of these mighty gods? These are the gods who struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness.
verses.textEn: We’re doomed! Who will deliver us from the hand of these mighty gods? They are the gods who struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness.

verses.textZh: 非利士人哪！你们要刚强，要作大丈夫，免得你们作希伯来人的奴仆，好象他们作过你们的奴仆一样；你们要作大丈夫，作战吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人哪！你们要刚强，要作大丈夫，免得你们作希伯来人的奴仆，好象他们作过你们的奴仆一样；你们要作大丈夫，作战吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人哪，你们要刚强，要作大丈夫，免得作希伯来人的奴仆，如同他们作你们的奴仆一样。你们要作大丈夫，与他们争战。」
verses.textEnNiv: Be strong, Philistines! Be men, or you will be subject to the Hebrews, as they have been to you. Be men, and fight!"
verses.textEnEsv: Take courage, and be men, O Philistines, lest you become slaves to the Hebrews as they have been to you; be men and fight."
verses.textEnNkjv: Be strong and conduct yourselves like men, you Philistines, that you do not become servants of the Hebrews, as they have been to you. Conduct yourselves like men, and fight!"
verses.textEnNlt: Fight as never before, Philistines! If you don’t, we will become the Hebrews’ slaves just as they have been ours! Stand up like men and fight!"
verses.textEnNasb: Take courage and be men, Philistines, or you will become slaves to the Hebrews, as they have been slaves to you; so be men and fight!"
verses.textEn: Be strong, Philistines! Be men, or you will be subject to the Hebrews, as they have been to you. Be men, and fight!"

verses.textZh: 于是非利士人起来作战，以色列人就被击败，各人都往自己的帐棚逃跑。这是一场大屠杀，以色列人中有三万步兵阵亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是非利士人起来作战，以色列人就被击败，各人都往自己的帐棚逃跑。这是一场大屠杀，以色列人中有三万步兵阵亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人和以色列人打仗，以色列人败了，各向各家奔逃，被杀的人甚多，以色列的步兵仆倒了三万。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Philistines fought, and the Israelites were defeated and every man fled to his tent. The slaughter was very great; Israel lost thirty thousand foot soldiers.
verses.textEnEsv: So the Philistines fought, and Israel was defeated, and they fled, every man to his home. And there was a very great slaughter, for thirty thousand foot soldiers of Israel fell.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Philistines fought, and Israel was defeated, and every man fled to his tent. There was a very great slaughter, and there fell of Israel thirty thousand foot soldiers.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Philistines fought desperately, and Israel was defeated again. The slaughter was great; 30,000 Israelite soldiers died that day. The survivors turned and fled to their tents.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Philistines fought and Israel was defeated, and every man fled to his tent; and the defeat was very great, for thirty thousand foot soldiers of Israel fell.
verses.textEn: So the Philistines fought, and the Israelites were defeated and every man fled to his tent. The slaughter was very great; Israel lost thirty thousand foot soldiers.

verses.textZh: 神的约柜也被抢去，以利的两个儿子何弗尼和非尼哈也死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的约柜也被抢去，以利的两个儿子何弗尼和非尼哈也死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 神的约柜被掳去，以利的两个儿子何弗尼、非尼哈也都被杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: The ark of God was captured, and Eli’s two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, died.
verses.textEnEsv: And the ark of God was captured, and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, died.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the ark of God was captured; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, died.
verses.textEnNlt: The Ark of God was captured, and Hophni and Phinehas, the two sons of Eli, were killed.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, the ark of God was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, died.
verses.textEn: The ark of God was captured, and Eli’s two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, died.

verses.textZh: 有一个便雅悯人跑离战场，衣服撕裂，头蒙尘土，当天来到示罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个便雅悯人跑离战场，衣服撕裂，头蒙尘土，当天来到示罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 当日，有一个便雅悯人从阵上逃跑，衣服撕裂，头蒙灰尘，来到示罗。
verses.textEnNiv: That same day a Benjamite ran from the battle line and went to Shiloh with his clothes torn and dust on his head.
verses.textEnEsv: A man of Benjamin ran from the battle line and came to Shiloh the same day, with his clothes torn and with dirt on his head.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then a man of Benjamin ran from the battle line the same day, and came to Shiloh with his clothes torn and dirt on his head.
verses.textEnNlt: A man from the tribe of Benjamin ran from the battlefield and arrived at Shiloh later that same day. He had torn his clothes and put dust on his head to show his grief.
verses.textEnNasb: Now a man of Benjamin ran from the battle line and came to Shiloh the same day with his clothes torn, and dust on his head.
verses.textEn: That same day a Benjamite ran from the battle line and went to Shiloh with his clothes torn and dust on his head.

verses.textZh: 他来到的时候，以利正在路旁坐在自己的椅子上观望，因为他为神的约柜担忧战栗。那人进城里报信，全城的人就都喊叫起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他来到的时候，以利正在路旁坐在自己的椅子上观望，因为他为神的约柜担忧战栗。那人进城里报信，全城的人就都喊叫起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了的时候，以利正在道旁坐在自己的位上观望，为神的约柜心里担忧。那人进城报信，合城的人就都呼喊起来。
verses.textEnNiv: When he arrived, there was Eli sitting on his chair by the side of the road, watching, because his heart feared for the ark of God. When the man entered the town and told what had happened, the whole town sent up a cry.
verses.textEnEsv: When he arrived, Eli was sitting on his seat by the road watching, for his heart trembled for the ark of God. And when the man came into the city and told the news, all the city cried out.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when he came, there was Eli, sitting on a seat by the wayside watching, for his heart trembled for the ark of God. And when the man came into the city and told it, all the city cried out.
verses.textEnNlt: Eli was waiting beside the road to hear the news of the battle, for his heart trembled for the safety of the Ark of God. When the messenger arrived and told what had happened, an outcry resounded throughout the town.
verses.textEnNasb: When he came, behold, Eli was sitting on his seat by the road keeping watch, because his heart was anxious about the ark of God. And the man came to give a report in the city, and all the city cried out.
verses.textEn: When he arrived, there was Eli sitting on his chair by the side of the road, watching, because his heart feared for the ark of God. When the man entered the town and told what had happened, the whole town sent up a cry.

verses.textZh: 以利听见喊叫的声音，就问："这喧嚷的声音是甚么意思呢？"那人急忙前来，向以利报告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利听见喊叫的声音，就问："这喧嚷的声音是甚么意思呢？"那人急忙前来，向以利报告。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利听见呼喊的声音就问说：「这喧嚷是什么缘故呢？」那人急忙来报信给以利。
verses.textEnNiv: Eli heard the outcry and asked, "What is the meaning of this uproar?" The man hurried over to Eli,
verses.textEnEsv: When Eli heard the sound of the outcry, he said, "What is this uproar?" Then the man hurried and came and told Eli.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Eli heard the noise of the outcry, he said, "What does the sound of this tumult mean?" And the man came quickly and told Eli.
verses.textEnNlt: "What is all the noise about?" Eli asked. The messenger rushed over to Eli,
verses.textEnNasb: When Eli heard the noise of the outcry, he said, "What does the noise of this commotion mean?" Then the man came hurriedly and told Eli.
verses.textEn: Eli heard the outcry and asked, "What is the meaning of this uproar?" The man hurried over to Eli,

verses.textZh: 那时以利九十八岁了，眼睛发直，不能看见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时以利九十八岁了，眼睛发直，不能看见。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时以利九十八岁了，眼目发直，不能看见。
verses.textEnNiv: who was ninety-eight years old and whose eyes had failed so that he could not see.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Eli was ninety-eight years old and his eyes were set so that he could not see.
verses.textEnNkjv: Eli was ninety-eight years old, and his eyes were so dim that he could not see.
verses.textEnNlt: who was ninety-eight years old and blind.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Eli was ninety-eight years old, and his eyes were fixed and he could not see.
verses.textEn: who was ninety-eight years old and whose eyes had failed so that he could not see.

verses.textZh: 那人告诉以利："我是从战场上来的，今天从战场上逃回来。"以利问："我儿，事情怎么样？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人告诉以利："我是从战场上来的，今天从战场上逃回来。"以利问："我儿，事情怎么样？"
verses.textZhCuv: 那人对以利说：「我是从阵上来的，今日我从阵上逃回。」以利说：「我儿，事情怎样？」
verses.textEnNiv: He told Eli, "I have just come from the battle line; I fled from it this very day." Eli asked, "What happened, my son?"
verses.textEnEsv: And the man said to Eli, "I am he who has come from the battle; I fled from the battle today." And he said, "How did it go, my son?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the man said to Eli, "I am he who came from the battle. And I fled today from the battle line." And he said, "What happened, my son?"
verses.textEnNlt: He said to Eli, "I have just come from the battlefield—I was there this very day." "What happened, my son?" Eli demanded.
verses.textEnNasb: The man said to Eli, "I am the one who came from the battle line. Indeed, I escaped from the battle line today." And he said, "How are things, my son?"
verses.textEn: He told Eli, "I have just come from the battle line; I fled from it this very day." Eli asked, "What happened, my son?"

verses.textZh: 报信的人回答，说："以色列人在非利士人面前逃跑，伤亡惨重，你两个儿子何弗尼和非尼哈也都死了，民中被杀的甚多，神的约柜也被抢去了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 报信的人回答，说："以色列人在非利士人面前逃跑，伤亡惨重，你两个儿子何弗尼和非尼哈也都死了，民中被杀的甚多，神的约柜也被抢去了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 报信的回答说：「以色列人在非利士人面前逃跑，民中被杀的甚多！你的两个儿子何弗尼、非尼哈也都死了，并且神的约柜被掳去。」
verses.textEnNiv: The man who brought the news replied, "Israel fled before the Philistines, and the army has suffered heavy losses. Also your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and the ark of God has been captured."
verses.textEnEsv: He who brought the news answered and said, "Israel has fled before the Philistines, and there has also been a great defeat among the people. Your two sons also, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and the ark of God has been captured."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the messenger answered and said, "Israel has fled before the Philistines, and there has been a great slaughter among the people. Also your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead; and the ark of God has been captured."
verses.textEnNlt: "Israel has been defeated by the Philistines," the messenger replied. "The people have been slaughtered, and your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, were also killed. And the Ark of God has been captured."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the one who brought the news replied, "Israel has fled before the Philistines and there has also been a great defeat among the people, and your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas are also dead; and the ark of God has been taken."
verses.textEn: The man who brought the news replied, "Israel fled before the Philistines, and the army has suffered heavy losses. Also your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and the ark of God has been captured."

verses.textZh: 因为以利年老体重，报信的人一提到神的约柜，以利就从椅子上往后跌倒在门旁，颈骨折断而死。以利治理了以色列四十年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为以利年老体重，报信的人一提到神的约柜，以利就从椅子上往后跌倒在门旁，颈骨折断而死。以利治理了以色列四十年。
verses.textZhCuv: 他一提神的约柜，以利就从他的位上往后跌倒，在门旁折断颈项而死；因为他年纪老迈，身体沉重。以利作以色列的士师四十年。
verses.textEnNiv: When he mentioned the ark of God, Eli fell backward off his chair by the side of the gate. His neck was broken and he died, for he was an old man, and he was heavy. He had led Israel forty years.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as he mentioned the ark of God, Eli fell over backward from his seat by the side of the gate, and his neck was broken and he died, for the man was old and heavy. He had judged Israel forty years.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it happened, when he made mention of the ark of God, that Eli fell off the seat backward by the side of the gate; and his neck was broken and he died, for the man was old and heavy. And he had judged Israel forty years.
verses.textEnNlt: When the messenger mentioned what had happened to the Ark of God, Eli fell backward from his seat beside the gate. He broke his neck and died, for he was old and overweight. He had been Israel’s judge for forty years.
verses.textEnNasb: When he mentioned the ark of God, Eli fell off the seat backward beside the gate, and his neck was broken and he died, for he was old and heavy. And so he judged Israel for forty years.
verses.textEn: When he mentioned the ark of God, Eli fell backward off his chair by the side of the gate. His neck was broken and he died, for he was an old man, and he was heavy. He had led Israel forty years.

verses.textZh: 以利的媳妇，非尼哈的妻子怀了孕，产期近了；她一听见神的约柜被抢去，以及她公公和丈夫都死了的消息，就忽然感到疼痛，曲身生产了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利的媳妇，非尼哈的妻子怀了孕，产期近了；她一听见神的约柜被抢去，以及她公公和丈夫都死了的消息，就忽然感到疼痛，曲身生产了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利的儿妇、非尼哈的妻怀孕将到产期，她听见神的约柜被掳去，公公和丈夫都死了，就猛然疼痛，曲身生产；
verses.textEnNiv: His daughter-in-law, the wife of Phinehas, was pregnant and near the time of delivery. When she heard the news that the ark of God had been captured and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, she went into labor and gave birth, but was overcome by her labor pains.
verses.textEnEsv: Now his daughter-in-law, the wife of Phinehas, was pregnant, about to give birth. And when she heard the news that the ark of God was captured, and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, she bowed and gave birth, for her pains came upon her.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now his daughter-in-law, Phinehas’s wife, was with child, due to be delivered; and when she heard the news that the ark of God was captured, and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, she bowed herself and gave birth, for her labor pains came upon her.
verses.textEnNlt: Eli’s daughter-in-law, the wife of Phinehas, was pregnant and near her time of delivery. When she heard that the Ark of God had been captured and that her father-in-law and husband were dead, she went into labor and gave birth.
verses.textEnNasb: Now his daughter-in-law, Phinehas’ wife, was pregnant and about to give birth; and when she heard the news that the ark of God had been taken and that her father-in-law and her husband had died, she kneeled down and gave birth, because her pains came upon her.
verses.textEn: His daughter-in-law, the wife of Phinehas, was pregnant and near the time of delivery. When she heard the news that the ark of God had been captured and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, she went into labor and gave birth, but was overcome by her labor pains.

verses.textZh: 她快要死的时候，站在旁边的妇女们对她说："不要怕，你生了一个儿子！"她却不回答，也不理会。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她快要死的时候，站在旁边的妇女们对她说："不要怕，你生了一个儿子！"她却不回答，也不理会。
verses.textZhCuv: 将要死的时候，旁边站着的妇人们对她说：「不要怕！你生了男孩子了。」她却不回答，也不放在心上。
verses.textEnNiv: As she was dying, the women attending her said, "Don’t despair; you have given birth to a son." But she did not respond or pay any attention.
verses.textEnEsv: And about the time of her death the women attending her said to her, "Do not be afraid, for you have borne a son." But she did not answer or pay attention.
verses.textEnNkjv: And about the time of her death the women who stood by her said to her, "Do not fear, for you have borne a son." But she did not answer, nor did she regard it.
verses.textEnNlt: She died in childbirth, but before she passed away the midwives tried to encourage her. "Don’t be afraid," they said. "You have a baby boy!" But she did not answer or pay attention to them.
verses.textEnNasb: And about the time of her death the women who were standing by her said to her, "Do not be afraid, for you have given birth to a son." But she did not answer or pay attention.
verses.textEn: As she was dying, the women attending her said, "Don’t despair; you have given birth to a son." But she did not respond or pay any attention.

verses.textZh: 她给孩子起名叫以迦博，说："荣耀已经离开以色列了。"这是因为神的约柜被抢去，又因为她的公公和丈夫都死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她给孩子起名叫以迦博，说："荣耀已经离开以色列了。"这是因为神的约柜被抢去，又因为她的公公和丈夫都死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 她给孩子起名叫以迦博，说：「荣耀离开以色列了！」这是因神的约柜被掳去，又因她公公和丈夫都死了。
verses.textEnNiv: She named the boy Ichabod, saying, "The Glory has departed from Israel"—because of the capture of the ark of God and the deaths of her father-in-law and her husband.
verses.textEnEsv: And she named the child Ichabod, saying, "The glory has departed from Israel!" because the ark of God had been captured and because of her father-in-law and her husband.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she named the child Ichabod, saying, "The glory has departed from Israel!" because the ark of God had been captured and because of her father-in-law and her husband.
verses.textEnNlt: She named the child Ichabod (which means "Where is the glory?"), for she said, "Israel’s glory is gone." She named him this because the Ark of God had been captured and because her father-in-law and husband were dead.
verses.textEnNasb: And she named the boy Ichabod, saying, "The glory has departed from Israel," because the ark of God had been taken and because of her father-in-law and her husband.
verses.textEn: She named the boy Ichabod, saying, "The Glory has departed from Israel"—because of the capture of the ark of God and the deaths of her father-in-law and her husband.

verses.textZh: 她说："荣耀已经离开了以色列，因为神的约柜被抢去了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她说："荣耀已经离开了以色列，因为神的约柜被抢去了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 她又说：「荣耀离开以色列，因为神的约柜被掳去了。」
verses.textEnNiv: She said, "The Glory has departed from Israel, for the ark of God has been captured."
verses.textEnEsv: And she said, "The glory has departed from Israel, for the ark of God has been captured."
verses.textEnNkjv: And she said, "The glory has departed from Israel, for the ark of God has been captured."
verses.textEnNlt: Then she said, "The glory has departed from Israel, for the Ark of God has been captured."
verses.textEnNasb: So she said, "The glory has departed from Israel, because the ark of God has been taken."
verses.textEn: She said, "The Glory has departed from Israel, for the ark of God has been captured."

verses.textZh: 非利士人抢去了神的约柜，就把它从以便以谢运到亚实突。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人抢去了神的约柜，就把它从以便以谢运到亚实突。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人将神的约柜从以便以谢抬到亚实突。
verses.textEnNiv: After the Philistines had captured the ark of God, they took it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.
verses.textEnEsv: When the Philistines captured the ark of God, they brought it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Philistines took the ark of God and brought it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.
verses.textEnNlt: After the Philistines captured the Ark of God, they took it from the battleground at Ebenezer to the town of Ashdod.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Philistines took the ark of God and brought it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.
verses.textEn: After the Philistines had captured the ark of God, they took it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.

verses.textZh: 非利士人抢去神的约柜，把它抬进大衮庙，放在大衮神像的旁边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人抢去神的约柜，把它抬进大衮庙，放在大衮神像的旁边。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人将神的约柜抬进大衮庙，放在大衮的旁边。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they carried the ark into Dagon’s temple and set it beside Dagon.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Philistines took the ark of God and brought it into the house of Dagon and set it up beside Dagon.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the Philistines took the ark of God, they brought it into the house of Dagon and set it by Dagon.
verses.textEnNlt: They carried the Ark of God into the temple of Dagon and placed it beside an idol of Dagon.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Philistines took the ark of God and brought it into the house of Dagon, and placed it beside Dagon.
verses.textEn: Then they carried the ark into Dagon’s temple and set it beside Dagon.

verses.textZh: 第二天清早，亚实突人起来，看见大衮神像仆倒在地，俯伏在耶和华的约柜面前。他们就把大衮神像竖立起来，放回原处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天清早，亚实突人起来，看见大衮神像仆倒在地，俯伏在耶和华的约柜面前。他们就把大衮神像竖立起来，放回原处。
verses.textZhCuv: 次日清早，亚实突人起来，见大衮仆倒在耶和华的约柜前，脸伏于地，就把大衮仍立在原处。
verses.textEnNiv: When the people of Ashdod rose early the next day, there was Dagon, fallen on his face on the ground before the ark of the Lord ! They took Dagon and put him back in his place.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the people of Ashdod rose early the next day, behold, Dagon had fallen face downward on the ground before the ark of the Lord . So they took Dagon and put him back in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the people of Ashdod arose early in the morning, there was Dagon, fallen on its face to the earth before the ark of the Lord. So they took Dagon and set it in its place again.
verses.textEnNlt: But when the citizens of Ashdod went to see it the next morning, Dagon had fallen with his face to the ground in front of the Ark of the Lord ! So they took Dagon and put him in his place again.
verses.textEnNasb: When the Ashdodites got up early the next day, behold, Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before the ark of the Lord. So they took Dagon and set him back in his place.
verses.textEn: When the people of Ashdod rose early the next day, there was Dagon, fallen on his face on the ground before the ark of the Lord ! They took Dagon and put him back in his place.

verses.textZh: 再次日早晨，他们起来的时候，看见大衮神像又仆倒在地，俯伏在耶和华的约柜面前，大衮的头和双手也都在门槛上折断了，只剩下大衮的身体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 再次日早晨，他们起来的时候，看见大衮神像又仆倒在地，俯伏在耶和华的约柜面前，大衮的头和双手也都在门槛上折断了，只剩下大衮的身体。
verses.textZhCuv: 又次日清早起来，见大衮仆倒在耶和华的约柜前，脸伏于地，并且大衮的头和两手都在门槛上折断，只剩下大衮的残体。（
verses.textEnNiv: But the following morning when they rose, there was Dagon, fallen on his face on the ground before the ark of the Lord ! His head and hands had been broken off and were lying on the threshold; only his body remained.
verses.textEnEsv: But when they rose early on the next morning, behold, Dagon had fallen face downward on the ground before the ark of the Lord , and the head of Dagon and both his hands were lying cut off on the threshold. Only the trunk of Dagon was left to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they arose early the next morning, there was Dagon, fallen on its face to the ground before the ark of the Lord. The head of Dagon and both the palms of its hands were broken off on the threshold; only Dagon’s torso was left of it.
verses.textEnNlt: But the next morning the same thing happened—Dagon had fallen face down before the Ark of the Lord again. This time his head and hands had broken off and were lying in the doorway. Only the trunk of his body was left intact.
verses.textEnNasb: But when they got up early the next morning, behold, Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before the ark of the Lord. And the head of Dagon and both palms of his hands were cut off on the threshold; only the torso of Dagon was left.
verses.textEn: But the following morning when they rose, there was Dagon, fallen on his face on the ground before the ark of the Lord ! His head and hands had been broken off and were lying on the threshold; only his body remained.

verses.textZh: 因此大衮的祭司和所有进亚实突大衮庙的人，都不踏大衮庙的门槛，直到现在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此大衮的祭司和所有进亚实突大衮庙的人，都不踏大衮庙的门槛，直到现在。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，大衮的祭司和一切进亚实突、大衮庙的人都不踏大衮庙的门槛，直到今日。）
verses.textEnNiv: That is why to this day neither the priests of Dagon nor any others who enter Dagon’s temple at Ashdod step on the threshold.
verses.textEnEsv: This is why the priests of Dagon and all who enter the house of Dagon do not tread on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore neither the priests of Dagon nor any who come into Dagon’s house tread on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why to this day neither the priests of Dagon nor anyone who enters the temple of Dagon in Ashdod will step on its threshold.
verses.textEnNasb: For that reason neither the priests of Dagon nor any who enter Dagon’s house step on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod to this day.
verses.textEn: That is why to this day neither the priests of Dagon nor any others who enter Dagon’s temple at Ashdod step on the threshold.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的手重重地压在亚实突人身上，败坏他们，用痔疮击打亚实突和亚实突四境的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的手重重地压在亚实突人身上，败坏他们，用痔疮击打亚实突和亚实突四境的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的手重重加在亚实突人身上，败坏他们，使他们生痔疮。亚实突和亚实突的四境都是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord ’s hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod and its vicinity; he brought devastation on them and afflicted them with tumors.
verses.textEnEsv: The hand of the Lord was heavy against the people of Ashdod, and he terrified and afflicted them with tumors, both Ashdod and its territory.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the hand of the Lord was heavy on the people of Ashdod, and He ravaged them and struck them with tumors, both Ashdod and its territory.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord ’s heavy hand struck the people of Ashdod and the nearby villages with a plague of tumors.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the hand of the Lord was heavy on the Ashdodites, and He made them feel devastated and struck them with tumors, both Ashdod and its territories.
verses.textEn: The Lord ’s hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod and its vicinity; he brought devastation on them and afflicted them with tumors.

verses.textZh: 亚实突人看见这种情形，就说："以色列神的约柜不可再留在我们这里，因为他的手重重地加在我们和我们的神大衮身上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚实突人看见这种情形，就说："以色列神的约柜不可再留在我们这里，因为他的手重重地加在我们和我们的神大衮身上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚实突人见这光景，就说：「以色列神的约柜不可留在我们这里，因为他的手重重加在我们和我们神大衮的身上」；
verses.textEnNiv: When the people of Ashdod saw what was happening, they said, "The ark of the god of Israel must not stay here with us, because his hand is heavy on us and on Dagon our god."
verses.textEnEsv: And when the men of Ashdod saw how things were, they said, "The ark of the God of Israel must not remain with us, for his hand is hard against us and against Dagon our god."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the men of Ashdod saw how itwas, they said, "The ark of the God of Israel must not remain with us, for His hand is harsh toward us and Dagon our god."
verses.textEnNlt: When the people realized what was happening, they cried out, "We can’t keep the Ark of the God of Israel here any longer! He is against us! We will all be destroyed along with Dagon, our god."
verses.textEnNasb: When the men of Ashdod saw that it was so, they said, "The ark of the God of Israel must not remain with us, because His hand is severe on us and on Dagon our god."
verses.textEn: When the people of Ashdod saw what was happening, they said, "The ark of the god of Israel must not stay here with us, because his hand is heavy on us and on Dagon our god."

verses.textZh: 他们就派人去召集非利士人各城的首领前来，问他们："我们要怎样处理以色列神的约柜呢？"他们回答："把以色列神的约柜运到迦特去吧。"他们就把它运到迦特去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就派人去召集非利士人各城的首领前来，问他们："我们要怎样处理以色列神的约柜呢？"他们回答："把以色列神的约柜运到迦特去吧。"他们就把它运到迦特去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 就打发人去请非利士的众首领来聚集，问他们说：「我们向以色列神的约柜应当怎样行呢？」他们回答说：「可以将以色列神的约柜运到迦特去。」于是将以色列神的约柜运到那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: So they called together all the rulers of the Philistines and asked them, "What shall we do with the ark of the god of Israel?" They answered, "Have the ark of the god of Israel moved to Gath." So they moved the ark of the God of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: So they sent and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines and said, "What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel?" They answered, "Let the ark of the God of Israel be brought around to Gath." So they brought the ark of the God of Israel there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they sent and gathered to themselves all the lords of the Philistines, and said, "What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel?" And they answered, "Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried away to Gath." So they carried the ark of the God of Israel away.
verses.textEnNlt: So they called together the rulers of the Philistine towns and asked, "What should we do with the Ark of the God of Israel?" The rulers discussed it and replied, "Move it to the town of Gath." So they moved the Ark of the God of Israel to Gath.
verses.textEnNasb: So they sent word and gathered all the governors of the Philistines to them, and said, "What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel?" And they said, "Have the ark of the God of Israel brought to Gath." So they took the ark of the God of Israel away.
verses.textEn: So they called together all the rulers of the Philistines and asked them, "What shall we do with the ark of the god of Israel?" They answered, "Have the ark of the god of Israel moved to Gath." So they moved the ark of the God of Israel.

verses.textZh: 运到那里以后，耶和华的手攻击那城，引起很大的恐慌。他击打全城的人，不分老幼，使痔疮在他们中间蔓延。
verses.textZhCnvs: 运到那里以后，耶和华的手攻击那城，引起很大的恐慌。他击打全城的人，不分老幼，使痔疮在他们中间蔓延。
verses.textZhCuv: 运到之后，耶和华的手攻击那城，使那城的人大大惊慌，无论大小都生痔疮。
verses.textEnNiv: But after they had moved it, the Lord ’s hand was against that city, throwing it into a great panic. He afflicted the people of the city, both young and old, with an outbreak of tumors.
verses.textEnEsv: But after they had brought it around, the hand of the Lord was against the city, causing a very great panic, and he afflicted the men of the city, both young and old, so that tumors broke out on them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, after they had carried it away, that the hand of the Lord was against the city with a very great destruction; and He struck the men of the city, both small and great, and tumors broke out on them.
verses.textEnNlt: But when the Ark arrived at Gath, the Lord ’s heavy hand fell on its men, young and old; he struck them with a plague of tumors, and there was a great panic.
verses.textEnNasb: After they had taken it away, the hand of the Lord was against the city, creating a very great panic; and He struck the people of the city, from the young to the old, so that tumors broke out on them.
verses.textEn: But after they had moved it, the Lord ’s hand was against that city, throwing it into a great panic. He afflicted the people of the city, both young and old, with an outbreak of tumors.

verses.textZh: 于是他们把神的约柜送到以革伦。神的约柜到了以革伦的时候，以革伦人就喊叫："他们把以色列神的约柜运到我们这里来，是要杀害我们和我们的人啊！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们把神的约柜送到以革伦。神的约柜到了以革伦的时候，以革伦人就喊叫："他们把以色列神的约柜运到我们这里来，是要杀害我们和我们的人啊！"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就把神的约柜送到以革伦。神的约柜到了，以革伦人就喊嚷起来说：「他们将以色列神的约柜运到我们这里，要害我们和我们的众民！」
verses.textEnNiv: So they sent the ark of God to Ekron. As the ark of God was entering Ekron, the people of Ekron cried out, "They have brought the ark of the god of Israel around to us to kill us and our people."
verses.textEnEsv: So they sent the ark of God to Ekron. But as soon as the ark of God came to Ekron, the people of Ekron cried out, "They have brought around to us the ark of the God of Israel to kill us and our people."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they sent the ark of God to Ekron. So it was, as the ark of God came to Ekron, that the Ekronites cried out, saying, "They have brought the ark of the God of Israel to us, to kill us and our people!"
verses.textEnNlt: So they sent the Ark of God to the town of Ekron, but when the people of Ekron saw it coming they cried out, "They are bringing the Ark of the God of Israel here to kill us, too!"
verses.textEnNasb: So they sent the ark of God to Ekron. And as the ark of God came to Ekron, the Ekronites cried out, saying, "They have brought the ark of the God of Israel to us, to kill us and our people!"
verses.textEn: So they sent the ark of God to Ekron. As the ark of God was entering Ekron, the people of Ekron cried out, "They have brought the ark of the god of Israel around to us to kill us and our people."

verses.textZh: 于是他们派人去召集非利士人各城的首领前来，对他们说："请把以色列神的约柜送回原处，免得它杀害我们和我们的人民。"死亡的恐慌笼罩全城，因为神的手重重地压在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们派人去召集非利士人各城的首领前来，对他们说："请把以色列神的约柜送回原处，免得它杀害我们和我们的人民。"死亡的恐慌笼罩全城，因为神的手重重地压在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是打发人去请非利士的众首领来，说：「愿你们将以色列神的约柜送回原处，免得害了我们和我们的众民！」原来神的手重重攻击那城，城中的人有因惊慌而死的；
verses.textEnNiv: So they called together all the rulers of the Philistines and said, "Send the ark of the god of Israel away; let it go back to its own place, or it will kill us and our people." For death had filled the city with panic; God’s hand was very heavy on it.
verses.textEnEsv: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines and said, "Send away the ark of the God of Israel, and let it return to its own place, that it may not kill us and our people." For there was a deathly panic throughout the whole city. The hand of God was very heavy there.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they sent and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and said, "Send away the ark of the God of Israel, and let it go back to its own place, so that it does not kill us and our people." For there was a deadly destruction throughout all the city; the hand of God was very heavy there.
verses.textEnNlt: The people summoned the Philistine rulers again and begged them, "Please send the Ark of the God of Israel back to its own country, or it will kill us all." For the deadly plague from God had already begun, and great fear was sweeping across the town.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore they sent word and gathered all the governors of the Philistines, and said, "Send away the ark of the God of Israel and let it return to its own place, so that it will not kill us and our people!" For there was a deadly panic throughout the city; the hand of God was very heavy there.
verses.textEn: So they called together all the rulers of the Philistines and said, "Send the ark of the god of Israel away; let it go back to its own place, or it will kill us and our people." For death had filled the city with panic; God’s hand was very heavy on it.

verses.textZh: 没有死的人都遭受痔疮的打击；那城的哀声，上达于天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有死的人都遭受痔疮的打击；那城的哀声，上达于天。
verses.textZhCuv: 未曾死的人都生了痔疮。合城呼号，声音上达于天。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who did not die were afflicted with tumors, and the outcry of the city went up to heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: The men who did not die were struck with tumors, and the cry of the city went up to heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the men who did not die were stricken with the tumors, and the cry of the city went up to heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who didn’t die were afflicted with tumors; and the cry from the town rose to heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: And the people who did not die were struck with tumors, and the outcry of the city went up to heaven.
verses.textEn: Those who did not die were afflicted with tumors, and the outcry of the city went up to heaven.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的约柜在非利士人的地方有七个月之久。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的约柜在非利士人的地方有七个月之久。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的约柜在非利士人之地七个月。
verses.textEnNiv: When the ark of the Lord had been in Philistine territory seven months,
verses.textEnEsv: The ark of the Lord was in the country of the Philistines seven months.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the ark of the Lord was in the country of the Philistines seven months.
verses.textEnNlt: The Ark of the Lord remained in Philistine territory seven months in all.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the ark of the Lord had been in the territory of the Philistines for seven months.
verses.textEn: When the ark of the Lord had been in Philistine territory seven months,

verses.textZh: 非利士人把众祭司和占卜的都召了来，问他们："我们应该怎样处理耶和华的约柜呢？请告诉我们，要怎样才能把它送回原处呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人把众祭司和占卜的都召了来，问他们："我们应该怎样处理耶和华的约柜呢？请告诉我们，要怎样才能把它送回原处呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人将祭司和占卜的聚了来，问他们说：「我们向耶和华的约柜应当怎样行？请指示我们用何法将约柜送回原处。」
verses.textEnNiv: the Philistines called for the priests and the diviners and said, "What shall we do with the ark of the Lord ? Tell us how we should send it back to its place."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Philistines called for the priests and the diviners and said, "What shall we do with the ark of the Lord ? Tell us with what we shall send it to its place."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Philistines called for the priests and the diviners, saying, "What shall we do with the ark of the Lord? Tell us how we should send it to its place."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Philistines called in their priests and diviners and asked them, "What should we do about the Ark of the Lord ? Tell us how to return it to its own country."
verses.textEnNasb: And the Philistines called for the priests and the diviners, saying, "What are we to do with the ark of the Lord? Tell us how we may send it to its place."
verses.textEn: the Philistines called for the priests and the diviners and said, "What shall we do with the ark of the Lord ? Tell us how we should send it back to its place."

verses.textZh: 他们回答："你们把以色列神的约柜送回去的时候，不可空空地把它送回去，却要偿还赔罪的礼物，这样，你们就可以得着医治，也可以知道，为甚么他的手没有离开你们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回答："你们把以色列神的约柜送回去的时候，不可空空地把它送回去，却要偿还赔罪的礼物，这样，你们就可以得着医治，也可以知道，为甚么他的手没有离开你们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「若要将以色列神的约柜送回去，不可空空地送去，必要给他献赔罪的礼物，然后你们可得痊愈，并知道他的手为何不离开你们。」
verses.textEnNiv: They answered, "If you return the ark of the god of Israel, do not send it back to him without a gift; by all means send a guilt offering to him. Then you will be healed, and you will know why his hand has not been lifted from you."
verses.textEnEsv: They said, "If you send away the ark of the God of Israel, do not send it empty, but by all means return him a guilt offering. Then you will be healed, and it will be known to you why his hand does not turn away from you."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they said, "If you send away the ark of the God of Israel, do not send it empty; but by all means return it to Him with a trespass offering. Then you will be healed, and it will be known to you why His hand is not removed from you."
verses.textEnNlt: "Send the Ark of the God of Israel back with a gift," they were told. "Send a guilt offering so the plague will stop. Then, if you are healed, you will know it was his hand that caused the plague."
verses.textEnNasb: And they said, "If you are going to send the ark of the God of Israel away, do not send it empty; but you shall certainly return to Him a guilt offering. Then you will be healed, and it will be revealed to you why His hand does not leave you."
verses.textEn: They answered, "If you return the ark of the god of Israel, do not send it back to him without a gift; by all means send a guilt offering to him. Then you will be healed, and you will know why his hand has not been lifted from you."

verses.textZh: 非利士人问："我们应当偿给他甚么作赔罪的礼物呢？"他们回答："要按照非利士人各城首领的数目，用五个金痔疮和五只金老鼠作赔罪的礼物，因为你们所有的人和你们各城的首领所遭遇的，都是一样的灾祸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人问："我们应当偿给他甚么作赔罪的礼物呢？"他们回答："要按照非利士人各城首领的数目，用五个金痔疮和五只金老鼠作赔罪的礼物，因为你们所有的人和你们各城的首领所遭遇的，都是一样的灾祸。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人说：「应当用什么献为赔罪的礼物呢？」他们回答说：「当照非利士首领的数目，用五个金痔疮，五个金老鼠，因为在你们众人和你们首领的身上都是一样的灾。
verses.textEnNiv: The Philistines asked, "What guilt offering should we send to him?" They replied, "Five gold tumors and five gold rats, according to the number of the Philistine rulers, because the same plague has struck both you and your rulers.
verses.textEnEsv: And they said, "What is the guilt offering that we shall return to him?" They answered, "Five golden tumors and five golden mice, according to the number of the lords of the Philistines, for the same plague was on all of you and on your lords.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said, "What is the trespass offering which we shall return to Him?" They answered, "Five golden tumors and five golden rats, accordingto the number of the lords of the Philistines. For the same plague was on all of you and on your lords.
verses.textEnNlt: "What sort of guilt offering should we send?" they asked. And they were told, "Since the plague has struck both you and your five rulers, make five gold tumors and five gold rats, just like those that have ravaged your land.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they said, "What is to be the guilt offering that we shall return to Him?" And they said, "Five gold tumors and five gold mice corresponding to the number of the governors of the Philistines, since one plague was on all of you and on your governors.
verses.textEn: The Philistines asked, "What guilt offering should we send to him?" They replied, "Five gold tumors and five gold rats, according to the number of the Philistine rulers, because the same plague has struck both you and your rulers.

verses.textZh: 所以你们要做痔疮的像和毁坏田地的老鼠的像，还要把荣耀归给以色列的神。也许他会向你们、你们的神和你们的田地手下留情。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们要做痔疮的像和毁坏田地的老鼠的像，还要把荣耀归给以色列的神。也许他会向你们、你们的神和你们的田地手下留情。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以当制造你们痔疮的像和毁坏你们田地老鼠的像，并要归荣耀给以色列的神，或者他向你们和你们的神，并你们的田地，把手放轻些。
verses.textEnNiv: Make models of the tumors and of the rats that are destroying the country, and give glory to Israel’s god. Perhaps he will lift his hand from you and your gods and your land.
verses.textEnEsv: So you must make images of your tumors and images of your mice that ravage the land, and give glory to the God of Israel. Perhaps he will lighten his hand from off you and your gods and your land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore you shall make images of your tumors and images of your rats that ravage the land, and you shall give glory to the God of Israel; perhaps He will lighten His hand from you, from your gods, and from your land.
verses.textEnNlt: Make these things to show honor to the God of Israel. Perhaps then he will stop afflicting you, your gods, and your land.
verses.textEnNasb: So you shall make likenesses of your tumors and likenesses of your mice that are ruining the land, and you shall give glory to the God of Israel; perhaps He will lighten His hand from you, your gods, and your land.
verses.textEn: Make models of the tumors and of the rats that are destroying the country, and give glory to Israel’s god. Perhaps he will lift his hand from you and your gods and your land.

verses.textZh: 你们为甚么要硬着心，像以前埃及人和法老那样呢？神严严地对付他们以后，他们不是放走了以色列人，以色列人不是真的离开了吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们为甚么要硬着心，像以前埃及人和法老那样呢？神严严地对付他们以后，他们不是放走了以色列人，以色列人不是真的离开了吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们为何硬着心像埃及人和法老一样呢？神在埃及人中间行奇事，埃及人岂不释放以色列人，他们就去了吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Why do you harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh did? When Israel’s god dealt harshly with them, did they not send the Israelites out so they could go on their way?
verses.textEnEsv: Why should you harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts? After he had dealt severely with them, did they not send the people away, and they departed?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why then do you harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts? When He did mighty things among them, did they not let the people go, that they might depart?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t be stubborn and rebellious as Pharaoh and the Egyptians were. By the time God was finished with them, they were eager to let Israel go.
verses.textEnNasb: Why then do you harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts? When He had severely dealt with them, did they not let the people go, and they left?
verses.textEn: Why do you harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh did? When Israel’s god dealt harshly with them, did they not send the Israelites out so they could go on their way?

verses.textZh: 现在你们要预备一辆新车和两头仍在乳养小牛、未曾负过轭的母牛，把牠们紧紧套在车上，把小牛从牠们身边带回棚里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们要预备一辆新车和两头仍在乳养小牛、未曾负过轭的母牛，把牠们紧紧套在车上，把小牛从牠们身边带回棚里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你们应当造一辆新车，将两只未曾负轭有乳的母牛套在车上，使牛犊回家去，离开母牛。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now then, get a new cart ready, with two cows that have calved and have never been yoked. Hitch the cows to the cart, but take their calves away and pen them up.
verses.textEnEsv: Now then, take and prepare a new cart and two milk cows on which there has never come a yoke, and yoke the cows to the cart, but take their calves home, away from them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, make a new cart, take two milk cows which have never been yoked, and hitch the cows to the cart; and take their calves home, away from them.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now build a new cart, and find two cows that have just given birth to calves. Make sure the cows have never been yoked to a cart. Hitch the cows to the cart, but shut their calves away from them in a pen.
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, take and prepare a new cart and two milk cows on which there has never been a yoke; and hitch the cows to the cart and take their calves back home, away from them.
verses.textEn: "Now then, get a new cart ready, with two cows that have calved and have never been yoked. Hitch the cows to the cart, but take their calves away and pen them up.

verses.textZh: 你们要把耶和华的约柜搬来，放在车上，把那些偿给他作赔罪礼物的金器放在盒子里，放置在约柜旁边，然后把它送上路，让它自己走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要把耶和华的约柜搬来，放在车上，把那些偿给他作赔罪礼物的金器放在盒子里，放置在约柜旁边，然后把它送上路，让它自己走。
verses.textZhCuv: 把耶和华的约柜放在车上，将所献赔罪的金物装在匣子里，放在柜旁，将柜送去。
verses.textEnNiv: Take the ark of the Lord and put it on the cart, and in a chest beside it put the gold objects you are sending back to him as a guilt offering. Send it on its way,
verses.textEnEsv: And take the ark of the Lord and place it on the cart and put in a box at its side the figures of gold, which you are returning to him as a guilt offering. Then send it off and let it go its way
verses.textEnNkjv: Then take the ark of the Lord and set it on the cart; and put the articles of gold which you are returning to Him as a trespass offering in a chest by its side. Then send it away, and let it go.
verses.textEnNlt: Put the Ark of the Lord on the cart, and beside it place a chest containing the gold rats and gold tumors you are sending as a guilt offering. Then let the cows go wherever they want.
verses.textEnNasb: Then take the ark of the Lord and place it on the cart; and put the articles of gold which you return to Him as a guilt offering in a saddlebag by its side. Then send it away that it may go.
verses.textEn: Take the ark of the Lord and put it on the cart, and in a chest beside it put the gold objects you are sending back to him as a guilt offering. Send it on its way,

verses.textZh: 你们要留意看，如果它是走向自己的境界，往伯．示麦去，那么就是耶和华降这大灾给我们；如果不是这样，我们就知道，不是他的手攻击我们，我们遭遇的不过是偶然的事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要留意看，如果它是走向自己的境界，往伯．示麦去，那么就是耶和华降这大灾给我们；如果不是这样，我们就知道，不是他的手攻击我们，我们遭遇的不过是偶然的事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要看看：车若直行以色列的境界到伯‧示麦去，这大灾就是耶和华降在我们身上的；若不然，便可以知道不是他的手击打我们，是我们偶然遇见的。」
verses.textEnNiv: but keep watching it. If it goes up to its own territory, toward Beth Shemesh, then the Lord has brought this great disaster on us. But if it does not, then we will know that it was not his hand that struck us but that it happened to us by chance."
verses.textEnEsv: and watch. If it goes up on the way to its own land, to Beth-shemesh, then it is he who has done us this great harm, but if not, then we shall know that it is not his hand that struck us; it happened to us by coincidence."
verses.textEnNkjv: And watch: if it goes up the road to its own territory, to Beth Shemesh, then He has done us this great evil. But if not, then we shall know that itis not His hand that struck us—it happened to us by chance."
verses.textEnNlt: If they cross the border of our land and go to Beth-shemesh, we will know it was the Lord who brought this great disaster upon us. If they don’t, we will know it was not his hand that caused the plague. It came simply by chance."
verses.textEnNasb: But watch: if it goes up by the way of its own territory to Beth-shemesh, then He has done this great evil to us. But if not, then we will know that it was not His hand that struck us; it happened to us by chance."
verses.textEn: but keep watching it. If it goes up to its own territory, toward Beth Shemesh, then the Lord has brought this great disaster on us. But if it does not, then we will know that it was not his hand that struck us but that it happened to us by chance."

verses.textZh: 非利士人就照着去行。他们牵来两头还在乳养小牛的母牛，把牠们紧紧套在车上，把小牛关在棚里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人就照着去行。他们牵来两头还在乳养小牛的母牛，把牠们紧紧套在车上，把小牛关在棚里。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人就这样行：将两只有乳的母牛套在车上，将牛犊关在家里，
verses.textEnNiv: So they did this. They took two such cows and hitched them to the cart and penned up their calves.
verses.textEnEsv: The men did so, and took two milk cows and yoked them to the cart and shut up their calves at home.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the men did so; they took two milk cows and hitched them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home.
verses.textEnNlt: So these instructions were carried out. Two cows were hitched to the cart, and their newborn calves were shut up in a pen.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the men did so: they took two milk cows and hitched them to the cart, and shut in their calves at home.
verses.textEn: So they did this. They took two such cows and hitched them to the cart and penned up their calves.

verses.textZh: 他们又把耶和华的约柜，装金老鼠和痔疮像的盒子，都放在车上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又把耶和华的约柜，装金老鼠和痔疮像的盒子，都放在车上。
verses.textZhCuv: 把耶和华的约柜和装金老鼠并金痔疮像的匣子都放在车上。
verses.textEnNiv: They placed the ark of the Lord on the cart and along with it the chest containing the gold rats and the models of the tumors.
verses.textEnEsv: And they put the ark of the Lord on the cart and the box with the golden mice and the images of their tumors.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they set the ark of the Lord on the cart, and the chest with the gold rats and the images of their tumors.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Ark of the Lord and the chest containing the gold rats and gold tumors were placed on the cart.
verses.textEnNasb: And they put the ark of the Lord on the cart, and the saddlebag with the gold mice and the likenesses of their tumors.
verses.textEn: They placed the ark of the Lord on the cart and along with it the chest containing the gold rats and the models of the tumors.

verses.textZh: 牛向着伯．示麦的路上直奔，如同走在一条大路上，一面走一面叫，不偏左也不偏右。非利士各城的首领在后面跟着走，直到伯．示麦的边界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牛向着伯．示麦的路上直奔，如同走在一条大路上，一面走一面叫，不偏左也不偏右。非利士各城的首领在后面跟着走，直到伯．示麦的边界。
verses.textZhCuv: 牛直行大道，往伯‧示麦去，一面走一面叫，不偏左右。非利士的首领跟在后面，直到伯‧示麦的境界。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the cows went straight up toward Beth Shemesh, keeping on the road and lowing all the way; they did not turn to the right or to the left. The rulers of the Philistines followed them as far as the border of Beth Shemesh.
verses.textEnEsv: And the cows went straight in the direction of Beth-shemesh along one highway, lowing as they went. They turned neither to the right nor to the left, and the lords of the Philistines went after them as far as the border of Beth-shemesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the cows headed straight for the road to Beth Shemesh, and went along the highway, lowing as they went, and did not turn aside to the right hand or the left. And the lords of the Philistines went after them to the border of Beth Shemesh.
verses.textEnNlt: And sure enough, without veering off in other directions, the cows went straight along the road toward Beth-shemesh, lowing as they went. The Philistine rulers followed them as far as the border of Beth-shemesh.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the cows went straight in the direction of Beth-shemesh; they went on the same road, bellowing as they went, and did not turn off to the right or to the left. And the governors of the Philistines followed them to the border of Beth-shemesh.
verses.textEn: Then the cows went straight up toward Beth Shemesh, keeping on the road and lowing all the way; they did not turn to the right or to the left. The rulers of the Philistines followed them as far as the border of Beth Shemesh.

verses.textZh: 那时，伯．示麦人正在谷中收割麦子，他们举目观看，看见了约柜，就欢欢喜喜迎见约柜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，伯．示麦人正在谷中收割麦子，他们举目观看，看见了约柜，就欢欢喜喜迎见约柜。
verses.textZhCuv: 伯‧示麦人正在平原收割麦子，举目看见约柜，就欢喜了。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the people of Beth Shemesh were harvesting their wheat in the valley, and when they looked up and saw the ark, they rejoiced at the sight.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the people of Beth-shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley. And when they lifted up their eyes and saw the ark, they rejoiced to see it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now thepeopleof Beth Shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley; and they lifted their eyes and saw the ark, and rejoiced to see it.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Beth-shemesh were harvesting wheat in the valley, and when they saw the Ark, they were overjoyed!
verses.textEnNasb: Now the people of Beth-shemesh were gathering in their wheat harvest in the valley, and they raised their eyes and saw the ark, and rejoiced at seeing it.
verses.textEn: Now the people of Beth Shemesh were harvesting their wheat in the valley, and when they looked up and saw the ark, they rejoiced at the sight.

verses.textZh: 牛车到了伯．示麦人约书亚的田间，就停在那里；那里有一块大石，他们把做那车的木料劈开，又把那两只母牛作燔祭献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牛车到了伯．示麦人约书亚的田间，就停在那里；那里有一块大石，他们把做那车的木料劈开，又把那两只母牛作燔祭献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 车到了伯‧示麦人约书亚的田间，就站住了。在那里有一块大磐石，他们把车劈了，将两只母牛献给耶和华为燔祭。
verses.textEnNiv: The cart came to the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh, and there it stopped beside a large rock. The people chopped up the wood of the cart and sacrificed the cows as a burnt offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The cart came into the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh and stopped there. A great stone was there. And they split up the wood of the cart and offered the cows as a burnt offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the cart came into the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh, and stood there; a large stone was there. So they split the wood of the cart and offered the cows as a burnt offering to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The cart came into the field of a man named Joshua and stopped beside a large rock. So the people broke up the wood of the cart for a fire and killed the cows and sacrificed them to the Lord as a burnt offering.
verses.textEnNasb: And the cart came into the field of Joshua the Beth-shemite and stopped there where there was a large stone; and they split the wood of the cart and offered the cows as a burnt offering to the Lord.
verses.textEn: The cart came to the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh, and there it stopped beside a large rock. The people chopped up the wood of the cart and sacrificed the cows as a burnt offering to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 利未人把耶和华的约柜，与它一同送来装有金器的盒子，都搬了下来，放在大石上；那一天，伯．示麦人向耶和华献上燔祭，又献上其他的祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人把耶和华的约柜，与它一同送来装有金器的盒子，都搬了下来，放在大石上；那一天，伯．示麦人向耶和华献上燔祭，又献上其他的祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人将耶和华的约柜和装金物的匣子拿下来，放在大磐石上。当日伯‧示麦人将燔祭和平安祭献给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: The Levites took down the ark of the Lord , together with the chest containing the gold objects, and placed them on the large rock. On that day the people of Beth Shemesh offered burnt offerings and made sacrifices to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And the Levites took down the ark of the Lord and the box that was beside it, in which were the golden figures, and set them upon the great stone. And the men of Beth-shemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices on that day to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: The Levites took down the ark of the Lord and the chest that was with it, in which were the articles of gold, and put them on the large stone. Then the men of Beth Shemesh offered burnt offerings and made sacrifices the same day to the Lord.
