verses.textEnNlt: Several men of the tribe of Levi lifted the Ark of the Lord and the chest containing the gold rats and gold tumors from the cart and placed them on the large rock. Many sacrifices and burnt offerings were offered to the Lord that day by the people of Beth-shemesh.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Levites took down the ark of the Lord and the saddlebag that was with it, in which were the articles of gold, and put them on the large stone; and the men of Beth-shemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices that day to the Lord.
verses.textEn: The Levites took down the ark of the Lord , together with the chest containing the gold objects, and placed them on the large rock. On that day the people of Beth Shemesh offered burnt offerings and made sacrifices to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 非利士人的五个首领看见了，当天就回以革伦去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人的五个首领看见了，当天就回以革伦去。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人的五个首领看见，当日就回以革伦去了。
verses.textEnNiv: The five rulers of the Philistines saw all this and then returned that same day to Ekron.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the five lords of the Philistines saw it, they returned that day to Ekron.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when the five lords of the Philistines had seen it, they returned to Ekron the same day.
verses.textEnNlt: The five Philistine rulers watched all this and then returned to Ekron that same day.
verses.textEnNasb: When the five governors of the Philistines saw it, they returned to Ekron that day.
verses.textEn: The five rulers of the Philistines saw all this and then returned that same day to Ekron.

verses.textZh: 这些金痔疮，就是非利士人偿给耶和华作赔罪的礼物的，一个是为亚实突，一个是为迦萨，一个是为亚实基伦，一个是为迦特，一个是为以革伦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些金痔疮，就是非利士人偿给耶和华作赔罪的礼物的，一个是为亚实突，一个是为迦萨，一个是为亚实基伦，一个是为迦特，一个是为以革伦。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人献给耶和华作赔罪的金痔疮像，就是这些：一个是为亚实突，一个是为迦萨，一个是为亚实基伦，一个是为迦特，一个是为以革伦。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the gold tumors the Philistines sent as a guilt offering to the Lord —one each for Ashdod, Gaza, Ashkelon, Gath and Ekron.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the golden tumors that the Philistines returned as a guilt offering to the Lord : one for Ashdod, one for Gaza, one for Ashkelon, one for Gath, one for Ekron,
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the golden tumors which the Philistines returned as a trespass offering to the Lord: one for Ashdod, one for Gaza, one for Ashkelon, one for Gath, one for Ekron;
verses.textEnNlt: The five gold tumors sent by the Philistines as a guilt offering to the Lord were gifts from the rulers of Ashdod, Gaza, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the gold tumors which the Philistines returned as a guilt offering to the Lord: one for Ashdod, one for Gaza, one for Ashkelon, one for Gath, and one for Ekron;
verses.textEn: These are the gold tumors the Philistines sent as a guilt offering to the Lord —one each for Ashdod, Gaza, Ashkelon, Gath and Ekron.

verses.textZh: 金老鼠的数目是按照非利士人五个首领所有的城市的数目，包括设防城和乡村。他们安放耶和华约柜的那块大石，直到现在还是在伯．示麦人约书亚的田间，是一个证物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 金老鼠的数目是按照非利士人五个首领所有的城市的数目，包括设防城和乡村。他们安放耶和华约柜的那块大石，直到现在还是在伯．示麦人约书亚的田间，是一个证物。
verses.textZhCuv: 金老鼠的数目是照非利士五个首领的城邑，就是坚固的城邑和乡村，以及大磐石。这磐石是放耶和华约柜的，到今日还在伯‧示麦人约书亚的田间。
verses.textEnNiv: And the number of the gold rats was according to the number of Philistine towns belonging to the five rulers—the fortified towns with their country villages. The large rock on which the Levites set the ark of the Lord is a witness to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh.
verses.textEnEsv: and the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both fortified cities and unwalled villages. The great stone beside which they set down the ark of the Lord is a witness to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the golden rats, accordingto the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both fortified cities and country villages, even as far as the large stoneof Abel on which they set the ark of the Lord, whichstoneremains to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh.
verses.textEnNlt: The five gold rats represented the five Philistine towns and their surrounding villages, which were controlled by the five rulers. The large rock at Beth-shemesh, where they set the Ark of the Lord , still stands in the field of Joshua as a witness to what happened there.
verses.textEnNasb: and the gold mice, corresponding to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five governors, both of fortified cities and of country villages. The large stone on which they placed the ark of the Lordis a witness to this day in the field of Joshua the Beth-shemite.
verses.textEn: And the number of the gold rats was according to the number of Philistine towns belonging to the five rulers—the fortified towns with their country villages. The large rock on which the Levites set the ark of the Lord is a witness to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh.

verses.textZh: 耶和华因为伯．示麦人偷窥他的约柜，就击杀他们；他击杀了七十人 。众人因为耶和华用大灾击杀他们，就哀哭起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华因为伯．示麦人偷窥他的约柜，就击杀他们；他击杀了七十人 。众人因为耶和华用大灾击杀他们，就哀哭起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华因伯‧示麦人擅观他的约柜，就击杀了他们七十人；那时有五万人在那里 。百姓因耶和华大大击杀他们，就哀哭了。
verses.textEnNiv: But God struck down some of the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh, putting seventy of them to death because they looked into the ark of the Lord . The people mourned because of the heavy blow the Lord had dealt them.
verses.textEnEsv: And he struck some of the men of Beth-shemesh, because they looked upon the ark of the Lord . He struck seventy men of them, and the people mourned because the Lord had struck the people with a great blow.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He struck the men of Beth Shemesh, because they had looked into the ark of the Lord. He struck fifty thousand and seventy men of the people, and the people lamented because the Lord had struck the people with a great slaughter.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord killed seventy men from Beth-shemesh because they looked into the Ark of the Lord . And the people mourned greatly because of what the Lord had done.
verses.textEnNasb: Now He fatally struck some of the men of Beth-shemesh because they had looked into the ark of the Lord. He struck 50,070 men among the people, and the people mourned because the Lord had struck the people with a great slaughter.
verses.textEn: But God struck down some of the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh, putting seventy of them to death because they looked into the ark of the Lord . The people mourned because of the heavy blow the Lord had dealt them.

verses.textZh: 伯．示麦人说："在耶和华这位圣洁的神面前，谁能站立得住呢？他可以从我们这里上到哪里去呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 伯．示麦人说："在耶和华这位圣洁的神面前，谁能站立得住呢？他可以从我们这里上到哪里去呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 伯‧示麦人说：「谁能在耶和华这圣洁的神面前侍立呢？这约柜可以从我们这里送到谁那里去呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: And the people of Beth Shemesh asked, "Who can stand in the presence of the Lord , this holy God? To whom will the ark go up from here?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then the men of Beth-shemesh said, "Who is able to stand before the Lord , this holy God? And to whom shall he go up away from us?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the men of Beth Shemesh said, "Who is able to stand before this holy Lord God? And to whom shall it go up from us?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Who is able to stand in the presence of the Lord , this holy God?" they cried out. "Where can we send the Ark from here?"
verses.textEnNasb: And the men of Beth-shemesh said, "Who is able to stand before the Lord, this holy God? And to whom will He go up from us?"
verses.textEn: And the people of Beth Shemesh asked, "Who can stand in the presence of the Lord , this holy God? To whom will the ark go up from here?"

verses.textZh: 于是他们派遣使者到基列．耶琳的居民那里去，对他们说："非利士人把耶和华的约柜送回来了。你们下来把它接到你们那里去吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们派遣使者到基列．耶琳的居民那里去，对他们说："非利士人把耶和华的约柜送回来了。你们下来把它接到你们那里去吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是打发人去见基列‧耶琳的居民，说：「非利士人将耶和华的约柜送回来了，你们下来将约柜接到你们那里去吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then they sent messengers to the people of Kiriath Jearim, saying, "The Philistines have returned the ark of the Lord . Come down and take it up to your town."
verses.textEnEsv: So they sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath-jearim, saying, "The Philistines have returned the ark of the Lord . Come down and take it up to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kirjath Jearim, saying, "The Philistines have brought back the ark of the Lord; come down and take it up with you."
verses.textEnNlt: So they sent messengers to the people at Kiriath-jearim and told them, "The Philistines have returned the Ark of the Lord . Come here and get it!"
verses.textEnNasb: So they sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath-jearim, saying, "The Philistines have brought back the ark of the Lord; come down and take it up to yourselves."
verses.textEn: Then they sent messengers to the people of Kiriath Jearim, saying, "The Philistines have returned the ark of the Lord . Come down and take it up to your town."

verses.textZh: 基列．耶琳人就前来，把耶和华的约柜抬上去；他们把它抬到山上亚比拿达的家中，又把他的儿子以利亚撒分别为圣，看守耶和华的约柜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基列．耶琳人就前来，把耶和华的约柜抬上去；他们把它抬到山上亚比拿达的家中，又把他的儿子以利亚撒分别为圣，看守耶和华的约柜。
verses.textZhCuv: 基列‧耶琳人就下来，将耶和华的约柜接上去，放在山上亚比拿达的家中，分派他儿子以利亚撒看守耶和华的约柜。
verses.textEnNiv: So the men of Kiriath Jearim came and took up the ark of the Lord . They brought it to Abinadab’s house on the hill and consecrated Eleazar his son to guard the ark of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And the men of Kiriath-jearim came and took up the ark of the Lord and brought it to the house of Abinadab on the hill. And they consecrated his son Eleazar to have charge of the ark of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the men of Kirjath Jearim came and took the ark of the Lord, and brought it into the house of Abinadab on the hill, and consecrated Eleazar his son to keep the ark of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So the men of Kiriath-jearim came to get the Ark of the Lord . They took it to the hillside home of Abinadab and ordained Eleazar, his son, to be in charge of it.
verses.textEnNasb: And the men of Kiriath-jearim came and took the ark of the Lord and brought it into the house of Abinadab on the hill, and they consecrated his son Eleazar to watch over the ark of the Lord.
verses.textEn: So the men of Kiriath Jearim came and took up the ark of the Lord . They brought it to Abinadab’s house on the hill and consecrated Eleazar his son to guard the ark of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 约柜停留在基列．耶琳很久，有二十年之久，以色列全家都痛悔寻求耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约柜停留在基列．耶琳很久，有二十年之久，以色列全家都痛悔寻求耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 约柜在基列‧耶琳许久。过了二十年，以色列全家都倾向耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: The ark remained at Kiriath Jearim a long time—twenty years in all. Then all the people of Israel turned back to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: From the day that the ark was lodged at Kiriath-jearim, a long time passed, some twenty years, and all the house of Israel lamented after the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was that the ark remained in Kirjath Jearim a long time; it was there twenty years. And all the house of Israel lamented after the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The Ark remained in Kiriath-jearim for a long time—twenty years in all. During that time all Israel mourned because it seemed the Lord had abandoned them.
verses.textEnNasb: From the day that the ark remained at Kiriath-jearim, the time was long, for it was twenty years; and all the house of Israel mourned after the Lord.
verses.textEn: The ark remained at Kiriath Jearim a long time—twenty years in all. Then all the people of Israel turned back to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 于是撒母耳对以色列全家说："如果你们一心归向耶和华，就当把外族的神和亚斯他录从你们中间除掉，专心归向耶和华，单单事奉他，他必救你们脱离非利士人的手。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是撒母耳对以色列全家说："如果你们一心归向耶和华，就当把外族的神和亚斯他录从你们中间除掉，专心归向耶和华，单单事奉他，他必救你们脱离非利士人的手。"
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳对以色列全家说：「你们若一心归顺耶和华，就要把外邦的神和亚斯她录从你们中间除掉，专心归向耶和华，单单地事奉他。他必救你们脱离非利士人的手。」
verses.textEnNiv: So Samuel said to all the Israelites, "If you are returning to the Lord with all your hearts, then rid yourselves of the foreign gods and the Ashtoreths and commit yourselves to the Lord and serve him only, and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines."
verses.textEnEsv: And Samuel said to all the house of Israel, "If you are returning to the Lord with all your heart, then put away the foreign gods and the Ashtaroth from among you and direct your heart to the Lord and serve him only, and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Samuel spoke to all the house of Israel, saying, "If you return to the Lord with all your hearts, then put away the foreign gods and the Ashtoreths from among you, and prepare your hearts for the Lord, and serve Him only; and He will deliver you from the hand of the Philistines."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Samuel said to all the people of Israel, "If you want to return to the Lord with all your hearts, get rid of your foreign gods and your images of Ashtoreth. Turn your hearts to the Lord and obey him alone; then he will rescue you from the Philistines."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Samuel spoke to all the house of Israel, saying, "If you are returning to the Lord with all your heart, then remove the foreign gods and the Ashtaroth from among you, and direct your hearts to the Lord and serve Him alone; and He will save you from the hand of the Philistines."
verses.textEn: So Samuel said to all the Israelites, "If you are returning to the Lord with all your hearts, then rid yourselves of the foreign gods and the Ashtoreths and commit yourselves to the Lord and serve him only, and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines."

verses.textZh: 以色列人就除掉众巴力和亚斯他录，单单事奉耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人就除掉众巴力和亚斯他录，单单事奉耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人就除掉诸巴力和亚斯她录，单单地事奉耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Israelites put away their Baals and Ashtoreths, and served the Lord only.
verses.textEnEsv: So the people of Israel put away the Baals and the Ashtaroth, and they served the Lord only.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the children of Israel put away the Baals and the Ashtoreths, and served the Lord only.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Israelites got rid of their images of Baal and Ashtoreth and worshiped only the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of Israel removed the Baals and the Ashtaroth, and served the Lord alone.
verses.textEn: So the Israelites put away their Baals and Ashtoreths, and served the Lord only.

verses.textZh: 撒母耳又说："你们要把以色列众人都聚集在米斯巴，我好为你们向耶和华祷告。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳又说："你们要把以色列众人都聚集在米斯巴，我好为你们向耶和华祷告。"
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳说：「要使以色列众人聚集在米斯巴，我好为你们祷告耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Samuel said, "Assemble all Israel at Mizpah, and I will intercede with the Lord for you."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Samuel said, "Gather all Israel at Mizpah, and I will pray to the Lord for you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Samuel said, "Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray to the Lord for you."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Samuel told them, "Gather all of Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray to the Lord for you."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Samuel said, "Gather all Israel to Mizpah and I will pray to the Lord for you."
verses.textEn: Then Samuel said, "Assemble all Israel at Mizpah, and I will intercede with the Lord for you."

verses.textZh: 于是，他们聚集在米斯巴，打了水，浇奠在耶和华面前；当日他们禁食，并且在那里说："我们得罪了耶和华。"撒母耳就在米斯巴治理以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，他们聚集在米斯巴，打了水，浇奠在耶和华面前；当日他们禁食，并且在那里说："我们得罪了耶和华。"撒母耳就在米斯巴治理以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就聚集在米斯巴，打水浇在耶和华面前，当日禁食，说：「我们得罪了耶和华。」于是撒母耳在米斯巴审判以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: When they had assembled at Mizpah, they drew water and poured it out before the Lord . On that day they fasted and there they confessed, "We have sinned against the Lord ." Now Samuel was serving as leader of Israel at Mizpah.
verses.textEnEsv: So they gathered at Mizpah and drew water and poured it out before the Lord and fasted on that day and said there, "We have sinned against the Lord ." And Samuel judged the people of Israel at Mizpah.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they gathered together at Mizpah, drew water, and poured it out before the Lord. And they fasted that day, and said there, "We have sinned against the Lord." And Samuel judged the children of Israel at Mizpah.
verses.textEnNlt: So they gathered at Mizpah and, in a great ceremony, drew water from a well and poured it out before the Lord . They also went without food all day and confessed that they had sinned against the Lord . (It was at Mizpah that Samuel became Israel’s judge.)
verses.textEnNasb: So they gathered to Mizpah, and drew water and poured it out before the Lord, and fasted on that day and said there, "We have sinned against the Lord." And Samuel judged the sons of Israel at Mizpah.
verses.textEn: When they had assembled at Mizpah, they drew water and poured it out before the Lord . On that day they fasted and there they confessed, "We have sinned against the Lord ." Now Samuel was serving as leader of Israel at Mizpah.

verses.textZh: 非利士人听见以色列人集合在米斯巴，各城的领袖就上来攻打以色列人；以色列人听见了，都害怕起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人听见以色列人集合在米斯巴，各城的领袖就上来攻打以色列人；以色列人听见了，都害怕起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人听见以色列人聚集在米斯巴，非利士的首领就上来要攻击以色列人。以色列人听见，就惧怕非利士人。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Philistines heard that Israel had assembled at Mizpah, the rulers of the Philistines came up to attack them. When the Israelites heard of it, they were afraid because of the Philistines.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when the Philistines heard that the people of Israel had gathered at Mizpah, the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. And when the people of Israel heard of it, they were afraid of the Philistines.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the Philistines heard that the children of Israel had gathered together at Mizpah, the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. And when the children of Israel heard ofit, they were afraid of the Philistines.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Philistine rulers heard that Israel had gathered at Mizpah, they mobilized their army and advanced. The Israelites were badly frightened when they learned that the Philistines were approaching.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the Philistines heard that the sons of Israel had gathered at Mizpah, the governors of the Philistines went up against Israel. And when the sons of Israel heard about it, they were afraid of the Philistines.
verses.textEn: When the Philistines heard that Israel had assembled at Mizpah, the rulers of the Philistines came up to attack them. When the Israelites heard of it, they were afraid because of the Philistines.

verses.textZh: 以色列人对撒母耳说："请你不要静默，为我们呼求耶和华我们的神吧，好叫他拯救我们脱离非利士人的手。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人对撒母耳说："请你不要静默，为我们呼求耶和华我们的神吧，好叫他拯救我们脱离非利士人的手。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人对撒母耳说：「愿你不住地为我们呼求耶和华－我们的神，救我们脱离非利士人的手。」
verses.textEnNiv: They said to Samuel, "Do not stop crying out to the Lord our God for us, that he may rescue us from the hand of the Philistines."
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel said to Samuel, "Do not cease to cry out to the Lord our God for us, that he may save us from the hand of the Philistines."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the children of Israel said to Samuel, "Do not cease to cry out to the Lord our God for us, that He may save us from the hand of the Philistines."
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t stop pleading with the Lord our God to save us from the Philistines!" they begged Samuel.
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of Israel said to Samuel, "Do not stop crying out to the Lord our God for us, that He will save us from the hand of the Philistines!"
verses.textEn: They said to Samuel, "Do not stop crying out to the Lord our God for us, that he may rescue us from the hand of the Philistines."

verses.textZh: 撒母耳就牵来一只还在吃奶的羊羔，把牠作全牲的燔祭献给耶和华，又为以色列人向耶和华呼求，耶和华就应允他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳就牵来一只还在吃奶的羊羔，把牠作全牲的燔祭献给耶和华，又为以色列人向耶和华呼求，耶和华就应允他。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳就把一只吃奶的羊羔献与耶和华作全牲的燔祭，为以色列人呼求耶和华；耶和华就应允他。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Samuel took a suckling lamb and sacrificed it as a whole burnt offering to the Lord . He cried out to the Lord on Israel’s behalf, and the Lord answered him.
verses.textEnEsv: So Samuel took a nursing lamb and offered it as a whole burnt offering to the Lord . And Samuel cried out to the Lord for Israel, and the Lord answered him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Samuel took a suckling lamb and offered itas a whole burnt offering to the Lord. Then Samuel cried out to the Lord for Israel, and the Lord answered him.
verses.textEnNlt: So Samuel took a young lamb and offered it to the Lord as a whole burnt offering. He pleaded with the Lord to help Israel, and the Lord answered him.
verses.textEnNasb: Samuel took a nursing lamb and offered it as a whole burnt offering to the Lord; and Samuel cried out to the Lord for Israel, and the Lord answered him.
verses.textEn: Then Samuel took a suckling lamb and sacrificed it as a whole burnt offering to the Lord . He cried out to the Lord on Israel’s behalf, and the Lord answered him.

verses.textZh: 撒母耳正在献上燔祭的时候，非利士人前来要与以色列人争战。当天，耶和华发出极大的雷声，攻击非利士人，使他们溃乱，他们就在以色列人面前被击败。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳正在献上燔祭的时候，非利士人前来要与以色列人争战。当天，耶和华发出极大的雷声，攻击非利士人，使他们溃乱，他们就在以色列人面前被击败。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳正献燔祭的时候，非利士人前来要与以色列人争战。当日，耶和华大发雷声，惊乱非利士人，他们就败在以色列人面前。
verses.textEnNiv: While Samuel was sacrificing the burnt offering, the Philistines drew near to engage Israel in battle. But that day the Lord thundered with loud thunder against the Philistines and threw them into such a panic that they were routed before the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: As Samuel was offering up the burnt offering, the Philistines drew near to attack Israel. But the Lord thundered with a mighty sound that day against the Philistines and threw them into confusion, and they were defeated before Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as Samuel was offering up the burnt offering, the Philistines drew near to battle against Israel. But the Lord thundered with a loud thunder upon the Philistines that day, and so confused them that they were overcome before Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Just as Samuel was sacrificing the burnt offering, the Philistines arrived to attack Israel. But the Lord spoke with a mighty voice of thunder from heaven that day, and the Philistines were thrown into such confusion that the Israelites defeated them.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Samuel was offering up the burnt offering, and the Philistines advanced to battle Israel. But the Lord thundered with a great thunder on that day against the Philistines and confused them, so that they were struck down before Israel.
verses.textEn: While Samuel was sacrificing the burnt offering, the Philistines drew near to engage Israel in battle. But that day the Lord thundered with loud thunder against the Philistines and threw them into such a panic that they were routed before the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 于是以色列人从米斯巴出去，追赶非利士人，击杀他们，直到伯．甲的下边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以色列人从米斯巴出去，追赶非利士人，击杀他们，直到伯．甲的下边。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人从米斯巴出来，追赶非利士人，击杀他们，直到伯‧甲的下边。
verses.textEnNiv: The men of Israel rushed out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, slaughtering them along the way to a point below Beth Kar.
verses.textEnEsv: And the men of Israel went out from Mizpah and pursued the Philistines and struck them, as far as below Beth-car.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the men of Israel went out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, and drove them back as far as below Beth Car.
verses.textEnNlt: The men of Israel chased them from Mizpah to a place below Beth-car, slaughtering them all along the way.
verses.textEnNasb: And the men of Israel came out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, and killed them as far as below Beth-car.
verses.textEn: The men of Israel rushed out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, slaughtering them along the way to a point below Beth Kar.

verses.textZh: 撒母耳搬来了一块石头，把它竖立在米斯巴和善之间，给这块石头起名叫以便以谢，说："直到现在，耶和华都帮助我们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳搬来了一块石头，把它竖立在米斯巴和善之间，给这块石头起名叫以便以谢，说："直到现在，耶和华都帮助我们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳将一块石头立在米斯巴和善的中间，给石头起名叫以便以谢，说：「到如今耶和华都帮助我们。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Samuel took a stone and set it up between Mizpah and Shen. He named it Ebenezer, saying, "Thus far the Lord has helped us."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Samuel took a stone and set it up between Mizpah and Shen and called its name Ebenezer; for he said, "Till now the Lord has helped us."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Samuel took a stone and set it up between Mizpah and Shen, and called its name Ebenezer, saying, "Thus far the Lord has helped us."
verses.textEnNlt: Samuel then took a large stone and placed it between the towns of Mizpah and Jeshanah. He named it Ebenezer (which means "the stone of help"), for he said, "Up to this point the Lord has helped us!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Samuel took a stone and placed it between Mizpah and Shen, and named it Ebenezer, saying, " So far the Lord has helped us."
verses.textEn: Then Samuel took a stone and set it up between Mizpah and Shen. He named it Ebenezer, saying, "Thus far the Lord has helped us."

verses.textZh: 这样，非利士人就被制伏了，不再侵犯以色列的境界。撒母耳在世的日子，耶和华的手一直攻击非利士人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，非利士人就被制伏了，不再侵犯以色列的境界。撒母耳在世的日子，耶和华的手一直攻击非利士人。
verses.textZhCuv: 从此，非利士人就被制伏，不敢再入以色列人的境内。撒母耳作士师的时候，耶和华的手攻击非利士人。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Philistines were subdued and they stopped invading Israel’s territory. Throughout Samuel’s lifetime, the hand of the Lord was against the Philistines.
verses.textEnEsv: So the Philistines were subdued and did not again enter the territory of Israel. And the hand of the Lord was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Philistines were subdued, and they did not come anymore into the territory of Israel. And the hand of the Lord was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Philistines were subdued and didn’t invade Israel again for some time. And throughout Samuel’s lifetime, the Lord ’s powerful hand was raised against the Philistines.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Philistines were subdued, and they did not come anymore within the border of Israel. And the hand of the Lord was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.
verses.textEn: So the Philistines were subdued and they stopped invading Israel’s territory. Throughout Samuel’s lifetime, the hand of the Lord was against the Philistines.

verses.textZh: 非利士人从以色列人夺得的城市，自以革伦直到迦特，都归还以色列人；属于这些城市的四境，以色列人也从非利士人手中夺回。那时，以色列人和亚摩利人和平相处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人从以色列人夺得的城市，自以革伦直到迦特，都归还以色列人；属于这些城市的四境，以色列人也从非利士人手中夺回。那时，以色列人和亚摩利人和平相处。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人所取以色列人的城邑，从以革伦直到迦特，都归以色列人了。属这些城的四境，以色列人也从非利士人手下收回。那时以色列人与亚摩利人和好。
verses.textEnNiv: The towns from Ekron to Gath that the Philistines had captured from Israel were restored to Israel, and Israel delivered the neighboring territory from the hands of the Philistines. And there was peace between Israel and the Amorites.
verses.textEnEsv: The cities that the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron to Gath, and Israel delivered their territory from the hand of the Philistines. There was peace also between Israel and the Amorites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron to Gath; and Israel recovered its territory from the hands of the Philistines. Also there was peace between Israel and the Amorites.
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelite villages near Ekron and Gath that the Philistines had captured were restored to Israel, along with the rest of the territory that the Philistines had taken. And there was peace between Israel and the Amorites in those days.
verses.textEnNasb: The cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron even to Gath; and Israel recovered their territory from the hand of the Philistines. So there was peace between Israel and the Amorites.
verses.textEn: The towns from Ekron to Gath that the Philistines had captured from Israel were restored to Israel, and Israel delivered the neighboring territory from the hands of the Philistines. And there was peace between Israel and the Amorites.

verses.textZh: 撒母耳终生作以色列人的士师。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳终生作以色列人的士师。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳平生作以色列的士师。
verses.textEnNiv: Samuel continued as Israel’s leader all the days of his life.
verses.textEnEsv: Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.
verses.textEnNlt: Samuel continued as Israel’s judge for the rest of his life.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.
verses.textEn: Samuel continued as Israel’s leader all the days of his life.

verses.textZh: 他每年都巡回伯特利、吉甲和米斯巴，在这些地方治理以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他每年都巡回伯特利、吉甲和米斯巴，在这些地方治理以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他每年巡行到伯特利、吉甲、米斯巴，在这几处审判以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: From year to year he went on a circuit from Bethel to Gilgal to Mizpah, judging Israel in all those places.
verses.textEnEsv: And he went on a circuit year by year to Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah. And he judged Israel in all these places.
verses.textEnNkjv: He went from year to year on a circuit to Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah, and judged Israel in all those places.
verses.textEnNlt: Each year he traveled around, setting up his court first at Bethel, then at Gilgal, and then at Mizpah. He judged the people of Israel at each of these places.
verses.textEnNasb: And he used to go annually on a circuit to Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah, and he judged Israel in all these places.
verses.textEn: From year to year he went on a circuit from Bethel to Gilgal to Mizpah, judging Israel in all those places.

verses.textZh: 然后，他回到拉玛，因为他的家在那里。他也在那里治理以色列人，并且在那里为耶和华筑了一座祭坛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后，他回到拉玛，因为他的家在那里。他也在那里治理以色列人，并且在那里为耶和华筑了一座祭坛。
verses.textZhCuv: 随后回到拉玛，因为他的家在那里；也在那里审判以色列人，且为耶和华筑了一座坛。
verses.textEnNiv: But he always went back to Ramah, where his home was, and there he also held court for Israel. And he built an altar there to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Then he would return to Ramah, for his home was there, and there also he judged Israel. And he built there an altar to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: But he always returned to Ramah, for his home was there. There he judged Israel, and there he built an altar to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he would return to his home at Ramah, and he would hear cases there, too. And Samuel built an altar to the Lord at Ramah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he would make his return to Ramah, because his house was there, and there he also judged Israel; and there he built an altar to the Lord.
verses.textEn: But he always went back to Ramah, where his home was, and there he also held court for Israel. And he built an altar there to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 撒母耳年老的时候，立了他的儿子作以色列人的士师。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳年老的时候，立了他的儿子作以色列人的士师。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳年纪老迈，就立他儿子作以色列的士师。
verses.textEnNiv: When Samuel grew old, he appointed his sons as Israel’s leaders.
verses.textEnEsv: When Samuel became old, he made his sons judges over Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass when Samuel was old that he made his sons judges over Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: As Samuel grew old, he appointed his sons to be judges over Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about, when Samuel was old, that he appointed his sons as judges over Israel.
verses.textEn: When Samuel grew old, he appointed his sons as Israel’s leaders.

verses.textZh: 他的长子名叫约珥，次子名叫亚比亚，都在别是巴作士师。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的长子名叫约珥，次子名叫亚比亚，都在别是巴作士师。
verses.textZhCuv: 长子名叫约珥，次子名叫亚比亚；他们在别是巴作士师。
verses.textEnNiv: The name of his firstborn was Joel and the name of his second was Abijah, and they served at Beersheba.
verses.textEnEsv: The name of his firstborn son was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah; they were judges in Beersheba.
verses.textEnNkjv: The name of his firstborn was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah; theywere judges in Beersheba.
verses.textEnNlt: Joel and Abijah, his oldest sons, held court in Beersheba.
verses.textEnNasb: The name of his firstborn was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah; they were judging in Beersheba.
verses.textEn: The name of his firstborn was Joel and the name of his second was Abijah, and they served at Beersheba.

verses.textZh: 两个儿子都没有行撒母耳的道路，反而转去追求不义之财，收受贿赂，屈枉正直。
verses.textZhCnvs: 两个儿子都没有行撒母耳的道路，反而转去追求不义之财，收受贿赂，屈枉正直。
verses.textZhCuv: 他儿子不行他的道，贪图财利，收受贿赂，屈枉正直。
verses.textEnNiv: But his sons did not follow his ways. They turned aside after dishonest gain and accepted bribes and perverted justice.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet his sons did not walk in his ways but turned aside after gain. They took bribes and perverted justice.
verses.textEnNkjv: But his sons did not walk in his ways; they turned aside after dishonest gain, took bribes, and perverted justice.
verses.textEnNlt: But they were not like their father, for they were greedy for money. They accepted bribes and perverted justice.
verses.textEnNasb: His sons, however, did not walk in his ways but turned aside after dishonest gain, and they took bribes and perverted justice.
verses.textEn: But his sons did not follow his ways. They turned aside after dishonest gain and accepted bribes and perverted justice.

verses.textZh: 于是以色列所有的长老都集合起来，到拉玛去见撒母耳，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以色列所有的长老都集合起来，到拉玛去见撒母耳，
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列的长老都聚集，来到拉玛见撒母耳，
verses.textEnNiv: So all the elders of Israel gathered together and came to Samuel at Ramah.
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the elders of Israel gathered together and came to Samuel at Ramah
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all the elders of Israel gathered together and came to Samuel at Ramah,
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, all the elders of Israel met at Ramah to discuss the matter with Samuel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the elders of Israel gathered together and came to Samuel at Ramah;
verses.textEn: So all the elders of Israel gathered together and came to Samuel at Ramah.

verses.textZh: 对他说："你老了，看哪，你的儿子不行你的道路，现在求你为我们立一个王治理我们，好象列国一样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他说："你老了，看哪，你的儿子不行你的道路，现在求你为我们立一个王治理我们，好象列国一样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 对他说：「你年纪老迈了，你儿子不行你的道。现在求你为我们立一个王治理我们，像列国一样。」
verses.textEnNiv: They said to him, "You are old, and your sons do not follow your ways; now appoint a king to lead us, such as all the other nations have."
verses.textEnEsv: and said to him, "Behold, you are old and your sons do not walk in your ways. Now appoint for us a king to judge us like all the nations."
verses.textEnNkjv: and said to him, "Look, you are old, and your sons do not walk in your ways. Now make us a king to judge us like all the nations."
verses.textEnNlt: "Look," they told him, "you are now old, and your sons are not like you. Give us a king to judge us like all the other nations have."
verses.textEnNasb: and they said to him, "Behold, you have grown old, and your sons do not walk in your ways. Now appoint us a king to judge us like all the nations."
verses.textEn: They said to him, "You are old, and your sons do not follow your ways; now appoint a king to lead us, such as all the other nations have."

verses.textZh: 他们说"求你为我们立一个王治理我们"这件事，使撒母耳很不高兴，他就祷告耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说"求你为我们立一个王治理我们"这件事，使撒母耳很不高兴，他就祷告耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳不喜悦他们说「立一个王治理我们」，他就祷告耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: But when they said, "Give us a king to lead us," this displeased Samuel; so he prayed to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: But the thing displeased Samuel when they said, "Give us a king to judge us." And Samuel prayed to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: But the thing displeased Samuel when they said, "Give us a king to judge us." So Samuel prayed to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Samuel was displeased with their request and went to the Lord for guidance.
verses.textEnNasb: But the matter was displeasing in the sight of Samuel when they said, "Give us a king to judge us." And Samuel prayed to the Lord.
verses.textEn: But when they said, "Give us a king to lead us," this displeased Samuel; so he prayed to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华对撒母耳说："众民对你所说的一切，你只管听从，因为他们不是厌弃你，而是厌弃我，不要我作他们的王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对撒母耳说："众民对你所说的一切，你只管听从，因为他们不是厌弃你，而是厌弃我，不要我作他们的王。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对撒母耳说：「百姓向你说的一切话，你只管依从；因为他们不是厌弃你，乃是厌弃我，不要我作他们的王。
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord told him: "Listen to all that the people are saying to you; it is not you they have rejected, but they have rejected me as their king.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Samuel, "Obey the voice of the people in all that they say to you, for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected me from being king over them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Samuel, "Heed the voice of the people in all that they say to you; for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected Me, that I should not reign over them.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do everything they say to you," the Lord replied, "for they are rejecting me, not you. They don’t want me to be their king any longer.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said to Samuel, "Listen to the voice of the people regarding all that they say to you, because they have not rejected you, but they have rejected Me from being King over them.
verses.textEn: And the Lord told him: "Listen to all that the people are saying to you; it is not you they have rejected, but they have rejected me as their king.

verses.textZh: 自从我把他们从埃及领上来的那天起，直到现在，他们怎样离开我，事奉别的神，他们对我所行的一切，也照样对你行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 自从我把他们从埃及领上来的那天起，直到现在，他们怎样离开我，事奉别的神，他们对我所行的一切，也照样对你行。
verses.textZhCuv: 自从我领他们出埃及到如今，他们常常离弃我，事奉别神。现在他们向你所行的，是照他们素来所行的。
verses.textEnNiv: As they have done from the day I brought them up out of Egypt until this day, forsaking me and serving other gods, so they are doing to you.
verses.textEnEsv: According to all the deeds that they have done, from the day I brought them up out of Egypt even to this day, forsaking me and serving other gods, so they are also doing to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt, even to this day—with which they have forsaken Me and served other gods—so they are doing to you also.
verses.textEnNlt: Ever since I brought them from Egypt they have continually abandoned me and followed other gods. And now they are giving you the same treatment.
verses.textEnNasb: Like all the deeds which they have done since the day that I brought them up from Egypt even to this day—in that they have abandoned Me and served other gods—so they are doing to you as well.
verses.textEn: As they have done from the day I brought them up out of Egypt until this day, forsaking me and serving other gods, so they are doing to you.

verses.textZh: 现在你只管听从他们的话，但必须郑重警告他们，告诉他们那要统治他们的王要怎样治理他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你只管听从他们的话，但必须郑重警告他们，告诉他们那要统治他们的王要怎样治理他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 故此你要依从他们的话，只是当警戒他们，告诉他们将来那王怎样管辖他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now listen to them; but warn them solemnly and let them know what the king who will reign over them will claim as his rights."
verses.textEnEsv: Now then, obey their voice; only you shall solemnly warn them and show them the ways of the king who shall reign over them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, heed their voice. However, you shall solemnly forewarn them, and show them the behavior of the king who will reign over them."
verses.textEnNlt: Do as they ask, but solemnly warn them about the way a king will reign over them."
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, listen to their voice; however, you shall warn them strongly and tell them of the practice of the king who will reign over them."
verses.textEn: Now listen to them; but warn them solemnly and let them know what the king who will reign over them will claim as his rights."

verses.textZh: 于是，撒母耳把耶和华所讲的一切话都告诉那些向他要求一个王的民众，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，撒母耳把耶和华所讲的一切话都告诉那些向他要求一个王的民众，
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳将耶和华的话都传给求他立王的百姓，说：
verses.textEnNiv: Samuel told all the words of the Lord to the people who were asking him for a king.
verses.textEnEsv: So Samuel told all the words of the Lord to the people who were asking for a king from him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Samuel told all the words of the Lord to the people who asked him for a king.
verses.textEnNlt: So Samuel passed on the Lord ’s warning to the people who were asking him for a king.
verses.textEnNasb: So Samuel spoke all the words of the Lord to the people who had asked him for a king.
verses.textEn: Samuel told all the words of the Lord to the people who were asking him for a king.

verses.textZh: 说："那要统治你们的王将这样治理你们：他必征用你们的儿子，派他们作他的战车兵、骑兵、在车前奔走的前锋，
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："那要统治你们的王将这样治理你们：他必征用你们的儿子，派他们作他的战车兵、骑兵、在车前奔走的前锋，
verses.textZhCuv: 「管辖你们的王必这样行：他必派你们的儿子为他赶车、跟马，奔走在车前；
verses.textEnNiv: He said, "This is what the king who will reign over you will claim as his rights: He will take your sons and make them serve with his chariots and horses, and they will run in front of his chariots.
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "These will be the ways of the king who will reign over you: he will take your sons and appoint them to his chariots and to be his horsemen and to run before his chariots.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "This will be the behavior of the king who will reign over you: He will take your sons and appoint them for his own chariots and tobe his horsemen, and some will run before his chariots.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is how a king will reign over you," Samuel said. "The king will draft your sons and assign them to his chariots and his charioteers, making them run before his chariots.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "This will be the practice of the king who will reign over you: he will take your sons and put them in his chariots for himself and among his horsemen, and they will run before his chariots.
verses.textEn: He said, "This is what the king who will reign over you will claim as his rights: He will take your sons and make them serve with his chariots and horses, and they will run in front of his chariots.

verses.textZh: 又派他们作千夫长、五十夫长，替他耕田、收他的庄稼、替他制造作战的武器和战车上的装备。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又派他们作千夫长、五十夫长，替他耕田、收他的庄稼、替他制造作战的武器和战车上的装备。
verses.textZhCuv: 又派他们作千夫长、五十夫长，为他耕种田地，收割庄稼，打造军器和车上的器械；
verses.textEnNiv: Some he will assign to be commanders of thousands and commanders of fifties, and others to plow his ground and reap his harvest, and still others to make weapons of war and equipment for his chariots.
verses.textEnEsv: And he will appoint for himself commanders of thousands and commanders of fifties, and some to plow his ground and to reap his harvest, and to make his implements of war and the equipment of his chariots.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will appoint captains over his thousands and captains over his fifties, willsetsome to plow his ground and reap his harvest, and some to make his weapons of war and equipment for his chariots.
verses.textEnNlt: Some will be generals and captains in his army, some will be forced to plow in his fields and harvest his crops, and some will make his weapons and chariot equipment.
verses.textEnNasb: He will appoint for himself commanders of thousands and commanders of fifties, and some to do his plowing and to gather in his harvest, and to make his weapons of war and equipment for his chariots.
verses.textEn: Some he will assign to be commanders of thousands and commanders of fifties, and others to plow his ground and reap his harvest, and still others to make weapons of war and equipment for his chariots.

verses.textZh: 他必征用你们的女儿作配香膏的、烧饭的和烤饼的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必征用你们的女儿作配香膏的、烧饭的和烤饼的。
verses.textZhCuv: 必取你们的女儿为他制造香膏，做饭烤饼；
verses.textEnNiv: He will take your daughters to be perfumers and cooks and bakers.
verses.textEnEsv: He will take your daughters to be perfumers and cooks and bakers.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will take your daughters tobe perfumers, cooks, and bakers.
verses.textEnNlt: The king will take your daughters from you and force them to cook and bake and make perfumes for him.
verses.textEnNasb: He will also take your daughters and use them as perfumers, cooks, and bakers.
verses.textEn: He will take your daughters to be perfumers and cooks and bakers.

verses.textZh: 他必夺去你们最好的田地、葡萄园和橄榄园，赐给自己的臣仆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必夺去你们最好的田地、葡萄园和橄榄园，赐给自己的臣仆。
verses.textZhCuv: 也必取你们最好的田地、葡萄园、橄榄园赐给他的臣仆。
verses.textEnNiv: He will take the best of your fields and vineyards and olive groves and give them to his attendants.
verses.textEnEsv: He will take the best of your fields and vineyards and olive orchards and give them to his servants.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he will take the best of your fields, your vineyards, and your olive groves, and give them to his servants.
verses.textEnNlt: He will take away the best of your fields and vineyards and olive groves and give them to his own officials.
verses.textEnNasb: He will take the best of your fields, your vineyards, and your olive groves, and give them to his servants.
verses.textEn: He will take the best of your fields and vineyards and olive groves and give them to his attendants.

verses.textZh: 你们撒种所得的和葡萄园所出的，他都征收十分之一，赐给他的太监和臣仆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们撒种所得的和葡萄园所出的，他都征收十分之一，赐给他的太监和臣仆。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的粮食和葡萄园所出的，他必取十分之一给他的太监和臣仆；
verses.textEnNiv: He will take a tenth of your grain and of your vintage and give it to his officials and attendants.
verses.textEnEsv: He will take the tenth of your grain and of your vineyards and give it to his officers and to his servants.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will take a tenth of your grain and your vintage, and give it to his officers and servants.
verses.textEnNlt: He will take a tenth of your grain and your grape harvest and distribute it among his officers and attendants.
verses.textEnNasb: And he will take a tenth of your seed and your vineyards and give it to his high officials and his servants.
verses.textEn: He will take a tenth of your grain and of your vintage and give it to his officials and attendants.

verses.textZh: 他又必征收你们的仆婢、最精壮的青年和驴，替他工作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又必征收你们的仆婢、最精壮的青年和驴，替他工作。
verses.textZhCuv: 又必取你们的仆人婢女，健壮的少年人和你们的驴，供他的差役。
verses.textEnNiv: Your male and female servants and the best of your cattle and donkeys he will take for his own use.
verses.textEnEsv: He will take your male servants and female servants and the best of your young men and your donkeys, and put them to his work.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he will take your male servants, your female servants, your finest young men, and your donkeys, and put them to his work.
verses.textEnNlt: He will take your male and female slaves and demand the finest of your cattle and donkeys for his own use.
verses.textEnNasb: He will also take your male servants and your female servants, and your best young men, and your donkeys, and use them for his work.
verses.textEn: Your male and female servants and the best of your cattle and donkeys he will take for his own use.

verses.textZh: 你们的羊群，他要征收十分之一；连你们自己也作他的奴仆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的羊群，他要征收十分之一；连你们自己也作他的奴仆。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的羊群他必取十分之一，你们也必作他的仆人。
verses.textEnNiv: He will take a tenth of your flocks, and you yourselves will become his slaves.
verses.textEnEsv: He will take the tenth of your flocks, and you shall be his slaves.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will take a tenth of your sheep. And you will be his servants.
verses.textEnNlt: He will demand a tenth of your flocks, and you will be his slaves.
verses.textEnNasb: He will take a tenth of your flocks, and you yourselves will become his servants.
verses.textEn: He will take a tenth of your flocks, and you yourselves will become his slaves.

verses.textZh: 到时，你们必因你们为自己拣选的王而哀求，那时耶和华却不应允你们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到时，你们必因你们为自己拣选的王而哀求，那时耶和华却不应允你们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时你们必因所选的王哀求耶和华，耶和华却不应允你们。」
verses.textEnNiv: When that day comes, you will cry out for relief from the king you have chosen, but the Lord will not answer you in that day."
verses.textEnEsv: And in that day you will cry out because of your king, whom you have chosen for yourselves, but the Lord will not answer you in that day."
verses.textEnNkjv: And you will cry out in that day because of your king whom you have chosen for yourselves, and the Lord will not hear you in that day."
verses.textEnNlt: When that day comes, you will beg for relief from this king you are demanding, but then the Lord will not help you."
verses.textEnNasb: Then you will cry out on that day because of your king whom you have chosen for yourselves, but the Lord will not answer you on that day."
verses.textEn: When that day comes, you will cry out for relief from the king you have chosen, but the Lord will not answer you in that day."

verses.textZh: 众民竟不肯听从撒母耳的话，说："不，我们要一个王治理我们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 众民竟不肯听从撒母耳的话，说："不，我们要一个王治理我们，
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓竟不肯听撒母耳的话，说：「不然！我们定要一个王治理我们，
verses.textEnNiv: But the people refused to listen to Samuel. "No!" they said. "We want a king over us.
verses.textEnEsv: But the people refused to obey the voice of Samuel. And they said, "No! But there shall be a king over us,
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless the people refused to obey the voice of Samuel; and they said, "No, but we will have a king over us,
verses.textEnNlt: But the people refused to listen to Samuel’s warning. "Even so, we still want a king," they said.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel, and they said, "No, but there shall be a king over us,
verses.textEn: But the people refused to listen to Samuel. "No!" they said. "We want a king over us.

verses.textZh: 让我们也像列国一样，有自己的王治理我们，帅领我们出征，为我们作战。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 让我们也像列国一样，有自己的王治理我们，帅领我们出征，为我们作战。"
verses.textZhCuv: 使我们像列国一样，有王治理我们，统领我们，为我们争战。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then we will be like all the other nations, with a king to lead us and to go out before us and fight our battles."
verses.textEnEsv: that we also may be like all the nations, and that our king may judge us and go out before us and fight our battles."
verses.textEnNkjv: that we also may be like all the nations, and that our king may judge us and go out before us and fight our battles."
verses.textEnNlt: "We want to be like the nations around us. Our king will judge us and lead us into battle."
verses.textEnNasb: so that we also may be like all the nations, and our king may judge us and go out before us and fight our battles."
verses.textEn: Then we will be like all the other nations, with a king to lead us and to go out before us and fight our battles."

verses.textZh: 撒母耳听了众民的一切话，就向耶和华复述。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳听了众民的一切话，就向耶和华复述。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳听见百姓这一切话，就将这话陈明在耶和华面前。
verses.textEnNiv: When Samuel heard all that the people said, he repeated it before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And when Samuel had heard all the words of the people, he repeated them in the ears of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he repeated them in the hearing of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So Samuel repeated to the Lord what the people had said,
verses.textEnNasb: Now after Samuel had heard all the words of the people, he repeated them in the Lord’s hearing.
verses.textEn: When Samuel heard all that the people said, he repeated it before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华对撒母耳说："你只管听从他们的话，为他们立一个王。"于是撒母耳对以色列人说："你们各人回自己的城去吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对撒母耳说："你只管听从他们的话，为他们立一个王。"于是撒母耳对以色列人说："你们各人回自己的城去吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对撒母耳说：「你只管依从他们的话，为他们立王。」撒母耳对以色列人说：「你们各归各城去吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord answered, "Listen to them and give them a king." Then Samuel said to the Israelites, "Everyone go back to your own town."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Samuel, "Obey their voice and make them a king." Samuel then said to the men of Israel, "Go every man to his city."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord said to Samuel, "Heed their voice, and make them a king." And Samuel said to the men of Israel, "Every man go to his city."
verses.textEnNlt: and the Lord replied, "Do as they say, and give them a king." Then Samuel agreed and sent the people home.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said to Samuel, "Listen to their voice and appoint a king for them." So Samuel said to the men of Israel, "Go, every man to his city."
verses.textEn: The Lord answered, "Listen to them and give them a king." Then Samuel said to the Israelites, "Everyone go back to your own town."

verses.textZh: 有一个便雅悯人，名叫基士，是亚别的儿子。亚别是洗罗的儿子，洗罗是比歌拉的儿子，比歌拉是亚斐亚的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个便雅悯人，名叫基士，是亚别的儿子。亚别是洗罗的儿子，洗罗是比歌拉的儿子，比歌拉是亚斐亚的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个便雅悯人，名叫基士，是便雅悯人亚斐亚的玄孙，比歌拉的曾孙，洗罗的孙子，亚别的儿子，是个大能的勇士 。
verses.textEnNiv: There was a Benjamite, a man of standing, whose name was Kish son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Bekorath, the son of Aphiah of Benjamin.
verses.textEnEsv: There was a man of Benjamin whose name was Kish, the son of Abiel, son of Zeror, son of Becorath, son of Aphiah, a Benjaminite, a man of wealth.
verses.textEnNkjv: There was a man of Benjamin whose name was Kish the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Bechorath, the son of Aphiah, a Benjamite, a mighty man of power.
verses.textEnNlt: There was a wealthy, influential man named Kish from the tribe of Benjamin. He was the son of Abiel, son of Zeror, son of Becorath, son of Aphiah, of the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was a man of Benjamin whose name was Kish the son of Abiel, son of Zeror, son of Becorath, son of Aphiah, son of a Benjaminite, a valiant mighty man.
verses.textEn: There was a Benjamite, a man of standing, whose name was Kish son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Bekorath, the son of Aphiah of Benjamin.

verses.textZh: 他有一个儿子，名叫扫罗，既年轻又英俊；在以色列人中，没有一个能比他更英俊的。他比人高出一个头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他有一个儿子，名叫扫罗，既年轻又英俊；在以色列人中，没有一个能比他更英俊的。他比人高出一个头。
verses.textZhCuv: 他有一个儿子，名叫扫罗，又健壮、又俊美，在以色列人中没有一个能比他的；身体比众民高过一头。
verses.textEnNiv: Kish had a son named Saul, as handsome a young man as could be found anywhere in Israel, and he was a head taller than anyone else.
verses.textEnEsv: And he had a son whose name was Saul, a handsome young man. There was not a man among the people of Israel more handsome than he. From his shoulders upward he was taller than any of the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he had a choice and handsome son whose name was Saul. Therewas not a more handsome person than he among the children of Israel. From his shoulders upward hewas taller than any of the people.
verses.textEnNlt: His son Saul was the most handsome man in Israel—head and shoulders taller than anyone else in the land.
verses.textEnNasb: He had a son whose name was Saul, a young and handsome man, and there was not a more handsome man than he among the sons of Israel; from his shoulders and up he was taller than any of the people.
verses.textEn: Kish had a son named Saul, as handsome a young man as could be found anywhere in Israel, and he was a head taller than anyone else.

verses.textZh: 扫罗的父亲基士有几头母驴走失了，他就对他的儿子扫罗说："你带一个仆人，动身去寻找母驴吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗的父亲基士有几头母驴走失了，他就对他的儿子扫罗说："你带一个仆人，动身去寻找母驴吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗的父亲基士丢了几头驴，他就吩咐儿子扫罗说：「你带一个仆人去寻找驴。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now the donkeys belonging to Saul’s father Kish were lost, and Kish said to his son Saul, "Take one of the servants with you and go and look for the donkeys."
verses.textEnEsv: Now the donkeys of Kish, Saul’s father, were lost. So Kish said to Saul his son, "Take one of the young men with you, and arise, go and look for the donkeys."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the donkeys of Kish, Saul’s father, were lost. And Kish said to his son Saul, "Please take one of the servants with you, and arise, go and look for the donkeys."
verses.textEnNlt: One day Kish’s donkeys strayed away, and he told Saul, "Take a servant with you, and go look for the donkeys."
verses.textEnNasb: Now the donkeys of Kish, Saul’s father, had wandered off. So Kish said to his son Saul, "Now take with you one of the servants and arise, go search for the donkeys."
verses.textEn: Now the donkeys belonging to Saul’s father Kish were lost, and Kish said to his son Saul, "Take one of the servants with you and go and look for the donkeys."

verses.textZh: 扫罗走遍以法莲山地，又走遍沙利沙地，但他们都没有找到。他们又走遍沙琳地，母驴也不在那里；又走遍便雅悯地，还是找不到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗走遍以法莲山地，又走遍沙利沙地，但他们都没有找到。他们又走遍沙琳地，母驴也不在那里；又走遍便雅悯地，还是找不到。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗就走过以法莲山地，又过沙利沙地，都没有找着；又过沙琳地，驴也不在那里；又过便雅悯地，还没有找着。
verses.textEnNiv: So he passed through the hill country of Ephraim and through the area around Shalisha, but they did not find them. They went on into the district of Shaalim, but the donkeys were not there. Then he passed through the territory of Benjamin, but they did not find them.
verses.textEnEsv: And he passed through the hill country of Ephraim and passed through the land of Shalishah, but they did not find them. And they passed through the land of Shaalim, but they were not there. Then they passed through the land of Benjamin, but did not find them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he passed through the mountains of Ephraim and through the land of Shalisha, but they did not find them. Then they passed through the land of Shaalim, and theywere not there. Then he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they did not find them.
verses.textEnNlt: So Saul took one of the servants and traveled through the hill country of Ephraim, the land of Shalishah, the Shaalim area, and the entire land of Benjamin, but they couldn’t find the donkeys anywhere.
verses.textEnNasb: So he passed through the hill country of Ephraim and passed through the land of Shalishah, but they did not find them. Then they passed through the land of Shaalim, but they were not there. Then he passed through the land of the Benjaminites, but they did not find them.
verses.textEn: So he passed through the hill country of Ephraim and through the area around Shalisha, but they did not find them. They went on into the district of Shaalim, but the donkeys were not there. Then he passed through the territory of Benjamin, but they did not find them.

verses.textZh: 他们到了苏弗地，扫罗对跟随他的仆人说："来，我们回去吧，恐怕我父亲不为母驴挂心，反而为我们担忧了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们到了苏弗地，扫罗对跟随他的仆人说："来，我们回去吧，恐怕我父亲不为母驴挂心，反而为我们担忧了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到了苏弗地，扫罗对跟随他的仆人说：「我们不如回去，恐怕我父亲不为驴挂心，反为我们担忧。」
verses.textEnNiv: When they reached the district of Zuph, Saul said to the servant who was with him, "Come, let’s go back, or my father will stop thinking about the donkeys and start worrying about us."
verses.textEnEsv: When they came to the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant who was with him, "Come, let us go back, lest my father cease to care about the donkeys and become anxious about us."
verses.textEnNkjv: When they had come to the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant who was with him, "Come, let us return, lest my father cease caring about the donkeys and become worried about us."
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, they entered the region of Zuph, and Saul said to his servant, "Let’s go home. By now my father will be more worried about us than about the donkeys!"
verses.textEnNasb: When they came to the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant who was with him, "Come, and let’s return, or else my father will stop being concerned about the donkeys and will become anxious about us."
verses.textEn: When they reached the district of Zuph, Saul said to the servant who was with him, "Come, let’s go back, or my father will stop thinking about the donkeys and start worrying about us."

verses.textZh: 仆人对他说："看哪，这城里有一位神人，很受人敬重，他所说的，都必应验。现在，我们到他那里去吧，也许他会告诉我们当走的路。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 仆人对他说："看哪，这城里有一位神人，很受人敬重，他所说的，都必应验。现在，我们到他那里去吧，也许他会告诉我们当走的路。"
verses.textZhCuv: 仆人说：「这城里有一位神人，是众人所尊重的，凡他所说的全都应验。我们不如往他那里去，或者他能将我们当走的路指示我们。」
verses.textEnNiv: But the servant replied, "Look, in this town there is a man of God; he is highly respected, and everything he says comes true. Let’s go there now. Perhaps he will tell us what way to take."
verses.textEnEsv: But he said to him, "Behold, there is a man of God in this city, and he is a man who is held in honor; all that he says comes true. So now let us go there. Perhaps he can tell us the way we should go."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to him, "Look now, thereis in this city a man of God, and heis an honorable man; all that he says surely comes to pass. So let us go there; perhaps he can show us the way that we should go."
verses.textEnNlt: But the servant said, "I’ve just thought of something! There is a man of God who lives here in this town. He is held in high honor by all the people because everything he says comes true. Let’s go find him. Perhaps he can tell us which way to go."
verses.textEnNasb: But he said to him, "Behold now, there is a man of God in this city, and the man is held in honor; everything that he says definitely comes true. Now let’s go there, perhaps he can tell us about our journey on which we have set out."
verses.textEn: But the servant replied, "Look, in this town there is a man of God; he is highly respected, and everything he says comes true. Let’s go there now. Perhaps he will tell us what way to take."

verses.textZh: 扫罗对仆人说："如果我们去，有甚么可以送给那人呢？因为我们袋里的食物都已经用尽了，也没有礼物可以送给那神人，我们还有甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗对仆人说："如果我们去，有甚么可以送给那人呢？因为我们袋里的食物都已经用尽了，也没有礼物可以送给那神人，我们还有甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗对仆人说：「我们若去，有什么可以送那人呢？我们囊中的食物都吃尽了，也没有礼物可以送那神人，我们还有什么没有？」
verses.textEnNiv: Saul said to his servant, "If we go, what can we give the man? The food in our sacks is gone. We have no gift to take to the man of God. What do we have?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then Saul said to his servant, "But if we go, what can we bring the man? For the bread in our sacks is gone, and there is no present to bring to the man of God. What do we have?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul said to his servant, "But look, if we go, what shall we bring the man? For the bread in our vessels is all gone, and thereis no present to bring to the man of God. What do we have?"
verses.textEnNlt: "But we don’t have anything to offer him," Saul replied. "Even our food is gone, and we don’t have a thing to give him."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul said to his servant, "But look, if we go, what shall we bring the man? For the bread is gone from our sacks and there is no gift to bring to the man of God. What do we have?"
verses.textEn: Saul said to his servant, "If we go, what can we give the man? The food in our sacks is gone. We have no gift to take to the man of God. What do we have?"

verses.textZh: 仆人回答扫罗："看哪！我手里有三克银子，可以送给那神人，请他告诉我们应该走的路。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 仆人回答扫罗："看哪！我手里有三克银子，可以送给那神人，请他告诉我们应该走的路。"
verses.textZhCuv: 仆人回答扫罗说：「我手里有银子一舍客勒的四分之一，可以送那神人，请他指示我们当走的路。」（
verses.textEnNiv: The servant answered him again. "Look," he said, "I have a quarter of a shekel of silver. I will give it to the man of God so that he will tell us what way to take."
verses.textEnEsv: The servant answered Saul again, "Here, I have with me a quarter of a shekel of silver, and I will give it to the man of God to tell us our way."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the servant answered Saul again and said, "Look, I have here at hand one-fourth of a shekel of silver. I will give that to the man of God, to tell us our way."
verses.textEnNlt: "Well," the servant said, "I have one small silver piece. We can at least offer it to the man of God and see what happens!"
verses.textEnNasb: The servant answered Saul again and said, "Look, I have in my hand a fourth of a shekel of silver; I will give it to the man of God and he will tell us our way."
verses.textEn: The servant answered him again. "Look," he said, "I have a quarter of a shekel of silver. I will give it to the man of God so that he will tell us what way to take."

verses.textZh: 从前在以色列中，有人去求问神的时候，就这样说："来，我们去见先见吧。"因为今天称为先知的，从前称为先见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前在以色列中，有人去求问神的时候，就这样说："来，我们去见先见吧。"因为今天称为先知的，从前称为先见。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前以色列中，若有人去问神，就说：「我们问先见去吧！」现在称为「先知」的，从前称为「先见」。）
verses.textEnNiv: (Formerly in Israel, if someone went to inquire of God, they would say, "Come, let us go to the seer," because the prophet of today used to be called a seer.)
verses.textEnEsv: (Formerly in Israel, when a man went to inquire of God, he said, "Come, let us go to the seer," for today’s "prophet" was formerly called a seer.)
verses.textEnNkjv: (Formerly in Israel, when a man went to inquire of God, he spoke thus: "Come, let us go to the seer"; for hewhois now called a prophet was formerly called a seer.)
verses.textEnNlt: (In those days if people wanted a message from God, they would say, "Let’s go and ask the seer," for prophets used to be called seers.)
verses.textEnNasb: (Previously in Israel, when a man went to inquire of God, he used to say, "Come, and let’s go to the seer"; for he who is called a prophet now was previously called a seer.)
verses.textEn: (Formerly in Israel, if someone went to inquire of God, they would say, "Come, let us go to the seer," because the prophet of today used to be called a seer.)

verses.textZh: 扫罗对仆人说："你说的好。来，我们去吧！"于是他们到那神人所住的城里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗对仆人说："你说的好。来，我们去吧！"于是他们到那神人所住的城里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗对仆人说：「你说的是，我们可以去。」于是他们往神人所住的城里去了。
verses.textEnNiv: "Good," Saul said to his servant. "Come, let’s go." So they set out for the town where the man of God was.
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul said to his servant, "Well said; come, let us go." So they went to the city where the man of God was.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul said to his servant, "Well said; come, let us go." So they went to the city where the man of God was.
verses.textEnNlt: "All right," Saul agreed, "let’s try it!" So they started into the town where the man of God lived.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul said to his servant, " Good idea; come, let’s go." So they went to the city where the man of God was.
verses.textEn: "Good," Saul said to his servant. "Come, let’s go." So they set out for the town where the man of God was.

verses.textZh: 他们正上山坡要进城的时候，就遇见几个少女出来打水。他们就问那些少女："先见在这里吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们正上山坡要进城的时候，就遇见几个少女出来打水。他们就问那些少女："先见在这里吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们上坡要进城，就遇见几个少年女子出来打水，问她们说：「先见在这里没有？」
verses.textEnNiv: As they were going up the hill to the town, they met some young women coming out to draw water, and they asked them, "Is the seer here?"
verses.textEnEsv: As they went up the hill to the city, they met young women coming out to draw water and said to them, "Is the seer here?"
verses.textEnNkjv: As they went up the hill to the city, they met some young women going out to draw water, and said to them, "Is the seer here?"
verses.textEnNlt: As they were climbing the hill to the town, they met some young women coming out to draw water. So Saul and his servant asked, "Is the seer here today?"
verses.textEnNasb: As they went up the slope to the city, they found young women going out to draw water, and they said to them, "Is the seer here?"
verses.textEn: As they were going up the hill to the town, they met some young women coming out to draw water, and they asked them, "Is the seer here?"

verses.textZh: 那些少女回答他们说："在这里！他就在你们前面，现在快去吧！他今天正到这城里来，因为今天在邱坛上，人民有献祭的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些少女回答他们说："在这里！他就在你们前面，现在快去吧！他今天正到这城里来，因为今天在邱坛上，人民有献祭的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 女子回答说：「在这里，他在你们前面。快去吧！他今日正到城里，因为今日百姓要在邱坛献祭。
verses.textEnNiv: "He is," they answered. "He’s ahead of you. Hurry now; he has just come to our town today, for the people have a sacrifice at the high place.
verses.textEnEsv: They answered, "He is; behold, he is just ahead of you. Hurry. He has come just now to the city, because the people have a sacrifice today on the high place.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they answered them and said, "Yes, there he is, just ahead of you. Hurry now; for today he came to this city, because there is a sacrifice of the people today on the high place.
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes," they replied. "Stay right on this road. He is at the town gates. He has just arrived to take part in a public sacrifice up at the place of worship.
verses.textEnNasb: They answered them and said, "He is; see, he is ahead of you. Hurry now, for he has come into the city today, because the people have a sacrifice on the high place today.
verses.textEn: "He is," they answered. "He’s ahead of you. Hurry now; he has just come to our town today, for the people have a sacrifice at the high place.

verses.textZh: 你们一进城，在他登上邱坛吃祭物之前，必遇见他。因为他未到，众人不能先吃，他必先为祭物祝谢，然后客人才可以吃。现在你们上去吧！今天，你们必可遇见他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们一进城，在他登上邱坛吃祭物之前，必遇见他。因为他未到，众人不能先吃，他必先为祭物祝谢，然后客人才可以吃。现在你们上去吧！今天，你们必可遇见他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 在他还没有上邱坛吃祭物之先，你们一进城必遇见他；因他未到，百姓不能吃，必等他先祝祭，然后请的客才吃。现在你们上去，这时候必遇见他。」
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as you enter the town, you will find him before he goes up to the high place to eat. The people will not begin eating until he comes, because he must bless the sacrifice; afterward, those who are invited will eat. Go up now; you should find him about this time."
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as you enter the city you will find him, before he goes up to the high place to eat. For the people will not eat till he comes, since he must bless the sacrifice; afterward those who are invited will eat. Now go up, for you will meet him immediately."
verses.textEnNkjv: As soon as you come into the city, you will surely find him before he goes up to the high place to eat. For the people will not eat until he comes, because he must bless the sacrifice; afterward those who are invited will eat. Now therefore, go up, for about this time you will find him."
verses.textEnNlt: Hurry and catch him before he goes up there to eat. The guests won’t begin eating until he arrives to bless the food."
verses.textEnNasb: As soon as you enter the city you will find him before he goes up to the high place to eat, for the people will not eat until he comes, because he must bless the sacrifice; afterward those who are invited will eat. Now then, go up, for you will find him about this time."
verses.textEn: As soon as you enter the town, you will find him before he goes up to the high place to eat. The people will not begin eating until he comes, because he must bless the sacrifice; afterward, those who are invited will eat. Go up now; you should find him about this time."

verses.textZh: 于是二人上那城去；他们正进城的时候，撒母耳就迎着他们出来，要上邱坛去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是二人上那城去；他们正进城的时候，撒母耳就迎着他们出来，要上邱坛去。
verses.textZhCuv: 二人就上去；将进城的时候，撒母耳正迎着他们来，要上邱坛去。
verses.textEnNiv: They went up to the town, and as they were entering it, there was Samuel, coming toward them on his way up to the high place.
verses.textEnEsv: So they went up to the city. As they were entering the city, they saw Samuel coming out toward them on his way up to the high place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they went up to the city. As they were coming into the city, there was Samuel, coming out toward them on his way up to the high place.
verses.textEnNlt: So they entered the town, and as they passed through the gates, Samuel was coming out toward them to go up to the place of worship.
verses.textEnNasb: So they went up to the city. As they came into the city, behold, Samuel was coming out toward them to go up to the high place.
verses.textEn: They went up to the town, and as they were entering it, there was Samuel, coming toward them on his way up to the high place.

verses.textZh: 原来，在扫罗来到的前一天，耶和华已经启示撒母耳说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来，在扫罗来到的前一天，耶和华已经启示撒母耳说：
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗未到的前一日，耶和华已经指示撒母耳说：
verses.textEnNiv: Now the day before Saul came, the Lord had revealed this to Samuel:
verses.textEnEsv: Now the day before Saul came, the Lord had revealed to Samuel:
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord had told Samuel in his ear the day before Saul came, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Now the Lord had told Samuel the previous day,
verses.textEnNasb: Now a day before Saul’s coming, the Lord had revealed this to Samuel, saying,
verses.textEn: Now the day before Saul came, the Lord had revealed this to Samuel:

verses.textZh: "明天大约这个时候，我要差派一个人从便雅悯地到你那里去，你要膏立他作我子民以色列人的领袖。他要拯救我的子民脱离非利士人的手。我眷顾了我的子民，因为他们的哀求已经达到我这里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "明天大约这个时候，我要差派一个人从便雅悯地到你那里去，你要膏立他作我子民以色列人的领袖。他要拯救我的子民脱离非利士人的手。我眷顾了我的子民，因为他们的哀求已经达到我这里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「明日这时候，我必使一个人从便雅悯地到你这里来，你要膏他作我民以色列的君。他必救我民脱离非利士人的手；因我民的哀声上达于我，我就眷顾他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: "About this time tomorrow I will send you a man from the land of Benjamin. Anoint him ruler over my people Israel; he will deliver them from the hand of the Philistines. I have looked on my people, for their cry has reached me."
verses.textEnEsv: "Tomorrow about this time I will send to you a man from the land of Benjamin, and you shall anoint him to be prince over my people Israel. He shall save my people from the hand of the Philistines. For I have seen my people, because their cry has come to me."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Tomorrow about this time I will send you a man from the land of Benjamin, and you shall anoint him commander over My people Israel, that he may save My people from the hand of the Philistines; for I have looked upon My people, because their cry has come to Me."
verses.textEnNlt: "About this time tomorrow I will send you a man from the land of Benjamin. Anoint him to be the leader of my people, Israel. He will rescue them from the Philistines, for I have looked down on my people in mercy and have heard their cry."
verses.textEnNasb: "About this time tomorrow I will send you a man from the land of Benjamin, and you shall anoint him as ruler over My people Israel; and he will save My people from the hand of the Philistines. For I have considered My people, because their outcry has come to Me."
verses.textEn: "About this time tomorrow I will send you a man from the land of Benjamin. Anoint him ruler over my people Israel; he will deliver them from the hand of the Philistines. I have looked on my people, for their cry has reached me."

verses.textZh: 撒母耳看见了扫罗，耶和华就对撒母耳说："你看，这就是我对你所说的那人，他要统治我的子民。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳看见了扫罗，耶和华就对撒母耳说："你看，这就是我对你所说的那人，他要统治我的子民。"
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳看见扫罗的时候，耶和华对他说：「看哪，这人就是我对你所说的，他必治理我的民。」
verses.textEnNiv: When Samuel caught sight of Saul, the Lord said to him, "This is the man I spoke to you about; he will govern my people."
verses.textEnEsv: When Samuel saw Saul, the Lord told him, "Here is the man of whom I spoke to you! He it is who shall restrain my people."
verses.textEnNkjv: So when Samuel saw Saul, the Lord said to him, "There he is, the man of whom I spoke to you. This one shall reign over My people."
verses.textEnNlt: When Samuel saw Saul, the Lord said, "That’s the man I told you about! He will rule my people."
verses.textEnNasb: When Samuel saw Saul, the Lord said to him, "Behold, the man of whom I spoke to you! This one shall rule over My people."
verses.textEn: When Samuel caught sight of Saul, the Lord said to him, "This is the man I spoke to you about; he will govern my people."

verses.textZh: 扫罗在城门口，走近撒母耳跟前，说："请告诉我先见的家在哪里？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗在城门口，走近撒母耳跟前，说："请告诉我先见的家在哪里？"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗在城门里走到撒母耳跟前，说：「请告诉我，先见的寓所在哪里？」
verses.textEnNiv: Saul approached Samuel in the gateway and asked, "Would you please tell me where the seer’s house is?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then Saul approached Samuel in the gate and said, "Tell me where is the house of the seer?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul drew near to Samuel in the gate, and said, "Please tell me, where is the seer’s house?"
verses.textEnNlt: Just then Saul approached Samuel at the gateway and asked, "Can you please tell me where the seer’s house is?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul approached Samuel at the gateway and said, "Please tell me where the seer’s house is."
verses.textEn: Saul approached Samuel in the gateway and asked, "Would you please tell me where the seer’s house is?"

verses.textZh: 撒母耳回答扫罗："我就是先见，请你在我前面上邱坛去。今天你们要与我一同吃饭，明天早晨我就送你回去。你心里的一切事，我都会告诉你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳回答扫罗："我就是先见，请你在我前面上邱坛去。今天你们要与我一同吃饭，明天早晨我就送你回去。你心里的一切事，我都会告诉你。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳回答说：「我就是先见。你在我前面上邱坛去，因为你们今日必与我同席；明日早晨我送你去，将你心里的事都告诉你。
verses.textEnNiv: "I am the seer," Samuel replied. "Go up ahead of me to the high place, for today you are to eat with me, and in the morning I will send you on your way and will tell you all that is in your heart.
verses.textEnEsv: Samuel answered Saul, "I am the seer. Go up before me to the high place, for today you shall eat with me, and in the morning I will let you go and will tell you all that is on your mind.
verses.textEnNkjv: Samuel answered Saul and said, "I am the seer. Go up before me to the high place, for you shall eat with me today; and tomorrow I will let you go and will tell you all that is in your heart.
verses.textEnNlt: "I am the seer!" Samuel replied. "Go up to the place of worship ahead of me. We will eat there together, and in the morning I’ll tell you what you want to know and send you on your way.
verses.textEnNasb: And Samuel answered Saul and said, "I am the seer. Go up ahead of me to the high place, for you shall eat with me today; and in the morning I will let you go, and will tell you everything that is on your mind.
verses.textEn: "I am the seer," Samuel replied. "Go up ahead of me to the high place, for today you are to eat with me, and in the morning I will send you on your way and will tell you all that is in your heart.

verses.textZh: 至于你前三天失了的母驴，你不必为牠们担心，因为都已经找到了。以色列众人所渴求的是谁呢？不是你和你的父家吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你前三天失了的母驴，你不必为牠们担心，因为都已经找到了。以色列众人所渴求的是谁呢？不是你和你的父家吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 至于你前三日所丢的那几头驴，你心里不必挂念，已经找着了。以色列众人所仰慕的是谁呢？不是仰慕你和你父的全家吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: As for the donkeys you lost three days ago, do not worry about them; they have been found. And to whom is all the desire of Israel turned, if not to you and your whole family line?"
verses.textEnEsv: As for your donkeys that were lost three days ago, do not set your mind on them, for they have been found. And for whom is all that is desirable in Israel? Is it not for you and for all your father’s house?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But as for your donkeys that were lost three days ago, do not be anxious about them, for they have been found. And on whom is all the desire of Israel? Isit not on you and on all your father’s house?"
verses.textEnNlt: And don’t worry about those donkeys that were lost three days ago, for they have been found. And I am here to tell you that you and your family are the focus of all Israel’s hopes."
verses.textEnNasb: And as for your donkeys that wandered off three days ago, do not be concerned about them, for they have been found. And for whom is everything that is desirable in Israel? Is it not for you and for all your father’s household?"
verses.textEn: As for the donkeys you lost three days ago, do not worry about them; they have been found. And to whom is all the desire of Israel turned, if not to you and your whole family line?"

verses.textZh: 扫罗回答："我不是以色列众支派中最微小的便雅悯人吗？我的家族不是便雅悯支派的家族中最微小的吗？你为甚么对我说这样的话呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗回答："我不是以色列众支派中最微小的便雅悯人吗？我的家族不是便雅悯支派的家族中最微小的吗？你为甚么对我说这样的话呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗说：「我不是以色列支派中至小的便雅悯人吗？我家不是便雅悯支派中至小的家吗？你为何对我说这样的话呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Saul answered, "But am I not a Benjamite, from the smallest tribe of Israel, and is not my clan the least of all the clans of the tribe of Benjamin? Why do you say such a thing to me?"
verses.textEnEsv: Saul answered, "Am I not a Benjaminite, from the least of the tribes of Israel? And is not my clan the humblest of all the clans of the tribe of Benjamin? Why then have you spoken to me in this way?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Saul answered and said, "Am I not a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel, and my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? Why then do you speak like this to me?"
verses.textEnNlt: Saul replied, "But I’m only from the tribe of Benjamin, the smallest tribe in Israel, and my family is the least important of all the families of that tribe! Why are you talking like this to me?"
verses.textEnNasb: Saul replied, "Am I not a Benjaminite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel, and my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? Why then have you spoken to me in this way?"
verses.textEn: Saul answered, "But am I not a Benjamite, from the smallest tribe of Israel, and is not my clan the least of all the clans of the tribe of Benjamin? Why do you say such a thing to me?"

verses.textZh: 撒母耳把扫罗和扫罗的仆人领进了客厅，使他们坐在客人中的首位；那里约有三十人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳把扫罗和扫罗的仆人领进了客厅，使他们坐在客人中的首位；那里约有三十人。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳领扫罗和他仆人进了客堂，使他们在请来的客中坐首位；客约有三十个人。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Samuel brought Saul and his servant into the hall and seated them at the head of those who were invited—about thirty in number.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Samuel took Saul and his young man and brought them into the hall and gave them a place at the head of those who had been invited, who were about thirty persons.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Samuel took Saul and his servant and brought them into the hall, and had them sit in the place of honor among those who were invited; there were about thirty persons.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Samuel brought Saul and his servant into the hall and placed them at the head of the table, honoring them above the thirty special guests.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Samuel took Saul and his servant and brought them into the hall, and gave them a place at the head of those who were invited, who were about thirty men.
