verses.textZh: 现今不是收割麦子的时候吗？我要向耶和华呼求，他就会打雷降雨，你们就可以知道，又可以看见，你们为自己要求立王的事，在耶和华看来，是行了极大的恶事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现今不是收割麦子的时候吗？我要向耶和华呼求，他就会打雷降雨，你们就可以知道，又可以看见，你们为自己要求立王的事，在耶和华看来，是行了极大的恶事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这不是割麦子的时候吗？我求告耶和华，他必打雷降雨，使你们又知道又看出，你们求立王的事是在耶和华面前犯大罪了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Is it not wheat harvest now? I will call on the Lord to send thunder and rain. And you will realize what an evil thing you did in the eyes of the Lord when you asked for a king."
verses.textEnEsv: Is it not wheat harvest today? I will call upon the Lord , that he may send thunder and rain. And you shall know and see that your wickedness is great, which you have done in the sight of the Lord , in asking for yourselves a king."
verses.textEnNkjv: Is today not the wheat harvest? I will call to the Lord, and He will send thunder and rain, that you may perceive and see that your wickedness is great, which you have done in the sight of the Lord, in asking a king for yourselves."
verses.textEnNlt: You know that it does not rain at this time of the year during the wheat harvest. I will ask the Lord to send thunder and rain today. Then you will realize how wicked you have been in asking the Lord for a king!"
verses.textEnNasb: Is it not the wheat harvest today? I will call to the Lord, that He will send thunder and rain. Then you will know and see that your wickedness is great which you have done in the sight of the Lord, by asking for yourselves a king."
verses.textEn: Is it not wheat harvest now? I will call on the Lord to send thunder and rain. And you will realize what an evil thing you did in the eyes of the Lord when you asked for a king."

verses.textZh: 于是撒母耳向耶和华呼求，耶和华就在那天打雷降雨，众民就非常惧怕耶和华和撒母耳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是撒母耳向耶和华呼求，耶和华就在那天打雷降雨，众民就非常惧怕耶和华和撒母耳。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是撒母耳求告耶和华，耶和华就在这日打雷降雨，众民便甚惧怕耶和华和撒母耳。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Samuel called on the Lord , and that same day the Lord sent thunder and rain. So all the people stood in awe of the Lord and of Samuel.
verses.textEnEsv: So Samuel called upon the Lord , and the Lord sent thunder and rain that day, and all the people greatly feared the Lord and Samuel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Samuel called to the Lord, and the Lord sent thunder and rain that day; and all the people greatly feared the Lord and Samuel.
verses.textEnNlt: So Samuel called to the Lord , and the Lord sent thunder and rain that day. And all the people were terrified of the Lord and of Samuel.
verses.textEnNasb: So Samuel called to the Lord, and the Lord sent thunder and rain that day; and all the people greatly feared the Lord and Samuel.
verses.textEn: Then Samuel called on the Lord , and that same day the Lord sent thunder and rain. So all the people stood in awe of the Lord and of Samuel.

verses.textZh: 众民对撒母耳说："求你为仆人向耶和华你的神祷告，免得我们死亡，因为我们为自己要求立王的事，是在我们的一切罪上又增加了这一件恶事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众民对撒母耳说："求你为仆人向耶和华你的神祷告，免得我们死亡，因为我们为自己要求立王的事，是在我们的一切罪上又增加了这一件恶事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 众民对撒母耳说：「求你为仆人们祷告耶和华－你的神，免得我们死亡，因为我们求立王的事正是罪上加罪了。」
verses.textEnNiv: The people all said to Samuel, "Pray to the Lord your God for your servants so that we will not die, for we have added to all our other sins the evil of asking for a king."
verses.textEnEsv: And all the people said to Samuel, "Pray for your servants to the Lord your God, that we may not die, for we have added to all our sins this evil, to ask for ourselves a king."
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the people said to Samuel, "Pray for your servants to the Lord your God, that we may not die; for we have added to all our sins the evil of asking a king for ourselves."
verses.textEnNlt: "Pray to the Lord your God for us, or we will die!" they all said to Samuel. "For now we have added to our sins by asking for a king."
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the people said to Samuel, "Pray to the Lord your God for your servants, so that we do not die; for we have added to all our sins this evil, by asking for ourselves a king."
verses.textEn: The people all said to Samuel, "Pray to the Lord your God for your servants so that we will not die, for we have added to all our other sins the evil of asking for a king."

verses.textZh: 撒母耳对人民说："不要惧怕！虽然你们行了这一切恶事，只是不可偏离不跟随耶和华，总要一心事奉他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳对人民说："不要惧怕！虽然你们行了这一切恶事，只是不可偏离不跟随耶和华，总要一心事奉他。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳对百姓说：「不要惧怕！你们虽然行了这恶，却不要偏离耶和华，只要尽心事奉他。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not be afraid," Samuel replied. "You have done all this evil; yet do not turn away from the Lord , but serve the Lord with all your heart.
verses.textEnEsv: And Samuel said to the people, "Do not be afraid; you have done all this evil. Yet do not turn aside from following the Lord , but serve the Lord with all your heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Samuel said to the people, "Do not fear. You have done all this wickedness; yet do not turn aside from following the Lord, but serve the Lord with all your heart.
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t be afraid," Samuel reassured them. "You have certainly done wrong, but make sure now that you worship the Lord with all your heart, and don’t turn your back on him.
verses.textEnNasb: Samuel said to the people, "Do not fear. You have committed all this evil, yet do not turn aside from following the Lord, but serve the Lord with all your heart.
verses.textEn: "Do not be afraid," Samuel replied. "You have done all this evil; yet do not turn away from the Lord , but serve the Lord with all your heart.

verses.textZh: 不可偏离耶和华，去追随那些空虚的偶像，因为它们本是空虚的，对人没有甚么益处，也不能救人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可偏离耶和华，去追随那些空虚的偶像，因为它们本是空虚的，对人没有甚么益处，也不能救人。
verses.textZhCuv: 若偏离耶和华去顺从那不能救人的虚神是无益的。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not turn away after useless idols. They can do you no good, nor can they rescue you, because they are useless.
verses.textEnEsv: And do not turn aside after empty things that cannot profit or deliver, for they are empty.
verses.textEnNkjv: And do not turn aside; for thenyouwouldgo after empty things which cannot profit or deliver, for they are nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t go back to worshiping worthless idols that cannot help or rescue you—they are totally useless!
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, you must not turn aside, for then you would go after useless things which cannot benefit or save, because they are useless.
verses.textEn: Do not turn away after useless idols. They can do you no good, nor can they rescue you, because they are useless.

verses.textZh: 耶和华为了自己的大名的缘故，必不丢弃他的子民，因为他喜欢使你们作他的子民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华为了自己的大名的缘故，必不丢弃他的子民，因为他喜欢使你们作他的子民。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华既喜悦选你们作他的子民，就必因他的大名不撇弃你们。
verses.textEnNiv: For the sake of his great name the Lord will not reject his people, because the Lord was pleased to make you his own.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord will not forsake his people, for his great name’s sake, because it has pleased the Lord to make you a people for himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord will not forsake His people, for His great name’s sake, because it has pleased the Lord to make you His people.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will not abandon his people, because that would dishonor his great name. For it has pleased the Lord to make you his very own people.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord will not abandon His people on account of His great name, because the Lord has been pleased to make you a people for Himself.
verses.textEn: For the sake of his great name the Lord will not reject his people, because the Lord was pleased to make you his own.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我决不停止为你们祷告，以致得罪耶和华；我要把善道正路教导你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我决不停止为你们祷告，以致得罪耶和华；我要把善道正路教导你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于我，断不停止为你们祷告，以致得罪耶和华。我必以善道正路指教你们。
verses.textEnNiv: As for me, far be it from me that I should sin against the Lord by failing to pray for you. And I will teach you the way that is good and right.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, as for me, far be it from me that I should sin against the Lord by ceasing to pray for you, and I will instruct you in the good and the right way.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover, as for me, far be it from me that I should sin against the Lord in ceasing to pray for you; but I will teach you the good and the right way.
verses.textEnNlt: "As for me, I will certainly not sin against the Lord by ending my prayers for you. And I will continue to teach you what is good and right.
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, as for me, far be it from me that I would sin against the Lord by ceasing to pray for you; but I will instruct you in the good and right way.
verses.textEn: As for me, far be it from me that I should sin against the Lord by failing to pray for you. And I will teach you the way that is good and right.

verses.textZh: 你们只要敬畏耶和华，诚实全心事奉他，因为你们已经看过他为你们所作的是何等大的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们只要敬畏耶和华，诚实全心事奉他，因为你们已经看过他为你们所作的是何等大的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 只要你们敬畏耶和华，诚诚实实地尽心事奉他，想念他向你们所行的事何等大。
verses.textEnNiv: But be sure to fear the Lord and serve him faithfully with all your heart; consider what great things he has done for you.
verses.textEnEsv: Only fear the Lord and serve him faithfully with all your heart. For consider what great things he has done for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Only fear the Lord, and serve Him in truth with all your heart; for consider what great things He has done for you.
verses.textEnNlt: But be sure to fear the Lord and faithfully serve him. Think of all the wonderful things he has done for you.
verses.textEnNasb: Only fear the Lord and serve Him in truth with all your heart; for consider what great things He has done for you.
verses.textEn: But be sure to fear the Lord and serve him faithfully with all your heart; consider what great things he has done for you.

verses.textZh: 如果你们继续行恶，你们和你们的王就必一同灭亡。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们继续行恶，你们和你们的王就必一同灭亡。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若仍然作恶，你们和你们的王必一同灭亡。」
verses.textEnNiv: Yet if you persist in doing evil, both you and your king will perish."
verses.textEnEsv: But if you still do wickedly, you shall be swept away, both you and your king."
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you still do wickedly, you shall be swept away, both you and your king."
verses.textEnNlt: But if you continue to sin, you and your king will be swept away."
verses.textEnNasb: But if you still do evil, both you and your king will be swept away."
verses.textEn: Yet if you persist in doing evil, both you and your king will perish."

verses.textZh: 扫罗登基的时候年三十岁，作了以色列王四十二年 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗登基的时候年三十岁，作了以色列王四十二年 。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗登基年四十岁；作以色列王二年的时候，
verses.textEnNiv: Saul was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned over Israel forty- two years.
verses.textEnEsv: Saul lived for one year and then became king, and when he had reigned for two years over Israel,
verses.textEnNkjv: Saul reigned one year; and when he had reigned two years over Israel,
verses.textEnNlt: Saul was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned for forty-two years.
verses.textEnNasb: Saul was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for forty-two years over Israel.
verses.textEn: Saul was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned over Israel forty- two years.

verses.textZh: 他从以色列人中为自己拣选了三千人；两千人和扫罗一同驻在密抹和伯特利山，一千人与约拿单一同驻在便雅悯的基比亚。其余的人，扫罗都遣散他们各回自己的家去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从以色列人中为自己拣选了三千人；两千人和扫罗一同驻在密抹和伯特利山，一千人与约拿单一同驻在便雅悯的基比亚。其余的人，扫罗都遣散他们各回自己的家去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 就从以色列中拣选了三千人：二千跟随扫罗在密抹和伯特利山，一千跟随约拿单在便雅悯的基比亚；其余的人扫罗都打发各回各家去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Saul chose three thousand men from Israel; two thousand were with him at Mikmash and in the hill country of Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan at Gibeah in Benjamin. The rest of the men he sent back to their homes.
verses.textEnEsv: Saul chose three thousand men of Israel. Two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and the hill country of Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin. The rest of the people he sent home, every man to his tent.
verses.textEnNkjv: Saul chose for himself three thousand men of Israel. Two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in the mountains of Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin. The rest of the people he sent away, every man to his tent.
verses.textEnNlt: Saul selected 3,000 special troops from the army of Israel and sent the rest of the men home. He took 2,000 of the chosen men with him to Micmash and the hill country of Bethel. The other 1,000 went with Saul’s son Jonathan to Gibeah in the land of Benjamin.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Saul chose for himself three thousand men of Israel, of whom two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in the hill country of Bethel, while a thousand were with Jonathan at Gibeah of Benjamin. But he sent the rest of the people away, each to his tent.
verses.textEn: Saul chose three thousand men from Israel; two thousand were with him at Mikmash and in the hill country of Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan at Gibeah in Benjamin. The rest of the men he sent back to their homes.

verses.textZh: 约拿单攻打非利士人在迦巴的驻军，非利士人听见了；扫罗就在全地吹角，说："让希伯来人都听见。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单攻打非利士人在迦巴的驻军，非利士人听见了；扫罗就在全地吹角，说："让希伯来人都听见。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单攻击在迦巴的非利士人的防营，非利士人听见了。扫罗就在遍地吹角，意思说，要使希伯来人听见。
verses.textEnNiv: Jonathan attacked the Philistine outpost at Geba, and the Philistines heard about it. Then Saul had the trumpet blown throughout the land and said, "Let the Hebrews hear!"
verses.textEnEsv: Jonathan defeated the garrison of the Philistines that was at Geba, and the Philistines heard of it. And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, "Let the Hebrews hear."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jonathan attacked the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard ofit. Then Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, "Let the Hebrews hear!"
verses.textEnNlt: Soon after this, Jonathan attacked and defeated the garrison of Philistines at Geba. The news spread quickly among the Philistines. So Saul blew the ram’s horn throughout the land, saying, "Hebrews, hear this! Rise up in revolt!"
verses.textEnNasb: And Jonathan attacked the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard about it. Then Saul blew the trumpet throughout the land, saying, "Let the Hebrews hear!"
verses.textEn: Jonathan attacked the Philistine outpost at Geba, and the Philistines heard about it. Then Saul had the trumpet blown throughout the land and said, "Let the Hebrews hear!"

verses.textZh: 以色列众人听说扫罗攻打了非利士人的驻军，又听说非利士人憎恨以色列人，就应召在吉甲跟随扫罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列众人听说扫罗攻打了非利士人的驻军，又听说非利士人憎恨以色列人，就应召在吉甲跟随扫罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列众人听见扫罗攻击非利士人的防营，又听见以色列人为非利士人所憎恶，就跟随扫罗聚集在吉甲。
verses.textEnNiv: So all Israel heard the news: "Saul has attacked the Philistine outpost, and now Israel has become obnoxious to the Philistines." And the people were summoned to join Saul at Gilgal.
verses.textEnEsv: And all Israel heard it said that Saul had defeated the garrison of the Philistines, and also that Israel had become a stench to the Philistines. And the people were called out to join Saul at Gilgal.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now all Israel heard it said that Saul had attacked a garrison of the Philistines, and that Israel had also become an abomination to the Philistines. And the people were called together to Saul at Gilgal.
verses.textEnNlt: All Israel heard the news that Saul had destroyed the Philistine garrison at Geba and that the Philistines now hated the Israelites more than ever. So the entire Israelite army was summoned to join Saul at Gilgal.
verses.textEnNasb: And all Israel heard the news that Saul had attacked the garrison of the Philistines, and also that Israel had become repulsive to the Philistines. Then the people were summoned to Saul at Gilgal.
verses.textEn: So all Israel heard the news: "Saul has attacked the Philistine outpost, and now Israel has become obnoxious to the Philistines." And the people were summoned to join Saul at Gilgal.

verses.textZh: 非利士人聚集起来，要与以色列人交战，他们有战车三千 辆、骑兵六千人、步兵像海边的沙那么多。他们上来，在伯．亚文东边的密抹安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人聚集起来，要与以色列人交战，他们有战车三千 辆、骑兵六千人、步兵像海边的沙那么多。他们上来，在伯．亚文东边的密抹安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人聚集，要与以色列人争战，有车三万辆，马兵六千，步兵像海边的沙那样多，就上来在伯‧亚文东边的密抹安营。
verses.textEnNiv: The Philistines assembled to fight Israel, with three thousand chariots, six thousand charioteers, and soldiers as numerous as the sand on the seashore. They went up and camped at Mikmash, east of Beth Aven.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Philistines mustered to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots and six thousand horsemen and troops like the sand on the seashore in multitude. They came up and encamped in Michmash, to the east of Beth-aven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Philistines gathered together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the seashore in multitude. And they came up and encamped in Michmash, to the east of Beth Aven.
verses.textEnNlt: The Philistines mustered a mighty army of 3,000 chariots, 6,000 charioteers, and as many warriors as the grains of sand on the seashore! They camped at Micmash east of Beth-aven.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Philistines assembled to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots and six thousand horsemen, and people like the sand which is on the seashore in abundance; and they came up and camped in Michmash, east of Beth-aven.
verses.textEn: The Philistines assembled to fight Israel, with three thousand chariots, six thousand charioteers, and soldiers as numerous as the sand on the seashore. They went up and camped at Mikmash, east of Beth Aven.

verses.textZh: 以色列人看见自己情况危急，处境窘迫，众人就藏在山洞、岩穴、地洞里和地坑之中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人看见自己情况危急，处境窘迫，众人就藏在山洞、岩穴、地洞里和地坑之中。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列百姓见自己危急窘迫，就藏在山洞、丛林、石穴、隐密处，和坑中。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Israelites saw that their situation was critical and that their army was hard pressed, they hid in caves and thickets, among the rocks, and in pits and cisterns.
verses.textEnEsv: When the men of Israel saw that they were in trouble (for the people were hard pressed), the people hid themselves in caves and in holes and in rocks and in tombs and in cisterns,
verses.textEnNkjv: When the men of Israel saw that they were in danger (for the people were distressed), then the people hid in caves, in thickets, in rocks, in holes, and in pits.
verses.textEnNlt: The men of Israel saw what a tight spot they were in; and because they were hard pressed by the enemy, they tried to hide in caves, thickets, rocks, holes, and cisterns.
verses.textEnNasb: When the men of Israel saw that they were in trouble (for the people were hard-pressed), then the people kept themselves hidden in caves, in crevices, in cliffs, in crypts, and in pits.
verses.textEn: When the Israelites saw that their situation was critical and that their army was hard pressed, they hid in caves and thickets, among the rocks, and in pits and cisterns.

verses.textZh: 有些希伯来人渡过了约旦河，逃到迦得和基列地。但是扫罗仍然留在吉甲，跟随他的众人都恐惧战兢。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有些希伯来人渡过了约旦河，逃到迦得和基列地。但是扫罗仍然留在吉甲，跟随他的众人都恐惧战兢。
verses.textZhCuv: 有些希伯来人过了约旦河，逃到迦得和基列地。扫罗还是在吉甲，百姓都战战兢兢地跟随他。
verses.textEnNiv: Some Hebrews even crossed the Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. Saul remained at Gilgal, and all the troops with him were quaking with fear.
verses.textEnEsv: and some Hebrews crossed the fords of the Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. Saul was still at Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.
verses.textEnNkjv: And someof the Hebrews crossed over the Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. As for Saul, he was still in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.
verses.textEnNlt: Some of them crossed the Jordan River and escaped into the land of Gad and Gilead. Meanwhile, Saul stayed at Gilgal, and his men were trembling with fear.
verses.textEnNasb: And some of the Hebrews crossed the Jordan into the land of Gad and Gilead. But as for Saul, he was still in Gilgal, and all the people followed him, trembling.
verses.textEn: Some Hebrews even crossed the Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. Saul remained at Gilgal, and all the troops with him were quaking with fear.

verses.textZh: 扫罗照着撒母耳所定的日期等了七天，但撒母耳还没有来到吉甲，众人就离开扫罗散去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗照着撒母耳所定的日期等了七天，但撒母耳还没有来到吉甲，众人就离开扫罗散去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗照着撒母耳所定的日期等了七日。撒母耳还没有来到吉甲，百姓也离开扫罗散去了。
verses.textEnNiv: He waited seven days, the time set by Samuel; but Samuel did not come to Gilgal, and Saul’s men began to scatter.
verses.textEnEsv: He waited seven days, the time appointed by Samuel. But Samuel did not come to Gilgal, and the people were scattering from him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he waited seven days, according to the time set by Samuel. But Samuel did not come to Gilgal; and the people were scattered from him.
verses.textEnNlt: Saul waited there seven days for Samuel, as Samuel had instructed him earlier, but Samuel still didn’t come. Saul realized that his troops were rapidly slipping away.
verses.textEnNasb: Now he waited for seven days, until the appointed time that Samuel had set, but Samuel did not come to Gilgal; and the people were scattering from him.
verses.textEn: He waited seven days, the time set by Samuel; but Samuel did not come to Gilgal, and Saul’s men began to scatter.

verses.textZh: 扫罗说："你们把燔祭和平安祭带到我这里来。"他就献上燔祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗说："你们把燔祭和平安祭带到我这里来。"他就献上燔祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗说：「把燔祭和平安祭带到我这里来。」扫罗就献上燔祭。
verses.textEnNiv: So he said, "Bring me the burnt offering and the fellowship offerings." And Saul offered up the burnt offering.
verses.textEnEsv: So Saul said, "Bring the burnt offering here to me, and the peace offerings." And he offered the burnt offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Saul said, "Bring a burnt offering and peace offerings here to me." And he offered the burnt offering.
verses.textEnNlt: So he demanded, "Bring me the burnt offering and the peace offerings!" And Saul sacrificed the burnt offering himself.
verses.textEnNasb: So Saul said, "Bring me the burnt offering and the peace offerings." And he offered the burnt offering.
verses.textEn: So he said, "Bring me the burnt offering and the fellowship offerings." And Saul offered up the burnt offering.

verses.textZh: 他刚刚献完了燔祭，撒母耳就来到了；扫罗出去迎接他，向他问安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他刚刚献完了燔祭，撒母耳就来到了；扫罗出去迎接他，向他问安。
verses.textZhCuv: 刚献完燔祭，撒母耳就到了。扫罗出去迎接他，要问他好。
verses.textEnNiv: Just as he finished making the offering, Samuel arrived, and Saul went out to greet him.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came. And Saul went out to meet him and greet him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, as soon as he had finished presenting the burnt offering, that Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might greet him.
verses.textEnNlt: Just as Saul was finishing with the burnt offering, Samuel arrived. Saul went out to meet and welcome him,
verses.textEnNasb: But as soon as he finished offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him and to greet him.
verses.textEn: Just as he finished making the offering, Samuel arrived, and Saul went out to greet him.

verses.textZh: 撒母耳说："你作了甚么事？"扫罗回答："因为我看见众民都离开我散去了，你又没有照所定的日子来到，而非利士人正在密抹聚集起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳说："你作了甚么事？"扫罗回答："因为我看见众民都离开我散去了，你又没有照所定的日子来到，而非利士人正在密抹聚集起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳说：「你做的是什么事呢？」扫罗说：「因为我见百姓离开我散去，你也不照所定的日期来到，而且非利士人聚集在密抹。
verses.textEnNiv: "What have you done?" asked Samuel. Saul replied, "When I saw that the men were scattering, and that you did not come at the set time, and that the Philistines were assembling at Mikmash,
verses.textEnEsv: Samuel said, "What have you done?" And Saul said, "When I saw that the people were scattering from me, and that you did not come within the days appointed, and that the Philistines had mustered at Michmash,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Samuel said, "What have you done?" Saul said, "When I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that you did not come within the days appointed, and that the Philistines gathered together at Michmash,
verses.textEnNlt: but Samuel said, "What is this you have done?" Saul replied, "I saw my men scattering from me, and you didn’t arrive when you said you would, and the Philistines are at Micmash ready for battle.
verses.textEnNasb: But Samuel said, "What have you done?" And Saul said, "Since I saw that the people were scattering from me, and that you did not come at the appointed time, and that the Philistines were assembling at Michmash,
verses.textEn: "What have you done?" asked Samuel. Saul replied, "When I saw that the men were scattering, and that you did not come at the set time, and that the Philistines were assembling at Mikmash,

verses.textZh: 我心里想：‘非利士人现在就要下到吉甲来攻打我，我却还没有向耶和华求恩。’所以我就勉强自己把燔祭献上了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我心里想：‘非利士人现在就要下到吉甲来攻打我，我却还没有向耶和华求恩。’所以我就勉强自己把燔祭献上了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我心里说：恐怕我没有祷告耶和华。非利士人下到吉甲攻击我，我就勉强献上燔祭。」
verses.textEnNiv: I thought, ‘Now the Philistines will come down against me at Gilgal, and I have not sought the Lord ’s favor.’ So I felt compelled to offer the burnt offering."
verses.textEnEsv: I said, ‘Now the Philistines will come down against me at Gilgal, and I have not sought the favor of the Lord .’ So I forced myself, and offered the burnt offering."
verses.textEnNkjv: then I said, ‘The Philistines will now come down on me at Gilgal, and I have not made supplication to the Lord.’ Therefore I felt compelled, and offered a burnt offering."
verses.textEnNlt: So I said, ‘The Philistines are ready to march against us at Gilgal, and I haven’t even asked for the Lord ’s help!’ So I felt compelled to offer the burnt offering myself before you came."
verses.textEnNasb: I thought, ‘Now the Philistines will come down against me at Gilgal, and I have not asked the favor of the Lord.’ So I worked up the courage and offered the burnt offering."
verses.textEn: I thought, ‘Now the Philistines will come down against me at Gilgal, and I have not sought the Lord ’s favor.’ So I felt compelled to offer the burnt offering."

verses.textZh: 撒母耳对扫罗说："你作了糊涂事了！你没有谨守耶和华你的神吩咐你的命令。如果你谨守，耶和华就必在以色列中坚立你的王位，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳对扫罗说："你作了糊涂事了！你没有谨守耶和华你的神吩咐你的命令。如果你谨守，耶和华就必在以色列中坚立你的王位，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳对扫罗说：「你做了糊涂事了，没有遵守耶和华－你神所吩咐你的命令。若遵守，耶和华必在以色列中坚立你的王位，直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: "You have done a foolish thing," Samuel said. "You have not kept the command the Lord your God gave you; if you had, he would have established your kingdom over Israel for all time.
verses.textEnEsv: And Samuel said to Saul, "You have done foolishly. You have not kept the command of the Lord your God, with which he commanded you. For then the Lord would have established your kingdom over Israel forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Samuel said to Saul, "You have done foolishly. You have not kept the commandment of the Lord your God, which He commanded you. For now the Lord would have established your kingdom over Israel forever.
verses.textEnNlt: "How foolish!" Samuel exclaimed. "You have not kept the command the Lord your God gave you. Had you kept it, the Lord would have established your kingdom over Israel forever.
verses.textEnNasb: But Samuel said to Saul, "You have acted foolishly! You have not kept the commandment of the Lord your God, which He commanded you, for the Lord would now have established your kingdom over Israel forever.
verses.textEn: "You have done a foolish thing," Samuel said. "You have not kept the command the Lord your God gave you; if you had, he would have established your kingdom over Israel for all time.

verses.textZh: 但现在你的王位必不长久，耶和华已经为自己找到一个合他心意的人，立他作自己子民的领袖，因为你没有谨守耶和华所吩咐你的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但现在你的王位必不长久，耶和华已经为自己找到一个合他心意的人，立他作自己子民的领袖，因为你没有谨守耶和华所吩咐你的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你的王位必不长久。耶和华已经寻着一个合他心意的人，立他作百姓的君，因为你没有遵守耶和华所吩咐你的。」
verses.textEnNiv: But now your kingdom will not endure; the Lord has sought out a man after his own heart and appointed him ruler of his people, because you have not kept the Lord ’s command."
verses.textEnEsv: But now your kingdom shall not continue. The Lord has sought out a man after his own heart, and the Lord has commanded him to be prince over his people, because you have not kept what the Lord commanded you."
verses.textEnNkjv: But now your kingdom shall not continue. The Lord has sought for Himself a man after His own heart, and the Lord has commanded him tobe commander over His people, because you have not kept what the Lord commanded you."
verses.textEnNlt: But now your kingdom must end, for the Lord has sought out a man after his own heart. The Lord has already appointed him to be the leader of his people, because you have not kept the Lord ’s command."
verses.textEnNasb: But now your kingdom shall not endure. The Lord has sought for Himself a man after His own heart, and the Lord has appointed him ruler over His people, because you have not kept what the Lord commanded you."
verses.textEn: But now your kingdom will not endure; the Lord has sought out a man after his own heart and appointed him ruler of his people, because you have not kept the Lord ’s command."

verses.textZh: 于是撒母耳动身，从吉甲上便雅悯的基比亚去；扫罗数点跟随他的人，约有六百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是撒母耳动身，从吉甲上便雅悯的基比亚去；扫罗数点跟随他的人，约有六百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳就起来，从吉甲上到便雅悯的基比亚。 扫罗数点跟随他的，约有六百人。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Samuel left Gilgal and went up to Gibeah in Benjamin, and Saul counted the men who were with him. They numbered about six hundred.
verses.textEnEsv: And Samuel arose and went up from Gilgal. The rest of the people went up after Saul to meet the army; they went up from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people who were present with him, about six hundred men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Samuel arose and went up from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people present with him, about six hundred men.
verses.textEnNlt: Samuel then left Gilgal and went on his way, but the rest of the troops went with Saul to meet the army. They went up from Gilgal to Gibeah in the land of Benjamin. When Saul counted the men who were still with him, he found only 600 were left!
verses.textEnNasb: Then Samuel set out and went up from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul counted the people who were present with him, about six hundred men.
verses.textEn: Then Samuel left Gilgal and went up to Gibeah in Benjamin, and Saul counted the men who were with him. They numbered about six hundred.

verses.textZh: 扫罗和他的儿子约拿单，以及跟随他们的人都停留在便雅悯的迦巴，非利士人却在密抹安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗和他的儿子约拿单，以及跟随他们的人都停留在便雅悯的迦巴，非利士人却在密抹安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗和他儿子约拿单，并跟随他们的人，都住在便雅悯的迦巴；但非利士人安营在密抹。
verses.textEnNiv: Saul and his son Jonathan and the men with them were staying in Gibeah in Benjamin, while the Philistines camped at Mikmash.
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul and Jonathan his son and the people who were present with them stayed in Geba of Benjamin, but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.
verses.textEnNkjv: Saul, Jonathan his son, and the people present with them remained in Gibeah of Benjamin. But the Philistines encamped in Michmash.
verses.textEnNlt: Saul and Jonathan and the troops with them were staying at Geba in the land of Benjamin. The Philistines set up their camp at Micmash.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Saul, his son Jonathan, and the people who were present with them were staying in Geba of Benjamin while the Philistines camped at Michmash.
verses.textEn: Saul and his son Jonathan and the men with them were staying in Gibeah in Benjamin, while the Philistines camped at Mikmash.

verses.textZh: 有突击队从非利士人的营里出来，分成三队，一队往俄弗拉向书亚地去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 有突击队从非利士人的营里出来，分成三队，一队往俄弗拉向书亚地去，
verses.textZhCuv: 有掠兵从非利士营中出来，分为三队：一队往俄弗拉向书亚地去，
verses.textEnNiv: Raiding parties went out from the Philistine camp in three detachments. One turned toward Ophrah in the vicinity of Shual,
verses.textEnEsv: And raiders came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies. One company turned toward Ophrah, to the land of Shual;
verses.textEnNkjv: Then raiders came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies. One company turned onto the road to Ophrah, to the land of Shual,
verses.textEnNlt: Three raiding parties soon left the camp of the Philistines. One went north toward Ophrah in the land of Shual,
verses.textEnNasb: Then raiders came from the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned toward Ophrah, to the land of Shual,
verses.textEn: Raiding parties went out from the Philistine camp in three detachments. One turned toward Ophrah in the vicinity of Shual,

verses.textZh: 一队往伯．和仑去，一队往洗波音谷对面的境界向旷野去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一队往伯．和仑去，一队往洗波音谷对面的境界向旷野去。
verses.textZhCuv: 一队往伯‧和仑去，一队往洗波音谷对面的地境向旷野去。
verses.textEnNiv: another toward Beth Horon, and the third toward the borderland overlooking the Valley of Zeboyim facing the wilderness.
verses.textEnEsv: another company turned toward Beth-horon; and another company turned toward the border that looks down on the Valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: another company turned to the road to Beth Horon, and another company turned to the road of the border that overlooks the Valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: another went west to Beth-horon, and the third moved toward the border above the valley of Zeboim near the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: and another company turned toward Beth-horon, and another company turned toward the border that overlooks the Valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.
verses.textEn: another toward Beth Horon, and the third toward the borderland overlooking the Valley of Zeboyim facing the wilderness.

verses.textZh: 那时，以色列全地找不到一个铁匠，因为非利士人说："恐怕希伯来人制造刀剑或枪矛。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，以色列全地找不到一个铁匠，因为非利士人说："恐怕希伯来人制造刀剑或枪矛。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，以色列全地没有一个铁匠；因为非利士人说，恐怕希伯来人制造刀枪。
verses.textEnNiv: Not a blacksmith could be found in the whole land of Israel, because the Philistines had said, "Otherwise the Hebrews will make swords or spears!"
verses.textEnEsv: Now there was no blacksmith to be found throughout all the land of Israel, for the Philistines said, "Lest the Hebrews make themselves swords or spears."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there was no blacksmith to be found throughout all the land of Israel, for the Philistines said, "Lest the Hebrews make swords or spears."
verses.textEnNlt: There were no blacksmiths in the land of Israel in those days. The Philistines wouldn’t allow them for fear they would make swords and spears for the Hebrews.
verses.textEnNasb: Now no blacksmith could be found in all the land of Israel, because the Philistines said, "Otherwise the Hebrews will make swords or spears."
verses.textEn: Not a blacksmith could be found in the whole land of Israel, because the Philistines had said, "Otherwise the Hebrews will make swords or spears!"

verses.textZh: 以色列众人要磨锄头、犁头、斧头和铲子，就各自下到非利士人那里去磨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列众人要磨锄头、犁头、斧头和铲子，就各自下到非利士人那里去磨。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人要磨锄、犁、斧、铲，就下到非利士人那里去磨。
verses.textEnNiv: So all Israel went down to the Philistines to have their plow points, mattocks, axes and sickles sharpened.
verses.textEnEsv: But every one of the Israelites went down to the Philistines to sharpen his plowshare, his mattock, his axe, or his sickle,
verses.textEnNkjv: But all the Israelites would go down to the Philistines to sharpen each man’s plowshare, his mattock, his ax, and his sickle;
verses.textEnNlt: So whenever the Israelites needed to sharpen their plowshares, picks, axes, or sickles, they had to take them to a Philistine blacksmith.
verses.textEnNasb: So all Israel went down to the Philistines, each to sharpen his plowshare, his mattock, his axe, and his hoe.
verses.textEn: So all Israel went down to the Philistines to have their plow points, mattocks, axes and sickles sharpened.

verses.textZh: 磨锄头或犁头的价钱是七克银子，磨三齿叉、斧头或刺棒的价钱是四克银子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 磨锄头或犁头的价钱是七克银子，磨三齿叉、斧头或刺棒的价钱是四克银子。
verses.textZhCuv: 但有锉可以锉铲、犁、三齿叉、斧子，并赶牛锥。
verses.textEnNiv: The price was two-thirds of a shekel for sharpening plow points and mattocks, and a third of a shekel for sharpening forks and axes and for repointing goads.
verses.textEnEsv: and the charge was two-thirds of a shekel for the plowshares and for the mattocks, and a third of a shekel for sharpening the axes and for setting the goads.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the charge for a sharpening was a pim for the plowshares, the mattocks, the forks, and the axes, and to set the points of the goads.
verses.textEnNlt: The charges were as follows: a quarter of an ounce of silver for sharpening a plowshare or a pick, and an eighth of an ounce for sharpening an ax or making the point of an ox goad.
verses.textEnNasb: The charge was two-thirds of a shekel for the plowshares, the mattocks, the forks, and the axes, and to fix the cattle goads.
verses.textEn: The price was two-thirds of a shekel for sharpening plow points and mattocks, and a third of a shekel for sharpening forks and axes and for repointing goads.

verses.textZh: 所以，到了争战的时候，跟随扫罗和约拿单的众民，没有一个手里有刀或枪的，只有扫罗和他的儿子约拿单有刀枪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，到了争战的时候，跟随扫罗和约拿单的众民，没有一个手里有刀或枪的，只有扫罗和他的儿子约拿单有刀枪。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以到了争战的日子，跟随扫罗和约拿单的人没有一个手里有刀有枪的，惟独扫罗和他儿子约拿单有。
verses.textEnNiv: So on the day of the battle not a soldier with Saul and Jonathan had a sword or spear in his hand; only Saul and his son Jonathan had them.
verses.textEnEsv: So on the day of the battle there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people with Saul and Jonathan, but Saul and Jonathan his son had them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it came about, on the day of battle, that there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people who were with Saul and Jonathan. But they were found with Saul and Jonathan his son.
verses.textEnNlt: So on the day of the battle none of the people of Israel had a sword or spear, except for Saul and Jonathan.
verses.textEnNasb: So it came about on the day of battle that neither sword nor spear was found in the hands of any of the people who were with Saul and Jonathan, but they were found with Saul and his son Jonathan.
verses.textEn: So on the day of the battle not a soldier with Saul and Jonathan had a sword or spear in his hand; only Saul and his son Jonathan had them.

verses.textZh: 有一队非利士人的驻军出到密抹的隘口去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一队非利士人的驻军出到密抹的隘口去。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人的一队防兵到了密抹的隘口。
verses.textEnNiv: Now a detachment of Philistines had gone out to the pass at Mikmash.
verses.textEnEsv: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the pass of Michmash.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the pass of Michmash.
verses.textEnNlt: The pass at Micmash had meanwhile been secured by a contingent of the Philistine army.
verses.textEnNasb: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the gorge of Michmash.
verses.textEn: Now a detachment of Philistines had gone out to the pass at Mikmash.

verses.textZh: 有一天，扫罗的儿子约拿单对替他拿武器的仆人说："来！我们过到非利士人的驻军那边去吧。"但他没有告诉父亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一天，扫罗的儿子约拿单对替他拿武器的仆人说："来！我们过到非利士人的驻军那边去吧。"但他没有告诉父亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一日，扫罗的儿子约拿单对拿他兵器的少年人说：「我们不如过到那边，到非利士人的防营那里去。」但他没有告诉父亲。
verses.textEnNiv: One day Jonathan son of Saul said to his young armor-bearer, "Come, let’s go over to the Philistine outpost on the other side." But he did not tell his father.
verses.textEnEsv: One day Jonathan the son of Saul said to the young man who carried his armor, "Come, let us go over to the Philistine garrison on the other side." But he did not tell his father.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened one day that Jonathan the son of Saul said to the young man who bore his armor, "Come, let us go over to the Philistines’ garrison that is on the other side." But he did not tell his father.
verses.textEnNlt: One day Jonathan said to his armor bearer, "Come on, let’s go over to where the Philistines have their outpost." But Jonathan did not tell his father what he was doing.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the day came that Jonathan, the son of Saul, said to the young man who was carrying his armor, "Come, and let’s cross over to the Philistines’ garrison that is on the other side." But he did not tell his father.
verses.textEn: One day Jonathan son of Saul said to his young armor-bearer, "Come, let’s go over to the Philistine outpost on the other side." But he did not tell his father.

verses.textZh: 那时扫罗在基比亚的边界，坐在米矶仑的石榴树下，跟随他的约有六百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时扫罗在基比亚的边界，坐在米矶仑的石榴树下，跟随他的约有六百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗在基比亚的尽边，坐在米矶仑的石榴树下，跟随他的约有六百人。
verses.textEnNiv: Saul was staying on the outskirts of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree in Migron. With him were about six hundred men,
verses.textEnEsv: Saul was staying in the outskirts of Gibeah in the pomegranate cave at Migron. The people who were with him were about six hundred men,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Saul was sitting in the outskirts of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree which is in Migron. The people who were with him were about six hundred men.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Saul and his 600 men were camped on the outskirts of Gibeah, around the pomegranate tree at Migron.
verses.textEnNasb: Saul was staying on the outskirts of Gibeah under the pomegranate tree that is in Migron. And the people who were with him numbered about six hundred men;
verses.textEn: Saul was staying on the outskirts of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree in Migron. With him were about six hundred men,

verses.textZh: 其中有亚希突的儿子亚希亚带着以弗得；亚希突是以迦博的哥哥，非尼哈的儿子，以利的孙子。以利从前在示罗作耶和华的祭司。约拿单去了，众人都不知道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其中有亚希突的儿子亚希亚带着以弗得；亚希突是以迦博的哥哥，非尼哈的儿子，以利的孙子。以利从前在示罗作耶和华的祭司。约拿单去了，众人都不知道。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里有亚希突的儿子亚希亚，穿着以弗得。（亚希突是以迦博的哥哥，非尼哈的儿子，以利的孙子。以利从前在示罗作耶和华的祭司。）约拿单去了，百姓却不知道。
verses.textEnNiv: among whom was Ahijah, who was wearing an ephod. He was a son of Ichabod’s brother Ahitub son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the Lord ’s priest in Shiloh. No one was aware that Jonathan had left.
verses.textEnEsv: including Ahijah the son of Ahitub, Ichabod’s brother, son of Phinehas, son of Eli, the priest of the Lord in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. And the people did not know that Jonathan had gone.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ahijah the son of Ahitub, Ichabod’s brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the Lord’s priest in Shiloh, was wearing an ephod. But the people did not know that Jonathan had gone.
verses.textEnNlt: Among Saul’s men was Ahijah the priest, who was wearing the ephod, the priestly vest. Ahijah was the son of Ichabod’s brother Ahitub, son of Phinehas, son of Eli, the priest of the Lord who had served at Shiloh. No one realized that Jonathan had left the Israelite camp.
verses.textEnNasb: and Ahijah, the son of Ahitub, Ichabod’s brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the priest of the Lord at Shiloh, was wearing an ephod. And the people did not know that Jonathan had gone.
verses.textEn: among whom was Ahijah, who was wearing an ephod. He was a son of Ichabod’s brother Ahitub son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the Lord ’s priest in Shiloh. No one was aware that Jonathan had left.

verses.textZh: 约拿单设法要经过那个隘口到非利士人的驻军那里去，隘口的两边各有一个山峰，一个名叫播薛，另一个名叫西尼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单设法要经过那个隘口到非利士人的驻军那里去，隘口的两边各有一个山峰，一个名叫播薛，另一个名叫西尼。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单要从隘口过到非利士防营那里去。这隘口两边各有一个山峰：一名播薛，一名西尼；
verses.textEnNiv: On each side of the pass that Jonathan intended to cross to reach the Philistine outpost was a cliff; one was called Bozez and the other Seneh.
verses.textEnEsv: Within the passes, by which Jonathan sought to go over to the Philistine garrison, there was a rocky crag on the one side and a rocky crag on the other side. The name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Between the passes, by which Jonathan sought to go over to the Philistines’ garrison, therewas a sharp rock on one side and a sharp rock on the other side. And the name of one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.
verses.textEnNlt: To reach the Philistine outpost, Jonathan had to go down between two rocky cliffs that were called Bozez and Seneh.
verses.textEnNasb: Now between the gorges by which Jonathan sought to cross over to the Philistines’ garrison there was a rocky crag on the one side, and a rocky crag on the other side; and the name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other, Seneh.
verses.textEn: On each side of the pass that Jonathan intended to cross to reach the Philistine outpost was a cliff; one was called Bozez and the other Seneh.

verses.textZh: 一个高峰向北，与密抹相对，另一个向南，与迦巴相对。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一个高峰向北，与密抹相对，另一个向南，与迦巴相对。
verses.textZhCuv: 一峰向北，与密抹相对，一峰向南，与迦巴相对。
verses.textEnNiv: One cliff stood to the north toward Mikmash, the other to the south toward Geba.
verses.textEnEsv: The one crag rose on the north in front of Michmash, and the other on the south in front of Geba.
verses.textEnNkjv: The front of one faced northward opposite Michmash, and the other southward opposite Gibeah.
verses.textEnNlt: The cliff on the north was in front of Micmash, and the one on the south was in front of Geba.
verses.textEnNasb: The one crag rose on the north opposite Michmash, and the other on the south opposite Geba.
verses.textEn: One cliff stood to the north toward Mikmash, the other to the south toward Geba.

verses.textZh: 约拿单对替他拿武器的仆人说："来！我们过到这些未受割礼的人的驻军那里去，也许耶和华会为我们动工，因为不论人多或人少，都不能妨碍耶和华施行拯救。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单对替他拿武器的仆人说："来！我们过到这些未受割礼的人的驻军那里去，也许耶和华会为我们动工，因为不论人多或人少，都不能妨碍耶和华施行拯救。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单对拿兵器的少年人说：「我们不如过到未受割礼人的防营那里去，或者耶和华为我们施展能力；因为耶和华使人得胜，不在乎人多人少。」
verses.textEnNiv: Jonathan said to his young armor-bearer, "Come, let’s go over to the outpost of those uncircumcised men. Perhaps the Lord will act in our behalf. Nothing can hinder the Lord from saving, whether by many or by few."
verses.textEnEsv: Jonathan said to the young man who carried his armor, "Come, let us go over to the garrison of these uncircumcised. It may be that the Lord will work for us, for nothing can hinder the Lord from saving by many or by few."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jonathan said to the young man who bore his armor, "Come, let us go over to the garrison of these uncircumcised; it may be that the Lord will work for us. For nothing restrains the Lord from saving by many or by few."
verses.textEnNlt: "Let’s go across to the outpost of those pagans," Jonathan said to his armor bearer. "Perhaps the Lord will help us, for nothing can hinder the Lord . He can win a battle whether he has many warriors or only a few!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jonathan said to the young man who was carrying his armor, "Come, and let’s cross over to the garrison of these uncircumcised men; perhaps the Lord will work for us, because the Lord is not limited to saving by many or by few!"
verses.textEn: Jonathan said to his young armor-bearer, "Come, let’s go over to the outpost of those uncircumcised men. Perhaps the Lord will act in our behalf. Nothing can hinder the Lord from saving, whether by many or by few."

verses.textZh: 替他拿武器的仆人对他说："照你的心意作吧！去吧，我必与你同心。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 替他拿武器的仆人对他说："照你的心意作吧！去吧，我必与你同心。"
verses.textZhCuv: 拿兵器的对他说：「随你的心意行吧。你可以上去，我必跟随你，与你同心。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Do all that you have in mind," his armor-bearer said. "Go ahead; I am with you heart and soul."
verses.textEnEsv: And his armor-bearer said to him, "Do all that is in your heart. Do as you wish. Behold, I am with you heart and soul."
verses.textEnNkjv: So his armorbearer said to him, "Do all that is in your heart. Go then; here I am with you, according to your heart."
verses.textEnNlt: "Do what you think is best," the armor bearer replied. "I’m with you completely, whatever you decide."
verses.textEnNasb: His armor bearer said to him, "Do everything that is in your heart; turn yourself to it, and here I am with you, as your heart desires."
verses.textEn: "Do all that you have in mind," his armor-bearer said. "Go ahead; I am with you heart and soul."

verses.textZh: 约拿单说："我们要过到那些人那里去，让他们看见我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单说："我们要过到那些人那里去，让他们看见我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单说：「我们要过到那些人那里去，使他们看见我们。
verses.textEnNiv: Jonathan said, "Come on, then; we will cross over toward them and let them see us.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jonathan said, "Behold, we will cross over to the men, and we will show ourselves to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jonathan said, "Very well, let us cross over to these men, and we will show ourselves to them.
verses.textEnNlt: "All right, then," Jonathan told him. "We will cross over and let them see us.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jonathan said, "Behold, we are going to cross over to the men and reveal ourselves to them.
verses.textEn: Jonathan said, "Come on, then; we will cross over toward them and let them see us.

verses.textZh: 如果他们对我们这样说：‘你们站住！等我们到你们那里去。’我们就站在原地，不上他们那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他们对我们这样说：‘你们站住！等我们到你们那里去。’我们就站在原地，不上他们那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们若对我们说：『你们站住，等我们到你们那里去』，我们就站住，不上他们那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: If they say to us, ‘Wait there until we come to you,’ we will stay where we are and not go up to them.
verses.textEnEsv: If they say to us, ‘Wait until we come to you,’ then we will stand still in our place, and we will not go up to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: If they say thus to us, ‘Wait until we come to you,’ then we will stand still in our place and not go up to them.
verses.textEnNlt: If they say to us, ‘Stay where you are or we’ll kill you,’ then we will stop and not go up to them.
verses.textEnNasb: If they say to us, ‘Wait until we come to you’; then we will stand in our place and not go up to them.
verses.textEn: If they say to us, ‘Wait there until we come to you,’ we will stay where we are and not go up to them.

verses.textZh: 如果他们对我们这样说：‘你们上到我们这里来吧！’我们就上去，这就是我们的凭据，因为耶和华已经把他们交在我们的手里了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他们对我们这样说：‘你们上到我们这里来吧！’我们就上去，这就是我们的凭据，因为耶和华已经把他们交在我们的手里了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们若说：『你们上到我们这里来』，这话就是我们的证据；我们便上去，因为耶和华将他们交在我们手里了。」
verses.textEnNiv: But if they say, ‘Come up to us,’ we will climb up, because that will be our sign that the Lord has given them into our hands."
verses.textEnEsv: But if they say, ‘Come up to us,’ then we will go up, for the Lord has given them into our hand. And this shall be the sign to us."
verses.textEnNkjv: But if they say thus, ‘Come up to us,’ then we will go up. For the Lord has delivered them into our hand, and this willbe a sign to us."
verses.textEnNlt: But if they say, ‘Come on up and fight,’ then we will go up. That will be the Lord ’s sign that he will help us defeat them."
verses.textEnNasb: But if they say, ‘Come up to us,’ then we will go up, for the Lord has handed them over to us; and this shall be the sign to us."
verses.textEn: But if they say, ‘Come up to us,’ we will climb up, because that will be our sign that the Lord has given them into our hands."

verses.textZh: 他们二人就让非利士人的驻军看见。非利士人说："看哪！有希伯来人从他们躲藏的洞里出来了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们二人就让非利士人的驻军看见。非利士人说："看哪！有希伯来人从他们躲藏的洞里出来了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 二人就使非利士的防兵看见。非利士人说：「希伯来人从所藏的洞穴里出来了！」
verses.textEnNiv: So both of them showed themselves to the Philistine outpost. "Look!" said the Philistines. "The Hebrews are crawling out of the holes they were hiding in."
verses.textEnEsv: So both of them showed themselves to the garrison of the Philistines. And the Philistines said, "Look, Hebrews are coming out of the holes where they have hidden themselves."
verses.textEnNkjv: So both of them showed themselves to the garrison of the Philistines. And the Philistines said, "Look, the Hebrews are coming out of the holes where they have hidden."
verses.textEnNlt: When the Philistines saw them coming, they shouted, "Look! The Hebrews are crawling out of their holes!"
verses.textEnNasb: When the two of them revealed themselves to the garrison of the Philistines, the Philistines said, "Behold, Hebrews are coming out of the holes where they have kept themselves hidden."
verses.textEn: So both of them showed themselves to the Philistine outpost. "Look!" said the Philistines. "The Hebrews are crawling out of the holes they were hiding in."

verses.textZh: 驻军中有人应声对约拿单和替他拿武器的人说："你们上我们这里来吧！我们有一件事要告诉你们。"约拿单对替他拿武器的人说："你跟我上去，因为耶和华已经把他们交在以色列人的手里了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 驻军中有人应声对约拿单和替他拿武器的人说："你们上我们这里来吧！我们有一件事要告诉你们。"约拿单对替他拿武器的人说："你跟我上去，因为耶和华已经把他们交在以色列人的手里了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 防兵对约拿单和拿兵器的人说：「你们上到这里来，我们有一件事指示你们。」约拿单就对拿兵器的人说：「你跟随我上去，因为耶和华将他们交在以色列人手里了。」
verses.textEnNiv: The men of the outpost shouted to Jonathan and his armor-bearer, "Come up to us and we’ll teach you a lesson." So Jonathan said to his armor-bearer, "Climb up after me; the Lord has given them into the hand of Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: And the men of the garrison hailed Jonathan and his armor-bearer and said, "Come up to us, and we will show you a thing." And Jonathan said to his armor-bearer, "Come up after me, for the Lord has given them into the hand of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the men of the garrison called to Jonathan and his armorbearer, and said, "Come up to us, and we will show you something." Jonathan said to his armorbearer, "Come up after me, for the Lord has delivered them into the hand of Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the men from the outpost shouted to Jonathan, "Come on up here, and we’ll teach you a lesson!" "Come on, climb right behind me," Jonathan said to his armor bearer, "for the Lord will help us defeat them!"
verses.textEnNasb: So the men of the garrison responded to Jonathan and his armor bearer and said, "Come up to us and we will inform you of something." And Jonathan said to his armor bearer, "Come up after me, for the Lord has handed them over to Israel."
verses.textEn: The men of the outpost shouted to Jonathan and his armor-bearer, "Come up to us and we’ll teach you a lesson." So Jonathan said to his armor-bearer, "Climb up after me; the Lord has given them into the hand of Israel."

verses.textZh: 约拿单手脚并用地爬了上去，替他拿武器的人跟着他。非利士人在约拿单面前倒下，替他拿武器的也跟在后面把他们杀死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单手脚并用地爬了上去，替他拿武器的人跟着他。非利士人在约拿单面前倒下，替他拿武器的也跟在后面把他们杀死。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单就爬上去，拿兵器的人跟随他。约拿单杀倒非利士人，拿兵器的人也随着杀他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Jonathan climbed up, using his hands and feet, with his armor-bearer right behind him. The Philistines fell before Jonathan, and his armor-bearer followed and killed behind him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jonathan climbed up on his hands and feet, and his armor-bearer after him. And they fell before Jonathan, and his armor-bearer killed them after him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jonathan climbed up on his hands and knees with his armorbearer after him; and they fell before Jonathan. And as he came after him, his armorbearer killed them.
verses.textEnNlt: So they climbed up using both hands and feet, and the Philistines fell before Jonathan, and his armor bearer killed those who came behind them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jonathan climbed up on his hands and feet, with his armor bearer behind him; and the men fell before Jonathan, and his armor bearer put some to death after him.
verses.textEn: Jonathan climbed up, using his hands and feet, with his armor-bearer right behind him. The Philistines fell before Jonathan, and his armor-bearer followed and killed behind him.

verses.textZh: 约拿单和替他拿武器的第一次杀敌，约杀死了二十人，都是在四分之一公顷的范围内杀的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单和替他拿武器的第一次杀敌，约杀死了二十人，都是在四分之一公顷的范围内杀的。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单和拿兵器的人起头所杀的约有二十人，都在一亩地的半犁沟之内。
verses.textEnNiv: In that first attack Jonathan and his armor-bearer killed some twenty men in an area of about half an acre.
verses.textEnEsv: And that first strike, which Jonathan and his armor-bearer made, killed about twenty men within as it were half a furrow’s length in an acre of land.
verses.textEnNkjv: That first slaughter which Jonathan and his armorbearer made was about twenty men within about half an acre of land.
verses.textEnNlt: They killed some twenty men in all, and their bodies were scattered over about half an acre.
verses.textEnNasb: Now that first slaughter which Jonathan and his armor bearer inflicted was about twenty men within about half a furrow in an acre of land.
verses.textEn: In that first attack Jonathan and his armor-bearer killed some twenty men in an area of about half an acre.

verses.textZh: 于是在营房里，在田野中和在众人中间，都有恐慌，驻军和突击队也都恐惧，地也震动，这是从神而来的恐惧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是在营房里，在田野中和在众人中间，都有恐慌，驻军和突击队也都恐惧，地也震动，这是从神而来的恐惧。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是在营中、在田野、在众民内都有战兢，防兵和掠兵也都战兢，地也震动，战兢之势甚大。
verses.textEnNiv: Then panic struck the whole army—those in the camp and field, and those in the outposts and raiding parties—and the ground shook. It was a panic sent by God.
verses.textEnEsv: And there was a panic in the camp, in the field, and among all the people. The garrison and even the raiders trembled, the earth quaked, and it became a very great panic.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there was trembling in the camp, in the field, and among all the people. The garrison and the raiders also trembled; and the earth quaked, so that it was a very great trembling.
verses.textEnNlt: Suddenly, panic broke out in the Philistine army, both in the camp and in the field, including even the outposts and raiding parties. And just then an earthquake struck, and everyone was terrified.
verses.textEnNasb: And there was a trembling in the camp, in the field, and among all the people. Even the garrison and the raiders trembled, and the earth quaked so that it became a great trembling.
verses.textEn: Then panic struck the whole army—those in the camp and field, and those in the outposts and raiding parties—and the ground shook. It was a panic sent by God.

verses.textZh: 在便雅悯的基比亚，扫罗的瞭望兵看见非利士人的大军溃败，四处逃窜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在便雅悯的基比亚，扫罗的瞭望兵看见非利士人的大军溃败，四处逃窜。
verses.textZhCuv: 在便雅悯的基比亚，扫罗的守望兵看见非利士的军众溃散，四围乱窜。
verses.textEnNiv: Saul’s lookouts at Gibeah in Benjamin saw the army melting away in all directions.
verses.textEnEsv: And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked, and behold, the multitude was dispersing here and there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked, and there was the multitude, melting away; and they went here and there.
verses.textEnNlt: Saul’s lookouts in Gibeah of Benjamin saw a strange sight—the vast army of Philistines began to melt away in every direction.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Saul’s watchmen in Gibeah of Benjamin looked, and behold, the multitude dissolved; they went here and there.
verses.textEn: Saul’s lookouts at Gibeah in Benjamin saw the army melting away in all directions.

verses.textZh: 于是扫罗对跟随他的众民说："你们数点一下，看看谁从我们这里出去了。"他们一数点，就发现约拿单和替他拿武器的不在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是扫罗对跟随他的众民说："你们数点一下，看看谁从我们这里出去了。"他们一数点，就发现约拿单和替他拿武器的不在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗就对跟随他的民说：「你们查点查点，看从我们这里出去的是谁？」他们一查点，就知道约拿单和拿兵器的人没有在这里。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Saul said to the men who were with him, "Muster the forces and see who has left us." When they did, it was Jonathan and his armor-bearer who were not there.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Saul said to the people who were with him, "Count and see who has gone from us." And when they had counted, behold, Jonathan and his armor-bearer were not there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul said to the people who were with him, "Now call the roll and see who has gone from us." And when they had called the roll, surprisingly, Jonathan and his armorbearer were not there.
verses.textEnNlt: "Call the roll and find out who’s missing," Saul ordered. And when they checked, they found that Jonathan and his armor bearer were gone.
verses.textEnNasb: So Saul said to the people who were with him, "Look carefully now and see who has left us." And when they had looked, behold, Jonathan and his armor bearer were not there.
verses.textEn: Then Saul said to the men who were with him, "Muster the forces and see who has left us." When they did, it was Jonathan and his armor-bearer who were not there.

verses.textZh: 扫罗对亚希亚说："把神的约柜运来！"因为那时神的约柜在以色列人那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗对亚希亚说："把神的约柜运来！"因为那时神的约柜在以色列人那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时神的约柜在以色列人那里。扫罗对亚希亚说：「你将神的约柜运了来。」
verses.textEnNiv: Saul said to Ahijah, "Bring the ark of God." (At that time it was with the Israelites.)
verses.textEnEsv: So Saul said to Ahijah, "Bring the ark of God here." For the ark of God went at that time with the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Saul said to Ahijah, "Bring the ark of God here" (for at that time the ark of God was with the children of Israel).
verses.textEnNlt: Then Saul shouted to Ahijah, "Bring the ephod here!" For at that time Ahijah was wearing the ephod in front of the Israelites.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul said to Ahijah, "Bring the ark of God here." For at that time the ark of God was with the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: Saul said to Ahijah, "Bring the ark of God." (At that time it was with the Israelites.)

verses.textZh: 扫罗正对祭司说话的时候，非利士营中的骚乱越来越大，扫罗就对祭司说："住手吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗正对祭司说话的时候，非利士营中的骚乱越来越大，扫罗就对祭司说："住手吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗正与祭司说话的时候，非利士营中的喧嚷越发大了；扫罗就对祭司说：「停手吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: While Saul was talking to the priest, the tumult in the Philistine camp increased more and more. So Saul said to the priest, "Withdraw your hand."
verses.textEnEsv: Now while Saul was talking to the priest, the tumult in the camp of the Philistines increased more and more. So Saul said to the priest, "Withdraw your hand."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, while Saul talked to the priest, that the noise which was in the camp of the Philistines continued to increase; so Saul said to the priest, "Withdraw your hand."
verses.textEnNlt: But while Saul was talking to the priest, the confusion in the Philistine camp grew louder and louder. So Saul said to the priest, "Never mind; let’s get going!"
verses.textEnNasb: While Saul talked to the priest, the commotion in the camp of the Philistines continued and increased; so Saul said to the priest, "Withdraw your hand."
verses.textEn: While Saul was talking to the priest, the tumult in the Philistine camp increased more and more. So Saul said to the priest, "Withdraw your hand."

verses.textZh: 扫罗和所有跟随他的人就聚集起来，到了战场，就看见非利士人用刀互相击杀，十分混乱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗和所有跟随他的人就聚集起来，到了战场，就看见非利士人用刀互相击杀，十分混乱。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗和跟随他的人都聚集，来到战场，看见非利士人用刀互相击杀，大大惶乱。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Saul and all his men assembled and went to the battle. They found the Philistines in total confusion, striking each other with their swords.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Saul and all the people who were with him rallied and went into the battle. And behold, every Philistine’s sword was against his fellow, and there was very great confusion.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul and all the people who were with him assembled, and they went to the battle; and indeed every man’s sword was against his neighbor, andtherewas very great confusion.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Saul and all his men rushed out to the battle and found the Philistines killing each other. There was terrible confusion everywhere.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul and all the people who were with him rallied and came to the battle; and behold, every man’s sword was against his fellow Philistine, and there was very great confusion.
verses.textEn: Then Saul and all his men assembled and went to the battle. They found the Philistines in total confusion, striking each other with their swords.

verses.textZh: 那些从前归顺非利士人的希伯来人，就是混杂在营里与非利士人一起上来的，现在也转过来，与那些跟从扫罗和约拿单的以色列人在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些从前归顺非利士人的希伯来人，就是混杂在营里与非利士人一起上来的，现在也转过来，与那些跟从扫罗和约拿单的以色列人在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前由四方来跟随非利士军的希伯来人现在也转过来，帮助跟随扫罗和约拿单的以色列人了。
verses.textEnNiv: Those Hebrews who had previously been with the Philistines and had gone up with them to their camp went over to the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the Hebrews who had been with the Philistines before that time and who had gone up with them into the camp, even they also turned to be with the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the Hebrews who were with the Philistines before that time, who went up with them into the camp fromthe surrounding country, they also joined the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.
verses.textEnNlt: Even the Hebrews who had previously gone over to the Philistine army revolted and joined in with Saul, Jonathan, and the rest of the Israelites.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Hebrews who were with the Philistines previously, who went up with them all around in the camp, even they also returned to be with the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.
verses.textEn: Those Hebrews who had previously been with the Philistines and had gone up with them to their camp went over to the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.

verses.textZh: 那些躲藏在以法莲山地的以色列众人一听见非利士人逃跑，也就在战场上紧紧追赶他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些躲藏在以法莲山地的以色列众人一听见非利士人逃跑，也就在战场上紧紧追赶他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 那藏在以法莲山地的以色列人听说非利士人逃跑，就出来紧紧地追杀他们。
verses.textEnNiv: When all the Israelites who had hidden in the hill country of Ephraim heard that the Philistines were on the run, they joined the battle in hot pursuit.
verses.textEnEsv: Likewise, when all the men of Israel who had hidden themselves in the hill country of Ephraim heard that the Philistines were fleeing, they too followed hard after them in the battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise all the men of Israel who had hidden in the mountains of Ephraim, when they heard that the Philistines fled, they also followed hard after them in the battle.
verses.textEnNlt: Likewise, the men of Israel who were hiding in the hill country of Ephraim joined the chase when they saw the Philistines running away.
verses.textEnNasb: When all the men of Israel who had kept themselves hidden in the hill country of Ephraim heard that the Philistines had fled, they also closely pursued them in the battle.
verses.textEn: When all the Israelites who had hidden in the hill country of Ephraim heard that the Philistines were on the run, they joined the battle in hot pursuit.

verses.textZh: 那一天，耶和华拯救了以色列人。战争伸展到伯．亚文。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天，耶和华拯救了以色列人。战争伸展到伯．亚文。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日，耶和华使以色列人得胜，一直战到伯‧亚文。
verses.textEnNiv: So on that day the Lord saved Israel, and the battle moved on beyond Beth Aven.
verses.textEnEsv: So the Lord saved Israel that day. And the battle passed beyond Beth-aven.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord saved Israel that day, and the battle shifted to Beth Aven.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord saved Israel that day, and the battle continued to rage even beyond Beth-aven.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord saved Israel that day, and the battle spread beyond Beth-aven.
verses.textEn: So on that day the Lord saved Israel, and the battle moved on beyond Beth Aven.

verses.textZh: 那一天，以色列人处境很窘迫，因为扫罗叫众人起誓说："不等到晚上，不等到我向敌人报了仇，就吃食物的，那人必受咒诅。"所以众民都没有尝过食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天，以色列人处境很窘迫，因为扫罗叫众人起誓说："不等到晚上，不等到我向敌人报了仇，就吃食物的，那人必受咒诅。"所以众民都没有尝过食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗叫百姓起誓说，凡不等到晚上向敌人报完了仇吃什么的，必受咒诅。因此这日百姓没有吃什么，就极其困惫。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Israelites were in distress that day, because Saul had bound the people under an oath, saying, "Cursed be anyone who eats food before evening comes, before I have avenged myself on my enemies!" So none of the troops tasted food.
verses.textEnEsv: And the men of Israel had been hard pressed that day, so Saul had laid an oath on the people, saying, "Cursed be the man who eats food until it is evening and I am avenged on my enemies." So none of the people had tasted food.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the men of Israel were distressed that day, for Saul had placed the people under oath, saying, "Cursed is the man who eats any food until evening, before I have taken vengeance on my enemies." So none of the people tasted food.
verses.textEnNlt: Now the men of Israel were pressed to exhaustion that day, because Saul had placed them under an oath, saying, "Let a curse fall on anyone who eats before evening—before I have full revenge on my enemies." So no one ate anything all day,
verses.textEnNasb: Now the men of Israel were hard-pressed on that day, for Saul had put the people under oath, saying, "Cursed be the man who eats food before evening, and before I have avenged myself on my enemies." So none of the people tasted food.
verses.textEn: Now the Israelites were in distress that day, because Saul had bound the people under an oath, saying, "Cursed be anyone who eats food before evening comes, before I have avenged myself on my enemies!" So none of the troops tasted food.

verses.textZh: 众人进了树林，林中地上有蜂蜜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人进了树林，林中地上有蜂蜜。
verses.textZhCuv: 众民进入树林，见有蜜在地上。
verses.textEnNiv: The entire army entered the woods, and there was honey on the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when all the people came to the forest, behold, there was honey on the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now all thepeople of the land came to a forest; and there was honey on the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: even though they had all found honeycomb on the ground in the forest.
verses.textEnNasb: All the people of the land entered the forest, and there was honey on the ground.
verses.textEn: The entire army entered the woods, and there was honey on the ground.

verses.textZh: 他们进了树林，看见有蜂蜜流出来，却没有人敢伸手取蜜入口，因为众人都害怕所起的誓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们进了树林，看见有蜂蜜流出来，却没有人敢伸手取蜜入口，因为众人都害怕所起的誓。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们进了树林，见有蜜流下来，却没有人敢用手取蜜入口，因为他们怕那誓言。
verses.textEnNiv: When they went into the woods, they saw the honey oozing out; yet no one put his hand to his mouth, because they feared the oath.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the people entered the forest, behold, the honey was dropping, but no one put his hand to his mouth, for the people feared the oath.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the people had come into the woods, there was the honey, dripping; but no one put his hand to his mouth, for the people feared the oath.
verses.textEnNlt: They didn’t dare touch the honey because they all feared the oath they had taken.
verses.textEnNasb: When the people entered the forest, behold, there was honey dripping; but no man put his hand to his mouth, because the people feared the oath.
verses.textEn: When they went into the woods, they saw the honey oozing out; yet no one put his hand to his mouth, because they feared the oath.

verses.textZh: 约拿单没有听见他父亲叫众民所起的誓，所以伸出手中的杖，用杖头蘸在蜂房里，转手送进口里，他的眼睛就明亮了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单没有听见他父亲叫众民所起的誓，所以伸出手中的杖，用杖头蘸在蜂房里，转手送进口里，他的眼睛就明亮了。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单没有听见他父亲叫百姓起誓，所以伸手中的杖，用杖头蘸在蜂房里，转手送入口内，眼睛就明亮了。
verses.textEnNiv: But Jonathan had not heard that his father had bound the people with the oath, so he reached out the end of the staff that was in his hand and dipped it into the honeycomb. He raised his hand to his mouth, and his eyes brightened.
verses.textEnEsv: But Jonathan had not heard his father charge the people with the oath, so he put out the tip of the staff that was in his hand and dipped it in the honeycomb and put his hand to his mouth, and his eyes became bright.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jonathan had not heard his father charge the people with the oath; therefore he stretched out the end of the rod that was in his hand and dipped it in a honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his countenance brightened.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jonathan had not heard his father’s command, and he dipped the end of his stick into a piece of honeycomb and ate the honey. After he had eaten it, he felt refreshed.
verses.textEnNasb: However, Jonathan had not heard it when his father put the people under oath; so he put out the end of the staff that was in his hand and dipped it in the honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth, and his eyes brightened.
verses.textEn: But Jonathan had not heard that his father had bound the people with the oath, so he reached out the end of the staff that was in his hand and dipped it into the honeycomb. He raised his hand to his mouth, and his eyes brightened.

verses.textZh: 众民中有一个人说："你父亲曾经叫众人严严地起誓说：‘今天吃食物的，那人必受咒诅。’所以众人都疲乏了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众民中有一个人说："你父亲曾经叫众人严严地起誓说：‘今天吃食物的，那人必受咒诅。’所以众人都疲乏了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓中有一人对他说：「你父亲曾叫百姓严严地起誓说，今日吃什么的，必受咒诅；因此百姓就疲乏了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then one of the soldiers told him, "Your father bound the army under a strict oath, saying, ‘Cursed be anyone who eats food today!’ That is why the men are faint."
verses.textEnEsv: Then one of the people said, "Your father strictly charged the people with an oath, saying, ‘Cursed be the man who eats food this day.’" And the people were faint.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then one of the people said, "Your father strictly charged the people with an oath, saying, ‘Cursed is the man who eats food this day.’ " And the people were faint.
verses.textEnNlt: But one of the men saw him and said, "Your father made the army take a strict oath that anyone who eats food today will be cursed. That is why everyone is weary and faint."
verses.textEnNasb: Then one of the people responded and said, "Your father strictly put the people under oath, saying, ‘Cursed be the man who eats food today.’ " And the people were weary.
verses.textEn: Then one of the soldiers told him, "Your father bound the army under a strict oath, saying, ‘Cursed be anyone who eats food today!’ That is why the men are faint."

verses.textZh: 约拿单说："我父亲连累了这地的人。你们看！我尝了这一点蜂蜜以后，我的眼睛就明亮了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单说："我父亲连累了这地的人。你们看！我尝了这一点蜂蜜以后，我的眼睛就明亮了。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单说：「我父亲连累你们了。你看，我尝了这一点蜜，眼睛就明亮了。
verses.textEnNiv: Jonathan said, "My father has made trouble for the country. See how my eyes brightened when I tasted a little of this honey.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jonathan said, "My father has troubled the land. See how my eyes have become bright because I tasted a little of this honey.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jonathan said, "My father has troubled the land. Look now, how my countenance has brightened because I tasted a little of this honey.
verses.textEnNlt: "My father has made trouble for us all!" Jonathan exclaimed. "A command like that only hurts us. See how refreshed I am now that I have eaten this little bit of honey.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jonathan said, "My father has troubled the land. See now that my eyes have brightened because I tasted a little of this honey.
verses.textEn: Jonathan said, "My father has made trouble for the country. See how my eyes brightened when I tasted a little of this honey.

verses.textZh: 今天众民若是随意吃了从他们的仇敌夺得的东西，不是更好吗？如今被击杀的非利士人，不是更多吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 今天众民若是随意吃了从他们的仇敌夺得的东西，不是更好吗？如今被击杀的非利士人，不是更多吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 今日百姓若任意吃了从仇敌所夺的物，击杀的非利士人岂不更多吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: How much better it would have been if the men had eaten today some of the plunder they took from their enemies. Would not the slaughter of the Philistines have been even greater?"
verses.textEnEsv: How much better if the people had eaten freely today of the spoil of their enemies that they found. For now the defeat among the Philistines has not been great."
verses.textEnNkjv: How much better if the people had eaten freely today of the spoil of their enemies which they found! For now would there not have been a much greater slaughter among the Philistines?"
verses.textEnNlt: If the men had been allowed to eat freely from the food they found among our enemies, think how many more Philistines we could have killed!"
verses.textEnNasb: How much more, if only the people had freely eaten today of the spoils of their enemies which they found! For now the defeat among the Philistines has not been great."
verses.textEn: How much better it would have been if the men had eaten today some of the plunder they took from their enemies. Would not the slaughter of the Philistines have been even greater?"

verses.textZh: 那一天，他们击杀非利士人，从密抹直到亚雅仑；众人都非常疲乏了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天，他们击杀非利士人，从密抹直到亚雅仑；众人都非常疲乏了，
verses.textZhCuv: 这日，以色列人击杀非利士人，从密抹直到亚雅仑。百姓甚是疲乏，
verses.textEnNiv: That day, after the Israelites had struck down the Philistines from Mikmash to Aijalon, they were exhausted.
verses.textEnEsv: They struck down the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon. And the people were very faint.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now they had driven back the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon. So the people were very faint.
verses.textEnNlt: They chased and killed the Philistines all day from Micmash to Aijalon, growing more and more faint.
verses.textEnNasb: They attacked the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon. But the people were very tired.
verses.textEn: That day, after the Israelites had struck down the Philistines from Mikmash to Aijalon, they were exhausted.

verses.textZh: 就急忙抢夺战利品；他们捉住了羊、牛或牛犊，就地宰杀，带着血一起吃了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就急忙抢夺战利品；他们捉住了羊、牛或牛犊，就地宰杀，带着血一起吃了。
verses.textZhCuv: 就急忙将所夺的牛羊和牛犊宰于地上，肉还带血就吃了。
verses.textEnNiv: They pounced on the plunder and, taking sheep, cattle and calves, they butchered them on the ground and ate them, together with the blood.
verses.textEnEsv: The people pounced on the spoil and took sheep and oxen and calves and slaughtered them on the ground. And the people ate them with the blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the people rushed on the spoil, and took sheep, oxen, and calves, and slaughtered them on the ground; and the people ate them with the blood.
verses.textEnNlt: That evening they rushed for the battle plunder and butchered the sheep, goats, cattle, and calves, but they ate them without draining the blood.
verses.textEnNasb: So the people loudly rushed upon the spoils, and took sheep, oxen, and calves, and slaughtered them on the ground; and the people ate them with the blood.
verses.textEn: They pounced on the plunder and, taking sheep, cattle and calves, they butchered them on the ground and ate them, together with the blood.

verses.textZh: 有人告诉扫罗说："众民吃了带着血的肉，得罪耶和华了。"他说："你们作了不忠的事了，立刻把一块大石头滚到我这里来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人告诉扫罗说："众民吃了带着血的肉，得罪耶和华了。"他说："你们作了不忠的事了，立刻把一块大石头滚到我这里来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉扫罗说：「百姓吃带血的肉，得罪耶和华了。」扫罗说：「你们有罪了，今日要将大石头滚到我这里来。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then someone said to Saul, "Look, the men are sinning against the Lord by eating meat that has blood in it." "You have broken faith," he said. "Roll a large stone over here at once."
verses.textEnEsv: Then they told Saul, "Behold, the people are sinning against the Lord by eating with the blood." And he said, "You have dealt treacherously; roll a great stone to me here."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they told Saul, saying, "Look, the people are sinning against the Lord by eating with the blood!" So he said, "You have dealt treacherously; roll a large stone to me this day."
verses.textEnNlt: Someone reported to Saul, "Look, the men are sinning against the Lord by eating meat that still has blood in it." "That is very wrong," Saul said. "Find a large stone and roll it over here.
verses.textEnNasb: Then observers informed Saul, saying, "Look, the people are sinning against the Lord by eating meat with the blood." And he said, "You have acted treacherously; roll a large rock to me today."
verses.textEn: Then someone said to Saul, "Look, the men are sinning against the Lord by eating meat that has blood in it." "You have broken faith," he said. "Roll a large stone over here at once."

verses.textZh: 扫罗又说："你们分散到众人中去，对他们说：‘你们各人要把自己的牛羊带到我面前来，在这里宰了吃；不可吃带着血的肉，得罪耶和华。’"于是当天晚上，众人都各把自己的牛羊带到那里宰了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗又说："你们分散到众人中去，对他们说：‘你们各人要把自己的牛羊带到我面前来，在这里宰了吃；不可吃带着血的肉，得罪耶和华。’"于是当天晚上，众人都各把自己的牛羊带到那里宰了。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗又说：「你们散在百姓中，对他们说，你们各人将牛羊牵到我这里来宰了吃，不可吃带血的肉得罪耶和华。」这夜，百姓就把牛羊牵到那里宰了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said, "Go out among the men and tell them, ‘Each of you bring me your cattle and sheep, and slaughter them here and eat them. Do not sin against the Lord by eating meat with blood still in it.’ " So everyone brought his ox that night and slaughtered it there.
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul said, "Disperse yourselves among the people and say to them, ‘Let every man bring his ox or his sheep and slaughter them here and eat, and do not sin against the Lord by eating with the blood.’" So every one of the people brought his ox with him that night and they slaughtered them there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul said, "Disperse yourselves among the people, and say to them, ‘Bring me here every man’s ox and every man’s sheep, slaughter them here, and eat; and do not sin against the Lord by eating with the blood.’ " So every one of the people brought his ox with him that night, and slaughtered it there.
verses.textEnNlt: Then go out among the troops and tell them, ‘Bring the cattle, sheep, and goats here to me. Kill them here, and drain the blood before you eat them. Do not sin against the Lord by eating meat with the blood still in it.’" So that night all the troops brought their animals and slaughtered them there.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul said, "Disperse yourselves among the people and say to them, ‘Each one of you bring me his ox or his sheep, and slaughter it here and eat; and do not sin against the Lord by eating it with the blood.’ " So all the people brought them that night, each one his ox with him, and they slaughtered them there.
verses.textEn: Then he said, "Go out among the men and tell them, ‘Each of you bring me your cattle and sheep, and slaughter them here and eat them. Do not sin against the Lord by eating meat with blood still in it.’ " So everyone brought his ox that night and slaughtered it there.

verses.textZh: 扫罗为耶和华筑了一座祭坛，这是他初次为耶和华筑的祭坛。
