verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗为耶和华筑了一座祭坛，这是他初次为耶和华筑的祭坛。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗为耶和华筑了一座坛，这是他初次为耶和华筑的坛。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Saul built an altar to the Lord ; it was the first time he had done this.
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul built an altar to the Lord ; it was the first altar that he built to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul built an altar to the Lord. This was the first altar that he built to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Saul built an altar to the Lord ; it was the first of the altars he built to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And Saul built an altar to the Lord; it was the first altar that he built to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Then Saul built an altar to the Lord ; it was the first time he had done this.

verses.textZh: 扫罗说："我们趁着晚上下去追赶非利士人，抢掠他们，直到天亮，不让他们留下一人。"他们说："你看怎么好，就怎么行吧！"但祭司说："我们先在这里亲近神！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗说："我们趁着晚上下去追赶非利士人，抢掠他们，直到天亮，不让他们留下一人。"他们说："你看怎么好，就怎么行吧！"但祭司说："我们先在这里亲近神！"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗说：「我们不如夜里下去追赶非利士人，抢掠他们，直到天亮，不留他们一人。」众民说：「你看怎样好就去行吧！」祭司说：「我们先当亲近神。」
verses.textEnNiv: Saul said, "Let us go down and pursue the Philistines by night and plunder them till dawn, and let us not leave one of them alive." "Do whatever seems best to you," they replied. But the priest said, "Let us inquire of God here."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Saul said, "Let us go down after the Philistines by night and plunder them until the morning light; let us not leave a man of them." And they said, "Do whatever seems good to you." But the priest said, "Let us draw near to God here."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Saul said, "Let us go down after the Philistines by night, and plunder them until the morning light; and let us not leave a man of them." And they said, "Do whatever seems good to you." Then the priest said, "Let us draw near to God here."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Saul said, "Let’s chase the Philistines all night and plunder them until sunrise. Let’s destroy every last one of them." His men replied, "We’ll do whatever you think is best." But the priest said, "Let’s ask God first."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul said, "Let’s go down after the Philistines by night and take plunder among them until the morning light, and let’s not leave a man among them alive." And they said, "Do whatever seems good to you." So the priest said, "Let’s approach God here."
verses.textEn: Saul said, "Let us go down and pursue the Philistines by night and plunder them till dawn, and let us not leave one of them alive." "Do whatever seems best to you," they replied. But the priest said, "Let us inquire of God here."

verses.textZh: 扫罗求问神："我可以下去追赶非利士人吗？你把他们交在以色列人的手里吗？"那天神没有回答他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗求问神："我可以下去追赶非利士人吗？你把他们交在以色列人的手里吗？"那天神没有回答他。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗求问神说：「我下去追赶非利士人可以不可以？你将他们交在以色列人手里不交？」这日神没有回答他。
verses.textEnNiv: So Saul asked God, "Shall I go down and pursue the Philistines? Will you give them into Israel’s hand?" But God did not answer him that day.
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul inquired of God, "Shall I go down after the Philistines? Will you give them into the hand of Israel?" But he did not answer him that day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Saul asked counsel of God, "Shall I go down after the Philistines? Will You deliver them into the hand of Israel?" But He did not answer him that day.
verses.textEnNlt: So Saul asked God, "Should we go after the Philistines? Will you help us defeat them?" But God made no reply that day.
verses.textEnNasb: So Saul inquired of God: "Shall I go down after the Philistines? Will You hand them over to Israel?" But He did not answer him on that day.
verses.textEn: So Saul asked God, "Shall I go down and pursue the Philistines? Will you give them into Israel’s hand?" But God did not answer him that day.

verses.textZh: 扫罗说："民间的众领袖啊，你们都要走近这里来；你们要查看今天我们犯了甚么罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗说："民间的众领袖啊，你们都要走近这里来；你们要查看今天我们犯了甚么罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗说：「你们百姓中的长老都上这里来，查明今日是谁犯了罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Saul therefore said, "Come here, all you who are leaders of the army, and let us find out what sin has been committed today.
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul said, "Come here, all you leaders of the people, and know and see how this sin has arisen today.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Saul said, "Come over here, all you chiefs of the people, and know and see what this sin was today.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Saul said to the leaders, "Something’s wrong! I want all my army commanders to come here. We must find out what sin was committed today.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul said, " Come here, all you leaders of the people, and investigate and see how this sin has happened today.
verses.textEn: Saul therefore said, "Come here, all you who are leaders of the army, and let us find out what sin has been committed today.

verses.textZh: 我指着拯救以色列、永活的耶和华起誓，即使是我的儿子约拿单犯了罪，他也一定要死。"众人中没有一人回答他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我指着拯救以色列、永活的耶和华起誓，即使是我的儿子约拿单犯了罪，他也一定要死。"众人中没有一人回答他。
verses.textZhCuv: 我指着救以色列－永生的耶和华起誓，就是我儿子约拿单犯了罪，他也必死。」但百姓中无一人回答他。
verses.textEnNiv: As surely as the Lord who rescues Israel lives, even if the guilt lies with my son Jonathan, he must die." But not one of them said a word.
verses.textEnEsv: For as the Lord lives who saves Israel, though it be in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die." But there was not a man among all the people who answered him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as the Lord lives, who saves Israel, though it be in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die." But not a man among all the people answered him.
verses.textEnNlt: I vow by the name of the Lord who rescued Israel that the sinner will surely die, even if it is my own son Jonathan!" But no one would tell him what the trouble was.
verses.textEnNasb: For as the Lord lives, who saves Israel, even if it is in my son Jonathan, he shall assuredly die!" But not one of all the people answered him.
verses.textEn: As surely as the Lord who rescues Israel lives, even if the guilt lies with my son Jonathan, he must die." But not one of them said a word.

verses.textZh: 于是扫罗对以色列众人说："你们站在这里，我和我的儿子约拿单站在那边。"众民回答扫罗："你看怎么好，就怎么行吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是扫罗对以色列众人说："你们站在这里，我和我的儿子约拿单站在那边。"众民回答扫罗："你看怎么好，就怎么行吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗就对以色列众人说：「你们站在一边，我与我儿子约拿单也站在一边。」百姓对扫罗说：「你看怎样好就去行吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: Saul then said to all the Israelites, "You stand over there; I and Jonathan my son will stand over here." "Do what seems best to you," they replied.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to all Israel, "You shall be on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side." And the people said to Saul, "Do what seems good to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to all Israel, "You be on one side, and my son Jonathan and I will be on the other side." And the people said to Saul, "Do what seems good to you."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Saul said, "Jonathan and I will stand over here, and all of you stand over there." And the people responded to Saul, "Whatever you think is best."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to all Israel, "You shall be on one side, and I and my son Jonathan will be on the other side." And the people said to Saul, "Do what seems good to you."
verses.textEn: Saul then said to all the Israelites, "You stand over there; I and Jonathan my son will stand over here." "Do what seems best to you," they replied.

verses.textZh: 扫罗祷告耶和华以色列的神说："求你指示实情！"于是抽签，抽中了约拿单和扫罗；众民都没事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗祷告耶和华以色列的神说："求你指示实情！"于是抽签，抽中了约拿单和扫罗；众民都没事。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗祷告耶和华－以色列的神说：「求你指示实情。」于是掣签掣出扫罗和约拿单来；百姓尽都无事。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Saul prayed to the Lord , the God of Israel, "Why have you not answered your servant today? If the fault is in me or my son Jonathan, respond with Urim, but if the men of Israel are at fault, respond with Thummim." Jonathan and Saul were taken by lot, and the men were cleared.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore Saul said, "O Lord God of Israel, why have you not answered your servant this day? If this guilt is in me or in Jonathan my son, O Lord , God of Israel, give Urim. But if this guilt is in your people Israel, give Thummim." And Jonathan and Saul were taken, but the people escaped.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore Saul said to the Lord God of Israel, "Give a perfect lot." So Saul and Jonathan were taken, but the people escaped.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Saul prayed, "O Lord , God of Israel, please show us who is guilty and who is innocent. " Then they cast sacred lots, and Jonathan and Saul were chosen as the guilty ones, and the people were declared innocent.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, Saul said to the Lord, the God of Israel, "Give a perfect lot." And Jonathan and Saul were selected by lot, but the people were exonerated.
verses.textEn: Then Saul prayed to the Lord , the God of Israel, "Why have you not answered your servant today? If the fault is in me or my son Jonathan, respond with Urim, but if the men of Israel are at fault, respond with Thummim." Jonathan and Saul were taken by lot, and the men were cleared.

verses.textZh: 扫罗说："你们再抽签，看是我，或是我的儿子约拿单。"结果抽中约拿单。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗说："你们再抽签，看是我，或是我的儿子约拿单。"结果抽中约拿单。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗说：「你们再掣签，看是我，是我儿子约拿单」，就掣出约拿单来。
verses.textEnNiv: Saul said, "Cast the lot between me and Jonathan my son." And Jonathan was taken.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Saul said, "Cast the lot between me and my son Jonathan." And Jonathan was taken.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Saul said, "Cast lots between my son Jonathan and me." So Jonathan was taken.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Saul said, "Now cast lots again and choose between me and Jonathan." And Jonathan was shown to be the guilty one.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul said, "Cast lots between me and my son Jonathan." And Jonathan was selected by lot.
verses.textEn: Saul said, "Cast the lot between me and Jonathan my son." And Jonathan was taken.

verses.textZh: 扫罗对约拿单说："告诉我，你作了甚么事？"约拿单告诉他："我用我手中的杖头尝了一点蜂蜜。我在这里，我愿意死！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗对约拿单说："告诉我，你作了甚么事？"约拿单告诉他："我用我手中的杖头尝了一点蜂蜜。我在这里，我愿意死！"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗对约拿单说：「你告诉我，你做了什么事？」约拿单说：「我实在以手里的杖，用杖头蘸了一点蜜尝了一尝。这样我就死吗 ？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Saul said to Jonathan, "Tell me what you have done." So Jonathan told him, "I tasted a little honey with the end of my staff. And now I must die!"
verses.textEnEsv: Then Saul said to Jonathan, "Tell me what you have done." And Jonathan told him, "I tasted a little honey with the tip of the staff that was in my hand. Here I am; I will die."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul said to Jonathan, "Tell me what you have done." And Jonathan told him, and said, "I only tasted a little honey with the end of the rod that was in my hand. So now I must die!"
verses.textEnNlt: "Tell me what you have done," Saul demanded of Jonathan. "I tasted a little honey," Jonathan admitted. "It was only a little bit on the end of my stick. Does that deserve death?"
verses.textEnNasb: So Saul said to Jonathan, "Tell me what you have done." And Jonathan told him, and said, "I did indeed taste a little honey with the end of the staff that was in my hand. Here I am, I must die!"
verses.textEn: Then Saul said to Jonathan, "Tell me what you have done." So Jonathan told him, "I tasted a little honey with the end of my staff. And now I must die!"

verses.textZh: 扫罗说："约拿单啊！你必定要死，否则，愿神加倍惩罚我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗说："约拿单啊！你必定要死，否则，愿神加倍惩罚我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗说：「约拿单哪，你定要死！若不然，愿神重重地降罚与我。」
verses.textEnNiv: Saul said, "May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if you do not die, Jonathan."
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul said, "God do so to me and more also; you shall surely die, Jonathan."
verses.textEnNkjv: Saul answered, "God do so and more also; for you shall surely die, Jonathan."
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes, Jonathan," Saul said, "you must die! May God strike me and even kill me if you do not die for this."
verses.textEnNasb: And Saul said, "May God do the same to me and more also, for you shall certainly die, Jonathan!"
verses.textEn: Saul said, "May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if you do not die, Jonathan."

verses.textZh: 众民对扫罗说："约拿单在以色列人中行了这样大的拯救，难道一定要他死吗？绝对不可以！我们指着永活的耶和华起誓，连他一根头发也不可落在地上，因为他今天是与神一同作工。"这样，众民救了约拿单，使他免了一死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众民对扫罗说："约拿单在以色列人中行了这样大的拯救，难道一定要他死吗？绝对不可以！我们指着永活的耶和华起誓，连他一根头发也不可落在地上，因为他今天是与神一同作工。"这样，众民救了约拿单，使他免了一死。
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓对扫罗说：「约拿单在以色列人中这样大行拯救，岂可使他死呢？断乎不可！我们指着永生的耶和华起誓，连他的一根头发也不可落地，因为他今日与神一同做事。」于是百姓救约拿单免了死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: But the men said to Saul, "Should Jonathan die—he who has brought about this great deliverance in Israel? Never! As surely as the Lord lives, not a hair of his head will fall to the ground, for he did this today with God’s help." So the men rescued Jonathan, and he was not put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the people said to Saul, "Shall Jonathan die, who has worked this great salvation in Israel? Far from it! As the Lord lives, there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground, for he has worked with God this day." So the people ransomed Jonathan, so that he did not die.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the people said to Saul, "Shall Jonathan die, who has accomplished this great deliverance in Israel? Certainly not! As the Lord lives, not one hair of his head shall fall to the ground, for he has worked with God this day." So the people rescued Jonathan, and he did not die.
verses.textEnNlt: But the people broke in and said to Saul, "Jonathan has won this great victory for Israel. Should he die? Far from it! As surely as the Lord lives, not one hair on his head will be touched, for God helped him do a great deed today." So the people rescued Jonathan, and he was not put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: But the people said to Saul, "Must Jonathan die, he who has brought about this great victory in Israel? Far from it! As the Lord lives, not even a hair of his head shall fall to the ground, because he has worked with God this day." So the people rescued Jonathan and he did not die.
verses.textEn: But the men said to Saul, "Should Jonathan die—he who has brought about this great deliverance in Israel? Never! As surely as the Lord lives, not a hair of his head will fall to the ground, for he did this today with God’s help." So the men rescued Jonathan, and he was not put to death.

verses.textZh: 扫罗上去，不再追赶非利士人；非利士人也回到自己的地方去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗上去，不再追赶非利士人；非利士人也回到自己的地方去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗回去，不追赶非利士人；非利士人也回本地去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Saul stopped pursuing the Philistines, and they withdrew to their own land.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Saul went up from pursuing the Philistines, and the Philistines went to their own place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul returned from pursuing the Philistines, and the Philistines went to their own place.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Saul called back the army from chasing the Philistines, and the Philistines returned home.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul went up from pursuing the Philistines, and the Philistines went to their own place.
verses.textEn: Then Saul stopped pursuing the Philistines, and they withdrew to their own land.

verses.textZh: 扫罗取得了以色列的王国以后，常常攻打四围的一切仇敌，就是摩押人、亚扪人、以东人、琐巴众王和非利士人，他无论往哪里去，都得到胜利 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗取得了以色列的王国以后，常常攻打四围的一切仇敌，就是摩押人、亚扪人、以东人、琐巴众王和非利士人，他无论往哪里去，都得到胜利 。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗执掌以色列的国权，常常攻击他四围的一切仇敌，就是摩押人、亚扪人、以东人，和琐巴诸王，并非利士人。他无论往何处去，都打败仇敌。
verses.textEnNiv: After Saul had assumed rule over Israel, he fought against their enemies on every side: Moab, the Ammonites, Edom, the kings of Zobah, and the Philistines. Wherever he turned, he inflicted punishment on them.
verses.textEnEsv: When Saul had taken the kingship over Israel, he fought against all his enemies on every side, against Moab, against the Ammonites, against Edom, against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines. Wherever he turned he routed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Saul established his sovereignty over Israel, and fought against all his enemies on every side, against Moab, against the people of Ammon, against Edom, against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines. Wherever he turned, he harassed them.
verses.textEnNlt: Now when Saul had secured his grasp on Israel’s throne, he fought against his enemies in every direction—against Moab, Ammon, Edom, the kings of Zobah, and the Philistines. And wherever he turned, he was victorious.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Saul had taken control of the kingdom over Israel, he fought against all his enemies on every side, against Moab, the sons of Ammon, Edom, the kings of Zobah, and the Philistines; and wherever he turned, he inflicted punishment.
verses.textEn: After Saul had assumed rule over Israel, he fought against their enemies on every side: Moab, the Ammonites, Edom, the kings of Zobah, and the Philistines. Wherever he turned, he inflicted punishment on them.

verses.textZh: 扫罗行事勇敢，击败了亚玛力人，把以色列人从抢掠他们的人手中救了出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗行事勇敢，击败了亚玛力人，把以色列人从抢掠他们的人手中救了出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗奋勇攻击亚玛力人，救了以色列人脱离抢掠他们之人的手。
verses.textEnNiv: He fought valiantly and defeated the Amalekites, delivering Israel from the hands of those who had plundered them.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did valiantly and struck the Amalekites and delivered Israel out of the hands of those who plundered them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he gathered an army and attacked the Amalekites, and delivered Israel from the hands of those who plundered them.
verses.textEnNlt: He performed great deeds and conquered the Amalekites, saving Israel from all those who had plundered them.
verses.textEnNasb: And he acted valiantly and defeated the Amalekites, and saved Israel from the hands of those who plundered them.
verses.textEn: He fought valiantly and defeated the Amalekites, delivering Israel from the hands of those who had plundered them.

verses.textZh: 扫罗的儿子是约拿单、亦施韦和麦基舒亚。他的两个女儿，长女名叫米拉，次女名叫米甲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗的儿子是约拿单、亦施韦和麦基舒亚。他的两个女儿，长女名叫米拉，次女名叫米甲。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗的儿子是约拿单、亦施韦、麦基舒亚。他的两个女儿：长女名米拉，次女名米甲。
verses.textEnNiv: Saul’s sons were Jonathan, Ishvi and Malki-Shua. The name of his older daughter was Merab, and that of the younger was Michal.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchi-shua. And the names of his two daughters were these: the name of the firstborn was Merab, and the name of the younger Michal.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Saul were Jonathan, Jishui, and Malchishua. And the names of his two daughters werethese: the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal.
verses.textEnNlt: Saul’s sons included Jonathan, Ishbosheth, and Malkishua. He also had two daughters: Merab, who was older, and Michal.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchi-shua; and the names of his two daughters were these: the name of the firstborn was Merab, and the name of the younger, Michal.
verses.textEn: Saul’s sons were Jonathan, Ishvi and Malki-Shua. The name of his older daughter was Merab, and that of the younger was Michal.

verses.textZh: 扫罗的妻子名叫亚希暖，是亚希玛斯的女儿。扫罗军队的元帅名叫押尼珥，是尼珥的儿子，尼珥是扫罗的叔叔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗的妻子名叫亚希暖，是亚希玛斯的女儿。扫罗军队的元帅名叫押尼珥，是尼珥的儿子，尼珥是扫罗的叔叔。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗的妻名叫亚希暖，是亚希玛斯的女儿。扫罗的元帅名叫押尼珥，是尼珥的儿子；尼珥是扫罗的叔叔。
verses.textEnNiv: His wife’s name was Ahinoam daughter of Ahimaaz. The name of the commander of Saul’s army was Abner son of Ner, and Ner was Saul’s uncle.
verses.textEnEsv: And the name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam the daughter of Ahimaaz. And the name of the commander of his army was Abner the son of Ner, Saul’s uncle.
verses.textEnNkjv: The name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam the daughter of Ahimaaz. And the name of the commander of his army was Abner the son of Ner, Saul’s uncle.
verses.textEnNlt: Saul’s wife was Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz. The commander of Saul’s army was Abner, the son of Saul’s uncle Ner.
verses.textEnNasb: And the name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam the daughter of Ahimaaz. And the name of the commander of his army was Abner the son of Ner, Saul’s uncle.
verses.textEn: His wife’s name was Ahinoam daughter of Ahimaaz. The name of the commander of Saul’s army was Abner son of Ner, and Ner was Saul’s uncle.

verses.textZh: 扫罗的父亲基士和押尼珥的父亲尼珥都是亚别的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗的父亲基士和押尼珥的父亲尼珥都是亚别的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗的父亲基士，押尼珥的父亲尼珥，都是亚别的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Saul’s father Kish and Abner’s father Ner were sons of Abiel.
verses.textEnEsv: Kish was the father of Saul, and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Kish was the father of Saul, and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.
verses.textEnNlt: Saul’s father, Kish, and Abner’s father, Ner, were both sons of Abiel.
verses.textEnNasb: Kish was the father of Saul, and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.
verses.textEn: Saul’s father Kish and Abner’s father Ner were sons of Abiel.

verses.textZh: 扫罗的一生常常与非利士人有猛烈的争战。每逢扫罗看见任何勇士或有能力的人，就都招募归他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗的一生常常与非利士人有猛烈的争战。每逢扫罗看见任何勇士或有能力的人，就都招募归他。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗平生常与非利士人大大争战。扫罗遇见有能力的人或勇士，都招募了来跟随他。
verses.textEnNiv: All the days of Saul there was bitter war with the Philistines, and whenever Saul saw a mighty or brave man, he took him into his service.
verses.textEnEsv: There was hard fighting against the Philistines all the days of Saul. And when Saul saw any strong man, or any valiant man, he attached him to himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there was fierce war with the Philistines all the days of Saul. And when Saul saw any strong man or any valiant man, he took him for himself.
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelites fought constantly with the Philistines throughout Saul’s lifetime. So whenever Saul observed a young man who was brave and strong, he drafted him into his army.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the war against the Philistines was severe all the days of Saul; and when Saul saw any warrior or any valiant man, he attached him to his staff.
verses.textEn: All the days of Saul there was bitter war with the Philistines, and whenever Saul saw a mighty or brave man, he took him into his service.

verses.textZh: 撒母耳对扫罗说："耶和华差遣我膏立你作他子民以色列的王，所以现在你要听耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳对扫罗说："耶和华差遣我膏立你作他子民以色列的王，所以现在你要听耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳对扫罗说：「耶和华差遣我膏你为王，治理他的百姓以色列；所以你当听从耶和华的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Samuel said to Saul, "I am the one the Lord sent to anoint you king over his people Israel; so listen now to the message from the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And Samuel said to Saul, "The Lord sent me to anoint you king over his people Israel; now therefore listen to the words of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Samuel also said to Saul, "The Lord sent me to anoint you king over His people, over Israel. Now therefore, heed the voice of the words of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: One day Samuel said to Saul, "It was the Lord who told me to anoint you as king of his people, Israel. Now listen to this message from the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: Then Samuel said to Saul, "The Lord sent me to anoint you as king over His people, over Israel; now therefore, listen to the words of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Samuel said to Saul, "I am the one the Lord sent to anoint you king over his people Israel; so listen now to the message from the Lord .

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华这样说：‘以色列人从埃及上来的时候，亚玛力人对他们所行的，在路上攻击他们的事，我必要惩罚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华这样说：‘以色列人从埃及上来的时候，亚玛力人对他们所行的，在路上攻击他们的事，我必要惩罚。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华如此说：『以色列人出埃及的时候，在路上亚玛力人怎样待他们，怎样抵挡他们，我都没忘。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘I will punish the Amalekites for what they did to Israel when they waylaid them as they came up from Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord of hosts, ‘I have noted what Amalek did to Israel in opposing them on the way when they came up out of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord of hosts: ‘I will punish Amalek for what he did to Israel, how he ambushed him on the way when he came up from Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies has declared: I have decided to settle accounts with the nation of Amalek for opposing Israel when they came from Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord of armies says: ‘I will punish Amalek for what he did to Israel, in that he obstructed him on the way while he was coming up from Egypt.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘I will punish the Amalekites for what they did to Israel when they waylaid them as they came up from Egypt.

verses.textZh: 现在你要去攻打亚玛力人，彻底毁灭他们所有的一切，不可怜惜他们。无论男女、孩童，或吃奶的婴儿，牛羊、骆驼、驴子，都要杀死。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你要去攻打亚玛力人，彻底毁灭他们所有的一切，不可怜惜他们。无论男女、孩童，或吃奶的婴儿，牛羊、骆驼、驴子，都要杀死。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你要去击打亚玛力人，灭尽他们所有的，不可怜惜他们，将男女、孩童、吃奶的，并牛、羊、骆驼，和驴尽行杀死。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Now go, attack the Amalekites and totally destroy all that belongs to them. Do not spare them; put to death men and women, children and infants, cattle and sheep, camels and donkeys.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Now go and strike Amalek and devote to destruction all that they have. Do not spare them, but kill both man and woman, child and infant, ox and sheep, camel and donkey.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now go and attack Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and do not spare them. But kill both man and woman, infant and nursing child, ox and sheep, camel and donkey.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Now go and completely destroy the entire Amalekite nation—men, women, children, babies, cattle, sheep, goats, camels, and donkeys."
verses.textEnNasb: Now go and strike Amalek and completely destroy everything that he has, and do not spare him; but put to death both man and woman, child and infant, ox and sheep, camel and donkey.’ "
verses.textEn: Now go, attack the Amalekites and totally destroy all that belongs to them. Do not spare them; put to death men and women, children and infants, cattle and sheep, camels and donkeys.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是扫罗招聚众人，在提拉因数点他们，共有步兵二十万，另有犹大人一万。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是扫罗招聚众人，在提拉因数点他们，共有步兵二十万，另有犹大人一万。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是扫罗招聚百姓在提拉因，数点他们，共有步兵二十万，另有犹大人一万。
verses.textEnNiv: So Saul summoned the men and mustered them at Telaim—two hundred thousand foot soldiers and ten thousand from Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: So Saul summoned the people and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand men on foot, and ten thousand men of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Saul gathered the people together and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand foot soldiers and ten thousand men of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: So Saul mobilized his army at Telaim. There were 200,000 soldiers from Israel and 10,000 men from Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul summoned the people and counted them in Telaim: two hundred thousand foot soldiers and ten thousand men of Judah.
verses.textEn: So Saul summoned the men and mustered them at Telaim—two hundred thousand foot soldiers and ten thousand from Judah.

verses.textZh: 扫罗到了亚玛力人的城市，就在山谷中设下伏兵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗到了亚玛力人的城市，就在山谷中设下伏兵。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗到了亚玛力的京城，在谷中设下埋伏。
verses.textEnNiv: Saul went to the city of Amalek and set an ambush in the ravine.
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul came to the city of Amalek and lay in wait in the valley.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Saul came to a city of Amalek, and lay in wait in the valley.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Saul and his army went to a town of the Amalekites and lay in wait in the valley.
verses.textEnNasb: And Saul came to the city of Amalek and set an ambush in the wadi.
verses.textEn: Saul went to the city of Amalek and set an ambush in the ravine.

verses.textZh: 扫罗又对基尼人说："你们走吧！离开亚玛力人下去吧！免得我把你们与他们一同消灭。因为以色列众人从埃及上来的时候，你们曾经以慈爱待他们。"于是基尼人离开亚玛力人去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗又对基尼人说："你们走吧！离开亚玛力人下去吧！免得我把你们与他们一同消灭。因为以色列众人从埃及上来的时候，你们曾经以慈爱待他们。"于是基尼人离开亚玛力人去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗对基尼人说：「你们离开亚玛力人下去吧，恐怕我将你们和亚玛力人一同杀灭；因为以色列人出埃及的时候，你们曾恩待他们。」于是基尼人离开亚玛力人去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to the Kenites, "Go away, leave the Amalekites so that I do not destroy you along with them; for you showed kindness to all the Israelites when they came up out of Egypt." So the Kenites moved away from the Amalekites.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Saul said to the Kenites, "Go, depart; go down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them. For you showed kindness to all the people of Israel when they came up out of Egypt." So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul said to the Kenites, "Go, depart, get down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them. For you showed kindness to all the children of Israel when they came up out of Egypt." So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.
verses.textEnNlt: Saul sent this warning to the Kenites: "Move away from where the Amalekites live, or you will die with them. For you showed kindness to all the people of Israel when they came up from Egypt." So the Kenites packed up and left.
verses.textEnNasb: But Saul said to the Kenites, "Go, get away, go down from among the Amalekites, so that I do not destroy you along with them; for you showed kindness to all the sons of Israel when they went up from Egypt." So the Kenites got away from among the Amalekites.
verses.textEn: Then he said to the Kenites, "Go away, leave the Amalekites so that I do not destroy you along with them; for you showed kindness to all the Israelites when they came up out of Egypt." So the Kenites moved away from the Amalekites.

verses.textZh: 扫罗击杀亚玛力人，从哈腓拉直到埃及东的书珥，
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗击杀亚玛力人，从哈腓拉直到埃及东的书珥，
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗击打亚玛力人，从哈腓拉直到埃及前的书珥，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Saul attacked the Amalekites all the way from Havilah to Shur, near the eastern border of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul defeated the Amalekites from Havilah as far as Shur, which is east of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Saul attacked the Amalekites, from Havilah all the way to Shur, which is east of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Saul slaughtered the Amalekites from Havilah all the way to Shur, east of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul defeated the Amalekites, from Havilah going toward Shur, which is east of Egypt.
verses.textEn: Then Saul attacked the Amalekites all the way from Havilah to Shur, near the eastern border of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 生擒了亚玛力人的王亚甲，用刀杀灭了所有人民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 生擒了亚玛力人的王亚甲，用刀杀灭了所有人民。
verses.textZhCuv: 生擒了亚玛力王亚甲，用刀杀尽亚玛力的众民。
verses.textEnNiv: He took Agag king of the Amalekites alive, and all his people he totally destroyed with the sword.
verses.textEnEsv: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive and devoted to destruction all the people with the edge of the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also took Agag king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: He captured Agag, the Amalekite king, but completely destroyed everyone else.
verses.textEnNasb: He captured Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and completely destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.
verses.textEn: He took Agag king of the Amalekites alive, and all his people he totally destroyed with the sword.

verses.textZh: 但扫罗和众人怜惜亚甲，也爱惜上好的牛羊、肥牛犊、羊羔和一切美好的东西。他们不愿彻底毁灭这些；凡是卑贱的、没有价值的，他们就彻底毁灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但扫罗和众人怜惜亚甲，也爱惜上好的牛羊、肥牛犊、羊羔和一切美好的东西。他们不愿彻底毁灭这些；凡是卑贱的、没有价值的，他们就彻底毁灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗和百姓却怜惜亚甲，也爱惜上好的牛、羊、牛犊、羊羔，并一切美物，不肯灭绝。凡下贱瘦弱的，尽都杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: But Saul and the army spared Agag and the best of the sheep and cattle, the fat calves and lambs—everything that was good. These they were unwilling to destroy completely, but everything that was despised and weak they totally destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: But Saul and the people spared Agag and the best of the sheep and of the oxen and of the fattened calves and the lambs, and all that was good, and would not utterly destroy them. All that was despised and worthless they devoted to destruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Saul and the people spared Agag and the best of the sheep, the oxen, the fatlings, the lambs, and all thatwas good, and were unwilling to utterly destroy them. But everything despised and worthless, that they utterly destroyed.
verses.textEnNlt: Saul and his men spared Agag’s life and kept the best of the sheep and goats, the cattle, the fat calves, and the lambs—everything, in fact, that appealed to them. They destroyed only what was worthless or of poor quality.
verses.textEnNasb: But Saul and the people spared Agag and the best of the sheep, the oxen, the more valuable animals, the lambs, and everything that was good, and were unwilling to destroy them completely; but everything despicable and weak, that they completely destroyed.
verses.textEn: But Saul and the army spared Agag and the best of the sheep and cattle, the fat calves and lambs—everything that was good. These they were unwilling to destroy completely, but everything that was despised and weak they totally destroyed.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到撒母耳说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到撒母耳说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到撒母耳说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord came to Samuel:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to Samuel:
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the word of the Lord came to Samuel, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Samuel,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to Samuel, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came to Samuel:

verses.textZh: "我后悔立了扫罗为王，因为他已经离去不跟随我，也不执行我的命令了。"撒母耳非常忿怒，整夜哀求耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我后悔立了扫罗为王，因为他已经离去不跟随我，也不执行我的命令了。"撒母耳非常忿怒，整夜哀求耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我立扫罗为王，我后悔了；因为他转去不跟从我，不遵守我的命令。」撒母耳便甚忧愁，终夜哀求耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: "I regret that I have made Saul king, because he has turned away from me and has not carried out my instructions." Samuel was angry, and he cried out to the Lord all that night.
verses.textEnEsv: "I regret that I have made Saul king, for he has turned back from following me and has not performed my commandments." And Samuel was angry, and he cried to the Lord all night.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I greatly regret that I have set up Saul as king, for he has turned back from following Me, and has not performed My commandments." And it grieved Samuel, and he cried out to the Lord all night.
verses.textEnNlt: "I am sorry that I ever made Saul king, for he has not been loyal to me and has refused to obey my command." Samuel was so deeply moved when he heard this that he cried out to the Lord all night.
verses.textEnNasb: "I regret that I have made Saul king, because he has turned back from following Me and has not carried out My commands." And Samuel was furious and cried out to the Lord all night.
verses.textEn: "I regret that I have made Saul king, because he has turned away from me and has not carried out my instructions." Samuel was angry, and he cried out to the Lord all that night.

verses.textZh: 撒母耳清早起来，要在早晨去见扫罗；有人告诉撒母耳："扫罗到了迦密，在那里为自己立了一座纪念碑，然后转身下到吉甲去了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳清早起来，要在早晨去见扫罗；有人告诉撒母耳："扫罗到了迦密，在那里为自己立了一座纪念碑，然后转身下到吉甲去了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳清早起来，迎接扫罗。有人告诉撒母耳说：「扫罗到了迦密，在那里立了纪念碑，又转身下到吉甲。」
verses.textEnNiv: Early in the morning Samuel got up and went to meet Saul, but he was told, "Saul has gone to Carmel. There he has set up a monument in his own honor and has turned and gone on down to Gilgal."
verses.textEnEsv: And Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning. And it was told Samuel, "Saul came to Carmel, and behold, he set up a monument for himself and turned and passed on and went down to Gilgal."
verses.textEnNkjv: So when Samuel rose early in the morning to meet Saul, it was told Samuel, saying, "Saul went to Carmel, and indeed, he set up a monument for himself; and he has gone on around, passed by, and gone down to Gilgal."
verses.textEnNlt: Early the next morning Samuel went to find Saul. Someone told him, "Saul went to the town of Carmel to set up a monument to himself; then he went on to Gilgal."
verses.textEnNasb: Samuel got up early in the morning to meet Saul; and it was reported to Samuel, saying, "Saul came to Carmel, and behold, he set up a monument for himself, then turned and proceeded on down to Gilgal."
verses.textEn: Early in the morning Samuel got up and went to meet Saul, but he was told, "Saul has gone to Carmel. There he has set up a monument in his own honor and has turned and gone on down to Gilgal."

verses.textZh: 撒母耳到了扫罗那里，扫罗对他说："愿耶和华赐福给你！我已经执行了耶和华的命令。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳到了扫罗那里，扫罗对他说："愿耶和华赐福给你！我已经执行了耶和华的命令。"
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳到了扫罗那里，扫罗对他说：「愿耶和华赐福与你，耶和华的命令我已遵守了。」
verses.textEnNiv: When Samuel reached him, Saul said, "The Lord bless you! I have carried out the Lord ’s instructions."
verses.textEnEsv: And Samuel came to Saul, and Saul said to him, "Blessed be you to the Lord . I have performed the commandment of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Samuel went to Saul, and Saul said to him, "Blessed are you of the Lord! I have performed the commandment of the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: When Samuel finally found him, Saul greeted him cheerfully. "May the Lord bless you," he said. "I have carried out the Lord ’s command!"
verses.textEnNasb: So Samuel came to Saul, and Saul said to him, "Blessed are you of the Lord! I have carried out the command of the Lord."
verses.textEn: When Samuel reached him, Saul said, "The Lord bless you! I have carried out the Lord ’s instructions."

verses.textZh: 撒母耳说："我耳中听见有羊叫牛鸣的声音，到底是甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳说："我耳中听见有羊叫牛鸣的声音，到底是甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳说：「我耳中听见有羊叫、牛鸣，是从哪里来的呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: But Samuel said, "What then is this bleating of sheep in my ears? What is this lowing of cattle that I hear?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Samuel said, "What then is this bleating of the sheep in my ears and the lowing of the oxen that I hear?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But Samuel said, "What then is this bleating of the sheep in my ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Then what is all the bleating of sheep and goats and the lowing of cattle I hear?" Samuel demanded.
verses.textEnNasb: But Samuel said, "What then is this bleating of the sheep in my ears, and the bellowing of the oxen which I hear?"
verses.textEn: But Samuel said, "What then is this bleating of sheep in my ears? What is this lowing of cattle that I hear?"

verses.textZh: 扫罗回答："这是众民从亚玛力人那里带来的，因为他们爱惜这些上好的牛羊，要献给耶和华你的神为祭；其余的，我们都已经彻底毁灭了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗回答："这是众民从亚玛力人那里带来的，因为他们爱惜这些上好的牛羊，要献给耶和华你的神为祭；其余的，我们都已经彻底毁灭了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗说：「这是百姓从亚玛力人那里带来的；因为他们爱惜上好的牛羊，要献与耶和华－你的神；其余的，我们都灭尽了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Saul answered, "The soldiers brought them from the Amalekites; they spared the best of the sheep and cattle to sacrifice to the Lord your God, but we totally destroyed the rest."
verses.textEnEsv: Saul said, "They have brought them from the Amalekites, for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen to sacrifice to the Lord your God, and the rest we have devoted to destruction."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Saul said, "They have brought them from the Amalekites; for the people spared the best of the sheep and the oxen, to sacrifice to the Lord your God; and the rest we have utterly destroyed."
verses.textEnNlt: "It’s true that the army spared the best of the sheep, goats, and cattle," Saul admitted. "But they are going to sacrifice them to the Lord your God. We have destroyed everything else."
verses.textEnNasb: Saul said, "They have brought them from the Amalekites, for the people spared the best of the sheep and oxen to sacrifice to the Lord your God; but the rest we have completely destroyed."
verses.textEn: Saul answered, "The soldiers brought them from the Amalekites; they spared the best of the sheep and cattle to sacrifice to the Lord your God, but we totally destroyed the rest."

verses.textZh: 撒母耳对扫罗说："住口吧！让我把耶和华昨天晚上对我所说的话告诉你。"扫罗对他说："请说。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳对扫罗说："住口吧！让我把耶和华昨天晚上对我所说的话告诉你。"扫罗对他说："请说。"
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳对扫罗说：「你住口吧！等我将耶和华昨夜向我所说的话告诉你。」扫罗说：「请讲。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Enough!" Samuel said to Saul. "Let me tell you what the Lord said to me last night." "Tell me," Saul replied.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Samuel said to Saul, "Stop! I will tell you what the Lord said to me this night." And he said to him, "Speak."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Samuel said to Saul, "Be quiet! And I will tell you what the Lord said to me last night." And he said to him, "Speak on."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Samuel said to Saul, "Stop! Listen to what the Lord told me last night!" "What did he tell you?" Saul asked.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Samuel said to Saul, "Stop, and let me inform you of what the Lord said to me last night." And he said to him, "Speak!"
verses.textEn: "Enough!" Samuel said to Saul. "Let me tell you what the Lord said to me last night." "Tell me," Saul replied.

verses.textZh: 撒母耳说："从前你虽然自以为微小，不是作了以色列众支派的首领吗？耶和华膏立了你作以色列的王，
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳说："从前你虽然自以为微小，不是作了以色列众支派的首领吗？耶和华膏立了你作以色列的王，
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳对扫罗说：「从前你虽然以自己为小，岂不是被立为以色列支派的元首吗？耶和华膏你作以色列的王。
verses.textEnNiv: Samuel said, "Although you were once small in your own eyes, did you not become the head of the tribes of Israel? The Lord anointed you king over Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And Samuel said, "Though you are little in your own eyes, are you not the head of the tribes of Israel? The Lord anointed you king over Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Samuel said, "When you were little in your own eyes, were you not head of the tribes of Israel? And did not the Lord anoint you king over Israel?
verses.textEnNlt: And Samuel told him, "Although you may think little of yourself, are you not the leader of the tribes of Israel? The Lord has anointed you king of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: So Samuel said, " Is it not true, though you were insignificant in your own eyes, that you became the head of the tribes of Israel? For the Lord anointed you as king over Israel.
verses.textEn: Samuel said, "Although you were once small in your own eyes, did you not become the head of the tribes of Israel? The Lord anointed you king over Israel.

verses.textZh: 差遣你去，说：‘你去彻底毁灭那些犯罪的亚玛力人，攻打他们，直到把他们全部毁灭。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 差遣你去，说：‘你去彻底毁灭那些犯罪的亚玛力人，攻打他们，直到把他们全部毁灭。’
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华差遣你，吩咐你说，你去击打那些犯罪的亚玛力人，将他们灭绝净尽。
verses.textEnNiv: And he sent you on a mission, saying, ‘Go and completely destroy those wicked people, the Amalekites; wage war against them until you have wiped them out.’
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord sent you on a mission and said, ‘Go, devote to destruction the sinners, the Amalekites, and fight against them until they are consumed.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord sent you on a mission, and said, ‘Go, and utterly destroy the sinners, the Amalekites, and fight against them until they are consumed.’
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord sent you on a mission and told you, ‘Go and completely destroy the sinners, the Amalekites, until they are all dead.’
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord sent you on a mission, and said, ‘Go and completely destroy the sinners, the Amalekites, and fight against them until they are eliminated.’
verses.textEn: And he sent you on a mission, saying, ‘Go and completely destroy those wicked people, the Amalekites; wage war against them until you have wiped them out.’

verses.textZh: 你为甚么没有听从耶和华的话，急于夺取战利品，作了耶和华看为恶的事呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为甚么没有听从耶和华的话，急于夺取战利品，作了耶和华看为恶的事呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 你为何没有听从耶和华的命令，急忙掳掠财物，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Why did you not obey the Lord ? Why did you pounce on the plunder and do evil in the eyes of the Lord ?"
verses.textEnEsv: Why then did you not obey the voice of the Lord ? Why did you pounce on the spoil and do what was evil in the sight of the Lord ?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Why then did you not obey the voice of the Lord? Why did you swoop down on the spoil, and do evil in the sight of the Lord?"
verses.textEnNlt: Why haven’t you obeyed the Lord ? Why did you rush for the plunder and do what was evil in the Lord ’s sight?"
verses.textEnNasb: Why then did you not obey the voice of the Lord? Instead, you loudly rushed upon the spoils and did what was evil in the sight of the Lord!"
verses.textEn: Why did you not obey the Lord ? Why did you pounce on the plunder and do evil in the eyes of the Lord ?"

verses.textZh: 扫罗回答撒母耳："我实在听从了耶和华的话，行了耶和华差遣我行的路；我把亚玛力人的王亚甲带了回来，又把亚玛力人都彻底毁灭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗回答撒母耳："我实在听从了耶和华的话，行了耶和华差遣我行的路；我把亚玛力人的王亚甲带了回来，又把亚玛力人都彻底毁灭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗对撒母耳说：「我实在听从了耶和华的命令，行了耶和华所差遣我行的路，擒了亚玛力王亚甲来，灭尽了亚玛力人。
verses.textEnNiv: "But I did obey the Lord ," Saul said. "I went on the mission the Lord assigned me. I completely destroyed the Amalekites and brought back Agag their king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul said to Samuel, "I have obeyed the voice of the Lord . I have gone on the mission on which the Lord sent me. I have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and I have devoted the Amalekites to destruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Saul said to Samuel, "But I have obeyed the voice of the Lord, and gone on the mission on which the Lord sent me, and brought back Agag king of Amalek; I have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.
verses.textEnNlt: "But I did obey the Lord ," Saul insisted. "I carried out the mission he gave me. I brought back King Agag, but I destroyed everyone else.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul said to Samuel, "I did obey the voice of the Lord, for I went on the mission on which the Lord sent me; and I have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have completely destroyed the Amalekites.
verses.textEn: "But I did obey the Lord ," Saul said. "I went on the mission the Lord assigned me. I completely destroyed the Amalekites and brought back Agag their king.

verses.textZh: 可是众民却从那些战利品中，取了应当毁灭之物中上好的牛羊，要在吉甲献给耶和华你的神为祭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是众民却从那些战利品中，取了应当毁灭之物中上好的牛羊，要在吉甲献给耶和华你的神为祭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓却在所当灭的物中，取了最好的牛羊，要在吉甲献与耶和华－你的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: The soldiers took sheep and cattle from the plunder, the best of what was devoted to God, in order to sacrifice them to the Lord your God at Gilgal."
verses.textEnEsv: But the people took of the spoil, sheep and oxen, the best of the things devoted to destruction, to sacrifice to the Lord your God in Gilgal."
verses.textEnNkjv: But the people took of the plunder, sheep and oxen, the best of the things which should have been utterly destroyed, to sacrifice to the Lord your God in Gilgal."
verses.textEnNlt: Then my troops brought in the best of the sheep, goats, cattle, and plunder to sacrifice to the Lord your God in Gilgal."
verses.textEnNasb: But the people took some of the spoils, sheep and oxen, the choicest of the things designated for destruction, to sacrifice to the Lord your God at Gilgal."
verses.textEn: The soldiers took sheep and cattle from the plunder, the best of what was devoted to God, in order to sacrifice them to the Lord your God at Gilgal."

verses.textZh: 撒母耳说： "耶和华喜悦燔祭和平安祭， 岂像喜悦人听从耶和华的话呢？ 听从胜过献祭， 听命胜过公羊的脂油。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳说： "耶和华喜悦燔祭和平安祭， 岂像喜悦人听从耶和华的话呢？ 听从胜过献祭， 听命胜过公羊的脂油。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳说： 耶和华喜悦燔祭和平安祭， 岂如喜悦人听从他的话呢？ 听命胜于献祭； 顺从胜于公羊的脂油。
verses.textEnNiv: But Samuel replied: "Does the Lord delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as much as in obeying the Lord ? To obey is better than sacrifice, and to heed is better than the fat of rams.
verses.textEnEsv: And Samuel said, "Has the Lord as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the Lord ? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to listen than the fat of rams.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Samuel said: "Has the Lordasgreat delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, As in obeying the voice of the Lord? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, And to heed than the fat of rams.
verses.textEnNlt: But Samuel replied, "What is more pleasing to the Lord : your burnt offerings and sacrifices or your obedience to his voice? Listen! Obedience is better than sacrifice, and submission is better than offering the fat of rams.
verses.textEnNasb: Samuel said, "Does the Lord have as much delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices As in obeying the voice of the Lord? Behold, to obey is better than a sacrifice, And to pay attention is better than the fat of rams.
verses.textEn: But Samuel replied: "Does the Lord delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as much as in obeying the Lord ? To obey is better than sacrifice, and to heed is better than the fat of rams.

verses.textZh: 因为悖逆与行邪术的罪相同， 顽梗与拜虚无偶像一样， 因为你弃绝了耶和华的话， 耶和华也弃绝了你作王。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为悖逆与行邪术的罪相同， 顽梗与拜虚无偶像一样， 因为你弃绝了耶和华的话， 耶和华也弃绝了你作王。"
verses.textZhCuv: 悖逆的罪与行邪术的罪相等； 顽梗的罪与拜虚神和偶像的罪相同。 你既厌弃耶和华的命令， 耶和华也厌弃你作王。
verses.textEnNiv: For rebellion is like the sin of divination, and arrogance like the evil of idolatry. Because you have rejected the word of the Lord , he has rejected you as king."
verses.textEnEsv: For rebellion is as the sin of divination, and presumption is as iniquity and idolatry. Because you have rejected the word of the Lord , he has also rejected you from being king."
verses.textEnNkjv: For rebellion isas the sin of witchcraft, And stubbornness isas iniquity and idolatry. Because you have rejected the word of the Lord, He also has rejected you from being king."
verses.textEnNlt: Rebellion is as sinful as witchcraft, and stubbornness as bad as worshiping idols. So because you have rejected the command of the Lord , he has rejected you as king."
verses.textEnNasb: "For rebellion is as reprehensible as the sin of divination, And insubordination is as reprehensible as false religion and idolatry. Since you have rejected the word of the Lord, He has also rejected you from being king."
verses.textEn: For rebellion is like the sin of divination, and arrogance like the evil of idolatry. Because you have rejected the word of the Lord , he has rejected you as king."

verses.textZh: 于是扫罗对撒母耳说："我犯了罪了，我违背了耶和华的命令和你的话，因为我害怕众人，听从了他们的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是扫罗对撒母耳说："我犯了罪了，我违背了耶和华的命令和你的话，因为我害怕众人，听从了他们的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗对撒母耳说：「我有罪了，我因惧怕百姓，听从他们的话，就违背了耶和华的命令和你的言语。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Saul said to Samuel, "I have sinned. I violated the Lord ’s command and your instructions. I was afraid of the men and so I gave in to them.
verses.textEnEsv: Saul said to Samuel, "I have sinned, for I have transgressed the commandment of the Lord and your words, because I feared the people and obeyed their voice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul said to Samuel, "I have sinned, for I have transgressed the commandment of the Lord and your words, because I feared the people and obeyed their voice.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Saul admitted to Samuel, "Yes, I have sinned. I have disobeyed your instructions and the Lord ’s command, for I was afraid of the people and did what they demanded.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul said to Samuel, "I have sinned, for I have violated the command of the Lord and your words, because I feared the people and listened to their voice.
verses.textEn: Then Saul said to Samuel, "I have sinned. I violated the Lord ’s command and your instructions. I was afraid of the men and so I gave in to them.

verses.textZh: 现在求你赦免我的罪，与我一同回去，我好敬拜耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在求你赦免我的罪，与我一同回去，我好敬拜耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在求你赦免我的罪，同我回去，我好敬拜耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now I beg you, forgive my sin and come back with me, so that I may worship the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore, please pardon my sin and return with me that I may bow before the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, please pardon my sin, and return with me, that I may worship the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: But now, please forgive my sin and come back with me so that I may worship the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, please pardon my sin and return with me, so that I may worship the Lord."
verses.textEn: Now I beg you, forgive my sin and come back with me, so that I may worship the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 撒母耳回答扫罗："我不与你一同回去，因为你弃绝了耶和华的话，耶和华也弃绝你作以色列的王。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳回答扫罗："我不与你一同回去，因为你弃绝了耶和华的话，耶和华也弃绝你作以色列的王。"
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳对扫罗说：「我不同你回去；因为你厌弃耶和华的命令，耶和华也厌弃你作以色列的王。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Samuel said to him, "I will not go back with you. You have rejected the word of the Lord , and the Lord has rejected you as king over Israel!"
verses.textEnEsv: And Samuel said to Saul, "I will not return with you. For you have rejected the word of the Lord , and the Lord has rejected you from being king over Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Samuel said to Saul, "I will not return with you, for you have rejected the word of the Lord, and the Lord has rejected you from being king over Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: But Samuel replied, "I will not go back with you! Since you have rejected the Lord ’s command, he has rejected you as king of Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: But Samuel said to Saul, "I will not return with you; for you have rejected the word of the Lord, and the Lord has rejected you from being king over Israel."
verses.textEn: But Samuel said to him, "I will not go back with you. You have rejected the word of the Lord , and the Lord has rejected you as king over Israel!"

verses.textZh: 撒母耳转身要走，扫罗拉着他外袍的衣边，衣边就撕裂了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳转身要走，扫罗拉着他外袍的衣边，衣边就撕裂了。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳转身要走，扫罗就扯住他外袍的衣襟，衣襟就撕断了。
verses.textEnNiv: As Samuel turned to leave, Saul caught hold of the hem of his robe, and it tore.
verses.textEnEsv: As Samuel turned to go away, Saul seized the skirt of his robe, and it tore.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as Samuel turned around to go away, Saul seized the edge of his robe, and it tore.
verses.textEnNlt: As Samuel turned to go, Saul tried to hold him back and tore the hem of his robe.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Samuel turned to go, but Saul grasped the edge of his robe, and it tore off.
verses.textEn: As Samuel turned to leave, Saul caught hold of the hem of his robe, and it tore.

verses.textZh: 撒母耳就对他说："今天耶和华把以色列国从你身上撕裂，赐给比你更好的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳就对他说："今天耶和华把以色列国从你身上撕裂，赐给比你更好的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳对他说：「如此，今日耶和华使以色列国与你断绝，将这国赐与比你更好的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Samuel said to him, "The Lord has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today and has given it to one of your neighbors—to one better than you.
verses.textEnEsv: And Samuel said to him, "The Lord has torn the kingdom of Israel from you this day and has given it to a neighbor of yours, who is better than you.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Samuel said to him, "The Lord has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today, and has given it to a neighbor of yours, whois better than you.
verses.textEnNlt: And Samuel said to him, "The Lord has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today and has given it to someone else—one who is better than you.
verses.textEnNasb: So Samuel said to him, "The Lord has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today and has given it to your neighbor, who is better than you.
verses.textEn: Samuel said to him, "The Lord has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today and has given it to one of your neighbors—to one better than you.

verses.textZh: 以色列的大能者必不说谎，也不后悔。因为他不是世人，他决不后悔。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的大能者必不说谎，也不后悔。因为他不是世人，他决不后悔。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列的大能者必不致说谎，也不致后悔；因为他迥非世人，决不后悔。」
verses.textEnNiv: He who is the Glory of Israel does not lie or change his mind; for he is not a human being, that he should change his mind."
verses.textEnEsv: And also the Glory of Israel will not lie or have regret, for he is not a man, that he should have regret."
verses.textEnNkjv: And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor relent. For He is not a man, that He should relent."
verses.textEnNlt: And he who is the Glory of Israel will not lie, nor will he change his mind, for he is not human that he should change his mind!"
verses.textEnNasb: Also the Glory of Israel will not lie nor change His mind; for He is not a man, that He would change His mind."
verses.textEn: He who is the Glory of Israel does not lie or change his mind; for he is not a human being, that he should change his mind."

verses.textZh: 扫罗说："我犯了罪了，但是求你在我人民的长老面前和以色列人面前给我面子，与我一同回去，我好敬拜耶和华你的神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗说："我犯了罪了，但是求你在我人民的长老面前和以色列人面前给我面子，与我一同回去，我好敬拜耶和华你的神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗说：「我有罪了，虽然如此，求你在我百姓的长老和以色列人面前抬举我，同我回去，我好敬拜耶和华－你的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: Saul replied, "I have sinned. But please honor me before the elders of my people and before Israel; come back with me, so that I may worship the Lord your God."
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said, "I have sinned; yet honor me now before the elders of my people and before Israel, and return with me, that I may bow before the Lord your God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "I have sinned; yet honor me now, please, before the elders of my people and before Israel, and return with me, that I may worship the Lord your God."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Saul pleaded again, "I know I have sinned. But please, at least honor me before the elders of my people and before Israel by coming back with me so that I may worship the Lord your God."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul said, "I have sinned; but please honor me now before the elders of my people and before all Israel, and go back with me, so that I may worship the Lord your God."
verses.textEn: Saul replied, "I have sinned. But please honor me before the elders of my people and before Israel; come back with me, so that I may worship the Lord your God."

verses.textZh: 于是撒母耳跟着扫罗回去，扫罗就敬拜耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是撒母耳跟着扫罗回去，扫罗就敬拜耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是撒母耳转身跟随扫罗回去，扫罗就敬拜耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: So Samuel went back with Saul, and Saul worshiped the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: So Samuel turned back after Saul, and Saul bowed before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So Samuel turned back after Saul, and Saul worshiped the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So Samuel finally agreed and went back with him, and Saul worshiped the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So Samuel went back following Saul, and Saul worshiped the Lord.
verses.textEn: So Samuel went back with Saul, and Saul worshiped the Lord .

verses.textZh: 随后撒母耳说："把亚玛力人的王亚甲带到我这里来！"亚甲欢欢喜喜走到他面前，心里说："死亡的痛苦必定过去了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 随后撒母耳说："把亚玛力人的王亚甲带到我这里来！"亚甲欢欢喜喜走到他面前，心里说："死亡的痛苦必定过去了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳说：「要把亚玛力王亚甲带到我这里来。」亚甲就欢欢喜喜地来到他面前，心里说，死亡的苦难必定过去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Samuel said, "Bring me Agag king of the Amalekites." Agag came to him in chains. And he thought, "Surely the bitterness of death is past."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Samuel said, "Bring here to me Agag the king of the Amalekites." And Agag came to him cheerfully. Agag said, "Surely the bitterness of death is past."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Samuel said, "Bring Agag king of the Amalekites here to me." So Agag came to him cautiously. And Agag said, "Surely the bitterness of death is past."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Samuel said, "Bring King Agag to me." Agag arrived full of hope, for he thought, "Surely the worst is over, and I have been spared!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Samuel said, "Bring me Agag, the king of the Amalekites." And Agag came to him cheerfully. And Agag said, "Surely the bitterness of death is gone!"
verses.textEn: Then Samuel said, "Bring me Agag king of the Amalekites." Agag came to him in chains. And he thought, "Surely the bitterness of death is past."

verses.textZh: 撒母耳说："你的刀怎样使妇人丧子，你的母亲在妇人中也要怎样丧子。"于是撒母耳在吉甲，在耶和华面前把亚甲斩成碎块。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳说："你的刀怎样使妇人丧子，你的母亲在妇人中也要怎样丧子。"于是撒母耳在吉甲，在耶和华面前把亚甲斩成碎块。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳说：「你既用刀使妇人丧子，这样，你母亲在妇人中也必丧子。」于是，撒母耳在吉甲耶和华面前将亚甲杀死。
verses.textEnNiv: But Samuel said, "As your sword has made women childless, so will your mother be childless among women." And Samuel put Agag to death before the Lord at Gilgal.
verses.textEnEsv: And Samuel said, "As your sword has made women childless, so shall your mother be childless among women." And Samuel hacked Agag to pieces before the Lord in Gilgal.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Samuel said, "As your sword has made women childless, so shall your mother be childless among women." And Samuel hacked Agag in pieces before the Lord in Gilgal.
verses.textEnNlt: But Samuel said, "As your sword has killed the sons of many mothers, now your mother will be childless." And Samuel cut Agag to pieces before the Lord at Gilgal.
verses.textEnNasb: But Samuel said, "As your sword has made women childless, so shall your mother be childless among women." And Samuel cut Agag to pieces before the Lord at Gilgal.
verses.textEn: But Samuel said, "As your sword has made women childless, so will your mother be childless among women." And Samuel put Agag to death before the Lord at Gilgal.

verses.textZh: 后来撒母耳回拉玛去，扫罗也上他所住的基比亚自己的家去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来撒母耳回拉玛去，扫罗也上他所住的基比亚自己的家去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳回了拉玛。扫罗上他所住的基比亚，回自己的家去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Samuel left for Ramah, but Saul went up to his home in Gibeah of Saul.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Samuel went to Ramah, and Saul went up to his house in Gibeah of Saul.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Samuel went to Ramah, and Saul went up to his house at Gibeah of Saul.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Samuel went home to Ramah, and Saul returned to his house at Gibeah of Saul.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Samuel went to Ramah, but Saul went up to his house at Gibeah of Saul.
verses.textEn: Then Samuel left for Ramah, but Saul went up to his home in Gibeah of Saul.

verses.textZh: 撒母耳直到死的日子，再没有看见扫罗。撒母耳为扫罗悲伤，因为耶和华后悔立了扫罗作以色列的王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳直到死的日子，再没有看见扫罗。撒母耳为扫罗悲伤，因为耶和华后悔立了扫罗作以色列的王。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳直到死的日子，再没有见扫罗；但撒母耳为扫罗悲伤，是因耶和华后悔立他为以色列的王。
verses.textEnNiv: Until the day Samuel died, he did not go to see Saul again, though Samuel mourned for him. And the Lord regretted that he had made Saul king over Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And Samuel did not see Saul again until the day of his death, but Samuel grieved over Saul. And the Lord regretted that he had made Saul king over Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Samuel went no more to see Saul until the day of his death. Nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul, and the Lord regretted that He had made Saul king over Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Samuel never went to meet with Saul again, but he mourned constantly for him. And the Lord was sorry he had ever made Saul king of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: And Samuel did not see Saul again until the day of his death, though Samuel mourned for Saul. And the Lord regretted that He had made Saul king over Israel.
verses.textEn: Until the day Samuel died, he did not go to see Saul again, though Samuel mourned for him. And the Lord regretted that he had made Saul king over Israel.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对撒母耳说："你为扫罗悲哀要到几时呢？我已经弃绝他作以色列的王了。你把膏油盛满了角，然后去吧！我要差派你到伯利恒人耶西那里去，因为我在他的众子中，已经预定了一个为我作王。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对撒母耳说："你为扫罗悲哀要到几时呢？我已经弃绝他作以色列的王了。你把膏油盛满了角，然后去吧！我要差派你到伯利恒人耶西那里去，因为我在他的众子中，已经预定了一个为我作王。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对撒母耳说：「我既厌弃扫罗作以色列的王，你为他悲伤要到几时呢？你将膏油盛满了角，我差遣你往伯利恒人耶西那里去；因为我在他众子之内，预定一个作王的。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Samuel, "How long will you mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him as king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil and be on your way; I am sending you to Jesse of Bethlehem. I have chosen one of his sons to be king."
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to Samuel, "How long will you grieve over Saul, since I have rejected him from being king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil, and go. I will send you to Jesse the Bethlehemite, for I have provided for myself a king among his sons."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord said to Samuel, "How long will you mourn for Saul, seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel? Fill your horn with oil, and go; I am sending you to Jesse the Bethlehemite. For I have provided Myself a king among his sons."
verses.textEnNlt: Now the Lord said to Samuel, "You have mourned long enough for Saul. I have rejected him as king of Israel, so fill your flask with olive oil and go to Bethlehem. Find a man named Jesse who lives there, for I have selected one of his sons to be my king."
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord said to Samuel, "How long are you going to mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him from being king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil and go; I will send you to Jesse the Bethlehemite, because I have chosen a king for Myself among his sons."
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Samuel, "How long will you mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him as king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil and be on your way; I am sending you to Jesse of Bethlehem. I have chosen one of his sons to be king."

verses.textZh: 撒母耳说："我怎能去呢？扫罗听见了，必定杀我。"耶和华说："你可以带一头母牛犊去，就说：‘我来是要向耶和华献祭。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳说："我怎能去呢？扫罗听见了，必定杀我。"耶和华说："你可以带一头母牛犊去，就说：‘我来是要向耶和华献祭。’
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳说：「我怎能去呢？扫罗若听见，必要杀我。」耶和华说：「你可以带一只牛犊去，就说：『我来是要向耶和华献祭。』
verses.textEnNiv: But Samuel said, "How can I go? If Saul hears about it, he will kill me." The Lord said, "Take a heifer with you and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to the Lord .’
verses.textEnEsv: And Samuel said, "How can I go? If Saul hears it, he will kill me." And the Lord said, "Take a heifer with you and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to the Lord .’
verses.textEnNkjv: And Samuel said, "How can I go? If Saul hears it, he will kill me." But the Lord said, "Take a heifer with you, and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to the Lord.’
verses.textEnNlt: But Samuel asked, "How can I do that? If Saul hears about it, he will kill me." "Take a heifer with you," the Lord replied, "and say that you have come to make a sacrifice to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: But Samuel said, "How can I go? When Saul hears about it, he will kill me." But the Lord said, "Take a heifer with you and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to the Lord.’
verses.textEn: But Samuel said, "How can I go? If Saul hears about it, he will kill me." The Lord said, "Take a heifer with you and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to the Lord .’

verses.textZh: 你要请耶西参加献祭的筵席，我就会指示你当作的。我指示你的那人，你要为我膏立他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要请耶西参加献祭的筵席，我就会指示你当作的。我指示你的那人，你要为我膏立他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你要请耶西来吃祭肉，我就指示你所当行的事。我所指给你的人，你要膏他。」
verses.textEnNiv: Invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what to do. You are to anoint for me the one I indicate."
verses.textEnEsv: And invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you shall do. And you shall anoint for me him whom I declare to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you shall do; you shall anoint for Me the one I name to you."
verses.textEnNlt: Invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you which of his sons to anoint for me."
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will let you know what you shall do; and you shall anoint for Me the one whom I designate to you."
verses.textEn: Invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what to do. You are to anoint for me the one I indicate."

verses.textZh: 于是撒母耳照着耶和华的话去行。他到了伯利恒的时候，城里的长老就都战战兢兢地出来迎接他，说："你是为平安来的吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是撒母耳照着耶和华的话去行。他到了伯利恒的时候，城里的长老就都战战兢兢地出来迎接他，说："你是为平安来的吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳就照耶和华的话去行。到了伯利恒，那城里的长老都战战兢兢地出来迎接他，问他说：「你是为平安来的吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Samuel did what the Lord said. When he arrived at Bethlehem, the elders of the town trembled when they met him. They asked, "Do you come in peace?"
verses.textEnEsv: Samuel did what the Lord commanded and came to Bethlehem. The elders of the city came to meet him trembling and said, "Do you come peaceably?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So Samuel did what the Lord said, and went to Bethlehem. And the elders of the town trembled at his coming, and said, "Do you come peaceably?"
verses.textEnNlt: So Samuel did as the Lord instructed. When he arrived at Bethlehem, the elders of the town came trembling to meet him. "What’s wrong?" they asked. "Do you come in peace?"
verses.textEnNasb: So Samuel did what the Lord told him, and he came to Bethlehem. Then the elders of the city came trembling to meet him and said, "Do you come in peace?"
verses.textEn: Samuel did what the Lord said. When he arrived at Bethlehem, the elders of the town trembled when they met him. They asked, "Do you come in peace?"

verses.textZh: 他回答："是为平安来的。我来是要向耶和华献祭。你们要自洁，与我一同参加献祭的筵席。"撒母耳使耶西和他的儿子自洁，邀请他们来参加献祭的筵席。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答："是为平安来的。我来是要向耶和华献祭。你们要自洁，与我一同参加献祭的筵席。"撒母耳使耶西和他的儿子自洁，邀请他们来参加献祭的筵席。
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「为平安来的，我是给耶和华献祭。你们当自洁，来与我同吃祭肉。」撒母耳就使耶西和他众子自洁，请他们来吃祭肉。
verses.textEnNiv: Samuel replied, "Yes, in peace; I have come to sacrifice to the Lord . Consecrate yourselves and come to the sacrifice with me." Then he consecrated Jesse and his sons and invited them to the sacrifice.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Peaceably; I have come to sacrifice to the Lord . Consecrate yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice." And he consecrated Jesse and his sons and invited them to the sacrifice.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "Peaceably; I have come to sacrifice to the Lord. Sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice." Then he consecrated Jesse and his sons, and invited them to the sacrifice.
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes," Samuel replied. "I have come to sacrifice to the Lord . Purify yourselves and come with me to the sacrifice." Then Samuel performed the purification rite for Jesse and his sons and invited them to the sacrifice, too.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "In peace; I have come to sacrifice to the Lord. Consecrate yourselves and come with me to the sacrifice." He also consecrated Jesse and his sons and invited them to the sacrifice.
verses.textEn: Samuel replied, "Yes, in peace; I have come to sacrifice to the Lord . Consecrate yourselves and come to the sacrifice with me." Then he consecrated Jesse and his sons and invited them to the sacrifice.

verses.textZh: 他们来到的时候，撒母耳看见以利押，就心里想："在耶和华面前的这位，必是他所要膏立的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们来到的时候，撒母耳看见以利押，就心里想："在耶和华面前的这位，必是他所要膏立的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们来的时候，撒母耳看见以利押，就心里说，耶和华的受膏者必定在他面前。
verses.textEnNiv: When they arrived, Samuel saw Eliab and thought, "Surely the Lord ’s anointed stands here before the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: When they came, he looked on Eliab and thought, "Surely the Lord ’s anointed is before him."
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when they came, that he looked at Eliab and said, "Surely the Lord’s anointed is before Him!"
verses.textEnNlt: When they arrived, Samuel took one look at Eliab and thought, "Surely this is the Lord ’s anointed!"
verses.textEnNasb: When they entered, he looked at Eliab and thought, "Surely the Lord’s anointed is standing before Him."
verses.textEn: When they arrived, Samuel saw Eliab and thought, "Surely the Lord ’s anointed stands here before the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 但耶和华对撒母耳说："不要看他的外貌和他高大的身材，因为我不拣选他。耶和华看人不像人看人，人是看外表，耶和华是看内心。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶和华对撒母耳说："不要看他的外貌和他高大的身材，因为我不拣选他。耶和华看人不像人看人，人是看外表，耶和华是看内心。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华却对撒母耳说：「不要看他的外貌和他身材高大，我不拣选他。因为，耶和华不像人看人：人是看外貌；耶和华是看内心。」
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord said to Samuel, "Do not consider his appearance or his height, for I have rejected him. The Lord does not look at the things people look at. People look at the outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart."
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord said to Samuel, "Do not look on his appearance or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him. For the Lord sees not as man sees: man looks on the outward appearance, but the Lord looks on the heart."
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord said to Samuel, "Do not look at his appearance or at his physical stature, because I have refused him. For theLorddoes not see as man sees; for man looks at the outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart."
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord said to Samuel, "Don’t judge by his appearance or height, for I have rejected him. The Lord doesn’t see things the way you see them. People judge by outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart."
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord said to Samuel, "Do not look at his appearance or at the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for God does not see as man sees, since man looks at the outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart."
verses.textEn: But the Lord said to Samuel, "Do not consider his appearance or his height, for I have rejected him. The Lord does not look at the things people look at. People look at the outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart."

verses.textZh: 耶西叫亚比拿达在撒母耳面前经过，撒母耳说："这也不是耶和华所拣选的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶西叫亚比拿达在撒母耳面前经过，撒母耳说："这也不是耶和华所拣选的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶西叫亚比拿达从撒母耳面前经过，撒母耳说：「耶和华也不拣选他。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesse called Abinadab and had him pass in front of Samuel. But Samuel said, "The Lord has not chosen this one either."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jesse called Abinadab and made him pass before Samuel. And he said, "Neither has the Lord chosen this one."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. And he said, "Neither has the Lord chosen this one."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesse told his son Abinadab to step forward and walk in front of Samuel. But Samuel said, "This is not the one the Lord has chosen."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jesse called Abinadab and had him pass before Samuel. But he said, "The Lord has not chosen this one, either."
verses.textEn: Then Jesse called Abinadab and had him pass in front of Samuel. But Samuel said, "The Lord has not chosen this one either."

verses.textZh: 耶西又叫沙玛经过。撒母耳说："耶和华也不拣选这个。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶西又叫沙玛经过。撒母耳说："耶和华也不拣选这个。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶西又叫沙玛从撒母耳面前经过，撒母耳说：「耶和华也不拣选他。」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesse then had Shammah pass by, but Samuel said, "Nor has the Lord chosen this one."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jesse made Shammah pass by. And he said, "Neither has the Lord chosen this one."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesse made Shammah pass by. And he said, "Neither has the Lord chosen this one."
verses.textEnNlt: Next Jesse summoned Shimea, but Samuel said, "Neither is this the one the Lord has chosen."
verses.textEnNasb: Next Jesse had Shammah pass by. And he said, "The Lord has not chosen this one, either."
verses.textEn: Jesse then had Shammah pass by, but Samuel said, "Nor has the Lord chosen this one."

verses.textZh: 耶西叫他的七个儿子都在撒母耳面前经过。但撒母耳对耶西说："这些都不是耶和华所拣选的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶西叫他的七个儿子都在撒母耳面前经过。但撒母耳对耶西说："这些都不是耶和华所拣选的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶西叫他七个儿子都从撒母耳面前经过，撒母耳说：「这都不是耶和华所拣选的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesse had seven of his sons pass before Samuel, but Samuel said to him, "The Lord has not chosen these."
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesse made seven of his sons pass before Samuel. And Samuel said to Jesse, "The Lord has not chosen these."
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus Jesse made seven of his sons pass before Samuel. And Samuel said to Jesse, "The Lord has not chosen these."
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way all seven of Jesse’s sons were presented to Samuel. But Samuel said to Jesse, "The Lord has not chosen any of these."
verses.textEnNasb: So Jesse had seven of his sons pass before Samuel. But Samuel said to Jesse, "The Lord has not chosen these."
verses.textEn: Jesse had seven of his sons pass before Samuel, but Samuel said to him, "The Lord has not chosen these."

verses.textZh: 撒母耳问耶西："孩子们全都在这里吗？"耶西回答："还有一个最小的，正在牧羊。"撒母耳对耶西说："你派人去把他带回来，因为他没有来到以前，我们决不入席。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳问耶西："孩子们全都在这里吗？"耶西回答："还有一个最小的，正在牧羊。"撒母耳对耶西说："你派人去把他带回来，因为他没有来到以前，我们决不入席。"
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳对耶西说：「你的儿子都在这里吗？」他回答说：「还有个小的，现在放羊。」撒母耳对耶西说：「你打发人去叫他来；他若不来，我们必不坐席。」
verses.textEnNiv: So he asked Jesse, "Are these all the sons you have?" "There is still the youngest," Jesse answered. "He is tending the sheep." Samuel said, "Send for him; we will not sit down until he arrives."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Samuel said to Jesse, "Are all your sons here?" And he said, "There remains yet the youngest, but behold, he is keeping the sheep." And Samuel said to Jesse, "Send and get him, for we will not sit down till he comes here."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Samuel said to Jesse, "Are all the young men here?" Then he said, "There remains yet the youngest, and there he is, keeping the sheep." And Samuel said to Jesse, "Send and bring him. For we will not sit down till he comes here."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Samuel asked, "Are these all the sons you have?" "There is still the youngest," Jesse replied. "But he’s out in the fields watching the sheep and goats." "Send for him at once," Samuel said. "We will not sit down to eat until he arrives."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Samuel said to Jesse, "Are these all the boys?" And he said, "The youngest is still left, but behold, he is tending the sheep." So Samuel said to Jesse, "Send word and bring him; for we will not take our places at the table until he comes here."
verses.textEn: So he asked Jesse, "Are these all the sons you have?" "There is still the youngest," Jesse answered. "He is tending the sheep." Samuel said, "Send for him; we will not sit down until he arrives."

verses.textZh: 耶西就派人去把大卫带回来。他面色红润，眼目清秀，外貌英俊。耶和华说："就是这一个，你起来膏立他吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶西就派人去把大卫带回来。他面色红润，眼目清秀，外貌英俊。耶和华说："就是这一个，你起来膏立他吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶西就打发人去叫了他来。他面色光红，双目清秀，容貌俊美。耶和华说：「这就是他，你起来膏他。」
verses.textEnNiv: So he sent for him and had him brought in. He was glowing with health and had a fine appearance and handsome features. Then the Lord said, "Rise and anoint him; this is the one."
verses.textEnEsv: And he sent and brought him in. Now he was ruddy and had beautiful eyes and was handsome. And the Lord said, "Arise, anoint him, for this is he."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he sent and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, with bright eyes, and good-looking. And the Lord said, "Arise, anoint him; for this is the one!"
verses.textEnNlt: So Jesse sent for him. He was dark and handsome, with beautiful eyes. And the Lord said, "This is the one; anoint him."
verses.textEnNasb: So he sent word and brought him in. Now he was reddish, with beautiful eyes and a handsome appearance. And the Lord said, "Arise, anoint him; for this is he."
verses.textEn: So he sent for him and had him brought in. He was glowing with health and had a fine appearance and handsome features. Then the Lord said, "Rise and anoint him; this is the one."

verses.textZh: 撒母耳就拿起盛油的角，在他的兄长中膏立他。从那天起，耶和华的灵就大大感动大卫。后来撒母耳动身往拉玛去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳就拿起盛油的角，在他的兄长中膏立他。从那天起，耶和华的灵就大大感动大卫。后来撒母耳动身往拉玛去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳就用角里的膏油，在他诸兄中膏了他。从这日起，耶和华的灵就大大感动大卫。撒母耳起身回拉玛去了。
verses.textEnNiv: So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the presence of his brothers, and from that day on the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon David. Samuel then went to Ramah.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the midst of his brothers. And the Spirit of the Lord rushed upon David from that day forward. And Samuel rose up and went to Ramah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the midst of his brothers; and the Spirit of the Lord came upon David from that day forward. So Samuel arose and went to Ramah.
verses.textEnNlt: So as David stood there among his brothers, Samuel took the flask of olive oil he had brought and anointed David with the oil. And the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon David from that day on. Then Samuel returned to Ramah.
verses.textEnNasb: So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the midst of his brothers; and the Spirit of the Lord rushed upon David from that day forward. And Samuel set out and went to Ramah.
verses.textEn: So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the presence of his brothers, and from that day on the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon David. Samuel then went to Ramah.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的灵离开了扫罗。有恶鬼从耶和华那里来惊扰他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的灵离开了扫罗。有恶鬼从耶和华那里来惊扰他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的灵离开扫罗，有恶魔从耶和华那里来扰乱他。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Spirit of the Lord had departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the Lord tormented him.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the Spirit of the Lord departed from Saul, and a harmful spirit from the Lord tormented him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Spirit of the Lord departed from Saul, and a distressing spirit from the Lord troubled him.
verses.textEnNlt: Now the Spirit of the Lord had left Saul, and the Lord sent a tormenting spirit that filled him with depression and fear.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Spirit of the Lord left Saul, and an evil spirit from the Lord terrified him.
verses.textEn: Now the Spirit of the Lord had departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the Lord tormented him.

verses.textZh: 扫罗的臣仆对他说："看哪！有恶鬼从神那里来惊扰你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗的臣仆对他说："看哪！有恶鬼从神那里来惊扰你。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗的臣仆对他说：「现在有恶魔从神那里来扰乱你。
verses.textEnNiv: Saul’s attendants said to him, "See, an evil spirit from God is tormenting you.
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul’s servants said to him, "Behold now, a harmful spirit from God is tormenting you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Saul’s servants said to him, "Surely, a distressing spirit from God is troubling you.
verses.textEnNlt: Some of Saul’s servants said to him, "A tormenting spirit from God is troubling you.
verses.textEnNasb: Saul’s servants then said to him, "Behold now, an evil spirit from God is terrifying you.
verses.textEn: Saul’s attendants said to him, "See, an evil spirit from God is tormenting you.

verses.textZh: 愿我们的主吩咐你面前的臣仆，去寻找一位善于弹琴的人；从神那里来的灵临到你身上的时候，他可以弹琴，你就好了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿我们的主吩咐你面前的臣仆，去寻找一位善于弹琴的人；从神那里来的灵临到你身上的时候，他可以弹琴，你就好了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的主可以吩咐面前的臣仆，找一个善于弹琴的来，等神那里来的恶魔临到你身上的时候，使他用手弹琴，你就好了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Let our lord command his servants here to search for someone who can play the lyre. He will play when the evil spirit from God comes on you, and you will feel better."
