verses.textEnEsv: Let our lord now command your servants who are before you to seek out a man who is skillful in playing the lyre, and when the harmful spirit from God is upon you, he will play it, and you will be well."
verses.textEnNkjv: Let our master now command your servants, whoare before you, to seek out a man whois a skillful player on the harp. And it shall be that he will play it with his hand when the distressing spirit from God is upon you, and you shall be well."
verses.textEnNlt: Let us find a good musician to play the harp whenever the tormenting spirit troubles you. He will play soothing music, and you will soon be well again."
verses.textEnNasb: May our lord now command your servants who are before you. Have them search for a man who is a skillful musician on the harp; and it shall come about whenever the evil spirit from God is upon you, that he shall play the harp with his hand, and you will become well."
verses.textEn: Let our lord command his servants here to search for someone who can play the lyre. He will play when the evil spirit from God comes on you, and you will feel better."

verses.textZh: 扫罗对他的臣仆说："你们可以为我找一个善于弹琴的人，带到我这里来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗对他的臣仆说："你们可以为我找一个善于弹琴的人，带到我这里来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗对臣仆说：「你们可以为我找一个善于弹琴的，带到我这里来。」
verses.textEnNiv: So Saul said to his attendants, "Find someone who plays well and bring him to me."
verses.textEnEsv: So Saul said to his servants, "Provide for me a man who can play well and bring him to me."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Saul said to his servants, "Provide me now a man who can play well, and bring him to me."
verses.textEnNlt: "All right," Saul said. "Find me someone who plays well, and bring him here."
verses.textEnNasb: So Saul said to his servants, "Now select for me a man who can play well, and bring him to me."
verses.textEn: So Saul said to his attendants, "Find someone who plays well and bring him to me."

verses.textZh: 有一个仆人回答："我见过伯利恒人耶西的一个儿子，他善于弹琴，是个大能的勇士，又是个战士，谈吐合宜，容貌俊美，耶和华也与他同在。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个仆人回答："我见过伯利恒人耶西的一个儿子，他善于弹琴，是个大能的勇士，又是个战士，谈吐合宜，容貌俊美，耶和华也与他同在。"
verses.textZhCuv: 其中有一个少年人说：「我曾见伯利恒人耶西的一个儿子善于弹琴，是大有勇敢的战士，说话合宜，容貌俊美，耶和华也与他同在。」
verses.textEnNiv: One of the servants answered, "I have seen a son of Jesse of Bethlehem who knows how to play the lyre. He is a brave man and a warrior. He speaks well and is a fine-looking man. And the Lord is with him."
verses.textEnEsv: One of the young men answered, "Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite, who is skillful in playing, a man of valor, a man of war, prudent in speech, and a man of good presence, and the Lord is with him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then one of the servants answered and said, "Look, I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite, whois skillful in playing, a mighty man of valor, a man of war, prudent in speech, and a handsome person; and the Lordis with him."
verses.textEnNlt: One of the servants said to Saul, "One of Jesse’s sons from Bethlehem is a talented harp player. Not only that—he is a brave warrior, a man of war, and has good judgment. He is also a fine-looking young man, and the Lord is with him."
verses.textEnNasb: Then one of the young men responded and said, "Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite who is a skillful musician, a valiant mighty man, a warrior, skillful in speech, and a handsome man; and the Lord is with him."
verses.textEn: One of the servants answered, "I have seen a son of Jesse of Bethlehem who knows how to play the lyre. He is a brave man and a warrior. He speaks well and is a fine-looking man. And the Lord is with him."

verses.textZh: 于是扫罗派遣使者去见耶西，说："请你叫你放羊的儿子大卫到我这里来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是扫罗派遣使者去见耶西，说："请你叫你放羊的儿子大卫到我这里来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是扫罗差遣使者去见耶西，说：「请你打发你放羊的儿子大卫到我这里来。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Saul sent messengers to Jesse and said, "Send me your son David, who is with the sheep."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore Saul sent messengers to Jesse and said, "Send me David your son, who is with the sheep."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore Saul sent messengers to Jesse, and said, "Send me your son David, who is with the sheep."
verses.textEnNlt: So Saul sent messengers to Jesse to say, "Send me your son David, the shepherd."
verses.textEnNasb: So Saul sent messengers to Jesse to say, "Send me your son David, who is with the flock."
verses.textEn: Then Saul sent messengers to Jesse and said, "Send me your son David, who is with the sheep."

verses.textZh: 耶西就牵来一头驴子，驮上饼、一皮袋酒和一只山羊羔，交给他的儿子大卫送给扫罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶西就牵来一头驴子，驮上饼、一皮袋酒和一只山羊羔，交给他的儿子大卫送给扫罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶西就把几个饼和一皮袋酒，并一只山羊羔，都驮在驴上，交给他儿子大卫，送与扫罗。
verses.textEnNiv: So Jesse took a donkey loaded with bread, a skin of wine and a young goat and sent them with his son David to Saul.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesse took a donkey laden with bread and a skin of wine and a young goat and sent them by David his son to Saul.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesse took a donkey loadedwith bread, a skin of wine, and a young goat, and sent them by his son David to Saul.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesse responded by sending David to Saul, along with a young goat, a donkey loaded with bread, and a wineskin full of wine.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesse took a donkey loaded with bread and a jug of wine, and he took a young goat, and sent them to Saul by his son David.
verses.textEn: So Jesse took a donkey loaded with bread, a skin of wine and a young goat and sent them with his son David to Saul.

verses.textZh: 大卫到了扫罗那里，就侍立在他面前。扫罗很爱他，他就作了替扫罗拿武器的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫到了扫罗那里，就侍立在他面前。扫罗很爱他，他就作了替扫罗拿武器的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫到了扫罗那里，就侍立在扫罗面前。扫罗甚喜爱他，他就作了扫罗拿兵器的人。
verses.textEnNiv: David came to Saul and entered his service. Saul liked him very much, and David became one of his armor-bearers.
verses.textEnEsv: And David came to Saul and entered his service. And Saul loved him greatly, and he became his armor-bearer.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David came to Saul and stood before him. And he loved him greatly, and he became his armorbearer.
verses.textEnNlt: So David went to Saul and began serving him. Saul loved David very much, and David became his armor bearer.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David came to Saul and attended him; and Saul greatly loved him, and he became his armor bearer.
verses.textEn: David came to Saul and entered his service. Saul liked him very much, and David became one of his armor-bearers.

verses.textZh: 扫罗再派人到耶西那里去，说："请你让大卫侍立在我面前吧，因为我喜欢他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗再派人到耶西那里去，说："请你让大卫侍立在我面前吧，因为我喜欢他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗差遣人去见耶西，说：「求你容大卫侍立在我面前，因为他在我眼前蒙了恩。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Saul sent word to Jesse, saying, "Allow David to remain in my service, for I am pleased with him."
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul sent to Jesse, saying, "Let David remain in my service, for he has found favor in my sight."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul sent to Jesse, saying, "Please let David stand before me, for he has found favor in my sight."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Saul sent word to Jesse asking, "Please let David remain in my service, for I am very pleased with him."
verses.textEnNasb: So Saul sent word to Jesse, saying, "Let David now be my attendant for he has found favor in my sight."
verses.textEn: Then Saul sent word to Jesse, saying, "Allow David to remain in my service, for I am pleased with him."

verses.textZh: 每逢从神那里来的恶鬼临到扫罗身上的时候，大卫就拿起琴来弹奏，扫罗就舒服畅快，恶鬼也离开了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每逢从神那里来的恶鬼临到扫罗身上的时候，大卫就拿起琴来弹奏，扫罗就舒服畅快，恶鬼也离开了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 从神那里来的恶魔临到扫罗身上的时候，大卫就拿琴，用手而弹，扫罗便舒畅爽快，恶魔离了他。
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever the spirit from God came on Saul, David would take up his lyre and play. Then relief would come to Saul; he would feel better, and the evil spirit would leave him.
verses.textEnEsv: And whenever the harmful spirit from God was upon Saul, David took the lyre and played it with his hand. So Saul was refreshed and was well, and the harmful spirit departed from him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, whenever the spirit from God was upon Saul, that David would take a harp and play it with his hand. Then Saul would become refreshed and well, and the distressing spirit would depart from him.
verses.textEnNlt: And whenever the tormenting spirit from God troubled Saul, David would play the harp. Then Saul would feel better, and the tormenting spirit would go away.
verses.textEnNasb: So it came about whenever the evil spirit from God came to Saul, David would take the harp and play it with his hand; and Saul would feel relieved and become well, and the evil spirit would leave him.
verses.textEn: Whenever the spirit from God came on Saul, David would take up his lyre and play. Then relief would come to Saul; he would feel better, and the evil spirit would leave him.

verses.textZh: 非利士人聚集他们的军队作战。他们聚集在属犹大的梭哥，在梭哥和亚西加之间的以弗．大悯安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人聚集他们的军队作战。他们聚集在属犹大的梭哥，在梭哥和亚西加之间的以弗．大悯安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人招聚他们的军旅，要来争战；聚集在属犹大的梭哥，安营在梭哥和亚西加中间的以弗‧大悯。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Philistines gathered their forces for war and assembled at Sokoh in Judah. They pitched camp at Ephes Dammim, between Sokoh and Azekah.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the Philistines gathered their armies for battle. And they were gathered at Socoh, which belongs to Judah, and encamped between Socoh and Azekah, in Ephes-dammim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Philistines gathered their armies together to battle, and were gathered at Sochoh, which belongs to Judah; they encamped between Sochoh and Azekah, in Ephes Dammim.
verses.textEnNlt: The Philistines now mustered their army for battle and camped between Socoh in Judah and Azekah at Ephes-dammim.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Philistines gathered their armies for battle; and they were gathered at Socoh which belongs to Judah, and they camped between Socoh and Azekah, in Ephes-dammim.
verses.textEn: Now the Philistines gathered their forces for war and assembled at Sokoh in Judah. They pitched camp at Ephes Dammim, between Sokoh and Azekah.

verses.textZh: 扫罗和以色列人也聚集起来，在以拉谷安营；他们列出战阵，要迎战非利士人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗和以色列人也聚集起来，在以拉谷安营；他们列出战阵，要迎战非利士人。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗和以色列人也聚集，在以拉谷安营，摆列队伍，要与非利士人打仗。
verses.textEnNiv: Saul and the Israelites assembled and camped in the Valley of Elah and drew up their battle line to meet the Philistines.
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul and the men of Israel were gathered, and encamped in the Valley of Elah, and drew up in line of battle against the Philistines.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and they encamped in the Valley of Elah, and drew up in battle array against the Philistines.
verses.textEnNlt: Saul countered by gathering his Israelite troops near the valley of Elah.
verses.textEnNasb: Saul and the men of Israel were assembled and camped in the Valley of Elah, and they drew up in battle formation to confront the Philistines.
verses.textEn: Saul and the Israelites assembled and camped in the Valley of Elah and drew up their battle line to meet the Philistines.

verses.textZh: 非利士人站在这边山上，以色列人站在那边山上，中间有山谷分隔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人站在这边山上，以色列人站在那边山上，中间有山谷分隔。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人站在这边山上，以色列人站在那边山上，当中有谷。
verses.textEnNiv: The Philistines occupied one hill and the Israelites another, with the valley between them.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Philistines stood on the mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on the mountain on the other side, with a valley between them.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Philistines stood on a mountain on one side, and Israel stood on a mountain on the other side, with a valley between them.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Philistines and Israelites faced each other on opposite hills, with the valley between them.
verses.textEnNasb: The Philistines were standing on the mountain on one side, while Israel was standing on the mountain on the other side, with the valley between them.
verses.textEn: The Philistines occupied one hill and the Israelites another, with the valley between them.

verses.textZh: 有一个挑战的人从非利士人的军营中出来，名叫歌利亚，是迦特人，身高三公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个挑战的人从非利士人的军营中出来，名叫歌利亚，是迦特人，身高三公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 从非利士营中出来一个讨战的人，名叫歌利亚，是迦特人，身高六肘零一虎口；
verses.textEnNiv: A champion named Goliath, who was from Gath, came out of the Philistine camp. His height was six cubits and a span.
verses.textEnEsv: And there came out from the camp of the Philistines a champion named Goliath of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.
verses.textEnNkjv: And a champion went out from the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, from Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Goliath, a Philistine champion from Gath, came out of the Philistine ranks to face the forces of Israel. He was over nine feet tall!
verses.textEnNasb: Then a champion came forward from the army encampment of the Philistines, named Goliath, from Gath. His height was six cubits and a span.
verses.textEn: A champion named Goliath, who was from Gath, came out of the Philistine camp. His height was six cubits and a span.

verses.textZh: 他头戴铜盔，身穿铠甲，铠甲的铜重五十七公斤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他头戴铜盔，身穿铠甲，铠甲的铜重五十七公斤。
verses.textZhCuv: 头戴铜盔，身穿铠甲，甲重五千舍客勒；
verses.textEnNiv: He had a bronze helmet on his head and wore a coat of scale armor of bronze weighing five thousand shekels ;
verses.textEnEsv: He had a helmet of bronze on his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail, and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hehad a bronze helmet on his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail, and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: He wore a bronze helmet, and his bronze coat of mail weighed 125 pounds.
verses.textEnNasb: And he had a bronze helmet on his head, and he wore scale-armor which weighed five thousand shekels of bronze.
verses.textEn: He had a bronze helmet on his head and wore a coat of scale armor of bronze weighing five thousand shekels ;

verses.textZh: 他的腿上有铜护膝，两肩之间背着一根铜枪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的腿上有铜护膝，两肩之间背着一根铜枪。
verses.textZhCuv: 腿上有铜护膝，两肩之中背负铜戟；
verses.textEnNiv: on his legs he wore bronze greaves, and a bronze javelin was slung on his back.
verses.textEnEsv: And he had bronze armor on his legs, and a javelin of bronze slung between his shoulders.
verses.textEnNkjv: And hehad bronze armor on his legs and a bronze javelin between his shoulders.
verses.textEnNlt: He also wore bronze leg armor, and he carried a bronze javelin on his shoulder.
verses.textEnNasb: He also had bronze greaves on his legs and a bronze saber slung between his shoulders.
verses.textEn: on his legs he wore bronze greaves, and a bronze javelin was slung on his back.

verses.textZh: 另外，他手上拿着矛，矛杆有织布的机轴那么粗，矛头的铁重七公斤。还有一个拿大盾牌的人在他前面走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 另外，他手上拿着矛，矛杆有织布的机轴那么粗，矛头的铁重七公斤。还有一个拿大盾牌的人在他前面走。
verses.textZhCuv: 枪杆粗如织布的机轴，铁枪头重六百舍客勒。有一个拿盾牌的人在他前面走。
verses.textEnNiv: His spear shaft was like a weaver’s rod, and its iron point weighed six hundred shekels. His shield bearer went ahead of him.
verses.textEnEsv: The shaft of his spear was like a weaver’s beam, and his spear’s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron. And his shield-bearer went before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the staff of his spear was like a weaver’s beam, and his iron spearhead weighed six hundred shekels; and a shield-bearer went before him.
verses.textEnNlt: The shaft of his spear was as heavy and thick as a weaver’s beam, tipped with an iron spearhead that weighed 15 pounds. His armor bearer walked ahead of him carrying a shield.
verses.textEnNasb: The shaft of his spear was like a weaver’s beam, and the head of his spear weighed six hundred shekels of iron; and his shield-carrier walked in front of him.
verses.textEn: His spear shaft was like a weaver’s rod, and its iron point weighed six hundred shekels. His shield bearer went ahead of him.

verses.textZh: 歌利亚站着，向着以色列人的军队喊叫，对他们说："你们为甚么出来这里摆列战阵呢？我不是非利士人吗？你们不是扫罗的仆人吗？你们自己挑选一个人，叫他下到我这里来吧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 歌利亚站着，向着以色列人的军队喊叫，对他们说："你们为甚么出来这里摆列战阵呢？我不是非利士人吗？你们不是扫罗的仆人吗？你们自己挑选一个人，叫他下到我这里来吧。
verses.textZhCuv: 歌利亚对着以色列的军队站立，呼叫说：「你们出来摆列队伍做什么呢？我不是非利士人吗？你们不是扫罗的仆人吗？可以从你们中间拣选一人，使他下到我这里来。
verses.textEnNiv: Goliath stood and shouted to the ranks of Israel, "Why do you come out and line up for battle? Am I not a Philistine, and are you not the servants of Saul? Choose a man and have him come down to me.
verses.textEnEsv: He stood and shouted to the ranks of Israel, "Why have you come out to draw up for battle? Am I not a Philistine, and are you not servants of Saul? Choose a man for yourselves, and let him come down to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he stood and cried out to the armies of Israel, and said to them, "Why have you come out to line up for battle? Am I not a Philistine, and you the servants of Saul? Choose a man for yourselves, and let him come down to me.
verses.textEnNlt: Goliath stood and shouted a taunt across to the Israelites. "Why are you all coming out to fight?" he called. "I am the Philistine champion, but you are only the servants of Saul. Choose one man to come down here and fight me!
verses.textEnNasb: He stood and shouted to the ranks of Israel and said to them, "Why do you come out to draw up in battle formation? Am I not the Philistine, and you the servants of Saul? Choose a man as your representative and have him come down to me.
verses.textEn: Goliath stood and shouted to the ranks of Israel, "Why do you come out and line up for battle? Am I not a Philistine, and are you not the servants of Saul? Choose a man and have him come down to me.

verses.textZh: 如果他能与我决斗，击杀了我，我们就作你们的奴仆；但是，如果我能胜过他，击杀了他，你们就作我们的奴仆，服事我们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他能与我决斗，击杀了我，我们就作你们的奴仆；但是，如果我能胜过他，击杀了他，你们就作我们的奴仆，服事我们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他若能与我战斗，将我杀死，我们就作你们的仆人；我若胜了他，将他杀死，你们就作我们的仆人，服事我们。」
verses.textEnNiv: If he is able to fight and kill me, we will become your subjects; but if I overcome him and kill him, you will become our subjects and serve us."
verses.textEnEsv: If he is able to fight with me and kill me, then we will be your servants. But if I prevail against him and kill him, then you shall be our servants and serve us."
verses.textEnNkjv: If he is able to fight with me and kill me, then we will be your servants. But if I prevail against him and kill him, then you shall be our servants and serve us."
verses.textEnNlt: If he kills me, then we will be your slaves. But if I kill him, you will be our slaves!
verses.textEnNasb: If he is able to fight me and kill me, then we will become your servants; but if I prevail against him and kill him, then you shall become our servants and serve us."
verses.textEn: If he is able to fight and kill me, we will become your subjects; but if I overcome him and kill him, you will become our subjects and serve us."

verses.textZh: 那非利士人又说："今天我向以色列人的军队骂阵。你们派一个人出来，我们可以决斗！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那非利士人又说："今天我向以色列人的军队骂阵。你们派一个人出来，我们可以决斗！"
verses.textZhCuv: 那非利士人又说：「我今日向以色列人的军队骂阵。你们叫一个人出来，与我战斗。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Philistine said, "This day I defy the armies of Israel! Give me a man and let us fight each other."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Philistine said, "I defy the ranks of Israel this day. Give me a man, that we may fight together."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Philistine said, "I defy the armies of Israel this day; give me a man, that we may fight together."
verses.textEnNlt: I defy the armies of Israel today! Send me a man who will fight me!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Philistine said, "I have defied the ranks of Israel this day! Give me a man, so that we may fight together."
verses.textEn: Then the Philistine said, "This day I defy the armies of Israel! Give me a man and let us fight each other."

verses.textZh: 扫罗和以色列众人听见了那非利士人所说的这些话，就都惊惶，非常害怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗和以色列众人听见了那非利士人所说的这些话，就都惊惶，非常害怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗和以色列众人听见非利士人的这些话，就惊惶，极其害怕。
verses.textEnNiv: On hearing the Philistine’s words, Saul and all the Israelites were dismayed and terrified.
verses.textEnEsv: When Saul and all Israel heard these words of the Philistine, they were dismayed and greatly afraid.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Saul and all Israel heard these words of the Philistine, they were dismayed and greatly afraid.
verses.textEnNlt: When Saul and the Israelites heard this, they were terrified and deeply shaken.
verses.textEnNasb: When Saul and all Israel heard these words of the Philistine, they were dismayed and very fearful.
verses.textEn: On hearing the Philistine’s words, Saul and all the Israelites were dismayed and terrified.

verses.textZh: 大卫是犹大伯利恒的以法他人耶西的儿子；耶西有八个儿子。在扫罗的日子，耶西已经年纪老迈了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫是犹大伯利恒的以法他人耶西的儿子；耶西有八个儿子。在扫罗的日子，耶西已经年纪老迈了。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫是犹大伯利恒的以法他人耶西的儿子。耶西有八个儿子。当扫罗的时候，耶西已经老迈。
verses.textEnNiv: Now David was the son of an Ephrathite named Jesse, who was from Bethlehem in Judah. Jesse had eight sons, and in Saul’s time he was very old.
verses.textEnEsv: Now David was the son of an Ephrathite of Bethlehem in Judah, named Jesse, who had eight sons. In the days of Saul the man was already old and advanced in years.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Bethlehem Judah, whose name was Jesse, and who had eight sons. And the man was old, advanced inyears, in the days of Saul.
verses.textEnNlt: Now David was the son of a man named Jesse, an Ephrathite from Bethlehem in the land of Judah. Jesse was an old man at that time, and he had eight sons.
verses.textEnNasb: Now David was the son of the Ephrathite of Bethlehem in Judah, the man whose name was Jesse, and he had eight sons. And Jesse was old in the days of Saul, advanced in years among men.
verses.textEn: Now David was the son of an Ephrathite named Jesse, who was from Bethlehem in Judah. Jesse had eight sons, and in Saul’s time he was very old.

verses.textZh: 耶西的三个大儿子跟随了扫罗去作战。去了作战的这三个儿子的名字是：长子以利押、次子亚比拿达、三子沙玛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶西的三个大儿子跟随了扫罗去作战。去了作战的这三个儿子的名字是：长子以利押、次子亚比拿达、三子沙玛。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶西的三个大儿子跟随扫罗出征。这出征的三个儿子：长子名叫以利押，次子名叫亚比拿达，三子名叫沙玛。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesse’s three oldest sons had followed Saul to the war: The firstborn was Eliab; the second, Abinadab; and the third, Shammah.
verses.textEnEsv: The three oldest sons of Jesse had followed Saul to the battle. And the names of his three sons who went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next to him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The three oldest sons of Jesse had gone to follow Saul to the battle. The names of his three sons who went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, next to him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesse’s three oldest sons—Eliab, Abinadab, and Shimea —had already joined Saul’s army to fight the Philistines.
verses.textEnNasb: The three older sons of Jesse had followed Saul to the battle. And the names of his three sons who had gone into the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and second to him, Abinadab, and the third, Shammah.
verses.textEn: Jesse’s three oldest sons had followed Saul to the war: The firstborn was Eliab; the second, Abinadab; and the third, Shammah.

verses.textZh: 大卫是最小的，那三个年长的都跟随扫罗去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫是最小的，那三个年长的都跟随扫罗去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫是最小的；那三个大儿子跟随扫罗。
verses.textEnNiv: David was the youngest. The three oldest followed Saul,
verses.textEnEsv: David was the youngest. The three eldest followed Saul,
verses.textEnNkjv: David was the youngest. And the three oldest followed Saul.
verses.textEnNlt: David was the youngest son. David’s three oldest brothers stayed with Saul’s army,
verses.textEnNasb: So David was the youngest. Now the three oldest followed Saul,
verses.textEn: David was the youngest. The three oldest followed Saul,

verses.textZh: 大卫有时离开扫罗，回到伯利恒牧放他父亲的羊群。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫有时离开扫罗，回到伯利恒牧放他父亲的羊群。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫有时离开扫罗，回伯利恒放他父亲的羊。
verses.textEnNiv: but David went back and forth from Saul to tend his father’s sheep at Bethlehem.
verses.textEnEsv: but David went back and forth from Saul to feed his father’s sheep at Bethlehem.
verses.textEnNkjv: But David occasionally went and returned from Saul to feed his father’s sheep at Bethlehem.
verses.textEnNlt: but David went back and forth so he could help his father with the sheep in Bethlehem.
verses.textEnNasb: but David went back and forth from Saul to tend his father’s flock at Bethlehem.
verses.textEn: but David went back and forth from Saul to tend his father’s sheep at Bethlehem.

verses.textZh: 那非利士人每天早晚都近前来，站着骂阵，一连有四十天之久。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那非利士人每天早晚都近前来，站着骂阵，一连有四十天之久。
verses.textZhCuv: 那非利士人早晚都出来站着，如此四十日。
verses.textEnNiv: For forty days the Philistine came forward every morning and evening and took his stand.
verses.textEnEsv: For forty days the Philistine came forward and took his stand, morning and evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Philistine drew near and presented himself forty days, morning and evening.
verses.textEnNlt: For forty days, every morning and evening, the Philistine champion strutted in front of the Israelite army.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Philistine came forward morning and evening, and took his stand for forty days.
verses.textEn: For forty days the Philistine came forward every morning and evening and took his stand.

verses.textZh: 有一天，耶西对他的儿子大卫说："你拿这十公斤烘了的谷子和这十个饼去给你的哥哥们；你要跑到营里去给你的哥哥们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一天，耶西对他的儿子大卫说："你拿这十公斤烘了的谷子和这十个饼去给你的哥哥们；你要跑到营里去给你的哥哥们，
verses.textZhCuv: 一日，耶西对他儿子大卫说：「你拿一伊法烘了的穗子和十个饼，速速地送到营里去，交给你哥哥们；
verses.textEnNiv: Now Jesse said to his son David, "Take this ephah of roasted grain and these ten loaves of bread for your brothers and hurry to their camp.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesse said to David his son, "Take for your brothers an ephah of this parched grain, and these ten loaves, and carry them quickly to the camp to your brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesse said to his son David, "Take now for your brothers an ephah of this dried grain and these ten loaves, and run to your brothers at the camp.
verses.textEnNlt: One day Jesse said to David, "Take this basket of roasted grain and these ten loaves of bread, and carry them quickly to your brothers.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jesse said to his son David, "Take now for your brothers an ephah of this roasted grain and these ten loaves, and run to the camp to your brothers.
verses.textEn: Now Jesse said to his son David, "Take this ephah of roasted grain and these ten loaves of bread for your brothers and hurry to their camp.

verses.textZh: 又拿这十块乳酪去给他们的千夫长，看看你的哥哥们平安不平安，把他们的家书带回来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又拿这十块乳酪去给他们的千夫长，看看你的哥哥们平安不平安，把他们的家书带回来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 再拿这十块奶饼，送给他们的千夫长，且问你哥哥们好，向他们要一封信来。」
verses.textEnNiv: Take along these ten cheeses to the commander of their unit. See how your brothers are and bring back some assurance from them.
verses.textEnEsv: Also take these ten cheeses to the commander of their thousand. See if your brothers are well, and bring some token from them."
verses.textEnNkjv: And carry these ten cheeses to the captain of their thousand, and see how your brothers fare, and bring back news of them."
verses.textEnNlt: And give these ten cuts of cheese to their captain. See how your brothers are getting along, and bring back a report on how they are doing. "
verses.textEnNasb: Bring also these ten slices of cheese to the commander of their thousand, and look into the well-being of your brothers and bring back confirmation from them.
verses.textEn: Take along these ten cheeses to the commander of their unit. See how your brothers are and bring back some assurance from them.

verses.textZh: 扫罗和大卫的哥哥们，以及以色列众人都在以拉谷与非利士人作战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗和大卫的哥哥们，以及以色列众人都在以拉谷与非利士人作战。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗与大卫的三个哥哥和以色列众人，在以拉谷与非利士人打仗。
verses.textEnNiv: They are with Saul and all the men of Israel in the Valley of Elah, fighting against the Philistines."
verses.textEnEsv: Now Saul and they and all the men of Israel were in the Valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Saul and they and all the men of Israel were in the Valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.
verses.textEnNlt: David’s brothers were with Saul and the Israelite army at the valley of Elah, fighting against the Philistines.
verses.textEnNasb: For Saul and they and all the men of Israel are in the Valley of Elah, fighting the Philistines."
verses.textEn: They are with Saul and all the men of Israel in the Valley of Elah, fighting against the Philistines."

verses.textZh: 大卫清早起来，把羊群托给一个看守的人，就照着耶西所吩咐他的，带着食物去了。他来到军营中的时候，军队正出去列阵，吶喊助阵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫清早起来，把羊群托给一个看守的人，就照着耶西所吩咐他的，带着食物去了。他来到军营中的时候，军队正出去列阵，吶喊助阵。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫早晨起来，将羊交托一个看守的人，照着他父亲所吩咐的话，带着食物去了。到了辎重营，军兵刚出到战场，呐喊要战。
verses.textEnNiv: Early in the morning David left the flock in the care of a shepherd, loaded up and set out, as Jesse had directed. He reached the camp as the army was going out to its battle positions, shouting the war cry.
verses.textEnEsv: And David rose early in the morning and left the sheep with a keeper and took the provisions and went, as Jesse had commanded him. And he came to the encampment as the host was going out to the battle line, shouting the war cry.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David rose early in the morning, left the sheep with a keeper, and took thethings and went as Jesse had commanded him. And he came to the camp as the army was going out to the fight and shouting for the battle.
verses.textEnNlt: So David left the sheep with another shepherd and set out early the next morning with the gifts, as Jesse had directed him. He arrived at the camp just as the Israelite army was leaving for the battlefield with shouts and battle cries.
verses.textEnNasb: So David got up early in the morning and left the flock with a keeper, and took the supplies and went as Jesse had commanded him. And he came to the entrenchment encircling the camp while the army was going out in battle formation, shouting the war cry.
verses.textEn: Early in the morning David left the flock in the care of a shepherd, loaded up and set out, as Jesse had directed. He reached the camp as the army was going out to its battle positions, shouting the war cry.

verses.textZh: 以色列人和非利士人都摆列阵势，互相对峙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人和非利士人都摆列阵势，互相对峙。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人和非利士人都摆列队伍，彼此相对。
verses.textEnNiv: Israel and the Philistines were drawing up their lines facing each other.
verses.textEnEsv: And Israel and the Philistines drew up for battle, army against army.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Israel and the Philistines had drawn up in battle array, army against army.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon the Israelite and Philistine forces stood facing each other, army against army.
verses.textEnNasb: Israel and the Philistines drew up in battle formation, army against army.
verses.textEn: Israel and the Philistines were drawing up their lines facing each other.

verses.textZh: 大卫把身上的东西留在看守物件的人手中，跑到战阵上去，向他的哥哥们问安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫把身上的东西留在看守物件的人手中，跑到战阵上去，向他的哥哥们问安。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫把他带来的食物留在看守物件人的手下，跑到战场，问他哥哥们安。
verses.textEnNiv: David left his things with the keeper of supplies, ran to the battle lines and asked his brothers how they were.
verses.textEnEsv: And David left the things in charge of the keeper of the baggage and ran to the ranks and went and greeted his brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David left his supplies in the hand of the supply keeper, ran to the army, and came and greeted his brothers.
verses.textEnNlt: David left his things with the keeper of supplies and hurried out to the ranks to greet his brothers.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David left the baggage in the care of the baggage keeper and ran to the battle line. And he entered and greeted his brothers.
verses.textEn: David left his things with the keeper of supplies, ran to the battle lines and asked his brothers how they were.

verses.textZh: 大卫正与他们说话的时候，那个讨战的人，就是迦特的非利士人，名叫歌利亚，从非利士人阵中上来；他说的又是同样的那些话，大卫都听见了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫正与他们说话的时候，那个讨战的人，就是迦特的非利士人，名叫歌利亚，从非利士人阵中上来；他说的又是同样的那些话，大卫都听见了。
verses.textZhCuv: 与他们说话的时候，那讨战的，就是属迦特的非利士人歌利亚，从非利士队中出来，说从前所说的话；大卫都听见了。
verses.textEnNiv: As he was talking with them, Goliath, the Philistine champion from Gath, stepped out from his lines and shouted his usual defiance, and David heard it.
verses.textEnEsv: As he talked with them, behold, the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, came up out of the ranks of the Philistines and spoke the same words as before. And David heard him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then as he talked with them, there was the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, coming up from the armies of the Philistines; and he spoke according to the same words. So David heard them.
verses.textEnNlt: As he was talking with them, Goliath, the Philistine champion from Gath, came out from the Philistine ranks. Then David heard him shout his usual taunt to the army of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: As he was speaking with them, behold, the champion, the Philistine from Gath named Goliath, was coming up from the army of the Philistines, and he spoke these same words; and David heard him.
verses.textEn: As he was talking with them, Goliath, the Philistine champion from Gath, stepped out from his lines and shouted his usual defiance, and David heard it.

verses.textZh: 所有的以色列人一看见那人，就都从他面前逃跑，非常害怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有的以色列人一看见那人，就都从他面前逃跑，非常害怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列众人看见那人，就逃跑，极其害怕。
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever the Israelites saw the man, they all fled from him in great fear.
verses.textEnEsv: All the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him and were much afraid.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him and were dreadfully afraid.
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as the Israelite army saw him, they began to run away in fright.
verses.textEnNasb: When all the men of Israel saw the man, they fled from him and were very fearful.
verses.textEn: Whenever the Israelites saw the man, they all fled from him in great fear.

verses.textZh: 以色列人彼此说："这个上来的人你们看见了吗？他上来是要向以色列人骂阵的。如果有人能击杀他，王必赏赐他大财富，把自己的女儿给他作妻子，并且使他的父家在以色列中免纳税，免服役。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人彼此说："这个上来的人你们看见了吗？他上来是要向以色列人骂阵的。如果有人能击杀他，王必赏赐他大财富，把自己的女儿给他作妻子，并且使他的父家在以色列中免纳税，免服役。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人彼此说：「这上来的人你看见了吗？他上来是要向以色列人骂阵。若有能杀他的，王必赏赐他大财，将自己的女儿给他为妻，并在以色列人中免他父家纳粮当差。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Israelites had been saying, "Do you see how this man keeps coming out? He comes out to defy Israel. The king will give great wealth to the man who kills him. He will also give him his daughter in marriage and will exempt his family from taxes in Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: And the men of Israel said, "Have you seen this man who has come up? Surely he has come up to defy Israel. And the king will enrich the man who kills him with great riches and will give him his daughter and make his father’s house free in Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the men of Israel said, "Have you seen this man who has come up? Surely he has come up to defy Israel; and it shall be that the man who kills him the king will enrich with great riches, will give him his daughter, and give his father’s house exemption fromtaxes in Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: "Have you seen the giant?" the men asked. "He comes out each day to defy Israel. The king has offered a huge reward to anyone who kills him. He will give that man one of his daughters for a wife, and the man’s entire family will be exempted from paying taxes!"
verses.textEnNasb: And the men of Israel said, "Have you seen this man who is coming up? Surely he is coming up to defy Israel. And it will be that the king will make the man who kills him wealthy with great riches, and will give him his daughter and make his father’s house free in Israel."
verses.textEn: Now the Israelites had been saying, "Do you see how this man keeps coming out? He comes out to defy Israel. The king will give great wealth to the man who kills him. He will also give him his daughter in marriage and will exempt his family from taxes in Israel."

verses.textZh: 大卫问站在他旁边的人说："如果有人击杀这个非利士人，除去以色列人的耻辱，那人会得到怎么的对待呢？这未受割礼的非利士人是谁呢？竟敢向永活的神的军队骂阵？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫问站在他旁边的人说："如果有人击杀这个非利士人，除去以色列人的耻辱，那人会得到怎么的对待呢？这未受割礼的非利士人是谁呢？竟敢向永活的神的军队骂阵？"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫问站在旁边的人说：「有人杀这非利士人，除掉以色列人的耻辱，怎样待他呢？这未受割礼的非利士人是谁呢？竟敢向永生神的军队骂阵吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: David asked the men standing near him, "What will be done for the man who kills this Philistine and removes this disgrace from Israel? Who is this uncircumcised Philistine that he should defy the armies of the living God?"
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to the men who stood by him, "What shall be done for the man who kills this Philistine and takes away the reproach from Israel? For who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David spoke to the men who stood by him, saying, "What shall be done for the man who kills this Philistine and takes away the reproach from Israel? For who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?"
verses.textEnNlt: David asked the soldiers standing nearby, "What will a man get for killing this Philistine and ending his defiance of Israel? Who is this pagan Philistine anyway, that he is allowed to defy the armies of the living God?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to the men who were standing by him, "What will be done for the man who kills this Philistine and rids Israel of the disgrace? For who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he has dared to defy the armies of the living God?"
verses.textEn: David asked the men standing near him, "What will be done for the man who kills this Philistine and removes this disgrace from Israel? Who is this uncircumcised Philistine that he should defy the armies of the living God?"

verses.textZh: 于是众民用以上的那些话回答他说："如果有人能击杀他，那人必得这样的对待。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是众民用以上的那些话回答他说："如果有人能击杀他，那人必得这样的对待。"
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓照先前的话回答他说：「有人能杀这非利士人，必如此如此待他。」
verses.textEnNiv: They repeated to him what they had been saying and told him, "This is what will be done for the man who kills him."
verses.textEnEsv: And the people answered him in the same way, "So shall it be done to the man who kills him."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the people answered him in this manner, saying, "So shall it be done for the man who kills him."
verses.textEnNlt: And these men gave David the same reply. They said, "Yes, that is the reward for killing him."
verses.textEnNasb: The people answered him in agreement with this statement, saying, "This is what will be done for the man who kills him."
verses.textEn: They repeated to him what they had been saying and told him, "This is what will be done for the man who kills him."

verses.textZh: 大卫与那些人说话的时候，他的大哥以利押听见了，就向大卫发怒，说："你为甚么下这里来呢？在旷野的那几只羊你托了给谁呢？我知道你的骄傲和你心里的恶意。你下来是要看打仗。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫与那些人说话的时候，他的大哥以利押听见了，就向大卫发怒，说："你为甚么下这里来呢？在旷野的那几只羊你托了给谁呢？我知道你的骄傲和你心里的恶意。你下来是要看打仗。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫的长兄以利押听见大卫与他们所说的话，就向他发怒，说：「你下来做什么呢？在旷野的那几只羊，你交托了谁呢？我知道你的骄傲和你心里的恶意，你下来特为要看争战！」
verses.textEnNiv: When Eliab, David’s oldest brother, heard him speaking with the men, he burned with anger at him and asked, "Why have you come down here? And with whom did you leave those few sheep in the wilderness? I know how conceited you are and how wicked your heart is; you came down only to watch the battle."
verses.textEnEsv: Now Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spoke to the men. And Eliab’s anger was kindled against David, and he said, "Why have you come down? And with whom have you left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know your presumption and the evil of your heart, for you have come down to see the battle."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Eliab his oldest brother heard when he spoke to the men; and Eliab’s anger was aroused against David, and he said, "Why did you come down here? And with whom have you left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know your pride and the insolence of your heart, for you have come down to see the battle."
verses.textEnNlt: But when David’s oldest brother, Eliab, heard David talking to the men, he was angry. "What are you doing around here anyway?" he demanded. "What about those few sheep you’re supposed to be taking care of? I know about your pride and deceit. You just want to see the battle!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now Eliab his oldest brother heard him when he spoke to the men; and Eliab’s anger burned against David and he said, "Why is it that you have come down? And with whom have you left those few sheep in the wilderness? I myself know your insolence and the wickedness of your heart; for you have come down in order to see the battle."
verses.textEn: When Eliab, David’s oldest brother, heard him speaking with the men, he burned with anger at him and asked, "Why have you come down here? And with whom did you leave those few sheep in the wilderness? I know how conceited you are and how wicked your heart is; you came down only to watch the battle."

verses.textZh: 大卫说："我现在作了甚么事呢？不是只说了一句话吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫说："我现在作了甚么事呢？不是只说了一句话吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫说：「我做了什么呢？我来岂没有缘故吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Now what have I done?" said David. "Can’t I even speak?"
verses.textEnEsv: And David said, "What have I done now? Was it not but a word?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And David said, "What have I done now? Is there not a cause?"
verses.textEnNlt: "What have I done now?" David replied. "I was only asking a question!"
verses.textEnNasb: But David said, "What have I done now? Was it not just a question?"
verses.textEn: "Now what have I done?" said David. "Can’t I even speak?"

verses.textZh: 大卫离开他的哥哥，转向另一个人，问同样的问题。众民还是用先前的话回答他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫离开他的哥哥，转向另一个人，问同样的问题。众民还是用先前的话回答他。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫就离开他转向别人，照先前的话而问；百姓仍照先前的话回答他。
verses.textEnNiv: He then turned away to someone else and brought up the same matter, and the men answered him as before.
verses.textEnEsv: And he turned away from him toward another, and spoke in the same way, and the people answered him again as before.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he turned from him toward another and said the same thing; and these people answered him as the first ones did.
verses.textEnNlt: He walked over to some others and asked them the same thing and received the same answer.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he turned away from him to another and said the same thing; and the people replied with the same words as before.
verses.textEn: He then turned away to someone else and brought up the same matter, and the men answered him as before.

verses.textZh: 有人听见大卫所说的这些话，就告诉扫罗；扫罗就派人去把大卫接来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人听见大卫所说的这些话，就告诉扫罗；扫罗就派人去把大卫接来。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人听见大卫所说的话，就告诉了扫罗；扫罗便打发人叫他来。
verses.textEnNiv: What David said was overheard and reported to Saul, and Saul sent for him.
verses.textEnEsv: When the words that David spoke were heard, they repeated them before Saul, and he sent for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the words which David spoke were heard, they reported them to Saul; and he sent for him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David’s question was reported to King Saul, and the king sent for him.
verses.textEnNasb: When the words that David spoke were heard, they informed Saul, and he sent for him.
verses.textEn: What David said was overheard and reported to Saul, and Saul sent for him.

verses.textZh: 大卫对扫罗说："大家都不要因这非利士人丧胆，你的仆人要去与这非利士人决斗。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对扫罗说："大家都不要因这非利士人丧胆，你的仆人要去与这非利士人决斗。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对扫罗说：「人都不必因那非利士人胆怯。你的仆人要去与那非利士人战斗。」
verses.textEnNiv: David said to Saul, "Let no one lose heart on account of this Philistine; your servant will go and fight him."
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to Saul, "Let no man’s heart fail because of him. Your servant will go and fight with this Philistine."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David said to Saul, "Let no man’s heart fail because of him; your servant will go and fight with this Philistine."
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t worry about this Philistine," David told Saul. "I’ll go fight him!"
verses.textEnNasb: And David said to Saul, "May no one’s heart fail on account of him; your servant will go and fight this Philistine!"
verses.textEn: David said to Saul, "Let no one lose heart on account of this Philistine; your servant will go and fight him."

verses.textZh: 扫罗对大卫说："你不能去与这非利士人决斗，因为你年纪还轻，那人从小就作战士。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗对大卫说："你不能去与这非利士人决斗，因为你年纪还轻，那人从小就作战士。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗对大卫说：「你不能去与那非利士人战斗；因为你年纪太轻，他自幼就作战士。」
verses.textEnNiv: Saul replied, "You are not able to go out against this Philistine and fight him; you are only a young man, and he has been a warrior from his youth."
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul said to David, "You are not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him, for you are but a youth, and he has been a man of war from his youth."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Saul said to David, "You are not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him; for you are a youth, and he a man of war from his youth."
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t be ridiculous!" Saul replied. "There’s no way you can fight this Philistine and possibly win! You’re only a boy, and he’s been a man of war since his youth."
verses.textEnNasb: But Saul said to David, "You are not able to go against this Philistine to fight him; for you are only a youth, while he has been a warrior since his youth."
verses.textEn: Saul replied, "You are not able to go out against this Philistine and fight him; you are only a young man, and he has been a warrior from his youth."

verses.textZh: 大卫对扫罗说："你仆人是为父亲放羊的，有时狮子或熊来了，从羊群中抓去一只小羊，
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对扫罗说："你仆人是为父亲放羊的，有时狮子或熊来了，从羊群中抓去一只小羊，
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对扫罗说：「你仆人为父亲放羊，有时来了狮子，有时来了熊，从群中衔一只羊羔去。
verses.textEnNiv: But David said to Saul, "Your servant has been keeping his father’s sheep. When a lion or a bear came and carried off a sheep from the flock,
verses.textEnEsv: But David said to Saul, "Your servant used to keep sheep for his father. And when there came a lion, or a bear, and took a lamb from the flock,
verses.textEnNkjv: But David said to Saul, "Your servant used to keep his father’s sheep, and when a lion or a bear came and took a lamb out of the flock,
verses.textEnNlt: But David persisted. "I have been taking care of my father’s sheep and goats," he said. "When a lion or a bear comes to steal a lamb from the flock,
verses.textEnNasb: But David said to Saul, "Your servant was tending his father’s sheep. When a lion or a bear came and took a sheep from the flock,
verses.textEn: But David said to Saul, "Your servant has been keeping his father’s sheep. When a lion or a bear came and carried off a sheep from the flock,

verses.textZh: 我就出去追赶牠，击打牠，从牠的嘴里把小羊救出来。如果牠起来攻击我，我就揪住牠的胡须，击打牠，把牠杀死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就出去追赶牠，击打牠，从牠的嘴里把小羊救出来。如果牠起来攻击我，我就揪住牠的胡须，击打牠，把牠杀死。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就追赶它，击打它，将羊羔从它口中救出来。它起来要害我，我就揪着它的胡子，将它打死。
verses.textEnNiv: I went after it, struck it and rescued the sheep from its mouth. When it turned on me, I seized it by its hair, struck it and killed it.
verses.textEnEsv: I went after him and struck him and delivered it out of his mouth. And if he arose against me, I caught him by his beard and struck him and killed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: I went out after it and struck it, and delivered thelamb from its mouth; and when it arose against me, I caught it by its beard, and struck and killed it.
verses.textEnNlt: I go after it with a club and rescue the lamb from its mouth. If the animal turns on me, I catch it by the jaw and club it to death.
verses.textEnNasb: I went out after it and attacked it, and rescued the sheep from its mouth; and when it rose up against me, I grabbed it by its mane and struck it and killed it.
verses.textEn: I went after it, struck it and rescued the sheep from its mouth. When it turned on me, I seized it by its hair, struck it and killed it.

verses.textZh: 你仆人不但击杀过狮子，也击杀过熊。这个未受割礼的非利士人也必像一只狮子或熊一样，因为他向永活的神的军队骂阵。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你仆人不但击杀过狮子，也击杀过熊。这个未受割礼的非利士人也必像一只狮子或熊一样，因为他向永活的神的军队骂阵。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你仆人曾打死狮子和熊，这未受割礼的非利士人向永生神的军队骂阵，也必像狮子和熊一般。」
verses.textEnNiv: Your servant has killed both the lion and the bear; this uncircumcised Philistine will be like one of them, because he has defied the armies of the living God.
verses.textEnEsv: Your servant has struck down both lions and bears, and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be like one of them, for he has defied the armies of the living God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Your servant has killed both lion and bear; and this uncircumcised Philistine will be like one of them, seeing he has defied the armies of the living God."
verses.textEnNlt: I have done this to both lions and bears, and I’ll do it to this pagan Philistine, too, for he has defied the armies of the living God!
verses.textEnNasb: Your servant has killed both the lion and the bear; and this uncircumcised Philistine will be like one of them, since he has defied the armies of the living God."
verses.textEn: Your servant has killed both the lion and the bear; this uncircumcised Philistine will be like one of them, because he has defied the armies of the living God.

verses.textZh: 大卫又说："那曾救我脱离狮爪和熊掌的耶和华，也必救我脱离这非利士人的手。"于是扫罗对大卫说："你去吧！愿耶和华与你同在。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫又说："那曾救我脱离狮爪和熊掌的耶和华，也必救我脱离这非利士人的手。"于是扫罗对大卫说："你去吧！愿耶和华与你同在。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫又说：「耶和华救我脱离狮子和熊的爪，也必救我脱离这非利士人的手。」扫罗对大卫说：「你可以去吧！耶和华必与你同在。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord who rescued me from the paw of the lion and the paw of the bear will rescue me from the hand of this Philistine." Saul said to David, "Go, and the Lord be with you."
verses.textEnEsv: And David said, "The Lord who delivered me from the paw of the lion and from the paw of the bear will deliver me from the hand of this Philistine." And Saul said to David, "Go, and the Lord be with you!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover David said, "The Lord, who delivered me from the paw of the lion and from the paw of the bear, He will deliver me from the hand of this Philistine." And Saul said to David, "Go, and the Lord be with you!"
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord who rescued me from the claws of the lion and the bear will rescue me from this Philistine!" Saul finally consented. "All right, go ahead," he said. "And may the Lord be with you!"
verses.textEnNasb: And David said, "The Lord who saved me from the paw of the lion and the paw of the bear, He will save me from the hand of this Philistine." So Saul said to David, "Go, and may the Lord be with you."
verses.textEn: The Lord who rescued me from the paw of the lion and the paw of the bear will rescue me from the hand of this Philistine." Saul said to David, "Go, and the Lord be with you."

verses.textZh: 扫罗把自己的战袍给大卫穿上，把铜盔戴在他的头上，又给他穿上铠甲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗把自己的战袍给大卫穿上，把铜盔戴在他的头上，又给他穿上铠甲。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗就把自己的战衣给大卫穿上，将铜盔给他戴上，又给他穿上铠甲。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Saul dressed David in his own tunic. He put a coat of armor on him and a bronze helmet on his head.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Saul clothed David with his armor. He put a helmet of bronze on his head and clothed him with a coat of mail,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Saul clothed David with his armor, and he put a bronze helmet on his head; he also clothed him with a coat of mail.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Saul gave David his own armor—a bronze helmet and a coat of mail.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul clothed David with his military attire and put a bronze helmet on his head, and outfitted him with armor.
verses.textEn: Then Saul dressed David in his own tunic. He put a coat of armor on him and a bronze helmet on his head.

verses.textZh: 大卫把刀佩带在战袍上。因为他以前没有穿过，现在试着走一下。大卫对扫罗说："穿戴着这些东西，我不能走动，因为我从前没有穿过。"大卫就把这些装备从身上脱下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫把刀佩带在战袍上。因为他以前没有穿过，现在试着走一下。大卫对扫罗说："穿戴着这些东西，我不能走动，因为我从前没有穿过。"大卫就把这些装备从身上脱下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫把刀跨在战衣外，试试能走不能走；因为素来没有穿惯，就对扫罗说：「我穿戴这些不能走，因为素来没有穿惯。」于是摘脱了。
verses.textEnNiv: David fastened on his sword over the tunic and tried walking around, because he was not used to them. "I cannot go in these," he said to Saul, "because I am not used to them." So he took them off.
verses.textEnEsv: and David strapped his sword over his armor. And he tried in vain to go, for he had not tested them. Then David said to Saul, "I cannot go with these, for I have not tested them." So David put them off.
verses.textEnNkjv: David fastened his sword to his armor and tried to walk, for he had not tested them. And David said to Saul, "I cannot walk with these, for I have not tested them." So David took them off.
verses.textEnNlt: David put it on, strapped the sword over it, and took a step or two to see what it was like, for he had never worn such things before. "I can’t go in these," he protested to Saul. "I’m not used to them." So David took them off again.
verses.textEnNasb: And David strapped on his sword over his military attire and struggled at walking, for he had not trained with the armor. So David said to Saul, "I cannot go with these, because I have not trained with them." And David took them off.
verses.textEn: David fastened on his sword over the tunic and tried walking around, because he was not used to them. "I cannot go in these," he said to Saul, "because I am not used to them." So he took them off.

verses.textZh: 他手中拿着自己的杖，又从溪里挑选了五块光滑的石子，放在口袋里，就是牧人用的那种袋子，手里又拿着甩石的机弦，就向那非利士人走近去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他手中拿着自己的杖，又从溪里挑选了五块光滑的石子，放在口袋里，就是牧人用的那种袋子，手里又拿着甩石的机弦，就向那非利士人走近去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他手中拿杖，又在溪中挑选了五块光滑石子，放在袋里，就是牧人带的囊里；手中拿着甩石的机弦，就去迎那非利士人。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he took his staff in his hand, chose five smooth stones from the stream, put them in the pouch of his shepherd’s bag and, with his sling in his hand, approached the Philistine.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he took his staff in his hand and chose five smooth stones from the brook and put them in his shepherd’s pouch. His sling was in his hand, and he approached the Philistine.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he took his staff in his hand; and he chose for himself five smooth stones from the brook, and put them in a shepherd’s bag, in a pouch which he had, and his sling was in his hand. And he drew near to the Philistine.
verses.textEnNlt: He picked up five smooth stones from a stream and put them into his shepherd’s bag. Then, armed only with his shepherd’s staff and sling, he started across the valley to fight the Philistine.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he took his staff in his hand and chose for himself five smooth stones from the brook, and put them in the shepherd’s bag which he had, that is, in his shepherd’s pouch, and his sling was in his hand; and he approached the Philistine.
verses.textEn: Then he took his staff in his hand, chose five smooth stones from the stream, put them in the pouch of his shepherd’s bag and, with his sling in his hand, approached the Philistine.

verses.textZh: 那非利士人也向着大卫慢慢走过来，拿大盾牌的人在他前面走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那非利士人也向着大卫慢慢走过来，拿大盾牌的人在他前面走。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人也渐渐地迎着大卫来，拿盾牌的走在前头。
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile, the Philistine, with his shield bearer in front of him, kept coming closer to David.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Philistine moved forward and came near to David, with his shield-bearer in front of him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Philistine came, and began drawing near to David, and the man who bore the shield went before him.
verses.textEnNlt: Goliath walked out toward David with his shield bearer ahead of him,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Philistine came and approached David, with the shield-bearer in front of him.
verses.textEn: Meanwhile, the Philistine, with his shield bearer in front of him, kept coming closer to David.

verses.textZh: 那非利士人观看，看见了大卫，就藐视他，因为他年纪还轻，面色红润，外貌英俊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那非利士人观看，看见了大卫，就藐视他，因为他年纪还轻，面色红润，外貌英俊。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人观看，见了大卫，就藐视他；因为他年轻，面色光红，容貌俊美。
verses.textEnNiv: He looked David over and saw that he was little more than a boy, glowing with health and handsome, and he despised him.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the Philistine looked and saw David, he disdained him, for he was but a youth, ruddy and handsome in appearance.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the Philistine looked about and saw David, he disdained him; for he was only a youth, ruddy and good-looking.
verses.textEnNlt: sneering in contempt at this ruddy-faced boy.
verses.textEnNasb: When the Philistine looked and saw David, he was contemptuous of him; for he was only a youth, and reddish, with a handsome appearance.
verses.textEn: He looked David over and saw that he was little more than a boy, glowing with health and handsome, and he despised him.

verses.textZh: 那非利士人对大卫说："难道我是一条狗吗？你竟拿杖来攻击我。"于是指着自己的神咒诅大卫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那非利士人对大卫说："难道我是一条狗吗？你竟拿杖来攻击我。"于是指着自己的神咒诅大卫。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人对大卫说：「你拿杖到我这里来，我岂是狗呢？」非利士人就指着自己的神咒诅大卫。
verses.textEnNiv: He said to David, "Am I a dog, that you come at me with sticks?" And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Philistine said to David, "Am I a dog, that you come to me with sticks?" And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Philistine said to David, "Am I a dog, that you come to me with sticks?" And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.
verses.textEnNlt: "Am I a dog," he roared at David, "that you come at me with a stick?" And he cursed David by the names of his gods.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Philistine said to David, "Am I a dog, that you come to me with sticks?" And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.
verses.textEn: He said to David, "Am I a dog, that you come at me with sticks?" And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.

verses.textZh: 那非利士人又对大卫说："你到我这里来吧！我要把你的肉给空中的飞鸟和田野的走兽吃。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那非利士人又对大卫说："你到我这里来吧！我要把你的肉给空中的飞鸟和田野的走兽吃。"
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人又对大卫说：「来吧！我将你的肉给空中的飞鸟、田野的走兽吃。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Come here," he said, "and I’ll give your flesh to the birds and the wild animals!"
verses.textEnEsv: The Philistine said to David, "Come to me, and I will give your flesh to the birds of the air and to the beasts of the field."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Philistine said to David, "Come to me, and I will give your flesh to the birds of the air and the beasts of the field!"
verses.textEnNlt: "Come over here, and I’ll give your flesh to the birds and wild animals!" Goliath yelled.
verses.textEnNasb: The Philistine also said to David, "Come to me, and I will give your flesh to the birds of the sky and the wild animals."
verses.textEn: "Come here," he said, "and I’ll give your flesh to the birds and the wild animals!"

verses.textZh: 大卫回答那非利士人："你来攻击我是靠刀、靠矛、靠枪，但我来攻击你是靠万军之耶和华的名；万军之耶和华就是你所辱骂的以色列军队的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫回答那非利士人："你来攻击我是靠刀、靠矛、靠枪，但我来攻击你是靠万军之耶和华的名；万军之耶和华就是你所辱骂的以色列军队的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对非利士人说：「你来攻击我，是靠着刀枪和铜戟；我来攻击你，是靠着万军之耶和华的名，就是你所怒骂带领以色列军队的神。
verses.textEnNiv: David said to the Philistine, "You come against me with sword and spear and javelin, but I come against you in the name of the Lord Almighty, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David said to the Philistine, "You come to me with a sword and with a spear and with a javelin, but I come to you in the name of the Lord of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David said to the Philistine, "You come to me with a sword, with a spear, and with a javelin. But I come to you in the name of the Lord of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.
verses.textEnNlt: David replied to the Philistine, "You come to me with sword, spear, and javelin, but I come to you in the name of the Lord of Heaven’s Armies—the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.
verses.textEnNasb: But David said to the Philistine, "You come to me with a sword, a spear, and a saber, but I come to you in the name of the Lord of armies, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.
verses.textEn: David said to the Philistine, "You come against me with sword and spear and javelin, but I come against you in the name of the Lord Almighty, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.

verses.textZh: 今天耶和华要把你交在我手里，我必击杀你，砍下你的头。今天我还要把非利士人军队的尸体给空中的飞鸟和地上的野兽吃。这样，全地的人就都知道以色列中有一位神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 今天耶和华要把你交在我手里，我必击杀你，砍下你的头。今天我还要把非利士人军队的尸体给空中的飞鸟和地上的野兽吃。这样，全地的人就都知道以色列中有一位神。
verses.textZhCuv: 今日耶和华必将你交在我手里。我必杀你，斩你的头，又将非利士军兵的尸首给空中的飞鸟、地上的野兽吃，使普天下的人都知道以色列中有神；
verses.textEnNiv: This day the Lord will deliver you into my hands, and I’ll strike you down and cut off your head. This very day I will give the carcasses of the Philistine army to the birds and the wild animals, and the whole world will know that there is a God in Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: This day the Lord will deliver you into my hand, and I will strike you down and cut off your head. And I will give the dead bodies of the host of the Philistines this day to the birds of the air and to the wild beasts of the earth, that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel,
verses.textEnNkjv: This day the Lord will deliver you into my hand, and I will strike you and take your head from you. And this day I will give the carcasses of the camp of the Philistines to the birds of the air and the wild beasts of the earth, that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Today the Lord will conquer you, and I will kill you and cut off your head. And then I will give the dead bodies of your men to the birds and wild animals, and the whole world will know that there is a God in Israel!
verses.textEnNasb: This day the Lord will hand you over to me, and I will strike you and remove your head from you. Then I will give the dead bodies of the army of the Philistines this day to the birds of the sky and the wild animals of the earth, so that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel,
verses.textEn: This day the Lord will deliver you into my hands, and I’ll strike you down and cut off your head. This very day I will give the carcasses of the Philistine army to the birds and the wild animals, and the whole world will know that there is a God in Israel.

verses.textZh: 也使这些人群都知道，耶和华拯救人不是靠刀，不是靠枪，因为战争的胜败在于耶和华，他必把你们交在我们的手里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 也使这些人群都知道，耶和华拯救人不是靠刀，不是靠枪，因为战争的胜败在于耶和华，他必把你们交在我们的手里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又使这众人知道耶和华使人得胜，不是用刀用枪，因为争战的胜败全在乎耶和华。他必将你们交在我们手里。」
verses.textEnNiv: All those gathered here will know that it is not by sword or spear that the Lord saves; for the battle is the Lord ’s, and he will give all of you into our hands."
verses.textEnEsv: and that all this assembly may know that the Lord saves not with sword and spear. For the battle is the Lord ’s, and he will give you into our hand."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all this assembly shall know that the Lord does not save with sword and spear; for the battle is the Lord’s, and He will give you into our hands."
verses.textEnNlt: And everyone assembled here will know that the Lord rescues his people, but not with sword and spear. This is the Lord ’s battle, and he will give you to us!"
verses.textEnNasb: and that this entire assembly may know that the Lord does not save by sword or by spear; for the battle is the Lord’s, and He will hand you over to us!"
verses.textEn: All those gathered here will know that it is not by sword or spear that the Lord saves; for the battle is the Lord ’s, and he will give all of you into our hands."

verses.textZh: 那非利士人起身，迎着大卫慢慢走过来；大卫也赶快往阵上跑去，迎战那非利士人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那非利士人起身，迎着大卫慢慢走过来；大卫也赶快往阵上跑去，迎战那非利士人。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人起身，迎着大卫前来。大卫急忙迎着非利士人，往战场跑去。
verses.textEnNiv: As the Philistine moved closer to attack him, David ran quickly toward the battle line to meet him.
verses.textEnEsv: When the Philistine arose and came and drew near to meet David, David ran quickly toward the battle line to meet the Philistine.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when the Philistine arose and came and drew near to meet David, that David hurried and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.
verses.textEnNlt: As Goliath moved closer to attack, David quickly ran out to meet him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it happened, when the Philistine came closer to meet David, that David ran quickly toward the battle line to meet the Philistine.
verses.textEn: As the Philistine moved closer to attack him, David ran quickly toward the battle line to meet him.

verses.textZh: 大卫伸手入口袋里，从里面拿出了一块石子来，用机弦甩去，击中了那非利士人的前额；石子穿入前额里面，他就仆倒，面伏于地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫伸手入口袋里，从里面拿出了一块石子来，用机弦甩去，击中了那非利士人的前额；石子穿入前额里面，他就仆倒，面伏于地。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫用手从囊中掏出一块石子来，用机弦甩去，打中非利士人的额，石子进入额内，他就仆倒，面伏于地。
verses.textEnNiv: Reaching into his bag and taking out a stone, he slung it and struck the Philistine on the forehead. The stone sank into his forehead, and he fell facedown on the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: And David put his hand in his bag and took out a stone and slung it and struck the Philistine on his forehead. The stone sank into his forehead, and he fell on his face to the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David put his hand in his bag and took out a stone; and he slung it and struck the Philistine in his forehead, so that the stone sank into his forehead, and he fell on his face to the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Reaching into his shepherd’s bag and taking out a stone, he hurled it with his sling and hit the Philistine in the forehead. The stone sank in, and Goliath stumbled and fell face down on the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: And David put his hand into his bag and took from it a stone and slung it, and struck the Philistine on his forehead. And the stone penetrated his forehead, and he fell on his face to the ground.
verses.textEn: Reaching into his bag and taking out a stone, he slung it and struck the Philistine on the forehead. The stone sank into his forehead, and he fell facedown on the ground.

verses.textZh: 这样，大卫用机弦和一块石子胜过了那非利士人。大卫击杀了那非利士人，但他手中没有刀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，大卫用机弦和一块石子胜过了那非利士人。大卫击杀了那非利士人，但他手中没有刀。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，大卫用机弦甩石，胜了那非利士人，打死他；大卫手中却没有刀。
verses.textEnNiv: So David triumphed over the Philistine with a sling and a stone; without a sword in his hand he struck down the Philistine and killed him.
verses.textEnEsv: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and struck the Philistine and killed him. There was no sword in the hand of David.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and a stone, and struck the Philistine and killed him. But therewas no sword in the hand of David.
verses.textEnNlt: So David triumphed over the Philistine with only a sling and a stone, for he had no sword.
verses.textEnNasb: So David prevailed over the Philistine with the sling and the stone: he struck the Philistine and killed him, and there was no sword in David’s hand.
verses.textEn: So David triumphed over the Philistine with a sling and a stone; without a sword in his hand he struck down the Philistine and killed him.

verses.textZh: 大卫跑过去，站在那非利士人的身边，拿起他的刀来，把刀从鞘中拔出来，杀死他，又用刀砍下他的头。非利士人看见他们的勇士死了，就都逃跑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫跑过去，站在那非利士人的身边，拿起他的刀来，把刀从鞘中拔出来，杀死他，又用刀砍下他的头。非利士人看见他们的勇士死了，就都逃跑。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫跑去，站在非利士人身旁，将他的刀从鞘中拔出来，杀死他，割了他的头。非利士众人看见他们讨战的勇士死了，就都逃跑。
verses.textEnNiv: David ran and stood over him. He took hold of the Philistine’s sword and drew it from the sheath. After he killed him, he cut off his head with the sword. When the Philistines saw that their hero was dead, they turned and ran.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David ran and stood over the Philistine and took his sword and drew it out of its sheath and killed him and cut off his head with it. When the Philistines saw that their champion was dead, they fled.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore David ran and stood over the Philistine, took his sword and drew it out of its sheath and killed him, and cut off his head with it. And when the Philistines saw that their champion was dead, they fled.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David ran over and pulled Goliath’s sword from its sheath. David used it to kill him and cut off his head. When the Philistines saw that their champion was dead, they turned and ran.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David ran and stood over the Philistine, and took his sword and drew it out of its sheath and finished him, and cut off his head with it. When the Philistines saw that their champion was dead, they fled.
verses.textEn: David ran and stood over him. He took hold of the Philistine’s sword and drew it from the sheath. After he killed him, he cut off his head with the sword. When the Philistines saw that their hero was dead, they turned and ran.

verses.textZh: 以色列人和犹大人就起来，高声吶喊，追赶非利士人，直到迦特 的入口和以革伦的城门。被刺死的非利士人都倒在沙拉音的路上，直到迦特和以革伦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人和犹大人就起来，高声吶喊，追赶非利士人，直到迦特 的入口和以革伦的城门。被刺死的非利士人都倒在沙拉音的路上，直到迦特和以革伦。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人和犹大人便起身呐喊，追赶非利士人，直到迦特 和以革伦的城门。被杀的非利士人倒在沙拉音的路上，直到迦特和以革伦。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the men of Israel and Judah surged forward with a shout and pursued the Philistines to the entrance of Gath and to the gates of Ekron. Their dead were strewn along the Shaaraim road to Gath and Ekron.
verses.textEnEsv: And the men of Israel and Judah rose with a shout and pursued the Philistines as far as Gath and the gates of Ekron, so that the wounded Philistines fell on the way from Shaaraim as far as Gath and Ekron.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the men of Israel and Judah arose and shouted, and pursued the Philistines as far as the entrance of the valley and to the gates of Ekron. And the wounded of the Philistines fell along the road to Shaaraim, even as far as Gath and Ekron.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the men of Israel and Judah gave a great shout of triumph and rushed after the Philistines, chasing them as far as Gath and the gates of Ekron. The bodies of the dead and wounded Philistines were strewn all along the road from Shaaraim, as far as Gath and Ekron.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the men of Israel and Judah rose up and shouted, and they pursued the Philistines as far as the valley, and to the gates of Ekron. And the Philistine dead lay along the way to Shaaraim, even to Gath and Ekron.
verses.textEn: Then the men of Israel and Judah surged forward with a shout and pursued the Philistines to the entrance of Gath and to the gates of Ekron. Their dead were strewn along the Shaaraim road to Gath and Ekron.

verses.textZh: 以色列人穷追非利士人回来以后，就抢掠他们的营房。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人穷追非利士人回来以后，就抢掠他们的营房。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人追赶非利士人回来，就夺了他们的营盘。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Israelites returned from chasing the Philistines, they plundered their camp.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel came back from chasing the Philistines, and they plundered their camp.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the children of Israel returned from chasing the Philistines, and they plundered their tents.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Israelite army returned and plundered the deserted Philistine camp.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of Israel returned from their close pursuit of the Philistines, and plundered their camps.
verses.textEn: When the Israelites returned from chasing the Philistines, they plundered their camp.

verses.textZh: 大卫拿起那非利士人的头，把它带到耶路撒冷去，却把那人的武器放在自己的帐棚里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫拿起那非利士人的头，把它带到耶路撒冷去，却把那人的武器放在自己的帐棚里。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫将那非利士人的头拿到耶路撒冷，却将他军装放在自己的帐棚里。
verses.textEnNiv: David took the Philistine’s head and brought it to Jerusalem; he put the Philistine’s weapons in his own tent.
verses.textEnEsv: And David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem, but he put his armor in his tent.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem, but he put his armor in his tent.
verses.textEnNlt: (David took the Philistine’s head to Jerusalem, but he stored the man’s armor in his own tent.)
verses.textEnNasb: And David took the Philistine’s head and brought it to Jerusalem, but he put his weapons in his tent.
verses.textEn: David took the Philistine’s head and brought it to Jerusalem; he put the Philistine’s weapons in his own tent.

verses.textZh: 扫罗看见大卫出去迎战那非利士人，就问元帅押尼珥："押尼珥啊，这个年轻人是谁的儿子？"押尼珥回答："我敢指着王起誓，我不知道。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗看见大卫出去迎战那非利士人，就问元帅押尼珥："押尼珥啊，这个年轻人是谁的儿子？"押尼珥回答："我敢指着王起誓，我不知道。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗看见大卫去攻击非利士人，就问元帅押尼珥说：「押尼珥啊，那少年人是谁的儿子？」押尼珥说：「我敢在王面前起誓，我不知道。」
verses.textEnNiv: As Saul watched David going out to meet the Philistine, he said to Abner, commander of the army, "Abner, whose son is that young man?" Abner replied, "As surely as you live, Your Majesty, I don’t know."
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as Saul saw David go out against the Philistine, he said to Abner, the commander of the army, "Abner, whose son is this youth?" And Abner said, "As your soul lives, O king, I do not know."
verses.textEnNkjv: When Saul saw David going out against the Philistine, he said to Abner, the commander of the army, "Abner, whose son is this youth?" And Abner said, "As your soul lives, O king, I do not know."
verses.textEnNlt: As Saul watched David go out to fight the Philistine, he asked Abner, the commander of his army, "Abner, whose son is this young man?" "I really don’t know," Abner declared.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Saul had seen David going out against the Philistine, he said to Abner the commander of the army, "Abner, whose son is this young man?" And Abner said, "By your life, O king, I do not know."
verses.textEn: As Saul watched David going out to meet the Philistine, he said to Abner, commander of the army, "Abner, whose son is that young man?" Abner replied, "As surely as you live, Your Majesty, I don’t know."

verses.textZh: 王说："你去问问这个少年是谁的儿子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王说："你去问问这个少年是谁的儿子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王说：「你可以问问那幼年人是谁的儿子。」
verses.textEnNiv: The king said, "Find out whose son this young man is."
verses.textEnEsv: And the king said, "Inquire whose son the boy is."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king said, "Inquire whose son this young man is."
verses.textEnNlt: "Well, find out who he is!" the king told him.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king said, "You then, ask whose son the youth is."
verses.textEn: The king said, "Find out whose son this young man is."

verses.textZh: 大卫击杀了那非利士人回来的时候，押尼珥迎接他，把他带到扫罗面前，大卫手中还拿着那非利士人的头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫击杀了那非利士人回来的时候，押尼珥迎接他，把他带到扫罗面前，大卫手中还拿着那非利士人的头。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫打死非利士人回来，押尼珥领他到扫罗面前，他手中拿着非利士人的头。
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as David returned from killing the Philistine, Abner took him and brought him before Saul, with David still holding the Philistine’s head.
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as David returned from the striking down of the Philistine, Abner took him, and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then, as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as David returned from killing Goliath, Abner brought him to Saul with the Philistine’s head still in his hand.
verses.textEnNasb: So when David returned from killing the Philistine, Abner took him and brought him before Saul with the Philistine’s head in his hand.
verses.textEn: As soon as David returned from killing the Philistine, Abner took him and brought him before Saul, with David still holding the Philistine’s head.

verses.textZh: 扫罗问他："年轻人啊，你是谁的儿子？"大卫回答："我是你仆人伯利恒人耶西的儿子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗问他："年轻人啊，你是谁的儿子？"大卫回答："我是你仆人伯利恒人耶西的儿子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗问他说：「少年人哪，你是谁的儿子？」大卫说：「我是你仆人伯利恒人耶西的儿子。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Whose son are you, young man?" Saul asked him. David said, "I am the son of your servant Jesse of Bethlehem."
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul said to him, "Whose son are you, young man?" And David answered, "I am the son of your servant Jesse the Bethlehemite."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Saul said to him, "Whose son are you, young man?" So David answered, "Iam the son of your servant Jesse the Bethlehemite."
verses.textEnNlt: "Tell me about your father, young man," Saul said. And David replied, "His name is Jesse, and we live in Bethlehem."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul said to him, "Whose son are you, young man?" And David answered, "I am the son of your servant Jesse the Bethlehemite."
verses.textEn: "Whose son are you, young man?" Saul asked him. David said, "I am the son of your servant Jesse of Bethlehem."

verses.textZh: 大卫对扫罗说完了话，约拿单的心和大卫的心就深相契合。约拿单爱大卫如同爱自己的命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对扫罗说完了话，约拿单的心和大卫的心就深相契合。约拿单爱大卫如同爱自己的命。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对扫罗说完了话，约拿单的心与大卫的心深相契合。约拿单爱大卫，如同爱自己的性命。
verses.textEnNiv: After David had finished talking with Saul, Jonathan became one in spirit with David, and he loved him as himself.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as he had finished speaking to Saul, the soul of Jonathan was knit to the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when he had finished speaking to Saul, the soul of Jonathan was knit to the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.
verses.textEnNlt: After David had finished talking with Saul, he met Jonathan, the king’s son. There was an immediate bond between them, for Jonathan loved David.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about, when he had finished speaking to Saul, that Jonathan committed himself to David, and Jonathan loved him as himself.
verses.textEn: After David had finished talking with Saul, Jonathan became one in spirit with David, and he loved him as himself.

verses.textZh: 从那天起，扫罗就把大卫留下来，不让他回到父家去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从那天起，扫罗就把大卫留下来，不让他回到父家去。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日扫罗留住大卫，不容他再回父家。
verses.textEnNiv: From that day Saul kept David with him and did not let him return home to his family.
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul took him that day and would not let him return to his father’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Saul took him that day, and would not let him go home to his father’s house anymore.
verses.textEnNlt: From that day on Saul kept David with him and wouldn’t let him return home.
verses.textEnNasb: And Saul took him that day and did not let him return to his father’s house.
verses.textEn: From that day Saul kept David with him and did not let him return home to his family.

verses.textZh: 约拿单与大卫立盟约，因为他爱大卫如同爱自己的命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单与大卫立盟约，因为他爱大卫如同爱自己的命。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单爱大卫如同爱自己的性命，就与他结盟。
verses.textEnNiv: And Jonathan made a covenant with David because he loved him as himself.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jonathan made a covenant with David, because he loved him as his own soul.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.
verses.textEnNlt: And Jonathan made a solemn pact with David, because he loved him as he loved himself.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jonathan made a covenant with David because he loved him as himself.
verses.textEn: And Jonathan made a covenant with David because he loved him as himself.

verses.textZh: 约拿单把自己身上的外袍脱下来给大卫，又把自己的战衣、刀、弓和腰带都给了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单把自己身上的外袍脱下来给大卫，又把自己的战衣、刀、弓和腰带都给了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单从身上脱下外袍，给了大卫，又将战衣、刀、弓、腰带都给了他。
verses.textEnNiv: Jonathan took off the robe he was wearing and gave it to David, along with his tunic, and even his sword, his bow and his belt.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was on him and gave it to David, and his armor, and even his sword and his bow and his belt.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jonathan took off the robe that was on him and gave it to David, with his armor, even to his sword and his bow and his belt.
verses.textEnNlt: Jonathan sealed the pact by taking off his robe and giving it to David, together with his tunic, sword, bow, and belt.
verses.textEnNasb: Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was on him and gave it to David, with his military gear, including his sword, his bow, and his belt.
verses.textEn: Jonathan took off the robe he was wearing and gave it to David, along with his tunic, and even his sword, his bow and his belt.

verses.textZh: 扫罗无论差派大卫到哪里去，他都去，并且凡事亨通。于是扫罗立他作军兵的将领。所有的人民和扫罗的臣仆都非常高兴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗无论差派大卫到哪里去，他都去，并且凡事亨通。于是扫罗立他作军兵的将领。所有的人民和扫罗的臣仆都非常高兴。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗无论差遣大卫往何处去，他都做事精明。扫罗就立他作战士长，众百姓和扫罗的臣仆无不喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: Whatever mission Saul sent him on, David was so successful that Saul gave him a high rank in the army. This pleased all the troops, and Saul’s officers as well.
verses.textEnEsv: And David went out and was successful wherever Saul sent him, so that Saul set him over the men of war. And this was good in the sight of all the people and also in the sight of Saul’s servants.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David went out wherever Saul sent him, and behaved wisely. And Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people and also in the sight of Saul’s servants.
verses.textEnNlt: Whatever Saul asked David to do, David did it successfully. So Saul made him a commander over the men of war, an appointment that was welcomed by the people and Saul’s officers alike.
verses.textEnNasb: And David went into battle wherever Saul sent him, and always achieved success; so Saul put him in charge of the men of war. And it was pleasing in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul’s servants.
verses.textEn: Whatever mission Saul sent him on, David was so successful that Saul gave him a high rank in the army. This pleased all the troops, and Saul’s officers as well.
