verses.textZh: 大卫击杀了那非利士人，与众人一同回来的时候，妇女们从以色列各城里出来，唱歌、跳舞、打鼓、欢呼、击磬迎接扫罗王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫击杀了那非利士人，与众人一同回来的时候，妇女们从以色列各城里出来，唱歌、跳舞、打鼓、欢呼、击磬迎接扫罗王。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫打死了那非利士人，同众人回来的时候，妇女们从以色列各城里出来，欢欢喜喜，打鼓击磬，歌唱跳舞，迎接扫罗王。
verses.textEnNiv: When the men were returning home after David had killed the Philistine, the women came out from all the towns of Israel to meet King Saul with singing and dancing, with joyful songs and with timbrels and lyres.
verses.textEnEsv: As they were coming home, when David returned from striking down the Philistine, the women came out of all the cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet King Saul, with tambourines, with songs of joy, and with musical instruments.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it had happened as they were coming home, when David was returning from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women had come out of all the cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet King Saul, with tambourines, with joy, and with musical instruments.
verses.textEnNlt: When the victorious Israelite army was returning home after David had killed the Philistine, women from all the towns of Israel came out to meet King Saul. They sang and danced for joy with tambourines and cymbals.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it happened as they were coming, when David returned from killing the Philistine, that the women came out of all the cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet King Saul, with tambourines, with joy and with other musical instruments.
verses.textEn: When the men were returning home after David had killed the Philistine, the women came out from all the towns of Israel to meet King Saul with singing and dancing, with joyful songs and with timbrels and lyres.

verses.textZh: 妇女们跳舞、歌唱，说： "扫罗杀死千千！ 大卫杀死万万！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 妇女们跳舞、歌唱，说： "扫罗杀死千千！ 大卫杀死万万！"
verses.textZhCuv: 众妇女舞蹈唱和，说：「扫罗杀死千千，大卫杀死万万。」
verses.textEnNiv: As they danced, they sang: "Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands."
verses.textEnEsv: And the women sang to one another as they celebrated, "Saul has struck down his thousands, and David his ten thousands."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the women sang as they danced, and said: "Saul has slain his thousands, And David his ten thousands."
verses.textEnNlt: This was their song: "Saul has killed his thousands, and David his ten thousands!"
verses.textEnNasb: The women sang as they played, and said, "Saul has slain his thousands, And David his ten thousands."
verses.textEn: As they danced, they sang: "Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands."

verses.textZh: 扫罗非常恼怒，不喜欢这话，就说："他们给大卫万万，只给我千千，就只剩下王位没给他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗非常恼怒，不喜欢这话，就说："他们给大卫万万，只给我千千，就只剩下王位没给他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗甚发怒，不喜悦这话，就说：「将万万归大卫，千千归我，只剩下王位没有给他了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Saul was very angry; this refrain displeased him greatly. "They have credited David with tens of thousands," he thought, "but me with only thousands. What more can he get but the kingdom?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul was very angry, and this saying displeased him. He said, "They have ascribed to David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed thousands, and what more can he have but the kingdom?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul was very angry, and the saying displeased him; and he said, "They have ascribed to David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed only thousands. Now what more can he have but the kingdom?"
verses.textEnNlt: This made Saul very angry. "What’s this?" he said. "They credit David with ten thousands and me with only thousands. Next they’ll be making him their king!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul became very angry, for this lyric displeased him; and he said, "They have given David credit for ten thousands, but to me they have given credit for only thousands! Now what more can he have but the kingdom?"
verses.textEn: Saul was very angry; this refrain displeased him greatly. "They have credited David with tens of thousands," he thought, "but me with only thousands. What more can he get but the kingdom?"

verses.textZh: 从那天起，扫罗就妒忌大卫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从那天起，扫罗就妒忌大卫。
verses.textZhCuv: 从这日起，扫罗就怒视大卫。
verses.textEnNiv: And from that time on Saul kept a close eye on David.
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul eyed David from that day on.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Saul eyed David from that day forward.
verses.textEnNlt: So from that time on Saul kept a jealous eye on David.
verses.textEnNasb: And Saul eyed David with suspicion from that day on.
verses.textEn: And from that time on Saul kept a close eye on David.

verses.textZh: 第二天，从神那里来的恶鬼降在扫罗身上，他就在家中胡言乱语。大卫照常弹琴，扫罗手里拿着枪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，从神那里来的恶鬼降在扫罗身上，他就在家中胡言乱语。大卫照常弹琴，扫罗手里拿着枪。
verses.textZhCuv: 次日，从神那里来的恶魔大大降在扫罗身上，他就在家中胡言乱语。大卫照常弹琴，扫罗手里拿着枪。
verses.textEnNiv: The next day an evil spirit from God came forcefully on Saul. He was prophesying in his house, while David was playing the lyre, as he usually did. Saul had a spear in his hand
verses.textEnEsv: The next day a harmful spirit from God rushed upon Saul, and he raved within his house while David was playing the lyre, as he did day by day. Saul had his spear in his hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened on the next day that the distressing spirit from God came upon Saul, and he prophesied inside the house. So David played music with his hand, as at other times; but therewas a spear in Saul’s hand.
verses.textEnNlt: The very next day a tormenting spirit from God overwhelmed Saul, and he began to rave in his house like a madman. David was playing the harp, as he did each day. But Saul had a spear in his hand,
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about on the next day that an evil spirit from God rushed upon Saul, and he raved in the midst of the house while David was playing the harp with his hand, as usual; and a spear was in Saul’s hand.
verses.textEn: The next day an evil spirit from God came forcefully on Saul. He was prophesying in his house, while David was playing the lyre, as he usually did. Saul had a spear in his hand

verses.textZh: 扫罗把枪掷过去，心里说："我要把大卫刺在墙上。"大卫两次避开了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗把枪掷过去，心里说："我要把大卫刺在墙上。"大卫两次避开了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗把枪一抡，心里说，我要将大卫刺透，钉在墙上。大卫躲避他两次。
verses.textEnNiv: and he hurled it, saying to himself, "I’ll pin David to the wall." But David eluded him twice.
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul hurled the spear, for he thought, "I will pin David to the wall." But David evaded him twice.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Saul cast the spear, for he said, "I will pin David to the wall!" But David escaped his presence twice.
verses.textEnNlt: and he suddenly hurled it at David, intending to pin him to the wall. But David escaped him twice.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul hurled the spear, for he thought, "I will pin David to the wall." But David escaped from his presence, twice.
verses.textEn: and he hurled it, saying to himself, "I’ll pin David to the wall." But David eluded him twice.

verses.textZh: 扫罗惧怕大卫，因为耶和华与大卫同在，却离开了扫罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗惧怕大卫，因为耶和华与大卫同在，却离开了扫罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗惧怕大卫；因为耶和华离开自己，与大卫同在。
verses.textEnNiv: Saul was afraid of David, because the Lord was with David but had departed from Saul.
verses.textEnEsv: Saul was afraid of David because the Lord was with him but had departed from Saul.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Saul was afraid of David, because the Lord was with him, but had departed from Saul.
verses.textEnNlt: Saul was then afraid of David, for the Lord was with David and had turned away from Saul.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Saul was afraid of David, because the Lord was with him but had left Saul.
verses.textEn: Saul was afraid of David, because the Lord was with David but had departed from Saul.

verses.textZh: 因此扫罗使大卫离开自己，立他作千夫长，大卫就领导众民出入。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此扫罗使大卫离开自己，立他作千夫长，大卫就领导众民出入。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以扫罗使大卫离开自己，立他为千夫长，他就领兵出入。
verses.textEnNiv: So he sent David away from him and gave him command over a thousand men, and David led the troops in their campaigns.
verses.textEnEsv: So Saul removed him from his presence and made him a commander of a thousand. And he went out and came in before the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore Saul removed him from his presence, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, Saul sent him away and appointed him commander over 1,000 men, and David faithfully led his troops into battle.
verses.textEnNasb: So Saul removed him from his presence and appointed him as his commander of a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.
verses.textEn: So he sent David away from him and gave him command over a thousand men, and David led the troops in their campaigns.

verses.textZh: 大卫所行的一切都亨通，因为耶和华与他同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫所行的一切都亨通，因为耶和华与他同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫做事无不精明，耶和华也与他同在。
verses.textEnNiv: In everything he did he had great success, because the Lord was with him.
verses.textEnEsv: And David had success in all his undertakings, for the Lord was with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David behaved wisely in all his ways, and the Lordwas with him.
verses.textEnNlt: David continued to succeed in everything he did, for the Lord was with him.
verses.textEnNasb: David was successful in all his ways, for the Lordwas with him.
verses.textEn: In everything he did he had great success, because the Lord was with him.

verses.textZh: 扫罗看见大卫所行的十分亨通，就怕他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗看见大卫所行的十分亨通，就怕他。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗见大卫做事精明，就甚怕他。
verses.textEnNiv: When Saul saw how successful he was, he was afraid of him.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Saul saw that he had great success, he stood in fearful awe of him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, when Saul saw that he behaved very wisely, he was afraid of him.
verses.textEnNlt: When Saul recognized this, he became even more afraid of him.
verses.textEnNasb: When Saul saw that he was very successful, he was afraid of him.
verses.textEn: When Saul saw how successful he was, he was afraid of him.

verses.textZh: 但是所有的以色列人和犹大人都爱大卫，因为他领导他们出入。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是所有的以色列人和犹大人都爱大卫，因为他领导他们出入。
verses.textZhCuv: 但以色列和犹大众人都爱大卫，因为他领他们出入。
verses.textEnNiv: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he led them in their campaigns.
verses.textEnEsv: But all Israel and Judah loved David, for he went out and came in before them.
verses.textEnNkjv: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he went out and came in before them.
verses.textEnNlt: But all Israel and Judah loved David because he was so successful at leading his troops into battle.
verses.textEnNasb: But all Israel and Judah loved David, for he would go out to battle and return before them.
verses.textEn: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he led them in their campaigns.

verses.textZh: 扫罗对大卫说："我的大女儿米拉在这里。我要把她赐给你作妻子；只要你作我的勇士，为耶和华争战。"原来扫罗心里说："我不好亲手害他，让非利士人害他吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗对大卫说："我的大女儿米拉在这里。我要把她赐给你作妻子；只要你作我的勇士，为耶和华争战。"原来扫罗心里说："我不好亲手害他，让非利士人害他吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗对大卫说：「我将大女儿米拉给你为妻，只要你为我奋勇，为耶和华争战。」扫罗心里说：「我不好亲手害他，要藉非利士人的手害他。」
verses.textEnNiv: Saul said to David, "Here is my older daughter Merab. I will give her to you in marriage; only serve me bravely and fight the battles of the Lord ." For Saul said to himself, "I will not raise a hand against him. Let the Philistines do that!"
verses.textEnEsv: Then Saul said to David, "Here is my elder daughter Merab. I will give her to you for a wife. Only be valiant for me and fight the Lord ’s battles." For Saul thought, "Let not my hand be against him, but let the hand of the Philistines be against him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul said to David, "Here is my older daughter Merab; I will give her to you as a wife. Only be valiant for me, and fight the Lord’s battles." For Saul thought, "Let my hand not be against him, but let the hand of the Philistines be against him."
verses.textEnNlt: One day Saul said to David, "I am ready to give you my older daughter, Merab, as your wife. But first you must prove yourself to be a real warrior by fighting the Lord ’s battles." For Saul thought, "I’ll send him out against the Philistines and let them kill him rather than doing it myself."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul said to David, "Here is my older daughter Merab; I will give her to you as a wife, only be a valiant man for me and fight the Lord’s battles." For Saul thought, "My hand shall not be against him, but let the hand of the Philistines be against him."
verses.textEn: Saul said to David, "Here is my older daughter Merab. I will give her to you in marriage; only serve me bravely and fight the battles of the Lord ." For Saul said to himself, "I will not raise a hand against him. Let the Philistines do that!"

verses.textZh: 大卫回答扫罗："我是谁？我是甚么身分？我父家在以色列人中算得甚么？我怎么作王的女婿呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫回答扫罗："我是谁？我是甚么身分？我父家在以色列人中算得甚么？我怎么作王的女婿呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对扫罗说：「我是谁，我是什么出身，我父家在以色列中是何等的家，岂敢作王的女婿呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: But David said to Saul, "Who am I, and what is my family or my clan in Israel, that I should become the king’s son-in-law?"
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to Saul, "Who am I, and who are my relatives, my father’s clan in Israel, that I should be son-in-law to the king?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So David said to Saul, "Who am I, and what is my life or my father’s family in Israel, that I should be son-in-law to the king?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Who am I, and what is my family in Israel that I should be the king’s son-in-law?" David exclaimed. "My father’s family is nothing!"
verses.textEnNasb: But David said to Saul, "Who am I, and who is my family, or my father’s family in Israel, that I should be the king’s son-in-law?"
verses.textEn: But David said to Saul, "Who am I, and what is my family or my clan in Israel, that I should become the king’s son-in-law?"

verses.textZh: 到了扫罗的女儿米拉该嫁给大卫的时候，扫罗却把她给了米何拉人亚得列作妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了扫罗的女儿米拉该嫁给大卫的时候，扫罗却把她给了米何拉人亚得列作妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗的女儿米拉到了当给大卫的时候，扫罗却给了米何拉人亚得列为妻。
verses.textEnNiv: So when the time came for Merab, Saul’s daughter, to be given to David, she was given in marriage to Adriel of Meholah.
verses.textEnEsv: But at the time when Merab, Saul’s daughter, should have been given to David, she was given to Adriel the Meholathite for a wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: But it happened at the time when Merab, Saul’s daughter, should have been given to David, that she was given to Adriel the Meholathite as a wife.
verses.textEnNlt: So when the time came for Saul to give his daughter Merab in marriage to David, he gave her instead to Adriel, a man from Meholah.
verses.textEnNasb: So it came about at the time that Merab, Saul’s daughter, was to be given to David, that she was given instead to Adriel the Meholathite as a wife.
verses.textEn: So when the time came for Merab, Saul’s daughter, to be given to David, she was given in marriage to Adriel of Meholah.

verses.textZh: 扫罗的女儿米甲爱大卫。有人把这事告诉扫罗，扫罗就欢喜，
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗的女儿米甲爱大卫。有人把这事告诉扫罗，扫罗就欢喜，
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗的次女米甲爱大卫。有人告诉扫罗，扫罗就喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Saul’s daughter Michal was in love with David, and when they told Saul about it, he was pleased.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Saul’s daughter Michal loved David. And they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved David. And they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.
verses.textEnNlt: In the meantime, Saul’s daughter Michal had fallen in love with David, and Saul was delighted when he heard about it.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved David. When they informed Saul, the thing was pleasing to him.
verses.textEn: Now Saul’s daughter Michal was in love with David, and when they told Saul about it, he was pleased.

verses.textZh: 心里想："我要把米甲给大卫，利用米甲作他的陷阱，好让非利士人的手害他。"于是扫罗对大卫说："你今天可以第二次作我的女婿。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 心里想："我要把米甲给大卫，利用米甲作他的陷阱，好让非利士人的手害他。"于是扫罗对大卫说："你今天可以第二次作我的女婿。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗心里说：「我将这女儿给大卫，作他的网罗，好藉非利士人的手害他。」所以扫罗对大卫说：「你今日可以第二次作我的女婿。」
verses.textEnNiv: "I will give her to him," he thought, "so that she may be a snare to him and so that the hand of the Philistines may be against him." So Saul said to David, "Now you have a second opportunity to become my son-in-law."
verses.textEnEsv: Saul thought, "Let me give her to him, that she may be a snare for him and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him." Therefore Saul said to David a second time, "You shall now be my son-in-law."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Saul said, "I will give her to him, that she may be a snare to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him." Therefore Saul said to David a second time, "You shall be my son-in-law today."
verses.textEnNlt: "Here’s another chance to see him killed by the Philistines!" Saul said to himself. But to David he said, "Today you have a second chance to become my son-in-law!"
verses.textEnNasb: For Saul thought, "I will give her to him so that she may become a trap for him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him." Therefore Saul said to David, "For a second time you may become my son-in-law, today."
verses.textEn: "I will give her to him," he thought, "so that she may be a snare to him and so that the hand of the Philistines may be against him." So Saul said to David, "Now you have a second opportunity to become my son-in-law."

verses.textZh: 扫罗吩咐他的臣仆："你们要私下对大卫说：‘王喜欢你，他的臣仆也都爱你，现在你要作王的女婿！’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗吩咐他的臣仆："你们要私下对大卫说：‘王喜欢你，他的臣仆也都爱你，现在你要作王的女婿！’"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗吩咐臣仆说：「你们暗中对大卫说：『王喜悦你，王的臣仆也都喜爱你，所以你当作王的女婿。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Saul ordered his attendants: "Speak to David privately and say, ‘Look, the king likes you, and his attendants all love you; now become his son-in-law.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul commanded his servants, "Speak to David in private and say, ‘Behold, the king has delight in you, and all his servants love you. Now then become the king’s son-in-law.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Saul commanded his servants, "Communicate with David secretly, and say, ‘Look, the king has delight in you, and all his servants love you. Now therefore, become the king’s son-in-law.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then Saul told his men to say to David, "The king really likes you, and so do we. Why don’t you accept the king’s offer and become his son-in-law?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul commanded his servants, "Speak to David in secret, saying, ‘Behold, the king delights in you, and all his servants love you; now then, become the king’s son-in-law.’ "
verses.textEn: Then Saul ordered his attendants: "Speak to David privately and say, ‘Look, the king likes you, and his attendants all love you; now become his son-in-law.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是扫罗的臣仆把这些话说给大卫听。大卫说："你们以为作王的女婿是一件小事吗？我是个贫穷卑微的人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是扫罗的臣仆把这些话说给大卫听。大卫说："你们以为作王的女婿是一件小事吗？我是个贫穷卑微的人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗的臣仆就照这话说给大卫听。大卫说：「你们以为作王的女婿是一件小事吗？我是贫穷卑微的人。」
verses.textEnNiv: They repeated these words to David. But David said, "Do you think it is a small matter to become the king’s son-in-law? I’m only a poor man and little known."
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul’s servants spoke those words in the ears of David. And David said, "Does it seem to you a little thing to become the king’s son-in-law, since I am a poor man and have no reputation?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So Saul’s servants spoke those words in the hearing of David. And David said, "Does it seem to you a light thing to be a king’s son-in-law, seeing I am a poor and lightly esteemed man?"
verses.textEnNlt: When Saul’s men said these things to David, he replied, "How can a poor man from a humble family afford the bride price for the daughter of a king?"
verses.textEnNasb: So Saul’s servants spoke these words to David. But David said, "Is it trivial in your sight to become the king’s son-in-law, since I am only a poor man and insignificant?"
verses.textEn: They repeated these words to David. But David said, "Do you think it is a small matter to become the king’s son-in-law? I’m only a poor man and little known."

verses.textZh: 扫罗的臣仆把大卫所说的这些话都报告了扫罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗的臣仆把大卫所说的这些话都报告了扫罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗的臣仆回奏说，大卫所说的如此如此。
verses.textEnNiv: When Saul’s servants told him what David had said,
verses.textEnEsv: And the servants of Saul told him, "Thus and so did David speak."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the servants of Saul told him, saying, "In this manner David spoke."
verses.textEnNlt: When Saul’s men reported this back to the king,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul’s servants reported to him, saying, " These are the words David spoke."
verses.textEn: When Saul’s servants told him what David had said,

verses.textZh: 扫罗说："你们要对大卫这样说：‘王不要甚么聘礼，只要一百个非利士人的包皮，好在王的仇敌身上报仇。’"扫罗企图使大卫死在非利士人的手里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗说："你们要对大卫这样说：‘王不要甚么聘礼，只要一百个非利士人的包皮，好在王的仇敌身上报仇。’"扫罗企图使大卫死在非利士人的手里。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗说：「你们要对大卫这样说：『王不要什么聘礼，只要一百非利士人的阳皮，好在王的仇敌身上报仇。』」扫罗的意思要使大卫丧在非利士人的手里。
verses.textEnNiv: Saul replied, "Say to David, ‘The king wants no other price for the bride than a hundred Philistine foreskins, to take revenge on his enemies.’ " Saul’s plan was to have David fall by the hands of the Philistines.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Saul said, "Thus shall you say to David, ‘The king desires no bride-price except a hundred foreskins of the Philistines, that he may be avenged of the king’s enemies.’" Now Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul said, "Thus you shall say to David: ‘The king does not desire any dowry but one hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to take vengeance on the king’s enemies.’ " But Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.
verses.textEnNlt: he told them, "Tell David that all I want for the bride price is 100 Philistine foreskins! Vengeance on my enemies is all I really want." But what Saul had in mind was that David would be killed in the fight.
verses.textEnNasb: Saul then said, "This is what you shall say to David: ‘The king does not desire any dowry except a hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to take vengeance on the king’s enemies.’ " But Saul plotted to have David fall by the hand of the Philistines.
verses.textEn: Saul replied, "Say to David, ‘The king wants no other price for the bride than a hundred Philistine foreskins, to take revenge on his enemies.’ " Saul’s plan was to have David fall by the hands of the Philistines.

verses.textZh: 大卫和跟随他的人就起身出去，在非利士人中击杀了二百人，把他们的包皮带回来，满数交给王，要作王的女婿。于是扫罗把他的女儿米甲给大卫作妻子。

verses.textEnNiv: David took his men with him and went out and killed two hundred Philistines and brought back their foreskins. They counted out the full number to the king so that David might become the king’s son-in-law. Then Saul gave him his daughter Michal in marriage.
verses.textEnEsv: David arose and went, along with his men, and killed two hundred of the Philistines. And David brought their foreskins, which were given in full number to the king, that he might become the king’s son-in-law. And Saul gave him his daughter Michal for a wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore David arose and went, he and his men, and killed two hundred men of the Philistines. And David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full count to the king, that he might become the king’s son-in-law. Then Saul gave him Michal his daughter as a wife.
verses.textEnNlt: he and his men went out and killed 200 Philistines. Then David fulfilled the king’s requirement by presenting all their foreskins to him. So Saul gave his daughter Michal to David to be his wife.
verses.textEnNasb: David set out and went, he and his men, and fatally struck two hundred men among the Philistines. Then David brought their foreskins, and they presented all two hundred of them to the king, so that he might become the king’s son-in-law. And Saul gave him his daughter Michal as a wife.
verses.textEn: David took his men with him and went out and killed two hundred Philistines and brought back their foreskins. They counted out the full number to the king so that David might become the king’s son-in-law. Then Saul gave him his daughter Michal in marriage.

verses.textZh: 非利士人的领袖常常出征，每逢他们出征，大卫作事都比扫罗所有的臣仆所作的更亨通，所以他的名字极为人尊重。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人的领袖常常出征，每逢他们出征，大卫作事都比扫罗所有的臣仆所作的更亨通，所以他的名字极为人尊重。
verses.textZhCuv: 每逢非利士军长出来打仗，大卫比扫罗的臣仆做事精明，因此他的名被人尊重。
verses.textEnNiv: The Philistine commanders continued to go out to battle, and as often as they did, David met with more success than the rest of Saul’s officers, and his name became well known.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the commanders of the Philistines came out to battle, and as often as they came out David had more success than all the servants of Saul, so that his name was highly esteemed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the princes of the Philistines went out towar. And so it was, whenever they went out, that David behaved more wisely than all the servants of Saul, so that his name became highly esteemed.
verses.textEnNlt: Every time the commanders of the Philistines attacked, David was more successful against them than all the rest of Saul’s officers. So David’s name became very famous.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the commanders of the Philistines went to battle, and it happened as often as they went out, that David was more successful than all the servants of Saul. So his name was held in high esteem.
verses.textEn: The Philistine commanders continued to go out to battle, and as often as they did, David met with more success than the rest of Saul’s officers, and his name became well known.

verses.textEn: Saul told his son Jonathan and all the attendants to kill David. But Jonathan had taken a great liking to David

verses.textZh: 约拿单告诉大卫："我父亲扫罗正设法要杀死你。所以明天早晨你要小心，留在隐密的地方里，躲藏起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单告诉大卫："我父亲扫罗正设法要杀死你。所以明天早晨你要小心，留在隐密的地方里，躲藏起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单告诉大卫说：「我父扫罗想要杀你，所以明日早晨你要小心，到一个僻静地方藏身。
verses.textEnNiv: and warned him, "My father Saul is looking for a chance to kill you. Be on your guard tomorrow morning; go into hiding and stay there.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jonathan told David, "Saul my father seeks to kill you. Therefore be on your guard in the morning. Stay in a secret place and hide yourself.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jonathan told David, saying, "My father Saul seeks to kill you. Therefore please be on your guard until morning, and stay in a secret place and hide.
verses.textEnNlt: told him what his father was planning. "Tomorrow morning," he warned him, "you must find a hiding place out in the fields.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jonathan informed David, saying, "My father Saul is seeking to put you to death. Now then, please be on your guard in the morning, and stay in a hiding place and conceal yourself.
verses.textEn: and warned him, "My father Saul is looking for a chance to kill you. Be on your guard tomorrow morning; go into hiding and stay there.

verses.textZh: 我会出去，到你藏身的那块田那里，站在我父亲旁边，和他谈论你的事。我看看情形怎样，然后告诉你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我会出去，到你藏身的那块田那里，站在我父亲旁边，和他谈论你的事。我看看情形怎样，然后告诉你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我就出到你所藏的田里，站在我父亲旁边与他谈论。我看他情形怎样，我必告诉你。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will go out and stand with my father in the field where you are. I’ll speak to him about you and will tell you what I find out."
verses.textEnEsv: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you are, and I will speak to my father about you. And if I learn anything I will tell you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you are, and I will speak with my father about you. Then what I observe, I will tell you."
verses.textEnNlt: I’ll ask my father to go out there with me, and I’ll talk to him about you. Then I’ll tell you everything I can find out."
verses.textEnNasb: And as for me, I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you are hiding, and I will speak with my father about you; and whatever I find out, I will tell you."
verses.textEn: I will go out and stand with my father in the field where you are. I’ll speak to him about you and will tell you what I find out."

verses.textZh: 约拿单向父亲扫罗替大卫说好话，说："王不要得罪你的仆人大卫，因为他没有得罪你；并且他所作的，对你大有好处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单向父亲扫罗替大卫说好话，说："王不要得罪你的仆人大卫，因为他没有得罪你；并且他所作的，对你大有好处。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单向他父亲扫罗替大卫说好话，说：「王不可得罪王的仆人大卫；因为他未曾得罪你，他所行的都与你大有益处。
verses.textEnNiv: Jonathan spoke well of David to Saul his father and said to him, "Let not the king do wrong to his servant David; he has not wronged you, and what he has done has benefited you greatly.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jonathan spoke well of David to Saul his father and said to him, "Let not the king sin against his servant David, because he has not sinned against you, and because his deeds have brought good to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus Jonathan spoke well of David to Saul his father, and said to him, "Let not the king sin against his servant, against David, because he has not sinned against you, and because his works havebeen very good toward you.
verses.textEnNlt: The next morning Jonathan spoke with his father about David, saying many good things about him. "The king must not sin against his servant David," Jonathan said. "He’s never done anything to harm you. He has always helped you in any way he could.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jonathan spoke well of David to his father Saul and said to him, "May the king not sin against his servant David, since he has not sinned against you, and since his deeds have been very beneficial to you.
verses.textEn: Jonathan spoke well of David to Saul his father and said to him, "Let not the king do wrong to his servant David; he has not wronged you, and what he has done has benefited you greatly.

verses.textZh: 他冒着生命的危险击杀了那非利士人，耶和华为以色列人施行了大拯救，那时你看见了，也很欢喜。现在你为甚么要犯罪，无缘无故杀死大卫，流无辜人的血呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他冒着生命的危险击杀了那非利士人，耶和华为以色列人施行了大拯救，那时你看见了，也很欢喜。现在你为甚么要犯罪，无缘无故杀死大卫，流无辜人的血呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他拚命杀那非利士人，耶和华为以色列众人大行拯救；那时你看见，甚是欢喜，现在为何无故要杀大卫，流无辜人的血，自己取罪呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: He took his life in his hands when he killed the Philistine. The Lord won a great victory for all Israel, and you saw it and were glad. Why then would you do wrong to an innocent man like David by killing him for no reason?"
verses.textEnEsv: For he took his life in his hand and he struck down the Philistine, and the Lord worked a great salvation for all Israel. You saw it, and rejoiced. Why then will you sin against innocent blood by killing David without cause?"
verses.textEnNkjv: For he took his life in his hands and killed the Philistine, and the Lord brought about a great deliverance for all Israel. You saw it and rejoiced. Why then will you sin against innocent blood, to kill David without a cause?"
verses.textEnNlt: Have you forgotten about the time he risked his life to kill the Philistine giant and how the Lord brought a great victory to all Israel as a result? You were certainly happy about it then. Why should you murder an innocent man like David? There is no reason for it at all!"
verses.textEnNasb: For he took his life in his hand and struck the Philistine, and the Lord brought about a great victory for all Israel; you saw it and rejoiced. Why then would you sin against innocent blood by putting David to death for no reason?"
verses.textEn: He took his life in his hands when he killed the Philistine. The Lord won a great victory for all Israel, and you saw it and were glad. Why then would you do wrong to an innocent man like David by killing him for no reason?"

verses.textZh: 扫罗听了约拿单的话，就起誓，说："我指着永活的耶和华起誓，大卫必不会被杀死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗听了约拿单的话，就起誓，说："我指着永活的耶和华起誓，大卫必不会被杀死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗听了约拿单的话，就指着永生的耶和华起誓说：「我必不杀他。」
verses.textEnNiv: Saul listened to Jonathan and took this oath: "As surely as the Lord lives, David will not be put to death."
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul listened to the voice of Jonathan. Saul swore, "As the Lord lives, he shall not be put to death."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Saul heeded the voice of Jonathan, and Saul swore, "As the Lord lives, he shall not be killed."
verses.textEnNlt: So Saul listened to Jonathan and vowed, "As surely as the Lord lives, David will not be killed."
verses.textEnNasb: Saul listened to the voice of Jonathan, and Saul vowed, "As the Lord lives, David shall not be put to death."
verses.textEn: Saul listened to Jonathan and took this oath: "As surely as the Lord lives, David will not be put to death."

verses.textZh: 约拿单叫大卫来，把这一切话都告诉他；约拿单把大卫带到扫罗那里，他就像以前一样，侍候在扫罗面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单叫大卫来，把这一切话都告诉他；约拿单把大卫带到扫罗那里，他就像以前一样，侍候在扫罗面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单叫大卫来，把这一切事告诉他，带他去见扫罗。他就仍然侍立在扫罗面前。
verses.textEnNiv: So Jonathan called David and told him the whole conversation. He brought him to Saul, and David was with Saul as before.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jonathan called David, and Jonathan reported to him all these things. And Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence as before.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jonathan called David, and Jonathan told him all these things. So Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence as in times past.
verses.textEnNlt: Afterward Jonathan called David and told him what had happened. Then he brought David to Saul, and David served in the court as before.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jonathan called David, and Jonathan told him all these words. And Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence as before.
verses.textEn: So Jonathan called David and told him the whole conversation. He brought him to Saul, and David was with Saul as before.

verses.textZh: 后来，又有战事；大卫出去与非利士人交战，大败他们，他们就在大卫面前逃跑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，又有战事；大卫出去与非利士人交战，大败他们，他们就在大卫面前逃跑。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后又有争战的事。大卫出去与非利士人打仗，大大杀败他们，他们就在他面前逃跑。
verses.textEnNiv: Once more war broke out, and David went out and fought the Philistines. He struck them with such force that they fled before him.
verses.textEnEsv: And there was war again. And David went out and fought with the Philistines and struck them with a great blow, so that they fled before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there was war again; and David went out and fought with the Philistines, and struck them with a mighty blow, and they fled from him.
verses.textEnNlt: War broke out again after that, and David led his troops against the Philistines. He attacked them with such fury that they all ran away.
verses.textEnNasb: When there was war again, David went out and fought the Philistines and defeated them with great slaughter, so that they fled from him.
verses.textEn: Once more war broke out, and David went out and fought the Philistines. He struck them with such force that they fled before him.

verses.textZh: 从耶和华那里来的恶鬼又临到扫罗身上；那时扫罗坐在屋里，手里拿着枪。大卫正在弹琴，
verses.textZhCnvs: 从耶和华那里来的恶鬼又临到扫罗身上；那时扫罗坐在屋里，手里拿着枪。大卫正在弹琴，
verses.textZhCuv: 从耶和华那里来的恶魔又降在扫罗身上（扫罗手里拿枪坐在屋里），大卫就用手弹琴。
verses.textEnNiv: But an evil spirit from the Lord came on Saul as he was sitting in his house with his spear in his hand. While David was playing the lyre,
verses.textEnEsv: Then a harmful spirit from the Lord came upon Saul, as he sat in his house with his spear in his hand. And David was playing the lyre.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the distressing spirit from the Lord came upon Saul as he sat in his house with his spear in his hand. And David was playing music with his hand.
verses.textEnNlt: But one day when Saul was sitting at home, with spear in hand, the tormenting spirit from the Lord suddenly came upon him again. As David played his harp,
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was an evil spirit from the Lord on Saul as he was sitting in his house with his spear in his hand, and David was playing the harp with his hand.
verses.textEn: But an evil spirit from the Lord came on Saul as he was sitting in his house with his spear in his hand. While David was playing the lyre,

verses.textZh: 扫罗就想用枪刺杀大卫，把他刺在墙上，但大卫从扫罗面前躲开了，他的枪刺在墙上。那天晚上大卫逃跑，就逃脱了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗就想用枪刺杀大卫，把他刺在墙上，但大卫从扫罗面前躲开了，他的枪刺在墙上。那天晚上大卫逃跑，就逃脱了。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗用枪想要刺透大卫，钉在墙上，他却躲开，扫罗的枪刺入墙内。当夜大卫逃走，躲避了。
verses.textEnNiv: Saul tried to pin him to the wall with his spear, but David eluded him as Saul drove the spear into the wall. That night David made good his escape.
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul sought to pin David to the wall with the spear, but he eluded Saul, so that he struck the spear into the wall. And David fled and escaped that night.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul sought to pin David to the wall with the spear, but he slipped away from Saul’s presence; and he drove the spear into the wall. So David fled and escaped that night.
verses.textEnNlt: Saul hurled his spear at David. But David dodged out of the way, and leaving the spear stuck in the wall, he fled and escaped into the night.
verses.textEnNasb: And Saul tried to pin David to the wall with the spear, but he escaped from Saul’s presence, so that he stuck the spear into the wall. And David fled and escaped that night.
verses.textEn: Saul tried to pin him to the wall with his spear, but David eluded him as Saul drove the spear into the wall. That night David made good his escape.

verses.textZh: 扫罗派人到大卫家里去监视他，要在第二天早晨杀死他。大卫的妻子米甲告诉他说："今天晚上你若不逃命，明天就会被杀死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗派人到大卫家里去监视他，要在第二天早晨杀死他。大卫的妻子米甲告诉他说："今天晚上你若不逃命，明天就会被杀死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗打发人到大卫的房屋那里窥探他，要等到天亮杀他。大卫的妻米甲对他说：「你今夜若不逃命，明日你要被杀。」
verses.textEnNiv: Saul sent men to David’s house to watch it and to kill him in the morning. But Michal, David’s wife, warned him, "If you don’t run for your life tonight, tomorrow you’ll be killed."
verses.textEnEsv: Saul sent messengers to David’s house to watch him, that he might kill him in the morning. But Michal, David’s wife, told him, "If you do not escape with your life tonight, tomorrow you will be killed."
verses.textEnNkjv: Saul also sent messengers to David’s house to watch him and to kill him in the morning. And Michal, David’s wife, told him, saying, "If you do not save your life tonight, tomorrow you will be killed."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Saul sent troops to watch David’s house. They were told to kill David when he came out the next morning. But Michal, David’s wife, warned him, "If you don’t escape tonight, you will be dead by morning."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul sent messengers to David’s house to watch him, in order to put him to death in the morning. But Michal, David’s wife, informed him, saying, "If you do not save your life tonight, tomorrow you will be put to death!"
verses.textEn: Saul sent men to David’s house to watch it and to kill him in the morning. But Michal, David’s wife, warned him, "If you don’t run for your life tonight, tomorrow you’ll be killed."

verses.textZh: 于是米甲从窗口把大卫缒下去，大卫就离开那里逃走，逃脱了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是米甲从窗口把大卫缒下去，大卫就离开那里逃走，逃脱了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是米甲将大卫从窗户里缒下去，大卫就逃走，躲避了。
verses.textEnNiv: So Michal let David down through a window, and he fled and escaped.
verses.textEnEsv: So Michal let David down through the window, and he fled away and escaped.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Michal let David down through a window. And he went and fled and escaped.
verses.textEnNlt: So she helped him climb out through a window, and he fled and escaped.
verses.textEnNasb: So Michal let David down through a window, and he went and fled, and escaped.
verses.textEn: So Michal let David down through a window, and he fled and escaped.

verses.textZh: 米甲把家中的一尊神像拿来，放在床上，把头枕在用山羊毛弄成的枕头上，再用衣服盖着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米甲把家中的一尊神像拿来，放在床上，把头枕在用山羊毛弄成的枕头上，再用衣服盖着。
verses.textZhCuv: 米甲把家中的神像放在床上，头枕在山羊毛装的枕头上，用被遮盖。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Michal took an idol and laid it on the bed, covering it with a garment and putting some goats’ hair at the head.
verses.textEnEsv: Michal took an image and laid it on the bed and put a pillow of goats’ hair at its head and covered it with the clothes.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Michal took an image and laid it in the bed, put a cover of goats’ hair for his head, and covered it with clothes.
verses.textEnNlt: Then she took an idol and put it in his bed, covered it with blankets, and put a cushion of goat’s hair at its head.
verses.textEnNasb: And Michal took the household idol and laid it on the bed, and put a quilt of goats’ hair at its head, and covered it with clothing.
verses.textEn: Then Michal took an idol and laid it on the bed, covering it with a garment and putting some goats’ hair at the head.

verses.textZh: 扫罗派人来捉拿大卫，米甲说："他病了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗派人来捉拿大卫，米甲说："他病了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗打发人去捉拿大卫，米甲说：「他病了。」
verses.textEnNiv: When Saul sent the men to capture David, Michal said, "He is ill."
verses.textEnEsv: And when Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, "He is sick."
verses.textEnNkjv: So when Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, "He is sick."
verses.textEnNlt: When the troops came to arrest David, she told them he was sick and couldn’t get out of bed.
verses.textEnNasb: When Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, "He is sick."
verses.textEn: When Saul sent the men to capture David, Michal said, "He is ill."

verses.textZh: 扫罗又派人去看大卫说："你们把他连床一起抬到我这里来，我好杀死他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗又派人去看大卫说："你们把他连床一起抬到我这里来，我好杀死他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗又打发人去看大卫，说：「当连床将他抬来，我好杀他。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Saul sent the men back to see David and told them, "Bring him up to me in his bed so that I may kill him."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Saul sent the messengers to see David, saying, "Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may kill him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul sent the messengers back to see David, saying, "Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may kill him."
verses.textEnNlt: But Saul sent the troops back to get David. He ordered, "Bring him to me in his bed so I can kill him!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul sent messengers to see David, saying, "Bring him up to me on his bed, so that I may put him to death."
verses.textEn: Then Saul sent the men back to see David and told them, "Bring him up to me in his bed so that I may kill him."

verses.textZh: 奉派的人进去，看见床上有一尊家中的神像，头枕在用山羊毛弄成的枕头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 奉派的人进去，看见床上有一尊家中的神像，头枕在用山羊毛弄成的枕头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 使者进去，看见床上有神像，头枕在山羊毛装的枕头上。
verses.textEnNiv: But when the men entered, there was the idol in the bed, and at the head was some goats’ hair.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the messengers came in, behold, the image was in the bed, with the pillow of goats’ hair at its head.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the messengers had come in, there was the image in the bed, with a cover of goats’ hair for his head.
verses.textEnNlt: But when they came to carry David out, they discovered that it was only an idol in the bed with a cushion of goat’s hair at its head.
verses.textEnNasb: When the messengers entered, behold, the household idol was on the bed with the quilt of goats’ hair at its head.
verses.textEn: But when the men entered, there was the idol in the bed, and at the head was some goats’ hair.

verses.textZh: 扫罗问米甲："你为甚么这样欺骗我，放了我的仇敌，让他逃走呢？"米甲回答扫罗："他对我说：‘放我走！否则我要杀死你。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗问米甲："你为甚么这样欺骗我，放了我的仇敌，让他逃走呢？"米甲回答扫罗："他对我说：‘放我走！否则我要杀死你。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗对米甲说：「你为什么这样欺哄我，放我仇敌逃走呢？」米甲回答说：「他对我说：『你放我走，不然我要杀你。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Saul said to Michal, "Why did you deceive me like this and send my enemy away so that he escaped?" Michal told him, "He said to me, ‘Let me get away. Why should I kill you?’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Saul said to Michal, "Why have you deceived me thus and let my enemy go, so that he has escaped?" And Michal answered Saul, "He said to me, ‘Let me go. Why should I kill you?’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul said to Michal, "Why have you deceived me like this, and sent my enemy away, so that he has escaped?" And Michal answered Saul, "He said to me, ‘Let me go! Why should I kill you?’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Why have you betrayed me like this and let my enemy escape?" Saul demanded of Michal. "I had to," Michal replied. "He threatened to kill me if I didn’t help him."
verses.textEnNasb: So Saul said to Michal, "Why have you betrayed me like this and let my enemy go, so that he has escaped?" And Michal said to Saul, "He said to me, ‘Let me go! Why should I put you to death?’ "
verses.textEn: Saul said to Michal, "Why did you deceive me like this and send my enemy away so that he escaped?" Michal told him, "He said to me, ‘Let me get away. Why should I kill you?’ "

verses.textZh: 大卫逃跑，逃脱了，来到拉玛见撒母耳，把扫罗对他所作的一切都告诉了撒母耳。然后他和撒母耳去拿约，住在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫逃跑，逃脱了，来到拉玛见撒母耳，把扫罗对他所作的一切都告诉了撒母耳。然后他和撒母耳去拿约，住在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫逃避，来到拉玛见撒母耳，将扫罗向他所行的事述说了一遍。他和撒母耳就往拿约去居住。
verses.textEnNiv: When David had fled and made his escape, he went to Samuel at Ramah and told him all that Saul had done to him. Then he and Samuel went to Naioth and stayed there.
verses.textEnEsv: Now David fled and escaped, and he came to Samuel at Ramah and told him all that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and lived at Naioth.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David fled and escaped, and went to Samuel at Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and stayed in Naioth.
verses.textEnNlt: So David escaped and went to Ramah to see Samuel, and he told him all that Saul had done to him. Then Samuel took David with him to live at Naioth.
verses.textEnNasb: So David fled and escaped, and came to Samuel at Ramah; and he informed him of everything that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and stayed in Naioth.
verses.textEn: When David had fled and made his escape, he went to Samuel at Ramah and told him all that Saul had done to him. Then he and Samuel went to Naioth and stayed there.

verses.textZh: 有人告诉扫罗："大卫住在拉玛的拿约。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人告诉扫罗："大卫住在拉玛的拿约。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉扫罗，说大卫在拉玛的拿约。
verses.textEnNiv: Word came to Saul: "David is in Naioth at Ramah";
verses.textEnEsv: And it was told Saul, "Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it was told Saul, saying, "Take note, David is at Naioth in Ramah!"
verses.textEnNlt: When the report reached Saul that David was at Naioth in Ramah,
verses.textEnNasb: But it was reported to Saul, saying, "Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah."
verses.textEn: Word came to Saul: "David is in Naioth at Ramah";

verses.textZh: 于是扫罗派人去捉大卫。派去的人看见一群先知正在受感说话，撒母耳站着带领他们。那时，神的灵也临到扫罗的使者身上，他们都受感说话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是扫罗派人去捉大卫。派去的人看见一群先知正在受感说话，撒母耳站着带领他们。那时，神的灵也临到扫罗的使者身上，他们都受感说话。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗打发人去捉拿大卫。去的人见有一班先知都受感说话，撒母耳站在其中监管他们；打发去的人也受神的灵感动说话。
verses.textEnNiv: so he sent men to capture him. But when they saw a group of prophets prophesying, with Samuel standing there as their leader, the Spirit of God came on Saul’s men, and they also prophesied.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Saul sent messengers to take David, and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as head over them, the Spirit of God came upon the messengers of Saul, and they also prophesied.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul sent messengers to take David. And when they saw the group of prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as leader over them, the Spirit of God came upon the messengers of Saul, and they also prophesied.
verses.textEnNlt: he sent troops to capture him. But when they arrived and saw Samuel leading a group of prophets who were prophesying, the Spirit of God came upon Saul’s men, and they also began to prophesy.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul sent messengers to take David, but when they saw the company of prophets prophesying, with Samuel standing and presiding over them, the Spirit of God came upon the messengers of Saul; and they also prophesied.
verses.textEn: so he sent men to capture him. But when they saw a group of prophets prophesying, with Samuel standing there as their leader, the Spirit of God came on Saul’s men, and they also prophesied.

verses.textZh: 有人把这事告诉了扫罗，他就再派别的人去，这些人也受感说话。扫罗第三次派人去，他们也受感说话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人把这事告诉了扫罗，他就再派别的人去，这些人也受感说话。扫罗第三次派人去，他们也受感说话。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人将这事告诉扫罗，他又打发人去，他们也受感说话。扫罗第三次打发人去，他们也受感说话。
verses.textEnNiv: Saul was told about it, and he sent more men, and they prophesied too. Saul sent men a third time, and they also prophesied.
verses.textEnEsv: When it was told Saul, he sent other messengers, and they also prophesied. And Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they also prophesied.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Saul was told, he sent other messengers, and they prophesied likewise. Then Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they prophesied also.
verses.textEnNlt: When Saul heard what had happened, he sent other troops, but they, too, prophesied! The same thing happened a third time.
verses.textEnNasb: When Saul was informed of this, he sent other messengers, but they also prophesied. So Saul sent messengers again the third time, yet they prophesied.
verses.textEn: Saul was told about it, and he sent more men, and they prophesied too. Saul sent men a third time, and they also prophesied.

verses.textZh: 后来，扫罗也亲自到拉玛去，到了西沽的大井，就问人，说："撒母耳和大卫在哪里？"有一个人回答："在拉玛的拿约。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，扫罗也亲自到拉玛去，到了西沽的大井，就问人，说："撒母耳和大卫在哪里？"有一个人回答："在拉玛的拿约。"
verses.textZhCuv: 然后扫罗自己往拉玛去，到了西沽的大井，问人说：「撒母耳和大卫在哪里呢？」有人说：「在拉玛的拿约。」
verses.textEnNiv: Finally, he himself left for Ramah and went to the great cistern at Seku. And he asked, "Where are Samuel and David?" "Over in Naioth at Ramah," they said.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he himself went to Ramah and came to the great well that is in Secu. And he asked, "Where are Samuel and David?" And one said, "Behold, they are at Naioth in Ramah."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he also went to Ramah, and came to the great well that is at Sechu. So he asked, and said, "Where are Samuel and David?" And someone said, "Indeed theyare at Naioth in Ramah."
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, Saul himself went to Ramah and arrived at the great well in Secu. "Where are Samuel and David?" he demanded. "They are at Naioth in Ramah," someone told him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he went to Ramah himself and came as far as the large well that is in Secu; and he asked, "Where are Samuel and David?" And someone said, "Behold, they are at Naioth in Ramah."
verses.textEn: Finally, he himself left for Ramah and went to the great cistern at Seku. And he asked, "Where are Samuel and David?" "Over in Naioth at Ramah," they said.

verses.textZh: 扫罗就从那里往拉玛的拿约去。神的灵也临到他身上，他一面走，一面受感说话，直到他到了拉玛的拿约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗就从那里往拉玛的拿约去。神的灵也临到他身上，他一面走，一面受感说话，直到他到了拉玛的拿约。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就往拉玛的拿约去。神的灵也感动他，一面走一面说话，直到拉玛的拿约。
verses.textEnNiv: So Saul went to Naioth at Ramah. But the Spirit of God came even on him, and he walked along prophesying until he came to Naioth.
verses.textEnEsv: And he went there to Naioth in Ramah. And the Spirit of God came upon him also, and as he went he prophesied until he came to Naioth in Ramah.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he went there to Naioth in Ramah. Then the Spirit of God was upon him also, and he went on and prophesied until he came to Naioth in Ramah.
verses.textEnNlt: But on the way to Naioth in Ramah the Spirit of God came even upon Saul, and he, too, began to prophesy all the way to Naioth!
verses.textEnNasb: So he proceeded there to Naioth in Ramah; but the Spirit of God came upon him also, so that he went along prophesying continually until he came to Naioth in Ramah.
verses.textEn: So Saul went to Naioth at Ramah. But the Spirit of God came even on him, and he walked along prophesying until he came to Naioth.

verses.textZh: 他脱掉了自己的衣服，也在撒母耳面前受感说话。那一日，他整天整夜赤着身子躺着，因此有一句俗语说："扫罗也列在先知中吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他脱掉了自己的衣服，也在撒母耳面前受感说话。那一日，他整天整夜赤着身子躺着，因此有一句俗语说："扫罗也列在先知中吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他就脱了衣服，在撒母耳面前受感说话，一昼一夜露体躺卧。因此有句俗语说：「扫罗也列在先知中吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: He stripped off his garments, and he too prophesied in Samuel’s presence. He lay naked all that day and all that night. This is why people say, "Is Saul also among the prophets?"
verses.textEnEsv: And he too stripped off his clothes, and he too prophesied before Samuel and lay naked all that day and all that night. Thus it is said, "Is Saul also among the prophets?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And he also stripped off his clothes and prophesied before Samuel in like manner, and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Therefore they say, "Is Saul also among the prophets?"
verses.textEnNlt: He tore off his clothes and lay naked on the ground all day and all night, prophesying in the presence of Samuel. The people who were watching exclaimed, "What? Is even Saul a prophet?"
verses.textEnNasb: He also stripped off his clothes, and he too prophesied before Samuel and lay down naked all that day and all night. Therefore they say, "Is Saul also among the prophets?"
verses.textEn: He stripped off his garments, and he too prophesied in Samuel’s presence. He lay naked all that day and all that night. This is why people say, "Is Saul also among the prophets?"

verses.textZh: 大卫从拉玛的拿约逃走，来见约拿单，说："我作了甚么？我有甚么罪孽？我在你父亲面前犯了甚么罪，他竟寻索我的性命呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫从拉玛的拿约逃走，来见约拿单，说："我作了甚么？我有甚么罪孽？我在你父亲面前犯了甚么罪，他竟寻索我的性命呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫从拉玛的拿约逃跑，来到约拿单那里，对他说：「我做了什么？有什么罪孽呢？在你父亲面前犯了什么罪，他竟寻索我的性命呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then David fled from Naioth at Ramah and went to Jonathan and asked, "What have I done? What is my crime? How have I wronged your father, that he is trying to kill me?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then David fled from Naioth in Ramah and came and said before Jonathan, "What have I done? What is my guilt? And what is my sin before your father, that he seeks my life?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and went and said to Jonathan, "What have I done? What is my iniquity, and what is my sin before your father, that he seeks my life?"
verses.textEnNlt: David now fled from Naioth in Ramah and found Jonathan. "What have I done?" he exclaimed. "What is my crime? How have I offended your father that he is so determined to kill me?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and he came and said to Jonathan, "What have I done? What is my guilt? And what is my sin before your father, that he is seeking my life?"
verses.textEn: Then David fled from Naioth at Ramah and went to Jonathan and asked, "What have I done? What is my crime? How have I wronged your father, that he is trying to kill me?"

verses.textZh: 约拿单对他说："绝对没有这事，你必不会死。我父亲作事，无论大小，没有不让我知道的，为甚么这事他偏要隐瞒我呢？不会这样的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单对他说："绝对没有这事，你必不会死。我父亲作事，无论大小，没有不让我知道的，为甚么这事他偏要隐瞒我呢？不会这样的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单回答说：「断然不是！你必不致死。我父做事，无论大小，没有不叫我知道的。怎么独有这事隐瞒我呢？决不如此。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Never!" Jonathan replied. "You are not going to die! Look, my father doesn’t do anything, great or small, without letting me know. Why would he hide this from me? It isn’t so!"
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to him, "Far from it! You shall not die. Behold, my father does nothing either great or small without disclosing it to me. And why should my father hide this from me? It is not so."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jonathan said to him, "By no means! You shall not die! Indeed, my father will do nothing either great or small without first telling me. And why should my father hide this thing from me? It is not so!"
verses.textEnNlt: "That’s not true!" Jonathan protested. "You’re not going to die. He always tells me everything he’s going to do, even the little things. I know my father wouldn’t hide something like this from me. It just isn’t so!"
verses.textEnNasb: He said to him, "Far from it, you shall not die! Behold, my father does nothing either great or small without informing me. So why would my father hide this thing from me? It is not so!"
verses.textEn: "Never!" Jonathan replied. "You are not going to die! Look, my father doesn’t do anything, great or small, without letting me know. Why would he hide this from me? It isn’t so!"

verses.textZh: 大卫再起誓说："你父亲一定知道我在你眼中蒙恩，就心里想：‘不要让约拿单知道这事，免得他伤心。’可是，我指着永活的耶和华，又指着你的性命起誓，我离死只差一步。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫再起誓说："你父亲一定知道我在你眼中蒙恩，就心里想：‘不要让约拿单知道这事，免得他伤心。’可是，我指着永活的耶和华，又指着你的性命起誓，我离死只差一步。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫又起誓说：「你父亲准知我在你眼前蒙恩。他心里说，不如不叫约拿单知道，恐怕他愁烦。我指着永生的耶和华，又敢在你面前起誓，我离死不过一步。」
verses.textEnNiv: But David took an oath and said, "Your father knows very well that I have found favor in your eyes, and he has said to himself, ‘Jonathan must not know this or he will be grieved.’ Yet as surely as the Lord lives and as you live, there is only a step between me and death."
verses.textEnEsv: But David vowed again, saying, "Your father knows well that I have found favor in your eyes, and he thinks, ‘Do not let Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved.’ But truly, as the Lord lives and as your soul lives, there is but a step between me and death."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David took an oath again, and said, "Your father certainly knows that I have found favor in your eyes, and he has said, ‘Do not let Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved.’ But truly, as the Lord lives and as your soul lives, thereis but a step between me and death."
verses.textEnNlt: Then David took an oath before Jonathan and said, "Your father knows perfectly well about our friendship, so he has said to himself, ‘I won’t tell Jonathan—why should I hurt him?’ But I swear to you that I am only a step away from death! I swear it by the Lord and by your own soul!"
verses.textEnNasb: Yet David vowed again, saying, "Your father is well aware that I have found favor in your sight, and he has said, ‘Jonathan is not to know this, otherwise he will be worried.’ But indeed as the Lord lives and as your soul lives, there is just a step between me and death."
verses.textEn: But David took an oath and said, "Your father knows very well that I have found favor in your eyes, and he has said to himself, ‘Jonathan must not know this or he will be grieved.’ Yet as surely as the Lord lives and as you live, there is only a step between me and death."

verses.textZh: 约拿单对大卫说："你心里想要甚么，我必为你作成。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单对大卫说："你心里想要甚么，我必为你作成。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单对大卫说：「你心里所求的，我必为你成就。」
verses.textEnNiv: Jonathan said to David, "Whatever you want me to do, I’ll do for you."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jonathan said to David, "Whatever you say, I will do for you."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jonathan said to David, "Whatever you yourself desire, I will do it for you."
verses.textEnNlt: "Tell me what I can do to help you," Jonathan exclaimed.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jonathan said to David, "Whatever you say, I will do for you."
verses.textEn: Jonathan said to David, "Whatever you want me to do, I’ll do for you."

verses.textZh: 大卫就对约拿单说："你看，明天是初一，我本该与王一同坐席。但是，求你容我去藏在田里，直到后天晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫就对约拿单说："你看，明天是初一，我本该与王一同坐席。但是，求你容我去藏在田里，直到后天晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对约拿单说：「明日是初一，我当与王同席，求你容我去藏在田野，直到第三日晚上。
verses.textEnNiv: So David said, "Look, tomorrow is the New Moon feast, and I am supposed to dine with the king; but let me go and hide in the field until the evening of the day after tomorrow.
verses.textEnEsv: David said to Jonathan, "Behold, tomorrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to sit at table with the king. But let me go, that I may hide myself in the field till the third day at evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David said to Jonathan, "Indeed tomorrow is the New Moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king to eat. But let me go, that I may hide in the field until the third day at evening.
verses.textEnNlt: David replied, "Tomorrow we celebrate the new moon festival. I’ve always eaten with the king on this occasion, but tomorrow I’ll hide in the field and stay there until the evening of the third day.
verses.textEnNasb: So David said to Jonathan, "Behold, tomorrow is the new moon, and I am obligated to sit down to eat with the king. But let me go so that I may hide myself in the field until the third evening.
verses.textEn: So David said, "Look, tomorrow is the New Moon feast, and I am supposed to dine with the king; but let me go and hide in the field until the evening of the day after tomorrow.

verses.textZh: 如果你父亲不见我在座，你就说：‘大卫恳求我让他赶回他的本城伯利恒去，因为他全家在那里有献年祭的事。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你父亲不见我在座，你就说：‘大卫恳求我让他赶回他的本城伯利恒去，因为他全家在那里有献年祭的事。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你父亲若见我不在席上，你就说：『大卫切求我许他回本城伯利恒去，因为他全家在那里献年祭。』
verses.textEnNiv: If your father misses me at all, tell him, ‘David earnestly asked my permission to hurry to Bethlehem, his hometown, because an annual sacrifice is being made there for his whole clan.’
verses.textEnEsv: If your father misses me at all, then say, ‘David earnestly asked leave of me to run to Bethlehem his city, for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the clan.’
verses.textEnNkjv: If your father misses me at all, then say, ‘David earnestly asked permission of me that he might run over to Bethlehem, his city, for thereis a yearly sacrifice there for all the family.’
verses.textEnNlt: If your father asks where I am, tell him I asked permission to go home to Bethlehem for an annual family sacrifice.
verses.textEnNasb: If your father misses me at all, then say, ‘David earnestly requested leave of me to run to Bethlehem, his city, because it is the yearly sacrifice there for the whole family.’
verses.textEn: If your father misses me at all, tell him, ‘David earnestly asked my permission to hurry to Bethlehem, his hometown, because an annual sacrifice is being made there for his whole clan.’

verses.textZh: 如果你父亲这样说：‘好！’那么仆人就平安无事了；如果他大大发怒，你就知道，他决意要害我了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你父亲这样说：‘好！’那么仆人就平安无事了；如果他大大发怒，你就知道，他决意要害我了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你父亲若说好，仆人就平安了；他若发怒，你就知道他决意要害我。
verses.textEnNiv: If he says, ‘Very well,’ then your servant is safe. But if he loses his temper, you can be sure that he is determined to harm me.
verses.textEnEsv: If he says, ‘Good!’ it will be well with your servant, but if he is angry, then know that harm is determined by him.
verses.textEnNkjv: If he says thus: ‘Itis well,’ your servant will be safe. But if he is very angry, be sure that evil is determined by him.
verses.textEnNlt: If he says, ‘Fine!’ you will know all is well. But if he is angry and loses his temper, you will know he is determined to kill me.
verses.textEnNasb: If he says, ‘That is good,’ your servant will be safe; but if he is very angry, be aware that he has decided on evil.
verses.textEn: If he says, ‘Very well,’ then your servant is safe. But if he loses his temper, you can be sure that he is determined to harm me.

verses.textZh: 求你以慈爱待仆人，因为你曾与仆人在耶和华面前立盟约。如果我有罪孽，你就亲手把我杀死，为甚么要把我交给你父亲呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你以慈爱待仆人，因为你曾与仆人在耶和华面前立盟约。如果我有罪孽，你就亲手把我杀死，为甚么要把我交给你父亲呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 求你施恩与仆人，因你在耶和华面前曾与仆人结盟。我若有罪，不如你自己杀我，何必将我交给你父亲呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: As for you, show kindness to your servant, for you have brought him into a covenant with you before the Lord . If I am guilty, then kill me yourself! Why hand me over to your father?"
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore deal kindly with your servant, for you have brought your servant into a covenant of the Lord with you. But if there is guilt in me, kill me yourself, for why should you bring me to your father?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore you shall deal kindly with your servant, for you have brought your servant into a covenant of the Lord with you. Nevertheless, if there is iniquity in me, kill me yourself, for why should you bring me to your father?"
verses.textEnNlt: Show me this loyalty as my sworn friend—for we made a solemn pact before the Lord —or kill me yourself if I have sinned against your father. But please don’t betray me to him!"
verses.textEnNasb: So deal kindly with your servant, for you have brought your servant into a covenant of the Lord with you. But if I am guilty of wrongdoing, kill me yourself; for why then should you bring me to your father?"
verses.textEn: As for you, show kindness to your servant, for you have brought him into a covenant with you before the Lord . If I am guilty, then kill me yourself! Why hand me over to your father?"

verses.textZh: 约拿单说："绝对没有这事，如果我知道我父亲决意要害你，我会不告诉你吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单说："绝对没有这事，如果我知道我父亲决意要害你，我会不告诉你吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单说：「断无此事！我若知道我父亲决意害你，我岂不告诉你呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Never!" Jonathan said. "If I had the least inkling that my father was determined to harm you, wouldn’t I tell you?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Jonathan said, "Far be it from you! If I knew that it was determined by my father that harm should come to you, would I not tell you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jonathan said, "Far be it from you! For if I knew certainly that evil was determined by my father to come upon you, then would I not tell you?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Never!" Jonathan exclaimed. "You know that if I had the slightest notion my father was planning to kill you, I would tell you at once."
verses.textEnNasb: Jonathan said, "Far be it from you! For if I in fact learn that my father has decided to inflict harm on you, would I not inform you?"
verses.textEn: "Never!" Jonathan said. "If I had the least inkling that my father was determined to harm you, wouldn’t I tell you?"

verses.textZh: 大卫对约拿单说："如果你父亲严厉地回答你，谁来告诉我呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对约拿单说："如果你父亲严厉地回答你，谁来告诉我呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对约拿单说：「你父亲若用厉言回答你，谁来告诉我呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: David asked, "Who will tell me if your father answers you harshly?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then David said to Jonathan, "Who will tell me if your father answers you roughly?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David said to Jonathan, "Who will tell me, or what if your father answers you roughly?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then David asked, "How will I know whether or not your father is angry?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to Jonathan, "Who will inform me if your father answers you harshly?"
verses.textEn: David asked, "Who will tell me if your father answers you harshly?"

verses.textZh: 约拿单对大卫说："你来，我们出到田里去吧！"他们二人就出到田里去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单对大卫说："你来，我们出到田里去吧！"他们二人就出到田里去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单对大卫说：「你我且往田野去。」二人就往田野去了。
verses.textEnNiv: "Come," Jonathan said, "let’s go out into the field." So they went there together.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jonathan said to David, "Come, let us go out into the field." So they both went out into the field.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jonathan said to David, "Come, let us go out into the field." So both of them went out into the field.
verses.textEnNlt: "Come out to the field with me," Jonathan replied. And they went out there together.
verses.textEnNasb: Jonathan said to David, "Come, and let’s go out to the field." So both of them went out to the field.
verses.textEn: "Come," Jonathan said, "let’s go out into the field." So they went there together.

verses.textZh: 约拿单对大卫说："愿耶和华以色列的神作证，明天或后天约在这个时候，我探出了我父亲的意思，如果他对你有好感，那时我会不派人来告诉你吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单对大卫说："愿耶和华以色列的神作证，明天或后天约在这个时候，我探出了我父亲的意思，如果他对你有好感，那时我会不派人来告诉你吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单对大卫说：「愿耶和华－以色列的神为证。明日约在这时候，或第三日，我探我父亲的意思，若向你有好意，我岂不打发人告诉你吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jonathan said to David, "I swear by the Lord , the God of Israel, that I will surely sound out my father by this time the day after tomorrow! If he is favorably disposed toward you, will I not send you word and let you know?
verses.textEnEsv: And Jonathan said to David, "The Lord , the God of Israel, be witness! When I have sounded out my father, about this time tomorrow, or the third day, behold, if he is well disposed toward David, shall I not then send and disclose it to you?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jonathan said to David: "The Lord God of Israel iswitness! When I have sounded out my father sometime tomorrow, or the third day, and indeed thereis good toward David, and I do not send to you and tell you,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jonathan told David, "I promise by the Lord , the God of Israel, that by this time tomorrow, or the next day at the latest, I will talk to my father and let you know at once how he feels about you. If he speaks favorably about you, I will let you know.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jonathan said to David, "The Lord, the God of Israel, is my witness! When I have sounded out my father about this time tomorrow or the third day, behold, if he has a good feeling toward you, shall I not then send word to you and inform you?
verses.textEn: Then Jonathan said to David, "I swear by the Lord , the God of Israel, that I will surely sound out my father by this time the day after tomorrow! If he is favorably disposed toward you, will I not send you word and let you know?

verses.textZh: 假如我父亲有意要害你，我若是不告诉你，不让你走，不使你平平安安地离去，愿耶和华加倍惩罚我。愿耶和华与你同在，好象从前与我父亲同在一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 假如我父亲有意要害你，我若是不告诉你，不让你走，不使你平平安安地离去，愿耶和华加倍惩罚我。愿耶和华与你同在，好象从前与我父亲同在一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我父亲若有意害你，我不告诉你使你平平安安地走，愿耶和华重重地降罚与我。愿耶和华与你同在，如同从前与我父亲同在一样。
verses.textEnNiv: But if my father intends to harm you, may the Lord deal with Jonathan, be it ever so severely, if I do not let you know and send you away in peace. May the Lord be with you as he has been with my father.
verses.textEnEsv: But should it please my father to do you harm, the Lord do so to Jonathan and more also if I do not disclose it to you and send you away, that you may go in safety. May the Lord be with you, as he has been with my father.
verses.textEnNkjv: may the Lord do so and much more to Jonathan. But if it pleases my father todo you evil, then I will report it to you and send you away, that you may go in safety. And the Lord be with you as He has been with my father.
verses.textEnNlt: But if he is angry and wants you killed, may the Lord strike me and even kill me if I don’t warn you so you can escape and live. May the Lord be with you as he used to be with my father.
verses.textEnNasb: If it pleases my father to do you harm, may the Lord do so to me and more so, if I fail to inform you and send you away, so that you may go in safety. And may the Lord be with you as He has been with my father.
verses.textEn: But if my father intends to harm you, may the Lord deal with Jonathan, be it ever so severely, if I do not let you know and send you away in peace. May the Lord be with you as he has been with my father.

verses.textZh: 我活着的时候，求你以耶和华的慈爱待我，使我不致于死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我活着的时候，求你以耶和华的慈爱待我，使我不致于死。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要照耶和华的慈爱恩待我，不但我活着的时候免我死亡，
verses.textEnNiv: But show me unfailing kindness like the Lord ’s kindness as long as I live, so that I may not be killed,
verses.textEnEsv: If I am still alive, show me the steadfast love of the Lord , that I may not die;
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall not only show me the kindness of the Lord while I still live, that I may not die;
verses.textEnNlt: And may you treat me with the faithful love of the Lord as long as I live. But if I die,
verses.textEnNasb: And if I am still alive, will you not show me the faithfulness of the Lord, so that I do not die?
verses.textEn: But show me unfailing kindness like the Lord ’s kindness as long as I live, so that I may not be killed,

verses.textZh: 我死了以后，耶和华从地上一一剪除大卫的仇敌的时候，你也不可向我的家永远断绝你的慈爱。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我死了以后，耶和华从地上一一剪除大卫的仇敌的时候，你也不可向我的家永远断绝你的慈爱。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就是我死后，耶和华从地上剪除你仇敌的时候，你也永不可向我家绝了恩惠。」
verses.textEnNiv: and do not ever cut off your kindness from my family—not even when the Lord has cut off every one of David’s enemies from the face of the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: and do not cut off your steadfast love from my house forever, when the Lord cuts off every one of the enemies of David from the face of the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: but you shall not cut off your kindness from my house forever, no, not when the Lord has cut off every one of the enemies of David from the face of the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: treat my family with this faithful love, even when the Lord destroys all your enemies from the face of the earth."
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall never cut off your loyalty to my house, not even when the Lord cuts off every one of the enemies of David from the face of the earth."
verses.textEn: and do not ever cut off your kindness from my family—not even when the Lord has cut off every one of David’s enemies from the face of the earth."

verses.textZh: 于是约拿单与大卫家立盟约，说："愿耶和华藉大卫仇敌的手追讨违背盟约的罪。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是约拿单与大卫家立盟约，说："愿耶和华藉大卫仇敌的手追讨违背盟约的罪。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是约拿单与大卫家结盟，说：「愿耶和华藉大卫的仇敌追讨背约的罪。」
verses.textEnNiv: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, "May the Lord call David’s enemies to account."
verses.textEnEsv: And Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, "May the Lord take vengeance on David’s enemies."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jonathan made acovenant with the house of David, saying, "Let the Lord require it at the hand of David’s enemies."
verses.textEnNlt: So Jonathan made a solemn pact with David, saying, "May the Lord destroy all your enemies!"
verses.textEnNasb: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, "May the Lord demand it from the hands of David’s enemies."
verses.textEn: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, "May the Lord call David’s enemies to account."

verses.textZh: 约拿单由于爱大卫，就使大卫再起誓；他爱大卫如同爱自己的命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单由于爱大卫，就使大卫再起誓；他爱大卫如同爱自己的命。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单因爱大卫如同爱自己的性命，就使他再起誓。
verses.textEnNiv: And Jonathan had David reaffirm his oath out of love for him, because he loved him as he loved himself.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jonathan made David swear again by his love for him, for he loved him as he loved his own soul.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jonathan again caused David to vow, because he loved him; for he loved him as he loved his own soul.
verses.textEnNlt: And Jonathan made David reaffirm his vow of friendship again, for Jonathan loved David as he loved himself.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jonathan made David vow again because of his love for him, because he loved him as he loved his own life.
verses.textEn: And Jonathan had David reaffirm his oath out of love for him, because he loved him as he loved himself.

verses.textZh: 约拿单对大卫说："明天是初一，因为你的座位空着，人必注意到你不在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单对大卫说："明天是初一，因为你的座位空着，人必注意到你不在。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单对他说：「明日是初一，你的座位空设，人必理会你不在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jonathan said to David, "Tomorrow is the New Moon feast. You will be missed, because your seat will be empty.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jonathan said to him, "Tomorrow is the new moon, and you will be missed, because your seat will be empty.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jonathan said to David, "Tomorrow is the New Moon; and you will be missed, because your seat will be empty.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jonathan said, "Tomorrow we celebrate the new moon festival. You will be missed when your place at the table is empty.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jonathan said to him, "Tomorrow is the new moon, and you will be missed since your seat will be empty.
verses.textEn: Then Jonathan said to David, "Tomorrow is the New Moon feast. You will be missed, because your seat will be empty.

verses.textZh: 到后天，你要赶快下去，到你以前出事那天藏身的地方，在以色盘石旁边等候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到后天，你要赶快下去，到你以前出事那天藏身的地方，在以色盘石旁边等候。
verses.textZhCuv: 你等三日，就要速速下去，到你从前遇事所藏的地方，在以色磐石那里等候。
verses.textEnNiv: The day after tomorrow, toward evening, go to the place where you hid when this trouble began, and wait by the stone Ezel.
verses.textEnEsv: On the third day go down quickly to the place where you hid yourself when the matter was in hand, and remain beside the stone heap.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when you have stayed three days, go down quickly and come to the place where you hid on the day of the deed; and remain by the stone Ezel.
verses.textEnNlt: The day after tomorrow, toward evening, go to the place where you hid before, and wait there by the stone pile.
verses.textEnNasb: When you have stayed for three days, you shall go down quickly and come to the place where you hid yourself on that eventful day, and you shall remain beside the stone Ezel.
verses.textEn: The day after tomorrow, toward evening, go to the place where you hid when this trouble began, and wait by the stone Ezel.

verses.textZh: 我要向盘石旁边射三支箭，好象射箭靶一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要向盘石旁边射三支箭，好象射箭靶一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要向磐石旁边射三箭，如同射箭靶一样。
verses.textEnNiv: I will shoot three arrows to the side of it, as though I were shooting at a target.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will shoot three arrows to the side of it, as though I shot at a mark.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I will shoot three arrows to the side, as though I shot at a target;
verses.textEnNlt: I will come out and shoot three arrows to the side of the stone pile as though I were shooting at a target.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will shoot three arrows to the side, as though I shot at a target.
verses.textEn: I will shoot three arrows to the side of it, as though I were shooting at a target.

verses.textZh: 然后，我要派一个仆人去，说：‘你去把箭找回来。’如果我对那仆人说：‘看哪！箭在你的后面，把箭拿回来。’你就可以回来，因为我指着永活的耶和华起誓，你必平安无事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后，我要派一个仆人去，说：‘你去把箭找回来。’如果我对那仆人说：‘看哪！箭在你的后面，把箭拿回来。’你就可以回来，因为我指着永活的耶和华起誓，你必平安无事。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要打发童子，说：『去把箭找来。』我若对童子说：『箭在后头，把箭拿来』，你就可以回来；我指着永生的耶和华起誓，你必平安无事。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I will send a boy and say, ‘Go, find the arrows.’ If I say to him, ‘Look, the arrows are on this side of you; bring them here,’ then come, because, as surely as the Lord lives, you are safe; there is no danger.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, I will send the boy, saying, ‘Go, find the arrows.’ If I say to the boy, ‘Look, the arrows are on this side of you, take them,’ then you are to come, for, as the Lord lives, it is safe for you and there is no danger.
verses.textEnNkjv: and there I will send a lad, saying, ‘Go, find the arrows.’ If I expressly say to the lad, ‘Look, the arrows are on this side of you; get them and come’—then, as the Lord lives, thereis safety for you and no harm.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will send a boy to bring the arrows back. If you hear me tell him, ‘They’re on this side,’ then you will know, as surely as the Lord lives, that all is well, and there is no trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: Then behold, I will send the boy, telling him, ‘Go, find the arrows.’ If I specifically say to the boy, ‘Behold, the arrows are on this side of you, get them,’ then come, because it is safe for you and there is nothing to harm you, as the Lord lives.
verses.textEn: Then I will send a boy and say, ‘Go, find the arrows.’ If I say to him, ‘Look, the arrows are on this side of you; bring them here,’ then come, because, as surely as the Lord lives, you are safe; there is no danger.

verses.textZh: 如果我对仆人说：‘看哪！箭在你的前面。’你就要离去，因为是耶和华打发你去的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我对仆人说：‘看哪！箭在你的前面。’你就要离去，因为是耶和华打发你去的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我若对童子说：『箭在前头』，你就要去，因为是耶和华打发你去的。
verses.textEnNiv: But if I say to the boy, ‘Look, the arrows are beyond you,’ then you must go, because the Lord has sent you away.
verses.textEnEsv: But if I say to the youth, ‘Look, the arrows are beyond you,’ then go, for the Lord has sent you away.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if I say thus to the young man, ‘Look, the arrows are beyond you’—go your way, for the Lord has sent you away.
verses.textEnNlt: But if I tell him, ‘Go farther—the arrows are still ahead of you,’ then it will mean that you must leave immediately, for the Lord is sending you away.
verses.textEnNasb: But if I say to the youth, ‘Behold, the arrows are beyond you,’ go, because the Lord has sent you away.
verses.textEn: But if I say to the boy, ‘Look, the arrows are beyond you,’ then you must go, because the Lord has sent you away.

verses.textZh: 至于你我之间所说的这事，有耶和华永远在你我之间作证。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你我之间所说的这事，有耶和华永远在你我之间作证。"
verses.textZhCuv: 至于你我今日所说的话，有耶和华在你我中间为证，直到永远。」
verses.textEnNiv: And about the matter you and I discussed—remember, the Lord is witness between you and me forever."
verses.textEnEsv: And as for the matter of which you and I have spoken, behold, the Lord is between you and me forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: And as for the matter which you and I have spoken of, indeed the Lordbe between you and me forever."
verses.textEnNlt: And may the Lord make us keep our promises to each other, for he has witnessed them."
verses.textEnNasb: As for the agreement of which you and I have spoken, behold, the Lord is between you and me forever."
verses.textEn: And about the matter you and I discussed—remember, the Lord is witness between you and me forever."

verses.textZh: 于是大卫在田里藏起来。到了初一，王坐席吃饭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫在田里藏起来。到了初一，王坐席吃饭。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫就去藏在田野。到了初一日，王坐席要吃饭。
verses.textEnNiv: So David hid in the field, and when the New Moon feast came, the king sat down to eat.
verses.textEnEsv: So David hid himself in the field. And when the new moon came, the king sat down to eat food.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David hid in the field. And when the New Moon had come, the king sat down to eat the feast.
verses.textEnNlt: So David hid himself in the field, and when the new moon festival began, the king sat down to eat.
verses.textEnNasb: So David hid himself in the field; and when the new moon came, the king sat down to eat food.
verses.textEn: So David hid in the field, and when the New Moon feast came, the king sat down to eat.

verses.textZh: 王照常坐在他的座位上，就是靠墙的座位，约拿单坐在对面 ，押尼珥坐在扫罗旁边，大卫的座位却空着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王照常坐在他的座位上，就是靠墙的座位，约拿单坐在对面 ，押尼珥坐在扫罗旁边，大卫的座位却空着。
verses.textZhCuv: 王照常坐在靠墙的位上，约拿单侍立，押尼珥坐在扫罗旁边，大卫的座位空设。
verses.textEnNiv: He sat in his customary place by the wall, opposite Jonathan, and Abner sat next to Saul, but David’s place was empty.
