verses.textEnEsv: The king sat on his seat, as at other times, on the seat by the wall. Jonathan sat opposite, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, but David’s place was empty.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the king sat on his seat, as at other times, on a seat by the wall. And Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, but David’s place was empty.
verses.textEnNlt: He sat at his usual place against the wall, with Jonathan sitting opposite him and Abner beside him. But David’s place was empty.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the king sat on his seat as usual, the seat by the wall; then Jonathan stood up and Abner sat down by Saul’s side; but David’s place was empty.
verses.textEn: He sat in his customary place by the wall, opposite Jonathan, and Abner sat next to Saul, but David’s place was empty.

verses.textZh: 那天扫罗没有说甚么，因为他心里想："这是恰巧的事，或许大卫沾染了不洁，还没有得到洁净。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那天扫罗没有说甚么，因为他心里想："这是恰巧的事，或许大卫沾染了不洁，还没有得到洁净。"
verses.textZhCuv: 然而这日扫罗没有说什么，他想大卫遇事，偶染不洁，他必定是不洁。
verses.textEnNiv: Saul said nothing that day, for he thought, "Something must have happened to David to make him ceremonially unclean—surely he is unclean."
verses.textEnEsv: Yet Saul did not say anything that day, for he thought, "Something has happened to him. He is not clean; surely he is not clean."
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless Saul did not say anything that day, for he thought, "Something has happened to him; he is unclean, surely he is unclean."
verses.textEnNlt: Saul didn’t say anything about it that day, for he said to himself, "Something must have made David ceremonially unclean."
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless Saul did not say anything that day, because he thought, "It must have been an accident; he is not clean, undoubtedly he is not clean."
verses.textEn: Saul said nothing that day, for he thought, "Something must have happened to David to make him ceremonially unclean—surely he is unclean."

verses.textZh: 次日，就是初二，大卫的座位仍是空着。于是扫罗问他的儿子约拿单："为甚么耶西的儿子昨天今天都没有来吃饭呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 次日，就是初二，大卫的座位仍是空着。于是扫罗问他的儿子约拿单："为甚么耶西的儿子昨天今天都没有来吃饭呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 初二日大卫的座位还空设。扫罗问他儿子约拿单说：「耶西的儿子为何昨日、今日没有来吃饭呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: But the next day, the second day of the month, David’s place was empty again. Then Saul said to his son Jonathan, "Why hasn’t the son of Jesse come to the meal, either yesterday or today?"
verses.textEnEsv: But on the second day, the day after the new moon, David’s place was empty. And Saul said to Jonathan his son, "Why has not the son of Jesse come to the meal, either yesterday or today?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened the next day, the second day of the month, that David’s place was empty. And Saul said to Jonathan his son, "Why has the son of Jesse not come to eat, either yesterday or today?"
verses.textEnNlt: But when David’s place was empty again the next day, Saul asked Jonathan, "Why hasn’t the son of Jesse been here for the meal either yesterday or today?"
verses.textEnNasb: But it came about the next day, the second day of the new moon, that David’s place was empty again; so Saul said to his son Jonathan, "Why has the son of Jesse not come to the meal, either yesterday or today?"
verses.textEn: But the next day, the second day of the month, David’s place was empty again. Then Saul said to his son Jonathan, "Why hasn’t the son of Jesse come to the meal, either yesterday or today?"

verses.textZh: 约拿单回答扫罗："大卫恳切地求我让他回伯利恒去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单回答扫罗："大卫恳切地求我让他回伯利恒去。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单回答扫罗说：「大卫切求我容他往伯利恒去。
verses.textEnNiv: Jonathan answered, "David earnestly asked me for permission to go to Bethlehem.
verses.textEnEsv: Jonathan answered Saul, "David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Bethlehem.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jonathan answered Saul, "David earnestly asked permission of me togo to Bethlehem.
verses.textEnNlt: Jonathan replied, "David earnestly asked me if he could go to Bethlehem.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jonathan answered Saul, "David earnestly requested leave of me to go to Bethlehem.
verses.textEn: Jonathan answered, "David earnestly asked me for permission to go to Bethlehem.

verses.textZh: 他说：‘求你让我去，因为我们的家在城里有献祭的事，我哥哥吩咐我去。所以，我若是在你眼前蒙恩，求你让我离开，看看我的哥哥们。’因此，大卫没有来赴王的筵席。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说：‘求你让我去，因为我们的家在城里有献祭的事，我哥哥吩咐我去。所以，我若是在你眼前蒙恩，求你让我离开，看看我的哥哥们。’因此，大卫没有来赴王的筵席。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：『求你容我去，因为我家在城里有献祭的事；我长兄吩咐我去。如今我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你容我去见我的弟兄』；所以大卫没有赴王的席。」
verses.textEnNiv: He said, ‘Let me go, because our family is observing a sacrifice in the town and my brother has ordered me to be there. If I have found favor in your eyes, let me get away to see my brothers.’ That is why he has not come to the king’s table."
verses.textEnEsv: He said, ‘Let me go, for our clan holds a sacrifice in the city, and my brother has commanded me to be there. So now, if I have found favor in your eyes, let me get away and see my brothers.’ For this reason he has not come to the king’s table."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, ‘Please let me go, for our family has a sacrifice in the city, and my brother has commanded me tobethere. And now, if I have found favor in your eyes, please let me get away and see my brothers.’ Therefore he has not come to the king’s table."
verses.textEnNlt: He said, ‘Please let me go, for we are having a family sacrifice. My brother demanded that I be there. So please let me get away to see my brothers.’ That’s why he isn’t here at the king’s table."
verses.textEnNasb: He said, ‘Please let me go, because our family has a sacrifice in the city, and my brother has ordered me to attend. So now, if I have found favor in your sight, please let me slip away so that I may see my brothers.’ For this reason he has not come to the king’s table."
verses.textEn: He said, ‘Let me go, because our family is observing a sacrifice in the town and my brother has ordered me to be there. If I have found favor in your eyes, let me get away to see my brothers.’ That is why he has not come to the king’s table."

verses.textZh: 于是扫罗向约拿单发怒，对他说："你这邪僻悖逆妇人所生的，我岂不知道你喜悦耶西的儿子，自取羞辱，也羞辱生你的母亲吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是扫罗向约拿单发怒，对他说："你这邪僻悖逆妇人所生的，我岂不知道你喜悦耶西的儿子，自取羞辱，也羞辱生你的母亲吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗向约拿单发怒，对他说：「你这顽梗悖逆之妇人所生的，我岂不知道你喜悦耶西的儿子，自取羞辱，以致你母亲露体蒙羞吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Saul’s anger flared up at Jonathan and he said to him, "You son of a perverse and rebellious woman! Don’t I know that you have sided with the son of Jesse to your own shame and to the shame of the mother who bore you?
verses.textEnEsv: Then Saul’s anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said to him, "You son of a perverse, rebellious woman, do I not know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own shame, and to the shame of your mother’s nakedness?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul’s anger was aroused against Jonathan, and he said to him, "You son of a perverse, rebellious woman! Do I not know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own shame and to the shame of your mother’s nakedness?
verses.textEnNlt: Saul boiled with rage at Jonathan. "You stupid son of a whore!" he swore at him. "Do you think I don’t know that you want him to be king in your place, shaming yourself and your mother?
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul’s anger burned against Jonathan, and he said to him, "You son of a perverse, rebellious woman! Do I not know that you are choosing the son of Jesse to your own shame, and to the shame of your mother’s nakedness?
verses.textEn: Saul’s anger flared up at Jonathan and he said to him, "You son of a perverse and rebellious woman! Don’t I know that you have sided with the son of Jesse to your own shame and to the shame of the mother who bore you?

verses.textZh: 因为只要耶西的儿子还活在这世上，你和你的国就不能稳固。现在，你要派人去把他抓到我这里来，因为他是该死的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为只要耶西的儿子还活在这世上，你和你的国就不能稳固。现在，你要派人去把他抓到我这里来，因为他是该死的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶西的儿子若在世间活着，你和你的国位必站立不住。现在你要打发人去，将他捉拿交给我；他是该死的。」
verses.textEnNiv: As long as the son of Jesse lives on this earth, neither you nor your kingdom will be established. Now send someone to bring him to me, for he must die!"
verses.textEnEsv: For as long as the son of Jesse lives on the earth, neither you nor your kingdom shall be established. Therefore send and bring him to me, for he shall surely die."
verses.textEnNkjv: For as long as the son of Jesse lives on the earth, you shall not be established, nor your kingdom. Now therefore, send and bring him to me, for he shall surely die."
verses.textEnNlt: As long as that son of Jesse is alive, you’ll never be king. Now go and get him so I can kill him!"
verses.textEnNasb: For, as long as the son of Jesse lives on the earth, neither you nor your kingdom will be established. Now then, send men and bring him to me, for he is doomed to die!"
verses.textEn: As long as the son of Jesse lives on this earth, neither you nor your kingdom will be established. Now send someone to bring him to me, for he must die!"

verses.textZh: 约拿单回答他父亲扫罗说："为甚么要把他处死呢？他作了甚么事呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单回答他父亲扫罗说："为甚么要把他处死呢？他作了甚么事呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单对父亲扫罗说：「他为什么该死呢？他做了什么呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Why should he be put to death? What has he done?" Jonathan asked his father.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jonathan answered Saul his father, "Why should he be put to death? What has he done?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said to him, "Why should he be killed? What has he done?"
verses.textEnNlt: "But why should he be put to death?" Jonathan asked his father. "What has he done?"
verses.textEnNasb: But Jonathan replied to his father Saul and said to him, "Why must he be put to death? What has he done?"
verses.textEn: "Why should he be put to death? What has he done?" Jonathan asked his father.

verses.textZh: 扫罗向着约拿单把枪掷过去，要刺杀他。约拿单就知道，他父亲已经决意要杀死大卫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗向着约拿单把枪掷过去，要刺杀他。约拿单就知道，他父亲已经决意要杀死大卫。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗向约拿单抡枪要刺他，约拿单就知道他父亲决意要杀大卫。
verses.textEnNiv: But Saul hurled his spear at him to kill him. Then Jonathan knew that his father intended to kill David.
verses.textEnEsv: But Saul hurled his spear at him to strike him. So Jonathan knew that his father was determined to put David to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul cast a spear at him to kill him, by which Jonathan knew that it was determined by his father to kill David.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Saul hurled his spear at Jonathan, intending to kill him. So at last Jonathan realized that his father was really determined to kill David.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul hurled his spear at him to strike and kill him; so Jonathan knew that his father had decided to put David to death.
verses.textEn: But Saul hurled his spear at him to kill him. Then Jonathan knew that his father intended to kill David.

verses.textZh: 约拿单怒气冲冲地从席间退去，初二这天，他没有吃饭；因为他父亲羞辱了大卫，他就为大卫担忧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单怒气冲冲地从席间退去，初二这天，他没有吃饭；因为他父亲羞辱了大卫，他就为大卫担忧。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是约拿单气忿忿地从席上起来，在这初二日没有吃饭。他因见父亲羞辱大卫，就为大卫愁烦。
verses.textEnNiv: Jonathan got up from the table in fierce anger; on that second day of the feast he did not eat, because he was grieved at his father’s shameful treatment of David.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jonathan rose from the table in fierce anger and ate no food the second day of the month, for he was grieved for David, because his father had disgraced him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and ate no food the second day of the month, for he was grieved for David, because his father had treated him shamefully.
verses.textEnNlt: Jonathan left the table in fierce anger and refused to eat on that second day of the festival, for he was crushed by his father’s shameful behavior toward David.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jonathan got up from the table in the heat of anger, and did not eat food on the second day of the new moon, because he was worried about David since his father had insulted him.
verses.textEn: Jonathan got up from the table in fierce anger; on that second day of the feast he did not eat, because he was grieved at his father’s shameful treatment of David.

verses.textZh: 到了早晨，约拿单照着与大卫约定的时候，出到田里去，有一个小童与他在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了早晨，约拿单照着与大卫约定的时候，出到田里去，有一个小童与他在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 次日早晨，约拿单按着与大卫约会的时候出到田野，有一个童子跟随。
verses.textEnNiv: In the morning Jonathan went out to the field for his meeting with David. He had a small boy with him,
verses.textEnEsv: In the morning Jonathan went out into the field to the appointment with David, and with him a little boy.
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad was with him.
verses.textEnNlt: The next morning, as agreed, Jonathan went out into the field and took a young boy with him to gather his arrows.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about in the morning that Jonathan went out to the field at the time agreed upon with David, and a little boy was with him.
verses.textEn: In the morning Jonathan went out to the field for his meeting with David. He had a small boy with him,

verses.textZh: 他对那童仆说："你跑去，把我所射的箭找回来。"那童仆跑去的时候，约拿单就把箭射到他前面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对那童仆说："你跑去，把我所射的箭找回来。"那童仆跑去的时候，约拿单就把箭射到他前面。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单对童子说：「你跑去，把我所射的箭找来。」童子跑去，约拿单就把箭射在童子前头。
verses.textEnNiv: and he said to the boy, "Run and find the arrows I shoot." As the boy ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to his boy, "Run and find the arrows that I shoot." As the boy ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to his lad, "Now run, find the arrows which I shoot." As the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.
verses.textEnNlt: "Start running," he told the boy, "so you can find the arrows as I shoot them." So the boy ran, and Jonathan shot an arrow beyond him.
verses.textEnNasb: He said to his boy, "Run, find now the arrows which I am about to shoot." The boy ran, and he shot an arrow past him.
verses.textEn: and he said to the boy, "Run and find the arrows I shoot." As the boy ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.

verses.textZh: 那童仆到了约拿单的箭射到的地方，约拿单就在那童仆的背后喊叫："箭不是在你的前面吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那童仆到了约拿单的箭射到的地方，约拿单就在那童仆的背后喊叫："箭不是在你的前面吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 童子到了约拿单落箭之地，约拿单呼叫童子说：「箭不是在你前头吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: When the boy came to the place where Jonathan’s arrow had fallen, Jonathan called out after him, "Isn’t the arrow beyond you?"
verses.textEnEsv: And when the boy came to the place of the arrow that Jonathan had shot, Jonathan called after the boy and said, "Is not the arrow beyond you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: When the lad had come to the place where the arrow was which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried out after the lad and said, "Is not the arrow beyond you?"
verses.textEnNlt: When the boy had almost reached the arrow, Jonathan shouted, "The arrow is still ahead of you.
verses.textEnNasb: When the boy reached the location of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan called after the boy and said, "Is the arrow not beyond you?"
verses.textEn: When the boy came to the place where Jonathan’s arrow had fallen, Jonathan called out after him, "Isn’t the arrow beyond you?"

verses.textZh: 约拿单又在那童仆的背后喊叫："赶快跑去！不要停留！"那童仆就把箭拾起来，回到他主人那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单又在那童仆的背后喊叫："赶快跑去！不要停留！"那童仆就把箭拾起来，回到他主人那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单又呼叫童子说：「速速地去，不要迟延！」童子就拾起箭来，回到主人那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he shouted, "Hurry! Go quickly! Don’t stop!" The boy picked up the arrow and returned to his master.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jonathan called after the boy, "Hurry! Be quick! Do not stay!" So Jonathan’s boy gathered up the arrows and came to his master.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jonathan cried out after the lad, "Make haste, hurry, do not delay!" So Jonathan’s lad gathered up the arrows and came back to his master.
verses.textEnNlt: Hurry, hurry, don’t wait." So the boy quickly gathered up the arrows and ran back to his master.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jonathan called after the boy, "Hurry, be quick, do not stay!" And Jonathan’s boy picked up the arrow and came to his master.
verses.textEn: Then he shouted, "Hurry! Go quickly! Don’t stop!" The boy picked up the arrow and returned to his master.

verses.textZh: 那童仆一点也不知道这是甚么意思，只有约拿单和大卫知道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那童仆一点也不知道这是甚么意思，只有约拿单和大卫知道。
verses.textZhCuv: 童子却不知道这是什么意思，只有约拿单和大卫知道。
verses.textEnNiv: (The boy knew nothing about all this; only Jonathan and David knew.)
verses.textEnEsv: But the boy knew nothing. Only Jonathan and David knew the matter.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the lad did not know anything. Only Jonathan and David knew of the matter.
verses.textEnNlt: He, of course, suspected nothing; only Jonathan and David understood the signal.
verses.textEnNasb: But the boy was not aware of anything; only Jonathan and David knew about the matter.
verses.textEn: (The boy knew nothing about all this; only Jonathan and David knew.)

verses.textZh: 约拿单把自己的武器交给他的童仆，对他说："你带回城里去吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单把自己的武器交给他的童仆，对他说："你带回城里去吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单将弓箭交给童子，吩咐说：「你拿到城里去。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jonathan gave his weapons to the boy and said, "Go, carry them back to town."
verses.textEnEsv: And Jonathan gave his weapons to his boy and said to him, "Go and carry them to the city."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jonathan gave his weapons to his lad, and said to him, "Go, carry them to the city."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jonathan gave his bow and arrows to the boy and told him to take them back to town.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jonathan gave his weapons to his boy and said to him, "Go, bring them to the city."
verses.textEn: Then Jonathan gave his weapons to the boy and said, "Go, carry them back to town."

verses.textZh: 那童仆一离去，大卫就从石堆的南边起来，脸伏于地，叩拜了三次。二人互相亲吻，相对哭泣，大卫哭得更悲痛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那童仆一离去，大卫就从石堆的南边起来，脸伏于地，叩拜了三次。二人互相亲吻，相对哭泣，大卫哭得更悲痛。
verses.textZhCuv: 童子一去，大卫就从磐石的南边出来，俯伏在地，拜了三拜；二人亲嘴，彼此哭泣，大卫哭得更恸。
verses.textEnNiv: After the boy had gone, David got up from the south side of the stone and bowed down before Jonathan three times, with his face to the ground. Then they kissed each other and wept together—but David wept the most.
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as the boy had gone, David rose from beside the stone heap and fell on his face to the ground and bowed three times. And they kissed one another and wept with one another, David weeping the most.
verses.textEnNkjv: As soon as the lad had gone, David arose from aplace toward the south, fell on his face to the ground, and bowed down three times. And they kissed one another; and they wept together, but David more so.
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as the boy was gone, David came out from where he had been hiding near the stone pile. Then David bowed three times to Jonathan with his face to the ground. Both of them were in tears as they embraced each other and said good-bye, especially David.
verses.textEnNasb: When the boy was gone, David got up from the south side, then he fell on his face to the ground and bowed three times. And they kissed each other and wept together, until David wept immeasurably.
verses.textEn: After the boy had gone, David got up from the south side of the stone and bowed down before Jonathan three times, with his face to the ground. Then they kissed each other and wept together—but David wept the most.

verses.textZh: 约拿单对大卫说："你平平安安走吧！我们二人曾指着耶和华的名起誓说：‘愿耶和华在你我之间，也在我的后裔和你的后裔之间作证，直到永远。’"大卫就起身离开，约拿单也回城里去了 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单对大卫说："你平平安安走吧！我们二人曾指着耶和华的名起誓说：‘愿耶和华在你我之间，也在我的后裔和你的后裔之间作证，直到永远。’"大卫就起身离开，约拿单也回城里去了 。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单对大卫说：「我们二人曾指着耶和华的名起誓说：『愿耶和华在你我中间，并你我后裔中间为证，直到永远。』如今你平平安安地去吧！」大卫就起身走了；约拿单也回城里去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Jonathan said to David, "Go in peace, for we have sworn friendship with each other in the name of the Lord , saying, ‘The Lord is witness between you and me, and between your descendants and my descendants forever.’ " Then David left, and Jonathan went back to the town.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jonathan said to David, "Go in peace, because we have sworn both of us in the name of the Lord , saying, ‘The Lord shall be between me and you, and between my offspring and your offspring, forever.’" And he rose and departed, and Jonathan went into the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jonathan said to David, "Go in peace, since we have both sworn in the name of the Lord, saying, ‘May the Lord be between you and me, and between your descendants and my descendants, forever.’ " So he arose and departed, and Jonathan went into the city.
verses.textEnNlt: At last Jonathan said to David, "Go in peace, for we have sworn loyalty to each other in the Lord ’s name. The Lord is the witness of a bond between us and our children forever." Then David left, and Jonathan returned to the town.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jonathan said to David, "Go in safety, since we have sworn to each other in the name of the Lord, saying, ‘The Lord will be between me and you, and between my descendants and your descendants forever.’ " So David set out and went on his way, while Jonathan went into the city.
verses.textEn: Jonathan said to David, "Go in peace, for we have sworn friendship with each other in the name of the Lord , saying, ‘The Lord is witness between you and me, and between your descendants and my descendants forever.’ " Then David left, and Jonathan went back to the town.

verses.textZh: 大卫到了挪伯祭司亚希米勒那里，亚希米勒战战兢兢地迎接大卫，对他说："你为甚么独自一人，没有人跟随你呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫到了挪伯祭司亚希米勒那里，亚希米勒战战兢兢地迎接大卫，对他说："你为甚么独自一人，没有人跟随你呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫到了挪伯祭司亚希米勒那里，亚希米勒战战兢兢地出来迎接他，问他说：「你为什么独自来，没有人跟随呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: David went to Nob, to Ahimelek the priest. Ahimelek trembled when he met him, and asked, "Why are you alone? Why is no one with you?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then David came to Nob, to Ahimelech the priest. And Ahimelech came to meet David, trembling, and said to him, "Why are you alone, and no one with you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now David came to Nob, to Ahimelech the priest. And Ahimelech was afraid when he met David, and said to him, "Why are you alone, and no one is with you?"
verses.textEnNlt: David went to the town of Nob to see Ahimelech the priest. Ahimelech trembled when he saw him. "Why are you alone?" he asked. "Why is no one with you?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then David came to Nob, to Ahimelech the priest; and Ahimelech came trembling to meet David and said to him, "Why are you alone, and no one with you?"
verses.textEn: David went to Nob, to Ahimelek the priest. Ahimelek trembled when he met him, and asked, "Why are you alone? Why is no one with you?"

verses.textZh: 大卫对亚希米勒祭司说："王吩咐我作一件事，对我说：‘我差派你，吩咐你去办的这事，你不要让任何人知道，我已经指示我的仆人在某地会面。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对亚希米勒祭司说："王吩咐我作一件事，对我说：‘我差派你，吩咐你去办的这事，你不要让任何人知道，我已经指示我的仆人在某地会面。’
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫回答祭司亚希米勒说：「王吩咐我一件事说：『我差遣你委托你的这件事，不要使人知道。』故此我已派定少年人在某处等候我。
verses.textEnNiv: David answered Ahimelek the priest, "The king sent me on a mission and said to me, ‘No one is to know anything about the mission I am sending you on.’ As for my men, I have told them to meet me at a certain place.
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to Ahimelech the priest, "The king has charged me with a matter and said to me, ‘Let no one know anything of the matter about which I send you, and with which I have charged you.’ I have made an appointment with the young men for such and such a place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David said to Ahimelech the priest, "The king has ordered me on some business, and said to me, ‘Do not let anyone know anything about the business on which I send you, or what I have commanded you.’ And I have directed my young men to such and such a place.
verses.textEnNlt: "The king has sent me on a private matter," David said. "He told me not to tell anyone why I am here. I have told my men where to meet me later.
verses.textEnNasb: David said to Ahimelech the priest, "The king has commissioned me with a matter and has said to me, ‘No one is to know anything about the matter on which I am sending you and with which I have commissioned you; and I have directed the young men to a certain place.’
verses.textEn: David answered Ahimelek the priest, "The king sent me on a mission and said to me, ‘No one is to know anything about the mission I am sending you on.’ As for my men, I have told them to meet me at a certain place.

verses.textZh: 现在你手中有甚么？求你给我五个饼，或是别的食物。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你手中有甚么？求你给我五个饼，或是别的食物。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你手下有什么？求你给我五个饼或是别样的食物。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now then, what do you have on hand? Give me five loaves of bread, or whatever you can find."
verses.textEnEsv: Now then, what do you have on hand? Give me five loaves of bread, or whatever is here."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, what have you on hand? Give me five loavesof bread in my hand, or whatever can be found."
verses.textEnNlt: Now, what is there to eat? Give me five loaves of bread or anything else you have."
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, what do you have on hand? Give me five loaves of bread, or whatever can be found."
verses.textEn: Now then, what do you have on hand? Give me five loaves of bread, or whatever you can find."

verses.textZh: 祭司回答大卫："我手中没有普通的饼，只有圣饼。只有那些没有亲近过女人的年轻人，才可以吃的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司回答大卫："我手中没有普通的饼，只有圣饼。只有那些没有亲近过女人的年轻人，才可以吃的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司对大卫说：「我手下没有寻常的饼，只有圣饼；若少年人没有亲近妇人才可以给。」
verses.textEnNiv: But the priest answered David, "I don’t have any ordinary bread on hand; however, there is some consecrated bread here—provided the men have kept themselves from women."
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest answered David, "I have no common bread on hand, but there is holy bread— if the young men have kept themselves from women."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the priest answered David and said, "Thereis no common bread on hand; but there is holy bread, if the young men have at least kept themselves from women."
verses.textEnNlt: "We don’t have any regular bread," the priest replied. "But there is the holy bread, which you can have if your young men have not slept with any women recently."
verses.textEnNasb: The priest answered David and said, "There is no ordinary bread on hand, but there is consecrated bread, if only the young men have kept themselves from women."
verses.textEn: But the priest answered David, "I don’t have any ordinary bread on hand; however, there is some consecrated bread here—provided the men have kept themselves from women."

verses.textZh: 大卫回答祭司说："像以往我出征的时候一样，这次我们出征前，确实没有亲近女人。虽然这是一次普通的任务，众仆人的器皿还是清洁的，何况今天这些器皿更加是清洁的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫回答祭司说："像以往我出征的时候一样，这次我们出征前，确实没有亲近女人。虽然这是一次普通的任务，众仆人的器皿还是清洁的，何况今天这些器皿更加是清洁的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对祭司说：「实在约有三日我们没有亲近妇人；我出来的时候，虽是寻常行路，少年人的器皿还是洁净的；何况今日不更是洁净吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: David replied, "Indeed women have been kept from us, as usual whenever I set out. The men’s bodies are holy even on missions that are not holy. How much more so today!"
verses.textEnEsv: And David answered the priest, "Truly women have been kept from us as always when I go on an expedition. The vessels of the young men are holy even when it is an ordinary journey. How much more today will their vessels be holy?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David answered the priest, and said to him, "Truly, women havebeen kept from us about three days since I came out. And the vessels of the young men are holy, and thebreadis in effect common, even though it was consecrated in the vessel this day."
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t worry," David replied. "I never allow my men to be with women when we are on a campaign. And since they stay clean even on ordinary trips, how much more on this one!"
verses.textEnNasb: David answered the priest and said to him, "Be assured, women have been denied to us as previously when I left and the bodies of the young men were consecrated, though it was an ordinary journey; how much more then will their bodies be consecrated today?"
verses.textEn: David replied, "Indeed women have been kept from us, as usual whenever I set out. The men’s bodies are holy even on missions that are not holy. How much more so today!"

verses.textZh: 于是祭司把圣饼给他，因为在那里没有别的饼，只有陈设饼，就是那些刚从耶和华面前拿下来，为要换上热的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是祭司把圣饼给他，因为在那里没有别的饼，只有陈设饼，就是那些刚从耶和华面前拿下来，为要换上热的。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司就拿圣饼给他；因为在那里没有别样饼，只有更换新饼，从耶和华面前撤下来的陈设饼。 （
verses.textEnNiv: So the priest gave him the consecrated bread, since there was no bread there except the bread of the Presence that had been removed from before the Lord and replaced by hot bread on the day it was taken away.
verses.textEnEsv: So the priest gave him the holy bread, for there was no bread there but the bread of the Presence, which is removed from before the Lord , to be replaced by hot bread on the day it is taken away.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the priest gave him holy bread; for there was no bread there but the showbread which had been taken from before the Lord, in order to put hot bread initsplace on the day when it was taken away.
verses.textEnNlt: Since there was no other food available, the priest gave him the holy bread—the Bread of the Presence that was placed before the Lord in the Tabernacle. It had just been replaced that day with fresh bread.
verses.textEnNasb: So the priest gave him consecrated bread; for there was no bread there except the bread of the Presence which was removed from its place before the Lord, in order to put hot bread in its place on the day it was taken away.
verses.textEn: So the priest gave him the consecrated bread, since there was no bread there except the bread of the Presence that had been removed from before the Lord and replaced by hot bread on the day it was taken away.

verses.textZh: 那天有一个扫罗的臣仆在那里，留在耶和华面前。他名叫多益，是以东人，是扫罗牧羊人中的领袖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那天有一个扫罗的臣仆在那里，留在耶和华面前。他名叫多益，是以东人，是扫罗牧羊人中的领袖。
verses.textZhCuv: 当日有扫罗的一个臣子留在耶和华面前。他名叫多益，是以东人，作扫罗的司牧长。）
verses.textEnNiv: Now one of Saul’s servants was there that day, detained before the Lord ; he was Doeg the Edomite, Saul’s chief shepherd.
verses.textEnEsv: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before the Lord . His name was Doeg the Edomite, the chief of Saul’s herdsmen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before the Lord. And his name was Doeg, an Edomite, the chief of the herdsmen who belonged to Saul.
verses.textEnNlt: Now Doeg the Edomite, Saul’s chief herdsman, was there that day, having been detained before the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Now one of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before the Lord; and his name was Doeg the Edomite, the chief of Saul’s shepherds.
verses.textEn: Now one of Saul’s servants was there that day, detained before the Lord ; he was Doeg the Edomite, Saul’s chief shepherd.

verses.textZh: 大卫问亚希米勒："你手下有枪有刀没有？因为王的事很急迫，所以我手里连刀剑或其他武器都没有带来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫问亚希米勒："你手下有枪有刀没有？因为王的事很急迫，所以我手里连刀剑或其他武器都没有带来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫问亚希米勒说：「你手下有枪有刀没有？因为王的事甚急，连刀剑器械我都没有带。」
verses.textEnNiv: David asked Ahimelek, "Don’t you have a spear or a sword here? I haven’t brought my sword or any other weapon, because the king’s mission was urgent."
verses.textEnEsv: Then David said to Ahimelech, "Then have you not here a spear or a sword at hand? For I have brought neither my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king’s business required haste."
verses.textEnNkjv: And David said to Ahimelech, "Is there not here on hand a spear or a sword? For I have brought neither my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king’s business required haste."
verses.textEnNlt: David asked Ahimelech, "Do you have a spear or sword? The king’s business was so urgent that I didn’t even have time to grab a weapon!"
verses.textEnNasb: David said to Ahimelech, "Now is there no spear or sword on hand? For I brought neither my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king’s matter was urgent."
verses.textEn: David asked Ahimelek, "Don’t you have a spear or a sword here? I haven’t brought my sword or any other weapon, because the king’s mission was urgent."

verses.textZh: 祭司回答："有一把刀，是你从前在以拉谷击杀的那非利士人歌利亚的刀。这刀用布包着，放在以弗得后面，你若是要拿去自用，就拿去吧，因为这里除了这刀以外，再没有别的武器了。"大卫说："没有比这更好的刀了，请你给我吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司回答："有一把刀，是你从前在以拉谷击杀的那非利士人歌利亚的刀。这刀用布包着，放在以弗得后面，你若是要拿去自用，就拿去吧，因为这里除了这刀以外，再没有别的武器了。"大卫说："没有比这更好的刀了，请你给我吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司说：「你在以拉谷杀非利士人歌利亚的那刀在这里，裹在布中，放在以弗得后边，你要就可以拿去；除此以外，再没有别的。」大卫说：「这刀没有可比的！求你给我。」
verses.textEnNiv: The priest replied, "The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the Valley of Elah, is here; it is wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. If you want it, take it; there is no sword here but that one." David said, "There is none like it; give it to me."
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest said, "The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you struck down in the Valley of Elah, behold, it is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. If you will take that, take it, for there is none but that here." And David said, "There is none like that; give it to me."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the priest said, "The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the Valley of Elah, there it is, wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. If you will take that, take it. For thereis no other except that one here." And David said, "Thereis none like it; give it to me."
verses.textEnNlt: "I only have the sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the valley of Elah," the priest replied. "It is wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. Take that if you want it, for there is nothing else here." "There is nothing like it!" David replied. "Give it to me!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the priest said, "The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the Valley of Elah, behold, it is wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod; if you would take it for yourself, take it. For there is no other except it here." And David said, "There is none like it; give it to me."
verses.textEn: The priest replied, "The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the Valley of Elah, is here; it is wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. If you want it, take it; there is no sword here but that one." David said, "There is none like it; give it to me."

verses.textZh: 那一天大卫起来，从扫罗面前逃走，到了迦特王亚吉那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天大卫起来，从扫罗面前逃走，到了迦特王亚吉那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日大卫起来，躲避扫罗，逃到迦特王亚吉那里。
verses.textEnNiv: That day David fled from Saul and went to Achish king of Gath.
verses.textEnEsv: And David rose and fled that day from Saul and went to Achish the king of Gath.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David arose and fled that day from before Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.
verses.textEnNlt: So David escaped from Saul and went to King Achish of Gath.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David set out and fled that day from Saul, and went to Achish king of Gath.
verses.textEn: That day David fled from Saul and went to Achish king of Gath.

verses.textZh: 亚吉的臣仆对亚吉说："这不是那地的王大卫吗？那里的妇女不是指着他跳舞歌唱说： ‘扫罗杀死千千， 大卫杀死万万’吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚吉的臣仆对亚吉说："这不是那地的王大卫吗？那里的妇女不是指着他跳舞歌唱说： ‘扫罗杀死千千， 大卫杀死万万’吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚吉的臣仆对亚吉说：「这不是以色列国王大卫吗？那里的妇女跳舞唱和，不是指着他说『扫罗杀死千千，大卫杀死万万』吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: But the servants of Achish said to him, "Isn’t this David, the king of the land? Isn’t he the one they sing about in their dances: " ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands’?"
verses.textEnEsv: And the servants of Achish said to him, "Is not this David the king of the land? Did they not sing to one another of him in dances, ‘Saul has struck down his thousands, and David his ten thousands’?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the servants of Achish said to him, "Is this not David the king of the land? Did they not sing of him to one another in dances, saying: ‘Saul has slain his thousands, And David his ten thousands’?"
verses.textEnNlt: But the officers of Achish were unhappy about his being there. "Isn’t this David, the king of the land?" they asked. "Isn’t he the one the people honor with dances, singing, ‘Saul has killed his thousands, and David his ten thousands’?"
verses.textEnNasb: But the servants of Achish said to him, "Is this not David, the king of the land? Did they not sing of this one as they danced, saying, ‘Saul has slain his thousands, And David his ten thousands’?"
verses.textEn: But the servants of Achish said to him, "Isn’t this David, the king of the land? Isn’t he the one they sing about in their dances: " ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands’?"

verses.textZh: 大卫把这些话记在心里，他非常怕迦特王亚吉，
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫把这些话记在心里，他非常怕迦特王亚吉，
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫将这话放在心里，甚惧怕迦特王亚吉，
verses.textEnNiv: David took these words to heart and was very much afraid of Achish king of Gath.
verses.textEnEsv: And David took these words to heart and was much afraid of Achish the king of Gath.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now David took these words to heart, and was very much afraid of Achish the king of Gath.
verses.textEnNlt: David heard these comments and was very afraid of what King Achish of Gath might do to him.
verses.textEnNasb: David took these words to heart and greatly feared Achish king of Gath.
verses.textEn: David took these words to heart and was very much afraid of Achish king of Gath.

verses.textZh: 就在众人面前假装神智不健全，在他们手下装疯，在城门的门扇上胡乱涂写，又让唾沫流到胡须上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就在众人面前假装神智不健全，在他们手下装疯，在城门的门扇上胡乱涂写，又让唾沫流到胡须上。
verses.textZhCuv: 就在众人面前改变了寻常的举动，在他们手下假装疯癫，在城门的门扇上胡写乱画，使唾沫流在胡子上。
verses.textEnNiv: So he pretended to be insane in their presence; and while he was in their hands he acted like a madman, making marks on the doors of the gate and letting saliva run down his beard.
verses.textEnEsv: So he changed his behavior before them and pretended to be insane in their hands and made marks on the doors of the gate and let his spittle run down his beard.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he changed his behavior before them, pretended madness in their hands, scratched on the doors of the gate, and let his saliva fall down on his beard.
verses.textEnNlt: So he pretended to be insane, scratching on doors and drooling down his beard.
verses.textEnNasb: So he disguised his sanity while in their sight and acted insanely in their custody, and he scribbled on the doors of the gate, and drooled on his beard.
verses.textEn: So he pretended to be insane in their presence; and while he was in their hands he acted like a madman, making marks on the doors of the gate and letting saliva run down his beard.

verses.textZh: 亚吉就对他的臣仆说："你们看，这个人疯了，你们为甚么把他带到我这里来呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚吉就对他的臣仆说："你们看，这个人疯了，你们为甚么把他带到我这里来呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 亚吉对臣仆说：「你们看，这人是疯子。为什么带他到我这里来呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Achish said to his servants, "Look at the man! He is insane! Why bring him to me?
verses.textEnEsv: Then Achish said to his servants, "Behold, you see the man is mad. Why then have you brought him to me?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Achish said to his servants, "Look, you see the man is insane. Why have you brought him to me?
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, King Achish said to his men, "Must you bring me a madman?
verses.textEnNasb: Then Achish said to his servants, "Look, you see the man is behaving like an insane person. Why do you bring him to me?
verses.textEn: Achish said to his servants, "Look at the man! He is insane! Why bring him to me?

verses.textZh: 难道我缺少疯子吗？你们竟把这人带来我面前发疯。这人怎可以进我的家呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道我缺少疯子吗？你们竟把这人带来我面前发疯。这人怎可以进我的家呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我岂缺少疯子，你们带这人来在我面前疯癫吗？这人岂可进我的家呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Am I so short of madmen that you have to bring this fellow here to carry on like this in front of me? Must this man come into my house?"
verses.textEnEsv: Do I lack madmen, that you have brought this fellow to behave as a madman in my presence? Shall this fellow come into my house?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Have I need of madmen, that you have brought this fellow to play the madman in my presence? Shall this fellow come into my house?"
verses.textEnNlt: We already have enough of them around here! Why should I let someone like this be my guest?"
verses.textEnNasb: Do I lack insane people, that you have brought this one to behave like an insane person in my presence? Shall this one come into my house?"
verses.textEn: Am I so short of madmen that you have to bring this fellow here to carry on like this in front of me? Must this man come into my house?"

verses.textZh: 大卫离开那里，逃到亚杜兰洞。他哥哥们和他父亲的全家听到了，就都下到他那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫离开那里，逃到亚杜兰洞。他哥哥们和他父亲的全家听到了，就都下到他那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫就离开那里，逃到亚杜兰洞。他的弟兄和他父亲的全家听见了，就都下到他那里。
verses.textEnNiv: David left Gath and escaped to the cave of Adullam. When his brothers and his father’s household heard about it, they went down to him there.
verses.textEnEsv: David departed from there and escaped to the cave of Adullam. And when his brothers and all his father’s house heard it, they went down there to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: David therefore departed from there and escaped to the cave of Adullam. So when his brothers and all his father’s house heard it, they went down there to him.
verses.textEnNlt: So David left Gath and escaped to the cave of Adullam. Soon his brothers and all his other relatives joined him there.
verses.textEnNasb: So David departed from there and escaped to the cave of Adullam; and when his brothers and all his father’s household heard about it, they went down there to him.
verses.textEn: David left Gath and escaped to the cave of Adullam. When his brothers and his father’s household heard about it, they went down to him there.

verses.textZh: 凡是受窘迫的、负债的、心里不满的，都聚集到大卫那里，他就成了他们的领袖。那时，跟从他的约有四百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是受窘迫的、负债的、心里不满的，都聚集到大卫那里，他就成了他们的领袖。那时，跟从他的约有四百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡受窘迫的、欠债的、心里苦恼的都聚集到大卫那里；大卫就作他们的头目，跟随他的约有四百人。
verses.textEnNiv: All those who were in distress or in debt or discontented gathered around him, and he became their commander. About four hundred men were with him.
verses.textEnEsv: And everyone who was in distress, and everyone who was in debt, and everyone who was bitter in soul, gathered to him. And he became commander over them. And there were with him about four hundred men.
verses.textEnNkjv: And everyone whowas in distress, everyone who was in debt, and everyone whowas discontented gathered to him. So he became captain over them. And there were about four hundred men with him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then others began coming—men who were in trouble or in debt or who were just discontented—until David was the captain of about 400 men.
verses.textEnNasb: Then everyone who was in distress, and everyone who was in debt, and everyone who was discontented gathered to him; and he became captain over them. Now there were about four hundred men with him.
verses.textEn: All those who were in distress or in debt or discontented gathered around him, and he became their commander. About four hundred men were with him.

verses.textZh: 大卫从那里到摩押的米斯巴去，对摩押王说："求你容许我父母来住在你们这里，直到我知道神要为我作甚么。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫从那里到摩押的米斯巴去，对摩押王说："求你容许我父母来住在你们这里，直到我知道神要为我作甚么。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫从那里往摩押的米斯巴去，对摩押王说：「求你容我父母搬来，住在你们这里，等我知道神要为我怎样行。」
verses.textEnNiv: From there David went to Mizpah in Moab and said to the king of Moab, "Would you let my father and mother come and stay with you until I learn what God will do for me?"
verses.textEnEsv: And David went from there to Mizpeh of Moab. And he said to the king of Moab, "Please let my father and my mother stay with you, till I know what God will do for me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David went from there to Mizpah of Moab; and he said to the king of Moab, "Please let my father and mother come here with you, till I know what God will do for me."
verses.textEnNlt: Later David went to Mizpeh in Moab, where he asked the king, "Please allow my father and mother to live here with you until I know what God is going to do for me."
verses.textEnNasb: And David went from there to Mizpah of Moab; and he said to the king of Moab, "Please let my father and my mother come and stay with you until I know what God will do for me."
verses.textEn: From there David went to Mizpah in Moab and said to the king of Moab, "Would you let my father and mother come and stay with you until I learn what God will do for me?"

verses.textZh: 于是大卫把他们留在摩押王那里。大卫住在山寨的日子有多久，他父母也与摩押王同住多久。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫把他们留在摩押王那里。大卫住在山寨的日子有多久，他父母也与摩押王同住多久。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫领他父母到摩押王面前。大卫住山寨多少日子，他父母也住摩押王那里多少日子。
verses.textEnNiv: So he left them with the king of Moab, and they stayed with him as long as David was in the stronghold.
verses.textEnEsv: And he left them with the king of Moab, and they stayed with him all the time that David was in the stronghold.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he brought them before the king of Moab, and they dwelt with him all the time that David was in the stronghold.
verses.textEnNlt: So David’s parents stayed in Moab with the king during the entire time David was living in his stronghold.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he left them with the king of Moab; and they stayed with him all the time that David was in the stronghold.
verses.textEn: So he left them with the king of Moab, and they stayed with him as long as David was in the stronghold.

verses.textZh: 迦得先知对大卫说："你不要留在山寨，要到犹大地去。"大卫就离开那里，往哈列的森林去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦得先知对大卫说："你不要留在山寨，要到犹大地去。"大卫就离开那里，往哈列的森林去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 先知迦得对大卫说：「你不要住在山寨，要往犹大地去。」大卫就离开那里，进入哈列的树林。
verses.textEnNiv: But the prophet Gad said to David, "Do not stay in the stronghold. Go into the land of Judah." So David left and went to the forest of Hereth.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the prophet Gad said to David, "Do not remain in the stronghold; depart, and go into the land of Judah." So David departed and went into the forest of Hereth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the prophet Gad said to David, "Do not stay in the stronghold; depart, and go to the land of Judah." So David departed and went into the forest of Hereth.
verses.textEnNlt: One day the prophet Gad told David, "Leave the stronghold and return to the land of Judah." So David went to the forest of Hereth.
verses.textEnNasb: But Gad the prophet said to David, "Do not stay in the stronghold; leave, and go into the land of Judah." So David left and went into the forest of Hereth.
verses.textEn: But the prophet Gad said to David, "Do not stay in the stronghold. Go into the land of Judah." So David left and went to the forest of Hereth.

verses.textZh: 扫罗听见发现了大卫和跟从他的人的行踪。那时扫罗在基比亚坐在山上一棵垂柳树下，手中拿着枪，众臣仆侍立在他周围。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗听见发现了大卫和跟从他的人的行踪。那时扫罗在基比亚坐在山上一棵垂柳树下，手中拿着枪，众臣仆侍立在他周围。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗在基比亚的拉玛，坐在垂丝柳树下，手里拿着枪，众臣仆侍立在左右。扫罗听见大卫和跟随他的人在何处，
verses.textEnNiv: Now Saul heard that David and his men had been discovered. And Saul was seated, spear in hand, under the tamarisk tree on the hill at Gibeah, with all his officials standing at his side.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Saul heard that David was discovered, and the men who were with him. Saul was sitting at Gibeah under the tamarisk tree on the height with his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing about him.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Saul heard that David and the men who were with him had been discovered—now Saul was staying in Gibeah under a tamarisk tree in Ramah, with his spear in his hand, and all his servants standing about him—
verses.textEnNlt: The news of his arrival in Judah soon reached Saul. At the time, the king was sitting beneath the tamarisk tree on the hill at Gibeah, holding his spear and surrounded by his officers.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul heard that David and the men who were with him had been discovered. Now Saul was in Gibeah, sitting under the tamarisk tree on the height with his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing in front of him.
verses.textEn: Now Saul heard that David and his men had been discovered. And Saul was seated, spear in hand, under the tamarisk tree on the hill at Gibeah, with all his officials standing at his side.

verses.textZh: 扫罗就对侍立在他周围的臣仆说："便雅悯人哪，你们要听！耶西的儿子能把田地和葡萄园赐给你们各人吗？他能立你们各人作千夫长、作百夫长吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗就对侍立在他周围的臣仆说："便雅悯人哪，你们要听！耶西的儿子能把田地和葡萄园赐给你们各人吗？他能立你们各人作千夫长、作百夫长吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 就对左右侍立的臣仆说：「便雅悯人哪，你们要听我的话！耶西的儿子能将田地和葡萄园赐给你们各人吗？能立你们各人作千夫长百夫长吗？
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them, "Listen, men of Benjamin! Will the son of Jesse give all of you fields and vineyards? Will he make all of you commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds?
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul said to his servants who stood about him, "Hear now, people of Benjamin; will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards, will he make you all commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds,
verses.textEnNkjv: then Saul said to his servants who stood about him, "Hear now, you Benjamites! Will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards, and make you all captains of thousands and captains of hundreds?
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen here, you men of Benjamin!" Saul shouted to his officers when he heard the news. "Has that son of Jesse promised every one of you fields and vineyards? Has he promised to make you all generals and captains in his army?
verses.textEnNasb: Saul said to his servants who were standing in front of him, "Hear now, you Benjaminites! Will the son of Jesse really give all of you fields and vineyards? Will he make you all commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds?
verses.textEn: He said to them, "Listen, men of Benjamin! Will the son of Jesse give all of you fields and vineyards? Will he make all of you commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds?

verses.textZh: 你们竟都同谋陷害我。我的儿子与耶西的儿子立盟约的时候，没有人告诉我；我的儿子挑唆我的臣仆陷害我，就像今天一样，你们中间也没有人关心我，告诉我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们竟都同谋陷害我。我的儿子与耶西的儿子立盟约的时候，没有人告诉我；我的儿子挑唆我的臣仆陷害我，就像今天一样，你们中间也没有人关心我，告诉我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们竟都结党害我！我的儿子与耶西的儿子结盟的时候，无人告诉我；我的儿子挑唆我的臣子谋害我，就如今日的光景，也无人告诉我，为我忧虑。」
verses.textEnNiv: Is that why you have all conspired against me? No one tells me when my son makes a covenant with the son of Jesse. None of you is concerned about me or tells me that my son has incited my servant to lie in wait for me, as he does today."
verses.textEnEsv: that all of you have conspired against me? No one discloses to me when my son makes a covenant with the son of Jesse. None of you is sorry for me or discloses to me that my son has stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as at this day."
verses.textEnNkjv: All of you have conspired against me, and thereis no one who reveals to me that my son has made a covenant with the son of Jesse; and thereis not one of you who is sorry for me or reveals to me that my son has stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as itis this day."
verses.textEnNlt: Is that why you have conspired against me? For not one of you told me when my own son made a solemn pact with the son of Jesse. You’re not even sorry for me. Think of it! My own son—encouraging him to kill me, as he is trying to do this very day!"
verses.textEnNasb: For all of you have conspired against me so that there is no one who informs me when my son makes a covenant with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you who cares about me or informs me that my son has stirred up my servant against me to lie in ambush, as it is this day."
verses.textEn: Is that why you have all conspired against me? No one tells me when my son makes a covenant with the son of Jesse. None of you is concerned about me or tells me that my son has incited my servant to lie in wait for me, as he does today."

verses.textZh: 那时以东人多益与扫罗的臣仆侍立在那里，他回答说："我曾看见耶西的儿子到了挪伯亚希突的儿子亚希米勒那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时以东人多益与扫罗的臣仆侍立在那里，他回答说："我曾看见耶西的儿子到了挪伯亚希突的儿子亚希米勒那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时以东人多益站在扫罗的臣仆中，对他说：「我曾看见耶西的儿子到了挪伯，亚希突的儿子亚希米勒那里。
verses.textEnNiv: But Doeg the Edomite, who was standing with Saul’s officials, said, "I saw the son of Jesse come to Ahimelek son of Ahitub at Nob.
verses.textEnEsv: Then answered Doeg the Edomite, who stood by the servants of Saul, "I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then answered Doeg the Edomite, who was set over the servants of Saul, and said, "I saw the son of Jesse going to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Doeg the Edomite, who was standing there with Saul’s men, spoke up. "When I was at Nob," he said, "I saw the son of Jesse talking to the priest, Ahimelech son of Ahitub.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Doeg the Edomite, who was standing in front of the servants of Saul, responded and said, "I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.
verses.textEn: But Doeg the Edomite, who was standing with Saul’s officials, said, "I saw the son of Jesse come to Ahimelek son of Ahitub at Nob.

verses.textZh: 亚希米勒为他求问耶和华，给他粮食，又把非利士人歌利亚的刀给他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚希米勒为他求问耶和华，给他粮食，又把非利士人歌利亚的刀给他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚希米勒为他求问耶和华，又给他食物，并给他杀非利士人歌利亚的刀。」
verses.textEnNiv: Ahimelek inquired of the Lord for him; he also gave him provisions and the sword of Goliath the Philistine."
verses.textEnEsv: and he inquired of the Lord for him and gave him provisions and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he inquired of the Lord for him, gave him provisions, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine."
verses.textEnNlt: Ahimelech consulted the Lord for him. Then he gave him food and the sword of Goliath the Philistine."
verses.textEnNasb: And he inquired of the Lord for him, gave him provisions, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine."
verses.textEn: Ahimelek inquired of the Lord for him; he also gave him provisions and the sword of Goliath the Philistine."

verses.textZh: 扫罗就派人去把亚希突的儿子，亚希米勒祭司和他父亲的全家，就是在挪伯的众祭司，都召了来；他们众人都来见王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗就派人去把亚希突的儿子，亚希米勒祭司和他父亲的全家，就是在挪伯的众祭司，都召了来；他们众人都来见王。
verses.textZhCuv: 王就打发人将祭司亚希突的儿子亚希米勒和他父亲的全家，就是住挪伯的祭司都召了来；他们就来见王。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king sent for the priest Ahimelek son of Ahitub and all the men of his family, who were the priests at Nob, and they all came to the king.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king sent to summon Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father’s house, the priests who were at Nob, and all of them came to the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father’s house, the priests who were in Nob. And they all came to the king.
verses.textEnNlt: King Saul immediately sent for Ahimelech and all his family, who served as priests at Nob.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king sent a messenger to summon Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father’s household, the priests who were in Nob; and all of them came to the king.
verses.textEn: Then the king sent for the priest Ahimelek son of Ahitub and all the men of his family, who were the priests at Nob, and they all came to the king.

verses.textZh: 扫罗说："亚希突的儿子啊！你要听。"他回答："我主啊！我在这里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗说："亚希突的儿子啊！你要听。"他回答："我主啊！我在这里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗说：「亚希突的儿子，要听我的话！」他回答说：「主啊，我在这里。」
verses.textEnNiv: Saul said, "Listen now, son of Ahitub." "Yes, my lord," he answered.
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul said, "Hear now, son of Ahitub." And he answered, "Here I am, my lord."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Saul said, "Hear now, son of Ahitub!" He answered, "Here I am, my lord."
verses.textEnNlt: When they arrived, Saul shouted at him, "Listen to me, you son of Ahitub!" "What is it, my king?" Ahimelech asked.
verses.textEnNasb: Saul said, "Listen now, son of Ahitub." And he replied, "Here I am, my lord."
verses.textEn: Saul said, "Listen now, son of Ahitub." "Yes, my lord," he answered.

verses.textZh: 扫罗对他说："你为甚么与耶西的儿子合谋陷害我？把食物和刀给他，又为他求问神，使他起来陷害我，就像今天一样呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗对他说："你为甚么与耶西的儿子合谋陷害我？把食物和刀给他，又为他求问神，使他起来陷害我，就像今天一样呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗对他说：「你为什么与耶西的儿子结党害我，将食物和刀给他，又为他求问神，使他起来谋害我，就如今日的光景？」
verses.textEnNiv: Saul said to him, "Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, giving him bread and a sword and inquiring of God for him, so that he has rebelled against me and lies in wait for me, as he does today?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul said to him, "Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, in that you have given him bread and a sword and have inquired of God for him, so that he has risen against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul said to him, "Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, in that you have given him bread and a sword, and have inquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as it is this day?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Why have you and the son of Jesse conspired against me?" Saul demanded. "Why did you give him food and a sword? Why have you consulted God for him? Why have you encouraged him to kill me, as he is trying to do this very day?"
verses.textEnNasb: Saul then said to him, "Why have you and the son of Jesse conspired against me, in that you have given him bread and a sword, and have inquired of God for him, so that he would rise up against me by lying in ambush as it is this day?"
verses.textEn: Saul said to him, "Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, giving him bread and a sword and inquiring of God for him, so that he has rebelled against me and lies in wait for me, as he does today?"

verses.textZh: 亚希米勒回答王说："在你所有的臣仆中，有谁像大卫那样忠心呢？他是王的女婿，又是你的卫队的队长 ，并且在你朝中是受敬重的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚希米勒回答王说："在你所有的臣仆中，有谁像大卫那样忠心呢？他是王的女婿，又是你的卫队的队长 ，并且在你朝中是受敬重的。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚希米勒回答王说：「王的臣仆中有谁比大卫忠心呢？他是王的女婿，又是王的参谋，并且在王家中是尊贵的。
verses.textEnNiv: Ahimelek answered the king, "Who of all your servants is as loyal as David, the king’s son-in-law, captain of your bodyguard and highly respected in your household?
verses.textEnEsv: Then Ahimelech answered the king, "And who among all your servants is so faithful as David, who is the king’s son-in-law, and captain over your bodyguard, and honored in your house?
verses.textEnNkjv: So Ahimelech answered the king and said, "And who among all your servants isas faithful as David, who is the king’s son-in-law, who goes at your bidding, and is honorable in your house?
verses.textEnNlt: "But sir," Ahimelech replied, "is anyone among all your servants as faithful as David, your son-in-law? Why, he is the captain of your bodyguard and a highly honored member of your household!
verses.textEnNasb: Then Ahimelech answered the king and said, "And who among all your servants is as faithful as David, the king’s own son-in-law, who is commander over your bodyguard, and is honored in your house?
verses.textEn: Ahimelek answered the king, "Who of all your servants is as loyal as David, the king’s son-in-law, captain of your bodyguard and highly respected in your household?

verses.textZh: 我岂是今天才开始为他求问神的呢？绝对不是。请王不要归罪于我和我父的全家，因为这整件事无论大小，我都不知道。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我岂是今天才开始为他求问神的呢？绝对不是。请王不要归罪于我和我父的全家，因为这整件事无论大小，我都不知道。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我岂是从今日才为他求问神呢？断不是这样！王不要将罪归我和我父的全家；因为这事，无论大小，仆人都不知道。」
verses.textEnNiv: Was that day the first time I inquired of God for him? Of course not! Let not the king accuse your servant or any of his father’s family, for your servant knows nothing at all about this whole affair."
verses.textEnEsv: Is today the first time that I have inquired of God for him? No! Let not the king impute anything to his servant or to all the house of my father, for your servant has known nothing of all this, much or little."
verses.textEnNkjv: Did I then begin to inquire of God for him? Far be it from me! Let not the king impute anything to his servant, or to any in the house of my father. For your servant knew nothing of all this, little or much."
verses.textEnNlt: This was certainly not the first time I had consulted God for him! May the king not accuse me and my family in this matter, for I knew nothing at all of any plot against you."
verses.textEnNasb: Did I just begin to inquire of God for him today? Far be it from me! Do not let the king impute anything against his servant or against any of the household of my father, because your servant knows nothing at all of this whole affair."
verses.textEn: Was that day the first time I inquired of God for him? Of course not! Let not the king accuse your servant or any of his father’s family, for your servant knows nothing at all about this whole affair."

verses.textZh: 王说："亚希米勒啊！你和你父的全家都是该死的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王说："亚希米勒啊！你和你父的全家都是该死的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王说：「亚希米勒啊，你和你父的全家都是该死的！」
verses.textEnNiv: But the king said, "You will surely die, Ahimelek, you and your whole family."
verses.textEnEsv: And the king said, "You shall surely die, Ahimelech, you and all your father’s house."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king said, "You shall surely die, Ahimelech, you and all your father’s house!"
verses.textEnNlt: "You will surely die, Ahimelech, along with your entire family!" the king shouted.
verses.textEnNasb: But the king said, "You shall certainly die, Ahimelech, you and all your father’s household!"
verses.textEn: But the king said, "You will surely die, Ahimelek, you and your whole family."

verses.textZh: 王就对侍立在他周围的卫兵说："你们转过去，把耶和华的祭司杀死，因为他们与大卫携手，又因为他们知道大卫逃跑，也不告诉我。"但王的臣仆不愿下手杀害耶和华的祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王就对侍立在他周围的卫兵说："你们转过去，把耶和华的祭司杀死，因为他们与大卫携手，又因为他们知道大卫逃跑，也不告诉我。"但王的臣仆不愿下手杀害耶和华的祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 王就吩咐左右的侍卫说：「你们去杀耶和华的祭司；因为他们帮助大卫，又知道大卫逃跑，竟没有告诉我。」扫罗的臣子却不肯伸手杀耶和华的祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king ordered the guards at his side: "Turn and kill the priests of the Lord , because they too have sided with David. They knew he was fleeing, yet they did not tell me." But the king’s officials were unwilling to raise a hand to strike the priests of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And the king said to the guard who stood about him, "Turn and kill the priests of the Lord , because their hand also is with David, and they knew that he fled and did not disclose it to me." But the servants of the king would not put out their hand to strike the priests of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king said to the guards who stood about him, "Turn and kill the priests of the Lord, because their hand also is with David, and because they knew when he fled and did not tell it to me." But the servants of the king would not lift their hands to strike the priests of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: And he ordered his bodyguards, "Kill these priests of the Lord , for they are allies and conspirators with David! They knew he was running away from me, but they didn’t tell me!" But Saul’s men refused to kill the Lord ’s priests.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king said to the guards who were attending him, "Turn around and put the priests of the Lord to death, because their hand also is with David and because they knew that he was fleeing and did not inform me." But the servants of the king were unwilling to reach out with their hands to attack the priests of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Then the king ordered the guards at his side: "Turn and kill the priests of the Lord , because they too have sided with David. They knew he was fleeing, yet they did not tell me." But the king’s officials were unwilling to raise a hand to strike the priests of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 于是王对多益说："你转过去把祭司击杀。"以东人多益就转过去把祭司击杀了。那一天，他杀了八十五个穿细麻布以弗得的人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是王对多益说："你转过去把祭司击杀。"以东人多益就转过去把祭司击杀了。那一天，他杀了八十五个穿细麻布以弗得的人，
verses.textZhCuv: 王吩咐多益说：「你去杀祭司吧！」以东人多益就去杀祭司，那日杀了穿细麻布以弗得的八十五人；
verses.textEnNiv: The king then ordered Doeg, "You turn and strike down the priests." So Doeg the Edomite turned and struck them down. That day he killed eighty-five men who wore the linen ephod.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king said to Doeg, "You turn and strike the priests." And Doeg the Edomite turned and struck down the priests, and he killed on that day eighty-five persons who wore the linen ephod.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king said to Doeg, "You turn and kill the priests!" So Doeg the Edomite turned and struck the priests, and killed on that day eighty-five men who wore a linen ephod.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king said to Doeg, "You do it." So Doeg the Edomite turned on them and killed them that day, eighty-five priests in all, still wearing their priestly garments.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king said to Doeg, "You, turn around and attack the priests!" And Doeg the Edomite turned around and attacked the priests, and he killed on that day eighty-five men who wore the linen ephod.
verses.textEn: The king then ordered Doeg, "You turn and strike down the priests." So Doeg the Edomite turned and struck them down. That day he killed eighty-five men who wore the linen ephod.

verses.textZh: 又用刀击杀了祭司城挪伯，无论男女，孩童或吃奶的婴儿，牛驴或羊，都用刀杀尽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用刀击杀了祭司城挪伯，无论男女，孩童或吃奶的婴儿，牛驴或羊，都用刀杀尽。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用刀将祭司城挪伯中的男女、孩童、吃奶的，和牛、羊、驴尽都杀灭。
verses.textEnNiv: He also put to the sword Nob, the town of the priests, with its men and women, its children and infants, and its cattle, donkeys and sheep.
verses.textEnEsv: And Nob, the city of the priests, he put to the sword; both man and woman, child and infant, ox, donkey and sheep, he put to the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Nob, the city of the priests, he struck with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and nursing infants, oxen and donkeys and sheep—with the edge of the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he went to Nob, the town of the priests, and killed the priests’ families—men and women, children and babies—and all the cattle, donkeys, sheep, and goats.
verses.textEnNasb: He also struck Nob the city of the priests with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and infants; he also struck oxen, donkeys, and sheep with the edge of the sword.
verses.textEn: He also put to the sword Nob, the town of the priests, with its men and women, its children and infants, and its cattle, donkeys and sheep.

verses.textZh: 亚希突的儿子亚希米勒有一个儿子，名叫亚比亚他，逃过了大难，就逃去跟随大卫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚希突的儿子亚希米勒有一个儿子，名叫亚比亚他，逃过了大难，就逃去跟随大卫。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚希突的儿子亚希米勒有一个儿子，名叫亚比亚他，逃到大卫那里。
verses.textEnNiv: But one son of Ahimelek son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and fled to join David.
verses.textEnEsv: But one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and fled after David.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and fled after David.
verses.textEnNlt: Only Abiathar, one of the sons of Ahimelech, escaped and fled to David.
verses.textEnNasb: But one son of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and fled to David.
verses.textEn: But one son of Ahimelek son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and fled to join David.

verses.textZh: 亚比亚他把扫罗杀害耶和华祭司的事告诉了大卫，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比亚他把扫罗杀害耶和华祭司的事告诉了大卫，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比亚他将扫罗杀耶和华祭司的事告诉大卫。
verses.textEnNiv: He told David that Saul had killed the priests of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And Abiathar told David that Saul had killed the priests of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abiathar told David that Saul had killed the Lord’s priests.
verses.textEnNlt: When he told David that Saul had killed the priests of the Lord ,
verses.textEnNasb: Abiathar informed David that Saul had killed the priests of the Lord.
verses.textEn: He told David that Saul had killed the priests of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 大卫就对亚比亚他说："那一天我见以东人多益在那里，就知道他必定会告诉扫罗。你父全家每个人的死，我都有责任。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫就对亚比亚他说："那一天我见以东人多益在那里，就知道他必定会告诉扫罗。你父全家每个人的死，我都有责任。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对亚比亚他说：「那日我见以东人多益在那里，就知道他必告诉扫罗。你父的全家丧命，都是因我的缘故。
verses.textEnNiv: Then David said to Abiathar, "That day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, I knew he would be sure to tell Saul. I am responsible for the death of your whole family.
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to Abiathar, "I knew on that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul. I have occasioned the death of all the persons of your father’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David said to Abiathar, "I knew that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul. I have caused thedeath of all the persons of your father’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: David exclaimed, "I knew it! When I saw Doeg the Edomite there that day, I knew he was sure to tell Saul. Now I have caused the death of all your father’s family.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to Abiathar, "I knew on that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would certainly tell Saul. I myself have turned against every person in your father’s household.
verses.textEn: Then David said to Abiathar, "That day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, I knew he would be sure to tell Saul. I am responsible for the death of your whole family.

verses.textZh: 你可以住在我这里。不要惧怕，因为那寻索你命的，正在寻索我的命，你与我在一起就可保安全。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你可以住在我这里。不要惧怕，因为那寻索你命的，正在寻索我的命，你与我在一起就可保安全。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你可以住在我这里，不要惧怕。因为寻索你命的就是寻索我的命；你在我这里可得保全。」
verses.textEnNiv: Stay with me; don’t be afraid. The man who wants to kill you is trying to kill me too. You will be safe with me."
verses.textEnEsv: Stay with me; do not be afraid, for he who seeks my life seeks your life. With me you shall be in safekeeping."
verses.textEnNkjv: Stay with me; do not fear. For he who seeks my life seeks your life, but with me you shallbe safe."
verses.textEnNlt: Stay here with me, and don’t be afraid. I will protect you with my own life, for the same person wants to kill us both."
verses.textEnNasb: Stay with me; do not be afraid, even though he who is seeking my life is seeking your life. For you are safe with me."
verses.textEn: Stay with me; don’t be afraid. The man who wants to kill you is trying to kill me too. You will be safe with me."

verses.textZh: 有人告诉大卫："看哪，非利士人正在攻打基伊拉，并且抢掠禾场。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人告诉大卫："看哪，非利士人正在攻打基伊拉，并且抢掠禾场。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉大卫说：「非利士人攻击基伊拉，抢夺禾场。」
verses.textEnNiv: When David was told, "Look, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah and are looting the threshing floors,"
verses.textEnEsv: Now they told David, "Behold, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah and are robbing the threshing floors."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they told David, saying, "Look, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah, and they are robbing the threshing floors."
verses.textEnNlt: One day news came to David that the Philistines were at Keilah stealing grain from the threshing floors.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they informed David, saying, "Behold, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah and are plundering the threshing floors."
verses.textEn: When David was told, "Look, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah and are looting the threshing floors,"

verses.textZh: 大卫就求问耶和华说："我可以去击打这些非利士人吗？"耶和华对大卫说："你可以去击打非利士人，拯救基伊拉。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫就求问耶和华说："我可以去击打这些非利士人吗？"耶和华对大卫说："你可以去击打非利士人，拯救基伊拉。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以大卫求问耶和华说：「我去攻打那些非利士人可以不可以？」耶和华对大卫说：「你可以去攻打非利士人，拯救基伊拉。」
verses.textEnNiv: he inquired of the Lord , saying, "Shall I go and attack these Philistines?" The Lord answered him, "Go, attack the Philistines and save Keilah."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore David inquired of the Lord , "Shall I go and attack these Philistines?" And the Lord said to David, "Go and attack the Philistines and save Keilah."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore David inquired of the Lord, saying, "Shall I go and attack these Philistines?" And the Lord said to David, "Go and attack the Philistines, and save Keilah."
verses.textEnNlt: David asked the Lord , "Should I go and attack them?" "Yes, go and save Keilah," the Lord told him.
verses.textEnNasb: So David inquired of the Lord, saying, "Shall I go and attack these Philistines?" And the Lord said to David, "Go and attack the Philistines and save Keilah."
verses.textEn: he inquired of the Lord , saying, "Shall I go and attack these Philistines?" The Lord answered him, "Go, attack the Philistines and save Keilah."

verses.textZh: 跟随大卫的人对他说："看哪，我们在犹大地这里尚且惧怕，何况到基伊拉去攻打非利士人的军兵呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 跟随大卫的人对他说："看哪，我们在犹大地这里尚且惧怕，何况到基伊拉去攻打非利士人的军兵呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 跟随大卫的人对他说：「我们在犹大地这里尚且惧怕，何况往基伊拉去攻打非利士人的军旅呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: But David’s men said to him, "Here in Judah we are afraid. How much more, then, if we go to Keilah against the Philistine forces!"
verses.textEnEsv: But David’s men said to him, "Behold, we are afraid here in Judah; how much more then if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But David’s men said to him, "Look, we are afraid here in Judah. How much more then if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?"
verses.textEnNlt: But David’s men said, "We’re afraid even here in Judah. We certainly don’t want to go to Keilah to fight the whole Philistine army!"
verses.textEnNasb: But David’s men said to him, "Behold, we are fearful here in Judah. How much more then if we go to Keilah against the ranks of the Philistines?"
verses.textEn: But David’s men said to him, "Here in Judah we are afraid. How much more, then, if we go to Keilah against the Philistine forces!"

verses.textZh: 于是大卫再求问耶和华。耶和华回答他说："你只管起来，下到基伊拉去，因为我必把非利士人交在你的手里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫再求问耶和华。耶和华回答他说："你只管起来，下到基伊拉去，因为我必把非利士人交在你的手里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫又求问耶和华。耶和华回答说：「你起身下基伊拉去，我必将非利士人交在你手里。」
verses.textEnNiv: Once again David inquired of the Lord , and the Lord answered him, "Go down to Keilah, for I am going to give the Philistines into your hand."
verses.textEnEsv: Then David inquired of the Lord again. And the Lord answered him, "Arise, go down to Keilah, for I will give the Philistines into your hand."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David inquired of the Lord once again. And the Lord answered him and said, "Arise, go down to Keilah. For I will deliver the Philistines into your hand."
verses.textEnNlt: So David asked the Lord again, and again the Lord replied, "Go down to Keilah, for I will help you conquer the Philistines."
verses.textEnNasb: So David inquired of the Lord once more. And the Lord answered him and said, "Arise, go down to Keilah, for I am going to hand the Philistines over to you."
verses.textEn: Once again David inquired of the Lord , and the Lord answered him, "Go down to Keilah, for I am going to give the Philistines into your hand."

verses.textZh: 大卫和跟随他的人就到基伊拉去，与非利士人争战，掳走了他们的牲畜，又在他们中间杀戮多人。这样，大卫拯救了基伊拉的居民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫和跟随他的人就到基伊拉去，与非利士人争战，掳走了他们的牲畜，又在他们中间杀戮多人。这样，大卫拯救了基伊拉的居民。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫和跟随他的人往基伊拉去，与非利士人打仗，大大杀败他们，又夺获他们的牲畜。这样，大卫救了基伊拉的居民。
verses.textEnNiv: So David and his men went to Keilah, fought the Philistines and carried off their livestock. He inflicted heavy losses on the Philistines and saved the people of Keilah.
verses.textEnEsv: And David and his men went to Keilah and fought with the Philistines and brought away their livestock and struck them with a great blow. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David and his men went to Keilah and fought with the Philistines, struck them with a mighty blow, and took away their livestock. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.
verses.textEnNlt: So David and his men went to Keilah. They slaughtered the Philistines and took all their livestock and rescued the people of Keilah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David and his men went to Keilah and fought the Philistines; and he drove away their livestock and struck them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.
verses.textEn: So David and his men went to Keilah, fought the Philistines and carried off their livestock. He inflicted heavy losses on the Philistines and saved the people of Keilah.

verses.textZh: 亚希米勒的儿子亚比亚他逃到基伊拉去见大卫的时候，是手里带着以弗得下来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚希米勒的儿子亚比亚他逃到基伊拉去见大卫的时候，是手里带着以弗得下来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚希米勒的儿子亚比亚他逃到基伊拉见大卫的时候，手里拿着以弗得。
verses.textEnNiv: (Now Abiathar son of Ahimelek had brought the ephod down with him when he fled to David at Keilah.)
verses.textEnEsv: When Abiathar the son of Ahimelech had fled to David to Keilah, he had come down with an ephod in his hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David at Keilah, that he went down with an ephod in his hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Now when Abiathar son of Ahimelech fled to David at Keilah, he brought the ephod with him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David at Keilah, that he came down with an ephod in his hand.
verses.textEn: (Now Abiathar son of Ahimelek had brought the ephod down with him when he fled to David at Keilah.)

verses.textZh: 有人告诉扫罗，大卫到了基伊拉，扫罗就说："神把他交在我的手中了，因为他进了一座有门有闩的城，把自己关闭起来了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人告诉扫罗，大卫到了基伊拉，扫罗就说："神把他交在我的手中了，因为他进了一座有门有闩的城，把自己关闭起来了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉扫罗说：「大卫到了基伊拉。」扫罗说：「他进了有门有闩的城，困闭在里头；这是神将他交在我手里了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Saul was told that David had gone to Keilah, and he said, "God has delivered him into my hands, for David has imprisoned himself by entering a town with gates and bars."
verses.textEnEsv: Now it was told Saul that David had come to Keilah. And Saul said, "God has given him into my hand, for he has shut himself in by entering a town that has gates and bars."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Saul was told that David had gone to Keilah. So Saul said, "God has delivered him into my hand, for he has shut himself in by entering a town that has gates and bars."
verses.textEnNlt: Saul soon learned that David was at Keilah. "Good!" he exclaimed. "We’ve got him now! God has handed him over to me, for he has trapped himself in a walled town!"
verses.textEnNasb: When it was reported to Saul that David had come to Keilah, Saul said, "God has handed him over to me, for he shut himself in by entering a city with double gates and bars."
verses.textEn: Saul was told that David had gone to Keilah, and he said, "God has delivered him into my hands, for David has imprisoned himself by entering a town with gates and bars."

verses.textZh: 于是扫罗召集众人去争战，要下到基伊拉去，围困大卫和跟随他的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是扫罗召集众人去争战，要下到基伊拉去，围困大卫和跟随他的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是扫罗招聚众民，要下去攻打基伊拉城，围困大卫和跟随他的人。
verses.textEnNiv: And Saul called up all his forces for battle, to go down to Keilah to besiege David and his men.
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul summoned all the people to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul called all the people together for war, to go down to Keilah to besiege David and his men.
verses.textEnNlt: So Saul mobilized his entire army to march to Keilah and besiege David and his men.
verses.textEnNasb: So Saul summoned all the people for war, to go down to Keilah to besiege David and his men.
verses.textEn: And Saul called up all his forces for battle, to go down to Keilah to besiege David and his men.

verses.textZh: 大卫知道扫罗设计害他，就对亚比亚他祭司说："把以弗得拿来！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫知道扫罗设计害他，就对亚比亚他祭司说："把以弗得拿来！"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫知道扫罗设计谋害他，就对祭司亚比亚他说：「将以弗得拿过来。」
verses.textEnNiv: When David learned that Saul was plotting against him, he said to Abiathar the priest, "Bring the ephod."
verses.textEnEsv: David knew that Saul was plotting harm against him. And he said to Abiathar the priest, "Bring the ephod here."
verses.textEnNkjv: When David knew that Saul plotted evil against him, he said to Abiathar the priest, "Bring the ephod here."
verses.textEnNlt: But David learned of Saul’s plan and told Abiathar the priest to bring the ephod and ask the Lord what he should do.
verses.textEnNasb: But David knew that Saul was plotting evil against him; so he said to Abiathar the priest, "Bring the ephod here."
verses.textEn: When David learned that Saul was plotting against him, he said to Abiathar the priest, "Bring the ephod."

verses.textZh: 大卫说："耶和华以色列的神啊！你仆人确实听见了扫罗想要到基伊拉来，为了我的缘故要毁灭这城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫说："耶和华以色列的神啊！你仆人确实听见了扫罗想要到基伊拉来，为了我的缘故要毁灭这城。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫祷告说：「耶和华－以色列的神啊，你仆人听真了扫罗要往基伊拉来，为我的缘故灭城。
verses.textEnNiv: David said, " Lord , God of Israel, your servant has heard definitely that Saul plans to come to Keilah and destroy the town on account of me.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David said, "O Lord , the God of Israel, your servant has surely heard that Saul seeks to come to Keilah, to destroy the city on my account.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David said, "O Lord God of Israel, Your servant has certainly heard that Saul seeks to come to Keilah to destroy the city for my sake.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David prayed, "O Lord , God of Israel, I have heard that Saul is planning to come and destroy Keilah because I am here.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said, "Lord God of Israel, Your servant has heard for certain that Saul is seeking to come to Keilah to destroy the city on my account.
verses.textEn: David said, " Lord , God of Israel, your servant has heard definitely that Saul plans to come to Keilah and destroy the town on account of me.

verses.textZh: 基伊拉人会把我交在扫罗的手里吗？扫罗会照着你仆人所听到的下来吗？耶和华以色列的神啊！求你告诉你仆人。"耶和华说："他必下来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 基伊拉人会把我交在扫罗的手里吗？扫罗会照着你仆人所听到的下来吗？耶和华以色列的神啊！求你告诉你仆人。"耶和华说："他必下来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 基伊拉人将我交在扫罗手里不交？扫罗照着你仆人所听的话下来不下来？耶和华－以色列的神啊，求你指示仆人！」耶和华说：「扫罗必下来。」
verses.textEnNiv: Will the citizens of Keilah surrender me to him? Will Saul come down, as your servant has heard? Lord , God of Israel, tell your servant." And the Lord said, "He will."
verses.textEnEsv: Will the men of Keilah surrender me into his hand? Will Saul come down, as your servant has heard? O Lord , the God of Israel, please tell your servant." And the Lord said, "He will come down."
