verses.textEnNkjv: Will the men of Keilah deliver me into his hand? Will Saul come down, as Your servant has heard? O Lord God of Israel, I pray, tell Your servant." And the Lord said, "He will come down."
verses.textEnNlt: Will the leaders of Keilah betray me to him? And will Saul actually come as I have heard? O Lord , God of Israel, please tell me." And the Lord said, "He will come."
verses.textEnNasb: Will the citizens of Keilah hand me over to him? Will Saul come down just as Your servant has heard? Lord God of Israel, please, tell Your servant." And the Lord said, "He will come down."
verses.textEn: Will the citizens of Keilah surrender me to him? Will Saul come down, as your servant has heard? Lord , God of Israel, tell your servant." And the Lord said, "He will."

verses.textZh: 大卫又说："基伊拉人会把我和跟随我的人交在扫罗手里吗？"耶和华说："他们必把你们交出来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫又说："基伊拉人会把我和跟随我的人交在扫罗手里吗？"耶和华说："他们必把你们交出来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫又说：「基伊拉人将我和跟随我的人交在扫罗手里不交？」耶和华说：「必交出来。」
verses.textEnNiv: Again David asked, "Will the citizens of Keilah surrender me and my men to Saul?" And the Lord said, "They will."
verses.textEnEsv: Then David said, "Will the men of Keilah surrender me and my men into the hand of Saul?" And the Lord said, "They will surrender you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David said, "Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul?" And the Lord said, "They will deliver you."
verses.textEnNlt: Again David asked, "Will the leaders of Keilah betray me and my men to Saul?" And the Lord replied, "Yes, they will betray you."
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said, "Will the citizens of Keilah hand me and my men over to Saul?" And the Lord said, "They will hand you over."
verses.textEn: Again David asked, "Will the citizens of Keilah surrender me and my men to Saul?" And the Lord said, "They will."

verses.textZh: 大卫和跟从他的人，约有六百人，就起身离开基伊拉，到处漂泊。有人告诉扫罗，大卫已经逃离了基伊拉，扫罗就不出去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫和跟从他的人，约有六百人，就起身离开基伊拉，到处漂泊。有人告诉扫罗，大卫已经逃离了基伊拉，扫罗就不出去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫和跟随他的约有六百人，就起身出了基伊拉，往他们所能往的地方去。有人告诉扫罗，大卫离开基伊拉逃走；于是扫罗不出来了。
verses.textEnNiv: So David and his men, about six hundred in number, left Keilah and kept moving from place to place. When Saul was told that David had escaped from Keilah, he did not go there.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David and his men, who were about six hundred, arose and departed from Keilah, and they went wherever they could go. When Saul was told that David had escaped from Keilah, he gave up the expedition.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David and his men, about six hundred, arose and departed from Keilah and went wherever they could go. Then it was told Saul that David had escaped from Keilah; so he halted the expedition.
verses.textEnNlt: So David and his men—about 600 of them now—left Keilah and began roaming the countryside. Word soon reached Saul that David had escaped, so he didn’t go to Keilah after all.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David and his men, about six hundred, rose up and departed from Keilah, and they went wherever they could go. When it was reported to Saul that David had escaped from Keilah, he gave up the pursuit.
verses.textEn: So David and his men, about six hundred in number, left Keilah and kept moving from place to place. When Saul was told that David had escaped from Keilah, he did not go there.

verses.textZh: 大卫住在旷野的山寨里，又住在西弗旷野的山里。扫罗天天寻索大卫，神却不把大卫交在他手里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫住在旷野的山寨里，又住在西弗旷野的山里。扫罗天天寻索大卫，神却不把大卫交在他手里。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫住在旷野的山寨里，常在西弗旷野的山地。扫罗天天寻索大卫，神却不将大卫交在他手里。
verses.textEnNiv: David stayed in the wilderness strongholds and in the hills of the Desert of Ziph. Day after day Saul searched for him, but God did not give David into his hands.
verses.textEnEsv: And David remained in the strongholds in the wilderness, in the hill country of the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day, but God did not give him into his hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David stayed in strongholds in the wilderness, and remained in the mountains in the Wilderness of Ziph. Saul sought him every day, but God did not deliver him into his hand.
verses.textEnNlt: David now stayed in the strongholds of the wilderness and in the hill country of Ziph. Saul hunted him day after day, but God didn’t let Saul find him.
verses.textEnNasb: David stayed in the wilderness in the strongholds, and remained in the hill country in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul searched for him every day, but God did not hand him over to him.
verses.textEn: David stayed in the wilderness strongholds and in the hills of the Desert of Ziph. Day after day Saul searched for him, but God did not give David into his hands.

verses.textZh: 大卫惧怕，因为扫罗出来寻索他的命。那时大卫住在西弗旷野的何列斯那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫惧怕，因为扫罗出来寻索他的命。那时大卫住在西弗旷野的何列斯那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫知道扫罗出来寻索他的命。那时，他住在西弗旷野的树林里；
verses.textEnNiv: While David was at Horesh in the Desert of Ziph, he learned that Saul had come out to take his life.
verses.textEnEsv: David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life. David was in the wilderness of Ziph at Horesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life. And David was in the Wilderness of Ziph in a forest.
verses.textEnNlt: One day near Horesh, David received the news that Saul was on the way to Ziph to search for him and kill him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life while David was in the wilderness of Ziph, at Horesh.
verses.textEn: While David was at Horesh in the Desert of Ziph, he learned that Saul had come out to take his life.

verses.textZh: 扫罗的儿子约拿单起身，到何列斯去见大卫，鼓励他，使他靠神坚强起来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗的儿子约拿单起身，到何列斯去见大卫，鼓励他，使他靠神坚强起来，
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗的儿子约拿单起身，往那树林里去见大卫，使他倚靠神得以坚固，
verses.textEnNiv: And Saul’s son Jonathan went to David at Horesh and helped him find strength in God.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jonathan, Saul’s son, rose and went to David at Horesh, and strengthened his hand in God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jonathan, Saul’s son, arose and went to David in the woods and strengthened his hand in God.
verses.textEnNlt: Jonathan went to find David and encouraged him to stay strong in his faith in God.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jonathan, Saul’s son, set out and went to David at Horesh, and encouraged him in God.
verses.textEn: And Saul’s son Jonathan went to David at Horesh and helped him find strength in God.

verses.textZh: 对他说："你不要惧怕！我父亲扫罗的手必不能害你。你必要作以色列的王，我要在你以下位居第二，这事连我父亲扫罗也知道了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他说："你不要惧怕！我父亲扫罗的手必不能害你。你必要作以色列的王，我要在你以下位居第二，这事连我父亲扫罗也知道了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 对他说：「不要惧怕！我父扫罗的手必不加害于你；你必作以色列的王，我也作你的宰相。这事我父扫罗知道了。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Don’t be afraid," he said. "My father Saul will not lay a hand on you. You will be king over Israel, and I will be second to you. Even my father Saul knows this."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to him, "Do not fear, for the hand of Saul my father shall not find you. You shall be king over Israel, and I shall be next to you. Saul my father also knows this."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to him, "Do not fear, for the hand of Saul my father shall not find you. You shall be king over Israel, and I shall be next to you. Even my father Saul knows that."
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t be afraid," Jonathan reassured him. "My father will never find you! You are going to be the king of Israel, and I will be next to you, as my father, Saul, is well aware."
verses.textEnNasb: He said to him, "Do not be afraid, because the hand of Saul my father will not find you, and you will be king over Israel, and I will be second in command to you; and Saul my father knows that as well."
verses.textEn: "Don’t be afraid," he said. "My father Saul will not lay a hand on you. You will be king over Israel, and I will be second to you. Even my father Saul knows this."

verses.textZh: 于是他们二人在耶和华面前立了约。大卫仍住在何列斯，约拿单却回自己的家去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们二人在耶和华面前立了约。大卫仍住在何列斯，约拿单却回自己的家去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是二人在耶和华面前立约。大卫仍住在树林里，约拿单回家去了。
verses.textEnNiv: The two of them made a covenant before the Lord . Then Jonathan went home, but David remained at Horesh.
verses.textEnEsv: And the two of them made a covenant before the Lord . David remained at Horesh, and Jonathan went home.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the two of them made a covenant before the Lord. And David stayed in the woods, and Jonathan went to his own house.
verses.textEnNlt: So the two of them renewed their solemn pact before the Lord . Then Jonathan returned home, while David stayed at Horesh.
verses.textEnNasb: So the two of them made a covenant before the Lord; and David stayed at Horesh, while Jonathan went to his house.
verses.textEn: The two of them made a covenant before the Lord . Then Jonathan went home, but David remained at Horesh.

verses.textZh: 西弗人上到基比亚去见扫罗，说："大卫不是在我们这里的何列斯的山寨，就是在旷野南边的哈基拉山上藏着吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 西弗人上到基比亚去见扫罗，说："大卫不是在我们这里的何列斯的山寨，就是在旷野南边的哈基拉山上藏着吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 西弗人上到基比亚见扫罗，说：「大卫不是在我们那里的树林里山寨中、旷野南边的哈基拉山藏着吗？
verses.textEnNiv: The Ziphites went up to Saul at Gibeah and said, "Is not David hiding among us in the strongholds at Horesh, on the hill of Hakilah, south of Jeshimon?
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Ziphites went up to Saul at Gibeah, saying, "Is not David hiding among us in the strongholds at Horesh, on the hill of Hachilah, which is south of Jeshimon?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Ziphites came up to Saul at Gibeah, saying, "Is David not hiding with us in strongholds in the woods, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of Jeshimon?
verses.textEnNlt: But now the men of Ziph went to Saul in Gibeah and betrayed David to him. "We know where David is hiding," they said. "He is in the strongholds of Horesh on the hill of Hakilah, which is in the southern part of Jeshimon.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Ziphites came up to Saul at Gibeah, saying, "Is David not keeping himself hidden with us in the strongholds at Horesh, on the hill of Hachilah, which is south of Jeshimon?
verses.textEn: The Ziphites went up to Saul at Gibeah and said, "Is not David hiding among us in the strongholds at Horesh, on the hill of Hakilah, south of Jeshimon?

verses.textZh: 王啊，现在请下来，请你随着你的心愿下来，我们必亲自把他交在王的手里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王啊，现在请下来，请你随着你的心愿下来，我们必亲自把他交在王的手里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王啊，请你随你的心愿下来，我们必亲自将他交在王的手里。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now, Your Majesty, come down whenever it pleases you to do so, and we will be responsible for giving him into your hands."
verses.textEnEsv: Now come down, O king, according to all your heart’s desire to come down, and our part shall be to surrender him into the king’s hand."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, O king, come down according to all the desire of your soul to come down; and our part shallbe to deliver him into the king’s hand."
verses.textEnNlt: Come down whenever you’re ready, O king, and we will catch him and hand him over to you!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, O king, come down, since you fully desire to do so; and our part shall be to hand him over to the king."
verses.textEn: Now, Your Majesty, come down whenever it pleases you to do so, and we will be responsible for giving him into your hands."

verses.textZh: 扫罗说："愿耶和华赐福你们，因为你们关心我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗说："愿耶和华赐福你们，因为你们关心我。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗说：「愿耶和华赐福与你们，因你们顾恤我。
verses.textEnNiv: Saul replied, "The Lord bless you for your concern for me.
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul said, "May you be blessed by the Lord , for you have had compassion on me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Saul said, "Blessed are you of the Lord, for you have compassion on me.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord bless you," Saul said. "At last someone is concerned about me!
verses.textEnNasb: Saul said, "May you be blessed of the Lord, since you have had compassion on me.
verses.textEn: Saul replied, "The Lord bless you for your concern for me.

verses.textZh: 你们要去再确实查看他脚踪所到的地方，有谁看见他在那里，因为有人对我说，他非常狡猾。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要去再确实查看他脚踪所到的地方，有谁看见他在那里，因为有人对我说，他非常狡猾。
verses.textZhCuv: 请你们回去，再确实查明他的住处和行踪，是谁看见他在那里，因为我听见人说他甚狡猾。
verses.textEnNiv: Go and get more information. Find out where David usually goes and who has seen him there. They tell me he is very crafty.
verses.textEnEsv: Go, make yet more sure. Know and see the place where his foot is, and who has seen him there, for it is told me that he is very cunning.
verses.textEnNkjv: Please go and find out for sure, and see the place where his hideout is, and who has seen him there. For I am told he is very crafty.
verses.textEnNlt: Go and check again to be sure of where he is staying and who has seen him there, for I know that he is very crafty.
verses.textEnNasb: Go now, be more persistent, and investigate and see his place where he is hiding, and who has seen him there; for I am told that he is very cunning.
verses.textEn: Go and get more information. Find out where David usually goes and who has seen him there. They tell me he is very crafty.

verses.textZh: 你们要去查看他所有藏身的地方，确定以后再回来见我，我就与你们同去；如果他在本地，我必从犹大的千门万户中把他搜出来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要去查看他所有藏身的地方，确定以后再回来见我，我就与你们同去；如果他在本地，我必从犹大的千门万户中把他搜出来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以要看准他藏匿的地方，回来据实地告诉我，我就与你们同去。他若在犹大的境内，我必从千门万户中搜出他来。」
verses.textEnNiv: Find out about all the hiding places he uses and come back to me with definite information. Then I will go with you; if he is in the area, I will track him down among all the clans of Judah."
verses.textEnEsv: See therefore and take note of all the lurking places where he hides, and come back to me with sure information. Then I will go with you. And if he is in the land, I will search him out among all the thousands of Judah."
verses.textEnNkjv: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hides; and come back to me with certainty, and I will go with you. And it shall be, if he is in the land, that I will search for him throughout all the clans of Judah."
verses.textEnNlt: Discover his hiding places, and come back when you are sure. Then I’ll go with you. And if he is in the area at all, I’ll track him down, even if I have to search every hiding place in Judah!"
verses.textEnNasb: So look, and learn about all the hiding places where he keeps himself hidden, and return to me with certainty, and I will go with you; and if he is in the land, I will search him out among all the thousands of Judah."
verses.textEn: Find out about all the hiding places he uses and come back to me with definite information. Then I will go with you; if he is in the area, I will track him down among all the clans of Judah."

verses.textZh: 于是西弗人起身，在扫罗以先到西弗去了。那时大卫和跟随他的人却在玛云旷野，就是在荒野南边的亚拉巴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是西弗人起身，在扫罗以先到西弗去了。那时大卫和跟随他的人却在玛云旷野，就是在荒野南边的亚拉巴。
verses.textZhCuv: 西弗人就起身，在扫罗以先往西弗去。 大卫和跟随他的人却在玛云旷野南边的亚拉巴。
verses.textEnNiv: So they set out and went to Ziph ahead of Saul. Now David and his men were in the Desert of Maon, in the Arabah south of Jeshimon.
verses.textEnEsv: And they arose and went to Ziph ahead of Saul. Now David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the Arabah to the south of Jeshimon.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they arose and went to Ziph before Saul. But David and his men were in the Wilderness of Maon, in the plain on the south of Jeshimon.
verses.textEnNlt: So the men of Ziph returned home ahead of Saul. Meanwhile, David and his men had moved into the wilderness of Maon in the Arabah Valley south of Jeshimon.
verses.textEnNasb: So they set out and went to Ziph ahead of Saul. Now David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the Arabah to the south of Jeshimon.
verses.textEn: So they set out and went to Ziph ahead of Saul. Now David and his men were in the Desert of Maon, in the Arabah south of Jeshimon.

verses.textZh: 扫罗和跟随他的人去寻找大卫。有人告诉大卫，他就下到盘石那里，留在玛云旷野。扫罗听见了，就在玛云旷野追赶大卫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗和跟随他的人去寻找大卫。有人告诉大卫，他就下到盘石那里，留在玛云旷野。扫罗听见了，就在玛云旷野追赶大卫。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗和跟随他的人去寻找大卫；有人告诉大卫，他就下到磐石，住在玛云的旷野。扫罗听见，便在玛云的旷野追赶大卫。
verses.textEnNiv: Saul and his men began the search, and when David was told about it, he went down to the rock and stayed in the Desert of Maon. When Saul heard this, he went into the Desert of Maon in pursuit of David.
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul and his men went to seek him. And David was told, so he went down to the rock and lived in the wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard that, he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Saul and his men went to seek him, they told David. Therefore he went down to the rock, and stayed in the Wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard that, he pursued David in the Wilderness of Maon.
verses.textEnNlt: When David heard that Saul and his men were searching for him, he went even farther into the wilderness to the great rock, and he remained there in the wilderness of Maon. But Saul kept after him in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: When Saul and his men went to seek him, they informed David, and he came down to the rock and stayed in the wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard about it, he pursued David in the wilderness of Maon.
verses.textEn: Saul and his men began the search, and when David was told about it, he went down to the rock and stayed in the Desert of Maon. When Saul heard this, he went into the Desert of Maon in pursuit of David.

verses.textZh: 扫罗在山这边走，大卫和跟随他的人却在山那边走。大卫匆匆忙忙逃避扫罗，扫罗和跟随他的人却四面包围大卫和跟随他的人，要把他们捉住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗在山这边走，大卫和跟随他的人却在山那边走。大卫匆匆忙忙逃避扫罗，扫罗和跟随他的人却四面包围大卫和跟随他的人，要把他们捉住。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗在山这边走，大卫和跟随他的人在山那边走。大卫急忙躲避扫罗；因为扫罗和跟随他的人，四面围住大卫和跟随他的人，要拿获他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Saul was going along one side of the mountain, and David and his men were on the other side, hurrying to get away from Saul. As Saul and his forces were closing in on David and his men to capture them,
verses.textEnEsv: Saul went on one side of the mountain, and David and his men on the other side of the mountain. And David was hurrying to get away from Saul. As Saul and his men were closing in on David and his men to capture them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul went on one side of the mountain, and David and his men on the other side of the mountain. So David made haste to get away from Saul, for Saul and his men were encircling David and his men to take them.
verses.textEnNlt: Saul and David were now on opposite sides of a mountain. Just as Saul and his men began to close in on David and his men,
verses.textEnNasb: Saul went on one side of the mountain, and David and his men on the other side of the mountain; and David was hurrying to get away from Saul, while Saul and his men were surrounding David and his men to apprehend them.
verses.textEn: Saul was going along one side of the mountain, and David and his men were on the other side, hurrying to get away from Saul. As Saul and his forces were closing in on David and his men to capture them,

verses.textZh: 那时忽有使者来见扫罗说："请你赶快回去，因为非利士人来突击这地。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时忽有使者来见扫罗说："请你赶快回去，因为非利士人来突击这地。"
verses.textZhCuv: 忽有使者来报告扫罗说：「非利士人犯境抢掠，请王快快回去！」
verses.textEnNiv: a messenger came to Saul, saying, "Come quickly! The Philistines are raiding the land."
verses.textEnEsv: a messenger came to Saul, saying, "Hurry and come, for the Philistines have made a raid against the land."
verses.textEnNkjv: But a messenger came to Saul, saying, "Hurry and come, for the Philistines have invaded the land!"
verses.textEnNlt: an urgent message reached Saul that the Philistines were raiding Israel again.
verses.textEnNasb: But a messenger came to Saul, saying, "Hurry and come, for the Philistines have launched an attack against the land!"
verses.textEn: a messenger came to Saul, saying, "Come quickly! The Philistines are raiding the land."

verses.textZh: 于是扫罗不再追赶大卫，回去迎战非利士人。因此这地方被称为西拉．哈玛希罗结。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是扫罗不再追赶大卫，回去迎战非利士人。因此这地方被称为西拉．哈玛希罗结。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是扫罗不追赶大卫，回去攻打非利士人。因此那地方名叫西拉‧哈玛希罗结。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Saul broke off his pursuit of David and went to meet the Philistines. That is why they call this place Sela Hammahlekoth.
verses.textEnEsv: So Saul returned from pursuing after David and went against the Philistines. Therefore that place was called the Rock of Escape.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore Saul returned from pursuing David, and went against the Philistines; so they called that place the Rock of Escape.
verses.textEnNlt: So Saul quit chasing David and returned to fight the Philistines. Ever since that time, the place where David was camped has been called the Rock of Escape.
verses.textEnNasb: So Saul returned from pursuing David and went to confront the Philistines; therefore they called that place the Rock of Division.
verses.textEn: Then Saul broke off his pursuit of David and went to meet the Philistines. That is why they call this place Sela Hammahlekoth.

verses.textZh: 大卫从那里上去，住在隐．基底的山寨里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫从那里上去，住在隐．基底的山寨里。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫从那里上去，住在隐‧基底的山寨里。
verses.textEnNiv: And David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of En Gedi.
verses.textEnEsv: And David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of Engedi.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David went up from there and dwelt in strongholds at En Gedi.
verses.textEnNlt: David then went to live in the strongholds of En-gedi.
verses.textEnNasb: And David went up from there and stayed in the strongholds of Engedi.
verses.textEn: And David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of En Gedi.

verses.textZh: 扫罗追赶非利士人回来的时候，有人告诉他说："看哪，大卫在隐．基底的旷野。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗追赶非利士人回来的时候，有人告诉他说："看哪，大卫在隐．基底的旷野。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗追赶非利士人回来，有人告诉他说：「大卫在隐‧基底的旷野。」
verses.textEnNiv: After Saul returned from pursuing the Philistines, he was told, "David is in the Desert of En Gedi."
verses.textEnEsv: When Saul returned from following the Philistines, he was told, "Behold, David is in the wilderness of Engedi."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, when Saul had returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, "Take note! David is in the Wilderness of En Gedi."
verses.textEnNlt: After Saul returned from fighting the Philistines, he was told that David had gone into the wilderness of En-gedi.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Saul returned from pursuing the Philistines, it was reported to him, saying, "Behold, David is in the wilderness of Engedi."
verses.textEn: After Saul returned from pursuing the Philistines, he was told, "David is in the Desert of En Gedi."

verses.textZh: 扫罗就从以色列人中选出三千精兵，带领他们到野羊盘石去搜索大卫和跟随他的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗就从以色列人中选出三千精兵，带领他们到野羊盘石去搜索大卫和跟随他的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗就从以色列人中挑选三千精兵，率领他们往野羊的磐石去，寻索大卫和跟随他的人。
verses.textEnNiv: So Saul took three thousand able young men from all Israel and set out to look for David and his men near the Crags of the Wild Goats.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel and went to seek David and his men in front of the Wildgoats’ Rocks.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men from all Israel, and went to seek David and his men on the Rocks of the Wild Goats.
verses.textEnNlt: So Saul chose 3,000 elite troops from all Israel and went to search for David and his men near the rocks of the wild goats.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men from all Israel and went to search for David and his men in front of the Rocks of the Mountain Goats.
verses.textEn: So Saul took three thousand able young men from all Israel and set out to look for David and his men near the Crags of the Wild Goats.

verses.textZh: 到了路旁的羊圈，那里有一个洞，扫罗进去大解；那时，大卫和跟随他的人正坐在洞里的深处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了路旁的羊圈，那里有一个洞，扫罗进去大解；那时，大卫和跟随他的人正坐在洞里的深处。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了路旁的羊圈，在那里有洞，扫罗进去大解。大卫和跟随他的人正藏在洞里的深处。
verses.textEnNiv: He came to the sheep pens along the way; a cave was there, and Saul went in to relieve himself. David and his men were far back in the cave.
verses.textEnEsv: And he came to the sheepfolds by the way, where there was a cave, and Saul went in to relieve himself. Now David and his men were sitting in the innermost parts of the cave.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he came to the sheepfolds by the road, where there was a cave; and Saul went in to attend to his needs. ( David and his men were staying in the recesses of the cave.)
verses.textEnNlt: At the place where the road passes some sheepfolds, Saul went into a cave to relieve himself. But as it happened, David and his men were hiding farther back in that very cave!
verses.textEnNasb: And he came to the sheepfolds on the way, where there was a cave; and Saul went in to relieve himself. Now David and his men were sitting in the inner recesses of the cave.
verses.textEn: He came to the sheep pens along the way; a cave was there, and Saul went in to relieve himself. David and his men were far back in the cave.

verses.textZh: 跟随大卫的人对他说："耶和华曾应许你说：‘我要把你的仇敌交在你的手里，你可以随意待他。’看哪！今天就是时候了。"于是大卫起来，悄悄地割下扫罗外袍的衣边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 跟随大卫的人对他说："耶和华曾应许你说：‘我要把你的仇敌交在你的手里，你可以随意待他。’看哪！今天就是时候了。"于是大卫起来，悄悄地割下扫罗外袍的衣边。
verses.textZhCuv: 跟随的人对大卫说：「耶和华曾应许你说：『我要将你的仇敌交在你手里，你可以任意待他。』如今时候到了！」大卫就起来，悄悄地割下扫罗外袍的衣襟。
verses.textEnNiv: The men said, "This is the day the Lord spoke of when he said to you, ‘I will give your enemy into your hands for you to deal with as you wish.’ " Then David crept up unnoticed and cut off a corner of Saul’s robe.
verses.textEnEsv: And the men of David said to him, "Here is the day of which the Lord said to you, ‘Behold, I will give your enemy into your hand, and you shall do to him as it shall seem good to you.’" Then David arose and stealthily cut off a corner of Saul’s robe.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the men of David said to him, "This is the day of which the Lord said to you, ‘Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your hand, that you may do to him as it seems good to you.’ " And David arose and secretly cut off a corner of Saul’s robe.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now’s your opportunity!" David’s men whispered to him. "Today the Lord is telling you, ‘I will certainly put your enemy into your power, to do with as you wish.’" So David crept forward and cut off a piece of the hem of Saul’s robe.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David’s men said to him, "Behold, this is the day of which the Lord said to you, ‘Behold; I am about to hand your enemy over to you, and you shall do to him as it seems good to you.’ " Then David got up and cut off the edge of Saul’s robe secretly.
verses.textEn: The men said, "This is the day the Lord spoke of when he said to you, ‘I will give your enemy into your hands for you to deal with as you wish.’ " Then David crept up unnoticed and cut off a corner of Saul’s robe.

verses.textZh: 事后，大卫为了割下扫罗的衣边，心中自责，
verses.textZhCnvs: 事后，大卫为了割下扫罗的衣边，心中自责，
verses.textZhCuv: 随后大卫心中自责，因为割下扫罗的衣襟；
verses.textEnNiv: Afterward, David was conscience-stricken for having cut off a corner of his robe.
verses.textEnEsv: And afterward David’s heart struck him, because he had cut off a corner of Saul’s robe.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened afterward that David’s heart troubled him because he had cut Saul’s robe.
verses.textEnNlt: But then David’s conscience began bothering him because he had cut Saul’s robe.
verses.textEnNasb: But it came about afterward that David’s conscience bothered him because he had cut off the edge of Saul’s robe.
verses.textEn: Afterward, David was conscience-stricken for having cut off a corner of his robe.

verses.textZh: 就对跟随他的人说："我在耶和华面前绝对不能这样对待我主耶和华的受膏者，我绝对不能动手攻击他，因为他是耶和华的受膏者。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就对跟随他的人说："我在耶和华面前绝对不能这样对待我主耶和华的受膏者，我绝对不能动手攻击他，因为他是耶和华的受膏者。"
verses.textZhCuv: 对跟随他的人说：「我的主乃是耶和华的受膏者，我在耶和华面前万不敢伸手害他，因他是耶和华的受膏者。」
verses.textEnNiv: He said to his men, "The Lord forbid that I should do such a thing to my master, the Lord ’s anointed, or lay my hand on him; for he is the anointed of the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: He said to his men, "The Lord forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, the Lord ’s anointed, to put out my hand against him, seeing he is the Lord ’s anointed."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to his men, "The Lord forbid that I should do this thing to my master, the Lord’s anointed, to stretch out my hand against him, seeing he is the anointed of the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: He said to his men, "The Lord forbid that I should do this to my lord the king. I shouldn’t attack the Lord ’s anointed one, for the Lord himself has chosen him."
verses.textEnNasb: So he said to his men, "Far be it from me because of the Lord that I would do this thing to my lord, the Lord’s anointed, to reach out with my hand against him, since he is the Lord’s anointed."
verses.textEn: He said to his men, "The Lord forbid that I should do such a thing to my master, the Lord ’s anointed, or lay my hand on him; for he is the anointed of the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 大卫用这些话阻止了跟随他的人，不让他们起来攻击扫罗。扫罗起来，出了山洞，继续走他的路去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫用这些话阻止了跟随他的人，不让他们起来攻击扫罗。扫罗起来，出了山洞，继续走他的路去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫用这话拦住跟随他的人，不容他们起来害扫罗。扫罗起来，从洞里出去行路。
verses.textEnNiv: With these words David sharply rebuked his men and did not allow them to attack Saul. And Saul left the cave and went his way.
verses.textEnEsv: So David persuaded his men with these words and did not permit them to attack Saul. And Saul rose up and left the cave and went on his way.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David restrained his servants with these words, and did not allow them to rise against Saul. And Saul got up from the cave and went on his way.
verses.textEnNlt: So David restrained his men and did not let them kill Saul. After Saul had left the cave and gone on his way,
verses.textEnNasb: And David rebuked his men with these words and did not allow them to rise up against Saul. And Saul got up, left the cave, and went on his way.
verses.textEn: With these words David sharply rebuked his men and did not allow them to attack Saul. And Saul left the cave and went his way.

verses.textZh: 随后，大卫也起来，离开了山洞，在扫罗背后呼叫，说："我主！我王！"扫罗回头向后看的时候，大卫就脸伏于地，向他叩拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 随后，大卫也起来，离开了山洞，在扫罗背后呼叫，说："我主！我王！"扫罗回头向后看的时候，大卫就脸伏于地，向他叩拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 随后大卫也起来，从洞里出去，呼叫扫罗说：「我主，我王！」扫罗回头观看，大卫就屈身、脸伏于地下拜。
verses.textEnNiv: Then David went out of the cave and called out to Saul, "My lord the king!" When Saul looked behind him, David bowed down and prostrated himself with his face to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: Afterward David also arose and went out of the cave, and called after Saul, "My lord the king!" And when Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth and paid homage.
verses.textEnNkjv: David also arose afterward, went out of the cave, and called out to Saul, saying, "My lord the king!" And when Saul looked behind him, David stooped with his face to the earth, and bowed down.
verses.textEnNlt: David came out and shouted after him, "My lord the king!" And when Saul looked around, David bowed low before him.
verses.textEnNasb: Afterward, however, David got up and went out of the cave, and called after Saul, saying, "My lord the king!" And when Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the ground and prostrated himself.
verses.textEn: Then David went out of the cave and called out to Saul, "My lord the king!" When Saul looked behind him, David bowed down and prostrated himself with his face to the ground.

verses.textZh: 大卫对扫罗说："你为甚么听信人的话，说：‘大卫想要害你’呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对扫罗说："你为甚么听信人的话，说：‘大卫想要害你’呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对扫罗说：「你为何听信人的谗言，说大卫想要害你呢？
verses.textEnNiv: He said to Saul, "Why do you listen when men say, ‘David is bent on harming you’?
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to Saul, "Why do you listen to the words of men who say, ‘Behold, David seeks your harm’?
verses.textEnNkjv: And David said to Saul: "Why do you listen to the words of men who say, ‘Indeed David seeks your harm’?
verses.textEnNlt: Then he shouted to Saul, "Why do you listen to the people who say I am trying to harm you?
verses.textEnNasb: And David said to Saul, "Why do you listen to the words of men who say, ‘Behold, David is seeking to harm you’?
verses.textEn: He said to Saul, "Why do you listen when men say, ‘David is bent on harming you’?

verses.textZh: 现在你亲眼看到，今天耶和华在山洞里，把你交在我手里。有人叫我杀你，我却爱惜你。我说：‘我不敢下手伤害我主，因为他是耶和华的受膏者。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你亲眼看到，今天耶和华在山洞里，把你交在我手里。有人叫我杀你，我却爱惜你。我说：‘我不敢下手伤害我主，因为他是耶和华的受膏者。’
verses.textZhCuv: 今日你亲眼看见在洞中，耶和华将你交在我手里；有人叫我杀你，我却爱惜你，说：『我不敢伸手害我的主，因为他是耶和华的受膏者。』
verses.textEnNiv: This day you have seen with your own eyes how the Lord delivered you into my hands in the cave. Some urged me to kill you, but I spared you; I said, ‘I will not lay my hand on my lord, because he is the Lord ’s anointed.’
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, this day your eyes have seen how the Lord gave you today into my hand in the cave. And some told me to kill you, but I spared you. I said, ‘I will not put out my hand against my lord, for he is the Lord ’s anointed.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Look, this day your eyes have seen that the Lord delivered you today into my hand in the cave, and someone urged me to kill you. But myeye spared you, and I said, ‘I will not stretch out my hand against my lord, for he is the Lord’s anointed.’
verses.textEnNlt: This very day you can see with your own eyes it isn’t true. For the Lord placed you at my mercy back there in the cave. Some of my men told me to kill you, but I spared you. For I said, ‘I will never harm the king—he is the Lord ’s anointed one.’
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, this day your eyes have seen that the Lord had handed you over to me today in the cave, and someone said to kill you, but I spared you; and I said, ‘I will not reach out with my hand against my lord, because he is the Lord’s anointed.’
verses.textEn: This day you have seen with your own eyes how the Lord delivered you into my hands in the cave. Some urged me to kill you, but I spared you; I said, ‘I will not lay my hand on my lord, because he is the Lord ’s anointed.’

verses.textZh: 我父啊，请看，你外袍的衣边在我手中。我割下了你外袍的衣边，却没有杀你。你从此可以知道，也可以看出我手中没有邪恶，也没有过犯。我虽然没有得罪你，你却要猎取我的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我父啊，请看，你外袍的衣边在我手中。我割下了你外袍的衣边，却没有杀你。你从此可以知道，也可以看出我手中没有邪恶，也没有过犯。我虽然没有得罪你，你却要猎取我的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 我父啊，看看你外袍的衣襟在我手中。我割下你的衣襟，没有杀你；你由此可以知道我没有恶意叛逆你。你虽然猎取我的命，我却没有得罪你。
verses.textEnNiv: See, my father, look at this piece of your robe in my hand! I cut off the corner of your robe but did not kill you. See that there is nothing in my hand to indicate that I am guilty of wrongdoing or rebellion. I have not wronged you, but you are hunting me down to take my life.
verses.textEnEsv: See, my father, see the corner of your robe in my hand. For by the fact that I cut off the corner of your robe and did not kill you, you may know and see that there is no wrong or treason in my hands. I have not sinned against you, though you hunt my life to take it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover, my father, see! Yes, see the corner of your robe in my hand! For in that I cut off the corner of your robe, and did not kill you, know and see that thereis neither evil nor rebellion in my hand, and I have not sinned against you. Yet you hunt my life to take it.
verses.textEnNlt: Look, my father, at what I have in my hand. It is a piece of the hem of your robe! I cut it off, but I didn’t kill you. This proves that I am not trying to harm you and that I have not sinned against you, even though you have been hunting for me to kill me.
verses.textEnNasb: So, my father, look! Indeed, look at the edge of your robe in my hand! For by the fact that I cut off the edge of your robe but did not kill you, know and understand that there is no evil or rebellion in my hands, and I have not sinned against you, though you are lying in wait for my life, to take it.
verses.textEn: See, my father, look at this piece of your robe in my hand! I cut off the corner of your robe but did not kill you. See that there is nothing in my hand to indicate that I am guilty of wrongdoing or rebellion. I have not wronged you, but you are hunting me down to take my life.

verses.textZh: 愿耶和华在你我之间判断是非；愿耶和华在你身上为我伸冤。我的手却不敢伤害你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿耶和华在你我之间判断是非；愿耶和华在你身上为我伸冤。我的手却不敢伤害你。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿耶和华在你我中间判断是非，在你身上为我伸冤，我却不亲手加害于你。
verses.textEnNiv: May the Lord judge between you and me. And may the Lord avenge the wrongs you have done to me, but my hand will not touch you.
verses.textEnEsv: May the Lord judge between me and you, may the Lord avenge me against you, but my hand shall not be against you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the Lord judge between you and me, and let the Lord avenge me on you. But my hand shall not be against you.
verses.textEnNlt: "May the Lord judge between us. Perhaps the Lord will punish you for what you are trying to do to me, but I will never harm you.
verses.textEnNasb: May the Lord judge between you and me, and may the Lord take vengeance on you for me; but my hand shall not be against you.
verses.textEn: May the Lord judge between you and me. And may the Lord avenge the wrongs you have done to me, but my hand will not touch you.

verses.textZh: 正如古时的格言：‘恶事出于恶人。’所以，我的手不敢伤害你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正如古时的格言：‘恶事出于恶人。’所以，我的手不敢伤害你。
verses.textZhCuv: 古人有句俗语说：『恶事出于恶人。』我却不亲手加害于你。
verses.textEnNiv: As the old saying goes, ‘From evildoers come evil deeds,’ so my hand will not touch you.
verses.textEnEsv: As the proverb of the ancients says, ‘Out of the wicked comes wickedness.’ But my hand shall not be against you.
verses.textEnNkjv: As the proverb of the ancients says, ‘Wickedness proceeds from the wicked.’ But my hand shall not be against you.
verses.textEnNlt: As that old proverb says, ‘From evil people come evil deeds.’ So you can be sure I will never harm you.
verses.textEnNasb: As the proverb of the ancients says, ‘Out of the wicked comes wickedness’; but my hand shall not be against you.
verses.textEn: As the old saying goes, ‘From evildoers come evil deeds,’ so my hand will not touch you.

verses.textZh: 以色列的王出去追捕谁呢？你现在追赶谁呢？不过是追赶一条死狗，一只跳蚤罢了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的王出去追捕谁呢？你现在追赶谁呢？不过是追赶一条死狗，一只跳蚤罢了！
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王出来要寻找谁呢？追赶谁呢？不过追赶一条死狗，一个虼蚤就是了。
verses.textEnNiv: "Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Who are you pursuing? A dead dog? A flea?
verses.textEnEsv: After whom has the king of Israel come out? After whom do you pursue? After a dead dog! After a flea!
verses.textEnNkjv: After whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom do you pursue? A dead dog? A flea?
verses.textEnNlt: Who is the king of Israel trying to catch anyway? Should he spend his time chasing one who is as worthless as a dead dog or a single flea?
verses.textEnNasb: After whom has the king of Israel gone out? Whom are you pursuing? A dead dog, a single flea?
verses.textEn: "Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Who are you pursuing? A dead dog? A flea?

verses.textZh: 愿耶和华在你我中间施行审判，断定是非；愿他鉴察，为我的案件伸冤，救我脱离你的手。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿耶和华在你我中间施行审判，断定是非；愿他鉴察，为我的案件伸冤，救我脱离你的手。"
verses.textZhCuv: 愿耶和华在你我中间施行审判，断定是非，并且鉴察，为我伸冤，救我脱离你的手。」
verses.textEnNiv: May the Lord be our judge and decide between us. May he consider my cause and uphold it; may he vindicate me by delivering me from your hand."
verses.textEnEsv: May the Lord therefore be judge and give sentence between me and you, and see to it and plead my cause and deliver me from your hand."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore let the Lord be judge, and judge between you and me, and see and plead my case, and deliver me out of your hand."
verses.textEnNlt: May the Lord therefore judge which of us is right and punish the guilty one. He is my advocate, and he will rescue me from your power!"
verses.textEnNasb: May the Lord therefore be judge and decide between you and me; and may He see and plead my cause and save me from your hand."
verses.textEn: May the Lord be our judge and decide between us. May he consider my cause and uphold it; may he vindicate me by delivering me from your hand."

verses.textZh: 大卫对扫罗说完了这些话，扫罗就说："我儿大卫啊，这是你的声音吗？"于是扫罗放声大哭，
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对扫罗说完了这些话，扫罗就说："我儿大卫啊，这是你的声音吗？"于是扫罗放声大哭，
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫向扫罗说完这话，扫罗说：「我儿大卫，这是你的声音吗？」就放声大哭，
verses.textEnNiv: When David finished saying this, Saul asked, "Is that your voice, David my son?" And he wept aloud.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as David had finished speaking these words to Saul, Saul said, "Is this your voice, my son David?" And Saul lifted up his voice and wept.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when David had finished speaking these words to Saul, that Saul said, "Is this your voice, my son David?" And Saul lifted up his voice and wept.
verses.textEnNlt: When David had finished speaking, Saul called back, "Is that really you, my son David?" Then he began to cry.
verses.textEnNasb: When David had finished speaking these words to Saul, Saul said, "Is this your voice, my son David?" Then Saul raised his voice and wept.
verses.textEn: When David finished saying this, Saul asked, "Is that your voice, David my son?" And he wept aloud.

verses.textZh: 对大卫说："你比我公义，因为你以良善待我，我却以恶待你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对大卫说："你比我公义，因为你以良善待我，我却以恶待你。
verses.textZhCuv: 对大卫说：「你比我公义；因为你以善待我，我却以恶待你。
verses.textEnNiv: "You are more righteous than I," he said. "You have treated me well, but I have treated you badly.
verses.textEnEsv: He said to David, "You are more righteous than I, for you have repaid me good, whereas I have repaid you evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to David: "You are more righteous than I; for you have rewarded me with good, whereas I have rewarded you with evil.
verses.textEnNlt: And he said to David, "You are a better man than I am, for you have repaid me good for evil.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to David, "You are more righteous than I; for you have dealt well with me, while I have dealt maliciously with you.
verses.textEn: "You are more righteous than I," he said. "You have treated me well, but I have treated you badly.

verses.textZh: 今天你所作的说明了你以良善待我，因为耶和华把我交在你手里，你却没有杀我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 今天你所作的说明了你以良善待我，因为耶和华把我交在你手里，你却没有杀我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你今日显明是以善待我；因为耶和华将我交在你手里，你却没有杀我。
verses.textEnNiv: You have just now told me about the good you did to me; the Lord delivered me into your hands, but you did not kill me.
verses.textEnEsv: And you have declared this day how you have dealt well with me, in that you did not kill me when the Lord put me into your hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you have shown this day how you have dealt well with me; for when the Lord delivered me into your hand, you did not kill me.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, you have been amazingly kind to me today, for when the Lord put me in a place where you could have killed me, you didn’t do it.
verses.textEnNasb: You have declared today that you have done good to me, that the Lord handed me over to you and yet you did not kill me.
verses.textEn: You have just now told me about the good you did to me; the Lord delivered me into your hands, but you did not kill me.

verses.textZh: 如果人遇见仇敌，怎会让他平平安安离去呢？愿耶和华因你今天对我所作的以福报答你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果人遇见仇敌，怎会让他平平安安离去呢？愿耶和华因你今天对我所作的以福报答你。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若遇见仇敌，岂肯放他平安无事地去呢？愿耶和华因你今日向我所行的，以善报你。
verses.textEnNiv: When a man finds his enemy, does he let him get away unharmed? May the Lord reward you well for the way you treated me today.
verses.textEnEsv: For if a man finds his enemy, will he let him go away safe? So may the Lord reward you with good for what you have done to me this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if a man finds his enemy, will he let him get away safely? Therefore may the Lord reward you with good for what you have done to me this day.
verses.textEnNlt: Who else would let his enemy get away when he had him in his power? May the Lord reward you well for the kindness you have shown me today.
verses.textEnNasb: Though if a man finds his enemy, will he let him go away unharmed? May the Lord therefore reward you with good in return for what you have done to me this day.
verses.textEn: When a man finds his enemy, does he let him get away unharmed? May the Lord reward you well for the way you treated me today.

verses.textZh: 现在我知道你必要作王，以色列的王国必在你手里坚立起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我知道你必要作王，以色列的王国必在你手里坚立起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也知道你必要作王，以色列的国必坚立在你手里。
verses.textEnNiv: I know that you will surely be king and that the kingdom of Israel will be established in your hands.
verses.textEnEsv: And now, behold, I know that you shall surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in your hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now I know indeed that you shall surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in your hand.
verses.textEnNlt: And now I realize that you are surely going to be king, and that the kingdom of Israel will flourish under your rule.
verses.textEnNasb: Now, behold, I know that you will certainly be king, and that the kingdom of Israel will be established in your hand.
verses.textEn: I know that you will surely be king and that the kingdom of Israel will be established in your hands.

verses.textZh: 现在你要指着耶和华向我起誓，不剪除我的后裔，也不从我父家消灭我的名。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你要指着耶和华向我起誓，不剪除我的后裔，也不从我父家消灭我的名。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你要指着耶和华向我起誓，不剪除我的后裔，在我父家不灭没我的名。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now swear to me by the Lord that you will not kill off my descendants or wipe out my name from my father’s family."
verses.textEnEsv: Swear to me therefore by the Lord that you will not cut off my offspring after me, and that you will not destroy my name out of my father’s house."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore swear now to me by the Lord that you will not cut off my descendants after me, and that you will not destroy my name from my father’s house."
verses.textEnNlt: Now swear to me by the Lord that when that happens you will not kill my family and destroy my line of descendants!"
verses.textEnNasb: So now swear to me by the Lord that you will not cut off my descendants after me, and that you will not eliminate my name from my father’s household."
verses.textEn: Now swear to me by the Lord that you will not kill off my descendants or wipe out my name from my father’s family."

verses.textZh: 于是大卫向扫罗起誓，扫罗就回自己的家去了，大卫和跟随他的人也上山寨去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫向扫罗起誓，扫罗就回自己的家去了，大卫和跟随他的人也上山寨去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是大卫向扫罗起誓，扫罗就回家去；大卫和跟随他的人上山寨去了。
verses.textEnNiv: So David gave his oath to Saul. Then Saul returned home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.
verses.textEnEsv: And David swore this to Saul. Then Saul went home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David swore to Saul. And Saul went home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.
verses.textEnNlt: So David promised this to Saul with an oath. Then Saul went home, but David and his men went back to their stronghold.
verses.textEnNasb: And David swore an oath to Saul. Then Saul went to his home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.
verses.textEn: So David gave his oath to Saul. Then Saul returned home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.

verses.textZh: 撒母耳死了，以色列众人都聚集起来，为他哀哭，把他埋葬在拉玛他自己的家里。大卫起身，下到巴兰的旷野去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳死了，以色列众人都聚集起来，为他哀哭，把他埋葬在拉玛他自己的家里。大卫起身，下到巴兰的旷野去。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳死了，以色列众人聚集，为他哀哭，将他葬在拉玛－他自己的坟墓 里。 大卫起身，下到巴兰的旷野。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Samuel died, and all Israel assembled and mourned for him; and they buried him at his home in Ramah. Then David moved down into the Desert of Paran.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Samuel died. And all Israel assembled and mourned for him, and they buried him in his house at Ramah. Then David rose and went down to the wilderness of Paran.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Samuel died; and the Israelites gathered together and lamented for him, and buried him at his home in Ramah. And David arose and went down to the Wilderness of Paran.
verses.textEnNlt: Now Samuel died, and all Israel gathered for his funeral. They buried him at his house in Ramah. Then David moved down to the wilderness of Maon.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Samuel died; and all Israel assembled and mourned for him, and they buried him at his house in Ramah. And David set out and went down to the wilderness of Paran.
verses.textEn: Now Samuel died, and all Israel assembled and mourned for him; and they buried him at his home in Ramah. Then David moved down into the Desert of Paran.

verses.textZh: 在玛云有一个人，他的产业在迦密。他是一个很富有的人，有绵羊三千只，山羊一千只，那时他正在迦密剪羊毛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在玛云有一个人，他的产业在迦密。他是一个很富有的人，有绵羊三千只，山羊一千只，那时他正在迦密剪羊毛。
verses.textZhCuv: 在玛云有一个人，他的产业在迦密，是一个大富户，有三千绵羊，一千山羊；他正在迦密剪羊毛。
verses.textEnNiv: A certain man in Maon, who had property there at Carmel, was very wealthy. He had a thousand goats and three thousand sheep, which he was shearing in Carmel.
verses.textEnEsv: And there was a man in Maon whose business was in Carmel. The man was very rich; he had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats. He was shearing his sheep in Carmel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therewas a man in Maon whose business was in Carmel, and the man was very rich. He had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats. And he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.
verses.textEnNlt: There was a wealthy man from Maon who owned property near the town of Carmel. He had 3,000 sheep and 1,000 goats, and it was sheep-shearing time.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was a man in Maon whose business was in Carmel; and the man was very rich, and he had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats. And it came about while he was shearing his sheep in Carmel
verses.textEn: A certain man in Maon, who had property there at Carmel, was very wealthy. He had a thousand goats and three thousand sheep, which he was shearing in Carmel.

verses.textZh: 那人名叫拿八，他的妻子名叫亚比该。这女人既聪明，又美丽。但那男人为人粗暴，又行事凶恶。他是个迦勒族的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人名叫拿八，他的妻子名叫亚比该。这女人既聪明，又美丽。但那男人为人粗暴，又行事凶恶。他是个迦勒族的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人名叫拿八，是迦勒族的人；他的妻名叫亚比该，是聪明俊美的妇人。拿八为人刚愎凶恶。
verses.textEnNiv: His name was Nabal and his wife’s name was Abigail. She was an intelligent and beautiful woman, but her husband was surly and mean in his dealings—he was a Calebite.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the name of the man was Nabal, and the name of his wife Abigail. The woman was discerning and beautiful, but the man was harsh and badly behaved; he was a Calebite.
verses.textEnNkjv: The name of the man was Nabal, and the name of his wife Abigail. And shewas a woman of good understanding and beautiful appearance; but the man was harsh and evil in his doings. He wasofthehouseof Caleb.
verses.textEnNlt: This man’s name was Nabal, and his wife, Abigail, was a sensible and beautiful woman. But Nabal, a descendant of Caleb, was crude and mean in all his dealings.
verses.textEnNasb: (now the man’s name was Nabal, and his wife’s name was Abigail. And the woman was intelligent and beautiful in appearance, but the man was harsh and evil in his dealings, and he was a Calebite),
verses.textEn: His name was Nabal and his wife’s name was Abigail. She was an intelligent and beautiful woman, but her husband was surly and mean in his dealings—he was a Calebite.

verses.textZh: 大卫在旷野听说拿八正在剪羊毛，
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫在旷野听说拿八正在剪羊毛，
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫在旷野听见说拿八剪羊毛，
verses.textEnNiv: While David was in the wilderness, he heard that Nabal was shearing sheep.
verses.textEnEsv: David heard in the wilderness that Nabal was shearing his sheep.
verses.textEnNkjv: When David heard in the wilderness that Nabal was shearing his sheep,
verses.textEnNlt: When David heard that Nabal was shearing his sheep,
verses.textEnNasb: that David heard in the wilderness that Nabal was shearing his sheep.
verses.textEn: While David was in the wilderness, he heard that Nabal was shearing sheep.

verses.textZh: 就差派十个仆人，对他们说："你们上迦密去见拿八，以我的名义向他问安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就差派十个仆人，对他们说："你们上迦密去见拿八，以我的名义向他问安。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫就打发十个仆人，吩咐他们说：「你们上迦密去见拿八，提我的名问他安。
verses.textEnNiv: So he sent ten young men and said to them, "Go up to Nabal at Carmel and greet him in my name.
verses.textEnEsv: So David sent ten young men. And David said to the young men, "Go up to Carmel, and go to Nabal and greet him in my name.
verses.textEnNkjv: David sent ten young men; and David said to the young men, "Go up to Carmel, go to Nabal, and greet him in my name.
verses.textEnNlt: he sent ten of his young men to Carmel with this message for Nabal:
verses.textEnNasb: So David sent ten young men; and David said to the young men, "Go up to Carmel and visit Nabal, and greet him in my name;
verses.textEn: So he sent ten young men and said to them, "Go up to Nabal at Carmel and greet him in my name.

verses.textZh: 你们要这样说：‘愿你长寿！愿你平安！愿你的家平安！愿你所有的一切都平安！
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要这样说：‘愿你长寿！愿你平安！愿你的家平安！愿你所有的一切都平安！
verses.textZhCuv: 要对那富户如此说：『愿你平安，愿你家平安，愿你一切所有的都平安。
verses.textEnNiv: Say to him: ‘Long life to you! Good health to you and your household! And good health to all that is yours!
verses.textEnEsv: And thus you shall greet him: ‘Peace be to you, and peace be to your house, and peace be to all that you have.
verses.textEnNkjv: And thus you shall say to him who lives inprosperity: ‘Peace be to you, peace to your house, and peace to all that you have!
verses.textEnNlt: "Peace and prosperity to you, your family, and everything you own!
verses.textEnNasb: and this is what you shall say: ‘ Have a long life, peace to you, and peace to your house, and peace to all that you have!
verses.textEn: Say to him: ‘Long life to you! Good health to you and your household! And good health to all that is yours!

verses.textZh: 现在我听说有人为你剪羊毛。你的牧人与我们在一起的时候，我们都没有侮辱他们；他们在迦密的日子，也从没有遗失过甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我听说有人为你剪羊毛。你的牧人与我们在一起的时候，我们都没有侮辱他们；他们在迦密的日子，也从没有遗失过甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我听说有人为你剪羊毛，你的牧人在迦密的时候和我们在一处，我们没有欺负他们，他们也未曾失落什么。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Now I hear that it is sheep-shearing time. When your shepherds were with us, we did not mistreat them, and the whole time they were at Carmel nothing of theirs was missing.
verses.textEnEsv: I hear that you have shearers. Now your shepherds have been with us, and we did them no harm, and they missed nothing all the time they were in Carmel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I have heard that you have shearers. Your shepherds were with us, and we did not hurt them, nor was there anything missing from them all the while they were in Carmel.
verses.textEnNlt: I am told that it is sheep-shearing time. While your shepherds stayed among us near Carmel, we never harmed them, and nothing was ever stolen from them.
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, I have heard that you have shearers. Now, your shepherds have been with us; we have not harmed them, nor has anything of theirs gone missing all the days they were in Carmel.
verses.textEn: " ‘Now I hear that it is sheep-shearing time. When your shepherds were with us, we did not mistreat them, and the whole time they were at Carmel nothing of theirs was missing.

verses.textZh: 你可以问问你的仆人，他们必会告诉你。愿我派来的这些仆人在你眼前蒙恩，因为我们是在好日子来的，请你把手中所有的，随便赏赐一点给你的仆人和你的儿子大卫。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你可以问问你的仆人，他们必会告诉你。愿我派来的这些仆人在你眼前蒙恩，因为我们是在好日子来的，请你把手中所有的，随便赏赐一点给你的仆人和你的儿子大卫。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 可以问你的仆人，他们必告诉你。所以愿我的仆人在你眼前蒙恩，因为是在好日子来的。求你随手取点赐与仆人和你儿子大卫。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Ask your own servants and they will tell you. Therefore be favorable toward my men, since we come at a festive time. Please give your servants and your son David whatever you can find for them.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Ask your young men, and they will tell you. Therefore let my young men find favor in your eyes, for we come on a feast day. Please give whatever you have at hand to your servants and to your son David.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Ask your young men, and they will tell you. Therefore let my young men find favor in your eyes, for we come on a feast day. Please give whatever comes to your hand to your servants and to your son David.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Ask your own men, and they will tell you this is true. So would you be kind to us, since we have come at a time of celebration? Please share any provisions you might have on hand with us and with your friend David."
verses.textEnNasb: Ask your young men and they will tell you. Therefore let my young men find favor in your eyes, for we have come on a festive day. Please give whatever you find at hand to your servants and to your son David.’ "
verses.textEn: Ask your own servants and they will tell you. Therefore be favorable toward my men, since we come at a festive time. Please give your servants and your son David whatever you can find for them.’ "

verses.textZh: 大卫的仆人到了，就以大卫的名义，把这些话都对拿八说了，然后等候答复。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的仆人到了，就以大卫的名义，把这些话都对拿八说了，然后等候答复。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫的仆人到了，将这话提大卫的名都告诉了拿八，就住了口。
verses.textEnNiv: When David’s men arrived, they gave Nabal this message in David’s name. Then they waited.
verses.textEnEsv: When David’s young men came, they said all this to Nabal in the name of David, and then they waited.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when David’s young men came, they spoke to Nabal according to all these words in the name of David, and waited.
verses.textEnNlt: David’s young men gave this message to Nabal in David’s name, and they waited for a reply.
verses.textEnNasb: When David’s young men came, they spoke to Nabal in accordance with all these words in David’s name; then they waited.
verses.textEn: When David’s men arrived, they gave Nabal this message in David’s name. Then they waited.

verses.textZh: 拿八回答大卫的仆人说："大卫是谁？耶西的儿子是谁？现在离开主人逃走的仆人太多了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿八回答大卫的仆人说："大卫是谁？耶西的儿子是谁？现在离开主人逃走的仆人太多了。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿八回答大卫的仆人说：「大卫是谁？耶西的儿子是谁？近来悖逆主人奔逃的仆人甚多，
verses.textEnNiv: Nabal answered David’s servants, "Who is this David? Who is this son of Jesse? Many servants are breaking away from their masters these days.
verses.textEnEsv: And Nabal answered David’s servants, "Who is David? Who is the son of Jesse? There are many servants these days who are breaking away from their masters.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Nabal answered David’s servants, and said, "Who is David, and who is the son of Jesse? There are many servants nowadays who break away each one from his master.
verses.textEnNlt: "Who is this fellow David?" Nabal sneered to the young men. "Who does this son of Jesse think he is? There are lots of servants these days who run away from their masters.
verses.textEnNasb: But Nabal answered David’s servants and said, "Who is David? And who is the son of Jesse? There are many servants today who are each breaking away from his master.
verses.textEn: Nabal answered David’s servants, "Who is this David? Who is this son of Jesse? Many servants are breaking away from their masters these days.

verses.textZh: 我怎能把我的饼、我的水，和我为剪羊毛的人宰杀的肉，给那些我不知道从哪里来的人呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我怎能把我的饼、我的水，和我为剪羊毛的人宰杀的肉，给那些我不知道从哪里来的人呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我岂可将饮食和为我剪羊毛人所宰的肉给我不知道从哪里来的人呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Why should I take my bread and water, and the meat I have slaughtered for my shearers, and give it to men coming from who knows where?"
verses.textEnEsv: Shall I take my bread and my water and my meat that I have killed for my shearers and give it to men who come from I do not know where?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Shall I then take my bread and my water and my meat that I have killed for my shearers, and give it to men when I do not know where they are from?"
verses.textEnNlt: Should I take my bread and my water and my meat that I’ve slaughtered for my shearers and give it to a band of outlaws who come from who knows where?"
verses.textEnNasb: Shall I then take my bread and my water and my meat that I have slaughtered for my shearers, and give it to men whose origin I do not know?"
verses.textEn: Why should I take my bread and water, and the meat I have slaughtered for my shearers, and give it to men coming from who knows where?"

verses.textZh: 于是大卫的仆人转回原路，回去了。他们到了以后，就把这一切话都告诉大卫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫的仆人转回原路，回去了。他们到了以后，就把这一切话都告诉大卫。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫的仆人就转身从原路回去，照这话告诉大卫。
verses.textEnNiv: David’s men turned around and went back. When they arrived, they reported every word.
verses.textEnEsv: So David’s young men turned away and came back and told him all this.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David’s young men turned on their heels and went back; and they came and told him all these words.
verses.textEnNlt: So David’s young men returned and told him what Nabal had said.
verses.textEnNasb: So David’s young men made their way back and returned; and they came and informed him in accordance with all these words.
verses.textEn: David’s men turned around and went back. When they arrived, they reported every word.

verses.textZh: 大卫对跟随他的人说："你们各人都佩上刀。"他们各人就佩上自己的刀，大卫也佩上自己的刀。跟随大卫上去的约有四百人，有二百人留下来看守器具。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对跟随他的人说："你们各人都佩上刀。"他们各人就佩上自己的刀，大卫也佩上自己的刀。跟随大卫上去的约有四百人，有二百人留下来看守器具。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫向跟随他的人说：「你们各人都要带上刀！」众人就都带上刀，大卫也带上刀。跟随大卫上去的约有四百人，留下二百人看守器具。
verses.textEnNiv: David said to his men, "Each of you strap on your sword!" So they did, and David strapped his on as well. About four hundred men went up with David, while two hundred stayed with the supplies.
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to his men, "Every man strap on his sword!" And every man of them strapped on his sword. David also strapped on his sword. And about four hundred men went up after David, while two hundred remained with the baggage.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David said to his men, "Every man gird on his sword." So every man girded on his sword, and David also girded on his sword. And about four hundred men went with David, and two hundred stayed with the supplies.
verses.textEnNlt: "Get your swords!" was David’s reply as he strapped on his own. Then 400 men started off with David, and 200 remained behind to guard their equipment.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to his men, "Each of you strap on his sword." So each man strapped on his sword. And David also strapped on his sword, and about four hundred men went up behind David, while two hundred stayed with the baggage.
verses.textEn: David said to his men, "Each of you strap on your sword!" So they did, and David strapped his on as well. About four hundred men went up with David, while two hundred stayed with the supplies.

verses.textZh: 拿八的一个仆人告诉拿八的妻子亚比该说："大卫从旷野派遣使者来向我们的主人问候，主人却辱骂了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿八的一个仆人告诉拿八的妻子亚比该说："大卫从旷野派遣使者来向我们的主人问候，主人却辱骂了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 有拿八的一个仆人告诉拿八的妻亚比该说：「大卫从旷野打发使者来问我主人的安，主人却辱骂他们。
verses.textEnNiv: One of the servants told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, "David sent messengers from the wilderness to give our master his greetings, but he hurled insults at them.
verses.textEnEsv: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, "Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to greet our master, and he railed at them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, saying, "Look, David sent messengers from the wilderness to greet our master; and he reviled them.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, one of Nabal’s servants went to Abigail and told her, "David sent messengers from the wilderness to greet our master, but he screamed insults at them.
verses.textEnNasb: Now one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, saying, "Behold, David sent messengers from the wilderness to greet our master, and he spoke to them in anger.
verses.textEn: One of the servants told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, "David sent messengers from the wilderness to give our master his greetings, but he hurled insults at them.

verses.textZh: 但是，那些人对我们很好。我们在田野与他们往来的时候，他们都没有侮辱我们，我们也从没有遗失过甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，那些人对我们很好。我们在田野与他们往来的时候，他们都没有侮辱我们，我们也从没有遗失过甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 但是那些人待我们甚好；我们在田野与他们来往的时候，没有受他们的欺负，也未曾失落什么。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet these men were very good to us. They did not mistreat us, and the whole time we were out in the fields near them nothing was missing.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet the men were very good to us, and we suffered no harm, and we did not miss anything when we were in the fields, as long as we went with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the men were very good to us, and we were not hurt, nor did we miss anything as long as we accompanied them, when we were in the fields.
verses.textEnNlt: These men have been very good to us, and we never suffered any harm from them. Nothing was stolen from us the whole time they were with us.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet the men were very good to us, and we were not harmed, nor did anything go missing as long as we went with them, while we were in the fields.
verses.textEn: Yet these men were very good to us. They did not mistreat us, and the whole time we were out in the fields near them nothing was missing.

verses.textZh: 我们与他们在一起牧羊的日子，他们日夜都作保护我们的墙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们与他们在一起牧羊的日子，他们日夜都作保护我们的墙。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们在他们那里牧羊的时候，他们昼夜作我们的保障。
verses.textEnNiv: Night and day they were a wall around us the whole time we were herding our sheep near them.
verses.textEnEsv: They were a wall to us both by night and by day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.
verses.textEnNkjv: They were a wall to us both by night and day, all the time we were with them keeping the sheep.
verses.textEnNlt: In fact, day and night they were like a wall of protection to us and the sheep.
verses.textEnNasb: They were a wall to us both by night and by day, all the time we were with them tending the sheep.
verses.textEn: Night and day they were a wall around us the whole time we were herding our sheep near them.

verses.textZh: 现在，你要想一想，看看你该怎么办，因为灾祸必定临到我们的主人和他的全家。他是一个性情凶恶的人，没有人敢对他说话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，你要想一想，看看你该怎么办，因为灾祸必定临到我们的主人和他的全家。他是一个性情凶恶的人，没有人敢对他说话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你当筹划，看怎样行才好；不然，祸患定要临到我主人和他全家。他性情凶暴，无人敢与他说话。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now think it over and see what you can do, because disaster is hanging over our master and his whole household. He is such a wicked man that no one can talk to him."
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore know this and consider what you should do, for harm is determined against our master and against all his house, and he is such a worthless man that one cannot speak to him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, know and consider what you will do, for harm is determined against our master and against all his household. For he issuch a scoundrel that one cannot speak to him."
verses.textEnNlt: You need to know this and figure out what to do, for there is going to be trouble for our master and his whole family. He’s so ill-tempered that no one can even talk to him!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, be aware and consider what you should do, because harm is plotted against our master and against all his household; and he is such a worthless man that no one can speak to him."
verses.textEn: Now think it over and see what you can do, because disaster is hanging over our master and his whole household. He is such a wicked man that no one can talk to him."

verses.textZh: 亚比该急忙拿了两百个饼、两皮袋酒、五只预备好了的羊、十七公斤烘好了的穗子、一百个葡萄饼、两百个无花果饼，都驮在驴背上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比该急忙拿了两百个饼、两皮袋酒、五只预备好了的羊、十七公斤烘好了的穗子、一百个葡萄饼、两百个无花果饼，都驮在驴背上，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比该急忙将二百饼，两皮袋酒，五只收拾好了的羊，五细亚烘好了的穗子，一百葡萄饼，二百无花果饼，都驮在驴上，
verses.textEnNiv: Abigail acted quickly. She took two hundred loaves of bread, two skins of wine, five dressed sheep, five seahs of roasted grain, a hundred cakes of raisins and two hundred cakes of pressed figs, and loaded them on donkeys.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Abigail made haste and took two hundred loaves and two skins of wine and five sheep already prepared and five seahs of parched grain and a hundred clusters of raisins and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on donkeys.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abigail made haste and took two hundred loaves of bread, two skins of wine, five sheep already dressed, five seahs of roasted grain, one hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and loaded them on donkeys.
verses.textEnNlt: Abigail wasted no time. She quickly gathered 200 loaves of bread, two wineskins full of wine, five sheep that had been slaughtered, nearly a bushel of roasted grain, 100 clusters of raisins, and 200 fig cakes. She packed them on donkeys
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abigail hurried and took two hundred loaves of bread and two jugs of wine, and five sheep already prepared and five measures of roasted grain, and a hundred cakes of raisins and two hundred cakes of figs, and she loaded them on donkeys.
verses.textEn: Abigail acted quickly. She took two hundred loaves of bread, two skins of wine, five dressed sheep, five seahs of roasted grain, a hundred cakes of raisins and two hundred cakes of pressed figs, and loaded them on donkeys.

verses.textZh: 然后对她的仆人说："你们先去，我随着你们来。"这事她却没有告诉她的丈夫拿八。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后对她的仆人说："你们先去，我随着你们来。"这事她却没有告诉她的丈夫拿八。
verses.textZhCuv: 对仆人说：「你们前头走，我随着你们去。」这事她却没有告诉丈夫拿八。
verses.textEnNiv: Then she told her servants, "Go on ahead; I’ll follow you." But she did not tell her husband Nabal.
verses.textEnEsv: And she said to her young men, "Go on before me; behold, I come after you." But she did not tell her husband Nabal.
verses.textEnNkjv: And she said to her servants, "Go on before me; see, I am coming after you." But she did not tell her husband Nabal.
verses.textEnNlt: and said to her servants, "Go on ahead. I will follow you shortly." But she didn’t tell her husband Nabal what she was doing.
verses.textEnNasb: Then she said to her young men, "Go on ahead of me; behold, I am coming after you." But she did not tell her husband Nabal.
verses.textEn: Then she told her servants, "Go on ahead; I’ll follow you." But she did not tell her husband Nabal.

verses.textZh: 亚比该骑着驴，正从山坡下来，忽见大卫和跟随他的人也正从对面迎着她走下来，亚比该就与他相遇了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比该骑着驴，正从山坡下来，忽见大卫和跟随他的人也正从对面迎着她走下来，亚比该就与他相遇了。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比该骑着驴，正下山坡，见大卫和跟随他的人从对面下来，亚比该就迎接他们。
verses.textEnNiv: As she came riding her donkey into a mountain ravine, there were David and his men descending toward her, and she met them.
verses.textEnEsv: And as she rode on the donkey and came down under cover of the mountain, behold, David and his men came down toward her, and she met them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, as she rode on the donkey, that she went down under cover of the hill; and there were David and his men, coming down toward her, and she met them.
verses.textEnNlt: As she was riding her donkey into a mountain ravine, she saw David and his men coming toward her.
verses.textEnNasb: And it happened as she was riding on her donkey and coming down by the hidden part of the mountain, that behold, David and his men were coming down toward her; so she met them.
verses.textEn: As she came riding her donkey into a mountain ravine, there were David and his men descending toward her, and she met them.

verses.textZh: 大卫曾经说过："我在旷野看守这人一切所有的，使他一切所有的一样也没有失落，实在是白费心机了。他竟然对我以恶报善。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫曾经说过："我在旷野看守这人一切所有的，使他一切所有的一样也没有失落，实在是白费心机了。他竟然对我以恶报善。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫曾说：「我在旷野为那人看守所有的，以致他一样不失落，实在是徒然了！他向我以恶报善。
verses.textEnNiv: David had just said, "It’s been useless—all my watching over this fellow’s property in the wilderness so that nothing of his was missing. He has paid me back evil for good.
verses.textEnEsv: Now David had said, "Surely in vain have I guarded all that this fellow has in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that belonged to him, and he has returned me evil for good.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now David had said, "Surely in vain I have protected all that this fellow has in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that belongs to him. And he has repaid me evil for good.
verses.textEnNlt: David had just been saying, "A lot of good it did to help this fellow. We protected his flocks in the wilderness, and nothing he owned was lost or stolen. But he has repaid me evil for good.
verses.textEnNasb: Now David had said, "It is certainly for nothing that I have guarded everything that this man has in the wilderness, so that nothing has gone missing of all that belonged to him! For he has returned me evil for good.
verses.textEn: David had just said, "It’s been useless—all my watching over this fellow’s property in the wilderness so that nothing of his was missing. He has paid me back evil for good.

verses.textZh: 如果我让这人一切所有的，就是一个男丁，留到明天早晨，神怎样惩罚大卫的仇敌，愿他也怎样加倍惩罚我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我让这人一切所有的，就是一个男丁，留到明天早晨，神怎样惩罚大卫的仇敌，愿他也怎样加倍惩罚我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 凡属拿八的男丁，我若留一个到明日早晨，愿神重重降罚与我！」
verses.textEnNiv: May God deal with David, be it ever so severely, if by morning I leave alive one male of all who belong to him!"
verses.textEnEsv: God do so to the enemies of David and more also, if by morning I leave so much as one male of all who belong to him."
verses.textEnNkjv: May God do so, and more also, to the enemies of David, if I leave one male of all who belong to him by morning light."
verses.textEnNlt: May God strike me and kill me if even one man of his household is still alive tomorrow morning!"
verses.textEnNasb: May God do so to the enemies of David, and more so, if by morning I leave alive as much as one male of any who belong to him."
verses.textEn: May God deal with David, be it ever so severely, if by morning I leave alive one male of all who belong to him!"

verses.textZh: 亚比该见了大卫，就急忙从驴背下来，俯伏在大卫面前，脸伏于地，向他叩拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比该见了大卫，就急忙从驴背下来，俯伏在大卫面前，脸伏于地，向他叩拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比该见大卫，便急忙下驴，在大卫面前脸伏于地叩拜，
verses.textEnNiv: When Abigail saw David, she quickly got off her donkey and bowed down before David with her face to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: When Abigail saw David, she hurried and got down from the donkey and fell before David on her face and bowed to the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Abigail saw David, she dismounted quickly from the donkey, fell on her face before David, and bowed down to the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: When Abigail saw David, she quickly got off her donkey and bowed low before him.
verses.textEnNasb: When Abigail saw David, she hurried and dismounted from her donkey, and fell on her face in front of David and bowed herself to the ground.
verses.textEn: When Abigail saw David, she quickly got off her donkey and bowed down before David with her face to the ground.

verses.textZh: 她又俯伏在大卫的脚前，说："我主啊，愿这罪孽归我。求你容婢女向你讲话，求你听婢女所说的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她又俯伏在大卫的脚前，说："我主啊，愿这罪孽归我。求你容婢女向你讲话，求你听婢女所说的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 俯伏在大卫的脚前，说：「我主啊，愿这罪归我！求你容婢女向你进言，更求你听婢女的话。
verses.textEnNiv: She fell at his feet and said: "Pardon your servant, my lord, and let me speak to you; hear what your servant has to say.
verses.textEnEsv: She fell at his feet and said, "On me alone, my lord, be the guilt. Please let your servant speak in your ears, and hear the words of your servant.
verses.textEnNkjv: So she fell at his feet and said: "On me, my lord, on me let this iniquity be! And please let your maidservant speak in your ears, and hear the words of your maidservant.
verses.textEnNlt: She fell at his feet and said, "I accept all blame in this matter, my lord. Please listen to what I have to say.
verses.textEnNasb: She fell at his feet and said, "On me alone, my lord, be the blame. And please let your slave speak to you, and listen to the words of your slave.
verses.textEn: She fell at his feet and said: "Pardon your servant, my lord, and let me speak to you; hear what your servant has to say.

verses.textZh: 请我主不要把这个性情凶恶的人拿八放在心上。因为他的名字怎样，他的为人也怎样。他名叫拿八，他也真是愚笨。我主派来的仆人，你的婢女并没有看见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 请我主不要把这个性情凶恶的人拿八放在心上。因为他的名字怎样，他的为人也怎样。他名叫拿八，他也真是愚笨。我主派来的仆人，你的婢女并没有看见。
verses.textZhCuv: 我主不要理这坏人拿八，他的性情与他的名相称；他名叫拿八 ，他为人果然愚顽。但我主所打发的仆人，婢女并没有看见。
verses.textEnNiv: Please pay no attention, my lord, to that wicked man Nabal. He is just like his name—his name means Fool, and folly goes with him. And as for me, your servant, I did not see the men my lord sent.
verses.textEnEsv: Let not my lord regard this worthless fellow, Nabal, for as his name is, so is he. Nabal is his name, and folly is with him. But I your servant did not see the young men of my lord, whom you sent.
verses.textEnNkjv: Please, let not my lord regard this scoundrel Nabal. For as his name is, so is he: Nabal is his name, and folly is with him! But I, your maidservant, did not see the young men of my lord whom you sent.
verses.textEnNlt: I know Nabal is a wicked and ill-tempered man; please don’t pay any attention to him. He is a fool, just as his name suggests. But I never even saw the young men you sent.
verses.textEnNasb: Please do not let my lord pay attention to this worthless man, Nabal, for as his name is, so is he. Nabal is his name, and stupidity is with him; but I your slave did not see the young men of my lord whom you sent.
verses.textEn: Please pay no attention, my lord, to that wicked man Nabal. He is just like his name—his name means Fool, and folly goes with him. And as for me, your servant, I did not see the men my lord sent.

verses.textZh: 我主啊，现在我指着永活的耶和华，又在你面前起誓，耶和华既然阻止了你流人的血，又阻止了你亲手报仇，愿你的仇敌和那些谋害我主的人，都像拿八一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我主啊，现在我指着永活的耶和华，又在你面前起誓，耶和华既然阻止了你流人的血，又阻止了你亲手报仇，愿你的仇敌和那些谋害我主的人，都像拿八一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我主啊，耶和华既然阻止你亲手报仇，取流血的罪，所以我指着永生的耶和华、又敢在你面前起誓说：『愿你的仇敌和谋害你的人都像拿八一样。』
verses.textEnNiv: And now, my lord, as surely as the Lord your God lives and as you live, since the Lord has kept you from bloodshed and from avenging yourself with your own hands, may your enemies and all who are intent on harming my lord be like Nabal.
verses.textEnEsv: Now then, my lord, as the Lord lives, and as your soul lives, because the Lord has restrained you from bloodguilt and from saving with your own hand, now then let your enemies and those who seek to do evil to my lord be as Nabal.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, my lord, as the Lord lives and as your soul lives, since the Lord has held you back from coming to bloodshed and from avenging yourself with your own hand, now then, let your enemies and those who seek harm for my lord be as Nabal.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now, my lord, as surely as the Lord lives and you yourself live, since the Lord has kept you from murdering and taking vengeance into your own hands, let all your enemies and those who try to harm you be as cursed as Nabal is.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now then, my lord, as the Lord lives, and as your soul lives, since the Lord has restrained you from shedding blood, and from avenging yourself by your own hand, now then, may your enemies and those who seek evil against my lord, be like Nabal.
verses.textEn: And now, my lord, as surely as the Lord your God lives and as you live, since the Lord has kept you from bloodshed and from avenging yourself with your own hands, may your enemies and all who are intent on harming my lord be like Nabal.

verses.textZh: 现在，请把你婢女给我主带来的这礼物，赐给跟随我主的仆人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，请把你婢女给我主带来的这礼物，赐给跟随我主的仆人。
verses.textZhCuv: 如今求你将婢女送来的礼物给跟随你的仆人。
verses.textEnNiv: And let this gift, which your servant has brought to my lord, be given to the men who follow you.
verses.textEnEsv: And now let this present that your servant has brought to my lord be given to the young men who follow my lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now this present which your maidservant has brought to my lord, let it be given to the young men who follow my lord.
verses.textEnNlt: And here is a present that I, your servant, have brought to you and your young men.
verses.textEnNasb: And now let this gift which your servant has brought to my lord be given to the young men who accompany my lord.
verses.textEn: And let this gift, which your servant has brought to my lord, be given to the men who follow you.

verses.textZh: 求你饶恕你婢女的过犯。耶和华必为我主建立一个坚固的家，因为我主为耶和华争战；在你一生的日子里，在你身上也找不到甚么过错。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你饶恕你婢女的过犯。耶和华必为我主建立一个坚固的家，因为我主为耶和华争战；在你一生的日子里，在你身上也找不到甚么过错。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你饶恕婢女的罪过。耶和华必为我主建立坚固的家，因我主为耶和华争战；并且在你平生的日子查不出有什么过来。
verses.textEnNiv: "Please forgive your servant’s presumption. The Lord your God will certainly make a lasting dynasty for my lord, because you fight the Lord ’s battles, and no wrongdoing will be found in you as long as you live.
verses.textEnEsv: Please forgive the trespass of your servant. For the Lord will certainly make my lord a sure house, because my lord is fighting the battles of the Lord , and evil shall not be found in you so long as you live.
verses.textEnNkjv: Please forgive the trespass of your maidservant. For the Lord will certainly make for my lord an enduring house, because my lord fights the battles of the Lord, and evil is not found in you throughout your days.
verses.textEnNlt: Please forgive me if I have offended you in any way. The Lord will surely reward you with a lasting dynasty, for you are fighting the Lord ’s battles. And you have not done wrong throughout your entire life.
verses.textEnNasb: Please forgive the offense of your slave; for the Lord will certainly make for my lord an enduring house, because my lord is fighting the battles of the Lord, and evil will not be found in you all your days.
verses.textEn: "Please forgive your servant’s presumption. The Lord your God will certainly make a lasting dynasty for my lord, because you fight the Lord ’s battles, and no wrongdoing will be found in you as long as you live.

verses.textZh: 虽然有人起来追赶你，寻索你的命，我主的性命必得保全在耶和华你的神生命的囊中。至于你仇敌的命，耶和华却要甩去，像从甩石机甩出去一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然有人起来追赶你，寻索你的命，我主的性命必得保全在耶和华你的神生命的囊中。至于你仇敌的命，耶和华却要甩去，像从甩石机甩出去一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 虽有人起来追逼你，寻索你的性命，你的性命却在耶和华－你的神那里蒙保护，如包裹宝器一样；你仇敌的性命，耶和华必抛去，如用机弦甩石一样。
