verses.textEnNiv: Even though someone is pursuing you to take your life, the life of my lord will be bound securely in the bundle of the living by the Lord your God, but the lives of your enemies he will hurl away as from the pocket of a sling.
verses.textEnEsv: If men rise up to pursue you and to seek your life, the life of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of the living in the care of the Lord your God. And the lives of your enemies he shall sling out as from the hollow of a sling.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet a man has risen to pursue you and seek your life, but the life of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of the living with the Lord your God; and the lives of your enemies He shall sling out, asfrom the pocket of a sling.
verses.textEnNlt: "Even when you are chased by those who seek to kill you, your life is safe in the care of the Lord your God, secure in his treasure pouch! But the lives of your enemies will disappear like stones shot from a sling!
verses.textEnNasb: Should anyone rise up to pursue you and to seek your life, then the life of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of the living with the Lord your God; but the lives of your enemies He will sling out as from the hollow of a sling.
verses.textEn: Even though someone is pursuing you to take your life, the life of my lord will be bound securely in the bundle of the living by the Lord your God, but the lives of your enemies he will hurl away as from the pocket of a sling.

verses.textZh: 将来耶和华照着他应许的一切善待了你，立了你作以色列的领袖的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 将来耶和华照着他应许的一切善待了你，立了你作以色列的领袖的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对亚比该说：「耶和华－以色列的神是应当称颂的，因为他今日使你来迎接我。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord has fulfilled for my lord every good thing he promised concerning him and has appointed him ruler over Israel,
verses.textEnEsv: And when the Lord has done to my lord according to all the good that he has spoken concerning you and has appointed you prince over Israel,
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall come to pass, when the Lord has done for my lord according to all the good that He has spoken concerning you, and has appointed you ruler over Israel,
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lord has done all he promised and has made you leader of Israel,
verses.textEnNasb: And when the Lord does for my lord in accordance with all the good that He has spoken concerning you, and appoints you ruler over Israel,
verses.textEn: When the Lord has fulfilled for my lord every good thing he promised concerning him and has appointed him ruler over Israel,

verses.textZh: 我主就不致因为无缘无故流人的血或亲自报仇而良心不安，心里有愧了。耶和华恩待了我主以后，求你记念你的婢女。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我主就不致因为无缘无故流人的血或亲自报仇而良心不安，心里有愧了。耶和华恩待了我主以后，求你记念你的婢女。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你和你的见识也当称赞；因为你今日拦阻我亲手报仇、流人的血。
verses.textEnNiv: my lord will not have on his conscience the staggering burden of needless bloodshed or of having avenged himself. And when the Lord your God has brought my lord success, remember your servant."
verses.textEnEsv: my lord shall have no cause of grief or pangs of conscience for having shed blood without cause or for my lord working salvation himself. And when the Lord has dealt well with my lord, then remember your servant."
verses.textEnNkjv: that this will be no grief to you, nor offense of heart to my lord, either that you have shed blood without cause, or that my lord has avenged himself. But when the Lord has dealt well with my lord, then remember your maidservant."
verses.textEnNlt: don’t let this be a blemish on your record. Then your conscience won’t have to bear the staggering burden of needless bloodshed and vengeance. And when the Lord has done these great things for you, please remember me, your servant!"
verses.textEnNasb: this will not become an obstacle to you, or a troubled heart to my lord, both by having shed blood without cause and by my lord’s having avenged himself. When the Lord deals well with my lord, then remember your slave."
verses.textEn: my lord will not have on his conscience the staggering burden of needless bloodshed or of having avenged himself. And when the Lord your God has brought my lord success, remember your servant."

verses.textZh: 大卫对亚比该说："耶和华以色列的神是应当称颂的！他今天差派你来迎接我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对亚比该说："耶和华以色列的神是应当称颂的！他今天差派你来迎接我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我指着阻止我加害于你的耶和华－以色列永生的神起誓，你若不速速地来迎接我，到明日早晨，凡属拿八的男丁必定不留一个。」
verses.textEnNiv: David said to Abigail, "Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, who has sent you today to meet me.
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to Abigail, "Blessed be the Lord , the God of Israel, who sent you this day to meet me!
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David said to Abigail: "Blessed is the Lord God of Israel, who sent you this day to meet me!
verses.textEnNlt: David replied to Abigail, "Praise the Lord , the God of Israel, who has sent you to meet me today!
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to Abigail, "Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, who sent you this day to meet me,
verses.textEn: David said to Abigail, "Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, who has sent you today to meet me.

verses.textZh: 你的智慧和你的为人也是应当称赞的，因为你今天阻止了我流人的血，又阻止了我亲手报仇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的智慧和你的为人也是应当称赞的，因为你今天阻止了我流人的血，又阻止了我亲手报仇。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫受了亚比该送来的礼物，就对她说：「我听了你的话，准了你的情面，你可以平平安安地回家吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: May you be blessed for your good judgment and for keeping me from bloodshed this day and from avenging myself with my own hands.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed be your discretion, and blessed be you, who have kept me this day from bloodguilt and from working salvation with my own hand!
verses.textEnNkjv: And blessed is your advice and blessed are you, because you have kept me this day from coming to bloodshed and from avenging myself with my own hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Thank God for your good sense! Bless you for keeping me from murder and from carrying out vengeance with my own hands.
verses.textEnNasb: and blessed be your discernment, and blessed be you, who have kept me this day from bloodshed and from avenging myself by my own hand.
verses.textEn: May you be blessed for your good judgment and for keeping me from bloodshed this day and from avenging myself with my own hands.

verses.textZh: 我指着那拦阻了我加害你的永活的耶和华以色列的神起誓，如果你不及时来迎见我，到明天早晨，拿八所有的男丁必不留一个。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我指着那拦阻了我加害你的永活的耶和华以色列的神起誓，如果你不及时来迎见我，到明天早晨，拿八所有的男丁必不留一个。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比该到拿八那里，见他在家里设摆筵席，如同王的筵席；拿八快乐大醉。亚比该无论大小事都没有告诉他，就等到次日早晨。
verses.textEnNiv: Otherwise, as surely as the Lord , the God of Israel, lives, who has kept me from harming you, if you had not come quickly to meet me, not one male belonging to Nabal would have been left alive by daybreak."
verses.textEnEsv: For as surely as the Lord , the God of Israel, lives, who has restrained me from hurting you, unless you had hurried and come to meet me, truly by morning there had not been left to Nabal so much as one male."
verses.textEnNkjv: For indeed, as the Lord God of Israel lives, who has kept me back from hurting you, unless you had hurried and come to meet me, surely by morning light no males would have been left to Nabal!"
verses.textEnNlt: For I swear by the Lord , the God of Israel, who has kept me from hurting you, that if you had not hurried out to meet me, not one of Nabal’s men would still be alive tomorrow morning."
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless, as the Lord God of Israel lives, who has restrained me from harming you, if you had not come quickly to meet me, there certainly would not have been left to Nabal until the morning light as much as one male."
verses.textEn: Otherwise, as surely as the Lord , the God of Israel, lives, who has kept me from harming you, if you had not come quickly to meet me, not one male belonging to Nabal would have been left alive by daybreak."

verses.textZh: 大卫从亚比该手中接受了她带来给他的东西，就对她说："你平平安安回家去吧！你看，我已经听了你的话，也答应了你的请求。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫从亚比该手中接受了她带来给他的东西，就对她说："你平平安安回家去吧！你看，我已经听了你的话，也答应了你的请求。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到了早晨，拿八醒了酒，他的妻将这些事都告诉他，他就魂不附体，身僵如石头一般。
verses.textEnNiv: Then David accepted from her hand what she had brought him and said, "Go home in peace. I have heard your words and granted your request."
verses.textEnEsv: Then David received from her hand what she had brought him. And he said to her, "Go up in peace to your house. See, I have obeyed your voice, and I have granted your petition."
verses.textEnNkjv: So David received from her hand what she had brought him, and said to her, "Go up in peace to your house. See, I have heeded your voice and respected your person."
verses.textEnNlt: Then David accepted her present and told her, "Return home in peace. I have heard what you said. We will not kill your husband."
verses.textEnNasb: So David accepted from her hand what she had brought him, and said to her, "Go up to your house in peace. See, I have listened to you and granted your request."
verses.textEn: Then David accepted from her hand what she had brought him and said, "Go home in peace. I have heard your words and granted your request."

verses.textZh: 亚比该到了拿八那里，他正在家中摆设筵席，好象帝王的筵席一样。拿八心里畅快，喝得烂醉如泥，所以无论大事小事亚比该都没有告诉他，直到第二天早晨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比该到了拿八那里，他正在家中摆设筵席，好象帝王的筵席一样。拿八心里畅快，喝得烂醉如泥，所以无论大事小事亚比该都没有告诉他，直到第二天早晨。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了十天，耶和华击打拿八，他就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: When Abigail went to Nabal, he was in the house holding a banquet like that of a king. He was in high spirits and very drunk. So she told him nothing at all until daybreak.
verses.textEnEsv: And Abigail came to Nabal, and behold, he was holding a feast in his house, like the feast of a king. And Nabal’s heart was merry within him, for he was very drunk. So she told him nothing at all until the morning light.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Abigail went to Nabal, and there he was, holding a feast in his house, like the feast of a king. And Nabal’s heart was merry within him, for he was very drunk; therefore she told him nothing, little or much, until morning light.
verses.textEnNlt: When Abigail arrived home, she found that Nabal was throwing a big party and was celebrating like a king. He was very drunk, so she didn’t tell him anything about her meeting with David until dawn the next day.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abigail came to Nabal, and behold, he was having a feast in his house, like the feast of a king. And Nabal’s heart was cheerful within him, for he was very drunk; so she did not tell him anything at all until the morning light.
verses.textEn: When Abigail went to Nabal, he was in the house holding a banquet like that of a king. He was in high spirits and very drunk. So she told him nothing at all until daybreak.

verses.textZh: 到了早晨，拿八酒醒了，他的妻子才把这些事告诉他，他就吓得魂不附体，立刻中风瘫痪了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了早晨，拿八酒醒了，他的妻子才把这些事告诉他，他就吓得魂不附体，立刻中风瘫痪了。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫听见拿八死了，就说：「应当称颂耶和华，因他伸了拿八羞辱我的冤，又阻止仆人行恶；也使拿八的恶归到拿八的头上。」于是大卫打发人去，与亚比该说，要娶她为妻。
verses.textEnNiv: Then in the morning, when Nabal was sober, his wife told him all these things, and his heart failed him and he became like a stone.
verses.textEnEsv: In the morning, when the wine had gone out of Nabal, his wife told him these things, and his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, in the morning, when the wine had gone from Nabal, and his wife had told him these things, that his heart died within him, and he became like a stone.
verses.textEnNlt: In the morning when Nabal was sober, his wife told him what had happened. As a result he had a stroke, and he lay paralyzed on his bed like a stone.
verses.textEnNasb: But in the morning, when the wine had gone out of Nabal, his wife told him these things, and his heart died within him so that he became like a stone.
verses.textEn: Then in the morning, when Nabal was sober, his wife told him all these things, and his heart failed him and he became like a stone.

verses.textZh: 大约过了十天，耶和华击打拿八，他就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大约过了十天，耶和华击打拿八，他就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫的仆人到了迦密见亚比该，对她说：「大卫打发我们来见你，想要娶你为妻。」
verses.textEnNiv: About ten days later, the Lord struck Nabal and he died.
verses.textEnEsv: And about ten days later the Lord struck Nabal, and he died.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it happened, after about ten days, that the Lord struck Nabal, and he died.
verses.textEnNlt: About ten days later, the Lord struck him, and he died.
verses.textEnNasb: About ten days later, the Lord struck Nabal and he died.
verses.textEn: About ten days later, the Lord struck Nabal and he died.

verses.textZh: 大卫听见拿八死了，就说："耶和华是应当称颂的，因为他为我伸了拿八羞辱我的冤，又阻止了仆人行恶，也使拿八的恶归到他自己的头上。"于是大卫派人去对亚比该说要娶她作他的妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫听见拿八死了，就说："耶和华是应当称颂的，因为他为我伸了拿八羞辱我的冤，又阻止了仆人行恶，也使拿八的恶归到他自己的头上。"于是大卫派人去对亚比该说要娶她作他的妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比该就起来，俯伏在地，说：「我情愿作婢女，洗我主仆人的脚。」
verses.textEnNiv: When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, "Praise be to the Lord , who has upheld my cause against Nabal for treating me with contempt. He has kept his servant from doing wrong and has brought Nabal’s wrongdoing down on his own head." Then David sent word to Abigail, asking her to become his wife.
verses.textEnEsv: When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, "Blessed be the Lord who has avenged the insult I received at the hand of Nabal, and has kept back his servant from wrongdoing. The Lord has returned the evil of Nabal on his own head." Then David sent and spoke to Abigail, to take her as his wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, "Blessed be the Lord, who has pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and has kept His servant from evil! For the Lord has returned the wickedness of Nabal on his own head." And David sent and proposed to Abigail, to take her as his wife.
verses.textEnNlt: When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, "Praise the Lord , who has avenged the insult I received from Nabal and has kept me from doing it myself. Nabal has received the punishment for his sin." Then David sent messengers to Abigail to ask her to become his wife.
verses.textEnNasb: When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, "Blessed be the Lord, who has pleaded the cause of the shame inflicted on me by the hand of Nabal, and has kept back His servant from evil. The Lord has also returned the evildoing of Nabal on his own head." Then David sent a proposal to Abigail, to take her as his wife.
verses.textEn: When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, "Praise be to the Lord , who has upheld my cause against Nabal for treating me with contempt. He has kept his servant from doing wrong and has brought Nabal’s wrongdoing down on his own head." Then David sent word to Abigail, asking her to become his wife.

verses.textZh: 大卫的仆人到了迦密去见亚比该，对她说："大卫差派我们到你这里来，要娶你作他的妻子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的仆人到了迦密去见亚比该，对她说："大卫差派我们到你这里来，要娶你作他的妻子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比该立刻起身，骑上驴，带着五个使女，跟从大卫的使者去了，就作了大卫的妻。
verses.textEnNiv: His servants went to Carmel and said to Abigail, "David has sent us to you to take you to become his wife."
verses.textEnEsv: When the servants of David came to Abigail at Carmel, they said to her, "David has sent us to you to take you to him as his wife."
verses.textEnNkjv: When the servants of David had come to Abigail at Carmel, they spoke to her saying, "David sent us to you, to ask you to become his wife."
verses.textEnNlt: When the messengers arrived at Carmel, they told Abigail, "David has sent us to take you back to marry him."
verses.textEnNasb: When the servants of David came to Abigail at Carmel, they spoke to her, saying, "David has sent us to you to take you to him as his wife."
verses.textEn: His servants went to Carmel and said to Abigail, "David has sent us to you to take you to become his wife."

verses.textZh: 亚比该就起来，面伏于地叩拜，说："婢女愿意作女仆，洗我主人的脚！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比该就起来，面伏于地叩拜，说："婢女愿意作女仆，洗我主人的脚！"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫先娶了耶斯列人亚希暖，她们二人都作了他的妻。
verses.textEnNiv: She bowed down with her face to the ground and said, "I am your servant and am ready to serve you and wash the feet of my lord’s servants."
verses.textEnEsv: And she rose and bowed with her face to the ground and said, "Behold, your handmaid is a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she arose, bowed her face to the earth, and said, "Here is your maidservant, a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord."
verses.textEnNlt: She bowed low to the ground and responded, "I, your servant, would be happy to marry David. I would even be willing to become a slave, washing the feet of his servants!"
verses.textEnNasb: And she got up and bowed with her face to the ground, and said, "Behold, your slave is a servant to wash the feet of my lord’s servants."
verses.textEn: She bowed down with her face to the ground and said, "I am your servant and am ready to serve you and wash the feet of my lord’s servants."

verses.textZh: 亚比该急忙起来，骑上驴，带着五个跟随她的女仆，跟从大卫的使者去了，就作了大卫的妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比该急忙起来，骑上驴，带着五个跟随她的女仆，跟从大卫的使者去了，就作了大卫的妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗已将他的女儿米甲，就是大卫的妻，给了迦琳人拉亿的儿子帕提为妻。
verses.textEnNiv: Abigail quickly got on a donkey and, attended by her five female servants, went with David’s messengers and became his wife.
verses.textEnEsv: And Abigail hurried and rose and mounted a donkey, and her five young women attended her. She followed the messengers of David and became his wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abigail rose in haste and rode on a donkey, attended by five of her maidens; and she followed the messengers of David, and became his wife.
verses.textEnNlt: Quickly getting ready, she took along five of her servant girls as attendants, mounted her donkey, and went with David’s messengers. And so she became his wife.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abigail got up quickly, and rode on a donkey, with her five female attendants who accompanied her; and she followed the messengers of David and became his wife.
verses.textEn: Abigail quickly got on a donkey and, attended by her five female servants, went with David’s messengers and became his wife.

verses.textZh: 大卫先娶了耶斯列人亚希暖，她们二人都作了他的妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫先娶了耶斯列人亚希暖，她们二人都作了他的妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫先娶了耶斯列人亚希暖，她们二人都作了他的妻子。
verses.textEnNiv: David had also married Ahinoam of Jezreel, and they both were his wives.
verses.textEnEsv: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel, and both of them became his wives.
verses.textEnNkjv: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel, and so both of them were his wives.
verses.textEnNlt: David also married Ahinoam from Jezreel, making both of them his wives.
verses.textEnNasb: David had also taken Ahinoam of Jezreel, and they both became his wives.
verses.textEn: David had also married Ahinoam of Jezreel, and they both were his wives.

verses.textZh: 扫罗已经把他的女儿米甲，就是大卫的妻子，赐给了迦琳人拉亿的儿子帕提作妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗已经把他的女儿米甲，就是大卫的妻子，赐给了迦琳人拉亿的儿子帕提作妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗已经把他的女儿米甲，就是大卫的妻子，赐给了迦琳人拉亿的儿子帕提作妻子。
verses.textEnNiv: But Saul had given his daughter Michal, David’s wife, to Paltiel son of Laish, who was from Gallim.
verses.textEnEsv: Saul had given Michal his daughter, David’s wife, to Palti the son of Laish, who was of Gallim.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Saul had given Michal his daughter, David’s wife, to Palti the son of Laish, who was from Gallim.
verses.textEnNlt: Saul, meanwhile, had given his daughter Michal, David’s wife, to a man from Gallim named Palti son of Laish.
verses.textEnNasb: But Saul had given his daughter Michal, David’s wife, to Palti the son of Laish, who was from Gallim.
verses.textEn: But Saul had given his daughter Michal, David’s wife, to Paltiel son of Laish, who was from Gallim.

verses.textZh: 西弗人到基比亚来见扫罗，说："大卫不是在旷野前面的哈基拉山中躲藏起来吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 西弗人到基比亚来见扫罗，说："大卫不是在旷野前面的哈基拉山中躲藏起来吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 西弗人到基比亚见扫罗，说：「大卫不是在旷野前的哈基拉山藏着吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: The Ziphites went to Saul at Gibeah and said, "Is not David hiding on the hill of Hakilah, which faces Jeshimon?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Ziphites came to Saul at Gibeah, saying, "Is not David hiding himself on the hill of Hachilah, which is on the east of Jeshimon?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Ziphites came to Saul at Gibeah, saying, "Is David not hiding in the hill of Hachilah, opposite Jeshimon?"
verses.textEnNlt: Now some men from Ziph came to Saul at Gibeah to tell him, "David is hiding on the hill of Hakilah, which overlooks Jeshimon."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Ziphites came to Saul at Gibeah, saying, "Is David not keeping himself hidden on the hill of Hachilah, which is opposite Jeshimon?"
verses.textEn: The Ziphites went to Saul at Gibeah and said, "Is not David hiding on the hill of Hakilah, which faces Jeshimon?"

verses.textZh: 扫罗就动身，下到西弗旷野去，跟随他的有三千以色列精兵，要在西弗的旷野寻索大卫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗就动身，下到西弗旷野去，跟随他的有三千以色列精兵，要在西弗的旷野寻索大卫。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗就起身，带领以色列人中挑选的三千精兵下到西弗的旷野，要在那里寻索大卫。
verses.textEnNiv: So Saul went down to the Desert of Ziph, with his three thousand select Israelite troops, to search there for David.
verses.textEnEsv: So Saul arose and went down to the wilderness of Ziph with three thousand chosen men of Israel to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul arose and went down to the Wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the Wilderness of Ziph.
verses.textEnNlt: So Saul took 3,000 of Israel’s elite troops and went to hunt him down in the wilderness of Ziph.
verses.textEnNasb: So Saul set out and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, taking with him three thousand chosen men of Israel, to search for David in the wilderness of Ziph.
verses.textEn: So Saul went down to the Desert of Ziph, with his three thousand select Israelite troops, to search there for David.

verses.textZh: 那时，扫罗在旷野前面的哈基拉山的路旁安营，大卫仍然住在旷野。大卫看见扫罗来到旷野追寻他，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，扫罗在旷野前面的哈基拉山的路旁安营，大卫仍然住在旷野。大卫看见扫罗来到旷野追寻他，
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗在旷野前的哈基拉山，在道路上安营。大卫住在旷野，听说扫罗到旷野来追寻他，
verses.textEnNiv: Saul made his camp beside the road on the hill of Hakilah facing Jeshimon, but David stayed in the wilderness. When he saw that Saul had followed him there,
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul encamped on the hill of Hachilah, which is beside the road on the east of Jeshimon. But David remained in the wilderness. When he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Saul encamped in the hill of Hachilah, which is opposite Jeshimon, by the road. But David stayed in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: Saul camped along the road beside the hill of Hakilah, near Jeshimon, where David was hiding. When David learned that Saul had come after him into the wilderness,
verses.textEnNasb: And Saul camped on the hill of Hachilah, which is opposite Jeshimon, beside the road, and David was staying in the wilderness. When he saw that Saul had come after him into the wilderness,
verses.textEn: Saul made his camp beside the road on the hill of Hakilah facing Jeshimon, but David stayed in the wilderness. When he saw that Saul had followed him there,

verses.textZh: 就派出探子，知道扫罗已经到了纳康。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就派出探子，知道扫罗已经到了纳康。
verses.textZhCuv: 就打发人去探听，便知道扫罗果然来到。
verses.textEnNiv: he sent out scouts and learned that Saul had definitely arrived.
verses.textEnEsv: David sent out spies and learned that Saul had indeed come.
verses.textEnNkjv: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul had indeed come.
verses.textEnNlt: he sent out spies to verify the report of Saul’s arrival.
verses.textEnNasb: David sent out spies, and he learned that Saul was definitely coming.
verses.textEn: he sent out scouts and learned that Saul had definitely arrived.

verses.textZh: 大卫起来，来到扫罗安营的地方，看见扫罗和他的元帅，尼珥的儿子押尼珥睡卧的地方。扫罗睡在军营的中央，众人都在他的周围安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫起来，来到扫罗安营的地方，看见扫罗和他的元帅，尼珥的儿子押尼珥睡卧的地方。扫罗睡在军营的中央，众人都在他的周围安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫起来，到扫罗安营的地方，看见扫罗和他的元帅尼珥的儿子押尼珥睡卧之处；扫罗睡在辎重营里，百姓安营在他周围。
verses.textEnNiv: Then David set out and went to the place where Saul had camped. He saw where Saul and Abner son of Ner, the commander of the army, had lain down. Saul was lying inside the camp, with the army encamped around him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David rose and came to the place where Saul had encamped. And David saw the place where Saul lay, with Abner the son of Ner, the commander of his army. Saul was lying within the encampment, while the army was encamped around him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David arose and came to the place where Saul had encamped. And David saw the place where Saul lay, and Abner the son of Ner, the commander of his army. Now Saul lay within the camp, with the people encamped all around him.
verses.textEnNlt: David slipped over to Saul’s camp one night to look around. Saul and Abner son of Ner, the commander of his army, were sleeping inside a ring formed by the slumbering warriors.
verses.textEnNasb: David then set out and came to the place where Saul had camped. And David saw the place where Saul lay, and Abner the son of Ner, the commander of his army; and Saul was lying in the circle of the camp, and the people were camped around him.
verses.textEn: Then David set out and went to the place where Saul had camped. He saw where Saul and Abner son of Ner, the commander of the army, had lain down. Saul was lying inside the camp, with the army encamped around him.

verses.textZh: 大卫问赫人亚希米勒和洗鲁雅的儿子约押的兄弟亚比筛，说："谁愿与我一起下到扫罗的营里去呢？"亚比筛回答："我愿与你一起下去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫问赫人亚希米勒和洗鲁雅的儿子约押的兄弟亚比筛，说："谁愿与我一起下到扫罗的营里去呢？"亚比筛回答："我愿与你一起下去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对赫人亚希米勒和洗鲁雅的儿子约押的兄弟亚比筛说：「谁同我下到扫罗营里去？」亚比筛说：「我同你下去。」
verses.textEnNiv: David then asked Ahimelek the Hittite and Abishai son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, "Who will go down into the camp with me to Saul?" "I’ll go with you," said Abishai.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Joab’s brother Abishai the son of Zeruiah, "Who will go down with me into the camp to Saul?" And Abishai said, "I will go down with you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David answered, and said to Ahimelech the Hittite and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, saying, "Who will go down with me to Saul in the camp?" And Abishai said, "I will go down with you."
verses.textEnNlt: "Who will volunteer to go in there with me?" David asked Ahimelech the Hittite and Abishai son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother. "I’ll go with you," Abishai replied.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to Ahimelech the Hittite and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, saying, "Who will go down with me to Saul in the camp?" And Abishai said, "I will go down with you."
verses.textEn: David then asked Ahimelek the Hittite and Abishai son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, "Who will go down into the camp with me to Saul?" "I’ll go with you," said Abishai.

verses.textZh: 于是大卫和亚比筛趁着夜里到了众军那里。扫罗正躺在军营的中央睡着了，他的矛插在头旁的地上；押尼珥和众军都躺在他的周围。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫和亚比筛趁着夜里到了众军那里。扫罗正躺在军营的中央睡着了，他的矛插在头旁的地上；押尼珥和众军都躺在他的周围。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是大卫和亚比筛夜间到了百姓那里，见扫罗睡在辎重营里；他的枪在头旁，插在地上。押尼珥和百姓睡在他周围。
verses.textEnNiv: So David and Abishai went to the army by night, and there was Saul, lying asleep inside the camp with his spear stuck in the ground near his head. Abner and the soldiers were lying around him.
verses.textEnEsv: So David and Abishai went to the army by night. And there lay Saul sleeping within the encampment, with his spear stuck in the ground at his head, and Abner and the army lay around him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David and Abishai came to the people by night; and there Saul lay sleeping within the camp, with his spear stuck in the ground by his head. And Abner and the people lay all around him.
verses.textEnNlt: So David and Abishai went right into Saul’s camp and found him asleep, with his spear stuck in the ground beside his head. Abner and the soldiers were lying asleep around him.
verses.textEnNasb: So David and Abishai came to the people by night, and behold, Saul lay sleeping inside the circle of the camp with his spear stuck in the ground at his head; and Abner and the people were lying around him.
verses.textEn: So David and Abishai went to the army by night, and there was Saul, lying asleep inside the camp with his spear stuck in the ground near his head. Abner and the soldiers were lying around him.

verses.textZh: 亚比筛对大卫说："今天神把你的仇敌交在你手里了。现在求你容我用矛把他刺透在地上，一刺就够，不必再刺。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比筛对大卫说："今天神把你的仇敌交在你手里了。现在求你容我用矛把他刺透在地上，一刺就够，不必再刺。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比筛对大卫说：「现在神将你的仇敌交在你手里，求你容我拿枪将他刺透在地，一刺就成，不用再刺。」
verses.textEnNiv: Abishai said to David, "Today God has delivered your enemy into your hands. Now let me pin him to the ground with one thrust of the spear; I won’t strike him twice."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Abishai said to David, "God has given your enemy into your hand this day. Now please let me pin him to the earth with one stroke of the spear, and I will not strike him twice."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abishai said to David, "God has delivered your enemy into your hand this day. Now therefore, please, let me strike him at once with the spear, right to the earth; and I will not havetostrike him a second time!"
verses.textEnNlt: "God has surely handed your enemy over to you this time!" Abishai whispered to David. "Let me pin him to the ground with one thrust of the spear; I won’t need to strike twice!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abishai said to David, "Today God has handed your enemy over to you; now then, please let me pin him with the spear to the ground with one thrust, and I will not do it to him a second time."
verses.textEn: Abishai said to David, "Today God has delivered your enemy into your hands. Now let me pin him to the ground with one thrust of the spear; I won’t strike him twice."

verses.textZh: 大卫却对亚比筛说："不可杀死他，因为有谁伸手伤害耶和华的受膏者而无罪呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫却对亚比筛说："不可杀死他，因为有谁伸手伤害耶和华的受膏者而无罪呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对亚比筛说：「不可害死他。有谁伸手害耶和华的受膏者而无罪呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: But David said to Abishai, "Don’t destroy him! Who can lay a hand on the Lord ’s anointed and be guiltless?
verses.textEnEsv: But David said to Abishai, "Do not destroy him, for who can put out his hand against the Lord ’s anointed and be guiltless?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But David said to Abishai, "Do not destroy him; for who can stretch out his hand against the Lord’s anointed, and be guiltless?"
verses.textEnNlt: "No!" David said. "Don’t kill him. For who can remain innocent after attacking the Lord ’s anointed one?
verses.textEnNasb: But David said to Abishai, "Do not kill him, for who can reach out with his hand against the Lord’s anointed and remain innocent?"
verses.textEn: But David said to Abishai, "Don’t destroy him! Who can lay a hand on the Lord ’s anointed and be guiltless?

verses.textZh: 大卫又说："我指着永活的耶和华起誓，他或被耶和华击打，或死期到了，或下到战场阵亡了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫又说："我指着永活的耶和华起誓，他或被耶和华击打，或死期到了，或下到战场阵亡了，
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫又说：「我指着永生的耶和华起誓，他或被耶和华击打，或是死期到了，或是出战阵亡；
verses.textEnNiv: As surely as the Lord lives," he said, "the Lord himself will strike him, or his time will come and he will die, or he will go into battle and perish.
verses.textEnEsv: And David said, "As the Lord lives, the Lord will strike him, or his day will come to die, or he will go down into battle and perish.
verses.textEnNkjv: David said furthermore, "As the Lord lives, the Lord shall strike him, or his day shall come to die, or he shall go out to battle and perish.
verses.textEnNlt: Surely the Lord will strike Saul down someday, or he will die of old age or in battle.
verses.textEnNasb: David also said, "As the Lord lives, the Lord certainly will strike him, or his day will come that he dies, or he will go down in battle and perish.
verses.textEn: As surely as the Lord lives," he said, "the Lord himself will strike him, or his time will come and he will die, or he will go into battle and perish.

verses.textZh: 我在耶和华面前，绝对不敢伸手伤害耶和华的受膏者。现在，你可以把扫罗头旁的矛和水袋拿来，我们就走吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在耶和华面前，绝对不敢伸手伤害耶和华的受膏者。现在，你可以把扫罗头旁的矛和水袋拿来，我们就走吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 我在耶和华面前，万不敢伸手害耶和华的受膏者。现在你可以将他头旁的枪和水瓶拿来，我们就走。」
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord forbid that I should lay a hand on the Lord ’s anointed. Now get the spear and water jug that are near his head, and let’s go."
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord forbid that I should put out my hand against the Lord ’s anointed. But take now the spear that is at his head and the jar of water, and let us go."
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord forbid that I should stretch out my hand against the Lord’s anointed. But please, take now the spear and the jug of water that are by his head, and let us go."
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord forbid that I should kill the one he has anointed! But take his spear and that jug of water beside his head, and then let’s get out of here!"
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord forbid that I would reach out with my hand against the Lord’s anointed! But now please take the spear that is at his head and the jug of water, and let’s go."
verses.textEn: But the Lord forbid that I should lay a hand on the Lord ’s anointed. Now get the spear and water jug that are near his head, and let’s go."

verses.textZh: 于是大卫从扫罗的头旁拿了矛和水袋，他们二人就走了。没有人看见，没有人知道，也没有人醒来。他们都睡着了，因为耶和华使他们沉睡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫从扫罗的头旁拿了矛和水袋，他们二人就走了。没有人看见，没有人知道，也没有人醒来。他们都睡着了，因为耶和华使他们沉睡。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫从扫罗的头旁拿了枪和水瓶，二人就走了，没有人看见，没有人知道，也没有人醒起，都睡着了，因为耶和华使他们沉沉地睡了。
verses.textEnNiv: So David took the spear and water jug near Saul’s head, and they left. No one saw or knew about it, nor did anyone wake up. They were all sleeping, because the Lord had put them into a deep sleep.
verses.textEnEsv: So David took the spear and the jar of water from Saul’s head, and they went away. No man saw it or knew it, nor did any awake, for they were all asleep, because a deep sleep from the Lord had fallen upon them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David took the spear and the jug of water by Saul’s head, and they got away; and no man saw or knew it or awoke. For they were all asleep, because a deep sleep from the Lord had fallen on them.
verses.textEnNlt: So David took the spear and jug of water that were near Saul’s head. Then he and Abishai got away without anyone seeing them or even waking up, because the Lord had put Saul’s men into a deep sleep.
verses.textEnNasb: So David took the spear and the jug of water that were at Saul’s head, and they left; and no one saw or knew about it, nor did anyone awaken, for they were all asleep, because a deep sleep from the Lord had fallen on them.
verses.textEn: So David took the spear and water jug near Saul’s head, and they left. No one saw or knew about it, nor did anyone wake up. They were all sleeping, because the Lord had put them into a deep sleep.

verses.textZh: 然后大卫过到另一边去，远远地站在山顶上，两者之间的距离很远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后大卫过到另一边去，远远地站在山顶上，两者之间的距离很远。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫过到那边去，远远地站在山顶上，与他们相离甚远。
verses.textEnNiv: Then David crossed over to the other side and stood on top of the hill some distance away; there was a wide space between them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David went over to the other side and stood far off on the top of the hill, with a great space between them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of a hill afar off, a great distance being between them.
verses.textEnNlt: David climbed the hill opposite the camp until he was at a safe distance.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David crossed over to the other side and stood on top of the mountain at a distance with a large area between them.
verses.textEn: Then David crossed over to the other side and stood on top of the hill some distance away; there was a wide space between them.

verses.textZh: 大卫呼叫众人和尼珥的儿子押尼珥说："押尼珥啊，你不答话吗？"押尼珥回答说："你是谁，竟敢呼叫王？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫呼叫众人和尼珥的儿子押尼珥说："押尼珥啊，你不答话吗？"押尼珥回答说："你是谁，竟敢呼叫王？"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫呼叫百姓和尼珥的儿子押尼珥说：「押尼珥啊，你为何不答应呢？」押尼珥说：「你是谁？竟敢呼叫王呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: He called out to the army and to Abner son of Ner, "Aren’t you going to answer me, Abner?" Abner replied, "Who are you who calls to the king?"
verses.textEnEsv: And David called to the army, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, "Will you not answer, Abner?" Then Abner answered, "Who are you who calls to the king?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And David called out to the people and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, "Do you not answer, Abner?" Then Abner answered and said, "Who are you, calling out to the king?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then he shouted down to the soldiers and to Abner son of Ner, "Wake up, Abner!" "Who is it?" Abner demanded.
verses.textEnNasb: And David called to the people and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, "Will you not answer, Abner?" Then Abner replied, "Who are you who calls to the king?"
verses.textEn: He called out to the army and to Abner son of Ner, "Aren’t you going to answer me, Abner?" Abner replied, "Who are you who calls to the king?"

verses.textZh: 大卫对押尼珥说："你不是一个男子汉吗？以色列人中有谁能与你相比呢？众民中有一个人来要杀害王你的主，你为甚么没有保护王你的主呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对押尼珥说："你不是一个男子汉吗？以色列人中有谁能与你相比呢？众民中有一个人来要杀害王你的主，你为甚么没有保护王你的主呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对押尼珥说：「你不是个勇士吗？以色列中谁能比你呢？民中有人进来要害死王－你的主，你为何没有保护王－你的主呢？
verses.textEnNiv: David said, "You’re a man, aren’t you? And who is like you in Israel? Why didn’t you guard your lord the king? Someone came to destroy your lord the king.
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to Abner, "Are you not a man? Who is like you in Israel? Why then have you not kept watch over your lord the king? For one of the people came in to destroy the king your lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David said to Abner, "Are you not a man? And who is like you in Israel? Why then have you not guarded your lord the king? For one of the people came in to destroy your lord the king.
verses.textEnNlt: "Well, Abner, you’re a great man, aren’t you?" David taunted. "Where in all Israel is there anyone as mighty? So why haven’t you guarded your master the king when someone came to kill him?
verses.textEnNasb: So David said to Abner, "Are you not a man? And who is like you in Israel? Why then have you not guarded your lord the king? For one of the people came to kill the king your lord!
verses.textEn: David said, "You’re a man, aren’t you? And who is like you in Israel? Why didn’t you guard your lord the king? Someone came to destroy your lord the king.

verses.textZh: 你所作的这事不好。我指着永活的耶和华起誓，你们都是该死的，因为你们没有保护你的主，就是耶和华的受膏者。现在你看看王头旁的矛和水袋在哪里？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你所作的这事不好。我指着永活的耶和华起誓，你们都是该死的，因为你们没有保护你的主，就是耶和华的受膏者。现在你看看王头旁的矛和水袋在哪里？"
verses.textZhCuv: 你这样是不好的！我指着永生的耶和华起誓，你们都是该死的；因为没有保护你们的主，就是耶和华的受膏者。现在你看看王头旁的枪和水瓶在哪里。」
verses.textEnNiv: What you have done is not good. As surely as the Lord lives, you and your men must die, because you did not guard your master, the Lord ’s anointed. Look around you. Where are the king’s spear and water jug that were near his head?"
verses.textEnEsv: This thing that you have done is not good. As the Lord lives, you deserve to die, because you have not kept watch over your lord, the Lord ’s anointed. And now see where the king’s spear is and the jar of water that was at his head."
verses.textEnNkjv: This thing that you have done is not good. As the Lord lives, you deserve to die, because you have not guarded your master, the Lord’s anointed. And now see where the king’s spear is, and the jug of water that was by his head."
verses.textEnNlt: This isn’t good at all! I swear by the Lord that you and your men deserve to die, because you failed to protect your master, the Lord ’s anointed! Look around! Where are the king’s spear and the jug of water that were beside his head?"
verses.textEnNasb: This thing that you have done is not good. As the Lord lives, all of you undoubtedly must die, because you did not guard your lord, the Lord’s anointed. And now, see where the king’s spear is and the jug of water that was at his head!"
verses.textEn: What you have done is not good. As surely as the Lord lives, you and your men must die, because you did not guard your master, the Lord ’s anointed. Look around you. Where are the king’s spear and water jug that were near his head?"

verses.textZh: 扫罗认出是大卫的声音，就说："我儿大卫啊！这是你的声音吗？"大卫说："我主我王啊！是我的声音。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗认出是大卫的声音，就说："我儿大卫啊！这是你的声音吗？"大卫说："我主我王啊！是我的声音。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗听出是大卫的声音，就说：「我儿大卫，这是你的声音吗？」大卫说：「主－我的王啊，是我的声音」；
verses.textEnNiv: Saul recognized David’s voice and said, "Is that your voice, David my son?" David replied, "Yes it is, my lord the king."
verses.textEnEsv: Saul recognized David’s voice and said, "Is this your voice, my son David?" And David said, "It is my voice, my lord, O king."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul knew David’s voice, and said, "Is that your voice, my son David?" David said, "Itis my voice, my lord, O king."
verses.textEnNlt: Saul recognized David’s voice and called out, "Is that you, my son David?" And David replied, "Yes, my lord the king.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul recognized David’s voice and said, "Is this your voice, my son David?" And David said, "It is my voice, my lord the king."
verses.textEn: Saul recognized David’s voice and said, "Is that your voice, David my son?" David replied, "Yes it is, my lord the king."

verses.textZh: 又说："我主为甚么这样追赶仆人呢？我作了甚么？我手里犯了甚么过错？
verses.textZhCnvs: 又说："我主为甚么这样追赶仆人呢？我作了甚么？我手里犯了甚么过错？
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「我做了什么？我手里有什么恶事？我主竟追赶仆人呢？
verses.textEnNiv: And he added, "Why is my lord pursuing his servant? What have I done, and what wrong am I guilty of?
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Why does my lord pursue after his servant? For what have I done? What evil is on my hands?
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "Why does my lord thus pursue his servant? For what have I done, or what evil is in my hand?
verses.textEnNlt: Why are you chasing me? What have I done? What is my crime?
verses.textEnNasb: He also said, "Why then is my lord pursuing his servant? For what have I done? Or what evil is in my hand?
verses.textEn: And he added, "Why is my lord pursuing his servant? What have I done, and what wrong am I guilty of?

verses.textZh: 现在求我主我王听你仆人的话。如果是耶和华激动你攻击我，愿耶和华收纳祭物；如果是人激动你，愿他们在耶和华面前受咒诅，因为他们今天把我赶出来，不容我在耶和华的产业上有分，说：‘你去服事别的神吧！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在求我主我王听你仆人的话。如果是耶和华激动你攻击我，愿耶和华收纳祭物；如果是人激动你，愿他们在耶和华面前受咒诅，因为他们今天把我赶出来，不容我在耶和华的产业上有分，说：‘你去服事别的神吧！’
verses.textZhCuv: 求我主我王听仆人的话：若是耶和华激发你攻击我，愿耶和华收纳祭物；若是人激发你，愿他在耶和华面前受咒诅；因为他现今赶逐我，不容我在耶和华的产业上有分，说：『你去事奉别神吧！』
verses.textEnNiv: Now let my lord the king listen to his servant’s words. If the Lord has incited you against me, then may he accept an offering. If, however, people have done it, may they be cursed before the Lord ! They have driven me today from my share in the Lord ’s inheritance and have said, ‘Go, serve other gods.’
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore let my lord the king hear the words of his servant. If it is the Lord who has stirred you up against me, may he accept an offering, but if it is men, may they be cursed before the Lord , for they have driven me out this day that I should have no share in the heritage of the Lord , saying, ‘Go, serve other gods.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, please, let my lord the king hear the words of his servant: If the Lord has stirred you up against me, let Him accept an offering. But if itis the children of men, may they be cursed before the Lord, for they have driven me out this day from sharing in the inheritance of the Lord, saying, ‘Go, serve other gods.’
verses.textEnNlt: But now let my lord the king listen to his servant. If the Lord has stirred you up against me, then let him accept my offering. But if this is simply a human scheme, then may those involved be cursed by the Lord . For they have driven me from my home, so I can no longer live among the Lord ’s people, and they have said, ‘Go, worship pagan gods.’
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, please let my lord the king listen to the words of his servant. If the Lord has incited you against me, may He accept an offering; but if it is people, cursed are they before the Lord, because they have driven me out today so that I would have no share in the inheritance of the Lord, saying, ‘Go, serve other gods.’
verses.textEn: Now let my lord the king listen to his servant’s words. If the Lord has incited you against me, then may he accept an offering. If, however, people have done it, may they be cursed before the Lord ! They have driven me today from my share in the Lord ’s inheritance and have said, ‘Go, serve other gods.’

verses.textZh: 现在，求王不要让我的血流在远离耶和华的地上，因为以色列王出来寻索我的性命，就像人在山中猎取一只鹧鸪一样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，求王不要让我的血流在远离耶和华的地上，因为以色列王出来寻索我的性命，就像人在山中猎取一只鹧鸪一样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在求王不要使我的血流在离耶和华远的地方。以色列王出来是寻找一个虼蚤，如同人在山上猎取一个鹧鸪一般。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now do not let my blood fall to the ground far from the presence of the Lord . The king of Israel has come out to look for a flea—as one hunts a partridge in the mountains."
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore, let not my blood fall to the earth away from the presence of the Lord , for the king of Israel has come out to seek a single flea like one who hunts a partridge in the mountains."
verses.textEnNkjv: So now, do not let my blood fall to the earth before the face of the Lord. For the king of Israel has come out to seek a flea, as when one hunts a partridge in the mountains."
verses.textEnNlt: Must I die on foreign soil, far from the presence of the Lord ? Why has the king of Israel come out to search for a single flea? Why does he hunt me down like a partridge on the mountains?"
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, do not let my blood fall to the ground far from the presence of the Lord; for the king of Israel has come out to search for a single flea, just as one hunts a partridge in the mountains."
verses.textEn: Now do not let my blood fall to the ground far from the presence of the Lord . The king of Israel has come out to look for a flea—as one hunts a partridge in the mountains."

verses.textZh: 扫罗说："我有罪了，我儿大卫啊，你回来吧！因为今天你看我的命为宝贵，我必不再害你。看哪！我作了糊涂事了，并且错得很厉害。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗说："我有罪了，我儿大卫啊，你回来吧！因为今天你看我的命为宝贵，我必不再害你。看哪！我作了糊涂事了，并且错得很厉害。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗说：「我有罪了！我儿大卫，你可以回来，因你今日看我的性命为宝贵；我必不再加害于你。我是糊涂人，大大错了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Saul said, "I have sinned. Come back, David my son. Because you considered my life precious today, I will not try to harm you again. Surely I have acted like a fool and have been terribly wrong."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Saul said, "I have sinned. Return, my son David, for I will no more do you harm, because my life was precious in your eyes this day. Behold, I have acted foolishly, and have made a great mistake."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul said, "I have sinned. Return, my son David. For I will harm you no more, because my life was precious in your eyes this day. Indeed I have played the fool and erred exceedingly."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Saul confessed, "I have sinned. Come back home, my son, and I will no longer try to harm you, for you valued my life today. I have been a fool and very, very wrong."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul said, "I have sinned. Return, my son David, for I will not harm you again since my life was precious in your sight this day. Behold, I have played the fool and have made a very great mistake."
verses.textEn: Then Saul said, "I have sinned. Come back, David my son. Because you considered my life precious today, I will not try to harm you again. Surely I have acted like a fool and have been terribly wrong."

verses.textZh: 大卫回答说："看哪！王的矛在这里，可以叫一个仆人过来拿去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫回答说："看哪！王的矛在这里，可以叫一个仆人过来拿去。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫说：「王的枪在这里，可以吩咐一个仆人过来拿去。
verses.textEnNiv: "Here is the king’s spear," David answered. "Let one of your young men come over and get it.
verses.textEnEsv: And David answered and said, "Here is the spear, O king! Let one of the young men come over and take it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David answered and said, "Here is the king’s spear. Let one of the young men come over and get it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Here is your spear, O king," David replied. "Let one of your young men come over and get it.
verses.textEnNasb: David replied, "Behold, the spear of the king! Now have one of the young men come over and take it.
verses.textEn: "Here is the king’s spear," David answered. "Let one of your young men come over and get it.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必按着各人的公义和信实报答他；今天耶和华把你交在我手里，我却不愿伸手伤害耶和华的受膏者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必按着各人的公义和信实报答他；今天耶和华把你交在我手里，我却不愿伸手伤害耶和华的受膏者。
verses.textZhCuv: 今日耶和华将王交在我手里，我却不肯伸手害耶和华的受膏者。耶和华必照各人的公义诚实报应他。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord rewards everyone for their righteousness and faithfulness. The Lord delivered you into my hands today, but I would not lay a hand on the Lord ’s anointed.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord rewards every man for his righteousness and his faithfulness, for the Lord gave you into my hand today, and I would not put out my hand against the Lord ’s anointed.
verses.textEnNkjv: May the Lord repay every man for his righteousness and his faithfulness; for the Lord delivered you into my hand today, but I would not stretch out my hand against the Lord’s anointed.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gives his own reward for doing good and for being loyal, and I refused to kill you even when the Lord placed you in my power, for you are the Lord ’s anointed one.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord will repay each man for his righteousness and his faithfulness; for the Lord handed you over to me today, but I refused to reach out with my hand against the Lord’s anointed.
verses.textEn: The Lord rewards everyone for their righteousness and faithfulness. The Lord delivered you into my hands today, but I would not lay a hand on the Lord ’s anointed.

verses.textZh: 看哪，我今天怎样看重你的命，愿耶和华也怎样看重我的命，并且救我脱离一切患难。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，我今天怎样看重你的命，愿耶和华也怎样看重我的命，并且救我脱离一切患难。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我今日重看你的性命，愿耶和华也重看我的性命，并且拯救我脱离一切患难。」
verses.textEnNiv: As surely as I valued your life today, so may the Lord value my life and deliver me from all trouble."
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, as your life was precious this day in my sight, so may my life be precious in the sight of the Lord , and may he deliver me out of all tribulation."
verses.textEnNkjv: And indeed, as your life was valued much this day in my eyes, so let my life be valued much in the eyes of the Lord, and let Him deliver me out of all tribulation."
verses.textEnNlt: Now may the Lord value my life, even as I have valued yours today. May he rescue me from all my troubles."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore behold, just as your life was highly valued in my sight this day, so may my life be highly valued in the sight of the Lord, and may He rescue me from all distress."
verses.textEn: As surely as I valued your life today, so may the Lord value my life and deliver me from all trouble."

verses.textZh: 扫罗对大卫说："我儿大卫啊，愿你得福，你必作成你所要作的，也必得胜。"于是大卫离去了，扫罗也回自己的地方去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗对大卫说："我儿大卫啊，愿你得福，你必作成你所要作的，也必得胜。"于是大卫离去了，扫罗也回自己的地方去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗对大卫说：「我儿大卫，愿你得福！你必做大事，也必得胜。」于是大卫起行，扫罗回他的本处去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Saul said to David, "May you be blessed, David my son; you will do great things and surely triumph." So David went on his way, and Saul returned home.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Saul said to David, "Blessed be you, my son David! You will do many things and will succeed in them." So David went his way, and Saul returned to his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul said to David, "May you be blessed, my son David! You shall both do great things and also still prevail." So David went on his way, and Saul returned to his place.
verses.textEnNlt: And Saul said to David, "Blessings on you, my son David. You will do many heroic deeds, and you will surely succeed." Then David went away, and Saul returned home.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul said to David, "Blessed are you, my son David; you will both accomplish much and assuredly prevail." So David went on his way, and Saul returned to his place.
verses.textEn: Then Saul said to David, "May you be blessed, David my son; you will do great things and surely triumph." So David went on his way, and Saul returned home.

verses.textZh: 大卫心里说："总有一天，我会死在扫罗的手里，我倒不如逃奔到非利士人的国土，扫罗对我就会死心，不再在以色列全境寻索我，我就可以逃脱他的手了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫心里说："总有一天，我会死在扫罗的手里，我倒不如逃奔到非利士人的国土，扫罗对我就会死心，不再在以色列全境寻索我，我就可以逃脱他的手了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫心里说：「必有一日我死在扫罗手里，不如逃奔非利士地去。扫罗见我不在以色列的境内，就必绝望，不再寻索我；这样我可以脱离他的手。」
verses.textEnNiv: But David thought to himself, "One of these days I will be destroyed by the hand of Saul. The best thing I can do is to escape to the land of the Philistines. Then Saul will give up searching for me anywhere in Israel, and I will slip out of his hand."
verses.textEnEsv: Then David said in his heart, "Now I shall perish one day by the hand of Saul. There is nothing better for me than that I should escape to the land of the Philistines. Then Saul will despair of seeking me any longer within the borders of Israel, and I shall escape out of his hand."
verses.textEnNkjv: And David said in his heart, "Now I shall perish someday by the hand of Saul. Thereis nothing better for me than that I should speedily escape to the land of the Philistines; and Saul will despair of me, to seek me anymore in any part of Israel. So I shall escape out of his hand."
verses.textEnNlt: But David kept thinking to himself, "Someday Saul is going to get me. The best thing I can do is escape to the Philistines. Then Saul will stop hunting for me in Israelite territory, and I will finally be safe."
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to himself, "Now I will perish one day by the hand of Saul. There is nothing better for me than to safely escape into the land of the Philistines. Then Saul will despair of searching for me anymore in all the territory of Israel, and I will escape from his hand."
verses.textEn: But David thought to himself, "One of these days I will be destroyed by the hand of Saul. The best thing I can do is to escape to the land of the Philistines. Then Saul will give up searching for me anywhere in Israel, and I will slip out of his hand."

verses.textZh: 于是大卫起来，和跟随他的六百人都越过边界，到迦特王玛俄的儿子亚吉那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫起来，和跟随他的六百人都越过边界，到迦特王玛俄的儿子亚吉那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是大卫起身，和跟随他的六百人投奔迦特王－玛俄的儿子亚吉去了。
verses.textEnNiv: So David and the six hundred men with him left and went over to Achish son of Maok king of Gath.
verses.textEnEsv: So David arose and went over, he and the six hundred men who were with him, to Achish the son of Maoch, king of Gath.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David arose and went over with the six hundred men who were with him to Achish the son of Maoch, king of Gath.
verses.textEnNlt: So David took his 600 men and went over and joined Achish son of Maoch, the king of Gath.
verses.textEnNasb: So David set out and went over, he and the six hundred men who were with him, to Achish the son of Maoch, king of Gath.
verses.textEn: So David and the six hundred men with him left and went over to Achish son of Maok king of Gath.

verses.textZh: 大卫和跟随他的人，以及他们各人的家眷，都与亚吉一同住在迦特。大卫的两个妻子，就是耶斯列人亚希暖和作过拿八妻子的迦密人亚比该也都住在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫和跟随他的人，以及他们各人的家眷，都与亚吉一同住在迦特。大卫的两个妻子，就是耶斯列人亚希暖和作过拿八妻子的迦密人亚比该也都住在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫和他的两个妻，就是耶斯列人亚希暖和作过拿八妻的迦密人亚比该，并跟随他的人，连各人的眷属，都住在迦特的亚吉那里。
verses.textEnNiv: David and his men settled in Gath with Achish. Each man had his family with him, and David had his two wives: Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail of Carmel, the widow of Nabal.
verses.textEnEsv: And David lived with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, and David with his two wives, Ahinoam of Jezreel, and Abigail of Carmel, Nabal’s widow.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David dwelt with Achish at Gath, he and his men, each man with his household, and David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal’s widow.
verses.textEnNlt: David and his men and their families settled there with Achish at Gath. David brought his two wives along with him—Ahinoam from Jezreel and Abigail, Nabal’s widow from Carmel.
verses.textEnNasb: And David lived with Achish in Gath, he and his men, each with his own household—David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal’s widow.
verses.textEn: David and his men settled in Gath with Achish. Each man had his family with him, and David had his two wives: Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail of Carmel, the widow of Nabal.

verses.textZh: 有人告诉扫罗，大卫已经逃到迦特去了，扫罗就不再寻索他了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人告诉扫罗，大卫已经逃到迦特去了，扫罗就不再寻索他了。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉扫罗说：「大卫逃到迦特。」扫罗就不再寻索他了。
verses.textEnNiv: When Saul was told that David had fled to Gath, he no longer searched for him.
verses.textEnEsv: And when it was told Saul that David had fled to Gath, he no longer sought him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it was told Saul that David had fled to Gath; so he sought him no more.
verses.textEnNlt: Word soon reached Saul that David had fled to Gath, so he stopped hunting for him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it was reported to Saul that David had fled to Gath, so he no longer searched for him.
verses.textEn: When Saul was told that David had fled to Gath, he no longer searched for him.

verses.textZh: 大卫对亚吉说："我若是在你眼前蒙恩，求你在这地的城市中，给我一个地方，让我住在那里。为甚么要你的仆人与你一同住在王城呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对亚吉说："我若是在你眼前蒙恩，求你在这地的城市中，给我一个地方，让我住在那里。为甚么要你的仆人与你一同住在王城呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对亚吉说：「我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你在京外的城邑中赐我一个地方居住。仆人何必与王同住京都呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then David said to Achish, "If I have found favor in your eyes, let a place be assigned to me in one of the country towns, that I may live there. Why should your servant live in the royal city with you?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then David said to Achish, "If I have found favor in your eyes, let a place be given me in one of the country towns, that I may dwell there. For why should your servant dwell in the royal city with you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David said to Achish, "If I have now found favor in your eyes, let them give me a place in some town in the country, that I may dwell there. For why should your servant dwell in the royal city with you?"
verses.textEnNlt: One day David said to Achish, "If it is all right with you, we would rather live in one of the country towns instead of here in the royal city."
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to Achish, "If now I have found favor in your sight, have them give me a place in one of the cities in the country, so that I may live there; for why should your servant live in the royal city with you?"
verses.textEn: Then David said to Achish, "If I have found favor in your eyes, let a place be assigned to me in one of the country towns, that I may live there. Why should your servant live in the royal city with you?"

verses.textZh: 那天，亚吉就把洗革拉赐给大卫，因此，洗革拉直到今日还是属犹大王的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那天，亚吉就把洗革拉赐给大卫，因此，洗革拉直到今日还是属犹大王的。
verses.textZhCuv: 当日亚吉将洗革拉赐给他，因此洗革拉属犹大王，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: So on that day Achish gave him Ziklag, and it has belonged to the kings of Judah ever since.
verses.textEnEsv: So that day Achish gave him Ziklag. Therefore Ziklag has belonged to the kings of Judah to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Achish gave him Ziklag that day. Therefore Ziklag has belonged to the kings of Judah to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: So Achish gave him the town of Ziklag (which still belongs to the kings of Judah to this day),
verses.textEnNasb: So Achish gave him Ziklag that day; therefore Ziklag has belonged to the kings of Judah to this day.
verses.textEn: So on that day Achish gave him Ziklag, and it has belonged to the kings of Judah ever since.

verses.textZh: 大卫在非利士人的乡镇居住的日子，共有一年零四个月。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫在非利士人的乡镇居住的日子，共有一年零四个月。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫在非利士地住了一年零四个月。
verses.textEnNiv: David lived in Philistine territory a year and four months.
verses.textEnEsv: And the number of the days that David lived in the country of the Philistines was a year and four months.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the time that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was one full year and four months.
verses.textEnNlt: and they lived there among the Philistines for a year and four months.
verses.textEnNasb: The number of days that David lived in the country of the Philistines was a year and four months.
verses.textEn: David lived in Philistine territory a year and four months.

verses.textZh: 大卫和跟随他的人上去袭击基述人、基色人和亚玛力人，这些人自古以来就是这地的居民，居于书珥到埃及地之间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫和跟随他的人上去袭击基述人、基色人和亚玛力人，这些人自古以来就是这地的居民，居于书珥到埃及地之间。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫和跟随他的人上去，侵夺基述人、基色人、亚玛力人之地。这几族历来住在那地，从书珥直到埃及。
verses.textEnNiv: Now David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Girzites and the Amalekites. (From ancient times these peoples had lived in the land extending to Shur and Egypt.)
verses.textEnEsv: Now David and his men went up and made raids against the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites, for these were the inhabitants of the land from of old, as far as Shur, to the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites. For those nations were the inhabitants of the land from of old, as you go to Shur, even as far as the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: David and his men spent their time raiding the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites—people who had lived near Shur, toward the land of Egypt, since ancient times.
verses.textEnNasb: Now David and his men went up and attacked the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites; for they were the inhabitants of the land from ancient times, as you come to Shur even as far as the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: Now David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Girzites and the Amalekites. (From ancient times these peoples had lived in the land extending to Shur and Egypt.)

verses.textZh: 大卫攻打那地，无论男女，都不让一人存活，又掳走了牛、羊、驴子、骆驼和衣服，然后回来，到亚吉那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫攻打那地，无论男女，都不让一人存活，又掳走了牛、羊、驴子、骆驼和衣服，然后回来，到亚吉那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫击杀那地的人，无论男女都没有留下一个，又夺获牛、羊、骆驼、驴，并衣服，回来见亚吉。
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever David attacked an area, he did not leave a man or woman alive, but took sheep and cattle, donkeys and camels, and clothes. Then he returned to Achish.
verses.textEnEsv: And David would strike the land and would leave neither man nor woman alive, but would take away the sheep, the oxen, the donkeys, the camels, and the garments, and come back to Achish.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whenever David attacked the land, he left neither man nor woman alive, but took away the sheep, the oxen, the donkeys, the camels, and the apparel, and returned and came to Achish.
verses.textEnNlt: David did not leave one person alive in the villages he attacked. He took the sheep, goats, cattle, donkeys, camels, and clothing before returning home to see King Achish.
verses.textEnNasb: David attacked the land and did not leave a man or a woman alive, and he took the sheep, the cattle, the donkeys, the camels, and the clothing. Then he returned and came to Achish.
verses.textEn: Whenever David attacked an area, he did not leave a man or woman alive, but took sheep and cattle, donkeys and camels, and clothes. Then he returned to Achish.

verses.textZh: 亚吉问："你们今天袭击了甚么地方呢？"大卫回答："我们袭击了犹大的南方，耶拉蔑的南部，和基尼的南方。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚吉问："你们今天袭击了甚么地方呢？"大卫回答："我们袭击了犹大的南方，耶拉蔑的南部，和基尼的南方。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚吉说：「你们今日侵夺了什么地方呢？」大卫说：「侵夺了犹大的南方、耶拉篾的南方、基尼的南方。」
verses.textEnNiv: When Achish asked, "Where did you go raiding today?" David would say, "Against the Negev of Judah" or "Against the Negev of Jerahmeel" or "Against the Negev of the Kenites."
verses.textEnEsv: When Achish asked, "Where have you made a raid today?" David would say, "Against the Negeb of Judah," or, "Against the Negeb of the Jerahmeelites," or, "Against the Negeb of the Kenites."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Achish would say, "Where have you made a raid today?" And David would say, "Against the southern area of Judah, or against the southern area of the Jerahmeelites, or against the southern area of the Kenites."
verses.textEnNlt: "Where did you make your raid today?" Achish would ask. And David would reply, "Against the south of Judah, the Jerahmeelites, and the Kenites."
verses.textEnNasb: Now Achish said, " Where did you carry out an attack today?" And David said, "Against the Negev of Judah, against the Negev of the Jerahmeelites, and against the Negev of the Kenites."
verses.textEn: When Achish asked, "Where did you go raiding today?" David would say, "Against the Negev of Judah" or "Against the Negev of Jerahmeel" or "Against the Negev of the Kenites."

verses.textZh: 无论男女，大卫都不让一人活着带到迦特来，他说："恐怕他们把我们的事告诉别人，说：‘大卫作了这样的事，他住在非利士人乡镇的日子，常常这样作。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论男女，大卫都不让一人活着带到迦特来，他说："恐怕他们把我们的事告诉别人，说：‘大卫作了这样的事，他住在非利士人乡镇的日子，常常这样作。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 无论男女，大卫没有留下一个带到迦特来。他说：「恐怕他们将我们的事告诉人，说大卫住在非利士地的时候常常这样行。」
verses.textEnNiv: He did not leave a man or woman alive to be brought to Gath, for he thought, "They might inform on us and say, ‘This is what David did.’ " And such was his practice as long as he lived in Philistine territory.
verses.textEnEsv: And David would leave neither man nor woman alive to bring news to Gath, thinking, "lest they should tell about us and say, ‘So David has done.’" Such was his custom all the while he lived in the country of the Philistines.
verses.textEnNkjv: David would save neither man nor woman alive, to bring news to Gath, saying, "Lest they should inform on us, saying, ‘Thus David did.’ " And thus was his behavior all the time he dwelt in the country of the Philistines.
verses.textEnNlt: No one was left alive to come to Gath and tell where he had really been. This happened again and again while he was living among the Philistines.
verses.textEnNasb: And David did not leave a man or a woman alive to bring to Gath, saying, "Otherwise they will tell about us, saying, ‘This is what David has done, and this has been his practice all the time that he has lived in the country of the Philistines.’ "
verses.textEn: He did not leave a man or woman alive to be brought to Gath, for he thought, "They might inform on us and say, ‘This is what David did.’ " And such was his practice as long as he lived in Philistine territory.

verses.textZh: 亚吉相信了大卫，心里说："他在自己的族人以色列中留下了臭名，他必永远作我的仆人了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚吉相信了大卫，心里说："他在自己的族人以色列中留下了臭名，他必永远作我的仆人了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚吉信了大卫，心里说：「大卫使本族以色列人憎恶他，所以他必永远作我的仆人了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Achish trusted David and said to himself, "He has become so obnoxious to his people, the Israelites, that he will be my servant for life."
verses.textEnEsv: And Achish trusted David, thinking, "He has made himself an utter stench to his people Israel; therefore he shall always be my servant."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Achish believed David, saying, "He has made his people Israel utterly abhor him; therefore he will be my servant forever."
verses.textEnNlt: Achish believed David and thought to himself, "By now the people of Israel must hate him bitterly. Now he will have to stay here and serve me forever!"
verses.textEnNasb: So Achish believed David, saying, "He has undoubtedly made himself repulsive among his people Israel; therefore he will become my servant forever."
verses.textEn: Achish trusted David and said to himself, "He has become so obnoxious to his people, the Israelites, that he will be my servant for life."

verses.textZh: 那时，非利士人聚集他们的军队，要与以色列人争战。亚吉对大卫说："你要清楚知道，你和跟随你的人都要在军队中与我一同出征。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，非利士人聚集他们的军队，要与以色列人争战。亚吉对大卫说："你要清楚知道，你和跟随你的人都要在军队中与我一同出征。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，非利士人聚集军旅，要与以色列人打仗。亚吉对大卫说：「你当知道，你和跟随你的人都要随我出战。」
verses.textEnNiv: In those days the Philistines gathered their forces to fight against Israel. Achish said to David, "You must understand that you and your men will accompany me in the army."
verses.textEnEsv: In those days the Philistines gathered their forces for war, to fight against Israel. And Achish said to David, "Understand that you and your men are to go out with me in the army."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened in those days that the Philistines gathered their armies together for war, to fight with Israel. And Achish said to David, "You assuredly know that you will go out with me to battle, you and your men."
verses.textEnNlt: About that time the Philistines mustered their armies for another war with Israel. King Achish told David, "You and your men will be expected to join me in battle."
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about in those days that the Philistines gathered their armed camps for war, to fight against Israel. And Achish said to David, "Know for certain that you will go out with me in the camp, you and your men."
verses.textEn: In those days the Philistines gathered their forces to fight against Israel. Achish said to David, "You must understand that you and your men will accompany me in the army."

verses.textZh: 大卫回答亚吉说："仆人所能作的事你都知道。"于是亚吉对大卫说："好吧，我要立你永远作我的护卫长。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫回答亚吉说："仆人所能作的事你都知道。"于是亚吉对大卫说："好吧，我要立你永远作我的护卫长。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对亚吉说：「仆人所能做的事，王必知道。」亚吉对大卫说：「这样，我立你永远作我的护卫长。」
verses.textEnNiv: David said, "Then you will see for yourself what your servant can do." Achish replied, "Very well, I will make you my bodyguard for life."
verses.textEnEsv: David said to Achish, "Very well, you shall know what your servant can do." And Achish said to David, "Very well, I will make you my bodyguard for life."
verses.textEnNkjv: So David said to Achish, "Surely you know what your servant can do." And Achish said to David, "Therefore I will make you one of my chief guardians forever."
verses.textEnNlt: "Very well!" David agreed. "Now you will see for yourself what we can do." Then Achish told David, "I will make you my personal bodyguard for life."
verses.textEnNasb: David said to Achish, "Very well, you will learn what your servant can do." So Achish said to David, "Then I will assuredly make you my bodyguard for life!"
verses.textEn: David said, "Then you will see for yourself what your servant can do." Achish replied, "Very well, I will make you my bodyguard for life."

verses.textZh: 那时，撒母耳死了，以色列众人都为他哀哭，把他埋葬在拉玛他自己的城里。扫罗曾经把交鬼的和行巫术的，都从国中除去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，撒母耳死了，以色列众人都为他哀哭，把他埋葬在拉玛他自己的城里。扫罗曾经把交鬼的和行巫术的，都从国中除去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时撒母耳已经死了，以色列众人为他哀哭，葬他在拉玛，就是在他本城里。扫罗曾在国内不容有交鬼的和行巫术的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had mourned for him and buried him in his own town of Ramah. Saul had expelled the mediums and spiritists from the land.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Samuel had died, and all Israel had mourned for him and buried him in Ramah, his own city. And Saul had put the mediums and the necromancers out of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Samuel had died, and all Israel had lamented for him and buried him in Ramah, in his own city. And Saul had put the mediums and the spiritists out of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Samuel had died, and all Israel had mourned for him. He was buried in Ramah, his hometown. And Saul had banned from the land of Israel all mediums and those who consult the spirits of the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had mourned him and buried him in Ramah, his own city. And Saul had removed the mediums and spiritists from the land.
verses.textEn: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had mourned for him and buried him in his own town of Ramah. Saul had expelled the mediums and spiritists from the land.

verses.textZh: 非利士人聚集起来，来到书念安营；扫罗也聚集以色列众人，在基利波安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人聚集起来，来到书念安营；扫罗也聚集以色列众人，在基利波安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人聚集，来到书念安营；扫罗聚集以色列众人在基利波安营。
verses.textEnNiv: The Philistines assembled and came and set up camp at Shunem, while Saul gathered all Israel and set up camp at Gilboa.
verses.textEnEsv: The Philistines assembled and came and encamped at Shunem. And Saul gathered all Israel, and they encamped at Gilboa.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Philistines gathered together, and came and encamped at Shunem. So Saul gathered all Israel together, and they encamped at Gilboa.
verses.textEnNlt: The Philistines set up their camp at Shunem, and Saul gathered all the army of Israel and camped at Gilboa.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Philistines assembled and came and camped in Shunem; and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they camped in Gilboa.
verses.textEn: The Philistines assembled and came and set up camp at Shunem, while Saul gathered all Israel and set up camp at Gilboa.

verses.textZh: 扫罗看见了非利士人的军队，就惧怕，他的心大大发抖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗看见了非利士人的军队，就惧怕，他的心大大发抖。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗看见非利士的军旅就惧怕，心中发颤。
verses.textEnNiv: When Saul saw the Philistine army, he was afraid; terror filled his heart.
verses.textEnEsv: When Saul saw the army of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart trembled greatly.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Saul saw the army of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart trembled greatly.
verses.textEnNlt: When Saul saw the vast Philistine army, he became frantic with fear.
verses.textEnNasb: When Saul saw the camp of the Philistines, he was afraid and his heart trembled greatly.
verses.textEn: When Saul saw the Philistine army, he was afraid; terror filled his heart.

verses.textZh: 扫罗求问耶和华，耶和华却没有借着梦，或乌陵，或先知回答他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗求问耶和华，耶和华却没有借着梦，或乌陵，或先知回答他。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗求问耶和华，耶和华却不藉梦，或乌陵，或先知回答他。
verses.textEnNiv: He inquired of the Lord , but the Lord did not answer him by dreams or Urim or prophets.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Saul inquired of the Lord , the Lord did not answer him, either by dreams, or by Urim, or by prophets.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Saul inquired of the Lord, the Lord did not answer him, either by dreams or by Urim or by the prophets.
verses.textEnNlt: He asked the Lord what he should do, but the Lord refused to answer him, either by dreams or by sacred lots or by the prophets.
verses.textEnNasb: So Saul inquired of the Lord, but the Lord did not answer him, either in dreams, or by the Urim, or by the prophets.
verses.textEn: He inquired of the Lord , but the Lord did not answer him by dreams or Urim or prophets.

verses.textZh: 于是扫罗对他的臣仆说："你们要为我寻找一个能交鬼的女人，我好去求问她。"他的臣仆回答他说："在隐．多珥有一个能交鬼的女人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是扫罗对他的臣仆说："你们要为我寻找一个能交鬼的女人，我好去求问她。"他的臣仆回答他说："在隐．多珥有一个能交鬼的女人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗吩咐臣仆说：「当为我找一个交鬼的妇人，我好去问她。」臣仆说：「在隐‧多珥有一个交鬼的妇人。」
verses.textEnNiv: Saul then said to his attendants, "Find me a woman who is a medium, so I may go and inquire of her." "There is one in Endor," they said.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Saul said to his servants, "Seek out for me a woman who is a medium, that I may go to her and inquire of her." And his servants said to him, "Behold, there is a medium at En-dor."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul said to his servants, "Find me a woman who is a medium, that I may go to her and inquire of her." And his servants said to him, "In fact, thereis a woman who is a medium at En Dor."
verses.textEnNlt: Saul then said to his advisers, "Find a woman who is a medium, so I can go and ask her what to do." His advisers replied, "There is a medium at Endor."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul said to his servants, "Find for me a woman who is a medium, so that I may go to her and inquire of her." And his servants said to him, "Behold, there is a woman who is a medium at En-dor."
verses.textEn: Saul then said to his attendants, "Find me a woman who is a medium, so I may go and inquire of her." "There is one in Endor," they said.

verses.textZh: 于是扫罗改装易服，带着两个人与他一同去了。他们夜里到了那女人那里。扫罗说："请你用交鬼的法术，把我所告诉你的那人为我招上来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是扫罗改装易服，带着两个人与他一同去了。他们夜里到了那女人那里。扫罗说："请你用交鬼的法术，把我所告诉你的那人为我招上来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是扫罗改了装，穿上别的衣服，带着两个人，夜里去见那妇人。扫罗说：「求你用交鬼的法术，将我所告诉你的死人，为我招上来。」
verses.textEnNiv: So Saul disguised himself, putting on other clothes, and at night he and two men went to the woman. "Consult a spirit for me," he said, "and bring up for me the one I name."
verses.textEnEsv: So Saul disguised himself and put on other garments and went, he and two men with him. And they came to the woman by night. And he said, "Divine for me by a spirit and bring up for me whomever I shall name to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Saul disguised himself and put on other clothes, and he went, and two men with him; and they came to the woman by night. And he said, "Please conduct a séance for me, and bring up for me the one I shall name to you."
verses.textEnNlt: So Saul disguised himself by wearing ordinary clothing instead of his royal robes. Then he went to the woman’s home at night, accompanied by two of his men. "I have to talk to a man who has died," he said. "Will you call up his spirit for me?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul disguised himself by putting on different clothes, and went, he and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night; and he said, "Consult the spirit for me, please, and bring up for me the one whom I shall name for you."
verses.textEn: So Saul disguised himself, putting on other clothes, and at night he and two men went to the woman. "Consult a spirit for me," he said, "and bring up for me the one I name."

verses.textZh: 那女人回答他："你是知道扫罗所作的，他已经把交鬼的和行巫术的，都从国中剪除了，你为甚么要陷害我的命，使我死呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那女人回答他："你是知道扫罗所作的，他已经把交鬼的和行巫术的，都从国中剪除了，你为甚么要陷害我的命，使我死呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人对他说：「你知道扫罗从国中剪除交鬼的和行巫术的。你为何陷害我的性命，使我死呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: But the woman said to him, "Surely you know what Saul has done. He has cut off the mediums and spiritists from the land. Why have you set a trap for my life to bring about my death?"
verses.textEnEsv: The woman said to him, "Surely you know what Saul has done, how he has cut off the mediums and the necromancers from the land. Why then are you laying a trap for my life to bring about my death?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the woman said to him, "Look, you know what Saul has done, how he has cut off the mediums and the spiritists from the land. Why then do you lay a snare for my life, to cause me to die?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Are you trying to get me killed?" the woman demanded. "You know that Saul has outlawed all the mediums and all who consult the spirits of the dead. Why are you setting a trap for me?"
verses.textEnNasb: But the woman said to him, "Behold, you know what Saul has done, that he has eliminated the mediums and spiritists from the land. Why are you then setting a trap for my life, to bring about my death?"
verses.textEn: But the woman said to him, "Surely you know what Saul has done. He has cut off the mediums and spiritists from the land. Why have you set a trap for my life to bring about my death?"

verses.textZh: 扫罗指着耶和华起誓说："我指着永活的耶和华起誓，你必不因这事受惩罚。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗指着耶和华起誓说："我指着永活的耶和华起誓，你必不因这事受惩罚。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗向妇人指着耶和华起誓说：「我指着永生的耶和华起誓，你必不因这事受刑。」
verses.textEnNiv: Saul swore to her by the Lord , "As surely as the Lord lives, you will not be punished for this."
verses.textEnEsv: But Saul swore to her by the Lord , "As the Lord lives, no punishment shall come upon you for this thing."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Saul swore to her by the Lord, saying, "As the Lord lives, no punishment shall come upon you for this thing."
verses.textEnNlt: But Saul took an oath in the name of the Lord and promised, "As surely as the Lord lives, nothing bad will happen to you for doing this."
verses.textEnNasb: So Saul swore an oath to her by the Lord, saying, "As the Lord lives, no punishment shall come upon you for this thing."
verses.textEn: Saul swore to her by the Lord , "As surely as the Lord lives, you will not be punished for this."

verses.textZh: 那女人问："我要为你招谁上来呢？"扫罗回答："为我招撒母耳上来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那女人问："我要为你招谁上来呢？"扫罗回答："为我招撒母耳上来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人说：「我为你招谁上来呢？」回答说：「为我招撒母耳上来。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the woman asked, "Whom shall I bring up for you?" "Bring up Samuel," he said.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the woman said, "Whom shall I bring up for you?" He said, "Bring up Samuel for me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the woman said, "Whom shall I bring up for you?" And he said, "Bring up Samuel for me."
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, the woman said, "Well, whose spirit do you want me to call up?" "Call up Samuel," Saul replied.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the woman said, "Whom shall I bring up for you?" And he said, "Bring up Samuel for me."
verses.textEn: Then the woman asked, "Whom shall I bring up for you?" "Bring up Samuel," he said.

verses.textZh: 那女人看见了撒母耳，就大声呼叫。那女人对扫罗说："你为甚么欺骗我？你就是扫罗！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那女人看见了撒母耳，就大声呼叫。那女人对扫罗说："你为甚么欺骗我？你就是扫罗！"
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人看见撒母耳，就大声呼叫，对扫罗说：「你是扫罗，为什么欺哄我呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: When the woman saw Samuel, she cried out at the top of her voice and said to Saul, "Why have you deceived me? You are Saul!"
verses.textEnEsv: When the woman saw Samuel, she cried out with a loud voice. And the woman said to Saul, "Why have you deceived me? You are Saul."
verses.textEnNkjv: When the woman saw Samuel, she cried out with a loud voice. And the woman spoke to Saul, saying, "Why have you deceived me? For you are Saul!"
verses.textEnNlt: When the woman saw Samuel, she screamed, "You’ve deceived me! You are Saul!"
verses.textEnNasb: When the woman saw Samuel, she cried out with a loud voice; and the woman spoke to Saul, saying, "Why have you deceived me? For you are Saul!"
verses.textEn: When the woman saw Samuel, she cried out at the top of her voice and said to Saul, "Why have you deceived me? You are Saul!"

verses.textZh: 王对她说："不要惧怕。你看见了甚么？"那女人回答扫罗："我看见有神灵从地里上来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王对她说："不要惧怕。你看见了甚么？"那女人回答扫罗："我看见有神灵从地里上来。"
