verses.textZhCuv: 王对妇人说：「不要惧怕，你看见了什么呢？」妇人对扫罗说：「我看见有神从地里上来。」
verses.textEnNiv: The king said to her, "Don’t be afraid. What do you see?" The woman said, "I see a ghostly figure coming up out of the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: The king said to her, "Do not be afraid. What do you see?" And the woman said to Saul, "I see a god coming up out of the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king said to her, "Do not be afraid. What did you see?" And the woman said to Saul, "I saw a spirit ascending out of the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t be afraid!" the king told her. "What do you see?" "I see a god coming up out of the earth," she said.
verses.textEnNasb: But the king said to her, "Do not be afraid; but what do you see?" And the woman said to Saul, "I see a divine being coming up from the earth."
verses.textEn: The king said to her, "Don’t be afraid. What do you see?" The woman said, "I see a ghostly figure coming up out of the earth."

verses.textZh: 扫罗问她："他的容貌怎样？"她回答："上来的是一个身披外袍的老人。"扫罗知道那人是撒母耳，就脸伏于地向他叩拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗问她："他的容貌怎样？"她回答："上来的是一个身披外袍的老人。"扫罗知道那人是撒母耳，就脸伏于地向他叩拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗说：「他是怎样的形状？」妇人说：「有一个老人上来，身穿长衣。」扫罗知道是撒母耳，就屈身，脸伏于地下拜。
verses.textEnNiv: "What does he look like?" he asked. "An old man wearing a robe is coming up," she said. Then Saul knew it was Samuel, and he bowed down and prostrated himself with his face to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: He said to her, "What is his appearance?" And she said, "An old man is coming up, and he is wrapped in a robe." And Saul knew that it was Samuel, and he bowed with his face to the ground and paid homage.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said to her, "What is his form?" And she said, "An old man is coming up, and he is covered with a mantle." And Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he stooped with his face to the ground and bowed down.
verses.textEnNlt: "What does he look like?" Saul asked. "He is an old man wrapped in a robe," she replied. Saul realized it was Samuel, and he fell to the ground before him.
verses.textEnNasb: He said to her, " How does he appear?" And she said, "An old man is coming up, and he is wrapped in a robe." Then Saul knew that it was Samuel, and he bowed with his face to the ground and paid homage.
verses.textEn: "What does he look like?" he asked. "An old man wearing a robe is coming up," she said. Then Saul knew it was Samuel, and he bowed down and prostrated himself with his face to the ground.

verses.textZh: 撒母耳对扫罗说："你为甚么搅扰我，把我招上来呢？"扫罗说："我非常苦恼，非利士人正在攻打我，神又离开了我，不再借着先知或异梦回答我。所以我请你上来，指示我应该怎样行。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳对扫罗说："你为甚么搅扰我，把我招上来呢？"扫罗说："我非常苦恼，非利士人正在攻打我，神又离开了我，不再借着先知或异梦回答我。所以我请你上来，指示我应该怎样行。"
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳对扫罗说：「你为什么搅扰我，招我上来呢？」扫罗回答说：「我甚窘急；因为非利士人攻击我，神也离开我，不再藉先知或梦回答我。因此请你上来，好指示我应当怎样行。」
verses.textEnNiv: Samuel said to Saul, "Why have you disturbed me by bringing me up?" "I am in great distress," Saul said. "The Philistines are fighting against me, and God has departed from me. He no longer answers me, either by prophets or by dreams. So I have called on you to tell me what to do."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Samuel said to Saul, "Why have you disturbed me by bringing me up?" Saul answered, "I am in great distress, for the Philistines are warring against me, and God has turned away from me and answers me no more, either by prophets or by dreams. Therefore I have summoned you to tell me what I shall do."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Samuel said to Saul, "Why have you disturbed me by bringing me up?" And Saul answered, "I am deeply distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God has departed from me and does not answer me anymore, neither by prophets nor by dreams. Therefore I have called you, that you may reveal to me what I should do."
verses.textEnNlt: "Why have you disturbed me by calling me back?" Samuel asked Saul. "Because I am in deep trouble," Saul replied. "The Philistines are at war with me, and God has left me and won’t reply by prophets or dreams. So I have called for you to tell me what to do."
verses.textEnNasb: And Samuel said to Saul, "Why have you disturbed me by bringing me up?" Saul replied, "I am very distressed, for the Philistines are waging war against me, and God has abandoned me and no longer answers me, either through prophets or in dreams; therefore I have called you, so that you may let me know what I should do."
verses.textEn: Samuel said to Saul, "Why have you disturbed me by bringing me up?" "I am in great distress," Saul said. "The Philistines are fighting against me, and God has departed from me. He no longer answers me, either by prophets or by dreams. So I have called on you to tell me what to do."

verses.textZh: 撒母耳说："耶和华既然离开了你，又成了你的敌人，你为甚么还问我呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒母耳说："耶和华既然离开了你，又成了你的敌人，你为甚么还问我呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 撒母耳说：「耶和华已经离开你，且与你为敌，你何必问我呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Samuel said, "Why do you consult me, now that the Lord has departed from you and become your enemy?
verses.textEnEsv: And Samuel said, "Why then do you ask me, since the Lord has turned from you and become your enemy?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Samuel said: "So why do you ask me, seeing the Lord has departed from you and has become your enemy?
verses.textEnNlt: But Samuel replied, "Why ask me, since the Lord has left you and has become your enemy?
verses.textEnNasb: Samuel said, "But why ask me, since the Lord has abandoned you and has become your enemy?
verses.textEn: Samuel said, "Why do you consult me, now that the Lord has departed from you and become your enemy?

verses.textZh: 耶和华已经照着他藉我所说的话行了，他把王国从你手中夺去，赐给别人，就是大卫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华已经照着他藉我所说的话行了，他把王国从你手中夺去，赐给别人，就是大卫。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华照他藉我说的话，已经从你手里夺去国权，赐与别人，就是大卫。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has done what he predicted through me. The Lord has torn the kingdom out of your hands and given it to one of your neighbors—to David.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has done to you as he spoke by me, for the Lord has torn the kingdom out of your hand and given it to your neighbor, David.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord has done for Himself as He spoke by me. For the Lord has torn the kingdom out of your hand and given it to your neighbor, David.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has done just as he said he would. He has torn the kingdom from you and given it to your rival, David.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord has done just as He spoke through me; for the Lord has torn the kingdom from your hand and given it to your neighbor, to David.
verses.textEn: The Lord has done what he predicted through me. The Lord has torn the kingdom out of your hands and given it to one of your neighbors—to David.

verses.textZh: 因为你没有听从耶和华的话，没有执行他对亚玛力人所怀的烈怒，所以今天耶和华向你行了这样的事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你没有听从耶和华的话，没有执行他对亚玛力人所怀的烈怒，所以今天耶和华向你行了这样的事，
verses.textZhCuv: 因你没有听从耶和华的命令；他恼怒亚玛力人，你没有灭绝他们，所以今日耶和华向你这样行，
verses.textEnNiv: Because you did not obey the Lord or carry out his fierce wrath against the Amalekites, the Lord has done this to you today.
verses.textEnEsv: Because you did not obey the voice of the Lord and did not carry out his fierce wrath against Amalek, therefore the Lord has done this thing to you this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because you did not obey the voice of the Lord nor execute His fierce wrath upon Amalek, therefore the Lord has done this thing to you this day.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has done this to you today because you refused to carry out his fierce anger against the Amalekites.
verses.textEnNasb: Just as you did not obey the Lord and did not execute His fierce wrath on Amalek, so the Lord has done this thing to you this day.
verses.textEn: Because you did not obey the Lord or carry out his fierce wrath against the Amalekites, the Lord has done this to you today.

verses.textZh: 并且耶和华必把以色列和你一起都交在非利士人手里；明天你和你的儿子们都要和我一起了。耶和华必把以色列的军队交在非利士人手里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且耶和华必把以色列和你一起都交在非利士人手里；明天你和你的儿子们都要和我一起了。耶和华必把以色列的军队交在非利士人手里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 并且耶和华必将你和以色列人交在非利士人的手里。明日你和你众子必与我在一处了；耶和华必将以色列的军兵交在非利士人手里。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will deliver both Israel and you into the hands of the Philistines, and tomorrow you and your sons will be with me. The Lord will also give the army of Israel into the hands of the Philistines."
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, the Lord will give Israel also with you into the hand of the Philistines, and tomorrow you and your sons shall be with me. The Lord will give the army of Israel also into the hand of the Philistines."
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the Lord will also deliver Israel with you into the hand of the Philistines. And tomorrow you and your sons willbe with me. The Lord will also deliver the army of Israel into the hand of the Philistines."
verses.textEnNlt: What’s more, the Lord will hand you and the army of Israel over to the Philistines tomorrow, and you and your sons will be here with me. The Lord will bring down the entire army of Israel in defeat."
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, the Lord will also hand Israel along with you over to the Philistines; so tomorrow you and your sons will be with me. Indeed, the Lord will hand the army of Israel over to the Philistines!"
verses.textEn: The Lord will deliver both Israel and you into the hands of the Philistines, and tomorrow you and your sons will be with me. The Lord will also give the army of Israel into the hands of the Philistines."

verses.textZh: 扫罗立刻全身仆倒在地上，他因撒母耳的话，非常惧怕，又因为他已经一日一夜没有吃饭，所以一点气力也没有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗立刻全身仆倒在地上，他因撒母耳的话，非常惧怕，又因为他已经一日一夜没有吃饭，所以一点气力也没有。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗猛然仆倒，挺身在地，因撒母耳的话甚是惧怕；那一昼一夜，没有吃什么，就毫无气力。
verses.textEnNiv: Immediately Saul fell full length on the ground, filled with fear because of Samuel’s words. His strength was gone, for he had eaten nothing all that day and all that night.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Saul fell at once full length on the ground, filled with fear because of the words of Samuel. And there was no strength in him, for he had eaten nothing all day and all night.
verses.textEnNkjv: Immediately Saul fell full length on the ground, and was dreadfully afraid because of the words of Samuel. And there was no strength in him, for he had eaten no food all day or all night.
verses.textEnNlt: Saul fell full length on the ground, paralyzed with fright because of Samuel’s words. He was also faint with hunger, for he had eaten nothing all day and all night.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul immediately fell full length to the ground and was very afraid because of Samuel’s words; there was no strength in him either, because he had eaten no food all day and all night.
verses.textEn: Immediately Saul fell full length on the ground, filled with fear because of Samuel’s words. His strength was gone, for he had eaten nothing all that day and all that night.

verses.textZh: 那女人来到扫罗面前，见他非常惊慌，就对他说："你看，婢女听从了你的话；我冒着生命危险，听从了你对我所说的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那女人来到扫罗面前，见他非常惊慌，就对他说："你看，婢女听从了你的话；我冒着生命危险，听从了你对我所说的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人到扫罗面前，见他极其惊恐，对他说：「婢女听从你的话，不顾惜自己的性命，遵从你所吩咐的。
verses.textEnNiv: When the woman came to Saul and saw that he was greatly shaken, she said, "Look, your servant has obeyed you. I took my life in my hands and did what you told me to do.
verses.textEnEsv: And the woman came to Saul, and when she saw that he was terrified, she said to him, "Behold, your servant has obeyed you. I have taken my life in my hand and have listened to what you have said to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the woman came to Saul and saw that he was severely troubled, and said to him, "Look, your maidservant has obeyed your voice, and I have put my life in my hands and heeded the words which you spoke to me.
verses.textEnNlt: When the woman saw how distraught he was, she said, "Sir, I obeyed your command at the risk of my life.
verses.textEnNasb: The woman came to Saul and saw that he was utterly horrified, and she said to him, "Behold, your servant has obeyed you, and I have taken my life in my hand and have listened to your words which you spoke to me.
verses.textEn: When the woman came to Saul and saw that he was greatly shaken, she said, "Look, your servant has obeyed you. I took my life in my hands and did what you told me to do.

verses.textZh: 现在求你也听从婢女的话，允许我在你面前摆上一点食物。你吃了，身体就有气力，可以走路。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在求你也听从婢女的话，允许我在你面前摆上一点食物。你吃了，身体就有气力，可以走路。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在求你听婢女的话，容我在你面前摆上一点食物，你吃了，可以有气力行路。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now please listen to your servant and let me give you some food so you may eat and have the strength to go on your way."
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore, you also obey your servant. Let me set a morsel of bread before you; and eat, that you may have strength when you go on your way."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, please, heed also the voice of your maidservant, and let me set a piece of bread before you; and eat, that you may have strength when you go on your way."
verses.textEnNlt: Now do what I say, and let me give you a little something to eat so you can regain your strength for the trip back."
verses.textEnNasb: So now you too, please listen to the voice of your servant, and let me serve you a piece of bread, and eat it, so that you will have strength when you go on your way."
verses.textEn: Now please listen to your servant and let me give you some food so you may eat and have the strength to go on your way."

verses.textZh: 扫罗不肯，说："我不吃。"可是他的臣仆和那女人再三劝他，他才听从了他们的话，从地上起来，坐在床上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗不肯，说："我不吃。"可是他的臣仆和那女人再三劝他，他才听从了他们的话，从地上起来，坐在床上。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗不肯，说：「我不吃。」但他的仆人和妇人再三劝他，他才听了他们的话，从地上起来，坐在床上。
verses.textEnNiv: He refused and said, "I will not eat." But his men joined the woman in urging him, and he listened to them. He got up from the ground and sat on the couch.
verses.textEnEsv: He refused and said, "I will not eat." But his servants, together with the woman, urged him, and he listened to their words. So he arose from the earth and sat on the bed.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he refused and said, "I will not eat." So his servants, together with the woman, urged him; and he heeded their voice. Then he arose from the ground and sat on the bed.
verses.textEnNlt: But Saul refused to eat anything. Then his advisers joined the woman in urging him to eat, so he finally yielded and got up from the ground and sat on the couch.
verses.textEnNasb: But he refused and said, "I will not eat." However, his servants together with the woman urged him, and he listened to them. So he got up from the ground and sat on the bed.
verses.textEn: He refused and said, "I will not eat." But his men joined the woman in urging him, and he listened to them. He got up from the ground and sat on the couch.

verses.textZh: 那女人的家里有一头肥牛犊，她急忙把牠宰了，又拿点面粉，搓好了，烤成无酵饼，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那女人的家里有一头肥牛犊，她急忙把牠宰了，又拿点面粉，搓好了，烤成无酵饼，
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人急忙将家里的一只肥牛犊宰了，又拿面抟成无酵饼烤了，
verses.textEnNiv: The woman had a fattened calf at the house, which she butchered at once. She took some flour, kneaded it and baked bread without yeast.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the woman had a fattened calf in the house, and she quickly killed it, and she took flour and kneaded it and baked unleavened bread of it,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the woman had a fatted calf in the house, and she hastened to kill it. And she took flour and kneaded it, and baked unleavened bread from it.
verses.textEnNlt: The woman had been fattening a calf, so she hurried out and killed it. She took some flour, kneaded it into dough and baked unleavened bread.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the woman had a fattened calf in the house, and she quickly slaughtered it; then she took flour, kneaded it and baked unleavened bread from it.
verses.textEn: The woman had a fattened calf at the house, which she butchered at once. She took some flour, kneaded it and baked bread without yeast.

verses.textZh: 送到扫罗和他臣仆的面前；他们吃了以后，当夜就起身离去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 送到扫罗和他臣仆的面前；他们吃了以后，当夜就起身离去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 摆在扫罗和他仆人面前。他们吃完，当夜就起身走了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then she set it before Saul and his men, and they ate. That same night they got up and left.
verses.textEnEsv: and she put it before Saul and his servants, and they ate. Then they rose and went away that night.
verses.textEnNkjv: So she brought it before Saul and his servants, and they ate. Then they rose and went away that night.
verses.textEnNlt: She brought the meal to Saul and his advisers, and they ate it. Then they went out into the night.
verses.textEnNasb: She then served it to Saul and his servants, and they ate. Then they got up and left that night.
verses.textEn: Then she set it before Saul and his men, and they ate. That same night they got up and left.

verses.textZh: 非利士人把他们所有的军队都聚集在亚弗，以色列人却在耶斯列的泉旁安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人把他们所有的军队都聚集在亚弗，以色列人却在耶斯列的泉旁安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人将他们的军旅聚到亚弗；以色列人在耶斯列的泉旁安营。
verses.textEnNiv: The Philistines gathered all their forces at Aphek, and Israel camped by the spring in Jezreel.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the Philistines had gathered all their forces at Aphek. And the Israelites were encamped by the spring that is in Jezreel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Philistines gathered together all their armies at Aphek, and the Israelites encamped by a fountain which is in Jezreel.
verses.textEnNlt: The entire Philistine army now mobilized at Aphek, and the Israelites camped at the spring in Jezreel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek, while the Israelites were camping by the spring which is in Jezreel.
verses.textEn: The Philistines gathered all their forces at Aphek, and Israel camped by the spring in Jezreel.

verses.textZh: 非利士人的首领各率领百人或千人前进；大卫和跟随他的人也跟在亚吉的后面前进。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人的首领各率领百人或千人前进；大卫和跟随他的人也跟在亚吉的后面前进。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人的首领各率军队，或百或千，挨次前进；大卫和跟随他的人同着亚吉跟在后边。
verses.textEnNiv: As the Philistine rulers marched with their units of hundreds and thousands, David and his men were marching at the rear with Achish.
verses.textEnEsv: As the lords of the Philistines were passing on by hundreds and by thousands, and David and his men were passing on in the rear with Achish,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the lords of the Philistines passed in review by hundreds and by thousands, but David and his men passed in review at the rear with Achish.
verses.textEnNlt: As the Philistine rulers were leading out their troops in groups of hundreds and thousands, David and his men marched at the rear with King Achish.
verses.textEnNasb: And the governors of the Philistines were proceeding on, leading hundreds and thousands, and David and his men were proceeding in the back with Achish.
verses.textEn: As the Philistine rulers marched with their units of hundreds and thousands, David and his men were marching at the rear with Achish.

verses.textZh: 非利士人的领袖说："这些希伯来人在这里作甚么？"亚吉对非利士人的领袖说："这人不是以色列王扫罗的臣仆大卫吗？他已经在我这里有好些年日了。自从他降服我的一天，直到今日，我未曾发现他有甚么过错。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人的领袖说："这些希伯来人在这里作甚么？"亚吉对非利士人的领袖说："这人不是以色列王扫罗的臣仆大卫吗？他已经在我这里有好些年日了。自从他降服我的一天，直到今日，我未曾发现他有甚么过错。"
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人的首领说：「这些希伯来人在这里做什么呢？」亚吉对他们说：「这不是以色列王扫罗的臣子大卫吗？他在我这里有些年日了。自从他投降我直到今日，我未曾见他有过错。」
verses.textEnNiv: The commanders of the Philistines asked, "What about these Hebrews?" Achish replied, "Is this not David, who was an officer of Saul king of Israel? He has already been with me for over a year, and from the day he left Saul until now, I have found no fault in him."
verses.textEnEsv: the commanders of the Philistines said, "What are these Hebrews doing here?" And Achish said to the commanders of the Philistines, "Is this not David, the servant of Saul, king of Israel, who has been with me now for days and years, and since he deserted to me I have found no fault in him to this day."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the princes of the Philistines said, "What are these Hebrews doinghere?" And Achish said to the princes of the Philistines, "Is this not David, the servant of Saul king of Israel, who has been with me these days, or these years? And to this day I have found no fault in him since he defected tome."
verses.textEnNlt: But the Philistine commanders demanded, "What are these Hebrews doing here?" And Achish told them, "This is David, the servant of King Saul of Israel. He’s been with me for years, and I’ve never found a single fault in him from the day he arrived until today."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the commanders of the Philistines said, "What are these Hebrews doing here?" And Achish said to the commanders of the Philistines, "Is this not David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, who has been with me these days, or rather these years, and I have found nothing at all suspicious in him since the day he deserted to me to this day?"
verses.textEn: The commanders of the Philistines asked, "What about these Hebrews?" Achish replied, "Is this not David, who was an officer of Saul king of Israel? He has already been with me for over a year, and from the day he left Saul until now, I have found no fault in him."

verses.textZh: 非利士人的领袖向亚吉发怒，对他说："你叫这人回去，好让他回到你为他安排的地方去。他不可与我们一同下战场，免得他在战场上成为我们的对头。这人可用甚么去得他主人的欢心呢？岂不是用我们这些人的头吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人的领袖向亚吉发怒，对他说："你叫这人回去，好让他回到你为他安排的地方去。他不可与我们一同下战场，免得他在战场上成为我们的对头。这人可用甚么去得他主人的欢心呢？岂不是用我们这些人的头吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人的首领向亚吉发怒，对他说：「你要叫这人回你所安置他的地方，不可叫他同我们出战，恐怕他在阵上反为我们的敌人。他用什么与他主人复和呢？岂不是用我们这些人的首级吗？
verses.textEnNiv: But the Philistine commanders were angry with Achish and said, "Send the man back, that he may return to the place you assigned him. He must not go with us into battle, or he will turn against us during the fighting. How better could he regain his master’s favor than by taking the heads of our own men?
verses.textEnEsv: But the commanders of the Philistines were angry with him. And the commanders of the Philistines said to him, "Send the man back, that he may return to the place to which you have assigned him. He shall not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he become an adversary to us. For how could this fellow reconcile himself to his lord? Would it not be with the heads of the men here?
verses.textEnNkjv: But the princes of the Philistines were angry with him; so the princes of the Philistines said to him, "Make this fellow return, that he may go back to the place which you have appointed for him, and do not let him go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he become our adversary. For with what could he reconcile himself to his master, if not with the heads of these men?
verses.textEnNlt: But the Philistine commanders were angry. "Send him back to the town you’ve given him!" they demanded. "He can’t go into the battle with us. What if he turns against us in battle and becomes our adversary? Is there any better way for him to reconcile himself with his master than by handing our heads over to him?
verses.textEnNasb: But the commanders of the Philistines were angry with him, and the commanders of the Philistines said to him, "Make the man go back, so that he will return to his place where you have assigned him, and do not let him go down to battle with us, or in the battle he may become an adversary to us. For how could this man find favor with his lord? Would it not be with the heads of these men?
verses.textEn: But the Philistine commanders were angry with Achish and said, "Send the man back, that he may return to the place you assigned him. He must not go with us into battle, or he will turn against us during the fighting. How better could he regain his master’s favor than by taking the heads of our own men?

verses.textZh: 这人不就是大卫吗？从前以色列的妇女向他歌唱跳舞说： ‘扫罗杀死千千， 大卫杀死万万！’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这人不就是大卫吗？从前以色列的妇女向他歌唱跳舞说： ‘扫罗杀死千千， 大卫杀死万万！’"
verses.textZhCuv: 从前以色列的妇女跳舞唱和说：『扫罗杀死千千，大卫杀死万万』，所说的不是这个大卫吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Isn’t this the David they sang about in their dances: " ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands’?"
verses.textEnEsv: Is not this David, of whom they sing to one another in dances, ‘Saul has struck down his thousands, and David his ten thousands’?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Is this not David, of whom they sang to one another in dances, saying: ‘Saul has slain his thousands, And David his ten thousands’?"
verses.textEnNlt: Isn’t this the same David about whom the women of Israel sing in their dances, ‘Saul has killed his thousands, and David his ten thousands’?"
verses.textEnNasb: Is this not David, of whom they sing in the dances, saying, ‘Saul has slain his thousands, And David his ten thousands’?"
verses.textEn: Isn’t this the David they sang about in their dances: " ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands’?"

verses.textZh: 亚吉把大卫叫来，对他说："我指着永活的耶和华说，你是正直的人，你与我在军中出入，我感到很满意，因为自从你到我这里来的那一天，直到今日，我未曾在你身上找到甚么过失；只是各首领不喜欢你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚吉把大卫叫来，对他说："我指着永活的耶和华说，你是正直的人，你与我在军中出入，我感到很满意，因为自从你到我这里来的那一天，直到今日，我未曾在你身上找到甚么过失；只是各首领不喜欢你。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚吉叫大卫来，对他说：「我指着永生的耶和华起誓，你是正直人。你随我在军中出入，我看你甚好。自从你投奔我到如今，我未曾见你有什么过失；只是众首领不喜悦你。
verses.textEnNiv: So Achish called David and said to him, "As surely as the Lord lives, you have been reliable, and I would be pleased to have you serve with me in the army. From the day you came to me until today, I have found no fault in you, but the rulers don’t approve of you.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Achish called David and said to him, "As the Lord lives, you have been honest, and to me it seems right that you should march out and in with me in the campaign. For I have found nothing wrong in you from the day of your coming to me to this day. Nevertheless, the lords do not approve of you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Achish called David and said to him, "Surely, as the Lord lives, you have been upright, and your going out and your coming in with me in the army is good in my sight. For to this day I have not found evil in you since the day of your coming to me. Nevertheless the lords do not favor you.
verses.textEnNlt: So Achish finally summoned David and said to him, "I swear by the Lord that you have been a trustworthy ally. I think you should go with me into battle, for I’ve never found a single flaw in you from the day you arrived until today. But the other Philistine rulers won’t hear of it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Achish called David and said to him, "As the Lord lives, you have indeed been honest, and your going out and your coming in with me in the army are pleasing in my sight; for I have not found evil in you since the day of your coming to me to this day. Nevertheless, you are not pleasing in the sight of the governors.
verses.textEn: So Achish called David and said to him, "As surely as the Lord lives, you have been reliable, and I would be pleased to have you serve with me in the army. From the day you came to me until today, I have found no fault in you, but the rulers don’t approve of you.

verses.textZh: 现在，你可以回去，平平安安走吧！不要行非利士人的首领看为恶的事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，你可以回去，平平安安走吧！不要行非利士人的首领看为恶的事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你可以平平安安地回去，免得非利士人的首领不欢喜你。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now turn back and go in peace; do nothing to displease the Philistine rulers."
verses.textEnEsv: So go back now; and go peaceably, that you may not displease the lords of the Philistines."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore return now, and go in peace, that you may not displease the lords of the Philistines."
verses.textEnNlt: Please don’t upset them, but go back quietly."
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, return and go in peace, so that you will not do anything wrong in the sight of the governors of the Philistines."
verses.textEn: Now turn back and go in peace; do nothing to displease the Philistine rulers."

verses.textZh: 大卫对亚吉说："我作了甚么呢？自从我来到你面前的那一天，直到今日，你在仆人身上找到甚么，使我不能与我主我王的仇敌争战呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对亚吉说："我作了甚么呢？自从我来到你面前的那一天，直到今日，你在仆人身上找到甚么，使我不能与我主我王的仇敌争战呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对亚吉说：「我做了什么呢？自从仆人到你面前，直到今日，你查出我有什么过错，使我不去攻击主－我王的仇敌呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: "But what have I done?" asked David. "What have you found against your servant from the day I came to you until now? Why can’t I go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?"
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to Achish, "But what have I done? What have you found in your servant from the day I entered your service until now, that I may not go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So David said to Achish, "But what have I done? And to this day what have you found in your servant as long as I have been with you, that I may not go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?"
verses.textEnNlt: "What have I done to deserve this treatment?" David demanded. "What have you ever found in your servant, that I can’t go and fight the enemies of my lord the king?"
verses.textEnNasb: However, David said to Achish, "But what have I done? And what have you found in your servant since the day that I came before you, to this day, that I cannot go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?"
verses.textEn: "But what have I done?" asked David. "What have you found against your servant from the day I came to you until now? Why can’t I go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?"

verses.textZh: 亚吉回答大卫，说："我知道你在我眼中是个好人，像神的使者一样；只是非利士人的领袖曾经说过：‘他不可与我们一同上战场。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚吉回答大卫，说："我知道你在我眼中是个好人，像神的使者一样；只是非利士人的领袖曾经说过：‘他不可与我们一同上战场。’
verses.textZhCuv: 亚吉说：「我知道你在我眼前是好人，如同神的使者一般；只是非利士人的首领说：『这人不可同我们出战。』
verses.textEnNiv: Achish answered, "I know that you have been as pleasing in my eyes as an angel of God; nevertheless, the Philistine commanders have said, ‘He must not go up with us into battle.’
verses.textEnEsv: And Achish answered David and said, "I know that you are as blameless in my sight as an angel of God. Nevertheless, the commanders of the Philistines have said, ‘He shall not go up with us to the battle.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Achish answered and said to David, "I know that you are as good in my sight as an angel of God; nevertheless the princes of the Philistines have said, ‘He shall not go up with us to the battle.’
verses.textEnNlt: But Achish insisted, "As far as I’m concerned, you’re as perfect as an angel of God. But the Philistine commanders are afraid to have you with them in the battle.
verses.textEnNasb: But Achish replied to David, "I know that you are pleasing in my sight, like an angel of God; nevertheless the commanders of the Philistines have said, ‘He must not go up with us into the battle.’
verses.textEn: Achish answered, "I know that you have been as pleasing in my eyes as an angel of God; nevertheless, the Philistine commanders have said, ‘He must not go up with us into battle.’

verses.textZh: 所以明天早晨，你和跟你来的人，就是你主人的仆人都要清早起来。你们明天早晨都要早起，天一亮你们就要离开。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以明天早晨，你和跟你来的人，就是你主人的仆人都要清早起来。你们明天早晨都要早起，天一亮你们就要离开。"
verses.textZhCuv: 故此你和跟随你的人，就是你本主的仆人，要明日早晨起来，等到天亮回去吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: Now get up early, along with your master’s servants who have come with you, and leave in the morning as soon as it is light."
verses.textEnEsv: Now then rise early in the morning with the servants of your lord who came with you, and start early in the morning, and depart as soon as you have light."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, rise early in the morning with your master’s servants who have come with you. And as soon as you are up early in the morning and have light, depart."
verses.textEnNlt: Now get up early in the morning, and leave with your men as soon as it gets light."
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, rise early in the morning with the servants of your lord who have come with you, and as soon as you have risen early in the morning and have light, leave."
verses.textEn: Now get up early, along with your master’s servants who have come with you, and leave in the morning as soon as it is light."

verses.textZh: 于是大卫和跟随他的人清早起来，一早就离开，回到非利士人的地去。非利士人也上耶斯列去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫和跟随他的人清早起来，一早就离开，回到非利士人的地去。非利士人也上耶斯列去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是大卫和跟随他的人早晨起来，回往非利士地去。非利士人也上耶斯列去了。
verses.textEnNiv: So David and his men got up early in the morning to go back to the land of the Philistines, and the Philistines went up to Jezreel.
verses.textEnEsv: So David set out with his men early in the morning to return to the land of the Philistines. But the Philistines went up to Jezreel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David and his men rose early to depart in the morning, to return to the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went up to Jezreel.
verses.textEnNlt: So David and his men headed back into the land of the Philistines, while the Philistine army went on to Jezreel.
verses.textEnNasb: So David got up early, he and his men, to leave in the morning to return to the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went up to Jezreel.
verses.textEn: So David and his men got up early in the morning to go back to the land of the Philistines, and the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

verses.textZh: 第三天，大卫和跟随他的人到了洗革拉。那时亚玛力人袭击了南地和洗革拉。他们攻破了洗革拉，又放火焚烧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第三天，大卫和跟随他的人到了洗革拉。那时亚玛力人袭击了南地和洗革拉。他们攻破了洗革拉，又放火焚烧。
verses.textZhCuv: 第三日，大卫和跟随他的人到了洗革拉。亚玛力人已经侵夺南地，攻破洗革拉，用火焚烧，
verses.textEnNiv: David and his men reached Ziklag on the third day. Now the Amalekites had raided the Negev and Ziklag. They had attacked Ziklag and burned it,
verses.textEnEsv: Now when David and his men came to Ziklag on the third day, the Amalekites had made a raid against the Negeb and against Ziklag. They had overcome Ziklag and burned it with fire
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, when David and his men came to Ziklag, on the third day, that the Amalekites had invaded the South and Ziklag, attacked Ziklag and burned it with fire,
verses.textEnNlt: Three days later, when David and his men arrived home at their town of Ziklag, they found that the Amalekites had made a raid into the Negev and Ziklag; they had crushed Ziklag and burned it to the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it happened, when David and his men came to Ziklag on the third day, that the Amalekites had carried out an attack on the Negev and on Ziklag, and had overthrown Ziklag and burned it with fire;
verses.textEn: David and his men reached Ziklag on the third day. Now the Amalekites had raided the Negev and Ziklag. They had attacked Ziklag and burned it,

verses.textZh: 他们把城里的妇女，无论大小都掳走了 。他们没有杀人，都带着他们从原路回去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把城里的妇女，无论大小都掳走了 。他们没有杀人，都带着他们从原路回去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 掳了城内的妇女和其中的大小人口，却没有杀一个，都带着走了。
verses.textEnNiv: and had taken captive the women and everyone else in it, both young and old. They killed none of them, but carried them off as they went on their way.
verses.textEnEsv: and taken captive the women and all who were in it, both small and great. They killed no one, but carried them off and went their way.
verses.textEnNkjv: and had taken captive the women and those who were there, from small to great; they did not kill anyone, but carried them away and went their way.
verses.textEnNlt: They had carried off the women and children and everyone else but without killing anyone.
verses.textEnNasb: and they took captive the women and all who were in it, from the small to the great, without killing anyone, and drove them off and went their way.
verses.textEn: and had taken captive the women and everyone else in it, both young and old. They killed none of them, but carried them off as they went on their way.

verses.textZh: 大卫和跟随他的人到了那城，看见城已经被火烧毁，他们的妻子、儿女都被掳走了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫和跟随他的人到了那城，看见城已经被火烧毁，他们的妻子、儿女都被掳走了，
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫和跟随他的人到了那城，不料，城已烧毁，他们的妻子儿女都被掳去了。
verses.textEnNiv: When David and his men reached Ziklag, they found it destroyed by fire and their wives and sons and daughters taken captive.
verses.textEnEsv: And when David and his men came to the city, they found it burned with fire, and their wives and sons and daughters taken captive.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David and his men came to the city, and there it was, burned with fire; and their wives, their sons, and their daughters had been taken captive.
verses.textEnNlt: When David and his men saw the ruins and realized what had happened to their families,
verses.textEnNasb: When David and his men came to the city, behold, it was burned with fire, and their wives, their sons, and their daughters had been taken captive.
verses.textEn: When David and his men reached Ziklag, they found it destroyed by fire and their wives and sons and daughters taken captive.

verses.textZh: 就放声大哭，直哭到没有力气再哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就放声大哭，直哭到没有力气再哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫和跟随他的人就放声大哭，直哭得没有气力。
verses.textEnNiv: So David and his men wept aloud until they had no strength left to weep.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David and the people who were with him raised their voices and wept until they had no more strength to weep.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David and the people who were with him lifted up their voices and wept, until they had no more power to weep.
verses.textEnNlt: they wept until they could weep no more.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David and the people who were with him raised their voices and wept until there was no strength in them to weep.
verses.textEn: So David and his men wept aloud until they had no strength left to weep.

verses.textZh: 大卫的两个妻子，耶斯列人亚希暖和作过拿八妻子的迦密人亚比该，也都被掳去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的两个妻子，耶斯列人亚希暖和作过拿八妻子的迦密人亚比该，也都被掳去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫的两个妻－耶斯列人亚希暖和作过拿八妻的迦密人亚比该，也被掳去了。
verses.textEnNiv: David’s two wives had been captured—Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail, the widow of Nabal of Carmel.
verses.textEnEsv: David’s two wives also had been taken captive, Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David’s two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the widow of Nabal the Carmelite, had been taken captive.
verses.textEnNlt: David’s two wives, Ahinoam from Jezreel and Abigail, the widow of Nabal from Carmel, were among those captured.
verses.textEnNasb: Now David’s two wives had been taken captive, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess and Abigail the widow of Nabal the Carmelite.
verses.textEn: David’s two wives had been captured—Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail, the widow of Nabal of Carmel.

verses.textZh: 大卫处境非常困难，因为众人都为自己的儿女心中苦恼，说要用石头打死大卫；但大卫靠着耶和华他的神坚强起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫处境非常困难，因为众人都为自己的儿女心中苦恼，说要用石头打死大卫；但大卫靠着耶和华他的神坚强起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫甚是焦急，因众人为自己的儿女苦恼，说：「要用石头打死他。」大卫却倚靠耶和华－他的神，心里坚固。
verses.textEnNiv: David was greatly distressed because the men were talking of stoning him; each one was bitter in spirit because of his sons and daughters. But David found strength in the Lord his God.
verses.textEnEsv: And David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because all the people were bitter in soul, each for his sons and daughters. But David strengthened himself in the Lord his God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and his daughters. But David strengthened himself in the Lord his God.
verses.textEnNlt: David was now in great danger because all his men were very bitter about losing their sons and daughters, and they began to talk of stoning him. But David found strength in the Lord his God.
verses.textEnNasb: Also, David was in great distress because the people spoke of stoning him, for all the people were embittered, each one because of his sons and his daughters. But David felt strengthened in the Lord his God.
verses.textEn: David was greatly distressed because the men were talking of stoning him; each one was bitter in spirit because of his sons and daughters. But David found strength in the Lord his God.

verses.textZh: 大卫对亚希米勒的儿子、亚比亚他祭司说："请你把以弗得带到我这里来。"亚比亚他就把以弗得带到大卫那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对亚希米勒的儿子、亚比亚他祭司说："请你把以弗得带到我这里来。"亚比亚他就把以弗得带到大卫那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对亚希米勒的儿子祭司亚比亚他说：「请你将以弗得拿过来。」亚比亚他就将以弗得拿到大卫面前。
verses.textEnNiv: Then David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelek, "Bring me the ephod." Abiathar brought it to him,
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, "Bring me the ephod." So Abiathar brought the ephod to David.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David said to Abiathar the priest, Ahimelech’s son, "Please bring the ephod here to me." And Abiathar brought the ephod to David.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to Abiathar the priest, "Bring me the ephod!" So Abiathar brought it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, "Please bring me the ephod." So Abiathar brought the ephod to David.
verses.textEn: Then David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelek, "Bring me the ephod." Abiathar brought it to him,

verses.textZh: 大卫求问耶和华说："我可以追赶这群匪徒吗？我可以追上他们吗？"耶和华回答他："你可以追赶，你必定追上，也必定把一切救回来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫求问耶和华说："我可以追赶这群匪徒吗？我可以追上他们吗？"耶和华回答他："你可以追赶，你必定追上，也必定把一切救回来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫求问耶和华说：「我追赶敌军，追得上追不上呢？」耶和华说：「你可以追，必追得上，都救得回来。」
verses.textEnNiv: and David inquired of the Lord , "Shall I pursue this raiding party? Will I overtake them?" "Pursue them," he answered. "You will certainly overtake them and succeed in the rescue."
verses.textEnEsv: And David inquired of the Lord , "Shall I pursue after this band? Shall I overtake them?" He answered him, "Pursue, for you shall surely overtake and shall surely rescue."
verses.textEnNkjv: So David inquired of the Lord, saying, "Shall I pursue this troop? Shall I overtake them?" And He answered him, "Pursue, for you shall surely overtake them and without fail recover all."
verses.textEnNlt: Then David asked the Lord , "Should I chase after this band of raiders? Will I catch them?" And the Lord told him, "Yes, go after them. You will surely recover everything that was taken from you!"
verses.textEnNasb: And David inquired of the Lord, saying, "Shall I pursue this band of raiders? Will I overtake them?" And He said to him, "Pursue, for you will certainly overtake them, and you will certainly rescue everyone."
verses.textEn: and David inquired of the Lord , "Shall I pursue this raiding party? Will I overtake them?" "Pursue them," he answered. "You will certainly overtake them and succeed in the rescue."

verses.textZh: 于是大卫和跟随他的六百人出发。他们到了比梭溪，有些跟不上的就留在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫和跟随他的六百人出发。他们到了比梭溪，有些跟不上的就留在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，大卫和跟随他的六百人来到比梭溪；有不能前去的就留在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: David and the six hundred men with him came to the Besor Valley, where some stayed behind.
verses.textEnEsv: So David set out, and the six hundred men who were with him, and they came to the brook Besor, where those who were left behind stayed.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David went, he and the six hundred men who were with him, and came to the Brook Besor, where those stayed who were left behind.
verses.textEnNlt: So David and his 600 men set out, and they came to the brook Besor.
verses.textEnNasb: So David left, he and the six hundred men who were with him, and they came to the brook Besor, where some who were left behind stayed.
verses.textEn: David and the six hundred men with him came to the Besor Valley, where some stayed behind.

verses.textZh: 有二百人太疲乏，不能渡过比梭溪，就留在那里，大卫和四百人继续追赶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有二百人太疲乏，不能渡过比梭溪，就留在那里，大卫和四百人继续追赶。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫却带着四百人往前追赶，有二百人疲乏，不能过比梭溪，所以留在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Two hundred of them were too exhausted to cross the valley, but David and the other four hundred continued the pursuit.
verses.textEnEsv: But David pursued, he and four hundred men. Two hundred stayed behind, who were too exhausted to cross the brook Besor.
verses.textEnNkjv: But David pursued, he and four hundred men; for two hundred stayed behind, who were so weary that they could not cross the Brook Besor.
verses.textEnNlt: But 200 of the men were too exhausted to cross the brook, so David continued the pursuit with 400 men.
verses.textEnNasb: But David pursued, he and four hundred men, for two hundred who were too exhausted to cross the brook Besor stayed behind.
verses.textEn: Two hundred of them were too exhausted to cross the valley, but David and the other four hundred continued the pursuit.

verses.textZh: 他们在田野里遇见一个埃及人，就把他带到大卫那里。他们给他饭吃，又给他水喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在田野里遇见一个埃及人，就把他带到大卫那里。他们给他饭吃，又给他水喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 这四百人在田野遇见一个埃及人，就带他到大卫面前，给他饼吃，给他水喝，
verses.textEnNiv: They found an Egyptian in a field and brought him to David. They gave him water to drink and food to eat—
verses.textEnEsv: They found an Egyptian in the open country and brought him to David. And they gave him bread and he ate. They gave him water to drink,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David; and they gave him bread and he ate, and they let him drink water.
verses.textEnNlt: Along the way they found an Egyptian man in a field and brought him to David. They gave him some bread to eat and water to drink.
verses.textEnNasb: Now they found an Egyptian in the field and brought him to David, and gave him bread and he ate, and they provided him water to drink.
verses.textEn: They found an Egyptian in a field and brought him to David. They gave him water to drink and food to eat—

verses.textZh: 又给他一块无花果饼，两个葡萄饼。他吃了，精神就恢复过来，因为他已经三天三夜没有吃东西，没有喝水了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又给他一块无花果饼，两个葡萄饼。他吃了，精神就恢复过来，因为他已经三天三夜没有吃东西，没有喝水了。
verses.textZhCuv: 又给他一块无花果饼，两个葡萄饼。他吃了，就精神复原；因为他三日三夜没有吃饼，没有喝水。
verses.textEnNiv: part of a cake of pressed figs and two cakes of raisins. He ate and was revived, for he had not eaten any food or drunk any water for three days and three nights.
verses.textEnEsv: and they gave him a piece of a cake of figs and two clusters of raisins. And when he had eaten, his spirit revived, for he had not eaten bread or drunk water for three days and three nights.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs and two clusters of raisins. So when he had eaten, his strength came back to him; for he had eaten no bread nor drunk water for three days and three nights.
verses.textEnNlt: They also gave him part of a fig cake and two clusters of raisins, for he hadn’t had anything to eat or drink for three days and nights. Before long his strength returned.
verses.textEnNasb: They also gave him a slice of fig cake and two cakes of raisins, and he ate; then his spirit revived. For he had not eaten bread or drunk water for three days and three nights.
verses.textEn: part of a cake of pressed figs and two cakes of raisins. He ate and was revived, for he had not eaten any food or drunk any water for three days and three nights.

verses.textZh: 大卫问他："你是属谁的？你从哪里来？"他回答："我是个埃及的青年人，是亚玛力人的奴仆。因为我三天前病了，我的主人就把我丢弃了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫问他："你是属谁的？你从哪里来？"他回答："我是个埃及的青年人，是亚玛力人的奴仆。因为我三天前病了，我的主人就把我丢弃了。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫问他说：「你是属谁的？你是哪里的人？」他回答说：「我是埃及的少年人，是亚玛力人的奴仆；因我三日前患病，我主人就把我撇弃了。
verses.textEnNiv: David asked him, "Who do you belong to? Where do you come from?" He said, "I am an Egyptian, the slave of an Amalekite. My master abandoned me when I became ill three days ago.
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to him, "To whom do you belong? And where are you from?" He said, "I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite, and my master left me behind because I fell sick three days ago.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David said to him, "To whom do you belong, and where are you from?" And he said, "I am a young man from Egypt, servant of an Amalekite; and my master left me behind, because three days ago I fell sick.
verses.textEnNlt: "To whom do you belong, and where do you come from?" David asked him. "I am an Egyptian—the slave of an Amalekite," he replied. "My master abandoned me three days ago because I was sick.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to him, "To whom do you belong? And where are you from?" And he said, "I am a young man of Egypt, a servant of an Amalekite; and my master abandoned me when I became sick three days ago.
verses.textEn: David asked him, "Who do you belong to? Where do you come from?" He said, "I am an Egyptian, the slave of an Amalekite. My master abandoned me when I became ill three days ago.

verses.textZh: 我们侵袭了基利提的南方和属犹大地的南方，以及迦勒地的南方，又用火烧了洗革拉。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们侵袭了基利提的南方和属犹大地的南方，以及迦勒地的南方，又用火烧了洗革拉。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们侵夺了基利提的南方和属犹大的地，并迦勒地的南方，又用火烧了洗革拉。」
verses.textEnNiv: We raided the Negev of the Kerethites, some territory belonging to Judah and the Negev of Caleb. And we burned Ziklag."
verses.textEnEsv: We had made a raid against the Negeb of the Cherethites and against that which belongs to Judah and against the Negeb of Caleb, and we burned Ziklag with fire."
verses.textEnNkjv: We made an invasion of the southern area of the Cherethites, in the territory which belongs to Judah, and of the southern area of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire."
verses.textEnNlt: We were on our way back from raiding the Kerethites in the Negev, the territory of Judah, and the land of Caleb, and we had just burned Ziklag."
verses.textEnNasb: We carried out an attack on the Negev of the Cherethites, and on that which belongs to Judah, and on the Negev of Caleb, and we burned Ziklag with fire."
verses.textEn: We raided the Negev of the Kerethites, some territory belonging to Judah and the Negev of Caleb. And we burned Ziklag."

verses.textZh: 大卫对他说："你愿意带我下到那一群匪徒那里吗？"他回答："如果你指着神向我起誓，不杀死我，也不把我交在我主人手里，我就带你下到那一群匪徒那里去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对他说："你愿意带我下到那一群匪徒那里吗？"他回答："如果你指着神向我起誓，不杀死我，也不把我交在我主人手里，我就带你下到那一群匪徒那里去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫问他说：「你肯领我们到敌军那里不肯？」他回答说：「你要向我指着神起誓，不杀我，也不将我交在我主人手里，我就领你下到敌军那里。」
verses.textEnNiv: David asked him, "Can you lead me down to this raiding party?" He answered, "Swear to me before God that you will not kill me or hand me over to my master, and I will take you down to them."
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to him, "Will you take me down to this band?" And he said, "Swear to me by God that you will not kill me or deliver me into the hands of my master, and I will take you down to this band."
verses.textEnNkjv: And David said to him, "Can you take me down to this troop?" So he said, "Swear to me by God that you will neither kill me nor deliver me into the hands of my master, and I will take you down to this troop."
verses.textEnNlt: "Will you lead me to this band of raiders?" David asked. The young man replied, "If you take an oath in God’s name that you will not kill me or give me back to my master, then I will guide you to them."
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to him, "Will you bring me down to this band of raiders?" And he said, "Swear to me by God that you will not kill me or hand me over to my master, and I will bring you down to this band."
verses.textEn: David asked him, "Can you lead me down to this raiding party?" He answered, "Swear to me before God that you will not kill me or hand me over to my master, and I will take you down to them."

verses.textZh: 他带大卫下去。匪徒们都分散在各处，正在吃喝、跳舞，因为他们从非利士地和犹大地抢来的战利品很多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他带大卫下去。匪徒们都分散在各处，正在吃喝、跳舞，因为他们从非利士地和犹大地抢来的战利品很多。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人领大卫下去，见他们散在地上，吃喝跳舞，因为从非利士地和犹大地所掳来的财物甚多。
verses.textEnNiv: He led David down, and there they were, scattered over the countryside, eating, drinking and reveling because of the great amount of plunder they had taken from the land of the Philistines and from Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had taken him down, behold, they were spread abroad over all the land, eating and drinking and dancing, because of all the great spoil they had taken from the land of the Philistines and from the land of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he had brought him down, there they were, spread out over all the land, eating and drinking and dancing, because of all the great spoil which they had taken from the land of the Philistines and from the land of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: So he led David to them, and they found the Amalekites spread out across the fields, eating and drinking and dancing with joy because of the vast amount of plunder they had taken from the Philistines and the land of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when he had brought him down, behold, they were dispersed over all the land, eating and drinking and celebrating because of all the great plunder that they had taken from the land of the Philistines and from the land of Judah.
verses.textEn: He led David down, and there they were, scattered over the countryside, eating, drinking and reveling because of the great amount of plunder they had taken from the land of the Philistines and from Judah.

verses.textZh: 大卫击杀他们，从黄昏直到次日的晚上。除了四百个骑骆驼的年轻人逃跑了以外，他们当中一个人也没有逃脱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫击杀他们，从黄昏直到次日的晚上。除了四百个骑骆驼的年轻人逃跑了以外，他们当中一个人也没有逃脱。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫从黎明直到次日晚上，击杀他们，除了四百骑骆驼的少年人之外，没有一个逃脱的。
verses.textEnNiv: David fought them from dusk until the evening of the next day, and none of them got away, except four hundred young men who rode off on camels and fled.
verses.textEnEsv: And David struck them down from twilight until the evening of the next day, and not a man of them escaped, except four hundred young men, who mounted camels and fled.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David attacked them from twilight until the evening of the next day. Not a man of them escaped, except four hundred young men who rode on camels and fled.
verses.textEnNlt: David and his men rushed in among them and slaughtered them throughout that night and the entire next day until evening. None of the Amalekites escaped except 400 young men who fled on camels.
verses.textEnNasb: And David slaughtered them from the twilight until the evening of the next day; and not a man of them escaped, except four hundred young men who rode on camels and fled.
verses.textEn: David fought them from dusk until the evening of the next day, and none of them got away, except four hundred young men who rode off on camels and fled.

verses.textZh: 亚玛力人抢去的一切，大卫都救回来了，也救回了他的两个妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚玛力人抢去的一切，大卫都救回来了，也救回了他的两个妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚玛力人所掳去的财物，大卫全都夺回，并救回他的两个妻来。
verses.textEnNiv: David recovered everything the Amalekites had taken, including his two wives.
verses.textEnEsv: David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken, and David rescued his two wives.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away, and David rescued his two wives.
verses.textEnNlt: David got back everything the Amalekites had taken, and he rescued his two wives.
verses.textEnNasb: So David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken, and rescued his two wives.
verses.textEn: David recovered everything the Amalekites had taken, including his two wives.

verses.textZh: 无论大小，不分男女，无论是他们抢来的，或是被人掳去的，大卫都夺回来，没有失落一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论大小，不分男女，无论是他们抢来的，或是被人掳去的，大卫都夺回来，没有失落一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡亚玛力人所掳去的，无论大小、儿女、财物，大卫都夺回来，没有失落一个。
verses.textEnNiv: Nothing was missing: young or old, boy or girl, plunder or anything else they had taken. David brought everything back.
verses.textEnEsv: Nothing was missing, whether small or great, sons or daughters, spoil or anything that had been taken. David brought back all.
verses.textEnNkjv: And nothing of theirs was lacking, either small or great, sons or daughters, spoil or anything which they had taken from them; David recovered all.
verses.textEnNlt: Nothing was missing: small or great, son or daughter, nor anything else that had been taken. David brought everything back.
verses.textEnNasb: And nothing of theirs was missing, whether small or great, sons or daughters, plunder, or anything that they had taken for themselves; David brought it all back.
verses.textEn: Nothing was missing: young or old, boy or girl, plunder or anything else they had taken. David brought everything back.

verses.textZh: 大卫夺了所有的羊群和牛群，跟从大卫的人把牠们赶到原有的群畜面前，说："这是大卫的战利品。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫夺了所有的羊群和牛群，跟从大卫的人把牠们赶到原有的群畜面前，说："这是大卫的战利品。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫所夺来的牛群羊群，跟随他的人赶在原有的群畜前边，说：「这是大卫的掠物。」
verses.textEnNiv: He took all the flocks and herds, and his men drove them ahead of the other livestock, saying, "This is David’s plunder."
verses.textEnEsv: David also captured all the flocks and herds, and the people drove the livestock before him, and said, "This is David’s spoil."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David took all the flocks and herds they had driven before those other livestock, and said, "This is David’s spoil."
verses.textEnNlt: He also recovered all the flocks and herds, and his men drove them ahead of the other livestock. "This plunder belongs to David!" they said.
verses.textEnNasb: So David had captured all the sheep and the cattle which the people drove ahead of the other livestock, and they said, "This is David’s plunder."
verses.textEn: He took all the flocks and herds, and his men drove them ahead of the other livestock, saying, "This is David’s plunder."

verses.textZh: 大卫来到那二百人那里，那些人因太疲乏不能跟随大卫去，而留在比梭溪旁；他们出来迎接大卫和跟随他的众人。大卫接近众人的时候，就向他们问安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫来到那二百人那里，那些人因太疲乏不能跟随大卫去，而留在比梭溪旁；他们出来迎接大卫和跟随他的众人。大卫接近众人的时候，就向他们问安。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫到了那疲乏不能跟随、留在比梭溪的二百人那里。他们出来迎接大卫并跟随的人。大卫前来问他们安。
verses.textEnNiv: Then David came to the two hundred men who had been too exhausted to follow him and who were left behind at the Besor Valley. They came out to meet David and the men with him. As David and his men approached, he asked them how they were.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David came to the two hundred men who had been too exhausted to follow David, and who had been left at the brook Besor. And they went out to meet David and to meet the people who were with him. And when David came near to the people he greeted them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now David came to the two hundred men who had been so weary that they could not follow David, whom they also had made to stay at the Brook Besor. So they went out to meet David and to meet the people who were with him. And when David came near the people, he greeted them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David returned to the brook Besor and met up with the 200 men who had been left behind because they were too exhausted to go with him. They went out to meet David and his men, and David greeted them joyfully.
verses.textEnNasb: When David came to the two hundred men who were too exhausted to follow David and had been left behind at the brook Besor, and they went out to meet David and to meet the people who were with him, then David approached the people and greeted them.
verses.textEn: Then David came to the two hundred men who had been too exhausted to follow him and who were left behind at the Besor Valley. They came out to meet David and the men with him. As David and his men approached, he asked them how they were.

verses.textZh: 与大卫一起去的那些人中，有些恶人和流氓说："他们没有和我们一起去，我们就不把夺回来的战利品分给他们，只把他们各人的妻子和儿子还给他们，让他们领回去就是了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 与大卫一起去的那些人中，有些恶人和流氓说："他们没有和我们一起去，我们就不把夺回来的战利品分给他们，只把他们各人的妻子和儿子还给他们，让他们领回去就是了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 跟随大卫人中的恶人和匪类说：「这些人既然没有和我们同去，我们所夺的财物就不分给他们，只将他们各人的妻子儿女给他们，使他们带去就是了。」
verses.textEnNiv: But all the evil men and troublemakers among David’s followers said, "Because they did not go out with us, we will not share with them the plunder we recovered. However, each man may take his wife and children and go."
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the wicked and worthless fellows among the men who had gone with David said, "Because they did not go with us, we will not give them any of the spoil that we have recovered, except that each man may lead away his wife and children, and depart."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all the wicked and worthless men of those who went with David answered and said, "Because they did not go with us, we will not give them any of the spoil that we have recovered, except for every man’s wife and children, that they may lead them away and depart."
verses.textEnNlt: But some evil troublemakers among David’s men said, "They didn’t go with us, so they can’t have any of the plunder we recovered. Give them their wives and children, and tell them to be gone."
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the wicked and worthless men among those who went with David said, "Since they did not go with us, we will not give them any of the spoils that we have recovered, except to every man his wife and his children, so that they may lead them away and leave."
verses.textEn: But all the evil men and troublemakers among David’s followers said, "Because they did not go out with us, we will not share with them the plunder we recovered. However, each man may take his wife and children and go."

verses.textZh: 大卫说："兄弟们，耶和华赐给我们的，你们不可以这样作。他保护了我们，又把那些攻击我们的匪徒交在我们手里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫说："兄弟们，耶和华赐给我们的，你们不可以这样作。他保护了我们，又把那些攻击我们的匪徒交在我们手里。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫说：「弟兄们，耶和华所赐给我们的，不可不分给他们；因为他保佑我们，将那攻击我们的敌军交在我们手里。
verses.textEnNiv: David replied, "No, my brothers, you must not do that with what the Lord has given us. He has protected us and delivered into our hands the raiding party that came against us.
verses.textEnEsv: But David said, "You shall not do so, my brothers, with what the Lord has given us. He has preserved us and given into our hand the band that came against us.
verses.textEnNkjv: But David said, "My brethren, you shall not do so with what the Lord has given us, who has preserved us and delivered into our hand the troop that came against us.
verses.textEnNlt: But David said, "No, my brothers! Don’t be selfish with what the Lord has given us. He has kept us safe and helped us defeat the band of raiders that attacked us.
verses.textEnNasb: But David said, "You must not do so, my brothers, with what the Lord has given us, for He has protected us and handed over to us the band of raiders that came against us.
verses.textEn: David replied, "No, my brothers, you must not do that with what the Lord has given us. He has protected us and delivered into our hands the raiding party that came against us.

verses.textZh: 这事谁要听从你们呢？下战场的得多少，留守武器的也得多少，应当大家平分。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事谁要听从你们呢？下战场的得多少，留守武器的也得多少，应当大家平分。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这事谁肯依从你们呢？上阵的得多少，看守器具的也得多少；应当大家平分。」
verses.textEnNiv: Who will listen to what you say? The share of the man who stayed with the supplies is to be the same as that of him who went down to the battle. All will share alike."
verses.textEnEsv: Who would listen to you in this matter? For as his share is who goes down into the battle, so shall his share be who stays by the baggage. They shall share alike."
verses.textEnNkjv: For who will heed you in this matter? But as his part is who goes down to the battle, so shall his part be who stays by the supplies; they shall share alike."
verses.textEnNlt: Who will listen when you talk like this? We share and share alike—those who go to battle and those who guard the equipment."
verses.textEnNasb: And who will listen to you in this matter? For as is the share of the one who goes down into the battle, so shall be the share of the one who stays by the baggage; they shall share alike."
verses.textEn: Who will listen to what you say? The share of the man who stayed with the supplies is to be the same as that of him who went down to the battle. All will share alike."

verses.textZh: 从那天起，大卫定此为以色列的律例典章，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从那天起，大卫定此为以色列的律例典章，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫定此为以色列的律例典章，从那日直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: David made this a statute and ordinance for Israel from that day to this.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made it a statute and a rule for Israel from that day forward to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, from that day forward; he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: From then on David made this a decree and regulation for Israel, and it is still followed today.
verses.textEnNasb: So it has been from that day forward, that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel to this day.
verses.textEn: David made this a statute and ordinance for Israel from that day to this.

verses.textZh: 大卫到了洗革拉，就从战利品中取一部分送给他的朋友、犹大的长老，说："看哪，这是从耶和华的仇敌那里得来的战利品，送给你们作礼物。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫到了洗革拉，就从战利品中取一部分送给他的朋友、犹大的长老，说："看哪，这是从耶和华的仇敌那里得来的战利品，送给你们作礼物。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫到了洗革拉，从掠物中取些送给他朋友犹大的长老，说：「这是从耶和华仇敌那里夺来的，送你们为礼物。」
verses.textEnNiv: When David reached Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah, who were his friends, saying, "Here is a gift for you from the plunder of the Lord ’s enemies."
verses.textEnEsv: When David came to Ziklag, he sent part of the spoil to his friends, the elders of Judah, saying, "Here is a present for you from the spoil of the enemies of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when David came to Ziklag, he sent some of the spoil to the elders of Judah, to his friends, saying, "Here is a present for you from the spoil of the enemies of the Lord"—
verses.textEnNlt: When he arrived at Ziklag, David sent part of the plunder to the elders of Judah, who were his friends. "Here is a present for you, taken from the Lord ’s enemies," he said.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when David came to Ziklag, he sent some of the spoils to the elders of Judah, to his friends, saying, "Behold, a gift for you from the spoils of the enemies of the Lord:
verses.textEn: When David reached Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah, who were his friends, saying, "Here is a gift for you from the plunder of the Lord ’s enemies."

verses.textZh: 他送礼物给在伯特利的、在南地拉末的、在雅提珥的、
verses.textZhCnvs: 他送礼物给在伯特利的、在南地拉末的、在雅提珥的、
verses.textZhCuv: 他送礼物给住伯特利的，南地拉末的，雅提珥的；
verses.textEnNiv: David sent it to those who were in Bethel, Ramoth Negev and Jattir;
verses.textEnEsv: It was for those in Bethel, in Ramoth of the Negeb, in Jattir,
verses.textEnNkjv: to those who were in Bethel, those who were in Ramoth of the South, those who were in Jattir,
verses.textEnNlt: The gifts were sent to the people of the following towns David had visited: Bethel, Ramoth-negev, Jattir,
verses.textEnNasb: to those who were in Bethel, to those who were in Ramoth of the Negev, to those who were in Jattir,
verses.textEn: David sent it to those who were in Bethel, Ramoth Negev and Jattir;

verses.textZh: 在亚罗珥的、在息末的、在以实提莫的、
verses.textZhCnvs: 在亚罗珥的、在息末的、在以实提莫的、
verses.textZhCuv: 住亚罗珥的，息末的，以实提莫的；
verses.textEnNiv: to those in Aroer, Siphmoth, Eshtemoa
verses.textEnEsv: in Aroer, in Siphmoth, in Eshtemoa,
verses.textEnNkjv: those who were in Aroer, those who were in Siphmoth, those who were in Eshtemoa,
verses.textEnNlt: Aroer, Siphmoth, Eshtemoa,
verses.textEnNasb: to those who were in Aroer, to those who were in Siphmoth, to those who were in Eshtemoa,
verses.textEn: to those in Aroer, Siphmoth, Eshtemoa

verses.textZh: 在拉哈勒的、在耶拉蔑各城的、在基尼各城的、
verses.textZhCnvs: 在拉哈勒的、在耶拉蔑各城的、在基尼各城的、
verses.textZhCuv: 住拉哈勒的，耶拉篾各城的，基尼各城的；
verses.textEnNiv: and Rakal; to those in the towns of the Jerahmeelites and the Kenites;
verses.textEnEsv: in Racal, in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, in the cities of the Kenites,
verses.textEnNkjv: those who were in Rachal, those who were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, those who were in the cities of the Kenites,
verses.textEnNlt: Racal, the towns of the Jerahmeelites, the towns of the Kenites,
verses.textEnNasb: to those who were in Racal, to those who were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, to those who were in the cities of the Kenites,
verses.textEn: and Rakal; to those in the towns of the Jerahmeelites and the Kenites;

verses.textZh: 在何珥玛的、在歌拉珊的、在亚挞的、
verses.textZhCnvs: 在何珥玛的、在歌拉珊的、在亚挞的、
verses.textZhCuv: 住何珥玛的，歌拉珊的，亚挞的；
verses.textEnNiv: to those in Hormah, Bor Ashan, Athak
verses.textEnEsv: in Hormah, in Bor-ashan, in Athach,
verses.textEnNkjv: those who were in Hormah, those who were in Chorashan, those who were in Athach,
