verses.textZh: 在希伯仑的人，又送给一切大卫及其跟随者所到过之地的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在希伯仑的人，又送给一切大卫及其跟随者所到过之地的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 住希伯仑的，并大卫和跟随他的人素来所到之处的人。
verses.textEnNiv: and Hebron; and to those in all the other places where he and his men had roamed.
verses.textEnEsv: in Hebron, for all the places where David and his men had roamed.
verses.textEnNkjv: those who were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men were accustomed to rove.
verses.textEnNlt: Hebron, and all the other places David and his men had visited.
verses.textEnNasb: to those who were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men walked."
verses.textEn: and Hebron; and to those in all the other places where he and his men had roamed.

verses.textZh: 非利士人与以色列人交战。以色列人从非利士人面前逃跑，有很多人在基利波山上倒毙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人与以色列人交战。以色列人从非利士人面前逃跑，有很多人在基利波山上倒毙。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人与以色列人争战。以色列人在非利士人面前逃跑，在基利波有被杀仆倒的。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; the Israelites fled before them, and many fell dead on Mount Gilboa.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the Philistines were fighting against Israel, and the men of Israel fled before the Philistines and fell slain on Mount Gilboa.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell slain on Mount Gilboa.
verses.textEnNlt: Now the Philistines attacked Israel, and the men of Israel fled before them. Many were slaughtered on the slopes of Mount Gilboa.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Philistines were fighting against Israel, and the men of Israel fled from the Philistines but fell fatally wounded on Mount Gilboa.
verses.textEn: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; the Israelites fled before them, and many fell dead on Mount Gilboa.

verses.textZh: 非利士人紧紧追赶扫罗和他的众子，击杀了扫罗的儿子约拿单、亚比拿达和麦基舒亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人紧紧追赶扫罗和他的众子，击杀了扫罗的儿子约拿单、亚比拿达和麦基舒亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人紧追扫罗和他儿子们，就杀了扫罗的儿子约拿单、亚比拿达、麦基舒亚。
verses.textEnNiv: The Philistines were in hot pursuit of Saul and his sons, and they killed his sons Jonathan, Abinadab and Malki-Shua.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Philistines overtook Saul and his sons, and the Philistines struck down Jonathan and Abinadab and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Philistines followed hard after Saul and his sons. And the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, Saul’s sons.
verses.textEnNlt: The Philistines closed in on Saul and his sons, and they killed three of his sons—Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malkishua.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Philistines also overtook Saul and his sons, and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.
verses.textEn: The Philistines were in hot pursuit of Saul and his sons, and they killed his sons Jonathan, Abinadab and Malki-Shua.

verses.textZh: 战争激烈，扫罗受到猛烈的攻击，弓箭手发现了他，射箭的人射中了他，他的伤势严重；
verses.textZhCnvs: 战争激烈，扫罗受到猛烈的攻击，弓箭手发现了他，射箭的人射中了他，他的伤势严重；
verses.textZhCuv: 势派甚大，扫罗被弓箭手追上，射伤甚重，
verses.textEnNiv: The fighting grew fierce around Saul, and when the archers overtook him, they wounded him critically.
verses.textEnEsv: The battle pressed hard against Saul, and the archers found him, and he was badly wounded by the archers.
verses.textEnNkjv: The battle became fierce against Saul. The archers hit him, and he was severely wounded by the archers.
verses.textEnNlt: The fighting grew very fierce around Saul, and the Philistine archers caught up with him and wounded him severely.
verses.textEnNasb: The battle went heavily against Saul, and the archers found him; and he was gravely wounded by the archers.
verses.textEn: The fighting grew fierce around Saul, and when the archers overtook him, they wounded him critically.

verses.textZh: 扫罗就对替他拿兵器的人说："拔出你的刀来，把我刺透，免得这些未受割礼的人来把我刺透，戏弄我。"但替他拿兵器的人不肯这样作，因为他非常害怕。于是扫罗拿过刀来，自己伏在刀上死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗就对替他拿兵器的人说："拔出你的刀来，把我刺透，免得这些未受割礼的人来把我刺透，戏弄我。"但替他拿兵器的人不肯这样作，因为他非常害怕。于是扫罗拿过刀来，自己伏在刀上死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 就吩咐拿他兵器的人说：「你拔出刀来，将我刺死，免得那些未受割礼的人来刺我，凌辱我。」但拿兵器的人甚惧怕，不肯刺他；扫罗就自己伏在刀上死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Saul said to his armor-bearer, "Draw your sword and run me through, or these uncircumcised fellows will come and run me through and abuse me." But his armor-bearer was terrified and would not do it; so Saul took his own sword and fell on it.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Saul said to his armor-bearer, "Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through, and mistreat me." But his armor-bearer would not, for he feared greatly. Therefore Saul took his own sword and fell upon it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul said to his armorbearer, "Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised men come and thrust me through and abuse me." But his armorbearer would not, for he was greatly afraid. Therefore Saul took a sword and fell on it.
verses.textEnNlt: Saul groaned to his armor bearer, "Take your sword and kill me before these pagan Philistines come to run me through and taunt and torture me." But his armor bearer was afraid and would not do it. So Saul took his own sword and fell on it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, "Draw your sword and pierce me through with it, otherwise these uncircumcised Philistines will come and pierce me through, and abuse me." But his armor bearer was unwilling, because he was very fearful. So Saul took his sword and fell on it.
verses.textEn: Saul said to his armor-bearer, "Draw your sword and run me through, or these uncircumcised fellows will come and run me through and abuse me." But his armor-bearer was terrified and would not do it; so Saul took his own sword and fell on it.

verses.textZh: 替他拿兵器的人看见扫罗死了，他也伏在自己的刀上，与扫罗一起死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 替他拿兵器的人看见扫罗死了，他也伏在自己的刀上，与扫罗一起死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿兵器的人见扫罗已死，也伏在刀上死了。
verses.textEnNiv: When the armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his sword and died with him.
verses.textEnEsv: And when his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he also fell upon his sword and died with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when his armorbearer saw that Saul was dead, he also fell on his sword, and died with him.
verses.textEnNlt: When his armor bearer realized that Saul was dead, he fell on his own sword and died beside the king.
verses.textEnNasb: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he also fell on his sword and died with him.
verses.textEn: When the armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his sword and died with him.

verses.textZh: 这样，扫罗和他的三个儿子，以及替他拿兵器的人，还有所有跟随他的人，都在那一天一同死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，扫罗和他的三个儿子，以及替他拿兵器的人，还有所有跟随他的人，都在那一天一同死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，扫罗和他三个儿子，与拿他兵器的人，以及跟随他的人，都一同死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: So Saul and his three sons and his armor-bearer and all his men died together that same day.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus Saul died, and his three sons, and his armor-bearer, and all his men, on the same day together.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Saul, his three sons, his armorbearer, and all his men died together that same day.
verses.textEnNlt: So Saul, his three sons, his armor bearer, and his troops all died together that same day.
verses.textEnNasb: So Saul died with his three sons, his armor bearer, and all his men on that day together.
verses.textEn: So Saul and his three sons and his armor-bearer and all his men died together that same day.

verses.textZh: 在山谷那边，和约旦河那边的以色列人，看见以色列人逃跑，扫罗和他的儿子都死了，他们就弃城逃跑。非利士人就来住在城中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在山谷那边，和约旦河那边的以色列人，看见以色列人逃跑，扫罗和他的儿子都死了，他们就弃城逃跑。非利士人就来住在城中。
verses.textZhCuv: 住平原那边并约旦河西的以色列人，见以色列军兵逃跑，扫罗和他儿子都死了，也就弃城逃跑。非利士人便来住在其中。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Israelites along the valley and those across the Jordan saw that the Israelite army had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, they abandoned their towns and fled. And the Philistines came and occupied them.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the men of Israel who were on the other side of the valley and those beyond the Jordan saw that the men of Israel had fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities and fled. And the Philistines came and lived in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the men of Israel who were on the other side of the valley, and those who were on the other side of the Jordan, saw that the men of Israel had fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook the cities and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Israelites on the other side of the Jezreel Valley and beyond the Jordan saw that the Israelite army had fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their towns and fled. So the Philistines moved in and occupied their towns.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the people of Israel who were on the other side of the valley, with those who were beyond the Jordan, saw that the men of Israel had fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned the cities and fled; then the Philistines came and settled in them.
verses.textEn: When the Israelites along the valley and those across the Jordan saw that the Israelite army had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, they abandoned their towns and fled. And the Philistines came and occupied them.

verses.textZh: 第二天，非利士人来剥那些被杀的人的衣物的时候，发现扫罗和他的三个儿子都倒毙在基利波山上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，非利士人来剥那些被杀的人的衣物的时候，发现扫罗和他的三个儿子都倒毙在基利波山上，
verses.textZhCuv: 次日，非利士人来剥那被杀之人的衣服，看见扫罗和他三个儿子仆倒在基利波山，
verses.textEnNiv: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
verses.textEnEsv: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it happened the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
verses.textEnNlt: The next day, when the Philistines went out to strip the dead, they found the bodies of Saul and his three sons on Mount Gilboa.
verses.textEnNasb: It came about on the next day, when the Philistines came to strip those killed, that they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
verses.textEn: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

verses.textZh: 就砍下他的头，解下他的兵器，又派人到非利士地的各处，去向他们的偶像的庙和人民报信。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就砍下他的头，解下他的兵器，又派人到非利士地的各处，去向他们的偶像的庙和人民报信。
verses.textZhCuv: 就割下他的首级，剥了他的军装，打发人到 非利士地的四境，报信与他们庙里的偶像和众民；
verses.textEnNiv: They cut off his head and stripped off his armor, and they sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to proclaim the news in the temple of their idols and among their people.
verses.textEnEsv: So they cut off his head and stripped off his armor and sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines, to carry the good news to the house of their idols and to the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they cut off his head and stripped off his armor, and sent word throughout the land of the Philistines, to proclaim itin the temple of their idols and among the people.
verses.textEnNlt: So they cut off Saul’s head and stripped off his armor. Then they proclaimed the good news of Saul’s death in their pagan temple and to the people throughout the land of Philistia.
verses.textEnNasb: They cut off his head and stripped off his weapons, and sent them throughout the land of the Philistines, to bring the good news to the house of their idols and to the people.
verses.textEn: They cut off his head and stripped off his armor, and they sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to proclaim the news in the temple of their idols and among their people.

verses.textZh: 他们把扫罗的兵器放在亚斯他录的庙里，又把他的尸体钉在伯．珊的城墙上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把扫罗的兵器放在亚斯他录的庙里，又把他的尸体钉在伯．珊的城墙上。
verses.textZhCuv: 又将扫罗的军装放在亚斯她录庙里，将他的尸身钉在伯‧珊的城墙上。
verses.textEnNiv: They put his armor in the temple of the Ashtoreths and fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.
verses.textEnEsv: They put his armor in the temple of Ashtaroth, and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth-shan.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they put his armor in the temple of the Ashtoreths, and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.
verses.textEnNlt: They placed his armor in the temple of the Ashtoreths, and they fastened his body to the wall of the city of Beth-shan.
verses.textEnNasb: They put his weapons in the temple of Ashtaroth, and they nailed his body to the wall of Beth-shan.
verses.textEn: They put his armor in the temple of the Ashtoreths and fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.

verses.textZh: 基列．雅比的居民听见非利士人向扫罗所行的事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 基列．雅比的居民听见非利士人向扫罗所行的事，
verses.textZhCuv: 基列‧雅比的居民听见非利士人向扫罗所行的事，
verses.textEnNiv: When the people of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.textEnEsv: But when the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.textEnNlt: But when the people of Jabesh-gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.textEn: When the people of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,

verses.textZh: 所有的勇士就动身，走了一整夜，把扫罗的尸体和他三个儿子的尸体都从伯．珊的城墙上取下来，带回雅比，在那里把他们烧了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有的勇士就动身，走了一整夜，把扫罗的尸体和他三个儿子的尸体都从伯．珊的城墙上取下来，带回雅比，在那里把他们烧了，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们中间所有的勇士就起身，走了一夜，将扫罗和他儿子的尸身从伯‧珊城墙上取下来，送到雅比那里，用火烧了；
verses.textEnNiv: all their valiant men marched through the night to Beth Shan. They took down the bodies of Saul and his sons from the wall of Beth Shan and went to Jabesh, where they burned them.
verses.textEnEsv: all the valiant men arose and went all night and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth-shan, and they came to Jabesh and burned them there.
verses.textEnNkjv: all the valiant men arose and traveled all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth Shan; and they came to Jabesh and burned them there.
verses.textEnNlt: all their mighty warriors traveled through the night to Beth-shan and took the bodies of Saul and his sons down from the wall. They brought them to Jabesh, where they burned the bodies.
verses.textEnNasb: all the valiant men got up and walked all night, and they took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth-shan, and they came to Jabesh and burned them there.
verses.textEn: all their valiant men marched through the night to Beth Shan. They took down the bodies of Saul and his sons from the wall of Beth Shan and went to Jabesh, where they burned them.

verses.textZh: 又把他们的骸骨埋葬在雅比的垂柳树下，并且禁食七天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又把他们的骸骨埋葬在雅比的垂柳树下，并且禁食七天。
verses.textZhCuv: 将他们骸骨葬在雅比的垂丝柳树下，就禁食七日。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they took their bones and buried them under a tamarisk tree at Jabesh, and they fasted seven days.
verses.textEnEsv: And they took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh and fasted seven days.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree at Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they took their bones and buried them beneath the tamarisk tree at Jabesh, and they fasted for seven days.
verses.textEnNasb: And they took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh, and fasted for seven days.
verses.textEn: Then they took their bones and buried them under a tamarisk tree at Jabesh, and they fasted seven days.
